------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE atualizacursor
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE atualizacursor
ThisForm.Caption = _Dope

* Richard em 06/08/2014 - Alterando Caption Conforme Confguração da Movimentação
lcMnu = fRetDopMenu(_Dope, [], ThisForm.poDataMgr)
If Not Empty(lcMnu)
	ThisForm.Caption = Alltrim(lcMnu)
EndIf

lcQueryOpe = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+_Dope+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQueryOpe,'crSigCdOpe')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdOpe)')
	ThisForm.pagina.lista.grupo_saida.sair.Click()
	return
EndIf

Select crSigCdOpe
Go Top

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',_Dope) 

If InList( crSigCdOpe.SubNs, 1, 3, 4, 5 )
	lcOperacao = crSigCdOpe.Dopes
	lcWher = [Select a.cDopes, a.cNivels, b.nDopes, a.TpFats, b.CupFis From SigOpCsn a, SigCdOpe b ]+;
			 [Where a.cDopes = ?lcOperacao And a.cNivels = b.Dopes]
	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWher,'CsSigOpCsn')	 
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsSigOpCsn 1)')
		ThisForm.pagina.lista.grupo_saida.sair.Click()
	EndIf
	Select csSigOpCsn
	If Reccount() = 0
		lcWher = [Select a.Dopes As cDopes, a.Nivels As cNivels, a.nDopes, '   ' as TpFats, a.CupFis From SigCdOpe a ]+;
				 [Where a.Dopes = ?lcOperacao]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWher,'CsSigOpCsn')	 
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsSigOpCsn 2)')
			ThisForm.pagina.lista.grupo_saida.sair.Click()
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Select csSigOpCsn
	Index On NDopes Tag NDopes
EndIf

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorQuery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe',.f.,.f.,[CodProPads, Dopes ])
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorQuery('SigOpCdc','TmpdcOpe','Dopes',_Dope,[InibePa])

Select Distinct CodProPads as CPros, Dopes ;
  From TmpOpe ;
 Where (Dopes <> _Dope) And Not Empty(CodProPads) And TmpDcOpe.InibePa <> 2 ;
  Into Cursor csOpeAut
Index On CPros Tag CPros

lcWher = [Select Dopeds as Dopes, Cpros From SigOpTrf ]+;
		 [Where Dopes = ?_Dope Group by Dopeds,Cpros]

lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWher,'CsOpeTrf')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsOpeTrf)')
	ThisForm.pagina.lista.grupo_saida.sair.Click()
EndIf

Select CsOpeTrf
Index On Cpros + Dopes Tag Cpros


ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE atuatot
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE atuatot
Lparameters pCalcFrete

Local _Rec, _valos, _valinis, _valdevs, ndope, dope, nume, lnipi, lnicm, _ParAuto, _VlFrete, _CarOpCr
Local lnIpiFrt,lnIcmFrt,lnValSeg,lnIpiSeg,lnIcmSeg,lnIpiDes,lnIcmDes

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

_ParAuto = crSigCdOpe.ParAutos
_CarOpcr = crSigCdOpe.OpCrs

If _parAuto = 3
	ThisForm.TotPres = 0
EndIf

If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
	Select TprMvCab
	Replace TprMvCab.ValDevs With 0

	Select TmpOperacao
	If !Eof()
		_Rec = Recno()
	Else
		_Rec = -1
	EndIf
	Store 0 to _valos, _valinis, _valdevs, _valservs, _valencs, _VlFrete, _ValSubn, _VlDAces, _VlVar, _VlLiq, _VlSeg
	Store 0 to lnIpiFrt,lnIcmFrt,lnValSeg,lnIpiSeg,lnIcmSeg,lnIpiDes,lnIcmDes
	Scan
		Set Decimals to 0
		nDope = Val( Left( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 4 ) )
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','ndopes',nDope)
		Dope = crSigCdOpe.Dopes
		nume = Val( Right( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 6 ) )
		Set Decimals to 2
		lcEDNsub = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + Dope + Str(Nume,6)
		If (_CarOpCr <> 6 Or ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR') And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrTprMvCab','EmpdopNums',lcEDNsub, [ValDevs, ValServs, ValTrans, ValEncs, Valos ])
			Replace TprMvCab.ValDevs With TprMvCab.valdevs + crTprMvCab.ValDevs In TprMvCab
			If _ParAuto = 3
				ThisForm.TotPres = ThisForm.TotPres + CrTprMvCab.Valos
			EndIf
		EndIf
		xPerc    = Iif(TmpOperacao.ValInis=0,0,Round(TmpOperacao.ValCars / TmpOperacao.ValInis,6))
		_VlFrete = _VlFrete + Round(TmpOperacao.VlFretes  * xPerc,2)
		_VlDAces = _VldAces + Round(TmpOperacao.DespAces  * xPerc,2)
		_VlVar   = _VlVar   + Round(TmpOperacao.VlValVars * xPerc,2)
		lnIpiFrt = lnIpiFrt + Round(TmpOperacao.FrtIpis * xPerc,2)
		lnIcmFrt = lnIcmFrt + Round(TmpOperacao.FrtIcms * xPerc,2)
		lnValSeg = lnValSeg + Round(TmpOperacao.VlSeguros * xPerc,2)
		lnIpiSeg = lnIpiSeg + Round(TmpOperacao.SegIpis * xPerc,2)
		lnIcmSeg = lnIcmSeg + Round(TmpOperacao.SegIcms * xPerc,2)
		lnIpiDes = lnIpiDes + Round(TmpOperacao.DesIpis * xPerc,2)
		lnIcmDes = lnIcmDes + Round(TmpOperacao.DesIcms * xPerc,2)

		_VlLiq = _VlLiq + (TmpOperacao.Valos - TmpOperacao.OldValoBxs)
	Endscan

	Select TprMvCab
	Replace TprMvCab.ValDevs With TprMvCab.ValDevs + ThisForm.nValDevols 

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	_valos   = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr,TprMvCab.Dopes)

	llFinan = .f.
	If InList(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3) Or _ParAuto = 3
		_valinis = ThisForm.TotPres - TprMvCab.valdevs
	Else
		If InList(_CarOpcr,8,9)
			m.Valos = ThisForm.Totalizait(_CarOpCr)
			lcSql = [Select Dopes, Faixais, FaixaFs, Percs, Multiplos From SigOpCrr Where dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' ]+;
					[Order by Dopes, Faixais, Faixafs ]
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpCrOpe') < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( TmpCrOpe)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			m.xPercs = 0
			m.xMult  = 0
			Select TmpCrOpe
			Scan
				If Between(m.Valos,TmpCrOpe.FaixaIs,TmpCrOpe.FaixaFs)
					m.xPercs = TmpCrOpe.Percs
					m.xMult  = TmpCrOpe.Multiplos
					Exit
				EndIf
			EndScan
			m.Valos  = Iif(m.xPercs > 0, Round( m.Valos * m.xPercs / 100, 2 ), 0 )
			_ValInis = Iif(m.xMult > 0, Int(m.Valos / m.xMult) * m.xMult, m.Valos )
		Else
			If CrSigOpCdd.RcFinas = 1 And CrSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 And Not InList(CrSigCdOpe.SubNs,1,3,4,5)
				_ValInis = 0
				Select TmpBarFin
				Scan
					If Empty(nBarra2)
						Loop
					EndIf
					_ValInis = _ValInis + TmpBarFin.ValPs
				EndScan
				llFinan = .t.
			Else
				If CrSigOpCdd.CarVLiqOs = 1
					_ValInis = _VlLiq
				Else
					_valinis = _valos - TprMvCab.valdevs
				Endif
			Endif			
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Select TprMvCab
	Go Top

***	Tiago - 03/10/2014 - SRCOM - Antigamente esse código ficava aqui; tinham mudado para só calcular quando clicava em produtos, mas assim não recalcula os serviços, por isso voltei para cá
*!*		If _ValServs # 0
*!*			Replace TprMvCab.Valservs with _ValServs
*!*		EndIf
	If crSigCdOpe.HabServs = 1
		ThisForm.TotServ = fTotalizarSrv(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
		Replace TprMvCab.ValServs With Round(ThisForm.TotServ,2) In TprMvCab
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValServs.Value = ThisForm.Totserv

		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.DigItens,4,5) && Tiago - 29/09/2014 - SRCOM - Se for tela de Orçamento pega a linha do FEE e IMPOSTO e lança no campo serviço
			Select Sum(tota1s + tota2s + tota3s) as Tota1s from crSigMvOrc where Inlist(cBlocos,[TAXA],[IMPOSTO]) into cursor crTmpTotal
			Select crTmpTotal

			If !IsEmpty(crTmpTotal.Tota1s)
				Select TprMvCab
				Replace ValServs With ValServs + crTmpTotal.Tota1s
			Endif
			Use in crTmpTotal
		Endif
	EndIf

	If _ValEncs # 0
		Replace TprMvCab.ValEncs with _ValEncs
	EndIf

	* Incorporar o ICMS ao total da Movimentação
	lnIcm = 0
	lnIpi = 0
	
	Select crSigMvNfi
	Go Top
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCfo','CrSigCdCfo','codigos',crSigMvNfi.Cfis)
	If !crSigMvNfi.Cancelas
		lnIpi = crSigMvNfi.ValIpis
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCfo','CrSigCdCfo','codigos',crSigMvNfi.Cfis)
			If crSigCdCfo.IncIcmNfs = 1
				lnIcm = crSigMvNfi.Valicms
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	*** mena - 28/10/2015 incluido 5 e 6 ***
	If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,5,6)
		pCalcFrete = .f.
	EndIf

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.Nfiscals,1,2) Or crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3
		ThisForm.CriaRegNf()
	EndIf

	If Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0 And pCalcFrete
		If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3
			Replace VlFretes  With Iif(_VlFrete > 0,_VlFrete,VlFretes) ,;
					DespAces  With Iif(_VlDAces > 0,_VlDAces,DespAces) ,;
					VlSeguros With Iif(lnValSeg > 0,lnValSeg,VlSeguros) In crSigMvNfi
		Else
			Replace VlFretes  With Iif(_VlFrete > 0,_VlFrete,VlFretes) ,;
					FrtIpis   With Iif(lnIpiFrt > 0,lnIpiFrt,FrtIpis)  ,;
					FrtIcms   With Iif(lnIcmFrt > 0,lnIcmFrt,FrtIcms)  ,;
					DespAces  With Iif(_VlDAces > 0,_VlDAces,DespAces) ,;
					DesIpis   With Iif(lnIpiDes > 0,lnIpiDes,DesIpis)  ,;
					DesIcms   With Iif(lnIcmDes > 0,lnIcmDes,DesIcms)  ,;
					VlSeguros With Iif(lnValSeg > 0,lnValSeg,VlSeguros),;
					SegIpis   With Iif(lnIpiSeg > 0,lnIpiSeg,SegIpis)  ,;
					SegIcms   With Iif(lnIcmSeg > 0,lnIcmSeg,SegIcms)  In crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If _VlVar <> 0 And pCalcFrete
		Replace ValVars With _VlVar In TprMvCab
	EndIf

	lnTran = Iif(crSigOpCdc.nChkVsts = 1, TprMvCab.ValTrans, 0)

	_valos = _valinis + TprMvCab.valvars + TprMvCab.ValEncs + TprMvCab.ValServs + lnIPI + lnIcm + ;
			 crSigMvNfi.VlFretes + crSigMvNfi.Vlseguros + crSigMvNfi.DespAces + crSigMvNfi.Icmss + lnTran

	If crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 1 And crSigCdOpe.DigItens = 2 And Not llFinan And ;
		Not InList(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3) And TprMvCab.ValServs = 0 And ;
			crSigCdOpe.ParAutos # 3 And crSigCdOpe.ItAutos # 1 And Not InList(_CarOpcr,8,9)
		_Valos   = ThisForm.Topar
		_Valinis = ThisForm.Topar - TprMvCab.ValVars - TprMvCab.ValEncs - TprMvCab.ValServs - lnIPI - lnTran
	EndIf
	
	IF InList(crSigCdOpe.DigItens,2,3,8) AND crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 AND crSigCdOpe.ParAutos = 1 and .f. &&Desabitado: rotina ira criar o SigMvNfi
		_Valos   = _Valos + _VlFrete + _VlDAces
		_ValInis = _ValInis + _VlFrete + _VlDAces

		Replace VlrFrts With _VlFrete,;
				VlrDacs With _VldAces In TprMvCab
	EndIf

	This.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos.Value = Round( _Valos, 2 )
	This.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValIns.Value = _ValInis

	Replace TprMvCab.valos with _valos, ;
			TprMvCab.valinis with _valinis In TprMvCab

	If _VlVar <> 0 And pCalcFrete
		Replace Vars    With iif(TprMvCab.ValInis # 0,Round(TprMvCab.ValVars/TprMvCab.ValInis*100,4),0) In TprMvCab
		*** Tiago - 11/05/2011 - Se variação = 1 e valor de variação padrão estiver preenchido
		If TprMvCab.Vars = 0 and (crSigCdOpe.vars = 1 And crSigOpCdc.VarPads <> 0)
			replace Vars with crSigOpCdc.VarPads in TprMvCab
		EndIf
	EndIf

	Select TmpOperacao
	If _Rec > 0
		go _rec
	Else
		Go top
	EndIf

	This.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos.Refresh
	This.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValIns.Refresh
	This.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValServs.Refresh	
	This.Pagina.Dados.Refresh
EndIf
ThisForm.RefreshCntResumo()

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE baixabxest
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE baixabxest
Lparameters pExclusao

Private pDop

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
If crSigCdOpe.Chkqtdss <> 5
	Return .t.
EndIf

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde......'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Baixa de Sub_Nivel e!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

Select TmpOperacao
Count To lnOpeDig For Not IsEmpty(Codigos)
_OperDig  = ( lnOpeDig # 0 )

If !_OperDig
	Wait Clear
	Return .t.
EndIf

lcCidQuery = fUniqueIds()

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe',.f.,.f.,[Dopes,ndopes])

lcSql = [Select * From SigOpOss Where cDopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcsql,'PendSSOpe')
Select PendSSOpe
Index on cNivels Tag cNivels

Select CrSigTempd
Zap

Select Distinct a.EmpSubns + b.Dopes + Str(Val(Right(Str(a.Codigos, 10), 6)), 6) as EmpDopNums, b.Dopes ;
From TmpOperacao a, TmpOpe b ;
Where Val(Left(Str(a.Codigos, 10), 4)) = b.Ndopes ;
Into Cursor Operacoes
Select Operacoes
Scan

	If Seek(Operacoes.Dopes,'PendSsOpe','cNivels')
		Select Dopess From PendSsOpe Where cNivels = Operacoes.Dopes Into Cursor Selecao
		Select Selecao
		Scan
			Select CrSigTempd
			Append Blank
			Replace EmpDopNums With Operacoes.EmpDopNums,;
					CidQuerys  With lcCidQuery,;
					Dopes      with Selecao.Dopess,;
					CidChaves  With fUniqueIds()
		EndScan
	EndIf
EndScan

If !ThisForm.poDataMgr4.UpDate('CrSigTempd')
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr4.RollBack()
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
	Wait Clear
	Return .f.
EndIf
If ThisForm.poDataMgr4.commit() < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
	Wait Clear
	Return .f.
EndIf
	
llChkSubn = .f.

lcQuery = [Select a.CidChaves, a.cItens, a.Cpros, a.Qtdes, a.QtdBxs From SigTempd c, SigBxEst a ]+;
		  [Where c.CidQuerys = ?lcCidQuery And ]+;
		  [c.EmpDopNums = a.EmpDopNumb and c.Dopes = a.Dopes ]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTprMvCabi') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCabi)')
	Wait Clear
	Return .f.
EndIf

ThisForm.poDataMgr4.fSqlApagarTmp('SigTempD', lcCidquery )

Select CrTprMvCabi
Index On Cpros Tag Cpros

Select crTpmMvItn
oProg = CreateObject('fwprogressbar', 'Processando Ítens dos Subníveis...', Reccount())
oProg.Show
Scan
	oProg.Update(.t.)
	
	lcBusca   = crTpmMvItn.Cpros
	_QtBaixar = crTpmMvItn. Qtds

	Select CrTprMvCabi
	Set Order To Cpros
	=Seek(lcBusca)
	Scan While Cpros = lcBusca And _QtBaixar > 0

		If pExclusao
	
			If CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs <= _QtBaixar
				_QtBaixar = _QtBaixar - CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs
				Replace QtdBxs With 0 in CrTprMvCabi
			Else
				_QtBaixar = 0
				Replace QtdBxs With QtdBxs - _QtBaixar in CrTprMvCabi
			EndIf

		Else
			If CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs + _QtBaixar <= CrTprMvCabi.Qtdes
				Replace CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs With CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs + _QtBaixar
				_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar
				_QtBaixar = 0
			Else
				_QtBaixar = _QtBaixar - ( CrTprMvCabi.Qtdes - CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs )
				_QtBaixado = CrTprMvCabi.Qtdes - CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs
				Replace CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs With CrTprMvCabi.Qtdes
			EndIf
		EndIf

		lcUpDate = [UpDate SigBxEst Set QtdBxs = ]+Str(CrTprMvCabi.QtdBxs,12,3)+[ Where CidChaves = ']+CrTprMvCabi.CidChaves+[']

		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
		If LnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
			Wait Clear
			Return .f.
		EndIf

	EndScan
EndScan
Wait Clear
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE baixasubnivel
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE baixasubnivel
Private pDop

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
lcUltGrv = TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + '-BxSubnivel'

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdd','crSigOpCdd','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
_OperItens    = Iif(crSigCdOpe.ItAutos=4,"E",Iif(crSigCdOpe.ItAutos=5,"S"," "))

If (crSigOpCdd.chklmpss = 1) && Marca Subnível Como Cancelado
	llTrue = .t.
	Select TmpOperacao
	Scan for Codigos > 0
		_CodOper = Transform(Val(Right(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 6)), "999999")
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrOpe','ndopes', Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 4)))

		lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set lCancelas = ?llTrue Where EmpDopNums = '] + TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + CrOpe.dopes + _CodOper + [']
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
		If lnErro < 0
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 16)')
			Wait Clear
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf

If crSigCdOpe.BaixaSns = 1
	Select TmpOperacao
	Scan for Codigos > 0
		_CodOper = Transf( Val( Right( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 6 ) ), "999999" )
*!*			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrOpe','ndopes', Val(Left( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 4 )))

		lcQuery = [Select a.*, b.ConfigGers ] + ;
				    [From SigCdOpe a ] + ;
				    [Left Join SigOpCdd b ] + ;
				      [On a.Dopes = b.Dopes ] + ;
				   [Where a.NDopes = ] + Alltrim(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 4))

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crOpe]) < 1)
			=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crOpe)])
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Go Top In crOpe
		llBxS = .t.
		If Not Eof([crOpe]) And (Int(Val(Substr(crOpe.ConfigGers, 159, 01))) = 1) && Pasta Subnível / Subnível Secundário / Não Baixar Quando For Subnível
			llBxS = .f.
		EndIf

		If llBxS
			lcbusca = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + CrOpe.dopes + _CodOper
			llChkf = .t.
			ldDtAlt = _pData
			llDtBx  = TprMvCab.Datas
			lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, ChkBxParcs = ?llChkf, DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 16)')
				Wait Clear
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvItn Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, QtBaixas = Qtds  Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvItn 16)')
				Wait Clear
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvIts Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, QtBaixas = Qtds  Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvIts 16)')
				Wait Clear
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			If Seek(Substr(lcbusca,4,20),'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
				lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
				LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
				If lnErro < 0
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - Baixasubnivel)')
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvEte Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn  > 0
				If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'',4)
					LnErro = 1
				Else
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				EndIf
			Else
				LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			EndIf
			If lnErro < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvEte )')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Endscan
EndIf

If ( crSigCdOpe.BaixaSns = 1 ) Or ( !InList(crSigCdOpe.Subns,1,4,5) )
	Wait Clear
	Return .t.
EndIf

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde......'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Baixa de Sub_Nivel!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

lcSubn       = crSigCdOpe.Nivels
lcDopeNivels = crSigCdOpe.Nivels

Select TmpOperacao
Count To lnOpeDig For Not IsEmpty(Codigos)
_OperDig  = ( lnOpeDig # 0 )
_Recal    = ( crSigCdOpe.ValEsts = 1 )
_ChkQtdss = ( crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss )
_BxParc   = ( crSigCdOpe.BxParcials )

If ( ( InList(crSigCdOpe.BxParcials,1,3) Or crSigCdOpe.bxautos <> 1) And !_OperDig )
	Wait Clear
	Return .t.
EndIf

lcCidQuery = fUniqueIds()

If inlist(crSigCdOpe.SubNs,4,5) Or _OperDig

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe',.f.,.f.,[Dopes,ndopes])

	Select Distinct a.EmpSubns + b.Dopes + Str(Val(Right(Str(a.Codigos, 10), 6)), 6) as EmpDopNums ;
	  From TmpOperacao a, TmpOpe b ;
	 Where Val(Left(Str(a.Codigos, 10), 4)) = b.Ndopes ;
	  Into Cursor Operacoes

	Select CrSigTempd
	Zap
		
	Select Operacoes
	Scan
		Select CrSigTempd
		Append Blank
		Replace EmpDopNums With Operacoes.EmpDopNums,;
				CidQuerys  With lcCidQuery,;
				CidChaves  With fUniqueIds()
	EndScan
	If !ThisForm.poDataMgr4.UpDate('CrSigTempd')
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr4.RollBack()
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr4.commit() < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	llChkSubn = .f.

	lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, a.CodBarras, a.QtProds, a.Qtds, a.QtBaixas, a.CidChaves, a.EmpDopNums, ]+;
			  [a.Emps, a.Dopes, a.Numes, a.Citens, a.Opers, a.dpros, b.Grupoos, b.Contaos, b.Grupods, b.Contads, a.units ]+;
			  [From SigTempd c, SigMvCab b, SigMvItn a Where c.CidQuerys = ?lcCidQuery And ]+;
			  [c.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums and b.empdopnums = a.EmpDopNums And b.ChkSubn = ?llChkSubn]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTprMvCabi') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCabi)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, a.CodBarras, a.QtProds, a.Qtds, a.QtBaixas, a.CidChaves, a.EmpDopNums, ]+;
			  [a.Emps, a.Dopes, a.Numes, a.Citens, b.Grupoos, b.Contaos, b.Grupods, b.Contads, a.CodCors, a.CodTams, a.CodEmbs, a.qtdEmbs ]+;
			  [From SigTempd c, SigMvCab b, SigMvIts a Where c.CidQuerys = ?lcCidQuery And ]+;
			  [c.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums and b.empdopnums = a.EmpDopNums And b.ChkSubn = ?llChkSubn]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpEsti2') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEsti2)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	ThisForm.poDataMgr4.fSqlApagarTmp('SigTempD', lcCidquery )
Else
	pDop 	  = lcSubn
	llChkSubn = .f.
	lcEdnIni  = ThisForm.pEmps + pDop + Str(0,6)
	lcEdnFim  = ThisForm.pEmps + pDop + Str(999999,6)
	
	lcQuery = [Select a.GrupoOs, a.ContaOs, a.GrupoDs, a.ContaDs, a.EmpDopNums ] + ;
			  [From SigMvCab a ] + ;
			  [Where a.dopes = ?pDop And a.ChkSubn = ?llChkSubn]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrCabec') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crCabec)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcQuery = [Select b.Cpros, b.CodBarras, b.EmpDopNums, b.Opers, b.Dpros, ] + ;
			  [b.QtProds, b.Qtds, b.QtBaixas, b.cIdChaves, b.Emps, b.Dopes, b.Numes, b.Citens, b.units ] + ;
			  [From SigMvItn b ] + ;
			  [Where b.dopes = ?pdop ]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrItens') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrItens)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcQuery = [Select b.Cpros, b.CodCors, b.CodTams, b.CodBarras, ] + ;
			  [b.QtProds, b.Qtds, b.QtBaixas, b.CidChaves, b.EmpDopNums, b.Emps, b.Dopes, b.Numes, b.Citens, b.QtdEmbs, b.CodEmbs ] + ;
	          [From SigMvIts b ] + ;
			  [Where b.dopes = ?pdop ]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrItens2') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrItens2)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	Select a.GrupoOs, a.ContaOs, a.GrupoDs, a.ContaDs, b.* From CrCabec a, CrItens b ;
	Where a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums Into Cursor CrTprMvCabi readWrite
	
	Select a.GrupoOs, a.ContaOs, a.GrupoDs, a.ContaDs, b.* From CrCabec a, CrItens2 b ;
	Where a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums Into Cursor CrTmpEsti2 ReadWrite

EndIf

Select CrTprMvCabi
Index On Emps + Dopes + Cpros + Str(Numes,6) Tag EmpDopPro
Index On EmpDopNums + Cpros + Str(cItens,4) Tag EmpDopNums

Select CrTmpEsti2
Index On Emps + Dopes + Cpros + CodCors + CodTams + Str(Numes,6) Tag EmpDopPro
Index on EmpDopNums + Cpros + Str(cItens,4) Tag EmpDopItem
Index On EmpDopNums + Cpros + CodCors + CodTams Tag EmpDopNums

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdEmp','CrSigCdEmp','Cemps',TprMvCab.Emps)

Select crTpmMvItn
oProg = CreateObject('fwprogressbar', 'Processando Ítens dos Subníveis...', Reccount())
oProg.Show
Scan
	oProg.Update(.t.)
	
	Select crTpmMvIts
	Set Order to CItens
	Set Key to crTpmMvItn.CItens
	Goto Top
	llTemItem2 = Not Eof('crTpmMvIts')

	* Richard em 15/03/2017 - Não Baixar Itens com Quantidade Reprovada
	*_QtBaixar = Iif( crSigCdOpe.BxAutos = 1 Or InList(crSigCdOpe.BxParcials,1,3) Or crSigCdOpe.SubNAutos = 1, crTpmMvItn.qtds, 0 )
	llBaixar = .T.
	If Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs)
		lcQuery = [Select a.abrevs, a.Dopes, b.BxQtdMvAut ] + ;
			[from sigcdope a ] + ;
			[join sigopcdd b on a.dopes = b.dopes ] + ; 
			[where a.abrevs = ']+crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs+[' ]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[csTmpOp])<1
			MessageBox([Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (csTmpOp)])
			Return .F.
		EndIf 
		Select csTmpOp
		llBaixar = (csTmpOp.BxQtdMvAut = 1)
	EndIf 
	If llBaixar

		_QtBaixar = 0

					Loop

*!*					EndIf

						Replace CrTprMvCabi.QtProds With CrTprMvCabi.QtProds + _QtBaixar
						_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar
						_QtBaixar = 0
					Else
						_QtBaixar = _QtBaixar - ( Qtds - QtProds )
						_QtBaixado = CrTprMvCabi.Qtds - CrTprMvCabi.QtProds

					=Seek( TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + crOpe.Dopes + _CodOper + crTpmMvIts.cpros )

					Scan While EmpDopNums + Cpros = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + crOpe.Dopes + _CodOper + crTpmMvIts.cpros And _QtBaixar > 0

						If (CrTmpEsti2.CodCors # crTpmMvIts.CodCors Or CrTmpEsti2.CodTams # crTpmMvIts.CodTams) And crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss # 4
							Loop
						EndIf
						If crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubNs = 2
							=Seek(CrTmpEsti2.EmpDopNums+CrTmpEsti2.Cpros+Str(CrTmpEsti2.CItens,4),'CrTprMvCabi','EmpDopNums')
							If crTpmMvItn.Dpros <> CrTprMvCabi.Dpros
								Loop
							EndIf
						EndIf

						If _BxParc = 3
						
							If CrTmpEsti2.QtProds + _QtBaixar <= CrTmpEsti2.Qtds
								Select CrTmpEsti2
								Replace CrTmpEsti2.QtProds With CrTmpEsti2.QtProds + _QtBaixar
								_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar
								_QtBaixar  = 0
								_QtBaixadF = _QtBaixar
							Else
								_QtBaixar  = _QtBaixar - ( CrTmpEsti2.Qtds - CrTmpEsti2.QtProds )
								_QtBaixado = ( CrTmpEsti2.Qtds - CrTmpEsti2.QtProds )
								_QtBaixadF = _QtBaixar
								Select crTmpEsti2
								Replace CrTmpEsti2.QtProds With crTmpEsti2.Qtds
							EndIf

							lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvIts Set QtProds = ]+Str(CrTmpEsti2.QtProds,9,2)+[ Where CidChaves = ']+CrTmpEsti2.CidChaves+[']

						Else

							If CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas + _QtBaixar <= CrTmpEsti2.Qtds
								Select crTmpEsti2
								Replace CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas With crTmpEsti2.QtBaixas + _QtBaixar
								_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar * CrTmpEsti2.QtdEmbs
								_QtBaixadF = _QtBaixar
								_QtBaixar  = 0
							Else
								_QtBaixar  = _QtBaixar - ( crTmpEsti2.Qtds - crtmpEsti2.QtBaixas )
								_QtBaixado = ( crtmpEsti2.Qtds - crtmpEsti2.QtBaixas ) * CrTmpEsti2.QtdEmbs
								_QtBaixadF = ( crtmpEsti2.Qtds - crtmpEsti2.QtBaixas )
								Select crtmpEsti2
								Replace crtmpEsti2.QtBaixas With crtmpEsti2.Qtds
							EndIf
							llBaixa = Iif(CrTmpEsti2.Qtds = CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas,.t.,.f.)

							lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvIts Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llBaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrTmpEsti2.CidChaves+[']

						EndIf

						lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
						If LnErro < 1
							MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
							Wait Clear
							Return .f.
						EndIf
						
						Insert Into crSigBxEst ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, CItens, Cpros, Qtdes, Datas, Empbs, Dopebs, ;
								Numebs, Qtdfs, CodCors, CodTams, EmpDopNums, EmpDopNumb, cidChaves, CodEmbs, Dpros ) ;
							Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
								crtmpEsti2.CItens, crTpmMvItn.cpros, Iif(_BxParc=3,0,_QtBaixadF),;
								TprMvCab.Datas, crtmpEsti2.Emps, crtmpEsti2.Dopes, ;
								crtmpEsti2.Numes, Iif(_BxParc=3,_QtBaixado,0), ;
								crtmpEsti2.CodCors, crtmpEsti2.CodTams,;
								TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6),;
								CrTmpEsti2.Emps + CrTmpEsti2.Dopes + Str(CrTmpEsti2.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), ;
								CrTmpEsti2.CodEmbs, Iif(crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubns=2,crTpmMvItn.Dpros,' ') )

						Select CrTprMvCabi
						Set Order to EmpDopNums
						Seek (crtmpEsti2.Emps + crtmpEsti2.Dopes + Str(crtmpEsti2.Numes,6))
						Do While Not Eof() And (crTprMvCabi.Emps + crTprMvCabi.Dopes + Str(crTprMvCabi.Numes,6)) = (crtmpEsti2.Emps + crtmpEsti2.Dopes + Str(crtmpEsti2.Numes,6)) And _QtBaixado > 0
							Select crTprMvCabi
							If CrTprMvCabi.CItens = crTmpEsti2.CItens
								_QtBx = CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas + _QtBaixado
								Replace CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas With Iif(_QtBx > CrTprMvCabi.Qtds,CrTprMvCabi.Qtds,_QtBx) in CrTprMvCabi
								_QtBaixado = 0
								llBaixa = Iif(CrTprMvCabi.Qtds = CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas,.t.,.f.)
								lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvItn Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llBaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrTprMvCabi.CidChaves+[']
								lnErro   = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
								If LnErro < 1
									MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
									Wait Clear
									Return .f.
								EndIf
							Else
								Skip
							EndIf
						EndDo

						Select CrTmpEsti2

					Endscan
					Select TmpOperacao
					Skip
				Enddo
			EndIf
			
			If ( ( Not _OperDig ) And ( crSigCdOpe.BxAutos = 1 ) )
				_QtBaixar = crTpmMvIts.qtds
				_ChaveCli  = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Opers =1, TprMvCab.Grupoos + TprMvCab.Contaos, ;
												     TprMvCab.Grupods + TprMvCab.Contads )
				_ChaveCli2 = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Opers =1, TprMvCab.Grupods + TprMvCab.Contads, ;
												     TprMvCab.Grupoos + TprMvCab.Contaos )
				_CampoCli  = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Opers =1, "CrTmpEsti2.Grupoos + crtmpEsti2.Contaos", ;
												     "crTmpEsti2.Grupods + crtmpEsti2.Contads" )
				Select CrTmpEsti2
				Set Order to EmpDopPro
				Seek ( TprMvCab.Emps + lcDopeNivels + crTpmMvItn.CPros )
				Scan While !Eof('crTmpEsti2') And _QtBaixar # 0 And ;
					  CrTmpEsti2.Emps + CrTmpEsti2.Dopes + CrTmpEsti2.Cpros = (TprMvCab.Emps + lcDopeNivels + crTpmMvItn.CPros )

					If &_CampoCli. # _ChaveCli And &_CampoCli. # _ChaveCli2
						Loop
					EndIf
					If CrTmpEsti2.CodCors # crTpmMvIts.CodCors Or CrTmpEsti2.CodTams # crTpmMvIts.CodTams
						Loop
					EndIf
					If crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubNs = 2
						=Seek(CrTmpEsti2.EmpDopNums+CrTmpEsti2.Cpros+Str(CrTmpEsti2.CItens,4),'CrTprMvCabi','EmpDopNums')
						If crTpmMvItn.Dpros <> CrTprMvCabi.Dpros
							Loop
						EndIf
					EndIf

					Select CrTmpEsti2
					If CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas + _QtBaixar <= CrTmpEsti2.Qtds
						Replace CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas With CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas + _QtBaixar
						_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar * CrTmpEsti2.QtdEmbs
						_QtBaixadF = _QtBaixar
						_QtBaixar  = 0
					Else
						_QtBaixar  = _QtBaixar - ( CrTmpEsti2.Qtds - CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas )
						_QtBaixado = ( CrTmpEsti2.Qtds - CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas ) * CrTmpEsti2.QtdEmbs
						_QtBaixadF = ( CrTmpEsti2.Qtds - CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas ) 
						Replace CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas With CrTmpEsti2.Qtds
					EndIf
					llBaixa = Iif(CrTmpEsti2.Qtds=CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas,.t.,.f.)
					lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvIts Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrTmpEsti2.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llBaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrTmpEsti2.CidChaves+[']
					lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
					If LnErro < 1
						MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
						Wait Clear
						Return .f.
					EndIf

					Insert Into crSigBxEst ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, CItens, Cpros, Qtdes, Datas, Empbs,  ;
								Dopebs, Numebs, CodCors, CodTams, EmpDopNums, EmpDopNumb, CidChaves, CodEmbs, Dpros ) ;
						Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
							crtmpEsti2.CItens, crTpmMvItn.cpros, _QtBaixadF, TprMvCab.Datas, ;
							crtmpEsti2.Emps, crtmpEsti2.Dopes, crtmpEsti2.Numes, ;
							crtmpEsti2.CodCors, crtmpEsti2.CodTams,;
							TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
							crtmpEsti2.Emps + crtmpEsti2.Dopes + Str(crtmpEsti2.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), ;
							CrTmpEsti2.CodEmbs,Iif(crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubNs=2,crTpmMvItn.Dpros,' '))

					Select CrTprMvCabi
					Set Order to EmpDopNums
					Seek (CrTmpEsti2.Emps + CrTmpEsti2.Dopes + Str(crTmpEsti2.Numes,6))
					Do While Not Eof() And (crTprMvCabi.Emps + crTprMvCabi.Dopes + Str(crTprMvCabi.Numes,6)) = (crtmpEsti2.Emps + crtmpEsti2.Dopes + Str(CrTmpEsti2.Numes,6)) And _QtBaixado > 0
						Select crTprMvCabi
						If crTprMvCabi.CItens = crtmpEsti2.CItens
							_QtBx = CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas + _QtBaixado
							Replace crTprMvCabi.QtBaixas With Iif(_QtBx > CrTprMvCabi.Qtds,CrTprMvCabi.Qtds,_QtBx) in CrTprMvCabi
							_QtBaixado = 0
							llBaixa = Iif(CrTprMvCabi.Qtds=CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas,.t.,.f.)
							lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvItn Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llbaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrTprMvCabi.CidChaves+[']
							lnErro   = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
							If LnErro < 1
								MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
								Wait Clear
								Return .f.
							EndIf
						Else
							Skip
						EndIf
					EndDo

					lnNumSub = ( lnDopeNivels * 1000000 ) + CrTmpEsti2.Numes
					Select TmpOperacao
					Set Order to Codigos
					Seek lnNumSub
					If Eof()
						Insert Into TmpOperacao ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, EmpSubns) Values ;
							( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, lnNumSub, TprMvCab.Emps )
					EndIf
					Select CrTmpEsti2
				EndScan
				
			EndIf

			If _QtBaixar > 0 And crSigCdOpe.SubNAutos = 1 And Not IsEmpty( lcDopeNivels )
				Select crTpmMvIts
				Replace crTpmMvIts.QtdABaixar With _QtBaixar
				Select crTpmMvItn
				Replace crTpmMvItn.QtdABaixar With crTpmMvItn.QtdABaixar + _QtBaixar
			EndIf

			If _QtBaixar > 0 And crSigCdOpe.SubNAutos = 1 And Not IsEmpty( lcDopeNivels )
				Select crTpmMvItn
				Replace crTpmMvItn.QtdABaixar With crTpmMvItn.QtdABaixar - _QtBaixar
			EndIf

			Select crTpmMvIts
		EndScan
	EndIf
EndScan
oProg.Complete

If crSigCdOpe.BxParcials = 1 Or ( crSigCdOpe.BxAutos = 1 And _OperDig )
	Select TmpOperacao
	Scan for Codigos > 0
		_CodOper = Transf( Val( Right( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 6 ) ), "999999" )
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrOpe','ndopes',VAL(Left( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 4 )),[Dopes])
		Select CrTprMvCabi
		Set Order to EmpDopNums
		Seek( TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + crOpe.Dopes + _CodOper )
		_BaixaTotal = .t.
		Scan While Emps + Dopes + Str( Numes, 6 ) = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + crOpe.Dopes + _CodOper
			If QtBaixas # Qtds
				_BaixaTotal =.f.
				Exit
			EndIf
		Endscan
		lcbusca = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + CrOpe.dopes + _CodOper
		If _BaixaTotal
			llChkf = .t.
			llDtBx = TprMvCab.Datas
			lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, ChkBxParcs = ?llChkf, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Wait Clear
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvEte Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
				If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'',4)
					LnErro = 1
				Else
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				EndIf
			Else
				LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			EndIf
			If lnErro < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvEte )')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		Else
			llChkf = .t.
			lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkBxParcs = ?llChkf, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Wait Clear
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Seek(Substr(lcbusca,4,20),'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
			lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - BaixaSubnivel)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Endscan
Else
	If crSigCdOpe.BxAutos = 1 And !_OperDig
		Select crSigBxEst
		Scan
			Select CrTprMvCabi
			Set Order to EmpDopNums
			Seek( crSigBxEst.Empbs + crSigBxEst.Dopebs + Str(crSigBxEst.Numebs, 6 ) )
			_BaixaTotal = .t.
			Scan While Emps + Dopes + Str( Numes, 6 ) = crSigBxEst.Empbs + crSigBxEst.Dopebs + Str(crSigBxEst.Numebs, 6 )
				If QtBaixas # Qtds
					_BaixaTotal =.f.
					Exit
				EndIf
			Endscan
			lcbusca = crSigBxEst.Empbs + crSigBxEst.Dopebs + Str(crSigBxEst.Numebs, 6 )
			If _BaixaTotal 
				llChkf = .t.
				llDtBx = TprMvCab.Datas
				lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, ChkBxParcs = ?llChkf, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
				lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				If lnErro < 0
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
					Wait Clear
					Return .f.
				EndIf
				lcUpdate = [Update SigMvEte Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn  > 0
					If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
						LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'',4)
						LnErro = 1
					Else
						LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
					EndIf
				Else
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				EndIf
				If lnErro < 1
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvEte )')
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			Else
				llChkf = .t.
				lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkBxParcs = ?llChkf, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
				lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				If lnErro < 0
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
					Wait Clear
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Seek(Substr(lcbusca,4,20),'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
				lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
				LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
				If lnErro < 0
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - baixasubnivel)')
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Endscan
	EndIf
EndIf
Wait Clear
Return .t.

***************** fim ******************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE baixa_estpe
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE baixa_estpe
Local llRetorno

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdd','crSigOpCdd','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCsn','LocSnOpe','Cdopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

Select LocSnOpe
Index on cNivels Tag Dopes

lcUltGrv = ( TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + '-Baixa_Estpe' )
llRetorno = .t.

Select crSigMvPec
Scan
	_nDope = Val(Left(Str(crSigMvPec.Codigos,10),4))
	_nNume = Val(Right(Str(crSigMvPec.Codigos,10),6))
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','nDopes',_nDope,[Dopes])
	lcEdn = Iif(IsEmpty(crSigMvPec.EmpSubns),ThisForm.pEmps ,crSigMvPec.EmpSubns)+CrTmpOpe.Dopes+Str(_nNume,6)
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvPec','CrTmpEstPe','EmpDopNums',lcEdn)
	Select CrTmpEstPe
	Scan
		_nDope = Val(Left(Str(CrTmpEstPe.Codigos,10),4))
		_nNume = Val(Right(Str(CrTmpEstPe.Codigos,10),6))
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','nDopes',_nDope,[Dopes])
		=Seek(CrTmpEstPe.Dopes,'LocSnOpe','Dopes')

		lcEdn = Iif(IsEmpty(CrTmpEstPe.EmpSubns),ThisForm.pEmps,CrTmpEstPe.EmpSubns)+CrTmpOpe.Dopes+Str(_nNume,6)
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrTprMvCab','EmpDopNums',lcEdn)
		llSubn  = CrTprMvCab.ChkSubn
		llDtAgd = CrTprMvCab.DtAgends
		llPago  = CrTprMvCab.chkPagos
		llFalse = .f.
		llTrue  = .t.
		ldDtNull= Null

		If crSigCdOpe.cBxSubns # 1 And LocSnOpe.cBxPagos # 1 And LocSnOpe.PgSubNNs # 1
			Return .T.
		EndIf

		If crSigCdOpe.cBxSubns = 1 
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvPec Set ChkSubn = ?llSubn, DtAGends = ?llDtAgd Where Cidchaves = ']+CrTmpEstpe.CidChaves+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Baixa SubNivel 1)')
				llRetorno = .f.
				exit
			EndIf
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?llfalse, ChkBxParcs = ?llfalse, DtAgends = ?ldDtNull, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Baixa SubNivel 2)')
				llRetorno = .f.
				exit
			EndIf
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvEte Set ChkSubn = ?llFalse Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn  > 0
				If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'',4)
					LnErro = 1
				Else
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				EndIf
			Else
				LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			EndIf
			If lnErro < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvEte )')
				Return .f.
			EndIf

			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvItn Set QtBaixas = 0, ChkSubn = ?llFalse Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Baixa SubNivel 3)')
				llRetorno = .f.
				exit
			EndIf
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvIts Set QtBaixas = 0, ChkSubn = ?llFalse Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Baixa SubNivel 4)')
				llRetorno = .f.
				exit
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If LocSnOpe.cBxPagos = 1 Or LocSnOpe.PgSubNNs = 1
			lcUpdate = [Update SigMvPec Set ChkPagos = ?llPago Where Cidchaves = ']+CrTmpEstpe.CidChaves+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Baixa SubNivel 1)')
				llRetorno = .f.
				exit
			EndIf
			If LocSnOpe.PgSubNNs = 1
				lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set ChkPagos = ?llTrue, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			Else
				lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set ChkPagos = ?llfalse, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			EndIf
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Baixa SubNivel 2)')
				llRetorno = .f.
				exit
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Seek(CrTprMvCab.Dopes,'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
			lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - baixa_estpe)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndScan
Return (llRetorno)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE calcbasfrt
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE calcbasfrt
Store 0 to lnBFrete, lnvFrete

ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','crTmpCfo','Codigos',crSigMvNfi.Cfis)

lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+TprMvCab.ContaOs+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')

lcSql = [Select * From SigCdEmp Where Cemps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrSigCdEmp')

If !Empty( CrtmpCli.Estas )
	lcChaveUf = CrTmpCli.Estas
Else
	lcChaveUf = crSigCdEmp.Estas
EndIf

lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+TprMvCab.ContaDs+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')

If !Empty( CrtmpCli.Estas )
	lcChaveUf2 = CrTmpCli.Estas
Else
	lcChaveUf2 = crSigCdEmp.Estas
EndIf

If Not Empty(TprMvCab.IDEntrega)
	lcQry = [Select Top 1 Codigos, Descrs, Ceps, Paises, Endes, Nums, Compls, Bairs, ] + ;
		[Cidas, Estas, Ddds, Tel1s, Tel2s, Contatos, Refers ] + ;
		[From SigCdCeE ] + ;
		[Where 0=0 ] + ;
		Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs),[],[And IClis = '] + TprMvCab.ContaDs + [' ]) + ;
		[And idEntrega = ']+TprMvCab.IDEntrega+[' And descrs = 'ENTREGA' ] 

	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQry,'CrTmpCeE')
	
	If !Empty( CrTmpCeE.Estas )
		lcChaveUf2 = CrTmpCeE.Estas
	EndIf 
EndIf 

If crSigCdOpe.NFiscals = 1
	_Iclis = TprMvCab.Contaos
Else
	_Iclis = TprMvCab.Contads
EndIf

lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs, IdConta From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+_Iclis+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')

lcEstadoNF = crtmpCli.Estas

lcSql = [Select * From SigCdUfs Where Estados = ']+Iif(Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Estas),CrTmpCli.Estas,CrSigCdEmp.Estas)+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpUf')

Select crTpmMvItn
Scan
	
	lcSql = [Select Cpros,ClFiscals,sittricms,icms,cgrus,pesoms,TpTribs,PesoBs,Ipis,cunis,sgrus, idPro, AliqIpis, ]+;
			[pVens,pCuss,MarkupA,pvIdeals,Fabrproprs, origmercs, Valors,mercs,CodFinP,moecs,OrigMercs,SitTrIcms ]+;
			[From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpPro')	
	Select CrTmpPro
	Go Top In CrTmpPro
	If Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms)
		Replace SitTrIcms With [00] In CrTmpPro
	EndIf
	If Empty(CrTmpPro.OrigMercs)
		Replace OrigMercs With [0] In CrTmpPro
	EndIf
	If Empty(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals)
		Replace ClFiscals With [0] In CrTmpPro
	EndIf
	
	lcSql = [Select IpiFabs, IpiImpors From SigCdGrp Where Cgrus = ']+CrTmpPro.Cgrus+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpGru')

	lcSql = [Select * From SigCdClf Where codigos = ']+CrTmpPro.ClFiscals+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpClf')

	Store 0 to lnAliqIpis, lnAliqIcms, lnValIpis, lnValIcms, lnTipoIcms, lnTipoIpis
	
	Select crTpmMvItn
	lnTotal = Round( crTpmMvItn.Qtds * crTpmMvItn.Units, 2) + crTpmMvItn.ValRats
	LnBIcm  = lnTotal

	If CrTmpCfo.IcmsDscs = 1
		LnBIcm = Round( crTpmMvItn.Qtds * crTpmMvItn.Units, 2)
	EndIf

	lnBaseIcms = LnBIcm

	lnTotal = lnTotal + lnValIpis

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdIcm','CrTmpTrIcm','Codigos',CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms)

	If CrTmpCfo.Icms = 'T'

		lcSql = [Select * From SigPrTri Where Tipos = ']+CrTmpPro.TpTribs+[' And Movs = ']+crSigMvNfi.Operas+[']
		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'crSigPrTri') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CalcBarSfrt - crSigPrTri 1)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Select crSigPrTri
		Index On Cfops + origems + destinos Tag Busca
		If ( Seek(crSigMvNfi.Cfis + lcChaveUf + lcChaveUf2) Or Seek(Space(10) + lcChaveUf + lcChaveUf2) ) And ;
				crSigPrTri.Bases = 0 And crSigPrTri.Reduzidas = 0
			lnAliqIcms  = crSigPrTri.Aliquotas
			lCalcttri = .t.
			lnTipoIcms = 1
		Else
			lnTipoIcms = 1
			If !Empty(CrTmpCfo.AliqIVCs)
				lnAliqIcms = CrTmpCfo.AliqIVCs
			Else
				If Not Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms) And InList(crTmpTrIcm.Colunas, '2', '3')
					lnTipoIcms = Val(CrTmpTrIcm.Colunas)
				EndIf
				If lnTipoIcms = 1
					Declare laCampo(3,2)
					laCampo(1,1)='Codigos'
					laCampo(2,1)='Destinos'
					laCampo(3,1)='Cfos'
					laCampo(1,2)=lcChaveUf
					laCampo(2,2)=lcChaveUf2
					laCampo(3,2)=CrTmpCfo.Codigos
					If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfd','CrTmpUfDes',@laCampo)
						lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUfDes.Aliqs
					Else
						laCampo(3,2)=Space(10)
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfd','CrTmpUfDes',@laCampo)
							lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUfDes.Aliqs
						Else
							Declare laCampo(2,2)
							laCampo(1,1)='Grupos'
							laCampo(2,1)='Ests'
							laCampo(1,2)=CrTmpPro.Cgrus
							laCampo(2,2)=lcEstadoNf
							If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfi','CrTmpCicFi',@laCampo)
								lnAliqIcms = CrTmpCiCfi.Icms
							Else
								If CrTmpPro.Icms > 0
									lnAliqIcms = CrTmpPro.Icms
								Else
									lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUf.AIcms
								EndIf
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If CrTmpCfo.InclIcms = 2 And lnAliqIcms # 0
				lnBaseIcms = Round( LnBaseIcms / ( 1-(lnAliqIcms/100)) , 2 )
			EndIf
		EndIf

		lnValIcms = Round( lnBaseIcms * lnAliqIcms / 100, 2 )

	EndIf

	lnBFrete = lnbfrete + IIF(lnValIcms =0, 0, lnBaseIcms)
	lnvFrete = lnvFrete + lnValIcms

EndScan
lnAliqMed = Iif(lnbFrete<>0,( lnvFrete / lnbFrete * 100 ),1)
Return (lnAliqMed)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE calcimposto
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE calcimposto
LParameters llCalcIcms, lnCitem, llNIPI, llForca, llRecIcmsS, llManterIcmsS, llGerFilho

Local lnCasas, lcEstadoNF, _tItem, lnVlCusto, llCalcFrete, lnVezes, lnFrI, lnSgI, lnDeI, lcChave, lnSmfr, lcS

If Type('lnCitem') <> [N]
	lnCItem = 0
EndIf
If lnCitem > 0
	llCalcIcms = .t.
EndIf

Select crTpmMvItn
Go Top
Count to _tItem For Not Empty(Cpros) And Qtds<>0
Count to lnQtd For baseicms<>0

If Empty(TprMvCab.ContaOs) Or Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs)
	Return
EndIf

lnSmfr = 0 
*-- Rafael - Quando estiver configurado como 3 (Nao calcula automatico o sistema pega os impostos de outras fontes, EX: XML
If InList(crSigCdOpe.InfoIpis,3,4)
	Return .T.
EndIf 
For lnVezes = 1 to 2
	=ThisForm.Procrateio()  &&rateio dos encargos/variacao item a item
	=ThisForm.Procrateio2()  &&rateio dos impostos (frete + Seguro + Ipi Frete + Ipi Seguro )

	Store 0 to lnTotalPeso, lnTotalIpi, lnTotalIcm, lnTotalProd, lnTotalNota, lnTotBruto, lnTotServ
	Store 0 to lnTotIss, lnTotInss, lnTotIrrf, lnTotCssl, lnTotPis, lnTotCof	&& mena 23/05/2014 
	Store 0 to lnTotalBIcm1, lnTotalBIcm2, lnTotalBIcm3
	Store 0 to lnTotalBIcmS1, lnTotalBIcmS2, lnTotalBIcmS3
	Store 0 to lnTotalBIpi1, lnTotalBIpi2, lnTotalBIpi3, lnItem, lnTotBcIcmss, lnTotIcmss
	Store 0 to lnAliqMed,lnBasfda,lnBIcm2

	lcSql = [Select * From SigOpCdi Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'crSigOpCdi')

	lcSql = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'crSigCdOpe')

	lnCasas = crSigCdOpe.Casas
	llInformaipi = ( crSigCdOpe.InfoIpis = 1 )

	lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+TprMvCab.ContaOs+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')
	
	lcEmpEmi = 	IIF(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 239,3) != "   ",Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 239,3), TprMvCab.Emps)

	lcSql = [Select * From SigCdEmp Where Cemps = ']+lcEmpEmi+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrSigCdEmp')

	If !Empty( CrtmpCli.Estas )
		lcChaveUf = CrTmpCli.Estas
	Else
		lcChaveUf = crSigCdEmp.Estas
	EndIf

	lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+TprMvCab.ContaDs+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')

	If !Empty( CrtmpCli.Estas )
		lcChaveUf2 = CrTmpCli.Estas
	Else
		lcChaveUf2 = crSigCdEmp.Estas
	EndIf
	
	If Not Empty(TprMvCab.IDEntrega)

		lcQry = [Select Top 1 Codigos, Descrs, Ceps, Paises, Endes, Nums, Compls, Bairs, ] + ;
			[Cidas, Estas, Ddds, Tel1s, Tel2s, Contatos, Refers ] + ;
			[From SigCdCeE ] + ;
			[Where 0=0 ] + ;
			Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs),[],[And IClis = '] + TprMvCab.ContaDs + [' ]) + ;
			[And idEntrega = ']+TprMvCab.IDEntrega+[' And descrs = 'ENTREGA' ] 

		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQry,'CrTmpCeE')
		
		If !Empty( CrTmpCeE.Estas )
			lcChaveUf2 = CrTmpCeE.Estas
		EndIf 
	EndIf 

	If crSigCdOpe.NFiscals = 1
		_Iclis = TprMvCab.Contaos
	Else
		_Iclis = TprMvCab.Contads
	EndIf

	lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs, IdConta From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+_Iclis+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')

	lcEstadoNF = crtmpCli.Estas
	lcCfis = crSigMvNfi.Cfis

	Replace TprMvCab.idConta With CrTmpcli.IdConta In TprMvCab

	lcSql = [Select * From SigCdUfs Where Estados = ']+Iif(Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Estas),CrTmpCli.Estas,CrSigCdEmp.Estas)+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpUf')

	If Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
		ThisForm.CriaRegNf(.t.)
	EndIf

	*** Carregar o CFOP do SubNivel Qdo Configurado
	If Not Empty(ThisForm.CfopSubn) And crSigOpCdd.CarOuVlrs = 1
		Replace Cfis With ThisForm.CfOpSubN In crSigMvNfi
		ThisForm.CfopSubN = ' '
	EndIf
	
	Select crSigMvNfi
	Replace crSigMvNfi.CliFors with _IClis In crSigMvNfi
	
	lnValFrete = 0
	If Not Empty(TprMvCab.pedidoWeb)
		lcQuery = [Select Frete from SigWbPed where Pedido = ']+TprMvCab.pedidoWeb+[']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SQLExecute(lcQuery,[crFretePed])
		Select crFretePed
		If Reccount([crFretePed])>0
			lnValFrete = crFretePed.Frete
			If Empty(crSigMvNfi.VlFretes) 
				Replace crSigMvNfi.VlFretes With lnValFrete in crSigMvNfi
			EndIf 
		EndIf 
	EndIf 

	If Empty( crSigMvNfi.EspecieNFs ) And !Empty( crSigCdOpe.Especies )
		Replace crSigMvNfi.EspecieNFs with crSigCdOpe.Especies 
	EndIf

	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','crTmpCfo','Codigos',crSigMvNfi.Cfis)
		Replace crSigMvNfi.Operas With crTmpCfo.Operacaos
	EndIf

	If crSigMvNfi.Operas = [S]
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdEmp','CrSigCdEmp','Cemps', lcEmpEmi)
		lcChaveUf = crSigCdEmp.Estas
	EndIf
	If crSigMvNfi.Operas = [E]
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdEmp','CrSigCdEmp','Cemps', lcEmpEmi)
		lcChaveUf2 = crSigCdEmp.Estas
	EndIf

	*** Mena - 19/03/2018 - se devolucao mantem estado de origem/destino = a venda ***
	IF crSigCdOpe.nfcompls = 3
		lcChave = lcChaveUf2
		lcChaveUf2 = lcChaveUf
		lcChaveUf  = lcChave
	ENDIF
	
	If Empty( crSigMvNfi.Espes )
		Replace crSigMvNfi.Espes with TprMvCab.Espes
		If (crSigOpCdc.AltIntFs = 1)
			Replace crSigMvNfi.PLiqs with TprMvCab.PLiqs,;
					crSigMvNfi.PBrus with TprMvCab.PBrus
		EndIf
	EndIf
		
	If !IsEmpty( TprMvCab.Qtdes )
		Replace crSigMvNfi.Qtdes with TprMvCab.Qtdes
	EndIf

	If crSigOpCdc.FreteDefs = 2 And ThisForm.Alterafrete 
		Dimension laArray(2)
		laArray(1) = Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.ContaEs),Padr(crSigMvNfi.CliFors,10),TprMvCab.ContaEs)
		laArray(2) = Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.LocalEnts),' ',TprMvCab.LocalEnts)
		
		If Not Empty(TprMvCab.IDEntrega)
			laArray(1) = Padr(crSigMvNfi.CliFors,10)
			laArray(2) = TprMvCab.LocalEnts
		EndIf 
		
		If fEndEntrega(@laArray, ThisForm.poDataMgr,,TprMvCab.IDEntrega )
			lcCida = laArray(10)
			lcEsta = laArray(11)
			If fValidarTransps(crSigMvNfi.CodTrans,lcEsta,lcCida,crSigMvNfi.PBrus,TprMvCab.Dopes,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
				Replace VlFretes With TmpFrete.Valors ,;
						Fretes   With 2 in crSigMvNfi
						
*!*				mena - 28/11/2017 - retirado para nao alterar valor do frete 
*!*					Else
*!*					lnValAnt = crSigMvNfi.VlFretes
*!*					Replace VlFretes With 0 ,;
*!*							Fretes   With 2 ,;
*!*							FrtIcms  With 0 ,;
*!*							FrtIpis  With 0 in crSigMvNfi
*!*					If lnValAnt <> 0
*!*						ThisForm.AlteraFrete = .f.
*!*						ThisForm.Atuatot()
*!*					EndIf

			EndIf
		EndIf
	Endif

	lcSql = [Select * From SigCdCfo Where Codigos = ']+lcCfis+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCfo')

	If lnCitem = 0 
		* Soma o total do produtos 
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Scan
			If crTpmMvItn.CItens < 0 Or IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
				Loop
			EndIf
			
            *** Mena - 01/07/2014 - incluido campo serviços para checagem se produto é de serviço ***
            lcSql = [Select a.ClFiscals, b.servicos From SigCdPro a, SigCdGrp b Where a.Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[' and a.Cgrus=b.Cgrus]			
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro')
			
			If CrTmpCfo.InclIcms = 3 And lnVezes = 1
				Replace Units With UnitOrigs In crTpmMvItn
				ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
			EndIf
			Select crTpmMvItn

			Do Case
				Case crSigCdOpe.Qtdprecos = 2 && Tiago - 17/07/2011 - Não
					lnTotal = Round(crTpmMvItn.totas, 2)			
				Case crSigCdOpe.Qtdprecos = 3 && Sim. - composição
					lnTotal = Round(crTpmMvItn.totas, 2)
				Case crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 4 && Sim, Total de Peso
					lnTotal = Round(crTpmMvItn.Units * Iif(crTpmMvItn.TPesos = 0, 1, crTpmMvItn.TPesos), 2)
				Otherwise
					lnTotal = Round(Qtds * Units, 2 )
			EndCase

            If !IsEmpty( StrTran( LocalPro.ClFiscals, '.', '' ) ) or LocalPro.servicos = 1			
				lnTotalProd = lnTotalProd + lnTotal
			EndIf
		EndScan
	EndIf
	If CrTmpCfo.InclIcms = 3
		ThisForm.AtuaTot()
		=ThisForm.Procrateio()
		=ThisForm.Procrateio2()
	Else
		lnVezes = 2
	EndIf

	lcS = RTRIM(TiraChar(crSigMvNfi.Series))	&& Mena - 25/04/2019 - retirados caracteres inválidos do campo serie
	lcQuery = [Select Series, NldSer, MarPads, EspPads, Piss, FatBrutos, PesoVols ] + ;
	  			[From SigCnFnf ] + ;
	  		   [Where Emps = '] + ThisForm.pEmps + [' And ] + ;
	  		   		 [Series ='] + lcS + [' ]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigCnFnf') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CalcImposto - crSigCnFnf 1)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Select crSigCnFnf
	Go Top
	If Eof()
		lcQuery = [Select Series, NldSer, MarPads, EspPads, Piss, FatBrutos, PesoVols ] + ;
		  			[From SigCnFnf ] + ;
		  		   [Where Emps = '] + Space(3) + [' And ] + ;
	  		   		 [Series ='] + lcS + [' ]

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigCnFnf') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CalcImposto - crSigCnFnf 2)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Select crSigCnFnf
		Go Top
	EndIf
	Store 0 to lnAliqIpis, lnAliqIcms, lnValIpis, lnValIcms, lnTipoIcms, lnTipoIpis

	llCalcFrete = .f.
	Select crTpmMvItn
	SCAN
		If crTpmMvItn.CItens < 0 Or IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) Or ( lnCitem > 0 And crTpmMvItn.Citens <> lnCitem )
			Loop
		EndIf

		lcSql = [Select Cpros,ClFiscals,icms,cgrus,pesoms,TpTribs,PesoBs,Ipis,cunis,sgrus, idPro, AliqIpis, ]+;
				[pVens,pCuss,MarkupA,pvIdeals,Fabrproprs, origmercs, Valors,mercs,CodFinP,moecs,OrigMercs,SitTrIcms ]+;
				[From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
				
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpPro')	
		Select CrTmpPro
		Go Top In CrTmpPro
		If Empty(CrTmpPro.OrigMercs)

			EndIf
			lnDeI = lnDei + lnDif
			lnDei = IIF(TmpCfoI.Desicms = 1, lnDei, 0)
		EndIf
		**********************************************************************************************
		lnTotal = lnTotal + lnValIpis
		lCalcttri = .f.
		lnBaseRed = 0
		lnAliqIcmsS = 0
		lnBcIcmsS = 0
		lnValIcmss = 0
		lnBaseFrete = 0
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdIcm','CrTmpTrIcm','Codigos',CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms)

		If TmpCfoI.Icms = 'T' Or CrTmpTrIcm.Tipos = 'F'&&Substituição Tributária
			llSek = .f.
			lcSql = [Select * From SigPrTri Where Tipos = ']+CrTmpPro.TpTribs+[' And Movs = ']+crSigMvNfi.Operas+[']
			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'crSigPrTri') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CalcImposto - crSigPrTri 1)')
				Return 0
			EndIf
			Select crSigPrTri
			Index On Cfops + origems + destinos Tag Busca
			If Seek(crSigMvNfi.Cfis + lcChaveUf + lcChaveUf2) Or Seek(Space(10) + lcChaveUf + lcChaveUf2)
				llSek = .t.
			EndIf
			
			If Type([crSigOpCdi.ckVendaFis])=[N] And crSigOpCdi.ckVendaFis = 1
				lcChaveUf2 = lcChaveUf
			EndIf 
			
			*** mena 07/05/2017 - posiciona nas reduções se houver ***
			SELECT crTmpRed
			LOCATE for estas = lcChaveUf2
			********************************************************
			If ( llCalcIcms Or lnCitem > 0 ) And ( Not crTpmMvItn.AltImpost Or llForca )
				If llSek
					lnTipoIcms = 1
					If Not Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms) And InList(crTmpTrIcm.Colunas, '2', '3')
						lnTipoIcms = Val(CrTmpTrIcm.Colunas)
					EndIf
					lnAliqIcms  = crSigPrTri.Aliquotas
					lnAliqIcmsS = crSigPrTri.AliqIcmsts

					If crSigPrTri.bases <> 0
						lnBaseAnt  = lnBaseIcms
						lnBaseIcms = ( lnBaseIcms * ( (100.00-crSigPrTri.Bases)/100.00 ) )
						lnBaseRed  = lnBaseAnt - lnBaseIcms
					EndIf
					If crSigPrTri.reduzidas <> 0
						lnAliqIcms = crSigPrTri.Reduzidas
					EndIf
					lCalcttri = .t.
				Else
					lnTipoIcms = 1
					If !Empty(TmpCfoI.AliqIVCs)
						lnAliqIcms = TmpCfoI.AliqIVCs	&&tmpcfoi&&
					Else
						If Not Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms) And InList(crTmpTrIcm.Colunas, '2', '3')
							lnTipoIcms = Val(CrTmpTrIcm.Colunas)
						EndIf
						If lnTipoIcms = 1
							Declare laCampo(3,2)
							laCampo(1,1)='Codigos'
							laCampo(2,1)='Destinos'
							laCampo(3,1)='Cfos'
							laCampo(1,2)=lcChaveUf
							laCampo(2,2)=lcChaveUf2
							laCampo(3,2)=TmpCfoI.Codigos
							If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfd','CrTmpUfDes',@laCampo)
								lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUfDes.Aliqs
								lnAliqIcmsS = CrTmpUfDes.AliqSbs
								If CrTmpClf.AliqReds = 'S'
									If CrTmpUf.AReduzidas # 0
										lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUf.AReduzidas 
									ENDIF
									If !EOF('crTmpRed') and crTmpRed.aReds # 0	&& mena 07/05/2017 - reducao de aliquota por CLF
										lnAliqIcms = crTmpRed.aReds
									ENDIF
								EndIf
							Else
								laCampo(3,2)=Space(10)
								If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfd','CrTmpUfDes',@laCampo)
									lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUfDes.Aliqs
									lnAliqIcmsS = CrTmpUfDes.AliqSbs
									If CrTmpClf.AliqReds = 'S'
										If CrTmpUf.AReduzidas # 0
											lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUf.AReduzidas 
										ENDIF
										If !EOF('crTmpRed') and crTmpRed.aReds # 0	&& mena 07/05/2017 - reducao de aliquota por CLF
											lnAliqIcms = crTmpRed.aReds
										ENDIF
									EndIf
								Else
									Declare laCampo(2,2)
									laCampo(1,1)='Grupos'
									laCampo(2,1)='Ests'
									laCampo(1,2)=CrTmpPro.Cgrus
									laCampo(2,2)=lcEstadoNf
									If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfi','CrTmpCicFi',@laCampo)
										lnAliqIcms = CrTmpCiCfi.Icms
									Else
										If CrTmpPro.Icms > 0
											lnAliqIcms = CrTmpPro.Icms
										Else
											lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUf.AIcms
											lnAliqIcmsS = CrTmpUf.AliqSbs
											If CrTmpClf.AliqReds = 'S'
												If CrTmpUf.AReduzidas # 0
													lnAliqIcms = CrTmpUf.AReduzidas 
												ENDIF
												If !EOF('crTmpRed') and crTmpRed.aReds # 0	&& mena 07/05/2017 - reducao de aliquota por CLF
													lnAliqIcms = crTmpRed.aReds
												ENDIF
											EndIf
										EndIf
									EndIf
								EndIf
							EndIf
						EndIf
					ENDIF
					lnAliqIcms = IIF(lnAliqIcms <> 0 and llIcmsEsp,CrTmpUfDesPI.aliqpimps, lnAliqIcms)
					lnAliqIcms = IIF(RECCOUNT('localAlo') = 0 or localAlo.aliqlocal = 0, lnAliqIcms, localAlo.aliqlocal)
				EndIf

				If TmpCfoI.InclIcms = 2 And lnAliqIcms # 0
					lnBaseIcms = Round( LnBaseIcms / ( 1-(lnAliqIcms/100)) , 2 )
					If TmpCfoI.Icms = 'T'	&&tmpcfoi&&
	*					lnTotal    = Round( lnTotal    / ( 1-(lnAliqIcms/100)) , 2 )
					EndIf
				EndIf
				
				If CrTmpClf.BaseReds = 'S' And Not lCalcttri
					If !EOF('crTmpRed') and crTmpRed.bReds # 0
						lnBaseIcms = lnBaseIcms * ( 100 - crTmpRed.bReds ) / 100 
					else
						If CrTmpClf.BIcms # 0
							lnBaseIcms = lnBaseIcms * ( 100 - CrTmpClf.BIcms ) / 100 
						else
							If CrTmpUf.BIcms # 0
								lnBaseIcms = lnBaseIcms * ( 100 - CrTmpUf.BIcms ) / 100 
							EndIf
						ENDIF
					ENDIF
				EndIf

				*** Mena - 26/04/2018 - Soma IPI e despesas depois da base de icms ser calculada ***
				If CrTmpCli.TpClis = 1 Or Empty(CrTmpCli.Rgs) Or TmpCfoI.Ipi_Icms = 'S' &&Or CrTmpCfo.InclIcms = 2 &&tmpcfoi&&
					lnBaseIcms = lnBaseIcms + lnValIpis 
				EndIf
				
				If Empty(lnFri)
					If Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.PedidoWeb)
						lnFri = crSigMvNfi.VlFretes
					EndIf 
				EndIf 
				
				lnBaseIcms	= lnBaseIcms+lnFri+lnSgi+lnDei
				
				*** Mena - 03/01/2020  quando cst = 20 reducao em cima de tudo
				*** Mena - 26/04/2018 - faz reducao de base de calculo se CST de icms = 20 ***
				IF crTpmMvItn.sittricms =[20 ]	&& Essa reducao de base tem prioridade sobre as outras configuracoes
					lnBaseIcms = lnBaseIcms * (100 - CrTmpUfDesPI.aliqredb ) / 100 
				endif
				*************************************************************************************************************

				lnValIcms = Round( lnBaseIcms * lnAliqIcms / 100, 2 )

				If CrTmpTrIcm.Tipos = 'F' AND TmpCfoI.subTribs ='S'   && Mena - 11/03/2014 - usa CFOP do item para calculo da Substituição Tributária
					If lnAliqIcmsS = 0
						Declare laCampo(3,2)
						laCampo(1,1)='Codigos'
						laCampo(2,1)='Destinos'
						laCampo(3,1)='Cfos'
						laCampo(1,2)=lcChaveUf
						laCampo(2,2)=lcChaveUf2
						laCampo(3,2)=TmpCfoI.Codigos	&&tmpcfoi&&
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfd','CrTmpUfDes',@laCampo)
							lnAliqIcmsS = CrTmpUfDes.AliqSbs
						Else
							laCampo(3,2)=Space(10)
							If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfd','CrTmpUfDes',@laCampo)
								lnAliqIcmsS = CrTmpUfDes.AliqSbs
							Else
								lnAliqIcmsS = CrTmpUf.AliqSbs
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf

					*** se a aliq do icmss for 0 considera a aliquota do icms ***
                	lnAliqIcmsS = IIF(lnAliqIcmsS =0, lnAliqIcms, lnAliqIcmsS )

					**** Mena - 17/02/2014 - calcula substituicao com iva por classificacao ****
					lnIvaSt     = ( crTpmMvItn.Totas + crTpmMvItn.ValRats + crTpmMvItn.ValIpis + lnFri+lnSgi+lnDei )	&& mena 12/03/2014 acrescenta despesas à base icmss
					lnIvaSt     = ( lnIvaSt + (lnIvaSt * lnIndIva / 100) )

					Do Case					
						Case crSigCdOpe.Qtdprecos = 2 && Tiago - 17/07/2011 - Não
							lnBcIcmsS = Iif(llRecIcmsS, crTpmMvItn.BcIcmsS, ( Iif(crSigOpCdd.Bcsts = 2, lnIvaSt, CrTmpPro.Valors) ) )
						Case crSigCdOpe.Qtdprecos = 3 && Sim. - composição
							lnBcIcmsS = Iif(llRecIcmsS, crTpmMvItn.BcIcmsS, ( Iif(crSigOpCdd.Bcsts = 2, lnIvaSt, CrTmpPro.Valors) ) )
						Case crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 4 && Sim, Total de Peso
							lnBcIcmsS = Iif(llRecIcmsS, crTpmMvItn.BcIcmsS, ( Iif(crSigOpCdd.Bcsts = 2, lnIvaSt, CrTmpPro.Valors * Iif(crTpmMvItn.TPesos = 0, 1, crTpmMvItn.TPesos)) ) )
						Otherwise
							lnBcIcmsS = Iif(llRecIcmsS, crTpmMvItn.BcIcmsS, ( Iif(crSigOpCdd.Bcsts = 2, lnIvaSt, CrTmpPro.Valors * crTpmMvItn.Qtds) ) )
					ENDCASE

					*Mena - 04/04/2012 - verifica se aplica redução de base no icms substituição *
					lnBcIcmsS   = IIF(CrTmpClf.BIcmss=0,lnBcIcmsS, ( lnBcIcmsS * ( (100.00-CrTmpClf.BIcmss)/100.00 )))
					lnIcmSLoc   = Round( lnBcIcmsS * lnAliqIcmsS / 100, 2 )
					lnIcmSDes   = lnValIcms	&& mena 09/12/2015 - retirado lntt esta com valor errado Round( lnTT * lnAliqIcms / 100, 2 )
					lnValIcmsS  = Iif(llManterIcmsS,crTpmMvItn.IcmsS, ( lnIcmSLoc - lnIcmSDes ) )

					*** Mena - 06/05/2014 - se não tem iva, nao tem icmss ***
					lnBcIcmsS = IIF(lnIndIva=0,0,lnBcIcmsS)
					lnValIcmsS= IIF(lnIndIva=0,0,lnValIcmsS)
					
					Replace CfoSubs With CrTmpCfo.cfosts In crSigMvNfi
					If TmpCfoI.Icms <> 'T'
						lnTipoIcms = Iif( TmpCfoI.Icms = 'I', 2, 3 )
						lnAliqIcms = 0
						lnValIcms  = 0
						lnBcIcmsS   = 0
						lnAliqIcmsS = 0
						lnValIcmsS  = 0
					EndIf
					If Not Empty(CrTmpCfo.CfoSts)
						Replace CfoSub  With CrTmpCfo.CfoSts In crTpmMvItn
					EndIf
				Else
					If CrTmpTrIcm.Tipos = 'F' And Not Empty(CrTmpCfo.CfoSts)
						Replace CfoSub  With CrTmpCfo.CfoSts In crTpmMvItn
						Replace CfoSubs With CrTmpCfo.cfosts In crSigMvNfi
					EndIf
					lnBcIcmsS   = 0
					lnAliqIcmsS = 0
					lnValIcmsS  = 0
				EndIf
				Select crTpmMvItn
				If TmpCfoI.Icms = [T]
					Replace AliqIcms  With lnAliqIcms,;
							BaseIcms  With lnBaseIcms,;
							BaseIcm2s With 0,;
							BaseIcm3s With 0,;
							Icms      With lnValIcms,;
							Bcicmss   With lnBcIcmsS,;
							Icmss     With lnValIcmsS,;
							SiTribs   With Transf(lnTipoIcms,'@Z 9') in crTpmMvItn
				Else
					Replace AliqIcms  With 0,;
							BaseIcms  With 0,;
							BaseIcm2s With 0,;
							BaseIcm3s With 0,;
							Icms      With 0,;
							Bcicmss   With lnBcIcmsS,;
							Icmss     With lnValIcmsS,;
							SiTribs   With Transf(lnTipoIcms,'@Z 9') in crTpmMvItn
				EndIf
			Else
				lnAliqIcms = crTpmMvItn.AliqIcms
				lnValIcms  = crTpmMvItn.Icms
				lnBcIcmss  = crTpmMvItn.BcIcmss
				lnValIcmss = crTpmMvItn.Icmss
				lntipoIcms = Val(crTpmMvItn.Sitribs)
				lnBaseIcms = Iif(lntipoIcms=1,crTpmMvItn.BaseIcms,Iif(lntipoIcms=2,crTpmMvItn.BaseIcm2s,crTpmMvItn.BaseIcm3s))
				lnBaseRed  = Iif(lntipoIcms=1,crTpmMvItn.BaseIcm3s,0)
			EndIf
		Else
			lnTipoIcms = Iif( TmpCfoI.Icms = 'I', 2, 3 )
			Replace crTpmMvItn.AliqIcms  With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.BaseIcms  With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.BaseIcm2s With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.BaseIcm3s With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.BcIcmss   With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.Icms      With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.IcmsS     With 0,;
					crTpmMvItn.SiTribs   With Transf(lnTipoIcms,'@Z 9') in crTpmMvItn
