			xUnit = round( crTpmMvItn.Units / ( (100-crTpmMvItn.AliqIcms)/100 ),2)
			Replace Units With xUnit in crTpmMvItn
			ThisForm.Calc_valite()

			lcSql = [Select Cpros,ClFiscals,sittricms,icms,cgrus,pesoms,TpTribs,PesoBs,Ipis,cunis,sgrus, idPro, AliqIpis, ]+;
					[pVens,pCuss,MarkupA,pvIdeals,Fabrproprs, origmercs, Valors,mercs,CodFinP,moecs,OrigMercs,SitTrIcms ]+;
					[From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpPro')	
			Select CrTmpPro
			Go Top In CrTmpPro
			If Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms)
				Replace SitTrIcms With [00] In CrTmpPro
			EndIf
			If Empty(CrTmpPro.OrigMercs)
				Replace OrigMercs With [0] In CrTmpPro
			EndIf
			If Empty(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals)
				Replace ClFiscals With [0] In CrTmpPro
			EndIf
		EndIf

		Do Case
			Case lnTipoIpis = 1
				lnTotalBIpi1 = lnTotalBIpi1 + lnBaseIpis
				Replace BcIpis    With lnBaseIpis,;
						BaseIpi2s With 0,;
						BaseIpi3s With 0 In crTpmMvItn

			Case lnTipoIpis = 2
				lnTotalBIpi2 = lnTotalBIpi2 + lnBaseIpis
				Replace BaseIpi2s With lnBaseIpis ,;
						BaseIpi3s With 0,;
						BcIpis    With 0 In crTpmMvItn

			Case lnTipoIpis = 3
				lnTotalBIpi3 = lnTotalBIpi3 + lnBaseIpis
				Replace BaseIpi3s With lnBaseIpis ,;
						BaseIpi2s With 0,;
						BcIpis    With 0 In crTpmMvItn

		Endcase

		Do Case
			Case lnTipoIcms = 1
				lnTotalBIcm1 = lnTotalBIcm1 + lnBaseIcms
				lnTotalBIcm3 = lnTotalBIcm3 + lnBaseRed
				Replace BaseIcms  With lnBaseIcms ,;
						BaseIcm2s With 0,;
						BaseIcm3s With lnBaseRed In crTpmMvItn

			Case lnTipoIcms = 2
				lnTotalBIcm2 = lnTotalBIcm2 + lnBaseIcms
				Replace BaseIcm2s With lnBaseIcms ,;
						BaseIcm3s with 0,;
						BaseIcms  With 0 In crTpmMvItn

			Case lnTipoIcms = 3
				lnTotalBIcm3 = lnTotalBIcm3 + lnBaseIcms
				Replace BaseIcm3s With lnBaseIcms ,;
						BaseIcm2s With 0,;
						BaseIcms  With 0 In crTpmMvItn

		Endcase

		*** Mena - 11/03/2020 - Rateia despesas para calcular PIS e Cofins ***
		STORE 0 to lnFri, lnSgi, lnDei
		SELECT crTpmMvItn
		lnQtdI = _tItem		&& qtde de itens para calculo do PIS Cofins
		IF lnQtdI > 0		&& mena - verifica se tem itens para ratear	
			lnDif = 0
			lnFri = round(crSigMvNfi.VlFretes / lnQtdI, 2)
			If Recno() = Reccount()
				lnDif = crSigMvNfi.VlFretes - (lnFri*lnQtdI)
			EndIf
			lnFrI = lnFri + lnDif
			
			lnDif = 0
			lnSgi = round(crSigMvNfi.VlSeguros / lnQtdI, 2)
			If Recno() = Reccount()
				lnDif = crSigMvNfi.VlSeguros - (lnSgi*lnQtdI)
			EndIf
			lnSgI = lnSgi + lnDif

			lnDif = 0
			lnDei = round(crSigMvNfi.Despaces / lnQtdI, 2)
			If Recno() = Reccount()
				lnDif = crSigMvNfi.despaces - (lnDei*lnQtdI)
			EndIf
			lnDeI = lnDei + lnDif
		EndIf
		**********************************************************************************************

		If Not crTpmMvItn.AltImpost
			lcConta = crSigMvNfi.CliFors
			
			lnBas = crTpmMvItn.Totas +lnFri+lnSgi+lnDei+crTpmMvItn.Valrats 			
			Replace valbases With lnBas In crTpmMvItn	&& mena - 22/04/2014 - grava valor base de impostos

			lnAli = VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [PIS], ThisForm.PodataMgr ), 21,5))
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, IIF(TmpCfoI.AliqPis = 0, crSigCdEmp.PorcPis, TmpCfoI.AliqPis))
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			
			*-- Rafael 23/09/2021 - quando estiver configurado = SIM o Valor da base é menos o ICMS e muda o valor do imposto
			If Type([crSigOpCdi.ExICBsImp])=[N] And crSigOpCdi.ExICBsImp = 1
				lnBasPis = lnBas - lnValIcms
				lnVal = (lnBasPis * lnAli) / 100
			EndIf 		
			Replace aliqPis With lnAli ,;
					vpis with lnVal In crTpmMvItn

			lnAli = VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [COFINS], ThisForm.poDataMgr), 21,5))
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, IIF(TmpCfoI.AliqCofins = 0, crSigCdEmp.PorcCons, TmpCfoI.AliqCofins))
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			
			*-- Rafael 23/09/2021 - quando estiver configurado = SIM o Valor da base é menos o ICMS e muda o valor do imposto
			If Type([crSigOpCdi.ExICBsImp])=[N] And crSigOpCdi.ExICBsImp = 1
				lnBasCof = lnBas - lnValIcms
				lnVal = (lnBasCof * lnAli) / 100
			EndIf 
			
			Replace aliqCofs With lnAli ,;
					vCofins with lnVal In crTpmMvItn

			lnAli = VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [II], ThisForm.PodataMgr ), 21,5))
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, TmpCfoI.AliqII)
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			Replace aliqIIs With lnAli ,;
					TaxaIIs with lnVal In crTpmMvItn

			lnAli = VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [ISS], ThisForm.PodataMgr ), 21,5))
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, TmpCfoI.Aliqissqn)
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			Replace iss with IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1, lnVal, 0) In crTpmMvItn

			lnAli = 0
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [IRRF], ThisForm.PodataMgr ), 21,5)))
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			Replace irrf with IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1, lnVal, 0) In crTpmMvItn

			lnAli = 0
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [INSS], ThisForm.PodataMgr ), 21,5)))
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			Replace inss with IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1, lnVal, 0) In crTpmMvItn

			lnAli = 0
			lnAli = IIF(lnAli <> 0, lnAli, VAL(SUBSTR(FSigOpFin_imp(lcConta, [], [CSSL], ThisForm.PodataMgr ), 21,5)))
			lnVal = (lnBas * lnAli) / 100
			Replace cssl with IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1, lnVal, 0) In crTpmMvItn
			****************************************************************
		ENDIF


		lnTotalIpi  = lnTotalIpi + lnValIpis
		lnTotalIcm  = lnTotalIcm + lnValIcms
		lnTotalNota = lnTotalNota + lnTotal
		lnTotBcIcmss= lnTotBcIcmss + lnBcIcmss
		lnTotIcmss  = lnTotIcmss + lnValIcmsS

		IF INLIST(Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 27, 1))),2,3,4)
			lnTotServ = lnTotServ + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.iss+crTpmMvItn.inss+crTpmMvItn.irrf+crTpmMvItn.cssl+crTpmMvItn.Vpis+crTpmMvItn.Vcofins, 0)

			lnTotIss  = lnTotIss + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.iss, 0)
			lnTotInss = lnTotInss + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.inss, 0)
			lnTotIrrf = lnTotIrrf + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.irrf, 0)
			lnTotCssl = lnTotCssl + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.cssl, 0)
			lnTotPis  = lnTotPis + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.Vpis, 0)
			lnTotCof  = lnTotCof + IIF(CrTmpGru.servicos = 1,crTpmMvItn.Vcofins, 0)

		ENDIF

		If crSigOpCdi.chkInvs = 1
			lnTotalPeso = ( lnTotalPeso + crTpmMvItn.Pesos )
			lnTotBruto  = ( lnTotBruto  + crTpmMvItn.Pesos )
		Else

			If crTpmMvItn.Pesos # 0
				lnTotalPeso = lnTotalPeso + ( crTpmMvItn.Pesos * crTpmMvItn.Qtds )
			Else
				lnTotalPeso = lnTotalPeso + ( CrTmpPro.Pesoms * crTpmMvItn.Qtds ) 
			EndIf

			If crSigCnFnf.FatBrutos = 0
				lnTotBruto = lnTotBruto + IIF(CrTmpPro.PesoBs > 0, CrTmpPro.PesoBs,IIF(crTpmMvItn.Pesos#0,crTpmMvItn.Pesos,CrTmpPro.PesoMs) * crTpmMvItn.Qtds )
				IF CrTmpPro.PesoBs = 0
					Select crTpmMvIts
					SET ORDER TO CItens
					IF SEEK(crTpmMvItn.Citens) AND ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdEmb','CrTmpEmb','Cods',crTpmMvIts.CodEmbs)
						lnTotBruto = lnTotBruto + ( crTmpEmb.Pesos * crTpmMvIts.Qtds ) 
					EndIf
				EndIf
			Else
				lnTotBruto = lnTotBruto + ( IIF(CrTmpPro.PesoBs > 0, CrTmpPro.PesoBs,IIF(crTpmMvItn.Pesos#0,crTpmMvItn.Pesos,CrTmpPro.PesoMs) * crTpmMvItn.Qtds ) * crSigCnFnf.FatBrutos )
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndScan
Next

If Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CfoSubs)
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Locate For Not Empty(CfoSub)
	If Eof()
		Replace CfoSubs With ' ' In crSigMvNfi
	EndIf
EndIf

If crSigCnFnf.PesoVols # 0
	lnTotBruto = lnTotBruto + (crSigMvNfi.Qtdes * crSigCnFnf.PesoVols)
EndIf

If _tItem = 0 And lnTotalNota = 0 And TprMvCab.ValServs <> 0 And TprMvCab.ValVars <> 0
	lnTotalNota = TprMvCab.ValVars
EndIf

If lnCItem = 0

	lnAliqMed = ThisForm.CalcBasFrt()
	llCalcFrete = ( TprMvCab.AliqMed <> 0 And Str(TprMvCab.AliqMed,12,6) <> Str(lnAliqMed,12,6) )
	
	Replace AliqMed With lnAliqMed In TprMvCab
	
	lnRatBas  = ( lnTotalBIcm1 + lnTotalBIcm2 + lnTotalBIcm3 )
	lnRatBas1 = Iif(lnRatBas <> 0,( lnTotalBIcm1 / ( lnRatBas )),1)
	lnRatBas2 = Iif(lnRatBas <> 0,( lnTotalBIcm2 / ( lnRatBas )),1)
	lnRatBas3 = Iif(lnRatBas <> 0,( lnTotalBIcm3 / ( lnRatBas )),1)

	lnBaseFRT = crSigMvNfi.VlFretes  + Iif(CrTmpCfo.Ipi_Icms = 'S',crSigMvNfi.FrtIpis,0)
	lnBaseVLS = crSigMvNfi.VlSeguros + Iif(CrTmpCfo.Ipi_Icms = 'S',crSigMvNfi.SegIpis,0)
	lnBaseDAC = crSigMvNfi.DespAces  + Iif(CrTmpCfo.Ipi_Icms = 'S',crSigMvNfi.DesIpis,0)

	If crSigMvNfi.VlFretes # 0 And CrTmpCfo.Frticms = 1 
		If CrTmpCfo.IcmsIncs = 2
			lnBaseFRT = ( lnBaseFRT / ( 1 - ( lnAliqMed/100 ) ) )
		EndIf
		If  (crSigMvNfi.FrtIcms = 0 Or llCalcFrete )
			lnValFrete = Round( lnBaseFRT * lnAliqMed / 100,2 )
			Replace FrtIcms With lnValFrete in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigMvNfi.VlSeguros # 0 And CrTmpCfo.Segicms = 1
		If CrTmpCfo.IcmsIncs = 2
			lnBaseVLS = ( lnBaseVLS / ( 1 - ( lnAliqMed/100 ) ) )
		EndIf
		If ( crSigMvNfi.SegIcms = 0 Or llCalcFrete )
			lnValSeg = Round( lnBaseVLS * lnAliqMed / 100,2 )
			Replace SegIcms With lnValSeg in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigMvNfi.DespAces # 0 And CrTmpCfo.Desicms = 1 
		If CrTmpCfo.IcmsIncs = 2
			lnBaseDAC = ( lnBaseDAC / ( 1 - ( lnAliqMed/100 ) ) )
		EndIf
		If ( crSigMvNfi.DesIcms = 0 Or llCalcFrete )
			lnValDes = Round( lnBaseDAC * lnAliqMed / 100,2 )
			Replace DesIcms With lnValDes in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigMvNfi.VlFretes # 0 And crSigMvNfi.FrtIpis = 0 And CrTmpCfo.FrtIpis = 1 And ;
			ThisForm.NaoCalculaIpi And lnTotalBIpi1 > 0
		_xPerc  = ( lnTotalIpi / lnTotalBIpi1 )
		_IpiFrt = ( crSigMvNfi.vlFretes * _xPerc )
		Replace VlFretes With VlFretes - _IpiFrt,;
				FrtIpis  With _IpiFrt in crSigMvNfi
	EndIf

	OutBIpi = 0
	OutIcm = Iif(CrTmpCfo.FrtIcms=1 And crSigMvNfi.FrtIcms <> 0,lnBaseFRT, Iif(CrTmpCfo.Ipi_Icms = 'S', crSigMvNfi.FrtIpis, 0)) + ;
			 Iif(CrTmpCfo.SegIcms=1 And crSigMvNfi.SegIcms <> 0,lnBaseVLS, Iif(CrTmpCfo.Ipi_Icms = 'S', crSigMvNfi.SegIpis, 0)) + ;
			 Iif(CrTmpCfo.DesIcms=1 And crSigMvNfi.DesIcms <> 0,lnBaseDAC, Iif(CrTmpCfo.Ipi_Icms = 'S', crSigMvNfi.DesIpis, 0))

	OutIpi = Iif(CrTmpCfo.FrtIpis=1 And crSigMvNfi.FrtIpis <> 0,crSigMvNfi.VlFretes,  0) + ;
			 Iif(CrTmpCfo.SegIpis=1 And crSigMvNfi.SegIpis <> 0,crSigMvNfi.VlSeguros, 0) + ;
			 Iif(CrTmpCfo.DesIpis=1 And crSigMvNfi.DesIpis <> 0,crSigMvNfi.DespAces,  0)
		
	Select crSigMvNfi
	Replace BasecIpis With lnTotalBIpi1 + OutIpi , ;
			BasecIp2s With lnTotalBIpi2, ;
			BasecIp3s With lnTotalBIpi3, ;
			BasecIcms With lnTotalBIcm1, ;
			BasecIc2s With lnTotalBIcm2 , ;
			BasecIc3s With lnTotalBIcm3 , ;
			ValIpis   With lnTotalIpi + FrtIpis + SegIpis + DesIpis,;
			ValIcms   With lntotalIcm,;
			BcIcmss   With lnTotBcIcmss,;
			Icmss     With lnTotIcmss,;
			vTotIss   With lnTotIss, ;
			Vinss	  With lnTotInss, ;
			Virf	  With lnTotIrrf, ;
			Vcsll	  With lnTotCssl, ;
			Vpis	  With lnTotPis, ;
			Vcofins	  With lnTotCof, ;
			TotProds  With lnTotalProd,  ;
			TotNotas  With lnTotalNota + crSigMvNfi.Icmss + ;
						   crSigMvNfi.VlFretes + crSigMvNfi.vlseguros + crSigMvNfi.despaces + ;
						   crSigMvNfi.FrtIpis + crSigMvNfi.DesIpis + crSigMvNfi.SegIpis + ;
						   TprMvCab.ValServs

	If (crSigOpCdc.AltIntFs = 1)
		Replace PLiqs With lnTotalPeso,  ;
				PBrus With lnTotBruto In crSigMvNfi
	EndIf
	
	If CrTmpCfo.IncIcmNfs = 1
		Replace TotNotas With TotNotas + ValIcms In crSigMvNfi
	EndIf

	If (crSigOpCdc.AltIntFs = 1) And Not IsEmpty( TprMvCab.PLiqs )
		Replace crSigMvNfi.PLiqs With TprMvCab.PLiqs, ;
				crSigMvNfi.PBrus With TprMvCab.PBrus
	EndIf
	
	If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		ThisForm.Atuatot(llGerFilho)
	EndIf
EndIf

If (crSigOpCdd.SubFretes	= 1) && Utilizar Frete do Subnível
	lnFrt = 0
	Select TmpOperacao
	Go Top In TmpOperacao
	Scan While (lnFrt = 0)
		If Not Empty(TmpOperacao.Fretes)
			lnFrt = TmpOperacao.Fretes
		EndIf
	EndScan
	If (lnFrt > 0)
		Replace Fretes With lnFrt In crSigMvNfi
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE calcservico
RETURN





ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE calculapar
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE calculapar
Lparameters pTabela
Local cTotal, _RecNo, Cotacao, CotOper, _Moeda, lcTabela

lcTabela = Iif(Type('pTabela')=[C],pTabela,'xPar')
_Moeda = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, Iif( Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )

cTotal=0
Select (lcTabela)
Scan
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',&lcTabela..Fpags)
	Cotacao = ThisForm.Cotacao( &lcTabela..moefpgs )
	CotOper = ThisForm.Cotacao( _Moeda )
	lnInd   = Iif(crSigOpFp.Indices=0,1,crSigOpFp.Indices)
	If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
		cTotal = Round( cTotal - ( &lcTabela..Valos * (&lcTabela..CotFPgs*lnInd) / CotOper ), 2 )
	Else
		cTotal = Round( cTotal + ( &lcTabela..Valos * (&lcTabela..CotFPgs*lnInd) / CotOper ), 2 )
	EndIf
Endscan
Return (cTotal)
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE calcularvcto
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE calcularvcto
Lparameters pDat, pVct, pTip, pCnx
Local ldDtg, ldRet, ldDat
If (pTip = 2)
	ldDtg = Dtos(Gomonth(pVct, 1))
	ldRet = Ctod([10/] + Substr(ldDtg, 5, 2) + [/] + Left(ldDtg, 4))
	ldDat = ldRet
Else
	If (pTip = 3)
		ldDtg = Dtos(Gomonth(pVct,1))
		ldRet = pVct
		If (Day(ldRet) <= 15)
			ldDat = Ctod([01/] + Substr(ldDtg, 5, 2) + [/] + Left(ldDtg, 4)) - 1
		Else
			ldDat = Ctod([15/] + Substr(ldDtg, 5, 2) + [/] + Left(ldDtg, 4))
		EndIf
	Else
		ldRet = pVct
		ldDat = ldRet
	EndIf
EndIf
Do While .t.
	If fChkFeriado(pCnx, ldDat) Or InList(Dow(ldDat), 1, 7)
		ldDat = ldDat - 1
	Else
		Exit
	EndIf
EndDo
ldRet = ldDat
Return ldRet

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE calc_valite
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE calc_valite
Lparameters pArqItem, pArqCab, pMantV

Local lcpArqItem, lcpArqCab, lcMoeVs
Local lnCasas, lnValIpi, lnNParcs, llAtualiza, _xPrecoParc, _xPrecoNovo, llMoePreco, lcMoeFormula, llChkCot

If Type('pArqItem')='C'
	lcpArqItem = Alltrim(pArqItem)
Else
	lcpArqItem = 'crTpmMvItn'
Endif

If Type('pArqCab')='C'
	lcpArqCab = Alltrim(pArqCab)
Else
	lcpArqCab = 'TprMvCab'
Endif

Select ( lcpArqItem )

lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, a.Moevs, a.Moecs, a.Moedas, a.ClFiscals, a.Cgrus, a.Linhas, a.Colecoes, a.CUnis, ] + ;
	[a.CUniPs, a.CProEqs, a.vUltComps, a.CFtios, a.Sgrus, a.Mercs, a.CodFinP, a.OrigMercs, ] + ;
	[a.SitTrIcms, a.AliqIpis, a.mUltComps, b.CfgGerGprs, a.moecusfs, a.figjpgs, a.dpros ] + ;
	[From SigCdPro a, SigCdGrp b ] + ;
	[Where a.CPros = '] + &lcpArqItem..Cpros + [' And ] + ;
	[a.CGrus = b.CGrus]

If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crTmpPro]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crTmpPro)])
	Return 0
Endif

Select CrTmpPro
Go Top In CrTmpPro
If Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms)
	Replace SitTrIcms With [00] In CrTmpPro
Endif
If Empty(CrTmpPro.OrigMercs)
	Replace OrigMercs With [0] In CrTmpPro
Endif
If Empty(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals)
	Replace ClFiscals With [0] In CrTmpPro
Endif

lcWhere = [Select Arreds, TipoEstos, Tams, Cores, Embs, chkInstalas From SigCdGrp Where Cgrus = ']+CrTmpPro.Cgrus+[']
lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigCdGrp')
If lnErro < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdGrp)')
	Return .F.
Endif

If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
	=fCustoMedio(&lcpArqCab..Emps,CrTmpPro.Cpros,&lcpArqCab..DataS,Thisform.poDataMgr,(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
Endif

lcMoeVs = CrTmpPro.Moecs
If Inlist(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
	_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
	lcQuery = [Select Moevs,Pvens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
	If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 And Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
		lcMoeVs   = CrTmpfPro.Moevs
	Endif
EndIf

*-- 25/06/2019 - Opção nao Altera Preço
If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 14
	Return .T.
EndIf 
*--

lcMoeFormula = Iif( crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 1, Padr( CrTmpPro.Moevs, 10 ), ;
	Iif( crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 2, Padr( lcMoeVs, 10 ), ;
	Iif( crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 5, Padr( CrTmpPro.Moedas,10 ), ;
	Iif( crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7, Padr( CrTmpPro.mUltComps,10),;
	Iif( crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 8, Padr( TmpCusMed.Moedas,10), .F. )))))


If Empty( &lcpArqItem..Utilizas ) And ( Not Empty( &lcpArqItem..Cpros ) )
	lnValIpi = 0
	If crSigCdOpe.Cupfis = 1 And !Empty(crSigCdOpe.Cfos)
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','CrSigCdCfo','Codigos',crSigCdOpe.Cfos) And CrSigCdCfo.Ipis = 'T'
			If Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdClf','CrSigCdClf','Codigos',CrTmpPro.ClFiscals) And crSigCdClf.Ipis = 'T'
				lnValIpi = ( Iif(CrTmpPro.AliqIpis>0,CrTmpPro.AliqIpis,crSigCdClf.AIpis)  / 100 )
			Endif
		Endif
	Endif
	Select &lcpArqItem.

	lnCasas   = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Cupfis = 1 And crSigCdOpe.Casas > 2, 2, crSigCdOpe.Casas )
	_Formulas = Thisform.Formula1( lcMoeFormula, lcpArqCab )
	_Formula1 = Mline( _Formulas, 1 )
	_Moeda1   = Padr(Mline( _Formulas, 2 ),3)
	_Formula2 = Mline( _Formulas, 3 )
	_Moeda2   = Padr(Mline( _Formulas, 4 ),3)

	xTabela = &lcpArqCab..Tabds
	_pAuto  = Iif(crSigCdOpe.PrecoAuts = 3,2,1)

	For _CntCalc = 1 To _pAuto

		Select &lcpArqItem.

		_xMoeFator = &lcpArqItem..MoeFats
		_xMoeOper  = Iif(Empty(crSigCdOpe.CMoes),&lcpArqCab..MoeIts,crSigCdOpe.CMoes)
		llMoePreco = .F.
		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoAuts,1,3)
			If !Empty( &lcpArqCab..LPrecos )
				lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdLpi Where Cpros = ']+&lcpArqItem..Cpros+[' And LPrecos = ']+&lcpArqCab..LPrecos+[']
				lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigCdLpi')
				If lnErro < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdLpi 4)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
				Select crSigCdLpi
				Go Top
				If Reccount() > 0 And (IsEmpty(crSigCdLpi.VencFs) Or Between(&lcpArqCab..DataS,crSigCdLpi.VencIs, crSigCdLpi.VencFs))
					_xMoePreco = crSigCdLpi.Moevs
					llMoePreco = .T.
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif

		If Not llMoePreco
			_xMoePreco = ''
			If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs, 1, 9) &&crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 1 && Richard em 12/03/2014
				_xMoePreco = CrTmpPro.Moevs
			Else
				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,2,11,15)
					&&_xMoePreco = CrTmpPro.MoeCs
					_xMoePreco = Iif(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=2, CrTmpPro.Moecs, CrTmpPro.Moecusfs)	&& mena - 21/03/2014 pega moeda correspondente (flag = 11 -> total custo)
					If Inlist(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
						_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
						lcQuery = [Select Moevs,Pvens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
						=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
						If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 And Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
							_xMoePreco = CrTmpfPro.Moevs
						Endif
					Endif
					lcMoeda = _xMoePreco
					=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdMoe','crSigCdMoe','Cmoes',_xMoePreco)
					If Not Empty(crSigCdMoe.MoeQs)
						_xMoePreco = crSigCdMoe.MoeQs
					EndIf
					
					If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 15
						_xMoePreco = CrTmpPro.Moecusfs
						lcQuery = [select customedioreais as csmedio, (select moedaps from sigcdpam) as csmoedas ] + ;
								[from customedio3 where cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' ]
						If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpProMd') < 1
							=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpProMd)')
							Return 0
						EndIf
						If Reccount('CrTmpProMd')>0
							_xMoePreco = CrTmpProMd.csmoedas
						EndIf 	
					EndIf			
				Else
					If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 4 And &lcpArqItem..CodBarras > 0 && Tiago - 22/01/2016 - Costantini - Incluído para quando for preço = subnivel e não carregou o item buscar o valor do subnivel quando for barra
						_xMoePreco = &lcpArqItem..Moevs
					Else
						If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs, 5, 10)  && Richard em 13/03/2014 - Incluido o tipo 10
							_xMoePreco = CrTmpPro.Moedas
						Else
							If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7
								_xMoePreco = CrTmpPro.mUltComps
							Else
								If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
									=fCustoMedio(&lcpArqCab..Emps,CrTmpPro.Cpros,&lcpArqCab..DataS,Thisform.poDataMgr,(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
									_xMoePreco = TmpCusMed.Moedas
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif

		_xCotFator = Thisform.Cotacao( _xMoeFator )
		_xCotPreco = Thisform.Cotacao( _xMoePreco )
		_xCotOper  = Thisform.Cotacao( _xMoeOper )
		_xCotForm1 = Thisform.Cotacao( _Moeda1 )
		_xCotForm2 = Thisform.Cotacao( _Moeda2 )

		* Richard 26/07/2012 - Colocado para Vianna Para Acatar o
		* Ignora Cotação Em caso de uso da lista de precificação
		xTabela = &lcpArqCab..Tabds &&TprMvCab.TabDs && crSigCdOpe.TabdPs

		lcWhere = [Select * From SigOpTdt Where Codigos = ']+xTabela+[']
		lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigOpTdt')
		If lnErro < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigOpTdt)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
		Select crSigOpTdt
		Index On Codigos + Str(Tipos,1) + CodTips Tag CodTips
		If (Seek( xTabela + '4' + CrTmpPro.Cpros ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '9' + CrTmpPro.CodFinP ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '1' + CrTmpPro.Cgrus ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '2' + CrTmpPro.Linhas ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '3' + CrTmpPro.Colecoes ) Or ;
				( Type('lcMoeFormula') = 'C' And Seek( xTabela + '5' + lcMoeFormula, 'crSigOpTdt', 'CodTips' ) ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '6' + CrTmpPro.cunis ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '7' + CrTmpPro.Cftios ) Or ;
				Seek( xTabela + '8' + CrTmpPro.Sgrus )) And ;
				(crSigOpTdt.ChkCots = 1)
			_xCotForm1 = 0
			_xCotForm2 = 0
			_xCotOper  = 0
		Endif

		If !IsEmpty( _Formula1 ) Or !IsEmpty( _Formula2 )
			_Peso = &lcpArqItem..Pesos / Iif( &lcpArqItem..EtiEsps, Iif( Not IsEmpty(&lcpArqItem..Qtds), &lcpArqItem..Qtds, 1), 1 )
			_Comprimento = Iif(&lcpArqItem..Compris <> 0, &lcpArqItem..Compris, 1)
			_xFator = &lcpArqItem..Fators
			_xFator = Iif(_xFator = 0,1,_xFator)
			_xPreco = &lcpArqItem..Univals
			_Qtde = &lcpArqItem..Qtds
			Store 0 To _xTotalPeso, _xTotalPreco
			If !IsEmpty( _Formula1 )
				If !IsEmpty( _xMoeOper ) Or !IsEmpty( _Moeda1 )
					_Fator = ' ( _xFator * _xCotFator ) '
					_Preco = ' ( _xPreco * _xCotPreco ) '
				Else
					_Fator = ' _xFator '
					_Preco = ' _xPreco '
				Endif
				_xTotalPeso = &_Formula1 / Iif( IsEmpty( _xMoeOper ) And _xCotForm1 > 0, _xCotForm1, 1 )
			Endif
			If !IsEmpty( _Moeda1 ) And IsEmpty( _xMoeOper )
				_xMoeFator = _Moeda1
				_xCotFator = Thisform.Cotacao( _xMoeFator )
				If &lcpArqItem..MoeFats <> _Moeda1
					Replace &lcpArqItem..MoeFats With _Moeda1 In &lcpArqItem.
				EndIf 
			Endif
			If !IsEmpty( _Formula2 )
				If !IsEmpty( _xMoeOper ) Or !IsEmpty( _Moeda2 )
					_Fator = ' ( _xFator * _xCotFator ) '
					_Preco = ' ( _xPreco * _xCotPreco ) '
				Else
					_Fator = ' _xFator '
					_Preco = ' _xPreco '
				Endif
				_xTotalPreco = &_Formula2 / Iif( IsEmpty( _xMoeOper ) And _xCotForm2 > 0, _xCotForm2, 1 )
			Endif
			If !IsEmpty( _Moeda2 ) And IsEmpty( _xMoeOper )
				_xMoePreco = _Moeda2
				_xCotPreco = Thisform.Cotacao( _xMoePreco )
				Select &lcpArqItem.
				If &lcpArqItem..Moedas <> _Moeda2
					Replace &lcpArqItem..Moedas With _Moeda2 In &lcpArqItem.
				EndIf 
			Endif
		Else

			_xTotalPeso = &lcpArqItem..Pesos * &lcpArqItem..Fators * Iif( IsEmpty( _xMoeOper ), 1 , _xCotFator )

			If Seek( xTabela, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos' ) And CsSigOpTdz.Fators <> 0
				_CotaFat = Iif(Not Empty(CsSigOpTdz.MoeFats),Thisform.Cotacao(CsSigOpTdz.MoeFats),1)
				_xTotalPreco = ( &lcpArqItem..Univals * CsSigOpTdz.Fators * _CotaFat )
				_xMoeOper    = Iif(Empty(_xMoeOper),CsSigOpTdz.MoeFats,_xMoeOper)
			Else
				_xTotalPreco = &lcpArqItem..Univals * Iif( IsEmpty( _xMoeOper ), 1 , _xCotPreco )
			Endif
		Endif

		If _CntCalc = 2
			xTabela = crSigCdOpe.TabdPs
		Endif

		_xDescTabela = 1
		_xDescFator  = 1
		_xDescUnit   = 1
		lnNParcs     = 0

		If Seek( xTabela, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos' )
			lcSql = [Select Grupos,Contas,Retiras From SigCdMin Where ]+;
				[Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Emps=']+TprMvCab.Emps+[']
			lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocalPrEmp')
			If lnErro < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (LocalPrEmp)')
				Return .F.
			Endif
			Select Retiras From LocalPrEmp Where Grupos+Contas = &lcpArqCab..GrupoOs+&lcpArqCab..ContaOs ;
				Into Cursor ProPrEmp

			*!*				_xDescTabela = 1
			*** Tiago - 21/06/2012 - Costantini - Não tava tirando o desconto da tabela de variação
			_xDescTabela = 1 - Iif(((CsSigOpTdz.ChkRets=1 And (ProPrEmp.Retiras=1 Or (ProPrEmp.Retiras=3 And ;
				CrTmpPro.Retiras=1))) Or CsSigOpTdz.ChkRets <> 1 Or (Reccount('ProPrEmp') = 0 And ;
				CrTmpPro.Retiras=1)), ( CsSigOpTdz.Descos / 100 ) , 0 )
			***

			lnNParcs     = CsSigOpTdz.nParcs
		Endif

		_Lista = Thisform.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value
		Ok = .T.
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdLpc','crSigCdLpc','lPrecos',_Lista)
			If crSigCdLpc.Formulas = 2
				lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdLpi Where Cpros = ']+&lcpArqItem..Cpros+[' And LPrecos = ']+_Lista+[']
				lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigCdLpi')
				If lnErro < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdLpi 5)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
				Select crSigCdLpi
				If Reccount() > 0
					Ok = .F.
				Endif
			Endif
			If crSigCdLpc.AplicTabds = 2
				If crSigCdLpc.Descos # 0 And Not Empty(crSigCdLpc.Tabds) And !Ok
					If Seek(crSigCdLpc.Tabds, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos' ) And CsSigOpTdz.Codigos # &lcpArqCab..Tabds  &&Calculo de Juro composto
						lnPar   = CsSigOpTdz.nParcs
						lnnDias = lnNParcs - lnPar
						lnJurosDia   = Round((((1+crSigCdLpc.Descos/100) ^ (1/30)) - 1) * 100, 9)
						_xDescTabela = ( ( 1 + lnJurosDia / 100) ^ (lnnDias*30) )
						_xDescTabela = Iif(_xDescTabela = 0,1,_xDescTabela)
					Else
						_xDescTabela = 1
					Endif
				Else
					_xDescTabela = 1
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
		If Ok
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigOpTdt Where Codigos = ']+xTabela+[']
			lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigOpTdt')
			If lnErro < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigOpTdt)')
				Return .F.
			Endif
			Select crSigOpTdt
			Index On Codigos + Str(Tipos,1) + CodTips Tag CodTips
			If Seek( xTabela + '4' + CrTmpPro.Cpros ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '9' + CrTmpPro.CodFinP ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '1' + CrTmpPro.Cgrus ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '2' + CrTmpPro.Linhas ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '3' + CrTmpPro.Colecoes ) Or ;
					( Type('lcMoeFormula') = 'C' And Seek( xTabela + '5' + lcMoeFormula, 'crSigOpTdt', 'CodTips' ) ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '6' + CrTmpPro.cunis ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '7' + CrTmpPro.Cftios ) Or ;
					Seek( xTabela + '8' + CrTmpPro.Sgrus )

				_xDescTabela = Iif(crSigOpTdt.TExclus = [S],1,_xDescTabela)
				_pDesco      = crSigOpTdt.Descos
				_pdFator     = crSigOpTdt.DFators

				lcCdTabDi = crSigOpTdt.Codigos
				lnTipos   = crSigOpTdt.Tipos
				lcCodTips = crSigOpTdt.CodTips
				lnTipod   = crSigOpTdt.TipoDs
				_nChvTbd  = 0

				If (crSigOpTdt.FatorPads > 0) And Empty(&lcpArqItem..Fators)
					Replace Fators With crSigOpTdt.FatorPads In &lcpArqItem.
				Endif

				lcWhere = [Select * From SigOpTds Where Codigos = ']+xTabela+[']
				lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigOpTds')
				If lnErro < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigOpTds)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
				If Reccount('crSigOpTds') > 0
					Select crSigOpTds
					Index On Codigos + Str(Tipos,1) + CodTips + Str(TipoDs,1) Tag TabTipos
					Set Key To lcCdTabDi + Str(lnTipos,1) + lcCodTips + Str(lnTipod,1)

					lcData = Ttoc(Thisform.DataAbertura)
					lcHora = Substr(lcData,12,5)

					Do Case
					Case crSigOpTdt.TipoDs = 2
						lcDiaSemana = Dow(Thisform.DataAbertura)
						Locate For Between(Padr(lcDiaSemana,10),Campo4is,Campo4fs)
						If Not Eof()
							Scan While Between(Padr(lcDiaSemana,10),Campo4is,Campo4fs)
								If Between(Padr(lcHora,10),Campo2is,Campo2fs)
									_pDesco   = crSigOpTds.Descos
									_pdFator  = crSigOpTds.DFators
									_nChvTbd  = crSigOpTds.nChvTbds
									Exit
								Endif
							Endscan
						Endif

					Case crSigOpTdt.TipoDs = 3
						lcDiaMes = Transform(Day(Thisform.DataAbertura),"@L 99")
						Locate For Between(Padr(lcDiaMes,10),Campo1is,Campo1fs)
						If Not Eof()
							Scan While Between(Padr(lcDiaMes,10),Campo1is,Campo1fs)
								If Between(Padr(lcHora,10),Campo2is,Campo2fs)
									_pDesco   = crSigOpTds.Descos
									_pdFator  = crSigOpTds.DFators
									_nChvTbd  = crSigOpTds.nChvTbds
									Exit
								Endif
							Endscan
						Endif

					Case crSigOpTdt.TipoDs = 4
						Locate For Between(Padr(lcHora,10),Campo2is,Campo2fs)
						If Not Eof()
							_pDesco   = crSigOpTds.Descos
							_pdFator  = crSigOpTds.DFators
							_nChvTbd  = crSigOpTds.nChvTbds
						Endif

					Case crSigOpTdt.TipoDs = 5
						lcData = Dtos(Thisform.DataAbertura)
						Locate For Between(Padr(lcData,10),Campo1is,Campo1fs)
						If Not Eof()
							Scan While Between(Padr(lcData,10),Campo1is,Campo1fs)
								If Between(Padr(lcHora,10),Campo2is,Campo2fs)
									_pDesco   = crSigOpTds.Descos
									_pdFator  = crSigOpTds.DFators
									_nChvTbd  = crSigOpTds.nChvTbds
									Exit
								Endif
							Endscan
						Endif
					Endcase

					Replace &lcpArqItem..nChvTbds With _nChvTbd In &lcpArqItem.

				Endif

				*** Tiago - 02/03/2012 - Vianna - Ignorar a cotação de conversão, se o produto estiver configurado na tabela desconto
				If crSigOpTdt.ChkCots = 1
					llChkCot = .T.
				Endif

				_xDescFator  = _xDescFator - ( _pdFator / 100 )
				_xDescUnit   = _xDescUnit  - ( _pDesco  / 100 )
			Endif
		Endif

		***** Localiza Desconto do Grupo para Fator e Unitário

		If crSigCdOpe.Qtdpesos = 1
			_xTotalPeso = _xTotalPeso * &lcpArqItem..Qtds
		Endif

		lncasaspeso = Iif(Empty(crSigCdOpe.NCPesos),2,crSigCdOpe.NCPesos)
		_xTotalPeso = Round( _xTotalPeso * _xDescTabela * _xDescFator / Iif(_xCotOper=0,1,_xCotOper), lncasaspeso )

		If lnValIpi # 0
			If crSigCdOpe.UnitPesos = 1
				_xTotalPreco = &lcpArqItem..Pesos * &lcpArqItem..Fators * _xDescTabela * _xDescUnit
			Else
				_xTotalPreco = _xTotalPreco * _xDescTabela * _xDescUnit / Iif(_xCotOper = 0,1,_xCotOper)
			Endif
		Else
			If crSigCdOpe.UnitPesos = 1
				_xTotalPreco = Round( &lcpArqItem..Pesos * &lcpArqItem..Fators * _xDescTabela * _xDescUnit, lnCasas )
			Else

				_xTotalPreco = Round( _xTotalPreco * _xDescTabela * _xDescUnit /Iif(_xCotOper=0,1, _xCotOper), lnCasas )
			Endif
		Endif

		*** Tiago - 02/03/2012 - Vianna - Ignorar a cotação de conversão, se o produto estiver configurado na tabela desconto
		If llChkCot
			_xTotalPeso = _xTotalPeso * Iif(_xCotOper=0,1, _xCotOper)
			_xTotalPreco = _xTotalPreco * Iif(_xCotOper=0,1, _xCotOper)
		Endif

		If ( crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 1 ) And ( crSigCdGrp.Arreds # 0 )
			_FatArred = crSigCdGrp.Arreds
			_Soma = _FatArred
			Do While _Soma < _xTotalPreco
				_Soma = _Soma + _FatArred
			Enddo
			_xTotalPreco = _Soma
		Endif

		_xTotal = 0
		Select &lcpArqItem.
		Skip
		Skip -1
		Replace MoeVals With _xCotPreco,;
			FatVals With _xCotFator,;
			DescVals With 1 - _xDescTabela In &lcpArqItem.
		If Type('AltImpost') <> 'U'
			Replace AltImpost With .F. In &lcpArqItem.
		Endif

		If !IsEmpty( _Formula1 ) Or IsEmpty( _Formula1 + _Formula2 )
			Replace TPesos With _xTotalPeso In &lcpArqItem.
		Endif

		If !IsEmpty( _Formula2 ) Or IsEmpty( _Formula1 + _Formula2 )

			llAtuMoeda = .F.
			If Not Empty(_xMoeOper) And Not Empty(&lcpArqItem..Moedas) And &lcpArqItem..Moedas <> _xMoeOper
				llAtuMoeda = .T.	
			EndIf 
			
			If (( Inlist( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) And Iif( (_CntCalc=1 And _pAuto = 1) Or _CntCalc=2, &lcpArqItem..Units = 0, &lcpArqItem..UnitInfs = 0) ) Or ;
					( Not Inlist( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3) And crSigCdOpe.chkDVal # 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoAuts,1,3) ) Or ;
					( Not Inlist( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3) And crSigCdOpe.chkDVal = 1 And Iif( (_CntCalc=1 And _pAuto = 1) Or ;
					_CntCalc=2, &lcpArqItem..Units = 0, &lcpArqItem..UnitInfs = 0) )Or crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 4) Or llAtuMoeda 

				Select &lcpArqItem.
				If ( _CntCalc = 1 And _pAuto = 1 ) Or _CntCalc = 2
					=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','LocalCfo','Codigos',crSigMvNfi.Cfis,[InclIcms])
					If LocalCfo.InclIcms = 3 And &lcpArqItem..AliqIcms <> 0
						_xTotalPreco = Round( _xTotalPreco / ( (100-&lcpArqItem..AliqIcms)/100 ),2)
					Endif
					Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With Round( _xTotalPreco * ( 1 + lnValIpi ), lnCasas) ,;
						&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With Round( _xTotalPreco * ( 1 + lnValIpi ), lnCasas) In &lcpArqItem.
				Else
					Replace &lcpArqItem..UnitInfs With Round( _xTotalPreco * ( 1 + lnValIpi ), lnCasas) In &lcpArqItem.
				Endif

				_TpFat = &lcpArqCab..tpfats

				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.aptpfats,3,5) And !Empty(_TpFat) And Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdTif','crSigCdTif','Codigos',_TpFat)
					If crSigCdOpe.aptpfats = 3
						If ( _CntCalc = 1 And _pAuto = 1 ) Or _CntCalc = 2
							m.Units = Round(&lcpArqItem..Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100, lnCasas)
							Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
								&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
						Else
							m.UnitInfs = Round(&lcpArqItem..UnitInfs * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100, lnCasas)
							Replace &lcpArqItem..UnitInfs With m.UnitInfs In &lcpArqItem.
						Endif
					Else
						If ( _CntCalc = 1 And _pAuto = 1 ) Or _CntCalc = 2
							If crSigCdTif.PValors <> 100
								m.Units = Round(&lcpArqItem..Units - (&lcpArqItem..Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ), lnCasas)
							Else
								m.Units = Round(&lcpArqItem..Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100, lnCasas)
							Endif
							Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
								&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
						Else
							If crSigCdTif.PValors <> 100
								m.UnitInfs = Round(&lcpArqItem..UnitInfs - (&lcpArqItem..UnitInfs * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100), lnCasas)
							Else
								m.UnitInfs = Round(&lcpArqItem..UnitInfs * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100, lnCasas)
							Endif
							Replace &lcpArqItem..UnitInfs With m.UnitInfs In &lcpArqItem.
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif

			*** Tiago - 28/07/2010 - Inclui percentual da cor no cálculo unitário
			llSubItem = ( Inlist( crSigCdGrp.TipoEstos, 2, 3, 4 ) Or ( crSigCdGrp.Tams = 1) Or ;
				( crSigCdGrp.Cores = 1 ) Or ( crSigCdGrp.Embs = 1 ) )
			If llSubItem
				Select crTpmMvIts
				Locate For citens = &lcpArqItem..citens
				If !Eof() And !Empty(crTpmMvIts.CodTams)
					lcSql = [select Valor,PesoMs from SigPrTam Where cpros = ']+crTpmMvIts.Cpros+[' and codtams = ']+crTpmMvIts.CodTams+[']
					lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocalPrTam')
					If lnErro < 1
						Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (LocalPrTam)')
						Return .F.
					Endif

					*-- 21/10/2016 - Rafael - Se Estiver Preço de Venda e tem valor definido para o tamanho pega o valor do tamanho (solicitação do Richard para Rosana Joias)
					If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 1 And !pMantV	&& mena 26/10/2016 - verifica se mantem valor digitado
						*-- 28/09/2016 - Se Estiver Preço de Custo e tem valor definido para o tamanho pega o valor do tamanho
						If LocalPrTam.Valor <> 0
							m.Units = Round(LocalPrTam.Valor, lnCasas)
							Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
								&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
						Endif
					Endif

					*-- 21/10/2016 - Rafael - ( Retirado por solicitação do Richard Rosana Joias)
					*!*						If crSigCdOpe.Precops = 2 And crSigCdOpe.UnitPesos <> 1
					*!*							*-- 28/09/2016 - Se Estiver Preço de Custo e tem valor definido para o tamanho pega o valor do tamanho
					*!*							If LocalPrTam.Valor <> 0
					*!*								m.Units = Round(LocalPrTam.Valor, lnCasas)
					*!*								Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
					*!*										&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
					*!*							EndIf
					*!*							If LocalPrTam.PesoMs <> 0
					*!*								m.Units = Round(LocalPrTam.PesoMs, lnCasas)
					*!*								Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
					*!*										&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
					*!*							Endif
					*!*						Endif
				Endif

				Select crTpmMvIts
				Locate For citens = &lcpArqItem..citens
				If !Eof() And !Empty(crTpmMvIts.codcors)
					=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCor','LocalCor','Cods',crTpmMvIts.codcors,[varias])
					If LocalCor.varias <> 0
						m.Units = Round(&lcpArqItem..Units + (&lcpArqItem..Units * LocalCor.varias / 100 ), lnCasas)
						Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
							&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
					Endif
				Endif
				*-- 21/10/2016 - Rafael - Se Estiver Preço de Custo e tem valor definido para o tamanho / Cor no Fornecedor pega o valor do Fornecedor
				If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 2
					Select crTpmMvIts
					Locate For citens = &lcpArqItem..citens
					If !Eof()
						If Inlist(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
							_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
							lcQuery = [Select Moevs,Pvens From SigPrFnc ] + ;
								[Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' ] + ;
								[And Ifors = ']+_Ct+['] + ;
								Iif(!Empty(crTpmMvIts.codcors),[And CodCors = ']+crTpmMvIts.codcors+[' ],[])+;
								Iif(!Empty(crTpmMvIts.CodTams),[And CodTams = ']+crTpmMvIts.CodTams+[' ],[])
							=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
							If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 And Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
								m.Units = Round(CrTmpfPro.pvens, lnCasas)
								Replace &lcpArqItem..Units     With m.Units ,;
									&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs With m.Units In &lcpArqItem.
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif

			If ( _CntCalc = 1 And _pAuto = 1 ) Or _CntCalc = 2
				If crSigCdOpe.chkDVal = 1 And &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs <> &lcpArqItem..Units && PAF - Tiago - 16/03/2011 - pDescs sempre vem zerado quando vinha do form SigOpPro &lcpArqItem..pDescs <> 0
					*** PAF - Tiago - 16/03/2011 - Calcula o percentual de desconto
					If &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs > &lcpArqItem..Units
						lpDesc = ((&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs - &lcpArqItem..Units) / &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs) * 100
						lvDesc = 1
					Else
						lpDesc = Abs(((&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs - &lcpArqItem..Units) / &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs) * 100)
						lvDesc = -1
					Endif
					lvDesc  = lvDesc * Round(&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs * lpDesc / 100,2)
					lNewUnt = &lcpArqItem..Units && &lcpArqItem..Units - lvDesc
					Select &lcpArqItem.
					Replace Units     With lNewUnt,;
						ValDescs  With lvDesc,;
						pDescs	  With lpDesc

					If crTpmMvItn.Utilizas < 10
						Select crTpmMvItn
						Replace crTpmMvItn.Utilizas With crTpmMvItn.Utilizas + 10 In crTpmMvItn
					Else
						If crTpmMvItn.Utilizas >= 10
							Select crTpmMvItn
							Replace crTpmMvItn.Utilizas With crTpmMvItn.Utilizas - 10 In crTpmMvItn
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif

				_TotalUnit = Val(Str(Iif( Inlist(crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos, 1, 5) Or (crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 3 And &lcpArqItem..citem2=0) , &lcpArqItem..Qtds, 1 ) * &lcpArqItem..Units,12,6))
				Select &lcpArqItem.

				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Cupfis,1,3) And ChkTrunc(This.oModemEest)
					_TotalUnit = Int(_TotalUnit * 100) / 100
				Endif

				Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With _TotalUnit In &lcpArqItem.

				If (crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 4) && Sim, Total de Peso
					Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With &lcpArqItem..Univals In &lcpArqItem.
					Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * Iif(&lcpArqItem..TPesos = 0, 1, &lcpArqItem..TPesos) In &lcpArqItem.
				Endif

				* Richard em 11/09/2012
				If (crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 5) && Qtde, Peso e Fator
					Do Case
					Case (Substr(CrTmpPro.CfgGerGprs, 2, 1) = [1]) && Quantidade X Fator / Peso
						lnMtl = (&lcpArqItem..Qtds * &lcpArqItem..Fators)
						lnMtl = Iif(lnMtl = 0 Or Empty(&lcpArqItem..Pesos), 0, lnMtl / &lcpArqItem..Pesos)
						Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With lnMtl In &lcpArqItem.
						Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Pesos In &lcpArqItem.

					Case (Substr(CrTmpPro.CfgGerGprs, 2, 1) = [2]) && Peso X Fator / Quantidade
						lnMtl = (&lcpArqItem..Pesos * &lcpArqItem..Fators)
						lnMtl = Iif(lnMtl = 0 Or Empty(&lcpArqItem..Qtds), 0, lnMtl / &lcpArqItem..Qtds)
						Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With lnMtl In &lcpArqItem.
						Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Qtds In &lcpArqItem.

					Otherwise 									   && Quantidade X Unitário
						Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Qtds In &lcpArqItem.
					Endcase
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif

		*** mena - 04/01/2017 - calcula valor com desconto progressivo - monteCarlo ***
		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.tabdescs,7,8)
			lnUnit = &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs
			Select crSigMvitd
			Scan For Cpros = &lcpArqItem..Cpros And citens = &lcpArqItem..citens
				*!*lnUnit = lnUnit-(lnUnit*crSigMvitd.pdes/100)
				lnUnit = lnUnit-(crSigMvitd.vdes)
			Endscan
			Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With lnUnit In &lcpArqItem.
			Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Qtds In &lcpArqItem.
		Endif


		If ( _CntCalc = 1 And _pAuto = 1 ) Or _CntCalc = 2
			If !IsEmpty( _xMoeOper )
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Moedas With _xMoeOper In &lcpArqItem.
			Else
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Moedas With Iif( !IsEmpty( _Moeda2 ), _Moeda2, _xMoePreco ) In &lcpArqItem.
			Endif
			*** Tiago - 08/09/2015 - Voltei esse código para gravar a cotação correta da moeda que está convertendo
			_xCota = Thisform.Cotacao(&lcpArqItem..Moedas)
			Replace MoeVals With _xCota In &lcpArqItem.

			Select &lcpArqItem.
			If Thisform.NaoCalculaIPI And &lcpArqItem..TpIpis='1'
				Replace &lcpArqItem..ValIpis With Round(&lcpArqItem..Qtds * (&lcpArqItem..Aliqs / 100) * &lcpArqItem..Units,2) In &lcpArqItem.
			Endif
		Endif
	Next
Else
	If ( &lcpArqItem..Utilizas > 9 ) And Not IsEmpty(&lcpArqItem..Cpros)
		If crSigCdOpe.chkDVal = 1 And &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs <> &lcpArqItem..Units && Tiago - 20/06/2014 - Zenith - Incluído para atualizar campo de desconto
			If &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs > &lcpArqItem..Units
				lpDesc = ((&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs - &lcpArqItem..Units) / &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs) * 100
				lvDesc = 1
			Else
				lpDesc = Abs(((&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs - &lcpArqItem..Units) / &lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs) * 100)
				lvDesc = -1
			Endif
			lvDesc  = lvDesc * Round(&lcpArqItem..UnitOrigs * lpDesc / 100,2)
			lNewUnt = &lcpArqItem..Units
			Select &lcpArqItem.
			Replace Units     With lNewUnt,;
				ValDescs  With lvDesc,;
				pDescs	  With lpDesc
		Endif

		_TotalUnit = Val(Str(Iif( Inlist(crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos, 1, 5) Or (crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 3 And &lcpArqItem..citem2=0) , &lcpArqItem..Qtds, 1 ) * &lcpArqItem..Units,12,6))
		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Cupfis,1,3)
			_TotalUnit = Int(_TotalUnit * 100) / 100
		Endif
		Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With _TotalUnit In &lcpArqItem.

		If (crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 4) && Sim, Total de Peso
			Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * Iif(&lcpArqItem..TPesos = 0, 1, &lcpArqItem..TPesos) In &lcpArqItem.
		Endif

		* Richard em 11/09/2012
		If (crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 5) && Qtde, Peso e Fator
			Do Case
			Case (Substr(CrTmpPro.CfgGerGprs, 2, 1) = [1]) && Quantidade X Fator / Peso
				lnMtl = (&lcpArqItem..Qtds * &lcpArqItem..Fators)
				lnMtl = Iif(lnMtl = 0 Or Empty(&lcpArqItem..Pesos), 0, lnMtl / &lcpArqItem..Pesos)
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With lnMtl In &lcpArqItem.
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Pesos In &lcpArqItem.

			Case (Substr(CrTmpPro.CfgGerGprs, 2, 1) = [2]) && Peso X Fator / Quantidade
				lnMtl = (&lcpArqItem..Pesos * &lcpArqItem..Fators)
				lnMtl = Iif(lnMtl = 0 Or Empty(&lcpArqItem..Qtds), 0, lnMtl / &lcpArqItem..Qtds)
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With lnMtl In &lcpArqItem.
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Qtds In &lcpArqItem.

			Otherwise 									   && Quantidade X Unitário
				Replace &lcpArqItem..Totas With &lcpArqItem..Units * &lcpArqItem..Qtds In &lcpArqItem.
			Endcase
		Endif
	Endif
Endif
Replace &lcpArqItem..OrigMercs With CrTmpPro.OrigMercs In &lcpArqItem.

**** Mena - 12/2012 - recalcula preço unitário se flag divtot setado ****
Replace &lcpArqItem..Units With Iif(crSigOpCdd.divtot = 1 And &lcpArqItem..Qtds <> 0, Round(&lcpArqItem..Totas/&lcpArqItem..Qtds, 4), &lcpArqItem..Units) In &lcpArqItem

*-- Rafael - 14/07/2017 -
If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs= 13

	llComponente = .F.

	If &lcpArqItem..citem2 <> 0
		llComponente = .T.
	Endif

	If Not llComponente

		pDat = &lcpArqCab..DataS

		lcSql = [Select c.MtPrimas, c.chkInstalas, b.pftiocs, b.cftiocs, b.PCuss ] + ;
			[From SigCdPro b, SigCdGrp c ] + ;
			[Where b.Cpros = '] + &lcpArqItem..Cpros + [' And ] + ;
			[b.CGrus = c.CGrus]

		If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, [LocalPro]) < 1
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (fCalcCusto - 4)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
		Go Top In LocalPro

		llBar = .F.
		lnBar = &lcpArqItem..CodBarras
		lnPss = Iif(LocalPro.chkInstalas = 2, &lcpArqItem..Pesos, &lcpArqItem..Qtds)

		lnPesoPedra = 0
		lnCustoPedra = 0
		lnPesoAnterior = 0

		*!*			If Not Empty(lnBar)

		*!*				Select a.Mats, Space(3) As Moecusfs, a.Qtds, a.Pesos, a.Pesos As Custo ;
		*!*					From crSigMvSub a ;
		*!*					Where a.CodBarras = lnBar ;
		*!*					Into Cursor LocalCusto Readwrite

		*!*				Select LocalCusto
		*!*				Scan
		*!*					Replace Custo With 0 In LocalCusto

		*!*					lcSql = [Select b.MoeCusFs, b.CustoFs as Custo, c.chkInstalas ] + ;
		*!*						[From SigCdPro b, SigCdGrp c ] + ;
		*!*						[Where b.CPros = '] + LocalCusto.Mats + [' And b.CGrus = c.CGrus]

		*!*					If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, [LocalPc]) < 1
		*!*						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (fCalcCusto - 2.a)')
		*!*						Return .F.
		*!*					Endif
		*!*					Go Top In LocalPc
		*!*					If Not Eof([LocalPc])
		*!*						Replace Pesos 	 With Iif(LocalPc.chkInstalas = 2, LocalCusto.Pesos, LocalCusto.Qtds), ;
		*!*							Moecusfs With LocalPc.Moecusfs, ;
		*!*							Custo    With LocalPc.Custo In LocalCusto
		*!*					Endif
		*!*				Endscan
		*!*				Select LocalCusto
		*!*				Go Top In LocalCusto
		*!*				llBar = (Reccount([LocalCusto]) > 0)
		*!*				lnPesoAnterior = LocalCusto.Pesos
		*!*			Endif

		llBar	 = .F.

		lcSql = [Select a.Mats, b.MoeCusFs, ] + Str(&lcpArqItem..Pesos, 9, 3)+ [ as Pesos, ] + Str(&lcpArqItem..Qtds, 9, 3)+ [ as Qtds, a.pcompos as Custo, c.MtPrimas ] + ;
			[From SigPrCpo a, SigCdPro b, SigCdGrp c ] + ;
			[Where a.Cpros = '] + &lcpArqItem..Cpros + [' And ] + ;
			[a.Pesos = 0 And ] + ;
			[a.mats = b.matprincs And ] + ;
			[a.cpros = b.cpros And ] + ;
			[b.CGrus = c.CGrus And ] + ;
			[c.CEstoqs <> 2 ]
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, [csCustoPri]) < 1
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (csCustoPri)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		Select csCustoPri
		Go Top
		If Reccount([csCustoPri])>0

			lcMdO = csCustoPri.Moecusfs
			lnCtO = fBuscarCotacao(lcMdO, pDat, Thisform.poDataMgr)
			lnCus = (csCustoPri.Pesos * csCustoPri.Custo)
			lnUni = (csCustoPri.Pesos * csCustoPri.Custo)
			lnpes = 0


			lcSql =  [Select a.Mats, a.Moeds, b.MoeCusFs , a.qtds as Pesos, ] + Str(&lcpArqItem..Qtds, 9, 3)+ [ as Qtds, a.pcompos as Custo, c.MtPrimas ] + ;
				[From SigPrCpo a, SigCdPro b, SigCdGrp c ] + ;
				[Where a.Cpros = '] + &lcpArqItem..Cpros + [' ] + ;
				[And a.mats <> b.matprincs  ] + ;
				[And a.cpros = b.cpros ] + ;
				[And b.CGrus = c.CGrus ] + ;
				[And c.CEstoqs <> 2 ] + ;
				Iif(crSigOpCdc.carcompos = 7,[And a.OrdTs = 1 ],;
				Iif(Inlist(crSigOpCdc.carcompos,8,9),[And a.OrdTs = 0],[]))

			If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, [LocalCusto]) < 1
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalCusto)')
				Return .F.
			Endif

			Select LocalCusto
			Scan
				lnpes = LocalCusto.Pesos
				lnVlD = LocalCusto.Custo * lnpes
				lnUnD = LocalCusto.Custo

				If (lcMdO <> LocalCusto.moeds)
					lnCtD = fBuscarCotacao(LocalCusto.moeds, pDat, Thisform.poDataMgr)
					lnVlD = (lnVlD / lnCtO) * lnCtD
					lnUnD = (lnUnD / lnCtO) * lnCtD
				Endif
				lnCus = lnCus + lnVlD
				lnUni = lnUni + lnUnD
			Endscan

			lnValFto = 0
			
			If crSigOpCdd.AplicaImp <> 1
				If Not Empty(LocalPro.CfTioCs)

					lcSql = [Select Cgrus as Grupo, Mats as CPros, dCompos as Dgrus, Moeds as Moeda, ] + Str(&lcpArqItem..Pesos, 9, 3)+ [ as Pesos, ] + ;
						Str(&lcpArqItem..Pesos, 9, 3)+ [ as Qtds, PCompos, convert(Numeric(12,3),0) as ValGrupo, 0 as chkInstalas, OrdTs ] + ;
						[From SigPrCpo ] + ;
						[Where CPros = '] + &lcpArqItem..Cpros + [' ] + ;
						[Order By 1, 2, 3 ]

					If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, [LocalTGrupo]) < 1
						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalTGrupo)')
						Return .F.
					Endif

					Select LocalTGrupo
					Go Top
					Scan
						lcQuery = [Select b.chkInstalas ] + ;
							[From SigCdPro a, SigCdGrp b ] + ;
							[Where a.CPros = '] + LocalTGrupo.Cpros + [' And ] + ;
							[a.CGrus = b.CGrus]

						If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'LocalInstal') < 1
							=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalInstal)')
							Return .F.
						Endif
						Go Top In LocalInstal

						Replace chkInstalas With LocalInstal.chkInstalas In LocalTGrupo

					Endscan

					Select LocalTGrupo
					Go Top

					Update LocalTGrupo Set ValGrupo = Iif(chkInstalas=2, Pesos, Qtds) * PCompos
					Go Top In LocalTGrupo

					lcSql = [Select * From SigPrFti Where Cods = ']+LocalPro.CfTioCs+[']
					Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'TmpFtio')
					Select TmpFtio
					If Reccount() > 0 And TmpFtio.Acrescs = 0 And TmpFtio.Valors = 0

						lcSql = [Select a.*, IsNull(b.Dgrus,'') as Dgrus ] + ;
							[From SigPrFto a Left Join SigCdGrp b on a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus ] + ;
							[Where a.Cods = ']+LocalPro.CfTioCs+[' ]+;
							[And (a.Cgrus <> ' ' OR a.Ordem <> 0) Order by a.Cods ]
						Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'TmpFtioC')

						_lnCnt = 1
						_vacm  = 0
						_vFt   = 0

						If TmpFtio.AplsCus <> 1
							Select LocalTGrupo
							Scan
								Select TmpFtioC
								Locate For Cgrus = LocalTGrupo.Grupo And Cpros = LocalTGrupo.Cpros
								If Eof([TmpFtioC])
									Locate For Cgrus = LocalTGrupo.Grupo And Empty(Cpros)
								Endif
								*-- Rafael - Localiza o Feitio pela Ordem
								If Eof([TmpFtioC])
									Locate For Ordem = LocalTGrupo.OrdTs And Empty(Cpros)
								Endif
								If Not Eof([TmpFtioC])
									_Coef = TmpFtioC.Coefs
									If Eof()
										_Coef = 1
									Endif

									Moec = 1
									Moep = 1
									If TmpFtio.Moedas <> LocalTGrupo.Moeda
										Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdMoe', 'crMoe', 'CMoes', TmpFtio.Moedas)
										Go Top In crMoe
										If Not Empty(crMoe.MoeQs)
											m.Moedas = crMoe.MoeQs
											_Qtdeqs = Iif(crMoe.Qtdeqs=0, 1, crMoe.Qtdeqs)
										Else
											m.Moedas = TmpFtio.Moedas
											_Qtdeqs = 1
										Endif
										Moec = fBuscarCotacao(m.Moedas, Datetime(), Thisform.poDataMgr) * _Qtdeqs

										Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdMoe', 'crMoe', 'CMoes', LocalTGrupo.Moeda)
										Go Top In crMoe
										If Not Empty(crMoe.MoeQs)
											m.Moedas = crMoe.MoeQs
											_Qtdeqs = Iif(crMoe.Qtdeqs=0, 1, crMoe.Qtdeqs)
										Else
											m.Moedas = LocalTGrupo.Moeda
											_Qtdeqs = 1
										Endif
										Moep  = fBuscarCotacao(m.Moedas, Datetime(), Thisform.poDataMgr) * _Qtdeqs
									Endif
									_vcoef = Round(( LocalTGrupo.ValGrupo * Moep / Moec ),3)
									_vadic = Round((( _vcoef * _Coef ) - _vcoef ),3)
									_vacm  = _vacm + _vcoef + _vadic
									_vFt   = _vFt + _vadic

								Endif
							Endscan
						Else
							_vacm  = LocalPro.PCuss

						Endif

						lcSql = [Select a.*, b.Dpros From SigPrFto a, SigCdPro b Where a.Cods = ']+LocalPro.CfTioCs+[' And ]+;
							[a.Cpros = b.Cpros And a.Cgrus = Space(3) And a.Ordem = 0 Order by a.Seqs ]
						Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'TmpFtioC')

						Select TmpFtioC
						Scan
							_vcoef = ( _vacm )
							If TmpFtio.DivMults = 1
								_vadic = Round((( _vcoef * TmpFtioC.Coefs ) - _vcoef ),3)
							Else
								_vadic = Round(( ( _vcoef / ( 1-( TmpFtioC.Coefs/100 ) ) ) -_vcoef ),3)
							Endif
							_vacm  = _vacm + _vadic
							_vFt   = _vFt  + _vadic

						Endscan
						lnValFto = _vFt
					Endif
				Endif
			EndIf

			Replace Units  With Iif(Inlist(LocalPro.MtPrimas, 1, 2), lnUni, lnCus) + lnValFto, ;
				Totas  With Iif(Inlist(LocalPro.MtPrimas, 1, 2), lnUni, lnCus) + lnValFto, ;
				Moedas With lcMdO In &lcpArqItem.
		Endif
	Endif
Endif



Return .T.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE cancelcupomfiscal
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE cancelcupomfiscal
Local ImpFin,ImpCancel,VerStatus,RetCancel,oFormulario,lnIdent,RetNImp

RetCancel = .t.
oFormulario = ThisForm.oModemEest
ImpFin = .t.
ImpCancel=.t.
RetNImp = .F.
lnSoma = 0
llPrimeiroTef = .t.

=fLerFiscal(crSigOpCdd.NomEcfs)
Select crSigFiFis
Goto top

If RetCancel
	Select crSigFiFis
	goto top
	Do Case
		Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','DARUMA','BEMA8501','EPSON')
			ImpCancel = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
			Replace lCancelas with .t. In TprMvCab
			
		Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','ELGIN')
			ImpFin=.t.
			ThisForm.totite=fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
			If(!ThisForm.totite=0)
				ImpCancel=VendaCancel(oFormulario)
			EndIf
		Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
			ImpFin= ImpFin and FinFis(0,0,oFormulario)
			If ImpFin
				If(!ThisForm.totite=0)
					If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
						ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde Processando Cancelamento '+Iif(crSigFiFis.Imps<>'S/IMPRESSORA','Cupom Fiscal','')
					Else
						Wait Window 'Aguarde Processamento Cancelamento '+Iif(crSigFiFis.Imps<>'S/IMPRESSORA','Cupom Fiscal!!!','')  nowait
					EndIf
					lTime = DATETIME()
					DO WHILE (DATETIME()-lTime)< 20 && Aguarda 50 Segundos
						If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA'
							Exit
						EndIf
					EndDo
					For LoopCancel =1 to 5
						Checka=RotSTatus(1,oFormulario)
						If Type('Checka')='L'
							Checka=''
						EndIf
						If Substr(Checka,1,1)='F'
							ImpFin=ImpFin and FinFis(0,0,oFormulario)
							Checka=RotSTatus(1,oFormulario)
							If Type('Checka')='L'
								Checka=''
							EndIf
						EndIf
						
						If Substr(Checka,1,1)='L' and Substr(Checka,6,1) = 'K'
							ImpCancel=VendaCancel(oFormulario)
							If !ImpCancel
								Messagebox('Impossível Cancelamento para o estado da Impressora Fiscal !!',0+16,'')
							EndIf
							LoopCancel = 10
						EndIf
					EndFor
					If ImpCancel				
						If Type('RetNImp')='N' and ThisForm.TransTef<>1 And crSigCdPam.SisTef = 1
							lnIdent = RetNImp
							RetImpcVinc = ThisForm.ImprCVinCanc(lnIdent) 
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
	EndCase
EndIf

*** seleciona Cartao que não foi NCN - Mena 05/2012***
lcCupoms='R'+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+alltrim(str(TprMvCab.numes))+'CRT'
ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigFiTef','crCRT', 'cCupoms', lcCupoms)
lcCupoms='E'+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+alltrim(str(TprMvCab.numes))+'NCN'
ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigFiTef','crNCN', 'cCupoms', lcCupoms)
SELECT * from crCRT where cfinalzs not in (select cfinalzs from crNCN) into cursor crSigFiTef
 
*** Mena 05/2012 - Seleciona cartao não confirmado ainda **** 
lcCupoms='E'+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+alltrim(str(TprMvCab.numes))+'CNF'
ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigFiTef','crCNF', 'cCupoms', lcCupoms)
SELECT * from crSigFiTef where cfinalzs not in (select cfinalzs from crCNF) into cursor crAux1

**** Mena seleciona so os confirmados ****
SELECT * from crSigFiTef where cfinalzs in (select cfinalzs from crCNF) into cursor TmpSigFiTef
*************************************************************

RetCVinc = .t.

Wait Window 'Aguarde Processamento TEF !!' nowait

CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado

*** nao confirma cupom aberto ****
SELECT crAux1
GO top
IF not EOF()
	llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', thisform, thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, CrSigFiFis.Imps, ThisForm.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
	lcTipo = 'NCN'
	RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
				val(crAux1.cnIdents),crAux1.cNmRedes,crAux1.cnNSUs,;
				crAux1.cFinalzs,crAux1.cCupomnvs, crAux1.Fpags)
	Do Form SIGCNTEF with crAux1.cnNSUs, crAux1.cNmRedes,Iif(crSigCdPam.SisTef=3,val(StrTran(crAux1.cnValors,',','.')),val(crAux1.cnValors)/100), 'Última transação TEF Cancelada'
	ThisForm.DeleteSigTef(crAux1.cnIdents,'CRT')
ENDIF

*** Cancela só os confirmados ****
Select TmpSigFiTef
Go Top
Scan
	If crSigCdPam.SisTef = 1
		llCancTef = .t.
		DO While llCancTef
			lcCupomnv = TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigFiNfs Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And cComprovs = ?lcCupomnv],'crSigFiNfs')

			lcdirreq = alltrim(crSigFiNfs.cTefdReqs)
			lcdirresp = alltrim(crSigFiNfs.cTefdResps)
			lnQtdVias = crSigFiNfs.nqtdvias

			lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')
			=ApagaResp(ThisForm.poDataMgr)

			llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', thisform, thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, CrSigFiFis.Imps, ThisForm.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
			lcTipo = 'CNC'
			RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,'CNC',;
					val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
					TmpSigFiTef.cFinalzs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, TmpSigFiTef.Fpags, Val(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors) / 100)
			If RetNImp
				lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')
				Select CrTefImp
				Delete all 
				Select CrTefResp
				Set Order to resp
				Delete All
				Append From &lcArquivo SDF

				*** Mena 05/2012 pega informaçoes 012 e 027 para confirmação
				Select CrTefResp
				goto top
				If seek('012')
					lccnNSUs = Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)
				Endif
				Select CrTefResp
				goto top
				If seek('027')
					lccFinalzs = Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)
				Endif
				**************************************************************
				Seek '009'
				If Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)) = '0'
					Seek '030'
					lcMsg = Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11))
					DO Form SigTfDss With "Cancelamento","",lcMsg,"","","VR",0,0,(csSigCdPac.InibEscs=2)
					For lnContaQtdVia = 1 to lnQtdVias
						Select CrTefResp
						Go top
						Seek '029'
						If Found()
							DO While cInfos = '029'
								Select CrTefResp
								Scatter Memvar
								m.cnIdents = TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents
								m.cinfos = strtran(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11),'"','')
								m.nvias = lnContaQtdVia
								Insert into CrTefImp from Memvar
								Select CrTefResp
								Skip
							EndDo
							Select crTefImp
						Else
						EndIf
					Next
					llCancTef = .f.
					RetcVinc = .f.
					DO While ! RetcVinc 
						RetCVinc = RRelGerVinc(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario)
						If ! RetCVinc 
							CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
							fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado
							If Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (7), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'')=7 
								llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', thisform, thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, CrSigFiFis.Imps, ThisForm.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
								lcTipo = 'NCN'
								RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,'',0,lcTipo,;
											val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,lccnNSUs,;
											lccFinalzs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs,TmpSigFiTef.Fpags)

								Do Form SIGCNTEF with TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,Iif(crSigCdPam.SisTef=3,val(StrTran(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors,',','.')),val(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors)/100)														
			
								llcan = .T.					&& cancelou cupom vinculado
								llCancTef = .t.
								RetcVinc = .t.
								ThisForm.DeleteSigTef(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,'CNC')
							ENDIF 
						ELSE
							llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', thisform, thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, CrSigFiFis.Imps, ThisForm.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
							lcTipo = 'CNF'
							RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,'',0,lcTipo,;
										val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,lccnNSUs,;
										lccFinalzs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs,TmpSigFiTef.Fpags)
							llcan = .T.					&& cancelou cupom vinculado
							llCancTef = .f.
							lcSql = [Select CidChaves From SigFiTef Where ctipos = 'E' And cHeaders='CNC' AND CNNSUS = ']+Alltrim(TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs)+[']
							If thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
								Select LocSigFiTef
								Scan
									lcSql=[Update SigFiTef set cStatus = 'CNF' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
									RetSql=thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcSql)
									thisform.poDatamgr.Commit()
								Endscan
							Endif													
							ThisForm.DeleteSigTef(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,'CNC')
						EndIf																						
					EndDo
					fBlockInput(.T.)			&& trava teclado
				Else
					Seek '030'
					lcMsg = Iif(Empty(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)),'Movimentação Cancelada pelo Usuário',Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)))
					DO Form SigTfDss With "Erro na Trasação","",lcMsg,"Cancelar pelo Modulo Administrativo","","VM",0,0
					If MessageBox("Pressione Ok para tentar novamente",64,"") = 1
						llCancTef = .t.
						loop	
					EndIf
				EndIf
				lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.STS')
				ThisForm.DeleteSigTef(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,'CRT')	&& Mena 05/2012
			EndIf
		enddo
	Else
		llCancTef = .t.
		DO While llCancTef
			SELECT TmpSigFiTef
			llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', thisform, thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, CrSigFiFis.Imps, ThisForm.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
			lcTipo = 'NCN'
			RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
					val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
					TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, TmpSigFiTef.Fpags, Val(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors) / 100 )
			lcSql = [Select CidChaves From SigFiTef Where ctipos = 'R' And cHeaders='CRT' AND CNNSUS = ']+ALLTRIM(TmpSigFiTef.cnnsus)+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
				Select LocSigFiTef
				Scan
					lcSql=[Update SigFiTef set cStatus = 'CNC' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
					RetSql=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql)
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit()
				EndScan
			EndIf
			llCancTef = .f.
		EndDo
		RetCVinc = .f.
	EndIf
EndScan

If RetCancel
	llchecaSigTef = .f.
	If !used('SigTef')
		Use goSistema.DirTefEcfs+'\SigTef' in 0
		llchecaSigTef = .t.
	EndIf
	Select SigTef
	Delete
	If llchecaSigTef
		USE in SigTef
	EndIf
EndIf

Return(RetCancel)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE caritem
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE caritem
If ThisForm.pcEscolha # 'INSERIR'
	Return
EndIf
If crSigCdOpe.ItAutos = 6
	_Grupo = TprMvCab.Grupoos
	_Conta = TprMvCab.Contaos
Else
	_Grupo = TprMvCab.Grupods
	_conta = TprMvCab.Contads
EndIf

Wait Window 'Aguarde... Carregando itens!!!' Nowait

Select crTpmMvIts
Zap
Select crTpmMvItn
Zap

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

Go Top in crSigCdPam

opdevol    = ( crSigCdOpe.Dopes = crSigCdPam.OpDevols )
llProducao = ( crSigCdOpe.Produc = 1 )
oper       = crSigCdOpe.Opers
precop     = crSigCdOpe.precops
cpro       = ''
dpro       = ''
peso       = 0
lcMoeVs    = ''

lnCount = 0

lcEGC = ThisForm.pEmps + _Grupo + _Conta

LcWhere = [Select * From SigMvEst Where EmpGruEsts = ?lcEGC ]
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpEst')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEst)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select CrTmpEst
Scan

	If ( sQtds = 0 ) Or ( sQtds < 0 And Oper = 2 ) Or ( sQtds > 0 And Oper = 1 )
		Loop
	EndIf

	cPro = Cpros
	
	If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',cPro, [Cgrus,Cpros,Cunis,Dpros,Pesoms,fvendas,fcustos,moepvs,moepcs,moevs,pvens,moecs,pcuss,moedas,valors,reffs,sgrus,mercs,CodFinP,custofs])
		Loop
	EndIf

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdGrp','CrTmpGru','CGrus',CrTmpPro.cgrus,[Tipoestos,tams,cores,embs,pesos])
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUni','CrTmpUni','Cunis',CrTmpPro.cunis)

	Select crTpmMvItn
	Append Blank
	Replace crTpmMvItn.opers With Iif( oper=1, 'E', Iif(oper=2, 'S', Iif(CrTmpEst.sQtds<0,'E','S') ) )
	Replace crTpmMvItn.cpros with CrTmpPro.Cpros
	cpro = crTmpPro.Cpros
	dpro = crTmpPro.DPros
	cuni = crTmpPro.CUnis
	peso = CrTmpPro.Pesoms
	
	If crSigCdOpe.PesoAuts = 1
		Replace crTpmMvItn.Pesos With Peso
	EndIf
	If crSigCdOpe.FatAuts = 1
		Replace crTpmMvItn.Fators With Iif( crSigCdOpe.Precops = 1, crtmpPro.FVendas, Iif( crSigCdOpe.Precops = 2, CrTmpPro.FCustos, 0 ) )
	EndIf
	Replace crTpmMvItn.moefats with Iif( crSigCdOpe.Precops = 1, CrTmpPro.Moepvs, Iif( crSigCdOpe.Precops = 2, CrTmpPro.Moepcs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )
	Replace crTpmMvItn.units with 0

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.PrecoAuts,1,3) &&And !Empty(TprMvCab.lPrecos)
		lcSql = [Select Codigos from SigCdLpc Where lPrecos = ']+TprMvCab.lPrecos+[']
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrTmplPre')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		lcwhere = [Select * From SigCdLpi Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And LPrecos = ']+TprMvCab.lPrecos+[']
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigCdLpi')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdLpi 6)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Select crSigCdLpi
		Go Top
		If Reccount() > 0 And (IsEmpty(crSigCdLpi.VencFs) Or BetWeen(crTprMvCab.Datas,crSigCdLpi.VencIs, crSigCdLpi.VencFs))
			lcMoeVs = crSigCdLpi.MoeVs
			Replace crTpmMvItn.univals with crSigCdLpi.PVens, ;
					crTpmMvItn.MoeFats With crSigCdLpi.MoeVs ,;
					crTpmMvItn.lPrecos   with TprMvCab.LPrecos,;
					crTpmMvItn.CodlPrecs With CrTmplPre.Codigos in crTpmMvItn
		Else
			If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 1
				lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeVs
				lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.PVens
			Else
				If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 2
					lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeCs
					lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.PCuss
					If InList(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
						_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.ChkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
						lcQuery = [Select Moevs, Pvens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
						If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 and Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
							lcMoeVs   = CrTmpfPro.MoeVs
							lnUniVals = CrTmpfPro.pVens
						EndIf
					EndIf
					lcMoeda = lcMoeVs
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdMoe','crSigCdMoe','Cmoes',lcMoevs)
					If !Empty(crSigCdMoe.Moeqs)
						lcMoeVs   = crSigCdMoe.Moeqs
						lnUniVals = lnUniVals * Iif( crSigCdMoe.Qtdeqs = 0, 1, crSigCdMoe.QtdEqs )
					EndIf
				Else
					If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 5
						lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.Moedas
						lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.Valors
					Else
						If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7
							lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.mUltComps
							lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.vUltComps
						Else
							If InList(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
								=fCustoMedio(TprMvCab.Emps,CrTmpPro.Cpros,TprMvCab.Datas,ThisForm.poDataMgr,(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
								lcMoeVs   = TmpCusMed.Moedas
								lnUniVals = TmpCusMed.Valors
							Else
								lnUniVals = 0
								lcMoeVs   = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 11
				lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.custofs
			EndIf
			
			If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 15
				lnUniVals = crTmpPro.custofs
				lcQuery = [select customedioreais as csmedio, (select moedaps from sigcdpam) as csmoedas ] + ;
						[from customedio3 where cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' ]
				If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpProMd') < 1
					=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpProMd)')
					Return 0
				EndIf
				If Reccount('CrTmpProMd')>0
					lnUniVals = CrTmpProMd.csmedio
				EndIf 	
			EndIf
			
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Replace crTpmMvItn.UniVals With lnUniVals						
		EndIf
	Else
		lcMoeVs = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
	EndIf

	Select crTpmMvItn
	Replace crTpmMvItn.dpros With CrTmppro.dpros, ;
			crTpmMvItn.cunis With CrTmppro.cunis, ;
			crTpmMvItn.MoeVs With lcMoeVs,;
			crTpmMvItn.Reffs With CrTmpPro.Reffs,;
			crTpmMvItn.Qtds  With Abs(CrTmpEst.sQtds)

	lnCount = lnCount + 1
	Replace crTpmMvItn.CItens With lnCount

	If crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts = 1 And ;
			( InList( CrTmpGru.TipoEstos, 2, 3, 4 ) Or ( CrTmpGru.Tams = 1) Or ;
					( CrTmpGru.Cores = 1 ) Or ( CrTmpGru.Embs = 1 ) )
 
		Insert Into crTpmMvIts ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, CPros, CItens, QtdEmbs, Pesos, CodCors, CodTams, Qtds ) ;
			Value ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, crTpmMvItn.CPros, crTpmMvItn.CItens, ;
					Iif( CrTmpGru.Embs = 1, 0, 1 ), ;
					Iif( CrTmpGru.Pesos = 1, crTpmMvItn.Pesos, 0 ),;
					Iif( CrTmpGru.Cores = 1,CrtmpEst.Codcors,''), ;
					Iif( CrTmpGru.Tams = 1,CrTmpEst.CodTams,' '), crTpmMvItn.Qtds ) 

	EndIf

	ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()

EndScan

Select crTpmMvItn
Set Order To
If Reccount() = 0
	Append Blank
EndIf
Wait Clear
Return .t.
**************** fim *************
ENDPROC
