* PROCEDURE carregafpbl
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carregafpbl
**** Forma de publicidade - Mena - incluido em 12/12/2011 - Carat
loObj = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgInformacoes.cntFPubl
If loObj.Visible
	lcQuery = [Select descs From SigCdFpb Where cods = ']+TprMvCab.fpubls+[']
	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpFPu') < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFPu)')
	Endif
	loObj.GetDesFPubl.Value = IIF(EOF('CrTmpFPu'), '', CrTmpFPu.descs)
	loObj.GetDesFPubl.refresh
ENDIF

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carregaprzent
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carregaprzent
Local lcCta, ldDat

If (InList(crSigCdOpe.DtEntrs, 1, 4, 6) And (InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')) And ;
   (IsEmpty(TprMvCab.PrazoEnts) Or Dtos(TprMvCab.PrazoEnts) = Dtos(Date())))

	lcCta = Iif(crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1, TprMvCab.ContaDs, TprMvCab.ContaOs)
	
	If IsEmpty(TprMvCab.PrazoEnts)
		ldDat = Date()
		If CrSigOpCdc.NMinEnts = CrSigOpCdc.nMaxEnts
			ldDat = Date() + CrSigOpCdc.nMinEnts
			Replace PrazoEnts With ldDat In TprMvCab
		Endif
	Else
		ldDat = Iif(Type('TprMvCab.PrazoEnts')='T', Ttod(TprMvCab.PrazoEnts), TprMvCab.PrazoEnts)
	EndIf

	ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli', 'LocalCli', 'IClis', lcCta, 'PrazoEnts')
	If Used('LocalCli') And Not Eof('LocalCli') And (LocalCli.PrazoEnts > 0)
		ldDat = ldDat + LocalCli.PrazoEnts

		Replace PrazoEnts With ldDat In TprMvCab
	EndIf
EndIf
* Fim **************************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carregavendedor
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carregavendedor
lcQuery = [Select IClis, GrupoVens, ContaVens From SigCdCli Where IClis = '] + TprMvCab.ContaDs + [']
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalCli]) < 1)
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CarregaVendedor - LocalCli)])
	Return .f.
EndIf

ThisForm.Libaltven = .t.

If Not Empty(LocalCli.GrupoVens)
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_grupo.Value = LocalCli.GrupoVens
EndIf

If Not Empty(LocalCli.ContaVens)
	lcQuery = [Select IClis, RClis, Cpfs From SigCdCli Where IClis = '] + LocalCli.ContaVens + [']
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalCli]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CarregaVendedor - LocalCli 2)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_conta.Value  = LocalCli.IClis
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_dconta.Value = LocalCli.RClis
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_cpf.Value    = LocalCli.Cpfs

	If Not Empty(LocalCli.IClis)
		ThisForm.Libaltven = Empty(ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_conta.Value)

		If fChecaAcesso(Padl(crSigCdOpe.nDopes, 8, [0]), [ALTVEND], .f., ThisForm.UsuVendedor)
			ThisForm.Libaltven = .t.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf


ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carrega_comi
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carrega_comi
Local lnValTots, _pdata, lnpDesCC

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde.....'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando C.C.!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

Store 0 to lnTotalParc, lnDiferParc, lnValTots
ThisForm.ContaPar = 0
Select xPar
Scan 
	If Not Empty( xPar.Fpags)
		ThisForm.ContaPar = ThisForm.ContaPar + 1
	EndIf
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
	lnTotalParc = lnTotalParc + ( xPar.Valos * xPar.Cotfpgs )
	If crSigOpFp.BxComis # 1
		lnDiferParc = lnDiferParc + ( xPar.Valos * xPar.Cotfpgs )
	EndIf
Endscan

If lnTotalParc # 0
	lnDescParc = 1 - ( lnDiferParc / lnTotalParc )
Else
	lnDescParc = 1
EndIf

Store 0 to lnTotalBase, lnDiferComis, lnItens
If InList(crSigCdOpe.Valpres, 1, 3)
	Select TmpTotal
	Scan
		lnCota = ThisForm.Cotacao( TmpTotal.Moeds, TprMvCab.Datas )
		lnValTots = lnValTots + TmpTotal.ValTots * lnCota
		lnDiferComis = lnDiferComis + ( TmpTotal.ValDifs * lnCota * Iif( TmpTotal.Tipos = 'D', -1, 1 ) )
		lnTotalBase  = lnTotalBase + ( TmpTotal.ValItens * lnCota )
		lnItens = lnItens + ( Iif(TmpTotal.nSinals < 0, -1, 1) * TmpTotal.Valitens * lnCota )
	Endscan
	lnpDesCc = Iif(lnItens # 0, (lnValTots - Abs(lnItens)) / lnItens , 0)
	If lnTotalBase # 0
		lnDiferComis = 1 + ( lnDiferComis / lnTotalBase )
	EndIf

	If lnDiferComis = 0 And lnValTots # 0
		lnDiferComis = 1
	EndIf
	If lnValTots = 0
		lnDiferComis = 0
	EndIf
Else
	Store 1 to lnDiferComis
	lnpDesCc = TprMvCab.Vars
EndIf
lnpDesCc = Iif(lnpDesCc < 0, Abs(lnpDesCc), 0 )

lnDiferVars = 1
If (TprMvCab.Vars < 0 And crSigCdPam.Comiscvars = 1) Or (TprMvCab.Vars > 0 And crSigCdPam.ComisDvars=1)
	lnDiferVars = (100+TprMvCab.Vars)/100
EndIf

If Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EdComis,1,3,4)  &&Comissão Editável (calculado no método Salva)
	lcContaOD = Iif(crSigOpCdc.ChkComis = 1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,Iif(crSigOpCdc.Chkcomis = 2, TprMvCab.ContaDs, Space(10)))
	=fCalcularComissao(lnDiferComis, lnDescParc, lnDiferVars, ThisForm, lcContaOD, LnpDesCc)
EndIf

If Not Used([TmpComiss])
	Return .t.
EndIf

Select TmpComiss
Go Top

Select xPar
Scan 
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
	If ( crSigOpFp.BxComis = 1 ) And ( crSigCdPam.ComLancas = 1 Or ;
			( crSigCdPam.ComLancas = 2 And crSigOpFp.ValPends # 1 ) ) And ;
			( Not ( crSigOpFp.Infos = 'C' And crSigOpFp.BxComChqs = 1 ) )
		_PercBaixa = ( xPar.Valos * xPar.Cotfpgs ) / ( lnTotalParc - lnDiferParc )
		Select TmpComiss
		Scan 
			_Baixar = Round( Comissaos * _PercBaixa, 2 )
			Replace Baixas With Baixas + _Baixar
		Endscan
	EndIf
EndScan

Select TmpMccr2
Zap

Zap In crSigCdCmm

Select TmpComiss
Scan
	lnIdComis = fGerUniqueKey('INTCONTS') && Tiago - 29/01/2013 - Costantini - Incluido numeração de ID para vincular a tabela de comissão com a comissão liberada no conta corrente
	Insert Into crSigCdCmm ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Grupos, Contas, Moedas, Comissaos, Bases, Baixas, Datas, Linhas, ;
							CidChaves, Percs, Juros, Impostos, EmpDopNums, IntConts, ComiOrgs );
			Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes,  TprMvCab.Numes, TmpComiss.Grupos,;
					TmpComiss.Contas, TmpComiss.Moedas, TmpComiss.Comissaos, ;
					TmpComiss.Bases, TmpComiss.Baixas, TprMvCab.Datas, TmpComiss.Linhas, ;
					fUniqueIds(), TmpComiss.Percs, TmpComiss.Juros, TmpComiss.Impostos, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), lnIdComis, TmpComiss.ComiOrgs )
	If TmpComiss.Baixas # 0 And Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EdComis,3,4)
		xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
		xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')

		If (crSigCdOpe.Caixas = 1)
			If (crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1)
				_Conta = TprMvCab.ContaDs
			Else
				_Conta = TprMvCab.ContaOs
			EndIf
		Else
			If (crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1)
				_Conta = TprMvCab.ContaDs
			Else
				_Conta = TprMvCab.ContaOs
			EndIf
		EndIf
		_Hist  = TprMvCab.Emps + Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes ) + ' ' + Alltrim( fGerMascara(TprMvCab.Numes)) + ' - ' + ThisForm.CfgTitComissao
		_Hist2 = 'Cliente:'+_Conta
		lcMoeCom = ' '
		
		lcSql = [Select ComMoedas From SigCdGcr Where Codigos = ']+TmpComiss.Grupos+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpGccr') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão Carrega_Comi(TmpGccr)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		If Not Empty(TmpGccr.ComMoedas) And TmpGccr.ComMoedas # TmpComiss.Moedas
			lnValor = TmpComiss.Baixas * ThisForm.Cotacao( TmpComiss.Moedas, TprMvCab.Datas ) / ThisForm.Cotacao( TmpGccr.ComMoedas, TprMvCab.Datas )
			lnCota = ThisForm.Cotacao( TmpGccr.ComMoedas, TprMvCab.Datas )
			lnMoeda = TmpGccr.ComMoedas
		Else
			If crSigCdPam.ComMoedas # TmpComiss.Moedas And !Empty( crSigCdPam.ComMoedas )
				lnValor = TmpComiss.Baixas * ThisForm.Cotacao( TmpComiss.Moedas, TprMvCab.Datas ) / ThisForm.Cotacao( crSigCdPam.ComMoedas, TprMvCab.Datas )
				lnCota = ThisForm.Cotacao( crSigCdPam.ComMoedas, TprMvCab.Datas )
				lnMoeda = crSigCdPam.ComMoedas
			Else
				lnValor = TmpComiss.Baixas 
				lnCota = 1
				lnMoeda = TmpComiss.Moedas
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If lnValor = 0
			Loop
		EndIf
		lcMoeCom = TmpComiss.Moedas

		Select TmpMccr2
		Set Order To Comissao
		=Seek(TmpComiss.Grupos+TmpComiss.Contas+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+lnMoeda+lcMoeCom)

		If Eof('TmpMccr2')
			_noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SigMvCcr' )
			_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )

			Append Blank
			Replace NOpers    With _noper,;
					VOpers    With _voper,;
					Emps      With TprMvCab.emps,;
					Datas     With TprMvCab.datas,;
					usualts   With usuar,;
					datalts   With _pData,;
					Vencs     With TprMvCab.Datas,;
					hists     With _hist,;
					opers     With xoper,;
					sopers    With xsoper,;
					moedas    With lnMoeda,;
					cotacaos  With lnCota,;
					autos     With .t.,;
					grupos    With TmpComiss.Grupos,;
					contas    With TmpComiss.Contas,;
					sgrupos   With crSigCdPam.ComGrupos,;
					scontas   With crSigCdPam.ComContas,;
					smoedas   With lnMoeda,;
					scotacaos With lnCota,;
					dopes     With TprMvCab.Dopes,;
					numes     With TprMvCab.Numes,;
					Hist2s    With _Hist2,;
					Tipos     With 'X',;
					MoeComs   With lcMoeCom,;
					Jobs	  With TprMvCab.Jobs
		EndIf
		Replace valors  With Valors + lnValor,;
				svalors With Valors
	EndIf
EndScan

Select TmpMccr2
Index On Nopers Tag Nopers
Scan
	Scatter Memvar Memo

	If m.Valors < 0
		m.Valors  = Abs(m.Valors)
		m.sValors = m.Valors
		m.Opers   = iif(m.Opers = 'D','C','D')
		m.sOpers  = iif(m.Opers = 'C','D','C')
	EndIf
	Select CqSigMvCcr
	Append Blank
	Gather Memvar Memo

	Replace Dopes      With TprMvCab.Dopes,;
			Numes      With TprMvCab.Numes,;
			CidChaves  With Dtos(Datas)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(datas)),"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey ,;
			gruconmoes with grupos + contas + moedas,;
			EmpDopNums With Emps + Dopes + Str(Numes,6) ,;
			EmpDopncs  With Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs,6),;
			Pagos      With Iif(Valors=valpags,'0','1') ,;
			DopoTps    with Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos in cqSigMvCcr

	=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, CqSigMvCcr.Contas, CqSigMvCcr.Datas, CqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )
	ThisForm.FazContra(.t.)

Endscan

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carrega_eesti
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carrega_eesti
Local _RecEesti, lcNotas, lnValos, lnItem, lcEmpos, _OperDig, lnOpeDig, _ChkQtdss, llTemItem2
Local lcTransacao, lnValoSubNAutos, _pData

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde... Processando Itens!!!'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Itens!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

Zap In TmpSigCdGrp
Zap In TmpTransfs

Select TmpOperacao
Count To lnOpeDig For Not IsEmpty(Codigos)
_OperDig = ( lnOpeDig # 0 )
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
lcDopeNivels = crSigCdOpe.Nivels
lnnDopeNiv   = crSigCdOpe.nDopes

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',lcDopeNivels)
lnDopeNivels = crSigCdOpe.NDopes

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
_Recal = ( crSigCdOpe.ValEsts = 1 )
_ChkQtdss = crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss
_BxParc   = crSigCdOpe.BxParcials

If (crSigCdOpe.Consers = 1 And !Empty(crSigCdPam.OpConsers) ) Or ( crSigOpCdc.InibePa = 3 )
	If crSigOpCdc.InibePa = 3
		Select a.*, b.Dopes As DopeAuts From crTpmMvItn a, csOpeAut b ;
			Where Not Empty(a.Cpros) and Not Empty(Notas) And a.Cpros == b.CPros ;
			Into Cursor csItemCons
	Else
		Select *, crSigCdPam.OpConsers As DopeAuts From crTpmMvItn Where !Empty(Notas);
			Into Cursor csItemCons
	EndIf
	Index On Emps + DopeAuts + Notas Tag EmpDopNum
	
	If RecCount('csItemCons') > 0
	
		Select DopeAuts as Dopes, Notas, Sum(Totas) as Totas ;
		  From csItemCons ;
		 Group By DopeAuts, Notas ;
		  Into Cursor csCabCons 

		Select csCabCons
		Scan
			Select TprMvCab
			Scatter MemVar
			m.Dopes      = csCabCons.Dopes
			m.Emps       = Iif(Empty(crSigCdOpe.EmpPads),m.Emps,crSigCdOpe.EmpPads)
			If crSigOpCdc.InibePa = 3
				m.ValInis    = csCabCons.Totas
				m.Valos      = csCabCons.Totas
			Else
				m.ValInis    = 0
				m.Valos      = 0
			EndIf
			m.Utilizados = 1
			m.DGOpes     = ThisForm.pDGope
			m.Numes      = Val(CsCabCons.Notas)
			m.mascNum    = fGerMascara( m.Numes )
			m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
			m.vars=0
			m.ValVars  = 0
			m.ValVarPs = 0

			lcSql = [Select EmpdopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpdopNums = ']+m.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrEest') < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( creest 2)')
				Return .f.
			Else
				If Reccount('CrEest') > 0
					Messagebox('Documento ' + AllTrim(CsCabCons.Notas) + ;
							' Já Existe !!', 48, 'Movimentação: ' + m.empDopNums )
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf

			m.DtAlts = _pData
			m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
			lcNotas = csCabCons.Notas
			m.EmpGopNums = m.Emps + m.Dgopes + Str(m.numes,6)
			m.Codigos   = ( lnnDopeNiv * 1000000 ) + TprMvCab.Numes
			Insert Into crSigMvCab From MemVar

			Insert Into crSigMvPec ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, EmpSubns, Datas) ;
					Values ( m.Emps, m.Dopes, m.Numes, m.Codigos, ;
							 m.Emps+m.Dopes+Str(m.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), m.Emps, _pData)

			Select csItemCons
			Set Order to EmpDopnum
			Set Key To TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + lcNotas
			Goto Top
			lnItem  = 1
			Scan
				If Empty(Cpros)
					Loop
				EndIf
				Scatter Memvar Memo
				m.Dopes  = crSigMvCab.Dopes
				m.Valos  = m.Valos + m.Totas
				m.Emps   = Iif(Empty(crSigCdOpe.EmpPads),m.Emps,crSigCdOpe.EmpPads)
				m.CItens = lnItem
				m.nCodigos = 0
				m.Numes      = Val( lcNotas )
				m.mascNum    = fGerMascara( m.Numes )
				m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
				m.DtAlts = Iif(IsNull(m.DtAlts) or Empty(m.DtAlts),_pData,m.DtAlts)
				m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
				m.NumOlds = TprMvCab.Numes
				m.AliqOrigs = m.AliqIcms
				Insert Into crSigMvItn From Memvar
				lnItem = lnItem + 1
				Select csItemCons
			EndScan
			Select crSigMvCab
			Replace crSigMvCab.Notas With lcNotas, ;
					crSigMvCab.Valos With m.Valos in crSigMvCab
		EndScan

	EndIf

EndIf

If RecCount('csItemAut') > 0 And crSigOpCdc.InibePa # 3
	Select csCabAut
	Scan
		Select TprMvCab
		Scatter MemVar
		m.Dopes      = csCabAut.Dopes
		m.ValInis    = 0
		m.Valos      = 0
		m.Utilizados = 1
		m.DGOpes     = ThisForm.pDGope
		m.mascNum    = fGerMascara( m.Numes )
		m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
		m.DtAlts = _pData
		m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
		m.EmpGopNums = m.emps + m.dgopes + Str(m.numes,6)
		m.vars=0
		m.valvars=0
		m.ValVarPs = 0
		m.Codigos   = ( lnnDopeNiv * 1000000 ) + TprMvCab.Numes
		Insert Into crSigMvCab From MemVar

		Insert Into crSigMvPec ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, EmpSubns, Datas) ;
				Values ( m.Emps, m.Dopes, m.Numes, m.Codigos, ;
						 m.Emps+m.Dopes+Str(m.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), m.Emps, _pData)

		Select csItemAut
		Set Order to EmpDopnum
		Set Key To crSigMvCab.Emps + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6)
		Goto Top
		lcNotas = csItemAut.Notas
		lnItem  = 1
		Scan
			If Empty(Cpros)
				Loop
			EndIf
			Scatter Memvar Memo
			m.Dopes  = crSigMvCab.Dopes
			m.Valos  = m.Valos + m.Totas
			m.CItens = lnItem
			m.nCodigos = 0
			m.mascNum    = fGerMascara( m.Numes )
			m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
			m.DtAlts = Iif(IsNull(m.DtAlts) or Empty(m.DtAlts),_pData,m.DtAlts)
			m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
			m.AliqOrigs = m.AliqIcms			
			Insert Into crSigMvItn From Memvar
			lnItem = lnItem + 1
			Select csItemAut
		EndScan
		Select crSigMvCab
		Replace crSigMvCab.Notas With lcNotas, ;
				crSigMvCab.Valos With m.Valos in crSigMvCab
	EndScan
EndIf

If RecCount('csItemOpe') > 0
	Select csCabOpe
	Scan
		Select TprMvCab
		Scatter MemVar
		m.Dopes      = csCabOpe.Dopes
		m.ValInis    = 0
		m.Valos      = 0
		m.Utilizados = 1
		m.DGOpes     = PADR(' ',20)
		m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
		m.dtalts = _pData
		m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
		m.EmpGopNums = m.emps + m.dgopes + Str(m.numes,6)
		m.vars=0
		m.valvars=0
		m.ValVarPs = 0
		
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',m.dopes)

		If crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1
			m.grupoos = crSigCdOpe.GruOrigs
			m.contaos = crSigCdOpe.ConOrigs
		EndIf
		If crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1
			m.grupods = crSigCdOpe.GruDests
			m.Contads = crSigCdOpe.ConDests
		EndIf
		_PuxaOrigem   = crSigCdOpe.ConOSubs
		_PuxaDestino  = crSigCdOpe.ConDSubs
		If InList( _PuxaOrigem, 1, 2 )
			If IsEmpty( m.Grupoos ) Or ( IsEmpty( m.Contaos ) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGOrigs )
				m.Grupoos = Iif( _PuxaOrigem=1, TprMvCab.Grupoos, TprMvCab.Grupods )
			EndIf
			If IsEmpty( m.Contaos ) 
				m.Contaos = Iif( _PuxaOrigem=1, TprMvCab.Contaos, TprMvCab.Contads )
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If InList( _PuxaDestino, 1, 2 )
			If IsEmpty( m.Grupods ) Or ( IsEmpty( m.Contads ) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGDests )
				m.Grupods = Iif( _PuxaDestino=1, TprMvCab.Grupoos, TprMvCab.Grupods )
			EndIf
			If IsEmpty( m.Contads ) 
				m.Contads = Iif( _PuxaDestino=1, TprMvCab.Contaos, TprMvCab.Contads )
			EndIf
		EndIf

		Insert Into crSigMvCab From MemVar

		Select csItemOpe
		Set Order to EmpDopnum
		Set Key To crSigMvCab.Emps + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6)
		Goto Top
		lnItem  = 1
		Scan
			If Empty(cpros)
				Loop
			EndIf
			Scatter Memvar Memo
			m.Dopes  = crSigMvCab.Dopes
			m.Valos  = m.Valos + m.Totas
			m.CItens = lnItem
			m.nCodigos = 0
			m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
			m.DtAlts = Iif(IsNull(m.DtAlts) or Empty(m.DtAlts),_pData,m.DtAlts)
			m.Cidchaves = fUniqueIds()
			m.AliqOrigs = m.AliqIcms			
			Insert Into crSigMvItn From Memvar
			lnItem = lnItem + 1
			Select crSigMvCab
			Replace crSigMvCab.Valos With m.Valos in crSigMvCab
			
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',CsItemOpe.cpros, [Cgrus, Mercs])
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdGrp','CrTmpGru','Cgrus',CrTmpPro.Cgrus, [cestoqs, moecusts])
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdUni','CrTmpUni','Cunis',Csitemope.cunis)

			llMrc = .f.

	 		If (!Empty(CrSigOpCdd.Mercs) and CrSigOpCdd.Mercs = CrTmpPro.Mercs)
				llMrc = .t.
	 		Else
	 			If (crSigOpCdc.carcompos = 5)
					lcSql = [Select a.*, b.Dgrus From SigOpGpo a, SigCdGrp b Where a.Dopes = ']+crSigMvCab.Dopes+[' And a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus ]

					m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
					m.dtalts = Iif(IsNull(m.DtAlts) or Empty(m.DtAlts),_pData,m.DtAlts)
					m.cidchaves = fUniqueIds()

					Insert Into crSigMvIts From Memvar
					xQtd  = crTpmMvIts.qtds * crTpmMvIts.QtdEmbs
					xTota = crTpmMvItn.Units * crTpmMvIts.qtds * crTpmMvIts.QtdEmbs

					Insert Into CqSigMvHst ( Usuars, Datars, Emps, Opers, Dopes, Numes, Datas, DtAudits, CPros, Units, ;
										 Moedas, Totas, DataTrans, Empos, CodBarras, Qtds, Grupos, Estos, RecalMeds, ;
										 Obs, Pesos, CidChaves, EmpDopNums, EmpGruEsts, oriDopNums, BcIpis, CodCors, CodTams ) ;
						Values ( Usuar, _pData, TprMvCab.EmpDs, 'E', _DopeETrf, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
								 TprMvCab.Datas, Null, crTpmMvItn.CPros, crTpmMvItn.Units , crTpmMvItn.Moedas, ;
								 xTota, crTpmMvItn.DataTrans, TprMvCab.EmpDs, CodBarra, ;
								 xQtd, _GruEtrfs, _ConEtrfs, _Recal, crTpmMvItn.Obs, crTpmMvItn.Pesos, fUniqueIds(), ;
								 TprMvCab.EmpDs+_DopeETrf+Str(crTpmMvItn.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Empds+_GruEtrfs+_ConEtrfs,;
								 TprMvCab.EmpDs+_DopeETrf+Str(crTpmMvItn.Numes,6), ;
								 Iif(crTpmMvItn.Qtds<>0,Round(crTpmMvItn.BcIpis/crTpmMvItn.Qtds,2),0), crTpmMvIts.CodCors, crTpmMvIts.CodTams )

					If !Empty( CodBarra )
						Select crSigOpEtq
						Locate For Cbars = CodBarra
						If Eof()
							If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigOpEtq','CrTmpEti','Cbars',CodBarra)
								Select CrTmpEti
								Scatter to Memvar Memo
								Select crSigOpEtq
								Append From Array Memvar
							EndIf
						EndIf

						Replace	crSigOpEtq.grupos  with _GruEtrfs,;
								crSigOpEtq.contas  with _ConEtrfs,;
								crSigOpEtq.transps with .f.,;
								crSigOpEtq.Empos   With TprMvCab.EmpDs,;
								crSigOpEtq.DtMovs  With _pData in crSigOpEtq
					EndIf
					Replace CodBarras With CodBarra in crSigMvIts
				EndIf
			EndScan
		EndIf
		Select crTpmMvItn
	EndScan
EndIf

Select crTpmMvItn
set order to

If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigCdOpe.CfgFinancs, 1, 1))) = 1) 
	&& Inibir Lançamentos de CMV de Grupos de Produtos - Configuração em SIGOPFIN
	&& Richard em 25/03/2014 - Configurações Financeiras das Movimentações
	
	lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdGrp Where Not Grucmvs = ']+Space(10)+[' And Not Concmvs = ']+Space(10)+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpGru')

	Select crTmpGru
	Scan
		=Seek( CrTmpGru.Cgrus,'TmpSigCdGrp','Grupo')
		_VarTot = TmpSigCdGrp.vTotals
		If _Vartot # 0 And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And crSigCdOpe.Vendas = 1
			If crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1 && Entrada
				_GrupoOrig = TprMvCab.Grupods

			Else

				_GrupoOrig = crtmpGru.GruCMVs
				_ContaOrig = crtmpGru.ConCMVs
			EndIf

			_hist = TprMvCab.Emps + " " + Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes ) + " " + Alltrim( fGerMascara( TprMvCab.Numes ) )+ ' ( ' + Alltrim( crtmpGru.Cgrus ) + ' )'
			_noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SIGMVCCR' )
			_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
			xoper = 'D'
			xsoper = 'C'
			_CidChave = Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas)),"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey 

			Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, VOpers, Emps, Datas, usualts, datalts, Vencs, hists,;
					opers, sopers, moedas, cotacaos, valors, autos, grupos, contas, ;
					sgrupos, scontas, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, Dopes, numes, valpags, CidChaves, EmpDopNums, Jobs ) ;
				Values ( _NOper, _VOper, TprMvCab.emps, TprMvCab.datas, usuar, _pData, _pData, ;
						_hist, xoper, xsoper, CrTmpGru.MoeCusts, ThisForm.Cotacao(CrTmpGru.MoeCusts), _VarTot, .t., ;

						TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.numes, _VarTot, _CidChave, ;
						TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs )
			Select cqSigMvCcr
			Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes with cqSigMvCcr.grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.moedas,;
					cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
					cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.Valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1'),;
					CqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    with CqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + CqSigMvCcr.Opers + CqSigMvCcr.Tipos + CqSigMvCcr.Pagos
			
			=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )

			ThisForm.FazContra

		EndIf

EndIf

If InList(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs,5,7,9) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.nOpCrs)  &&Geração de Movimentação de crédito
	m.DGOpes = PADR(' ',20)
	m.Utilizados = 1
	m.EmpdnCrds = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.numes,6)
	m.Codigos   = ( crSigCdOpe.nDopes * 1000000 ) + m.Numes
	m.DtAlts = _pData
	m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
	m.Dopes = crSigCdOpe.nOpCrs
	m.Vars = 0
	m.ValVars = 0
	m.valVarPs = 0

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs,7,9)

		m.Valos = ThisForm.Totalizait(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs)

		lcSql = [Select Dopes, Faixais, FaixaFs, Percs, Multiplos From SigOpCrr Where dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' ]+;
				[Order by Dopes, Faixais, Faixafs ]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpCrOpe') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( TmpCrOpe)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		m.xPercs = 0
		m.xMult  = 0
		Select TmpCrOpe
		Scan
			If Between(m.Valos,TmpCrOpe.FaixaIs,TmpCrOpe.FaixaFs)
				m.xPercs = TmpCrOpe.Percs
				m.xMult  = TmpCrOpe.Multiplos
				Exit
			EndIf
		EndScan
		m.Valos = Iif(m.xPercs > 0, Round( m.Valos * m.xPercs / 100, 2 ), 0 )
		m.valos = iif(m.xMult > 0, Int(m.Valos / m.xMult), m.Valos )

	EndIf

	If m.Valos > 0
		lcSql = [Select EmpOpCrs as Emps From SigOpCdc Where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.NOpCrs+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CsTmpCred') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( CsTmpCred)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		lcEmpOpCr = Iif(Not Empty(CsTmpCred.Emps),CsTmpCred.Emps,ThisForm.pEmps)
		llSaida = .f.
		DO While Not llSaida
			m.Numes = fGerUniqueKey( AllTrim( m.Dopes ) + lcEmpOpCr )
			m.empDopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.Dopes  + Str(m.numes,6)
			lcSql = [Select EmpdopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpdopNums = ']+m.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrEest') < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( creest)')
				Return .f.
			Else
				If Reccount('CrEest') = 0
					llSaida = .t.
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Enddo

		m.Valinis = m.Valos
		m.MascNum = AllTrim( fGerMascara( m.Numes ) )
		m.EmpGopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.dgopes + Str(m.numes,6)
		m.empDopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.Dopes  + Str(m.numes,6)
		m.Notas  = Transform(m.Numes,"@L 999999")
		m.Status = Iif(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 9, crSigOpCdd.CodStss,' ' )
		Insert Into crSigMvCab From MemVar
		Replace Emps  With lcEmpOpCr ,;
				EmpDs With lcEmpOpCr  in crSigMvCab
		Replace TprMvCab.EmpdnCrds With m.empDnCrds in TprMvCab

		Insert Into crSigMvPec ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, EmpSubns, Datas) ;
				Values ( lcEmpOpCr , m.Dopes, m.Numes, m.Codigos, ;
						 lcEmpOpCr+m.Dopes+Str(m.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), m.Emps, _pData)
	EndIf

EndIf

Select crTpmMvItnS
Set Order to
Scan
	If Qtds > 0 And Not Empty(Cpros)
		Insert Into crSigMvItt (cpros, dpros, Dopes, emps, Numes, qtds, totas, units, moedas, EmpDopNums,;
								 Cidchaves, cUnis) ;
			            Values (crTpmMvItnS.cpros, crTpmMvItnS.dpros, TprMvCab.Dopes, ;
			            		TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.numes, crTpmMvItnS.qtds, crTpmMvItnS.totas, ;
			            		crTpmMvItnS.units, crTpmMvItnS.moedas, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
			            		fUniqueIds(), crTpmMvItnS.Cunis )
	EndIf
EndScan
