	If Not Empty(MotDscs) And Valos > 0
		Insert Into crSigMvEtd (Emps,Dopes,Numes,EmpDopNums,MotDscs,pDescs,Valos,Cidchaves,Obs) ;
			            Values (TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.numes, TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
			            		xEestDsc.MotDscs, xEestDsc.pDescs, xEestDsc.Valos, fUniqueIds(),xEestDsc.Obs )
	EndIf
EndScan

Select TprMvCab
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carrega_eestie
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carrega_eestie
If crSigOpCdc.Varcppqs > 0 And crSigCdOpe.opers = 3 And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 4
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Delete For Opers = [E]
	Select Max(citens) as Citens From crTpmMvItn Into Cursor Tempo
	Select Tempo
	_cItem = cItens
	
	Select * From crTpmMvItn Into Cursor Temporario
	Select Temporario
	Scan
		Scatter Memvar Memo
		m.Qtds  = m.Pesos
		m.Pesos = 0
		_cItem = _cItem + 1
		m.citens = _cItem
		m.Opers = [E] 
		Insert Into crTpmMvItn From Memvar
	EndScan
EndIf
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carrega_estpe
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carrega_estpe
Local _Posicao, _BaixaSns, lnCfgOpCrs, _pdata

lcSql = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.dopes+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcSql,'crSigCdOpe') < 1 Or Reccount('crSigCdOpe') = 0
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (SigCdOpe 20)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcSql = [Select * From SigOpCdc Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.dopes+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcSql,'crSigOpCdc') < 1 Or Reccount('crSigOpCdc') = 0
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (SigOpCdc 20)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde....'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Sub-Niveis!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

lcUltGrv= TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + '-Car_EstPe'
_pData  = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

*- Numeros das Movimentações baixadas -*
Select TprMvCab
_Posicao = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )
_BaixaSns  = crSigCdOpe.BaixaSns
lnCfgOpCrs = crSigCdOpe.OpCrs
_BaixaPgs  = ( crSigCdOpe.BxPagos = 1 )

Select crSigBxEst
Go Top
Index on EmpdopNumb Tag EmpDopNumb

Select TmpOperacao
Scan
	If Codigos = 0 Or crSigOpCdc.nGraSubs = 1
		Loop
	EndIf

	lcQuery = [Select a.*, b.ConfigGers ] + ;
			    [From SigCdOpe a ] + ;
			    [Left Join SigOpCdd b ] + ;
			      [On a.Dopes = b.Dopes ] + ;
			   [Where a.NDopes = ] + Alltrim(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 4))

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [TmpOpe]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (TmpOpe)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Go Top In TmpOpe
	llBxS = .t.
	If Not Eof([TmpOpe]) And (Int(Val(Substr(TmpOpe.ConfigGers, 159, 01))) = 1) && Pasta Subnível / Subnível Secundário / Não Baixar Quando For Subnível
		llBxS = .f.
	EndIf

	Dope = TmpOpe.Dopes
	Nume = Val( Right( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 6) )
	lcBusca = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + Dope + Str(Nume,6)
	
	lcSql = [Select Dopes, AgdAutos from SigOpCdc Where Dopes = ']+TmpOpe.Dopes+[']
	LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'TmpdcOpe')
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (SigOpCdc 10)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	If crSigOpCdd.SubnItBxs = 1 And Not Seek(lcBusca,'crSigBxEst','EmpDopNumb')
		Loop
	EndIf

	Insert Into crSigMvPec ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, Datatrans, ValoBxs, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, EmpSubns, Datas, ValVars) ;
			Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, TmpOperacao.Codigos, ;
					 Nvl(TprMvCab.DataTrans,Ctod('')), TmpOperacao.ValoBxs, ;
					 TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), ;
					 TmpOperacao.EmpSubns, _pData, TmpOperacao.ValVars)

	lcSql = [Select ValoBxs, ChkSubn, DtAlts, Valos, ChkPagos, PrazoEnts, DtAgends, dtAudits, Auditors, ]+;
			[UsuPagos, Nemps, Utilizados From SigMvCab Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
	LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrTprMvCab')
	If lnErro < 1 &&Or Reccount('CrTprMvCab') = 0
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCab-B)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select CrTprMvCab
	Go Top In CrTprMvCab
	If Eof([CrTprMvCab])
		Loop
	EndIf
	
	Replace CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs With crTprMvCab.ValoBxs + TmpOperacao.ValoBxs, DtAlts With _pData
	If _BaixaSns = 1 Or (  Not Empty(CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs) And CrTprMvCab.Valos = CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs ) And llBxS
		Replace CrTprMvCab.ChkSubn With .t. in CrTprMvCab
	EndIf
	If _BaixaPgs
		Replace CrTprMvCab.chkPagos With .t.,;
				CrTprMvCab.UsuPagos With Usuar in CrTprMvCab
	Else
		Replace TprMvCab.UsuPagos With Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.UsuPagos),CrTprMvCab.UsuPagos,TprMvCab.UsuPagos) in TprMvCab
	EndIf
	If TmpDcOpe.AgdAutos = 1
		Replace DtAgends With CrTprMvCab.PrazoEnts ,;
				DtAudits With _pData, ;
		        Auditors With Usuar in CrTprMvCab
	EndIf

	If crSigOpCdc.MarcUtils = 2
		Replace Utilizados With 1 in CrTprMvCab
	EndIf

	If crSigOpCdc.DdNfs = 1 And Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0
		lcSql = [Select Cgcs From SigCdEmp where Cemps = ']+TmpOperacao.EmpSubns+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrTmpEmp') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEmp)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		lcNemp = Alltrim(crSigMvNfi.Series)+'-'+Alltrim(crSigMvNfi.Cfis)+' '+Dtoc(crSigMvNfi.Emis)+' '+CrTmpEmp.Cgcs
		Replace Nemps With lcNemp In CrTprMvCab
	EndIf

	lcSubn2 = CrTprMvCab.ChkSubn
	If Not llBxS
		lcSubn2 = .f.
	EndIf
	
	DtAlt   = _pData
	llDtBx  = Iif(lcSubn2,TprMvCab.Datas,Null)
	lcPago2 = CrTprMvCab.chkPagos
	llDtAgd = crTprMvCab.DtAgends
	llDtAud = CrTprMvCab.DtAudits
	lcAudit = CrTprMvCab.Auditors
	lcUsPg  = CrTprMvCab.UsuPagos

	lcNemp  = Iif(_BaixaPgs And InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3),Alltrim(ThisForm.NoCaixa)+' '+Alltrim(TprMvCab.nCupoms),CrTprMvCab.Nemps)
	lnUtil  = CrTprMvCab.Utilizados
	
	lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set Valobxs = ]+Str(CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs,12,2)+[, DtAlts = ?DtAlt, ]+;
				[ChkSubn = ?lcSubN2, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, ChkPagos = ?lcPago2, DtAgends = ?llDtAgd, ]+;
				[DtAudits = ?llDtAud, Auditors = ']+lcAudit+[', ]+;
				[DataTrans = Null, UsuPagos = ?lcUsPg, Nemps = ?lcNemp, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv, ]+;
				[Utilizados = ]+Str(lnUtil)+[ ]+;
				Iif(Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3),[, CupFis = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1)+[ ],[ ])+;
				[Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[']

	LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 9)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcUpdate = [Update SigMvEte Set ChkSubn = ?lcSubn2 Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
		If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
			LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'',4)
			LnErro = 1
		Else
			LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
		EndIf
	Else
		LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	EndIf
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvEte )')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	If Seek(Substr(lcbusca,4,20),'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
		lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
		LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - Carrega_Estpe 1)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf

	Select TmpOperacao
EndScan

Select TmpDevol
Scan
	If !Empty(TmpDevol.Codigos)
		lnNDopes = Val( Left( Str( TmpDevol.Codigos, 10 ), 4 ) )
		If Not IsEmpty(lnNDopes) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','ndopes',lnNDopes)
			lcDopes = crSigCdOpe.Dopes
			Insert Into crSigOpDev ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, TpCodigos, EmpDopNums, Cidchaves  ) ;
					Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, TmpDevol.Codigos, lnCfgOpCrs, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds() )
			lnNumes = Val( Right( Str( TmpDevol.Codigos, 10 ), 6) )
			If lnCfgOpCrs = 1
				lcQuery = [Select EmpdopNums, dopes, CidChaves From SigMvCab Where EmpDopNums = ']+TprMvCab.Emps + lcDopes + Str( lnNumes, 6 )+[']
			Else
				If lnCfgOpCrs = 3
					lcQuery= [Select EmpDopNums, Dopes, CidChaves From SigMvCab Where Notas = ']+Transf(lnNumes,"@L 999999")+[' And Dopes = ']+lcDopes+[' ]
				Else
					Loop
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTprMvCab') > 0
				lcSubn = .t.
				ldDtAlt= _pData
				llDtBx = TprMvCab.Datas
				lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?lcSubn, DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where CidChaves = ']+CrTprMvCab.CidChaves+[']
				lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
				If LnErro < 1
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 10)')
					Return .f.
				EndIf

				If Seek(CrTprMvCab.Dopes,'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
					lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
					LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
					If lnErro < 1
						MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - Carrega_Estpe 2)')
						Return .f.
					EndIf
				EndIf
			Else
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_estpe (CrTprMvCab 10)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Select TmpDevol
EndScan

Select TmpTotal
Scan
	If !Empty(TmpTotal.Moeds) And (!Empty(TmpTotal.ValTots) Or !Empty(TmpTotal.ValItens) Or !Empty(TmpTotal.MoeVals))
		Insert Into crSigMvMov ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Moeds, ValTots, ValItens, ValDifs, ;
				PorcDifs, Tipos, Datatrans, Coefs, Teors, Qtdes, mObras, nSinals, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, DtAlts, MoeVals ) ;
			Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, TmpTotal.Moeds, ;
					 TmpTotal.ValTots, TmpTotal.ValItens, TmpTotal.ValDifs, TmpTotal.PorcDifs, ;
					 TmpTotal.Tipos, Nvl(TprMvCab.Datatrans,Ctod('')), TmpTotal.Coefs, TmpTotal.Teors, ;
					 TmpTotal.Qtdes, TmpTotal.mObras, TmpTotal.nSinals, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6),;
					 fUniqueIds(), _pData, TmpTotal.MoeVals )
	EndIf
EndScan

Select Distinct Grupos, Contas, CodSegs From TprMvCabV Into Cursor CsTprMvCabV

Select CsTprMvCabV
Scan
	If !Empty(Left(Contas,1))
		Insert Into crSigMvEtv( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Grupos, Contas, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, CodSegs ) ;
			Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, CsTprMvCabV.Grupos, ;
					CsTprMvCabV.Contas, TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), CsTprMvCabV.CodSegs ) &&TprMvCab.grvends
	EndIf
EndScan

Select TmpBarFin
Scan
	If Empty(nBarra1) Or Empty(nBarra2)
		Loop
	EndIf
		
	lcQryGer = [Select cEmps From SigCdEmp Where nEmps = ] + Str(TmpBarFin.nEmps,3)
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryGer, [csTmpEmp])

	lnCodigo = TmpBarFin.nDopes * 1000000 + TmpBarFin.nNumes

	Insert Into crSigMvPec ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, EmpSubns, Datas, nParcs, ValPs, VencPs) ;
			Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, lnCodigo, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), CsTmpEmp.cEmps, _pData,;
					TmpBarFin.nParcs, TmpBarFin.ValPs, TmpBarFin.VencPs)
EndScan

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carrega_par
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carrega_par
Local lcNCarnes, _Copia, GravChq, lcGrupos, lcContas, lcSGrupos, lcSContas, lcCheque
Local lcMoe, lnCotacao, lcOperChqEs, lcOperChqSs, _Hist, llCheque, lcLoteCart, llAlinea, _pDAta

oFormulario = Thisform.oModemEest

If Not (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
	Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.Caption = 'Aguarde. Processando Parcelas!!!'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Parcelas!!! ' Nowait
Endif

=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

lcquery = [Select a.Fpags,a.Contabs From SigOpFpo a Where a.Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,'LocalFpagO') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão - LocalfPagO')
	Return .F.
Endif
Select LocalFpagO
Index On Fpags Tag Fpags

_pDAta = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

lcOperChqEs = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.OperChqEs),crSigCdOpe.OperChqEs,'ENTRADA')
lcOperChqSs = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.OperChqSs),crSigCdOpe.OperChqSs,'DEPÓSITO')

If crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1
	_Grupo = TprMvCab.Grupods
	_Conta = TprMvCab.Contads
Else
	_Grupo = TprMvCab.Grupoos
	_Conta = TprMvCab.Contaos
Endif

If (crSigOpCdd.LanFinMats = 2) And !Empty(_Conta) And Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_Conta, [grupomats, contamats])
	If !Empty( CrTmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !Empty( CrTmpCli.ContaMats )
		_Grupo = CrTmpCli.GrupoMats
		_Conta = CrTmpCli.ContaMats
	Endif
Endif

Create Cursor csSigChLcq ( NumLotes N(8), Codigos C(15), ValTotChqSai N(12,2) )
Index On Codigos Tag Codigos

GravChq = crSigCdOpe.Cheqs
COper   = Iif( crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1, "E", "S" )
Thisform.ContaPar = 0
Select xPar
nrlotchq = .F.
nrlotcar = .F.
valtot = 0
vTotCC = 0
Scan
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags, [infos, emichqs,ValPends ])
	If GravChq = 1 And crSigOpFp.infos = "C"  And !Empty(bancos) And crSigOpFp.EmiChqs # 1
		nrlotchq = .T.
	Endif
	valtot=valtot+xPar.valos
	vTotCC = vTotCC + xPar.valos
Endscan

Select TprMvCab
Scatter Memvar Memo

Store 0 To ValTotChq, vLote
Store 0 To vLoteSai
cabec=.T.

Select xPar
Update xPar Set Totccs = vTotCC
Go Top In xPar

* Richard Em 29/08/2012 - Se Não Tem Parcelas, Mas Lança CC Sem Pagamento/Recebimento e
* Não Tem Pendências Financeiras Vai Lançar a Conta Corrente Apenas para Contabilização
If Eof([xPar]) And (crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 2) And (crSigCdOpe.ParContas = 3) And (crSigCdOpe.Valpends = 2) And ;
		(crSigCdOpe.OpPends = 2) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.CMoes)

	* Richard em 11/12/2012 - Para Criar Numeração Correta de Títulos
	If Empty(Thisform.NumeraTitulo)
		Thisform.NumeraTitulo = Thisform.GeraNrTitulo(TprMvCab.Notas, [])
	Endif

	lnVOper = Thisform.ContaCorrente(.T.)
	If lnVOper = -1
		Return .F.
	Endif
Endif

If Not Eof([xPar]) And (crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 2) And (crSigCdOpe.ParContas = 2) And (crSigCdOpe.caixas = 2)
	Return .T.
Endif


Select xPar
Scan
	If !Empty( xPar.Fpags )
		lcNCarnes = ''
		Thisform.ContaPar = Thisform.ContaPar + 1
		=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
		If crSigOpFp.Valpends # 1
			Replace xPar.VPags With xPar.valos In xPar
		Else
			Replace xPar.VPags With 0 In xPar
		Endif

		If crSigOpFp.EmiVales = 1
			If crSigOpFp.EmiVales = 1 And ;
					(( crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 2 And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.NopCrs) ) Or crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 8 )

				=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','CsTmpCred','Dopes',crSigCdOpe.NopCrs,[EmpOpCrs])
				lcEmpOpCr = Iif(Not Empty(CsTmpCred.EmpOpCrs),CsTmpCred.EmpOpCrs,TprMvCab.Emps)

				If crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 8
					lcNCarnes = xPar.nCarnes
					m.Numes = Val(xPar.nCarnes)
					m.Dopes = crSigCdOpe.NopCrs
					m.empDopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.Dopes  + Str(m.Numes,6)
					lcSql = [Select EmpdopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpdopNums = ']+m.empDopNums+[']
					If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrEest') < 1
						Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( creest)')
						Return .F.
					Else
						If Reccount('CrEest') > 0
							Messagebox('Movimentação '+m.empDopNums+' já Existe!!!',0+16,'Bonus já utilizado')
							Return .F.
						Endif
					Endif
				Else
					llSaida = .F.
					Do While Not llSaida
						m.Numes = fGerUniqueKey(Alltrim(crSigCdOpe.NopCrs)+lcEmpOpCr)
						lcNCarnes = Alltrim(Str(m.Numes))
						m.empDopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.Dopes  + Str(m.Numes,6)
						lcSql = [Select EmpdopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpdopNums = ']+m.empDopNums+[']
						If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrEest') < 1
							Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão carrega_eesti( creest)')
							Return .F.
						Else
							If Reccount('CrEest') = 0
								llSaida = .T.
							Endif
						Endif
					Enddo
					Replace xPar.nCarnes With lcNCarnes In xPar
				Endif

				m.DGOpes = Padr(' ',20)
				m.Emps  = TprMvCab.Emps
				m.Utilizados = 1
				m.EmpdnCrds = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
				m.Codigos   = ( crSigCdOpe.nDopes * 1000000 ) + TprMvCab.Numes
				m.DtAlts = _pDAta
				m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
				m.Dopes = crSigCdOpe.NopCrs
				m.Numes = Val(lcNCarnes)
				m.MascNum = Alltrim( fGerMascara( m.Numes ) )
				m.EmpGopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.DGOpes + Str(m.Numes,6)
				m.empDopNums = lcEmpOpCr + m.Dopes  + Str(m.Numes,6)

				m.Vars = 0
				m.ValVars = 0
				m.ValVarps = 0
				m.Valinis = xPar.valos
				m.valos   = xPar.valos
				m.Notas = Transform(m.Numes,"@L 999999")
				Insert Into crSigMvCab From Memvar
				Replace Emps  With lcEmpOpCr ,;
					EmpDs With lcEmpOpCr  In crSigMvCab

				Insert Into crSigMvPec ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, empDopNums, CidChaves, EmpSubns, DataS) ;
					Values ( lcEmpOpCr, m.Dopes, m.Numes, m.Codigos, ;
					lcEmpOpCr+m.Dopes+Str(m.Numes,6), fUniqueIds(), m.Emps, _pDAta)
			Endif
		EndIf
		
		Insert Into crSigMvPar (Parcs, Agencias, bancos,cartaos,contas,DataS,datatrans,;
			Dopes,dpags,ec_numes,Emps,Fpags,numeros,Numes,outros,;
			valos,moefpgs,cotfpgs,cotusus,vencs,VPags,nCarnes,numolds,;
			nrecs,nocreditos,dtdeps,numchqs,ncarts,impcars,dcarts,cotusus,obs,;
			cnNsuParcs,cnIdTefs,nidcheps,inschs,CidChaves,empDopNums,DtAlts,Pagos,;
			DigAgencs, DigContas, digChqs, Pracas, cpfs, tparcs, ValDescs, CodBcrts,;
			vIrf, vPis, vCofins, vcsll, Vlrtrbfs, Nsu, Autoriza, Adquirente ) ;
			values (xPar.Parcs, xPar.Agencias, xPar.bancos, xPar.cartaos, xPar.contas, xPar.DataS, ;
			xPar.datatrans, TprMvCab.Dopes, xPar.dpags, xPar.ec_numes, TprMvCab.Emps, ;
			xPar.Fpags, xPar.numeros, TprMvCab.Numes, xPar.outros, xPar.valos, xPar.moefpgs, ;
			xPar.cotfpgs, xPar.cotusus, xPar.vencs, xPar.VPags, xPar.nCarnes, xPar.numolds, ;
			xPar.nrecs, xPar.nocreditos, xPar.dtdeps, xPar.numchqs, xPar.ncarts, ;
			xPar.impcars, xPar.dcarts, xPar.cotusus, xPar.obs,;
			xPar.cnNsuParcs,xPar.cnIdTefs,xPar.nidcheps,xPar.inschs,fUniqueIds(), ;
			TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6),_pDAta,;
			Iif(xPar.valos=xPar.VPags,'0','1'), xPar.DigAgencs, xPar.DigContas, xPar.digChqs, ;
			xPar.Pracas, xPar.cpfs, xPar.tparcs, xPar.ValDescs, xPar.CodBcrts,;
			xPar.vIrf, xPar.vPis, xPar.vCofins, xPar.vcsll, xPar.Vlrtrbfs, xPar.Nsu, xPar.Autoriza, xPar.Adquirente )

		If Thisform.pAbreGaveta And crSigOpFp.Gavetas = 1
			AbreGaveta(oFormulario)
		Else
			If Thisform.pGavetaSerial And crSigOpFp.Gavetas = 1
				=fAtivarSerial(CfComGVTS.Portas)
			Endif
		Endif

		llCheque = .F.
		Do Case
		Case Inlist(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3) And COper = 'E' And ( GravChq = 1 ) And ( crSigOpFp.infos = "C" ) ;
				And ( crSigOpFp.Trocos # 1 ) And !Empty(bancos) And ( crSigOpFp.EmiChqs # 1 )

			llAcuVlrChe = .F.
			llLncCheque = .T.
			llAltCheque = .F.
			llAltVlrChe = .T.
			
			Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery([SigOpCdd],[crTmpOpp],[Dopes],crSigCdOpe.Dopes,[AcmVlrCheq])

			If crTmpOpp.AcmVlrCheq = 1
				
*!*					lcquery = [Select EmpDopNums From SigMvPar ] + ;
*!*						[where bancos = ']+xPar.bancos+[' ] + ;
*!*						[and Agencias = ']+xPar.Agencias+[' ] + ;
*!*						[and contas = ']+xPar.contas+[' ] + ;
*!*						[and numeros = ']+xPar.numeros+[' ] + ;
*!*						[and empdopnums = ']+xPar.empdopnums+[' ]

*!*					If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,[TmpChePar]) < 1
*!*						Messagebox([Favor Reiniciar o Processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (TmpChePar)])
*!*						Return .F.
*!*					Endif
				
*!*					Select crSigMvPar
*!*					Locate for .F.
				
*!*					Select xPar
*!*					Locate for .F.
*!*					
*!*					Select a.Empdopnums ;
*!*					From crSigMvPar a, xPar b ;
*!*					Where a.Bancos = b.Bancos ;
*!*					And a.Agencias = b.Agencias ;
*!*					and a.Contas = b.Contas ;
*!*					And a.Numeros = b.Numeros ;
*!*					And a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums ;
*!*					Into Cursor TmpChePar ReadWrite
*!*					
*!*					Select TmpChePar
*!*					Go Top
*!*					If Reccount([TmpChePar])>0
*!*						llAltCheque = .T.
*!*					EndIf 
*!*					
*!*					Select xPar
*!*					Locate 

				Select xPar
				
				lcquery = [Select Nums From SigChe ] + ;
					[where bancos = ']+xPar.bancos+[' ] + ;
					[and agencias = ']+xPar.Agencias+[' ] + ;
					[and ncontas = ']+xPar.contas+[' ] + ;
					[and ncheques  = ']+xPar.numeros+[' ]

				If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,[TmpChe]) < 1
					Messagebox([Favor Reiniciar o Processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (TmpChe)])
					Return .F.
				Endif

				Select TmpChe
				Go Top
				If Reccount([TmpChe])>0
					
					If Not llAltCheque 
						lcMsg = [Cheque já Lançado Anteriormente.]+Chr(13)
						lcMsg = lcMsg + [Deseja Somar o Valor da Movimentação com o Total do Cheque?]
						lnResp = Messagebox(lcMsg,4+32,[Atenção])
					Else
						lnResp = 6
					EndIf 	
					
					If lnResp = 6

						llAcuVlrChe = .T.
						llAltVlrChe = .T.
						
						lcQuery = [Select * from SigChe where Nums = ']+TmpChe.Nums+[' ]
						If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[crSigChe]) < 1
							Messagebox([Favor Reiniciar o Processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (TmpChe)])
							Return .F.
						EndIf
						
						If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR'
							If crSigChe.Valors = xPar.Valos
								llAltVlrChe = .F.
							EndIf 
						EndIf 
						
						If llAltVlrChe
						
							Select crSigChe
							If llAltCheque 
								Replace valors With xPar.valos In crSigChe
							Else
								Replace valors With valors +  xPar.valos In crSigChe
							EndIf 

							lcquery = [select * from sigcqchm ] + ;
								[where bancos = ']+xPar.bancos+[' ] + ;
								[and agencias = ']+xPar.Agencias+[' ] + ;
								[and ncontas = ']+xPar.contas+[' ] + ;
								[and ncheques  = ']+xPar.numeros+[' ]

							If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,[crSigCqChm]) < 1
								Messagebox([Favor Reiniciar o Processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (crSigCqChm)])
								Return .F.
							Endif

							Select crSigCqChm
							If Reccount([crSigCqChm]) > 0
								Select crSigCqChm
								If llAltCheque 
									Replace valconvs With xPar.valos ,;
											valtots With xPar.valos In crSigCqChm
								Else
									Replace valconvs With valconvs + xPar.valos ,;
											valtots With valtots + xPar.valos In crSigCqChm
								EndIf 
								

								lcquery = [select valconvs, valtots, * from sigchlcq where numlotes = ]+Str(crSigCqChm.NumLotes)
								If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,[crSigChLcq]) < 1
									Messagebox([Favor Reiniciar o Processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (crSigChLcq)])
									Return .F.
								Endif
								Select crSigChLcq
								If Reccount([crSigChLcq]) > 0
									If llAltCheque 
										Replace valconvs With xPar.valos ,;
												valtots With xPar.valos In crSigChLcq
									Else
										Replace valconvs With valconvs + xPar.valos ,;
												valtots With valtots + xPar.valos In crSigChLcq
									EndIf 
									
								Endif
							EndIf
						EndIf 
					Else
						llLncCheque = .F.	
					Endif
				Endif
			EndIf
			
			Select xPar
			
			If Not llAcuVlrChe And llLncCheque
				If Empty(vLote)
					vLote = fGerUniqueKey('LOTECH')
				Endif
				ValTotChq = ValTotChq + xPar.valos
				_num = Trans(fGerUniqueKey('busnum'),"@L 99999999")
				Insert Into crSigChe (bancos, Agencias, ncontas, ncheques, valors, vencs, ;
					Nums, umovs, iclis, grclis, Autos, datatrans, Emps, Notas, ;
					Fpags, GruCarts, ConCarts, Grupos, contas, GruOrigs, ConOrigs, DataS, DtAlts ) ;
					values (xPar.bancos, xPar.Agencias, xPar.contas, xPar.numeros, xPar.valos, ;
					xPar.vencs, _num, lcOperChqEs, _Conta, _Grupo, .T., xPar.datatrans, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Notas, xPar.Fpags, crSigCdPam.GruCarts, ;
					crSigCdPam.ConCarts, crSigOpFp.Grupods, crSigOpFp.Contads, _Grupo, _Conta, ;
					TprMvCab.DataS, _pDAta)

				=fCriarCurSit(crSigChe.iclis)

				Insert Into crSigCqChm (dtents, dtsis, Codigos, moeds, cotas, valtots, ;
					valconvs, Nums, tipos, Usuarios, NumLotes, Emps, Dopes, numDopes, ;
					autos, datatrans, iclis, grclis, bancos, Agencias, ncontas, ncheques, ;
					GruCarts, ConCarts, Grupos, contas, GruOrigs, ConOrigs, empDopNums, CidChaves) ;
					values (TprMvCab.DataS, _pDAta, lcOperChqEs, xPar.moefpgs, 1, ;
					xPar.valos, xPar.valos, _num, "DB", usuar, vLote, TprMvCab.Emps,;
					TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,.T.,xPar.datatrans,_Conta, _Grupo,;
					xPar.bancos,xPar.Agencias,xPar.contas,xPar.numeros, ;
					crSigCdPam.GruCarts, crSigCdPam.ConCarts, crSigOpFp.Grupods, crSigOpFp.Contads, ;
					_Grupo, _Conta, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds() )

				llCheque = .T.

				Select crSigChLcq
				Locate For NumLotes = vLote
				If Eof()
					Insert Into crSigChLcq (dtents, dtsis, Codigos, Nums, tipos, Usuarios, ;
						NumLotes, Emps, Dopes, moeds, cotas, numDopes, Autos, datatrans, ;
						iclis, grclis, valtots, valconvs, GruCarts, ConCarts, GruOrigs, ;
						ConOrigs, empDopNums) ;
						values (TprMvCab.DataS, _pDAta, lcOperChqEs, _num, "DB", usuar, vLote, ;
						xPar.Emps, xPar.Dopes, xPar.moefpgs, 1, TprMvCab.Numes, .T., ;
						xPar.datatrans, _Conta, _Grupo, ValTotChq, ValTotChq, ;
						crSigCdPam.GruCarts, crSigCdPam.ConCarts, _Grupo, _Conta, ;
						TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )
				Else
					Replace crSigChLcq.valtots  With ValTotChq ;
						crSigChLcq.valconvs With ValTotChq
				Endif

				If !IsEmpty(xPar.obs)
					Select crSigCheH
					Append Blank

					lcHis = Left(xPar.obs,76)
					lcHi2 = []
					If (crSigOpFp.TpHists = 4)
						lcHis = TprMvCab.Notas + [ CHQ: ] + xPar.bancos + [/] + xPar.Agencias + [/] + xPar.contas + ;
							[/] + xPar.numeros
						lcHi2 = [CPF: ] + xPar.cpfs
					Endif

*!*						Replace Nums  With crSigChe.Nums,;
*!*							Datas With crSigChLcq.dtents,;
*!*							Hists With lcHis,;
*!*							Hist2s With lcHi2,;
*!*							autos With .T.,;
*!*							NumLotes With crSigChLcq.NumLotes,;
*!*							Emps  With Thisform.pEmps,;
*!*							CidChaves With fUniqueIds()
				
					Replace Nums  With crSigChe.Nums,;
						Datas With crSigChLcq.dtents,;
						Hists With lcHis,;
						autos With .T.,;
						NumLotes With crSigChLcq.NumLotes,;
						Emps  With Thisform.pEmps,;
						CidChaves With fUniqueIds()
				Endif
			EndIf
			
		Case Inlist(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3) And crSigOpFp.infos = "T" And !Empty(xPar.nocreditos) And ;
				( (COper = 'E' And crSigOpFp.Trocos # 1) Or (COper='S' And crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1) )
			*- Nr. lote e nr cartao -*
			NLoteC = Str( fGerUniqueKey('nlotecs'),10)
			NCart  = fGerUniqueKey('ncarts')

			Insert Into crSigCdCar ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, DataS, Fpags, NLoteCs, iclis, CidChaves, empDopNums );
				Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, TprMvCab.DataS, ;
				xPar.dcarts, NLoteC, _Conta, fUniqueIds(), TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )

			Insert Into crSigCdCtt (Parcs, Emps, Dopes, Numes, DataS, datatrans,;
				cartaos, nocreditos, Fpags, valos, ncarts, NLoteCs, ;
				Notas, Taxas, iclis, empDopNums, CidChaves) ;
				Values ( xPar.Parcs, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, TprMvCab.DataS, ;
				TprMvCab.datatrans, xPar.cartaos, xPar.nocreditos, xPar.dcarts, xPar.valos, ;
				NCart, NLoteC, TprMvCab.Notas, crSigOpFp.Desc2s, _Conta, ;
				TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds() )

			If crSigOpFp.CarAuts = 'S'
				Insert Into crSigCdCrd ( Parcs, Numes, Dt_Deposit, datatrans, Fpags,;
					NoResumos, Recebidos, valos, TotRes, vencs, ;
					Vr_Recebs, Emps, Dopes, cartaos, nocreditos, ;
					Datas, Parcs, CtCCs, CCons, Nmcos, Taxas, ncarts, ;
					Notas, NLoteCs, iclis, empDopNums, CidChaves );
					Values ( xPar.Parcs, crSigCdCtt.Numes, xPar.vencs, ;
					crSigCdCtt.datatrans, crSigCdCtt.Fpags, crSigCdCtt.nocreditos, ;
					xPar.vencs, xPar.valos, xPar.valos, xPar.vencs, ;
					xPar.valos, crSigCdCtt.Emps, crSigCdCtt.Dopes, ;
					crSigCdCtt.cartaos, crSigCdCtt.nocreditos, crSigCdCtt.DataS, ;
					crSigCdCtt.Parcs, crSigOpFp.Grupods, crSigOpFp.Contads, ;
					crSigCdCtt.Nmcos, crSigCdCtt.Taxas, crSigCdCtt.ncarts, ;
					crSigCdCtt.Notas, NLoteC, _Conta, ;
					crSigCdCtt.Emps + crSigCdCtt.Dopes + Str(crSigCdCtt.Numes,6), fUniqueIds() )

				Select crSigCdCtt
				Replace NoResumos  With xPar.nocreditos ;
					vencs      With xPar.vencs ;
					Dt_Deposit With xPar.vencs ;
					CtCCs      With crSigOpFp.Grupods ;
					CCons      With crSigOpFp.Contads
			Endif

			Select crSigMvPar
			Replace ncarts With NCart, DtAlts With _pDAta

		Case Inlist(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3) And crSigOpFp.infos = 'C' And COper = 'S' And !IsEmpty(xPar.bancos) And ;
				( crSigOpFp.EmiChqs = 1 )
			_ChaveChi = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )

			=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCqChi','CrChi','nCheques',xPar.numeros)
			Select CrChi
			Index On bancos + Agencias + ncontas + ncheques Tag Cheque
			If Seek(xPar.bancos + xPar.Agencias + xPar.contas + xPar.numeros)
				Scatter Memvar Memo
				Select crSigCqChi
				Locate For bancos + Agencias + ncontas + ncheques  = xPar.bancos + xPar.Agencias + xPar.contas + xPar.numeros
				If Eof()
					Append Blank
					Gather Memvar Memo
				Endif
			Else
				Select crSigCqChi
				Locate For bancos + Agencias + ncontas + ncheques  = xPar.bancos + xPar.Agencias + xPar.contas + xPar.numeros
				If Eof()
					_Copia = fGerUniqueKey( "COPIA DE CHEQUE" + TprMvCab.Emps )
					Replace crSigMvPar.NCopias With _Copia, crSigMvPar.DtAlts With _pDAta In crSigMvPar
					Insert Into crSigCqChi ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, DataS, bancos, Agencias, ;
						ncontas, ncheques, valors, vencs, NCopias, Cancelas, ;
						Emitidos, Grupos, contas, empDopNums ) ;
						Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, TprMvCab.DataS,;
						xPar.bancos, xPar.Agencias, xPar.contas, xPar.numeros, ;
						xPar.valos, xPar.vencs, _Copia, .F., .F., crSigOpFp.Grupods, crSigOpFp.Contads, ;
						TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )
				Endif
			Endif
			If crSigCqChi.Emitidos
				Replace crSigCqChi.Cancelas With .F. In crSigCqChi
			Endif

		Case crSigOpFp.infos = 'C' And GravChq = 1 And ( (COper = 'E' And crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1 ) Or ;
				( COper = 'S' And crSigOpFp.Trocos # 1) ) And !IsEmpty(xPar.bancos) And ;
				( crSigOpFp.EmiChqs # 1 And Empty(crSigOpFp.OperAutos) ) Or ;
				( Not Empty(xPar.numchqs) And Empty(xPar.bancos) And Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigChe','CrTmpChe','Nums',xPar.numchqs))
			If Not Empty(xPar.numchqs) And Empty(xPar.bancos)
				lcCheque = CrTmpChe.bancos + CrTmpChe.Agencias + CrTmpChe.ncontas + CrTmpChe.ncheques
				llAlinea = .T.
			Else
				llAlinea = .F.
				lcCheque = xPar.bancos + xPar.Agencias + xPar.contas + xPar.numeros

				If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvPar','CrPar','Numeros',xPar.numeros)
					Select CrPar
					Index On bancos + Agencias + contas + numeros Tag Cheque
					=Seek(xPar.bancos+xPar.Agencias+xPar.contas+xPar.numeros)
					lcpago = '0'
					lddata = _pDAta
					lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvPar Set Vpags = Valos, pagos=?lcpago, dtalts = ?ldData Where CidChaves = ']+CrPar.CidChaves+[']
					Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
				Endif

				=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigChe','CrTmpChe','Ncheques',xPar.numeros)
				Select CrTmpChe
				Index On bancos + Agencias + ncontas + ncheques Tag Cheque
				=Seek(xPar.bancos+xPar.Agencias+xPar.contas+xPar.numeros)

			Endif

			If llAlinea And Not IsEmpty(CrTmpChe.NAlineas) And ;
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdAli','CrTmpAlin','codigos',CrTmpChe.NAlineas) And !Empty(crTmpAlin.OpSaidas)

				lcUmov = CrTmpChe.umovs

				=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpt','crSigCdOpt')
				Select crSigCdOpt
				Index On Operacaos Tag Operacao
				Locate For Opants = lcUmov
				Do While !Eof()
					If crSigCdOpt.GeraNarqs = 1
						Exit
					Endif
					Continue
				Enddo

				If ! Eof() And crSigCdOpt.GeraNarqs = 1
					lcOperChqSs = crSigCdOpt.Operacaos
				Else
					lcOperChqSs = crTmpAlin.OpSaidas
				Endif

			Else
				lcOperChqSs = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.OperChqSs),crSigCdOpe.OperChqSs,'DEPÓSITO')
			Endif

			=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpt','crSigCdOpt','Operacaos',lcOperChqSs)

			lcUmov = lcOperChqSs
			ldDtalt= _pDAta
			lcUpdate = [UpDate SigChe Set Umovs = ?lcUmov, DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt Where Nums =']+CrTmpChe.Nums+[']
			Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')

			=fCriarCurSit(CrTmpChe.iclis)

			If crSigCdOpt.GeraNarqs = 1
				_Arq = fGerUniqueKey('CHEQUEARQUIVO')
				lcUpdate = [UpDate SigChe Set Numeros = ']+Transform(_Arq,'@L 999999')+[' Where Nums =']+CrTmpChe.Nums+[']
				Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
			Endif

			If Not Seek(lcOperChqSs,'csSigChLcq','Codigos')
				vLoteSai = fGerUniqueKey('LOTECH')
				Insert Into csSigChLcq (Codigos, NumLotes) Values ;
					(lcOperChqSs, vLoteSai)
			Else
				vLoteSai = csSigChLcq.NumLotes
			Endif
			Select csSigChLcq
			Replace csSigChLcq.ValTotChqSai With csSigChLcq.ValTotChqSai + xPar.valos

			_GrupoOrig = CrTmpChe.Grupos
			_ContaOrig = CrTmpChe.contas
			_GrupoDest = TprMvCab.Grupoos
			_ContaDest = TprMvCab.Contaos
			lcMoe    = crSigCdPam.MoedaCheqs
			lnCotacao  = Thisform.Cotacao(crSigCdPam.MoedaCheqs, TprMvCab.DataS)

			_Hist = TprMvCab.Emps + '-' + Alltrim(lcOperChqSs) + ' : ' + ;
				Alltrim( Str( vLoteSai, 8 ) ) + ' (' + ;
				Alltrim(Transf(xPar.valos,'999,999,999.99')) + ' ' + ;
				AllTrim(xPar.moefpgs) + ') '
			_His2 = []
			If (crSigOpFp.TpHists = 4)
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ CHQ: ] + xPar.bancos + [/] + xPar.Agencias + [/] + ;
					xPar.contas + [/] + xPar.numeros
				_His2 = [CPF: ] + xPar.cpfs
			Endif

			If Not IsEmpty(CrTmpChe.Fpags) And Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',CrTmpChe.Fpags)
				If crSigOpFp.Valpends = 1
					Declare lacampo(4,2)
					lacampo(1,1)='Bancos'
					lacampo(2,1)='Agencias'
					lacampo(3,1)='nContas'
					lacampo(4,1)='nCheques'
					lacampo(1,2)=xPar.bancos
					lacampo(2,2)=xPar.Agencias
					lacampo(3,2)=xPar.contas
					lacampo(4,2)=xPar.numeros
					If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdPbx','CrPrbx','ncheques',xPar.numeros)
						Select CrPrBx
						Scan For !Deposits And valos # 0 And bancos + Agencias + ncontas = xPar.bancos + xPar.Agencias + xPar.contas
							_Grupo2 = crSigCdPam.gruporecs
							_Conta2 = crSigCdPam.contarecs

							=Seek(CrPrBx.Fpags,'csSigOpFp','Fpags')

							_Grupo1 = Iif(csSigOpFp.Valpends=1,CrPrBx.Grupos,csSigOpFp.Grupods)
							_Conta1 = Iif(csSigOpFp.Valpends=1,CrPrBx.contas,csSigOpFp.Contads)
							_Opers  = Iif(crSigCdOpt.tipos='CR','D','C')
							_Sopers = Iif(crSigCdOpt.tipos='CR','C','D')
							If !Seek( CrPrBx.Moedas, 'TmpCot' )
								m.Moedas = SigCdPbx.Moedas
								m.valos  = Thisform.Cotacao( m.Moedas, TprMvCab.DataS )
								Insert Into TmpCot From Memvar
							Endif
							_Cot = TmpCot.valos
							_ValPags = Iif( CrPrBx.tipos = 'X', 0, CrPrBx.valos )

							_Noper = fGerUniqueKey('SigMvCcr')
							_CidChave = Dtos(crSigChLcq.dtents)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(crSigChLcq.dtents)),"@L 999999")+Thisform.Sigkey

							Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, Emps, DataS, usualts, datalts, Hists,Hist2s,;
								docus, opers, sopers, Moedas, cotacaos, valors, Autos, Grupos, contas, ;
								sgrupos, scontas, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, valpags, Dopes, Numes, ;
								CidChaves, empDopNums, Jobs ) ;
								Values ( _Noper, TprMvCab.Emps, crSigChLcq.dtents, usuar, _pDAta, ;
								_Hist, _His2,Str( _Noper, 9 ), _Opers, _Sopers, CrPrBx.Moedas, _Cot, ;
								CrPrBx.valos, .T., _Grupo1, _Conta1, _Grupo2, _Conta2, ;
								CrPrBx.Moedas, _Cot, CrPrBx.valos, _ValPags, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
								_CidChave, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs )
							Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes With cqSigMvCcr.Grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.Moedas,;
								cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
								cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1') ,;
								cqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    With cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + cqSigMvCcr.opers + cqSigMvCcr.tipos + cqSigMvCcr.Pagos In cqSigMvCcr

							=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.contas, cqSigMvCcr.DataS, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )

							Thisform.FazContra

							llDep = .T.
							lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdPbx Set Deposits = ?llDep Where CidChaves = ']+CrPrBx.CidChaves+[']
							lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
							If lnErro < 1
								Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdPbx)')
								Return .F.
							Endif
							_Dep = .F.

						Endscan
					Else
						_Opers    = 'DB'
						_Sopers   = 'CR'
						lcGrupos  = crSigCdPam.gruporecs
						lcContas  = crSigCdPam.contarecs
						lcSGrupos = CrTmpChe.Grupos
						lcSContas = CrTmpChe.contas
						_Hist = TprMvCab.Emps + '-' + Alltrim(lcOperChqSs) + ' : ' + ;
							Alltrim( Str( vLoteSai, 8 ) ) + ' (' + ;
							Alltrim(Transf(xPar.valos,'999,999,999.99')) + ' ' + ;
							AllTrim(xPar.moefpgs) + ') '
						_His2 = []
						If (crSigOpFp.TpHists = 4)
							_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ CHQ: ] + xPar.bancos + [/] + xPar.Agencias + [/] + ;
								xPar.contas + [/] + xPar.numeros
							_His2 = [CPF: ] + xPar.cpfs
						Endif

						_Noper = fGerUniqueKey('SigMvCcr')
						_CidChave = Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)),"@L 999999")+Thisform.Sigkey

						Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, Emps, DataS, usualts, datalts, Hists,Hist2s,;
							docus, opers, sopers, Moedas, cotacaos, valors, Autos, ;
							Grupos, contas, sgrupos, scontas, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, ;
							valpags, Dopes, Numes, CidChaves, empDopNums, Jobs ) ;
							Values ( _Noper, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.DataS, usuar, _pDAta, ;
							_Hist, _His2, Str( _Noper, 9 ), _Opers, _Sopers, lcMoe, ;
							lnCotacao, CrTmpChe.valors, .T., lcGrupos, lcContas, ;
							lcSGrupos, lcSContas, lcMoe, lnCotacao, CrTmpChe.valors, ;
							CrTmpChe.valors, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, _CidChave,;
							TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs )
						Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes With cqSigMvCcr.Grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.Moedas,;
							cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
							cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1') ,;
							cqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    With cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + cqSigMvCcr.opers + cqSigMvCcr.tipos + cqSigMvCcr.Pagos In cqSigMvCcr

						=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.contas, cqSigMvCcr.DataS, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )

						Thisform.FazContra

						_Opers    = 'DB'
						_Sopers   = 'CR'
						lcGrupos  = TprMvCab.Grupoos
						lcContas  = TprMvCab.Contaos
						lcSGrupos = CrTmpChe.GruOrigs
						lcSContas = CrTmpChe.ConOrigs

						_Noper = fGerUniqueKey('SigMvCcr')
						_CidChave = Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)),"@L 999999")+Thisform.Sigkey

						Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, Emps, DataS, usualts, datalts, Hists,Hist2s,;
							docus, opers, sopers, Moedas, cotacaos, valors, Autos, ;
							Grupos, contas, sgrupos, scontas, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, ;
							valpags, Dopes, Numes, CidChaves, empDopNums, Jobs ) ;
							Values ( _Noper, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.DataS, usuar, _pDAta, ;
							_Hist,_His2, Str( _Noper, 9 ), _Opers, _Sopers, lcMoe, ;
							lnCotacao, CrTmpChe.valors, .T., lcGrupos, lcContas, ;
							lcSGrupos, lcSContas, lcMoe, lnCotacao, CrTmpChe.valors, ;
							CrTmpChe.valors, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, _CidChave, ;
							TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs )
						Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes With cqSigMvCcr.Grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.Moedas,;
							cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
							cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1') ,;
							cqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    With cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + cqSigMvCcr.opers + cqSigMvCcr.tipos + cqSigMvCcr.Pagos In cqSigMvCcr

						=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.contas, cqSigMvCcr.DataS, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )

						Thisform.FazContra

					Endif
				Endif
			Endif

			_num = CrTmpChe.Nums

			If Not Empty(_num) And GravChq = 1
				=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)

				Insert Into crSigCqChm ( dtents, dtsis, Codigos, Nums, tipos, Usuarios, ;
					NumLotes, Emps, Dopes, numDopes, Autos, Grupos, contas, ;
					grclis, iclis, bancos, Agencias, ncontas, ncheques, ;
					GruOrigs, ConOrigs, moeds, cotas, GruCarts, ConCarts, numeros,empDopNums,CidChaves ) ;
					Values ( TprMvCab.DataS, _pDAta, lcOperChqSs, _num, 'CR', ;
					usuar, vLoteSai, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
					.T., crSigOpFp.Grupods, crSigOpFp.Contads, CrTmpChe.grclis, CrTmpChe.iclis, ;
					CrTmpChe.bancos, CrTmpChe.Agencias, CrTmpChe.ncontas, CrTmpChe.ncheques, ;
					CrTmpChe.GruOrigs, CrTmpChe.ConOrigs, crSigCdPam.MoedaCheqs, ;
					fBuscarCotacao(crSigCdPam.MoedaCheqs, TprMvCab.DataS, Thisform.poDataMgr), ;
					crSigCdPam.GruCarts, crSigCdPam.ConCarts, CrTmpChe.numeros, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), fUniqueIds() )

				ldDtalt = _pDAta
				lcUpdate = [UpDate SigChe Set Grupos = ']+crSigOpFp.Grupods+[', Contas = ']+crSigOpFp.Contads+[', ]+;
					[GruCarts = ']+crSigCdPam.GruCarts+[', ConCarts = ']+crSigCdPam.ConCarts+[', DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt ]+;
					[ Where Nums =']+CrTmpChe.Nums+[']

				Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')

				llCheque = .T.

				Select crSigChLcq
				Locate For NumLotes = vLoteSai
				If Eof()
					Insert Into crSigChLcq ( dtents, dtsis, Codigos, Nums, tipos, Usuarios, ;
						NumLotes, Emps, Dopes, numDopes, Autos, Grupos, contas, ;
						grclis, iclis, moeds, valtots, valconvs, GruCarts, ConCarts, empDopNums ) ;
						Values ( TprMvCab.DataS, _pDAta, lcOperChqSs, _num, 'CR', usuar, ;
						vLoteSai, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, .T., ;
						crSigOpFp.Grupods, crSigOpFp.Contads, CrTmpChe.grclis, CrTmpChe.iclis, ;
						crSigOpFp.moefpgs, csSigChLcq.ValTotChqSai, csSigChLcq.ValTotChqSai, ;
						crSigCdPam.GruCarts, crSigCdPam.ConCarts, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )
				Else
					Replace crSigChLcq.valtots  With csSigChLcq.ValTotChqSai, ;
						crSigChLcq.valconvs With csSigChLcq.ValTotChqSai In crSigChLcq
				Endif
				=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
			Endif

		Case crSigOpFp.infos = 'T' And xPar.inschs And ;
				( (COper = 'E' And crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1) Or (COper = 'S' And crSigOpFp.Trocos # 1) )
			If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCtt','CrTmpCart','nCarts',xPar.ncarts)
				lcLoteCart = crtmpCart.Emps + crtmpCart.NLoteCs
				_Hist = Alltrim(TprMvCab.Emps) + '-' + ;
					AllTrim(TprMvCab.Dopes) + '-' + Alltrim(TprMvCab.MascNum) + ' ' + ;
					DToC(TprMvCab.DataS) + ' ' + Alltrim(TprMvCab.Usuars)

				lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdCtt Set Obses = ']+_Hist+[' Where CidChaves = ']+crtmpCart.CidChaves+[']

				=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')

				If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCrd','CrTmpCard','nCarts',xPar.ncarts)
					lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdCrd Set TotPar = TotRes Where CidChaves = ']+CrTmpCard.CidChaves+[']
				Else
					lDtVenc = Iif(!IsEmpty(TprMvCab.DataS),TprMvCab.DataS,Null)
					lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdCtt Set Vencs = ?lDtVenc Where CidChaves = ']+crtmpCart.CidChaves+[']
				Endif

				=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')

				lcquery  =  [Select * From SigCdCar ]+;
					[Where Emps = ']+crtmpCart.Emps+[' And nlotecs = ']+crtmpCart.NLoteCs+[' ]
				=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,'CrTmpCar')
				If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And CrTmpcar.Utilizados = 0
					If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCar','CrTmpCar','nlotecs',crtmpCart.NLoteCs)
						Select CrTmpcar
						Index On Emps Tag Emps
						If Seek(crtmpCart.Emps)
							lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdCar Set Utilizados = ]+Str(1,1)+[ Where CidChaves = ']+CrTmpcar.CidChaves+[']
							=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
		Endcase

		=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
		If crSigCdOpe.Caixas = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
			If Seek(xPar.Fpags,'LocalFPagO') And LocalFpagO.Contabs  = 1
				Loop
			Endif

			* Richard em 11/12/2012 - Para Criar Numeração Correta de Títulos
			If Empty(Thisform.NumeraTitulo)
				Thisform.NumeraTitulo = Thisform.GeraNrTitulo(TprMvCab.Notas, xPar.Fpags)
			Endif

			If llCheque
				lnVOper = Iif(crSigOpFp.OriDes=4,Thisform.ContacorrenteOp(.T.),Thisform.ContaCorrente( .T. ))
				If lnVOper = -1
					Return .F.
				Endif
				Select crSigCqChm
				Replace crSigCqChm.Numos With lnVOper
			Else
				lnVOper = Iif(crSigOpFp.OriDes=4,Thisform.ContacorrenteOp(),Thisform.ContaCorrente())
				If Not lnVOper
					Return .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
	Endif
	Select xPar
Endscan

If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigCdOpe.CfgFinancs, 2, 1))) = 1)
	&& Inibir Lançamentos de Mão de Obra da Movimentação - Configuração em SIGOPFIN
	&& Richard em 25/03/2014 - Configurações Financeiras das Movimentações

	If crSigCdOpe.Caixas = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3) And crSigCdOpe.Calcmos = 1 And !IsEmpty(crSigCdPam.GrpMos)
		Select TmpTotal
		Scan
			lnCota = Thisform.Cotacao( TmpTotal.moeds )
			lnCota2= Thisform.Cotacao( crSigCdPam.MoeMos )
			lnValDIf = TmpTotal.mObras
			If lnValDIf > 0
				_doc = Transf( crSigCdOpe.nDopes,"@L 999" ) + Transf( TprMvCab.Numes, "@L 999999" )
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Emps + " " + Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes ) + " " + Alltrim( fGerMascara( TprMvCab.Numes ) ) + " ( M.O. )"
				_Noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SigMvCcr' )
				_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( Str( _Noper, 9 ) )
				_numc = 0
				_dopc = ''
				lnValor = lnValDIf
				lnsValor= lnValor
				moep1 = TmpTotal.moeds
				moep2 = crSigCdPam.MoeMos
				_GrupoOrig = _Grupo
				_ContaOrig = _Conta
				_GrupoDest = crSigCdPam.GrpMos
				_ContaDest = crSigCdPam.CtoMos

				If TmpTotal.moeds # crSigCdPam.MoeMos
					lnsValor = Round(lnValor * lnCota / lnCota2,2)
				Endif

				xoper  = 'C'
				xsoper = 'D'

				_Hist2 = 'M.O. FORN:'+Alltrim(_Conta)+"  "+Alltrim(Transf(TmpTotal.Qtdes,"@Z 999,999.99"))+"x"+;
					Alltrim(Transf(TmpTotal.Coefs,"@z 99.999"))
				_CidChave = Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)),"@L 999999")+Thisform.Sigkey

				Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, VOpers, docus, Emps, DataS, usualts, datalts, vencs, Hists,;
					opers, sopers, Moedas, cotacaos, valors, Autos, Grupos, contas, sgrupos, scontas, ;
					smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, Dopes, Numes, valpags,	Dopcs, Numcs, nfs, titulos,;
					grupems, contems, grupages, contages, valliqs, dtemis, Hist2s, CidChaves, empDopNums, Jobs ) ;
					Values ( _Noper, _voper, _doc, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.DataS, usuar, _pDAta, TprMvCab.DataS, ;
					_Hist, xoper, xsoper, moep1, lnCota, lnValor, .T., ;
					_GrupoOrig, _ContaOrig, _GrupoDest, _ContaDest, ;
					moep2, lnCota2, lnsValor, ;
					TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, lnValor,_dopc, _numc, ;
					TprMvCab.Notas, Alltrim( TprMvCab.Notas ) + '/' + Alltrim( Str( Thisform.ContaPar ) ),;
					_GrupoOrig, _ContaOrig, ' ', ' ', lnValor, ;
					TprMvCab.dtemis, _Hist2, _CidChave, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs )
				Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes With cqSigMvCcr.Grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.Moedas,;
					cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
					cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1') ,;
					cqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    With cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + cqSigMvCcr.opers + cqSigMvCcr.tipos + cqSigMvCcr.Pagos In cqSigMvCcr

				=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.contas, cqSigMvCcr.DataS, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )

				_CidChave = Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(TprMvCab.DataS)),"@L 999999")+Thisform.Sigkey
				Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, VOpers, docus, Emps, DataS, usualts, datalts, vencs, Hists,;
					sopers, opers, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, Autos, sgrupos, scontas, ;
					Grupos, contas, Moedas, cotacaos, valors, Dopes, Numes, valpags,;
					Dopcs, Numcs, nfs, titulos,;
					grupems, contems, grupages, contages, valliqs, dtemis, Hist2s, CidChaves, empDopNums, Jobs ) ;
					Values ( _Noper, _voper, _doc, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.DataS, usuar, _pDAta, TprMvCab.DataS, ;
					_Hist, xoper, xsoper, moep1, lnCota, lnValor, .T., ;
					_GrupoOrig, _ContaOrig, _GrupoDest, _ContaDest, ;
					moep2, lnCota2, lnsValor, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, lnsValor,;
					_dopc, _numc, TprMvCab.Notas, Alltrim( TprMvCab.Notas ) + '/' + Alltrim( Str( Thisform.ContaPar ) ),;
					_GrupoDest, _ContaDest, ' ', ' ', lnsValor, ;
					TprMvCab.dtemis, _Hist2, _CidChave, TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs )
				Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes With cqSigMvCcr.Grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.Moedas,;
					cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
					cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1') ,;
					cqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    With cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + cqSigMvCcr.opers + cqSigMvCcr.tipos + cqSigMvCcr.Pagos In cqSigMvCcr

				=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.contas, cqSigMvCcr.DataS, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )

			Endif
		Endscan
	Endif
Endif

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE carrega_vsubn
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE carrega_vsubn
Lparameters pExclusao

Local _Posicao, _pdata

lcSql = [Select RecvSubs From SigOpCdd Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.dopes+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalOpe2') < 1 
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (LocalOpe2 - Carrega_vsubn)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

If LocalOpe2.RecvSubs <> 1 Or crSigOpCdc.nGraSubs = 1
	Return .t.
EndIf

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde.......'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Recalculando Sub-Niveis!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

_pData  = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

Select TprMvCab
_Posicao = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )

Select [ ] as Agrupar, Sum(Totas) as Totas From crTpmMvItn Where nCodigos <> 0 ;
Into Cursor TotITg Group by 1

Select TmpOperacao
Scan
	If Codigos = 0
		Loop
	EndIf
	
	lcSql = [Select dopes from SigCdOpe Where Ndopes = ]+Str(Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos,10),4)))
	LnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'TmpOpe')
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (SigCdOpe 10)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Dope = TmpOpe.Dopes
	Nume = Val( Right( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 6) )
	lcBusca = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + Dope + Str(Nume,6)
	
	Select [ ] as Agrupar, Sum(ValRats) as ValRats, Sum(Totas) as Totas From crTpmMvItn Where nCodigos = TmpOperacao.Codigos ;
	Into Cursor TotIT Group by 1
	
	xValRat = ( ( TprMvCab.VlrFrts + TprMvCab.VlrDacs ) +  ( TotIt.ValRats * -1 ) ) * -1
	xValRat = ( ( TotIt.Totas / TotItg.totas * TprMvCab.ValVars ) )

	If xValRat = TmpOperacao.ValVars
		Loop
	EndIf
	
	lcSql = [Select * From SigMvCab Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TprMvCabSB') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (TprMvCabSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	lcSql = [Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'crTpmMvItnSB') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crTpmMvItnSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcSql = [Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'xEsti2SB') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crTpmMvItnSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select xEsti2SB
	Index on cItens tag cItens

	lcSql = [Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'xParSB') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (xparSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcSql = [Select * From SigMvNfi Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'SigMvNfiSB') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (SigMvNfiSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	If pExclusao
		Replace Valos   With Valos - ValVars + TmpOperacao.ValVars ,;
				ValVars With TmpOperacao.ValVars,;
				Vars    With iif(TprMvCabSB.ValInis # 0,Round(TmpOperacao.ValVars/TprMvCabSB.ValInis*100,4),0) In TprMvCabSB
	Else
		Replace Valos   With Valos - TmpOperacao.ValVars + xValRat ,;
				ValVars With xValRat,;
				Vars    With iif(TprMvCabSB.ValInis # 0,Round(xValRat/TprMvCabSB.ValInis*100,4),0) In TprMvCabSB
	EndIf
	
	_Moeda  = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, Iif( Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )
	CotOper = ThisForm.Cotacao( _Moeda )

	lnValPar = ThisForm.CalculaPar('xParSB')
	lnTotOpe = (TprMvCabSB.Valos * CotOper )
	If lnValPar # lnTotOpe
		lnPerct  = lnTotOpe / LnValPar
		xTotPar = 0
		Select xParSB
		Scan
			Replace Valos with Valos * lnPerct
			xTotPar = xTotPar + ( Valos * xparSB.Cotfpgs / CotOper )
		EndScan
		If xTotPar <> lntotOpe
			Go bott
			xDif = ((lnTotOpe - xTotPar ) * CotOper  / xParSB.Cotfpgs )
			Replace Valos With Valos + xDif in xParSB
		EndIf
	EndIf

	=ThisForm.Procrateio('TprMvCabSB','crTpmMvItnSB','SigMvNfiSB')
	=ThisForm.Procrateio2('TprMvCabSB','crTpmMvItnSB','SigMvNfiSB')
	=fCalcularImpostos(0,ThisForm.poDataMgr,'TprMvCabSB','crTpmMvItnSB','xEsti2SB','SigMvNfiSB',SigMvNfiSB.VlFretes,SigMvNfiSB.VlSeguros,.f.,.f.,.f.,.t.,SigMvNfiSB.DespAces)

	Select TprMvCabSB
	Go Top
	Scatter Fields Valos, ValVars, Vars, CidChaves Memvar
	lcSql = [Update SigMvCab Set Valos = ]+Str(m.Valos,12,2)+[, ValVars = ]+Str(m.ValVars,12,2)+[, ]+;
			[Vars = ]+Str(m.Vars,10,4)+[ Where Cidchaves = ']+m.CidChaves+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha no Update (TprMvCabSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	Select SigMvNfiSB
	Go Top
	Scatter Memvar

	lcSql = [Update SigMvNfi Set TotProds = ]+Str(m.TotProds,12,2)+[, TotNotas = ]+Str(m.TotNotas,12,2)+[, ]+;
			[BasecIpis=]+Str(m.BasecIpis,12,2)+[, BasecIp2s=]+Str(m.BasecIp2s,12,2)+[, ]+;
			[BasecIp3s=]+Str(m.BasecIp3s,12,2)+[, BasecIcms=]+Str(m.Basecicms,12,2)+[, ]+;
			[BasecIc2s=]+Str(m.BasecIc2s,12,2)+[, BasecIc3s=]+Str(m.basecIc3s,12,2)+[, ]+;
			[ValIpis=]+Str(m.ValIpis,12,2)    +[, ValIcms=]+Str(m.ValIcms,12,2)+[, ]+;
			[BcIcmss=]+Str(m.BcIcmss,12,2)    +[, Icmss=]+Str(m.Icms,12,2)+[ ]+;
			[Where Cidchaves = ']+m.CidChaves+[' ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha no Update (SigMvNfiSB)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	Select xParSB
	Scan
		Scatter Fields valos, CidChaves Memvar
		lcSql = [Update SigMvPar Set Valos = ]+Str(m.Valos,12,2)+[ Where Cidchaves = ']+m.CidChaves+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha no Update (xParSB)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndScan
	
	Select crTpmMvItnSB
	Scan
		Scatter Fields Unit2s,ValRats,CidChaves,Icms,BaseIcms Memvar
		lcSql = [Update SigMvItn Set Unit2s = ]+Str(m.Unit2s,15,6)+[, ValRats = ]+Str(m.ValRats,15,6)+[, ]+;
				[BaseIcms = ]+Str(m.BaseIcms,12,2)+[, Icms = ]+Str(m.Icms,12,2)+[ ]+;
				[Where Cidchaves = ']+m.CidChaves+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha no Update (crTpmMvItnSB)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndScan
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE centralcred
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE centralcred
GrCli = crSigCdPam.GrPadClis
If crSigMvCab.Grupoos = GrCli or crSigMvCab.Grupods = GrCli
	_Conta = Iif(crSigMvCab.Grupoos=GrCli,crSigMvCab.Contaos,crSigMvCab.Contads)
	_Ocorr = crSigCdOpe.Ccentrals
	
	m.Grupos = GrCli
	m.Contas = _Conta
	m.GruContas = GrCli + _Conta
	m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
	m.Cocos = _Ocorr
	
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigClLan','CrTmpLanc','GruContas',GrCli + _Conta)
		Select CrTmpLanc
		Locate For Cocos = m.cocos
		If Eof()
			Select crSigClLan
			Append Blank
			Gather Memvar
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.Update('crSigClLan')
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigClLan)')
		Return .f.
	Else
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit()
	EndIf
EndIf
RETURN ( .t. )

**************fim **************
ENDPROC

llOks = .t.

		laCpo(20) = [015] && Comunicação
		laCpo(21) = [016] && Informações do local do evento
		* Página 3
		laCpo(22) = [024] && Líder de Projeto

		laCpo(25) = [026] && Comercial
		laCpo(26) = [029] && Orçamento
		laCpo(27) = [027] && Arquiteto
		laCpo(28) = [030] && Montagem
		laCpo(29) = [031] && Líder de Projeto
		laCpo(30) = [032] && Atendimento
		laCpo(31) = [035] && Planejamento
		laCpo(32) = [033] && Comercial
		laCpo(33) = [036] && Produção
		laCpo(34) = [034] && Criação
		laCpo(35) = [037] && Produção Financeira
		laCpo(36) = [003] && Pedido do Cliente
		laCpo(37) = [] 	  && Concorrência
		laCpo(38) = [] 	  && Licitação
		laCpo(39) = [] 	  && Proprietário
		laCpo(40) = [004] && Desenvolvimento Total
		laCpo(41) = [] 	  && Produção

		laCpo(48) = [007] && Impressão 2

		laCpo(66) = [062] && Código de Atividade
		laCpo(67) = [071] && Comentários Financeiros

		For lnCnt = 1 To lnCpo

								(crSigMvJbC.Jb_042 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_043 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_044 <> 0)

								(crSigMvJbC.Jb_049 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_050 <> 0)
						
					Case (lnCnt = 45) && Proposta Comercial (3 Checkbox)
						llOks =	(Int(Val(Substr(Nvl(crSigOpCdI.JOB_MV_OBR, []), lnCnt, 1))) <> 1) Or ;
								(crSigMvJbC.Jb_051 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_052 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_053 <> 0)
					
					Case (lnCnt = 48) && Proposta Técnica (3 Checkbox)
						llOks =	(Int(Val(Substr(Nvl(crSigOpCdI.JOB_MV_OBR, []), lnCnt, 1))) <> 1) Or ;
								(crSigMvJbC.Jb_054 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_055 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_056 <> 0)
						
					Case (lnCnt = 58) && Proposta Técnica (3 Checkbox)
						llOks =	(Int(Val(Substr(Nvl(crSigOpCdI.JOB_MV_OBR, []), lnCnt, 1))) <> 1) Or ;
								(crSigMvJbC.Jb_063 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_064 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_065 <> 0)
						
					Case (lnCnt = 61) && Proposta Técnica (5 Checkbox)
						llOks =	(Int(Val(Substr(Nvl(crSigOpCdI.JOB_MV_OBR, []), lnCnt, 1))) <> 1) Or ;
								(crSigMvJbC.Jb_066 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_067 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_068 + crSigMvJbC.Jb_069 <> 0)

					Case (lnCnt = 65) && Outras Receitas

					Otherwise
						llOks =	(Int(Val(Substr(Nvl(crSigOpCdI.JOB_MV_OBR, []), lnCnt, 1))) <> 1) Or Not IsEmpty(crSigMvJbC.Jb_&lcCpo.)

						If InList(lnCnt, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28) And InList(lnEmp, 3, 4)
							llOks = .t.
						EndIf

						If InList(lnCnt, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35) And InList(lnEmp, 2, 4)
							llOks = .t.
						EndIf

	EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE checavendedores
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE checavendedores
If (ThisForm.pcEscolha = [INSERIR])
	If Empty(goVendedor.Vendedor00)
		* Ativa a Tela Para Carregar os Vendedores Pela Primeira Vez
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .t.
		ThisForm.Enabled = .f.

		Do Form SigMvVde

		ThisForm.Enabled = .t.
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
		
		If (goVendedor.Vendedor00 = Replicate(Chr(254), 10)) && Se Deixou o Vendedor Principal em Branco
			goVendedor.Vendedor00 = []
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
			
	Zap In TprMvCabV
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_conta.Value = goVendedor.Vendedor00
	lcQuery = [Select IClis, RClis, Cpfs, Grupos From SigCdCli Where IClis = '] + Padr(goVendedor.Vendedor00, 10) + [']
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalCli]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalCli)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Go Top In LocalCli
	If Not Eof([LocalCli])
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_grupo.Value  = LocalCli.Grupos
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_cpf.Value    = LocalCli.Cpfs
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_dconta.Value = LocalCli.RClis
	EndIf
	
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_conta.Value = goVendedor.Vendedor00
	For lnVde = 1 To 10
		lcVde = Padl(lnVde, 2, [0])
		If Not Empty(goVendedor.Vendedor&lcVde.)
			lcQuery = [Select IClis, RClis, Grupos, CodSegs From SigCdCli Where IClis = '] + Padr(goVendedor.Vendedor&lcVde., 10) + [']
			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalCli]) < 1)
				=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalCli)])
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			Go Top In LocalCli
			If Not Eof([LocalCli])
				Insert Into TprMvCabV (Emps, Dopes, Numes, Grupos, Contas, RClis, CodSegs) ;
							  Values (TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
							  		  LocalCli.Grupos, LocalCli.IClis, LocalCli.RClis, LocalCli.CodSegs )
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Next
	Use In LocalCli
Else
	Zap In TprMvCabV
EndIf

If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [ALTERAR], [CONSULTAR], [EXCLUIR])
	lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvEtv Where EmpDopNums = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes, 6) + [']
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalVde]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalVde)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select LocalVde
	Scan
		Scatter Memvar Memo
		m.RClis = []
		lcQuery = [Select IClis, RClis, Grupos From SigCdCli Where IClis = '] + m.Contas + [']
		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalCli]) < 1)
			=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalCli)])
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Go Top In LocalCli
		If Not Eof([LocalCli])
			m.RClis = LocalCli.RClis
		EndIf
		Use In LocalCli
		Insert Into TprMvCabV From Memvar
	EndScan
	Use In LocalVde
EndIf

Return .t.
ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE chkcortampes
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE chkcortampes
*** Mena - 29/09/2016 - consiste grade de cor e tamanho - Rosana ***
If crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts = 1
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Go Top
	Scan For !IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
		lcQuery = [Select a.cores, a.tams, a.obriggrd from SigCdGrp a, sigcdpro b  Where b.CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.Cpros + [' and a.cgrus=b.cgrus]
		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crGrpA]) < 1)
			=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crGrpA)])
			Return .F.
		Endif
		Select * From crTpmMvIts Where Cpros = crTpmMvItn.Cpros And citens = crTpmMvItn.citens  And codcors = '   ' Into Cursor crAux
		If CrGrpA.Cores = 1 And Reccount('crAux')>0 And Inlist(CrGrpA.obriggrd,1,3)
			Messagebox('Há itens sem Cor',0+16,'Verifique cor/tamanho')
			Return .F.
		Endif
		Select * From crTpmMvIts Where Cpros = crTpmMvItn.Cpros And citens = crTpmMvItn.citens  And codtams = '   ' Into Cursor crAux
		If CrGrpA.tams = 1 And Reccount('crAux')>0 And Inlist(CrGrpA.obriggrd,2,3)
			Messagebox('Há itens sem Tamanho',0+16,'Verifique cor/tamanho')
			Return .F.
		Endif
	Endscan
Endif

If Type([crSigOpCdi.ValCorTam])=[N] And crSigOpCdi.ValCorTam = 1
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Set Order To
	Scan
		If Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
			lcQuery = [Select b.Cores, b.Tams ] + ;
			[From SigCdPro a, SigCdGrp b ] + ;
			[Where a.CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.Cpros + [' And ] + ;
			[a.CGrus = b.CGrus]

			If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalBusca]) < 1)
				=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalBusca)])
				Return 0
			Endif
			Select LocalBusca
			If Not Eof([LocalBusca])
				Select crTpmMvIts
				Go Top In crTpmMvIts
				Locate For citens = crTpmMvItn.citens
				If Eof([crTpmMvIts]) And (Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.codcors) Or Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.codtams))
					Insert Into crTpmMvIts (citens, Emps, Dopes, Numes, Cpros, Qtds, codcors, codtams, Pesos, CodBarras, QtdEmbs) ;
					Values (crTpmMvItn.citens, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, crTpmMvItn.Cpros, crTpmMvItn.Qtds, ;
					crTpmMvItn.codcors, crTpmMvItn.codtams, crTpmMvItn.Pesos, crTpmMvItn.CodBarras, 1)
				Endif

				If Empty(crTpmMvIts.codcors) And (LocalBusca.Cores = 1)
					=Messagebox([Existe Produtos Sem Cor no Item = ] + Alltrim(Str(crTpmMvItn.citens)) + ;
					[ - Produto: ] + Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) + [. Corrija!!!], ;
					0+16, [Item Com Cor Inválida])
					Return .F.
				Endif

				If Empty(crTpmMvIts.codtams) And (LocalBusca.tams = 1)
					=Messagebox([Existe Produtos Sem Tamanho no Item = ] + Alltrim(Str(crTpmMvItn.citens)) + ;
					[ - Produto: ] + Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) + [. Corrija!!!], ;
					0+16, [Item Com Tamanho Inválido])
					Return .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
	Endscan
Endif


*** mena - 09/11/2016 - checa peso obrigatório - MonteCarlo***
Select crTpmMvItn
Scan
	If Empty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
		Loop
	Endif

	If crSigCdOpe.EPesos = 3 And IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Pesos)
		Messagebox([Obrigatório Informar Peso do Produto ] + Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.Cpros),48,[Campo Obrigatório] )
		Return .F.
	Endif
Endscan

Return .T.
**********************************************************************

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE chkdadosconta
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE chkdadosconta
Lparameters lcConta, lbFiscal

If Type([lcConta]) <> [C] 
	Return(.T.)
EndIf

lbFiscal = Iif(Type([lbFiscal]) <> [L], .F., lbFiscal)

ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli],[crChkConta],[IClis],lcConta,[rClis,Endes,Cpfs,Ceps])
If IsEmpty(crChkConta.rClis)
	MessageBox([Nome da Conta não informado!],16,[Obrigatório])	
	Return(.F.)
EndIf
If IsEmpty(crChkConta.Endes)
	MessageBox([Endereço da Conta não informado!],16,[Obrigatório])
	Return(.F.)	
EndIf
If lbFiscal And IsEmpty(Strtran(Strtran(Strtran(crChkConta.Cpfs,[.],[]),[-],[]),[/],[]))
	MessageBox([CPF/CNPJ da Conta não informado!],16,[Obrigatório])
	Return(.F.)
EndIf
If not lbFiscal and IsEmpty(Strtran(crChkConta.Ceps,[-],[]))
	MessageBox([Cep da Conta não informado!],16,[Obrigatório])
	Return(.F.)
EndIf
Return(.T.)
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE chklimite
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE chklimite
LPARAMETERS _OldVal, _NewVal, _pvalvar, _pvar, _pLibItem, pAplTBD

If crSigCdOpe.Deacrs <> 1
	RETURN .t.
EndIf

LOCAL ChkLim, _ChkBin, _ChkTabD

llVerLimite = .T.
lnValos   = _OldVal
If _NewVal <> 0
	lnValVars = ( _NewVal - _OldVal )
	lnVars    = Iif(_OldVal = 0, 100 , ( ( ( _NewVal - _OldVal ) / _OldVal ) * 100 ) )
Else
	lnValVars = _pValVar
	lnVars    = _pVar
EndIf
Limite = .F.
lcSql = [Select Codigos From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+TprMvCab.ContaDs+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalCli') < 1
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (ChkLimite - LocalCli)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdUsu','CrSigCdUsu','Usuarios',Usuar)
=Seek(CrSigCdUsu.cCargs,'crSigCdCrg','cCargs')
_ChkDsc = Iif(InList(crSigOpCdc.MotDscs,1,3),[S],[ ] ) 
_ChkAcr = Iif(InList(crSigOpCdc.MotDscs,2,3),[S],[ ] )

_ChkBin = .f.
_ChkTabD = pAplTBD

If _ChkDsc = [S] Or _chkAcr = [S]
	Select xpar
	Scan
		lcSql = [Select ChkBins,BlqTabds From SigOpFp Where Fpags = ']+xpar.Fpags+[']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPar')
		If InList(LocalPar.ChkBins,1,3)
			_ChkBin = .t.
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf

If lnVars < 0
	If ( crSigCdCrg.LimDescs <> 0 Or crSigCdCrg.DescPors <> 0 )
		If ( Abs(lnValVars) <= crSigCdCrg.LimDescs Or crSigCdCrg.LimDescs = 0) And (Abs(lnVars) <= crSigCdCrg.DescPors Or crSigCdCrg.DescPors = 0)
			Limite = .T.
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	If lnVars > 0
		If ( crSigCdCrg.LimAcres <> 0 Or crSigCdCrg.AcrePors <> 0 )
			If ( Abs(lnValVars) <= crSigCdCrg.LimAcres Or crSigCdCrg.LimAcres = 0 ) And ( Abs(lnVars) <= crSigCdCrg.AcrePors Or crSigCdCrg.AcrePors = 0)
				Limite = .T.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf
If !Limite
	Limite = .T.
	If lnVars < 0
		Select crSigCdCrg
		Set Order to limdescs
		set near on
		seek Abs(lnValVars)
		set near off
		If eof()
			desconto = Abs(lnVars)
			Set Order to descpors
			set near on
			seek desconto
			set near off
			If eof()
				MessageBox('Valor de Desconto Não Permitido !!',0+48,'')
				limite = .F.
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If limite
			Do Form SigOpLim with lnValos,Abs(lnValVars),Abs(lnVars),"D",ThisForm,ThisForm.poDataMgr,(_ChkDsc=[S]),LocalCli.Codigos,_Chkbin,_ChkTabD,ThisForm.pEmps to chklim
			If Type('ChkLim') = 'L' And not chklim
				MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
				limite = .f.
			ELSE
				If _pLibItem
					Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Left(ChkLim,10),;
							crTpmMvItn.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in crTpmMvItn
				Else
					ThisForm.UsuLibs = Left(ChkLim,10)
					Replace TprMvCab.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		If lnVars > 0
			Select crSigCdCrg
			Set Order to limacres
			set near on
			seek Abs(lnValVars)
			set near off
			If eof()
				acresc = Abs(lnVars)
				Set Order to acrepors
				set near on
				seek acresc
				set near off
				If eof()
					MessageBox('Valor de Acréscimo Não Permitido !!',0+48,'')
					limite = .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If limite
				Do Form SigOpLim with lnValos,Abs(lnValVars),Abs(lnVars),"C",ThisForm,ThisForm.poDataMgr,(_ChkAcr=[S]),LocalCli.Codigos,_ChkBin,_ChkTabD,ThisForm.pEmps to chklim
				If Type('ChkLim') = 'L' And Not chklim
					MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
					Limite = .F.
				Else
					If _pLibItem
						Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Left(ChkLim,10),;
								crTpmMvItn.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in crTpmMvItn
					Else
						ThisForm.UsuLibs = Left(ChkLim,10)
						Replace TprMvCab.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in TprMvCab
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	If CrSigCdOpe.Vars = 6 && Tiago - 07/12/2015 - Dvie - Checa menor variação (desconto ou acréscimo) pela condição de pagamento
		lnVarMax = 999.99
		Select xPar
		Scan
			lcSql = [Select pVarias From SigOpFp Where Fpags = ']+xpar.Fpags+[']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPar')
			lnVarMax = Min(lnVarMax,LocalPar.pVarias)
		Endscan
		If lnVars < 0 And lnVarMax > 0 And Abs(lnVars) > lnVarMax
			Messagebox([Desconto máximo permitido = ] + Str(lnVarMax,6,2) + [%],48,[Limite de variação])
			Do Form SigOpLim with lnValos,Abs(lnValVars),Abs(lnVars),"L",ThisForm,ThisForm.poDataMgr,(_ChkAcr=[S]),LocalCli.Codigos,_ChkBin,_ChkTabD,ThisForm.pEmps to chklim
			If Type('ChkLim') = 'L' And Not chklim
				MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!',0+48,'')
				Limite = .F.
			Else
				If _pLibItem
					Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Left(ChkLim,10),;
							crTpmMvItn.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in crTpmMvItn
				Else
					ThisForm.UsuLibs = Left(ChkLim,10)
					Replace TprMvCab.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Endif
	Else
		If lnVars < 0 And _ChkDsc = [S]
			Do Form SigOpLim With 0,0,0,"D",ThisForm,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.t.,LocalCli.Codigos,_ChkBin,_ChkTabD,ThisForm.pEmps to chklim
			If Type('ChkLim') = 'L' And Not chklim
				MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
				Limite = .F.
			Else
				If _pLibItem
					Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Usuar,;
							crTpmMvItn.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in crTpmMvItn
				Else
					ThisForm.UsuLibs = Usuar
					Replace TprMvCab.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Else
			If lnVars > 0 And _ChkAcr = [S]
				Do Form SigOpLim With 0,0,0,"D",ThisForm,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.t.,LocalCli.Codigos,_ChkBin,_ChkTabD,ThisForm.pEmps to chklim
				If Type('ChkLim') = 'L' And Not chklim
					MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
					Limite = .F.
				Else
					If _pLibItem
						Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Usuar,;
								crTpmMvItn.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in crTpmMvItn
					Else
						ThisForm.UsuLibs = Usuar
						Replace TprMvCab.MotDscs With Substr(ChkLim,11) in TprMvCab
					EndIf
				EndIf
			Else
				If lnVars < 0 And _ChkDsc = [ ]
					If _pLibItem
						Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Usuar in crTpmMvItn
					Else
						ThisForm.UsuLibs = Usuar
					EndIf
				Else
					If lnVars > 0 And _ChkAcr = [ ]
						If _pLibItem
							Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Usuar in crTpmMvItn
						Else
							ThisForm.UsuLibs = Usuar
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Endif
EndIf
RETURN ( Limite )

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE chkopfec
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE chkopfec
Parameters pCod		&& inserir, alterar, excluir

*** Mena - 30/05/2017  - Não permite inclusão, exclusao ou alteracao de operações já fechadas *****************
Local ok
Private ldDtO
ok=.T.
If not fChecaAcesso(Padl(crSigCdOpe.nDopes, 8, [0]), [ALTPGTOFEC])
	Thisform.Podatamgr.Cursorquery('SigCdTom','CrTom','codigos', crSigCdOpe.TipoOps, 'GerGdmis')
	If crTom.gergdmis = 1	&& essa operaqcao faz parte do fechamento de venda ?
		*** seleciona operação de fechamento de hoje ***
		ldDtO=Iif(pCod=1, Dtot(Date()),crSigMvCab.DataS)
		lcQuery = [Select * From Sigmvcab where dopes = ']+Alltrim(crSigcdpam.dopes)+[' and emps = ']+crSigMvCab.Emps+[' and datas = ?ldDtO ]
		If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[crAux]) < 1)
			=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (sigmvcab)])
			Return 0
		Endif
		If Reccount('crAux') > 0		&& já tem fechamento
			Messagebox('Já foi feito o fechamento dessa operação !!!',0+48,'')
			ok=.F.
		Endif
	EndIf
EndIf 

*** Não permite fazer fechamento se transitoria com pendencias ***
IF ALLTRIM(crSigCdOpe.dopes) == ALLTRIM(crSigcdpam.dopes) and !EMPTY(crSigcdpac.grutran) and !EMPTY(crSigcdpac.contran) 
	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select sum(sqtds) as sqtds From Sigmvest where grupos = '] + ALLTRIM(crSigcdpac.grutran) + [' ]+;
		[and estos = '] + ALLTRIM(crSigcdpac.contran) + [' ] +;
		[and emps = ']+_empr+['], [crAux]) < 1)
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (sigmvcab)])
		Return 0
	ENDIF
	IF crAux.sqtds > 0		&& Tem transferencia entre locais pendente
		Messagebox('Operação de fechamento não pode ser feita pois há saldo na conta transitoria de transferência !!!',0+48,'')
		ok=.F.
	ENDIF
ENDIF

Return ok



ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE chkunidp
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE chkunidp
Lparameters pObrigatorio

Local lcConta,llRetorno, _pData

If Not InList(crSigOpCdd.UniDopes,1,2)
	Return .t.
EndIf
lcConta = Iif(crSigOpCdd.UniDopes=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.ContaDs)
llFalse = .f.
llRetorno = .t.

If crSigOpCdd.DdIntOpes = 0
	lcSql = [Select Count(*) as TT From SigMvCab Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[' And ]+;
			Iif(crSigOpCdd.UniDopes=1,[ContaOs = ']+TprMvCab.ContaOs+[' ],[ContaDs = ']+TprMvCab.ContaDs+[' ])+;
			[And ChkSubn = ?llFalse And EmpDopNums <> ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']

	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'UniEest') < 1
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão ChkUniDp - SigMvCab ')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	If UniEest.TT > 0
		MessageBox('Já existe uma Movimentação '+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes)+' pendente para a Conta '+lcConta,0+16,'')
		llRetorno = .f.
	EndIf
Else
	If (lcConta = ' ' Or TprMvCab.Resps = ' ' ) And Not pObrigatorio
		*** Checar no final devido aos campos obrigatórios ainda estarem sem informar
	Else
		_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
		lcSql = [Select Top 1 numes,Datas From SigMvCab Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[' And ]+;
				Iif(crSigOpCdd.UniDopes=1,[ContaOs = ']+TprMvCab.ContaOs+[' ],[ContaDs = ']+TprMvCab.ContaDs+[' ])+;
				[And Resps = ']+TprMvCab.Resps+[' And EmpDopNums <> ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[' Order by Datas Desc ]

		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'UniEest') < 1
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão ChkUniDp - SigMvCab ')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Select UniEest
		Go Bott
		lnDia = Ttod(_pData) - Ttod(UniEest.Datas)
		If Reccount('UniEest') > 0 And lnDia < crSigOpCdd.DdIntOpes
			MessageBox('Já existe uma Movimentação '+Alltrim(Str(UniEest.Numes))+' ('+Ttoc(UniEest.Datas)+') pendente para a Conta '+lcConta+Chr(13)+;
					   'Com Intervalo Menor que '+Alltrim(Str(crSigOpCdd.DdIntOpes))+' Dias ',0+16,'')
			llRetorno = .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf
Return (llRetorno)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE cmobras
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE cmobras
Select TmpTotal
If !Eof()
	_Rec = Recno()
Else
	_Rec = 0
EndIf
_MoeOpe = Iif( IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, ;
		  Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )
m.valos = 0
Scan
	If TmpTotal.Moeds # _MoeOpe
		Cotacao = ThisForm.Cotacao(TmpTotal.Moeds)
		m.Valos = Round( m.Valos + ( TmpTotal.ValTots * Cotacao ), 2 )
	Else
		m.Valos = m.Valos + TmpTotal.ValTots
	EndIf
Endscan
ThisForm.totpres = m.valos
ThisForm.AtuaTot
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos.Refresh
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Refresh
Select TmpTotal
If _Rec # 0
	Go _Rec
Else
	Go top
EndIf

If ValItens # ValTots And ValItens > 0 And !Eof()
	If ValItens > ValTots
		 _Difer = ValItens - ValTots
		 _Porc  = round(( _Difer / ValItens)*100,2)
		 _Tipo  = Iif( TmpTotal.nSinals >= 0, "D", "A")
	Else
		 _Difer = ValTots - ValItens
		 _Porc  = round(( _Difer / ValItens)*100,2)
		 _Tipo  = Iif( TmpTotal.nSinals >=0, "A", "D" )
	EndIf
	Replace ValDifs  With _Difer
	Replace PorcDifs With _Porc
	Replace Tipos    With _Tipo
Else
	If !Eof()
		If ValItens = 0
			Replace ValDifs  With ValTots
			Replace PorcDifs With 0
			Replace Tipos    With "A"
		Else
			Replace ValDifs  With 0
			Replace PorcDifs With 0
			Replace Tipos    With " "
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf
***************** fim ********************
ENDPROC
