PROCEDURE cnttxt
Return .t.

Select crSigCdPam
goto top

lcHeader = ''

If (alltrim(crSigFiTef.cTpTrans)= '99' And crSigCdPam.Sistef = 1) or crSigCdPam.Sistef = 3
	lcHeader = Space(3)
Else
	lcHeader = crSigFiTef.cHeaders
EndIf

*Select SigFiTra
*Set order to Tipo
*Seek str(crSigCdPam.Sistef,1)+lcHeader+crSigFiTef.cTpTrans
DECLARE laSigFiTra(3,2)	
laSigFiTra(1,1)='nTipos'
laSigFiTra(1,2)=crSigCdPam.Sistef
laSigFiTra(2,1)='cHeaders'
laSigFiTra(2,2)=lcHeader
laSigFiTra(3,1)='cTpTrans'
laSigFiTra(3,2)=crSigFiTef.cTpTrans
ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigFiTra','crSigFiTra', @laSigFiTra)
If eof() or crSigFiTef.cTpTrans = '99'
	lcTran = 'Outras'
Else
	lcTran = alltrim(crSigFiTra.cTrans)
EndIf
With ThisForm.CntTefTxt
	lcTxtOper = alltrim(crSigFiTef.cTxtOpers)
	lcTxtCli  = alltrim(crSigFiTef.cTxtClis)
	lcTxtTpTrans = lcTran
	.Top = 267
	.Left = 8
	If !IsEmpty(alltrim(crSigFiTef.cTxtOpers))
		.TxtOper.Caption = lcTxtOper 
		.TxtOper.Width = 458
		.TxtOper.autosize = .t.
		.Visible = .t.
	EndIf
	If !IsEmpty(alltrim(crSigFiTef.cTxtClis))
		.TxtCli.Caption = lcTxtCli
		.TxtCli.Width = 470
		.TxtCli.autosize = .t.
		.Visible = .t.
	EndIf
	If !IsEmpty(alltrim(crSigFiTef.cTpTrans))
		.TxtTpTrans.Caption = lcTxtTpTrans 
		.TxtTpTrans.Width = 381
		.TxtTpTrans.autosize = .t.
		.Visible = .t.
		.ZORDER
	EndIf
EndWith
*************** fim **************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE comissao
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE comissao
Lparameters llEditavel

Local lnValTots, llRetorno

llRetorno = .t.

If crSigCdOpe.CComis = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.ComCargs = 1

	If Inlist( Thisform.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		Store 0 to lnTotalParc, lnDiferParc, lnValTots
		Select xPar
		Scan 
			=Thisform.Podatamgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','CrSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
			lnTotalParc = lnTotalParc + ( xPar.Valos * xPar.Cotfpgs )
			If crSigOpFp.BxComis # 1
				lnDiferParc = lnDiferParc + ( xPar.Valos * xPar.Cotfpgs )
			Endif
		Endscan

		If lnTotalParc # 0
			lnDiferParc = 1 - ( lnDiferParc / lnTotalParc )
		Else
			lnDiferParc = 1
		Endif
		lnDiferParc = Iif(lnDiferParc=0, 1, lnDiferParc)
		
		lnDiferVars = 1
		If (TprMvCab.Vars < 0 And crSigCdPam.Comiscvars = 1) Or (TprMvCab.Vars > 0 And crSigCdPam.ComisDvars=1)
			lnDiferVars = (100+TprMvCab.Vars)/100
		Endif

		Store 0 to lnTotalBase, lnDiferComis, lnItens
		If InList(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3)
			Select TmpTotal
			Scan
				lnCota       = Thisform.Cotacao( TmpTotal.Moeds, TprMvCab.Datas )
				lnValTots    = lnValTots + TmpTotal.ValTots * lnCota
				lnDiferComis = lnDiferComis + ( TmpTotal.ValDifs * lnCota * Iif( TmpTotal.Tipos = 'D', -1, 1 ) )
				lnTotalBase  = lnTotalBase + ( TmpTotal.ValItens * lnCota )
				lnItens      = lnItens + ( Iif(TmpTotal.nSinals < 0, -1, 1) * TmpTotal.Valitens * lnCota )
			Endscan
			lnpDesCc = Iif(lnItens # 0, (lnValTots - Abs(lnItens)) / lnItens , 0)
			If lnTotalBase # 0
				lnDiferComis = 1 + ( lnDiferComis / lnTotalBase )
			Endif
			
			If lnDiferComis = 0 And lnValTots # 0
				lnDiferComis = 1
			EndIf
			
			If lnValTots = 0
				lnDiferComis = 0
			Endif
		Else
			Store 1 to lnDiferComis
			lnpDesCc = TprMvCab.Vars
		EndIf
		lnpDesCc = Iif(lnpDesCc < 0, Abs(lnpDesCc),0 )

		lcContaOD = Iif(CrSigOpCdc.ChkComis = 1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,Iif(CrSigOpCdc.Chkcomis = 2, TprMvCab.ContaDs, Space(10)))
		=fCalcularComissao(lnDiferComis, lnDiferParc, lnDiferVars, ThisForm, lcContaOD, lnpDesCc)

		Select TmpComiss
		Go Top
	Else
		lcBusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
		lcWhere = [Select *, '          '  as GruCads, 0 as CtFils, Space(50) as rclis From SigCdCmm Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
		lnErro = ThisForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpComis')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
			Return .f.
		Endif
		Select CrTmpComis
		Go Top
	EndIf
	
	If !Eof() or crSigCdOpe.edComis = 1
		If !(Thisform.pcEscolha='INSERIR' and INLIST(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6))	&& mena 06/07/2015 - se estiver incluindo NFCe ou SAT não entra na tela de comissao
			Do Form SigMvCom With llEditavel,ThisForm To llRetorno
		ENDIF
	Endif
Else
	If CrSigCdOpe.EdComis = 3
		=fCalcularComissao(1, 1, 1, ThisForm, ' ')

		Select TmpComiss
		Zap
		If Inlist( Thisform.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR', 'CONSULTAR' )
			lcBusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdCmm Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpComis')
			If lnErro < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Return .f.
			Endif
			Select CrTmpComis
			Scan
				Scatter Memvar
				m.Flags = Iif(ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'CONSULTAR',.F.,.T.)
				Insert Into TmpComiss From Memvar
			EndScan
			Select crSigCdCmm
			Scan
				Scatter Memvar
				m.Flags = Iif(ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'CONSULTAR',.F.,.T.)
				Insert Into TmpComiss From Memvar
			EndScan
		EndIf
		Select TmpComiss
		Go Top
		Do Form SigMvCom With llEditavel,ThisForm To llRetorno
	EndIf

	If CrSigCdOpe.EdComis = 4
		ThisForm.GerEdCpr('crTpmMvItn','TprMvCab',ThisForm.PodataMgr,CrSigCdOpe.Dopes)
		If Inlist( Thisform.pcEscolha, 'CONSULTAR' )
			Select TmpComiss
			Zap
			lcBusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdCmm Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpComis')
			If lnErro < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Return .f.
			Endif
			Select CrTmpComis
			Scan
				Scatter Memvar
				m.Flags = Iif(ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'CONSULTAR',.F.,.T.)
				Insert Into TmpComiss From Memvar
			EndScan
		EndIf
		Select TmpComiss
		Go Top
		Do Form SigMvCom With .f.,ThisForm To llRetorno
	EndIf	
Endif

If (crSigCdOpe.EdComis = 5) && Tipo 5 = Lança Só o CC dos Produtos // Richard em 24/07/2012
	=fCalcCCPro(ThisForm.poDataMgr, [crTpmMvItn])
	
	If llRetorno
		Zap In crSigCdCmm
		
		Select TmpComiss
		Scan
			Scatter Memvar Memo
			m.Datas = TprMvCab.Datas
			m.Emps  = TprMvCab.Emps
			m.Dopes = TprMvCab.Dopes
			m.Numes = TprMvCab.Numes
			m.cIdChaves = fUniqueIds()
			m.EmpDopNums = m.Emps + m.Dopes + Str(m.Numes, 6)
			m.IdComis = fGerUniqueKey('INTCONTS') && Tiago - 29/01/2013 - Costantini - Incluido numeração de ID para vincular a tabela de comissão com a comissão liberada no conta corrente

			Insert Into crSigCdCmm From Memvar
		EndScan
	EndIf
EndIf

Return llRetorno

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE contacorrente
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE contacorrente
LParameters llvoper

Local ldDtContab, lcRclis, lcGrupoCob, lcContaCob, _pData, lnCont, _lcOcorSv, _lcNota

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde...'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Lancamentos de Conta Corrente!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

lcRclis = ''
lnCont  = 0
lnRetVOper = 0

If crSigCdOpe.DtContab=2 && Contabilizar na Data de Vencimento
	ldDtContab = xPar.Vencs
Else && Contabilizar na Data de Lançamento

	* Richard em 26/09/2012 Pois em Lançamentos retroativos lançava errado
	*ldDtContab = Iif(Empty(xPar.Datas), Date(), xPar.Datas)
	ldDtContab = Iif(Empty(xPar.Datas), TprMvCab.Datas, xPar.Datas)
EndIf
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
_doc = Transf( crSigCdOpe.NDopes,"@L 999" ) + Transf( TprMvCab.Numes, "@L 999999" )

lcTitBan      = Iif(crSigOpFp.Infos = 'B' And crSigOpFp.ImpBols = 1,xPar.nCarnes,'')
_Departamento = Space(10)
_Titulo       = ThisForm.NumeraTitulo &&TprMvCab.Notas && Richard em 11/12/2012
_lcNota       = Iif(crSigOpFp.OpcSNAs = 2,[ ],TprMvCab.Notas)

lcEspecie = crSigOpFp.Especies
lcEmpccs  = TprMvCab.Empds
lcTpDopNf = 'NF'

If crSigOpFp.OpcSNAs = 1 And Empty(TprMvCab.Notas)
	MessageBox('Obrigatorio o Preenchimento do Campo Notas para a Condição de Pagamento '+crSigOpFp.Fpags,0+16,'')
	If llvOper
		Return -1
	Else
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

*** Movimentação x Cliente
If !IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Grupos + crSigCdOpe.Contas ) Or Eof([xPar])
	If crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 1
		_GrupoOrig = crSigCdOpe.Grupos
		_ContaOrig = crSigCdOpe.Contas
	Else
		If crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1
			_GrupoOrig = TprMvCab.Grupoos
			_ContaOrig = TprMvCab.Contaos
		Else
			_GrupoOrig = TprMvCab.Grupods
			_ContaOrig = TprMvCab.Contads
		EndIf
		
		If (crSigOpCdd.LanFinMats = 2) And !Empty(_ContaOrig) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [grupomats, contamats])
			If !Empty( crtmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !Empty( CrTmpCli.ContaMats )
				_GrupoOrig = CrTmpCli.GrupoMats
				_ContaOrig = CrTmpCli.ContaMats
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1
		_GrupoDest = TprMvCab.Grupods
		_ContaDest = TprMvCab.Contads
	Else
		_GrupoDest = TprMvCab.Grupoos
		_ContaDest = TprMvCab.Contaos
	EndIf
	
	If (crSigOpCdd.LanFinMats = 2) And !Empty(_ContaDest) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaDest,[grupomats, contamats])
		If !Empty( crtmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !Empty( CrtmpCli.ContaMats )
			_GrupoDest = crtmpCli.GrupoMats
			_ContaDest = crtmpCli.ContaMats
		EndIf
	EndIf

	lcRclis = ''
	If Not IsEmpty(_ContaDest) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaDest, [Rclis])
		lcRclis = crtmpCli.Rclis
	EndIf
	
	_Departamento = Space(10)

	If !IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Dopcs ) And crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1
		_numc = fGerUniqueKey( crSigCdOpe.Dopcs )
		_dopc = crSigCdOpe.Dopcs
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdUsu','CrUsu','Usuarios',Usuar,[Deptos])
		_Departamento = CrUsu.Deptos

		If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.Obses)
			Insert Into crSigTtCcd (EmpdopNums, EmpDopNcs, CidChaves, ObsD ) Values ;
						(TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
						 TprMvCab.Emps + _Dopc + Str(_Numc,6), fUniqueIds(), TprMvCab.Obses )
		EndIf
	Else
		_numc = 0 
		_dopc = '' 
	EndIf

	Select TprMvCab
	_Hist = ThisForm.MontaHists(_Titulo, crSigOpFp.FPags, lcRClis)
	
	_noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SigMvCcr' )
	If llVOper
		_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
		lnRetVOper = _noper
	Else
		_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
		lnRetVOper = 0
	EndIf

	lnValor = Abs( Iif(Empty(xpar.Valos), TprMvCab.Valos, xpar.Valos) )
	If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
		xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
		xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')
	Else
		xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
		xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')
	EndIf
	
	lcGrupoCob = ''
	lcContaCob = ''
	lcRclis    = ''
	
	If Not IsEmpty(_ContaOrig) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrtmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [Grupocobs, contacobs, Rclis ])
		lcGrupoCob = crtmpCli.GrupoCobs
		lcContaCob = crtmpCli.ContaCobs
		lcRclis    = CrTmpCli.Rclis
	EndIf

	_GrupoTx = _GrupoDest
	_ContaTx = _ContaDest

	_Hist2 = Alltrim( crSigCdOpe.Hist2s )
	DO Case
		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 1
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + _Titulo

		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 2
			If crSigOpFp.Infos = [C]
				_Hist2 = _Hist2 + ' Ch:'+xpar.Bancos+'-'+xpar.Agencias+'-'+xpar.Contas+'-'+xpar.numeros
			Else
				If crSigOpFp.Infos = [T]
					_Hist2 = _Hist2 + ' Ct:'+xPar.cnnsuparcs
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 3
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + Alltrim(lcRclis)

		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 4
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + Alltrim(_ContaOrig)

		Case crSigCdOpe.TpHist2s = 5
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + Iif(!IsNull(TprMvCab.Obses),Alltrim(TprMvCab.Obses),'')
	EndCase

	_CidChave = Dtos(ldDtContab)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(ldDtContab)),"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey 

	_ArqMccr = 'cqSigMvCcr'
	_LancaCC = .f.
	lnvTx    = 0

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpOpe','CrDope','Dopes',_Dopc,[RealPrevs,Opers])
	If _numc > 0
		If crDope.RealPrevs = 2
			_ArqMccr = 'crSigMvCpv'
		EndIf
		If crDOpe.Opers = [CR]
			GrupoTran = crSigCdPam.GrupoPags
			ContaTran = crSigCdPam.ContaPags
		Else
			GrupoTran = crSigCdPam.GrupoRecs
			ContaTran = crSigCdPam.ContaRecs
		EndIf
		If InList(crSigCdOpe.EdComis,3,4)
			_LancaCC = .t.
		EndIf
		
		If crSigOpFp.Infos = [T] And Not Empty(crSigOpFp.GrupoTs) And Not Empty(crSigOpFp.ContaTs) And crSigOpFp.Desc2s > 0
			lnvTx  = Round( lnValor * crSigOpFp.Desc2s / 100 , 2 ) * -1
		Else
			If Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CodServs)
				lcSql = [Select * From SigCdSrv Where ctipos = ]+Iif(crSigCdOpe.Opers=1,['E'],['S'])+[ And CodServs = ']+crSigMvNfi.CodServs+[']
				ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'cServEest')

				If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorPiss) And ( xPar.vPis + Iif(xPar.Vpis=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.vPis,0)) > 0
					lnvTx = lnvTx + xPar.vPis + Iif(xPar.Vpis=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.vPis,0)
				EndIf
				If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorCofin) And ( xPar.vCofins + Iif(xPar.vCofins=0 And ThisForm.Contapar = 1,crSigMvNfi.vCofins,0)) > 0
					lnvTx = lnvTx + xPar.vCofins + Iif(xPar.vCofins=0 And ThisForm.Contapar=1,crSigMvNfi.vCofins,0)
				EndIf
				If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorIrrfs) And ( xPar.virf + Iif(xPar.virf=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.virf,0) ) > 0
					lnvTx = lnvTx + xPar.vIrf + Iif(xPar.virf=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.virf,0)
				EndIf
				If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorCslls) And ( xPar.vCsll + Iif(xPar.vCsll=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.vCsll,0)) > 0
					lnvTx = lnvTx + xPar.vCsll + Iif(xPar.vCsll=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.vCsll,0)
				EndIf
				If ThisForm.ContaPar = 1
					If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorinss) And crSigMvNfi.vInss > 0
						lnvTx = lnvTx + crSigMvNfi.vInss
					EndIf
					If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorIss) And crSigMvNfi.vTotIss > 0
						lnvTx = lnvTx + crSigMvNfi.vTotIss
					EndIf
				EndIf
				lnvTx = lnvTx * -1
				lnValor = lnValor + Abs(lnvTx)
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		If crDOpe.Opers = [CR]
			GrupoTran = crSigCdPam.GrupoPags
			ContaTran = crSigCdPam.ContaPags
		Else
			GrupoTran = crSigCdPam.GrupoRecs
			ContaTran = crSigCdPam.ContaRecs
		EndIf
		If InList(crSigCdOpe.EdComis,3,4)
			_LancaCC = .t.
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If crSigOpFp.AgCobs = 1
		lcGrupoCob = crSigOpFp.GrupoDs
		lcContaCob = crSigOpFp.ContaDs
	EndIf
	
	lcGPEmI = _GrupoDest
	lcCPemI = _ContaDest

	If (crSigOpFp.TpHists = 4)
		Do Case
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [C]) && Cheque
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ CHQ: ] + xPar.Bancos + [/] + xPar.Agencias + [/] + ;
						xPar.Contas + [/] + xPar.Numeros
				_Hist2 = [CPF: ] + xPar.Cpfs		

			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [D]) && Duplicata
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ (] + Alltrim(Str(xPar.Parcs, 2)) + [/] + ;
						Alltrim(Str(xPar.TParcs, 2)) + [)]
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [O]) && Outros
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [R]) && Conta Corrente
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [T]) && Cartão
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ - ] + Alltrim(xPar.Outros) + [ - (] + Alltrim(Str(xPar.Parcs, 2)) + [/] + ;
						Alltrim(Str(xPar.TParcs, 2)) + [)]
				_Hist2 = lcRclis

			Otherwise
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
		EndCase 
	EndIf

	lcMd1 = Iif(Empty(crSigOpFp.MoeFpgs), crSigCdOpe.CMoes, crSigOpFp.MoeFpgs)
	
	Insert Into &_ArqMccr ( NOpers, VOpers, Docus, Emps, Datas, usualts, datalts, Vencs, hists,;
							opers, sopers, moedas, cotacaos, valors, autos, grupos, contas, sgrupos, scontas, ;
							smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, Dopes, numes, valpags,	dopcs, numcs, nfs, titulos,;
							grupems, contems, grupages, contages, valliqs, dtemis, Hist2s, CidChaves, EmpDopNums,;
							bContas,TitBans, ValOcurs, Jobs, EspecieNfs, Empccs, TpDocNf ) ;
				   Values ( _NOper, _VOper, _Doc, TprMvCab.emps, ldDtContab, usuar, _pData, Iif(Empty(xPar.Vencs), ldDtContab, xPar.Vencs), ;
				   			_hist, xoper, xsoper, lcMd1, 1, lnValor, .t., Iif(_LancaCC,GrupoTran,_GrupoOrig), ;
				   			Iif(_lancaCC,ContaTran,_ContaOrig), _GrupoDest, _ContaDest, lcMd1, 1, lnValor, ;
				   			TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.numes, xPar.VPags,_dopc, _numc, _lcNota, ;
				   			Alltrim( _Titulo ) + '/' + Alltrim( Str( ThisForm.ContaPar ) ), _GrupoOrig, _ContaOrig, ;
				   			lcGrupoCob, lcContaCob, lnValor, TprMvCab.DtEmis, _Hist2, _CidChave, ;
				   			TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), _Departamento, lcTitBan, lnVtx, ;
				   			TprMvCab.Jobs, lcEspecie, lcEmpccs, 'NF'  )
	Select ( _ArqMccr )
	Replace gruconmoes with grupos + contas + moedas,;
			EmpDopncs  With Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs,6),;
			Pagos      With Iif(Valors=valpags,'0','1'),;
			DopoTps    with Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos
	
	If _ArqMccr = 'cqSigMvCcr'
		If _Numc > 0
			Replace bGrupos With TprMvCab.UsuPagos in cqSigMvCcr
		EndIf
		=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )
	Else
		If Valors + valocurs = 0
			Replace Pagos   With '1',;
					DopoTps With Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos
		EndIf
	EndIf

	*** Tiago - 07/11/11 - Vianna - Alteração para lançar a perna de despesas através da conta do cliente ou fornecedor
	If ((crSigCdOpe.CTipos = 2) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [GrupocEnts,ContacEnts]) And ;
		Not Empty(crTmpCli.GrupoCEnts))

		Select cqSigMvCcr
		Scatter Memo Memvar
		Insert Into cqSigMvCcr From memvar

		Replace Tipos     With [E], ;
				Grupos    With crTmpCli.GrupoCEnts, ;
				Contas    With Iif(Empty(crTmpCli.ContaCEnts), _ContaOrig, crTmpCli.ContaCEnts), ;
				SGrupos   With _GrupoOrig, ;
				SContas   With _ContaOrig, ;
				GrupEms   With _GrupoOrig, ;
				ContEms   With _ContaOrig, ;
				Opers     With m.Opers, ; 
				SOpers    With m.SOpers, ;
				Nopers    With fGerUniqueKey([SigMvCcr]), ;
				Autos     With .t. In cqSigMvCcr		

		* Richard em 10/09/2012 - Acerto Para Preenchimento Correto dos Campos Abaixo
		lcKey = Dtos(cqSigMvCcr.Datas) + Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(cqSigMvCcr.Datas)), [@L 999999]) + ThisForm.SigKey

		Replace GruConMoes With Grupos + Contas + Moedas, ;
				EmpDopNcs  With Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs, 6), ;
				Pagos      With Iif(Valors = ValPags, [0], [1]), ;
				DopoTps    With Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos, ;
				cIdChaves  With lcKey In cqSigMvCcr

		=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	EndIf
	***
	
	lcGrupoCob = ''
	lcContaCob = ''

	If Not IsEmpty(_ContaDest) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaDest, [grupocobs, contacobs])
		lcGrupoCob = crtmpCli.GrupoCobs
		lcContaCob = crtmpCli.ContaCobs

			_ContaOrig = TprMvCab.Contaos
		EndIf
		If (crSigOpCdd.LanFinMats = 2) And !Empty(_ContaOrig) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrtmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [grupomats, contamats])
			If !IsEmpty( crtmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !IsEmpty( crtmpCli.ContaMats )
				_GrupoOrig = CrTmpCli.GrupoMats
				_ContaOrig = CrTmpCli.ContaMats
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	If Not IsEmpty(_ContaOrig) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrtmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [rclis])
		lcRclis = crtmpCli.Rclis
	EndIf

	Select TprMvCab
	_Hist = ThisForm.MontaHists(_Titulo, crSigOpFp.FPags, lcRClis)

	_noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SigMvCcr' )
	If llVOper
		_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + Alltrim( Str( lnRetVOper, 9 ) )
	Else
		_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
	EndIf

	lnValor = Abs( xpar.Valos )
	If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
		xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
		xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')
	Else
		If crSigOpFp.OriDes = 1 And crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1
			xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=2,'C','D')
			xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=2,'D','C')
		Else
			xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
			xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')
		EndIf
	EndIf

	_Hist2 = Alltrim( crSigCdOpe.Hist2s )

	DO Case
		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 1
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + _Titulo

		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 2
			If crSigOpFp.Infos = [C]
				_Hist2 = _Hist2 + ' Ch:'+xpar.Bancos+'-'+xpar.Agencias+'-'+xpar.Contas+'-'+xpar.numeros
			Else
				If crSigOpFp.Infos = [T]
					_Hist2 = _Hist2 + ' Ct:'+xPar.cnnsuparcs
				EndIf
			EndIf

		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 3
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + Alltrim(CrTmpCli.Rclis)

		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 4
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + Alltrim(_ContaOrig)

		Case crSigCdOpe.TpHist2s = 5
			_hist2 = _hist2 + ' ' + Iif(!IsNull(TprMvCab.Obses),Alltrim(TprMvCab.Obses),'')
	EndCase

	If (crSigOpFp.TpHists = 4)
		Do Case
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [C]) && Cheque
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ CHQ: ] + xPar.Bancos + [/] + xPar.Agencias + [/] + ;
						xPar.Contas + [/] + xPar.Numeros
				_Hist2 = [CPF: ] + xPar.Cpfs		

			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [D]) && Duplicata
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ (] + Alltrim(Str(xPar.Parcs, 2)) + [/] + ;
						Alltrim(Str(xPar.TParcs, 2)) + [)]
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [O]) && Outros
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [R]) && Conta Corrente
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [T]) && Cartão
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ - ] + Alltrim(xPar.Outros) + [ - (] + Alltrim(Str(xPar.Parcs, 2)) + [/] + ;
						Alltrim(Str(xPar.TParcs, 2)) + [)]
				_Hist2 = lcRclis

			Otherwise
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
		EndCase 
	EndIf
	
	_CidChave = Dtos(ldDtContab)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(ldDtContab)),"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey 

	lcMd1 = Iif(Empty(crSigOpFp.MoeFpgs), crSigCdOpe.CMoes, crSigOpFp.MoeFpgs)

	Insert Into cqSigMvCcr ( NOpers, VOpers, Docus, Emps, Datas, usualts, datalts, Vencs, hists,;
			opers, sopers, moedas, cotacaos, valors, autos, grupos, contas, ;
			sgrupos, scontas, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, Dopes, numes, valpags, Hist2s, CidChaves, ;
			EmpDopNums, Jobs, EspecieNfs, Empccs, TpDocNf ) ;
		Values ( _NOper, _VOper, _Doc, TprMvCab.emps, ldDtContab, usuar, _pData, xPar.Vencs, ;
				_hist, xoper, xsoper, lcMd1, 1, lnValor, .t., ;
				_GrupoOrig, _ContaOrig, _GrupoDest, _ContaDest, ;
				lcMd1, 1, lnValor, ;
				TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.numes, xPar.VPags, _Hist2, _CidChave, ;
				TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.Jobs, lcEspecie, lcEmpccs,'NF' )
	Replace cqSigMvCcr.gruconmoes with cqSigMvCcr.grupos + cqSigMvCcr.contas + cqSigMvCcr.moedas,;
			cqSigMvCcr.EmpDopncs  With cqSigMvCcr.Emps + cqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + Str(cqSigMvCcr.Numcs,6),;
			cqSigMvCcr.Pagos      With Iif(cqSigMvCcr.Valors=cqSigMvCcr.valpags,'0','1') ,;
			CqSigMvCcr.DopoTps    with CqSigMvCcr.Dopcs + CqSigMvCcr.Opers + CqSigMvCcr.Tipos + CqSigMvCcr.Pagos in cqSigMvCcr
			
	=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )

	ThisForm.FazContra

	Select crSigMvPar

	If Not InList(crSigOpFp.OriDes,1,2)
		Replace NOpers With _NOper, DtAlts With _pData
	EndIf
EndIf

* Taxas de Cartão de Crédito
If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Grupos + crSigCdOpe.Contas) And (crSigOpFp.Infos = [T]) And Not Empty(crSigOpFp.GrupoTs) And ;
   Not Empty(crSigOpFp.ContaTs) And (crSigOpFp.Desc2s > 0) And (_Numc > 0) And Not Eof([xPar])
   
	lcSql = [Select * From SIGOPOCO Where Grupos = ']+crSigOpFp.GrupoTs+[' And Contas = ']+crSigOpFp.ContaTs+[' ]+;
			Iif(crDOpe.Opers=[CR],[And Opers = 'DB' ],[And Opers = 'CR'] )

	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrSIGOPOCO')
	
	Select CrSIGOPOCO
	If Reccount('CrSIGOPOCO') = 0
		MessageBox('Ocorrencia não Cadastrada para Taxa de Cartão da Condição de Pagamento '+crSigOpFp.Fpags,0+16,'')
		If llvOper
			Return -1
		Else
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
	xsOper = CrSIGOPOCO.Opers
	xOper  = Iif(xsOper=[DB],[CR],[DB])
	
	lnvTx  = Round( lnValor * crSigOpFp.Desc2s / 100 , 2 ) * crSigMvPar.Cotfpgs
		
	_noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SigMvCcr' )

	Insert Into crSigOpCoc (Emps,Dopcs,Dataos,Notitulos,Moedas,Cotacaos, EmpDopNcs,CidChaves,Nopers,Valors,Opers,;
							Codigos,ValConvs, Autos ) Values ;
						   (TprMvCab.Emps,_Dopc,Ttod(ThisForm.Datapadrao),_Numc,crSigMvPar.MoeFpgs, crSigMvPar.CotFpgs,;
						   TprMvCab.Emps + _Dopc + Str(_Numc,6), fUniqueIds(), _nOper, lnvTx, CrSIGOPOCO.Opers, ;
						   CrSIGOPOCO.Codigos, Abs(lnvTx), .t.)

	_Hist = Alltrim(crSIGOPOCO.Descrs) + [-] + Alltrim(crSigOpCoc.codigos) + [-] + _Titulo
	
	lcEspecie = crSigOpFp.Especies
	lcEmpccs  = TprMvCab.Empds
	
	For lnCont=1 to 2

		lcGOri = Iif(lnCont=1,crSigOpFp.GrupoTs,_GrupoTx)
		lcCOri = Iif(lnCont=1,crSigOpFp.ContaTs,_ContaTx)
		lcGDes = Iif(lnCont=1,_GrupoTx,crSigOpFp.GrupoTs)
		lcCDes = Iif(lnCont=1,_ContaTx,crSigOpFp.ContaTs)
		lcodc  = Iif(lnCont=1,xOper,xsoper)
		lcSdc  = Iif(lnCont=1,xsoper,xoper)
		lcGPem = ' '
		lcCPem = ' '
			
		If llVOper
			_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
		Else
			_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
		EndIf
		
		If lnvTx = 0
			Loop
		EndIf
		
		_CidChave = Dtos(ldDtContab)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(ldDtContab)),"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey 

		lcMd1 = Iif(Empty(crSigOpFp.MoeFpgs), crSigCdOpe.CMoes, crSigOpFp.MoeFpgs)

		Insert Into &_ArqMccr ( NOpers, VOpers, Docus, Emps, Datas, usualts, datalts, Vencs, hists,;
				opers, sopers, moedas, cotacaos, valors, autos, grupos, contas, sgrupos, scontas, ;
				smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, Dopes, numes, valpags,	dopcs, numcs, nfs, titulos,;
				grupems, contems, grupages, contages, valliqs, dtemis, Hist2s, CidChaves, EmpDopNums,;
				bContas,TitBans,Tipos, Jobs, EspecieNfs, Empccs, TpDocNf ) ;
			Values ( _NOper, _VOper, _Doc, TprMvCab.emps, ldDtContab, usuar, _pData, xPar.Vencs, ;
					_hist, lcodc, lcsdc, lcMd1, 1, lnvTx, .t., lcGOri, lcCOri, ;
					lcGDes,lcCDes, lcMd1, 1, lnvTx, ;
					TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.numes, lnvTx ,_dopc, _numc, ;
					_lcNota, Alltrim( _Titulo ) + '/' + Alltrim( Str( ThisForm.ContaPar ) ),;
					lcGPem, lcCPem, lcGrupoCob, lcContaCob, 0, TprMvCab.DtEmis, _Hist2, _CidChave, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), _Departamento, lcTitBan,'O', ;
					TprMvCab.Jobs, lcEspecie, lcEmpccs,'NF' )
		Select ( _ArqMccr )
		Replace gruconmoes with grupos + contas + moedas,;
				EmpDopncs  With Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs,6),;
				Pagos      With Iif(Valors=valpags,'0','1'),;
				DopoTps    with Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos
						
		If _ArqMccr = 'cqSigMvCcr'
			If _Numc > 0
				Replace bGrupos With TprMvCab.UsuPagos in cqSigMvCcr
			EndIf
			=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )
		EndIf
	Next

	Replace VPags    With lnvTx,;
			ValoCurs With lnvTx,;
			Pagos    With Iif(Valos = Vpags, '0', '1') in crSigMvPar
EndIf

If llvOper 
	Return lnRetVOper
Else
	Return .t.
EndIf

*************** fim ******************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE contacorrenteccp
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE contacorrenteccp
LParameters llVoper, pArq

_ArqCtas = Iif(Type([pArq])=[C], pArq, [crSigCdCmm])

_ArqMccr = [cqSigMvCcr]
If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Grupos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Contas)
	GrupoTran = crSigCdOpe.Grupos
	ContaTran = crSigCdOpe.Contas
Else
	GrupoTran = Iif(crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1, TprMvCab.GrupoDs, TprMvCab.GrupoOs)
	ContaTran = Iif(crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1, TprMvCab.ContaDs, TprMvCab.ContaOs)
EndIf

xsope = Iif(crSigCdOpe.COpers=1, [C], [D])
xoper = Iif(crSigCdOpe.COpers=1, [D], [C])

If (_ArqCtas = [crSigCdCmm])
	lcCAG = &_ArqCtas..Grupos
	lcCAC = &_ArqCtas..Contas
Else
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigOpFp], [LocalFpag], [Fpags], &_ArqCtas..FPags)
	If Not Used([LocalFPag])
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalFPag)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select LocalFPag
	Go Top In LocalFPag
	lcCAG = LocalFPag.GrupoDs
	lcCAC = LocalFPag.ContaDs
EndIf

Select &_ArqCtas.
Scan
	If Not Empty(lcCAG) And Not Empty(GrupoTran) And Not Empty(lcCAC) And Not Empty(ContaTran)
		_Noper = fGerUniqueKey([SigMvCcr])

		For lnCont = 1 to 2
			If (crSigCdOpe.calcfecs = 1) && Estorno de Comissão
				lcGOri = Iif(lnCont=1, lcCAG, GrupoTran)
				lcCOri = Iif(lnCont=1, lcCAC, ContaTran)
				lcGDes = Iif(lnCont=1, GrupoTran, lcCAG)
				lcCDes = Iif(lnCont=1, ContaTran, lcCAC)
			Else
				lcGOri = Iif(lnCont=1, GrupoTran, lcCAG)
				lcCOri = Iif(lnCont=1, ContaTran, lcCAC)
				lcGDes = Iif(lnCont=1, lcCAG, GrupoTran)
				lcCDes = Iif(lnCont=1, lcCAC, ContaTran)
			EndIf
			lcodc     = Iif(lnCont=1,xOper,xsope)
			lcSdc     = Iif(lnCont=1,xsope,xoper)
			_VOper 	  = TprMvCab.Emps + Iif(llVOper, [], _TIPOE) + Alltrim(Str(_Noper, 9))
			_cIdChave = Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas) + Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas)), [@L 999999]) + ThisForm.Sigkey

			lcRCl = []
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [crTmpCli], [Iclis], lcCOri, [Rclis])
				lcRCl = crTmpCli.RClis
				Use In crTmpCli
			EndIf
			
			Select TprMvCab
			_Hist  = ThisForm.MontaHists(TprMvCab.Notas, [], lcRCl)
			_Hist2 = Alltrim(crSigCdOpe.Hist2s)
			
			lnVal  = Iif(_ArqCtas=[crSigCdCmm], &_ArqCtas..Comissaos, &_ArqCtas..Valos)
			lcMoe  = Iif(_ArqCtas=[crSigCdCmm], &_ArqCtas..Moedas, &_ArqCtas..MoeFpgs)
			
			Insert Into &_ArqMccr (NOpers, VOpers, Emps, Datas, UsuAlts, DatAlts, Vencs, Hists, Opers, SOpers, Moedas, ;
								   Cotacaos, Valors, Autos, Grupos, Contas, ContEms, GrupEms, SGrupos, SContas, SMoedas, ;
								   SCotacaos, SValors, Dopes, Numes, ValPags, ValLiqs, DtEmis, Hist2s, cIdChaves, Tipos, Jobs) ;
						   Values (_NOper, _VOper, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Datas, Usuar, Datetime(), TprMvCab.Datas, ;
						   		   _Hist, lcOdc, lcSdc, lcMoe, 1, lnVal, .t., lcGOri, lcCOri, lcGOri, ;
						   		   lcCOri, lcGDes, lcCDes, lcMoe, 1, lnVal, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
						   		   lnVal, lnVal, TprMvCab.DtEmis, _Hist2, _cIdChave, [P], TprMvCab.Jobs)

			Select (_ArqMccr)
			Replace GruConMoes With Grupos + Contas + Moedas, ;
					EmpDopNcs  With Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs,6), ;
					EmpDopNums With Emps + Dopes + Str(Numes,6), ;
					Pagos      With Iif(Valors = ValPags, [0], [1]), ;
					DopoTps    With Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos
					
			If (_ArqMccr = [cqSigMvCcr])
				=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
			EndIf
		Next
	EndIf
EndScan

Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE contacorrenteop
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE contacorrenteop
LParameters llvoper

Local ldDtContab, lcRclis, lcGrupoCob, lcContaCob, _pData, lnCont, _lcOcorSv, _lcNota

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde...'
Else
	Wait Window 'Aguarde. Processando Lancamentos de Conta Corrente!!! ' Nowait
EndIf

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
lcRclis = ''
lnCont  = 0
lnRetVOper = 0

If crSigCdOpe.DtContab=2 && Contabilizar na Data de Vencimento
	ldDtContab = xPar.Vencs
Else && Contabilizar na Data de Lançamento
	ldDtContab = xPar.Datas
EndIf
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
_doc = Transf( crSigCdOpe.NDopes,"@L 999" ) + Transf( TprMvCab.Numes, "@L 999999" )

lcTitBan      = Iif(crSigOpFp.Infos = 'B' And crSigOpFp.ImpBols = 1,xPar.nCarnes,'')
_Departamento = Space(10)
_Titulo       = ThisForm.NumeraTitulo &&TprMvCab.Notas && Richard em 11/12/2012
_lcNota       = Iif(crSigOpFp.OpcSNAs = 2,[ ],TprMvCab.Notas)

lcEspecie = crSigOpFp.Especies
lcEmpccs  = TprMvCab.Empds

If crSigOpFp.OpcSNAs = 1 And Empty(TprMvCab.Notas)
	MessageBox('Obrigatorio o Preenchimento do Campo Notas para a Condição de Pagamento '+crSigOpFp.Fpags,0+16,'')
	If llvOper
		Return -1
	Else
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

*** Movimentação x Cliente
If !IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Grupos + crSigCdOpe.Contas )

	If crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 1
		_GrupoOrig = crSigCdOpe.Grupos
		_ContaOrig = crSigCdOpe.Contas
	Else
		If crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1
			_GrupoOrig = TprMvCab.Grupoos
			_ContaOrig = TprMvCab.Contaos
		Else
			_GrupoOrig = TprMvCab.Grupods
			_ContaOrig = TprMvCab.Contads
		EndIf
		
		If (crSigOpCdd.LanFinMats = 2) And !Empty(_ContaOrig) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [grupomats, contamats])
			If !Empty( crtmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !Empty( CrTmpCli.ContaMats )
				_GrupoOrig = CrTmpCli.GrupoMats
				_ContaOrig = CrTmpCli.ContaMats
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1
		_GrupoDest = TprMvCab.Grupods
		_ContaDest = TprMvCab.Contads
	Else
		_GrupoDest = TprMvCab.Grupoos
		_ContaDest = TprMvCab.Contaos
	EndIf
	
	If (crSigOpCdd.LanFinMats = 2) And !Empty(_ContaDest) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaDest,[grupomats, contamats])
		If !Empty( crtmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !Empty( CrtmpCli.ContaMats )
			_GrupoDest = crtmpCli.GrupoMats
			_ContaDest = crtmpCli.ContaMats
		EndIf
	EndIf

	lcRclis = ''
	If Not IsEmpty(_ContaDest) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaDest, [Rclis])
		lcRclis = crtmpCli.Rclis
	EndIf
	
	_Departamento = Space(10)

	If !IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Dopcs ) And crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1
		_numc = fGerUniqueKey( crSigCdOpe.Dopcs )
		_dopc = crSigCdOpe.Dopcs
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdUsu','CrUsu','Usuarios',Usuar,[Deptos])
		_Departamento = CrUsu.Deptos

		If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.Obses)
			Insert Into crSigTtCcd (EmpdopNums, EmpDopNcs, CidChaves, ObsD ) Values ;
						(TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
						 TprMvCab.Emps + _Dopc + Str(_Numc,6), fUniqueIds(), TprMvCab.Obses )
		EndIf

	Else
		_numc = 0 
		_dopc = '' 
	EndIf

	Select TprMvCab
	_Hist = ThisForm.MontaHists(_Titulo, crSigOpFp.FPags, lcRClis)

	_noper = fGerUniqueKey( 'SigMvCcr' )
	If llVOper
		_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
		lnRetVOper = _noper
	Else
		_voper = TprMvCab.Emps + _TIPOE + Alltrim( str( _noper, 9 ) )
		lnRetVOper = 0
	EndIf

	lnValor = Abs( xpar.Valos )
	If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
		xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
		xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')
	Else
		xoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'C','D')
		xsoper = iif(crSigCdOpe.copers=1,'D','C')
	EndIf
	
	lcGrupoCob = ''
	lcContaCob = ''
	If Not IsEmpty(_ContaOrig) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrtmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [Grupocobs, contacobs, Rclis ])
		lcGrupoCob = crtmpCli.GrupoCobs
		lcContaCob = crtmpCli.ContaCobs
	EndIf

	_GrupoTx = crSigOpFp.GrupoDs
	_ContaTx = crSigOpFp.ContaDs

	_Hist2 = Alltrim( crSigCdOpe.Hist2s )
	DO Case
		Case crSigCdOpe.tpHist2s = 1

	If _numc > 0

			_ArqMccr = 'crSigMvCpv'

		Else

				If Not Empty(cServEest.cOcorCslls) And ( xPar.vCsll + Iif(xPar.vCsll=0 And ThisForm.ContaPar=1,crSigMvNfi.vCsll,0)) > 0

				If ThisForm.ContaPar = 1

						lnvTx = lnvTx + crSigMvNfi.vTotIss
					EndIf
				EndIf

				lnValor = lnValor + Abs(lnvTx)

			ContaTran = crSigCdPam.ContaPags
		Else

			ContaTran = crSigCdPam.ContaRecs

			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [R]) && Conta Corrente
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas
				_Hist2 = lcRclis
						
			Case (crSigOpFp.Infos = [T]) && Cartão
				_Hist = TprMvCab.Notas + [ - ] + Alltrim(xPar.Outros) + [ - (] + Alltrim(Str(xPar.Parcs, 2)) + [/] + ;

	_Hist = Alltrim(_Hist) + Iif(Not IsEmpty(),[ -],[]) + [ Taxa : ] + Alltrim(crSigOpFp.Descrs)

		Replace gruconmoes with grupos + contas + moedas,;
				EmpDopncs  With Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs,6),;
				Pagos      With Iif(Valors=valpags,'0','1'),;
				DopoTps    with Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos
				
		If _ArqMccr = 'cqSigMvCcr'
			If _Numc > 0
				Replace bGrupos With TprMvCab.UsuPagos in cqSigMvCcr
			EndIf
			=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )
		EndIf
	Next

	Replace VPags    With lnvTx,;
			ValoCurs With lnvTx,;
			Pagos    With Iif(Valos = Vpags, '0', '1') in crSigMvPar
EndIf

If llvOper 
	Return lnRetVOper
Else
	Return .t.
EndIf

*************** fim ******************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE cotacao
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE cotacao
LParameters _xMoeda, _xData
Local _xCotacao, lcAlias

lcAlias   = Alias()
_xCotacao = 1
_xData    = Iif(Type('_xData') = 'D', _xData, TprMvCab.Datas)

If Not IsEmpty( _xMoeda ) 
	lcSql = [Select Cotas From SigCdMoe where Cmoes = ']+_xMoeda+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcsql,'LocalMoe') < 1
		MessageBox([Favor reiniciar o Processo.],0+16,[Falha de conexão (LocalMoe)])
		Return .F.
	EndIf 
	If LocalMoe.Cotas
		If !Seek( _xMoeda, "TmpCot" )
			_xCotacao = fBuscarCotacao(_xMoeda,_xData,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
			Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( _xMoeda, _xCotacao )
		Else
			If TmpCot.Valos = 0
				_xCotacao = fBuscarCotacao(_xMoeda,_xData,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
				Replace Valos With _xCotacao In TmpCot
			EndIf
			_xCotacao = TmpCot.Valos
		Endif

		*** Tiago - 08/09/2015 - Alterado para gravar a cotação na tabela SIGMVMOV pois no SIGMVITN já está gravado convertido e perde a cotação caso tenha sido alterado
		Select TmpTotal
		Set Order To tag Moeds		
		If !Seek(_xMoeda)
			Insert Into TmpTotal (Moeds) Values (_xMoeda)
		Endif
		Replace MoeVals With _xCotacao In TmpTotal		
	Else
		_xCotacao = 1
	EndIf
EndIf

If Not IsEmpty(lcAlias)
	Select (lcAlias)
EndIf

Return _xCotacao

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE criabaixa
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE criabaixa
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
_CarregaItens = Inlist( crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,1,3,4,5,8,10) And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'

If !_CarregaItens

	Select TmpOperacao
	Scan
		nDope = Int(Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 4)))
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','ndopes',nDope,[Dopes])
		Dope  = crTmpOpe.Dopes
		Nume  = Int(Val(Right(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 6)))
		
		lcBusca = TprMvCab.Emps + Dope + Str( Nume, 6 )
		lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrEesti')
		If lnErro < 0 
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrEesti)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
			
		lcWhere = [Select * from SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrEsti2')
		If lnErro < 0 
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrEsti2)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf

		Select CrEesti
		Scan
			Scatter Memvar Memo
			Select xBaixa
			Set Order to Cpros
			If !Seek( crEesti.Cpros )
				Insert Into xBaixa ( Cpros ) Values ( CrEesti.Cpros )
			EndIf
			Replace xBaixa.Qtds     With xBaixa.Qtds + crEesti.Qtds,;
					xBaixa.QtBaixas With xBaixa.QtBaixas + crEesti.QtBaixas,;
					xBaixa.QtProds  With xBaixa.QtProds  + crEesti.QtProds
			Select xBaixaEtq
			Set Order to Cbars
			If !Seek( crEesti.CodBarras )
				Insert Into xBaixaEtq ( CodBarras, UniVals ) Values ( crEesti.CodBarras, crEesti.UniVals )
			EndIf
			Replace xBaixaEtq.Qtds     With xBaixaEtq.Qtds + crEesti.Qtds,;
					xBaixaEtq.QtBaixas with xBaixaEtq.QtBaixas + crEesti.QtBaixas
		EndScan
		Select crEsti2
		Scan
			Select xBaixa2
			Set Order to Cpros
			If !Seek( crEsti2.Cpros + crEsti2.CodCors + crEsti2.CodTams )
				Insert Into xBaixa2 ( Cpros, CodCors, CodTams ) Values ;
						( crEesti.Cpros, crEsti2.CodCors, crEsti2.CodTams )
			EndIf
			Replace xBaixa2.Qtds     With xBaixa2.Qtds + crEsti2.Qtds,;
					xBaixa2.QtBaixas With xBaixa2.QtBaixas + crEsti2.QtBaixas,;
					xBaixa2.QtProds  With xBaixa2.QtProds  + crEsti2.QtProds
		EndScan
	EndScan
EndIf
Return
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE criaregistro
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE criaregistro
Lparameters pItem

Local loProduto,lnItem,lnQtd,lOldCodPro,lnItOld 

If crSigCdOpe.CadProds <> 3
	Return 0
EndIf

lnItem = pItem
oper   = crSigCdOpe.Opers
OpePad = crSigCdOpe.OpePads
lnQtd  = crTpmMvItn.Qtds
lOldCodPro = crTpmMvItn.Cpros
lnItOld = crTpmMvItn.cItens

lcSql = [Select Cpros, cproeqs From SigCdPro where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcsql,'CrTmpPro') > 0
	If Empty(CrTmpPro.cproeqs)
		DO Form SigOpRef With CrTmpPro.cpros,crSigCdOpe.ItSituas,.t. name loProduto linked noshow
		lcCodProduto = Left(loProduto.Retcodproduto,10)
		loProduto = Null
		If Not Empty(lcCodProduto) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigCdPro','Cpros',lcCodProduto)
			cPro = lcCodProduto
			Replace crTpmMvItn.cpros With lcCodProduto ,;
					crTpmMvItn.Qtds  With Iif(crTpmMvItn.Qtds < 1,crTpmMvItn.Qtds,1) in crTpmMvItn

			Select * From crTpmMvIts Where 0=1 Into cursor TprMvCabi2 ReadWrite
				
			lnQtd  = lnQtd - crTpmMvItn.Qtds

			Select crTpmMvIts
			Set Order To
			Set Order To cItens
			=Seek(lnItOld )
			If Not Eof()
				_FirstReg = .t.
				Scan While cItens = lnItOld 
					lnQtdI = Int(Qtds)
					lnDif  = Qtds - Int(Qtds)
					For lnCont = 1 to LnQtdI + 1
						If lnCont > lnQtdI And lnDif = 0
							Exit
						EndIf
						If Not _FirstReg
							DO Form SigOpRef With CrTmpPro.cpros,crSigCdOpe.ItSituas,.t. name loProduto linked noshow
							lcCodProduto = Left(loProduto.Retcodproduto,14)
							loProduto = Null
							If Not Empty(lcCodProduto) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigCdPro','Cpros',lcCodProduto)
								Select crTpmMvItn
								Scatter Memvar Memo
								lnItem = lnItem + 1
								m.cItens = lnItem
								m.Qtds   = Iif(lnCont > lnQtdI,lnDif,1)
								m.cpros  = lcCodProduto
								Append Blank
								Gather Memvar Memo
							EndIf
						EndIf
						Select crTpmMvIts
						Scatter Memvar Memo
						m.cItens = lnItem
						m.Qtds   = Iif(lnCont > lnQtdI,lnDif,1)
						m.cpros  = lcCodProduto
						Select TprMvCabi2
						Append Blank
						Gather Memvar Memo
						_FirstReg = .f.
					Next
				EndScan
				Select crTpmMvIts
				Delete For cItens = pItem
				Append From Dbf('TprMvCabi2')
			Else
				If lnQtd > 1
					lnDif  = crTpmMvItn.Qtds - Int(crTpmMvItn.Qtds)
					For lnQtdI = 1 to lnQtd + 1
						If lnQtdI > lnQtd And lnDif = 0
							Exit
						EndIf
						DO Form SigOpRef With CrTmpPro.cpros,crSigCdOpe.ItSituas,.t. name loProduto linked noshow
						lcCodProduto = Left(loProduto.Retcodproduto,10)
						loProduto = Null
						If Not Empty(lcCodProduto) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigCdPro','Cpros',lcCodProduto)
							Select crTpmMvItn
							Scatter Memvar Memo
							lnItem = lnItem + 1
							m.cItens = lnItem
							m.Qtds   = Iif(lnQtdI > lnQtd,lnDif,1)
							m.Cpros  = lcCodProduto
							Append Blank
							Gather Memvar Memo
						EndIf
					Next
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf
Return (lnItem - pItem)

ENDPROC

lcSql = [Select estas, Cfos, transps, tpclis, rgs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+_Iclis+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCli')

lcEstadoNF = crtmpCli.Estas
lcCfis = crSigMvNfi.Cfis

lcSql = [Select * From SigCdUfs Where Estados = ']+Iif(Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Estas),CrTmpCli.Estas,lcEmpEmi)+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpUf')

Select crSigMvNfi
Go Top
If Reccount() = 0
	lcSerie = crSigCdOpe.Series 
	lcNota = ''
	lnNota = 0
	lcSql = [Select * From SigCdSer Where EmpCods = ']+lcEmpEmi + lcSerie+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpSerie')
	If Eof('crTmpSerie')
		lcSql = [Select * From SigCdSer Where EmpCods = ']+Space(3) + lcSerie+[']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpSerie')
	EndIf
	If Not Eof('crTmpSerie')
		Do Case
		    Case (crSigCdOpe.Tiponfs = 1) Or ((crSigCdOpe.Tiponfs = 4) And (crTmpSerie.Tiponfs = 1))
				lnNota = fGerUniqueKey( lcEmpEmi + 'NOTA FISCAL' + lcSerie )
				lcNota = Transf( lnNota, "@L 999999" )

		    Case (crSigCdOpe.Tiponfs = 3) Or ((crSigCdOpe.Tiponfs = 4) And (crTmpSerie.Tiponfs = 3))
				lnNota = 0
				IF crSigCdOpe.MarcaSubns = 1
					lnNota = TprMvCab.Numes
				EndIf
				lcNota = Transf( lnNota, "@L 999999" )

		    Case (crTmpSerie.Tiponfs = 4)
				lnNota = TprMvCab.Numes
				lcNota = Transf( lnNota, "@L 999999" )

		EndCase
	EndIf
	
	lcQuery = [Select Series, NldSer, MarPads, EspPads, Piss, FatBrutos, PesoVols ] + ;
	  			[From SigCnFnf ] + ;
	  		   [Where Emps = '] + lcEmpEmi + [' And ] + ;
	  		   		 [Series = '] + lcSerie + [']

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigCnFnf') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigCnFnf 1)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Select crSigCnFnf
	Go Top
	If Eof()
		lcQuery = [Select Series, NldSer, MarPads, EspPads, Piss, FatBrutos, PesoVols ] + ;
		  			[From SigCnFnf ] + ;
		  		   [Where Emps = '] + Space(3) + [' And ] + ;
		  		   		 [Series = '] + lcSerie + [']

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigCnFnf') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigCnFnf 2)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Select crSigCnFnf
		Go Top
	EndIf
	
	lcSerRps = ''
	lcTipRps = ''
	lnNumRps = 0
	If Not Empty(Right(crSigOpCdd.Rpss,5))
		lcSerRps = Right(crSigOpCdd.Rpss,5)
		lcTipRps = Left(crSigOpCdd.Rpss,5)
		lnNumRps = fGerUniqueKey(TprMvCab.Emps+lcSerRps)
	EndIf
	
	*** mena - 22/05/2015 - foi setado qtde de volumes inicial = 0 - solicitação da NAS ***
	Insert Into crSigMvNfi (Emps, Dopes, Numes, NFis, Emis, Series, VlFretes, VlSeguros, DespAces, Qtdes, ;
						   CidChaves, EmpDopNums, DtSaidas, CodTrans, Fretes, TipoRps, SerieRps, NumRps) ;
				   Values (TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.dopes, TprMvCab.numes, lcNota, ;
				   		   Iif(IsEmpty(TprMvCab.DtEmis),TprMvCab.datas,TprMvCab.DtEmis), lcSerie, 0,;
					 	   0, 0, 0, fUniqueIds(), TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
					 	   TprMvCab.DtEmis, TprMvCab.CodTrans, Iif(InList(crSigOpCdc.FreteDefs,0,3),1,;
					 	   crSigOpCdc.FreteDefs),lcTipRps,lcSerRps,lnNumRps )

	If crSigCdOpe.DigDoc <> 4 And crSigCdOpe.CupFis <> 3 And InList(crSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
		Replace TprMvCab.Notas with crSigMvNfi.NFis IN TprMvCab
	EndIf

EndIf

If Empty(crSigMvNfi.Cfis) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaOs) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs)

	Do Case
		Case Empty(crSigCdOpe.Cfos) Or Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Cfos)
			lcCfis = crTmpCli.CFos
						
		Case !Empty(crSigCdOpe.Cfos) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','crTmpCfo','Codigos',crSigCdOpe.Cfos)
			lcSerie = crSigCdOpe.Series
			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','CrTmpSerie','EmpCods',lcEmpEmi + crSigCdOpe.Series) Or ;
				ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','CrTmpSerie','EmpCods',Space(3) + crSigCdOpe.Series) )
			EndIf
			lcCfo = crTmpCfo.Codigos
			If (CrTmpCli.Estas # crSigCdEmp.Estas and !INLIST(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6)) && mena 22/06/2015 incluiida checagem de NFCe e SAT para não mudar cfop &&And (Not InList(crTmpSerie.TpServicos,1,3))
				lnCfo = Val(Left(crTmpCfo.Codigos,1)) 
				lcCfo = Str(lnCfo+1,1) + Substr(crTmpCfo.Codigos,2,Len(CrTmpCfo.Codigos)-1)
				If( crTmpCli.Estas = [EX] )
					lnCfoEX = Val(Left(lcCfo,1)) 
					lcCfo = Str(lnCfoEX+1,1) + Substr(lcCfo,2,Len(lcCfo)-1)
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If Not Empty(TprMvCab.IDEntrega)
				If (lcChaveUf2 # crSigCdEmp.Estas and !INLIST(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6)) && mena 22/06/2015 incluiida checagem de NFCe e SAT para não mudar cfop &&And (Not InList(crTmpSerie.TpServicos,1,3))
					lcCfo = crTmpCfo.Codigos
					lnCfo = Val(Left(crTmpCfo.Codigos,1)) 
					lcCfo = Str(lnCfo+1,1) + Substr(crTmpCfo.Codigos,2,Len(CrTmpCfo.Codigos)-1)
					If( crTmpCli.Estas = [EX] )
						lnCfoEX = Val(Left(lcCfo,1)) 
						lcCfo = Str(lnCfoEX+1,1) + Substr(lcCfo,2,Len(lcCfo)-1)
					EndIf
				Else
					llAtuCfis = .F.
					lcCfo = crTmpCfo.Codigos
				EndIf
			EndIf 
			
			*-- Rafael 29/06/2023 - Removido por solicitação do Support Request 13524: Alteração do indicador de presença
			*!**-- Rafael - 28/10/2021 - Quando for Venda Presencial pegar o CFOP default da movimentação
			If Type([crSigOpCdi.ckVendaFis])=[N] And crSigOpCdi.ckVendaFis = 1 And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.CFos)
				lcCfo = crSigCdOpe.CFos
			EndIf 

			lcCfis = lcCfo
		OtherWise
			lcCfis = crTmpCli.CFos
	EndCase
	Select crSigMvNfi
	If Empty(crSigMvNfi.CodTrans)
		Replace	crSigMvNfi.CodTrans With crTmpCli.Transps
	EndIf
	Replace crSigMvNfi.Cfis     With lcCfis
	
	If llAtuCfis
		* Verificação de Emissão de Nota Com CFO Interestadual de Não Contribuintes
		If (crTmpCli.Estas <> crSigCdEmp.Estas) And (crTmpCli.TpClis = 1) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs)
			Replace Cfis With crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs In crSigMvNfi
			* Se cliente = EX seta nova cfop
			If( crTmpCli.Estas = [EX] )
				Replace Cfis With Str(Val(Left(crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs,1))+1,1)+Substr(crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs,2)
			EndIf
		EndIf
		
		If Not Empty(TprMvCab.IDEntrega)
			If (lcChaveUf2 <> crSigCdEmp.Estas) And (crTmpCli.TpClis = 1) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs)
				Replace Cfis With crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs In crSigMvNfi
				* Se cliente = EX seta nova cfop
				If( crTmpCli.Estas = [EX] )
					Replace Cfis With Str(Val(Left(crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs,1))+1,1)+Substr(crSigOpCdc.CfoIncs,2)
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf 
	EndIf 
	
	*** Mena 23/12/2016 seta CFNC se necessário ***
	If crTmpCli.TpClis = 1
		Replace especienfs With 'CFNC' In crSigMvNfi
	EndIf

	** Checa se CFOP existe
	If not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCfo],[crChkCfo],[Codigos],crSigMvNfi.Cfis,[Situas])
		If Eof([crChkCfo])
			MessageBox([Cfop ] + lcCfis + [ não está cadastrado no sistema, impossível continuar!],16,[Atenção])		
			Return 0
		EndIf
		If crChkCfo.Situas <> 1
			MessageBox([Cfop ] + lcCfis + [ não está ativo, impossível continuar!],16,[Atenção])
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf		
	**	

	** Checagem da lista de CFOP's permitidos
	If( crSigOpCdd.ChkCFOP <> 2 )
		lcQuery = [Select Dopes from SigCdOop where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SQLExecute(lcQuery,[crTmpCfoOp])
		If not Eof([crTmpCfoOp])
			Use in crTmpCfoOp
			lcQuery = [Select Dopes from SigCdOop where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' and Cfops = ']+crSigMvNfi.Cfis+[']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.SQLExecute(lcQuery,[crTmpCfoOp])
			If Eof([crTmpCfoOp])
				MessageBox('O CFOP selecionado não está na lista de CFOPs permitidos para esta Movimentação!',16,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Used([crTmpCfoOp])
			Use in crTmpCfoOp
		EndIf			
	EndIf	
EndIf
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE cupomfiscal
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE cupomfiscal
Local ImpVen,ImpFin,Final,Primeira,LnSoma,lnTributo, ldAgora, lLoopStatus, llOk, _SanSupr, _VerSubTot

oFormulario = This.oModemEest
lnSoma = 0
ImpVen = .T.
ImpFin = .T.
RetImpcVinc = .T.
Select crSigFiFis
Goto Top
lcCliente = (TprMvCab.Contads)

fBlockInput(.T.)			&& trava teclado

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdEmp','CrSigCdEmp','Cemps',TprMvCab.Emps,[Estas,Cgcs,Ies,textopaf,mostraim,mostrapara,aliqia])	&& homologacao paf - 09/2012
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpdopNums',TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6),[EmpDopNums,ValVars,Valos,Obses,lCancelas,CidChaves])
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigMvItn','CrEesti','EmpdopNums',TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6),[Cpros,CodBarras,ValDescs,Units,Dpros,Qtds,CidChaves])
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',lcCliente,[Cpfs,Rclis,paises,Endes,Nums,cidas,Estas,Rgs])

lcSql = [Select a.Fpags, a.Nopers, a.Valos, a.Cotfpgs, a.parcs, a.cnidtefs, b.nfPags From SigMvPar a, SigOpFp b Where a.EmpDopNums = ']+;
		TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+[' And a.Fpags = b.Fpags ]

llOk = .t.
DO While llOk
	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrPar')
	llOk = ( lnErro < 1 )
Enddo

lnOrdem = 0
lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNtb Where Imps=']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Ordems = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.TrNfis,2)
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql,'CrSigFiNtb') > 0
	lnOrdem = crSigFiNtb.OperNF
EndIf

ThisForm.Cnfliquido = .f.

If crEest.ValVars>0 And .f.
	MessageBox('Impossível Emissão do Cupom Fiscal de Venda com Acréscimo !!!'+chr(13)+'Obrigatório Cancelamento da Venda !!',0+16,'')
Else
	If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 And !ThisForm.ImpNFiscal  And crSigCdOpe.ItAutos # 8 And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
		RetCupomN = ThisForm.CupomNFiscal()
		If !RetCupomN
			ImpVen = .F.
			ThisForm.SubNivelFiscal = .F.
			ThisForm.ItemNIcm = .f.
			ThisForm.ImpNFiscal = .f.
			MessageBox('Erro na Impressão do Cupom Não Fiscal !!',0+48,'ERRO')
			If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA')
				RetImp = ThisForm.FecharCupom(oFormulario,crSigFiFis.Imps)
			EndIf
			If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'ELGIN'
				RetImp = ThisForm.FecharCupom(oFormulario,crSigFiFis.Imps)
			EndIf
		Else
			ThisForm.SubNivelFiscal = .F.
		EndIf
	EndIf

	_VerSubTot = .f.

	If ThisForm.SubNivelFiscal Or crSigCdOpe.ItAutos = 8
		If Not InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS') And Not ThisForm.AbriuCupom
			lnOrdem = 0
			lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNtb Where Imps=']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Ordems = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.TrNfis,2)
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql,'CrSigFiNtb') > 0
				lnOrdem = crSigFiNtb.OperNF
			EndIf
			oFormulario = ThisForm.oModemEest
			
			llOk = .t.
			DO While llOk
				Select crSigFiFis
				Goto top
				Do Case
					Case InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON')
						If crSigCdOpe.CupFis=1
							ThisForm.AbriuCupom = ThisForm.AbreCupom(oFormulario)
						Else
							ThisForm.AbriuCupom = .t.
						EndIf
					Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA')
						Do Case
							Case crSigCdOpe.CupFis=1
								ThisForm.AbriuCupom =ThisForm.AbreCupom(oFormulario)
							Case crSigCdOpe.CupFis=3
								ThisForm.AbriuCupom =AbrirCupomNF(oFormulario,lnOrdem)
							OtherWise
								Messagebox('Movimentação não é Cupom Fiscal !!',0+48,'')
						EndCase
				EndCase
				If ThisForm.AbriuCupom Or Messagebox('Erro na Abertura do Cupom Fiscal, Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'') = 7
					llOk = .f.
				EndIf
			EndDo

			ok = .F.

			If ThisForm.AbriuCupom
				If Not ThisForm.GerarCupom()
					Return .f.
				Endif
				_VerSubTot = .t.
				lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set Notas = ']+TprMvCab.Notas+[', nCupoms = ']+TprMvCab.nCupoms+[', ]+;
						   [CcfGnfs = ']+TprMvCab.CcfGnfs+[' Where CidChaves = ']+TprMvCab.CidChaves+[']
				=ThisForm.PodataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
				=ThisForm.Podatamgr2.commit()				
			Else
				mObse = Nvl(TprMvCab.obses,'') + chr(13)+'Erro na Abertura do Cupom Fiscal'
				lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set Obses = ?mObse Where empDopNums = ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Go Top
		Do While !eof() And ImpVen
			If crTpmMvItn.ImpCupFis Or Empty(Cpros)
				Skip
				Loop
			EndIf
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',crTpmMvItn.cpros,[Cpros,Cbars,Icms,Cgrus,TpTribs,cunis,cproeqs,SitTrIcms,sgrus,mercs,DescFis,CodFinP,DescEcfs,IdPro,ClFiscals,origmercs ])
			Select CrTmpPro
			Go Top In CrTmpPro
			If Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms)
				Replace SitTrIcms With [00] In CrTmpPro
			EndIf
			If Empty(CrTmpPro.OrigMercs)
				Replace OrigMercs With [0] In CrTmpPro
			EndIf
			If Empty(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals)
				Replace ClFiscals With [0] In CrTmpPro
			EndIf
			ThisForm.VerIcms()
			If !ThisForm.lOkIcms
				MessageBox('Tributação Icms Inválida !!',0+48,'ERRO')
				ImpVen=.f.
			EndIf
			lcupdate = [Update SigMvItn Set AliqIcms = ]+Str(crTpmMvItn.AliqIcms,5,2)+[, Tipos = ']+crTpmMvItn.Tipos+[' Where CidChaves = ']+crTpmMvItn.CidChaves+[']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If ImpVen
				CodBarra = Iif(empty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras),CrTmpPro.Cbars,crTpmMvItn.CodBarras)
				lcDescr  = fLimpaTexto(crTpmMvItn.Dpros)

*!*	Mena - retirado - 14/05/2018	******************************************************************
*!*					**** Mena - 04/06/2013 - inclui o valor do imposto aproximado ****
*!*					*** Mena 02/02/2015 - retirado e substituido pelo trecho abaixo **
*!*	*!*					IF INLIST(crSigcdemp.mostraim, 2,4)	&& ecf ou ambos
*!*	*!*						IF USED('IBPTAX')
*!*	*!*							SELECT ibptax
*!*	*!*							LOCATE for c1 =  crTmpPro.ClFiscals 
*!*	*!*							*** verifica qual a Origem da mercadoria para aplicar a aliquota correspondente da tabela IBPT ***
*!*	*!*							lnImposA = IIF(FOUND(), IIF(INLIST(ALLTRIM(crTmpPro.origmercs), '0','3','4','5'), VAL(TRANSFORM(c4, '999999.99')), VAL(TRANSFORM(c5, '999999.99'))), 0)
*!*	*!*						ELSE
*!*	*!*							lnImposA = CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA
*!*	*!*						ENDIF
*!*	*!*						thisform.impostoa = thisform.impostoa + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposA/100, 2)
*!*	*!*					ENDIF
*!*					******************************************************************
*!*					**** Mena - 02/02/2015 - inclui o valor do imposto aproximado utilizando novas tabelas com aliquota Federal/Estadual/Municipal****
*!*					lcIBPT = goSistema.DirFiscais + 'IBPT\versao'+'.txt'
*!*					IF FILE(lcIBPT)
*!*						lcVTX = FILETOSTR(lcIBPT)
*!*					ELSE
*!*						lcVTX = '15.1'
*!*					ENDIF

*!*					lcIBPT = goSistema.DirFiscais + 'IBPT\TabelaIBPTax'+CrSigCdEmp.estas+lcVTX+'.XLS'
*!*					lcIBPTdbf = 'TabelaIBPTax'+CrSigCdEmp.estas+lcVTX
*!*					IF FILE(lcIBPT) AND !USED('IBPTAX')
*!*						SELECT 0
*!*						IMPORT FROM &lcIBPT TYPE XL5
*!*						USE
*!*						SELECT 0
*!*						use (lcIBPTdbf) alias IBPTAX
*!*					ENDIF

*!*					IF INLIST(crSigcdemp.mostraim, 2,4)	&& ecf ou ambos
*!*						IF USED('IBPTAX')	&& se este arquivo existe foi criado o DBF correspondente na no diretorio atual
*!*							SELECT IBPTAX
*!*							LOCATE for ALLTRIM(A) =  ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals) 
*!*							lnImposF = IIF(FOUND(), IIF(INLIST(ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.origmercs), '0','3','4','5'), VAL(TRANSFORM(E, '999999.99')), VAL(TRANSFORM(F, '999999.99'))), 0)
*!*							lnImposE = VAL(TRANSFORM(G, '999999.99'))
*!*							lnImposM = VAL(TRANSFORM(H, '999999.99'))
*!*						ELSE
*!*							lnImposF = CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA
*!*							lnImposE = 0.00
*!*							lnImposM = 0.00
*!*						ENDIF
*!*						thisform.impostoF = thisform.impostoF + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposF/100, 2)
*!*						thisform.impostoE = thisform.impostoE + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposE/100, 2)
*!*						thisform.impostoM = thisform.impostoM + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposM/100, 2)
*!*					ENDIF
*!*					******************************************************************

			*** Mena - 14/05/2018 - pega imposto transparente do banco de dados *** 
				IF INLIST(crSigcdemp.mostraim, 2,4)	&& ecf ou ambos
					IF CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA =0
						lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdIbp Where ufs = ']+CrSigCdEmp.estas+[' and codigo = ']+ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals)+[' order by datini desc]
						If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalIbp]) < 1)
							=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalIbp)])
							Return 0
						ENDIF
						SELECT LocalIbp
						GO top
						lnImposF = IIF(INLIST(ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.origmercs), '0','3','4','5'), NVL(LocalIbp.nacfederal,0), NVL(LocalIbp.impfederal,0))
						lnImposE = NVL(LocalIbp.estadual,0)
						lnImposM = NVL(LocalIbp.municipal,0)
					ELSE
						lnImposF = CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA
						lnImposE = 0.00
						lnImposM = 0.00
					ENDIF
					thisform.impostoF = thisform.impostoF + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposF/100, 2)
					thisform.impostoE = thisform.impostoE + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposE/100, 2)
					thisform.impostoM = thisform.impostoM + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposM/100, 2)
				ENDIF
				******************************************************************

						lcTipo = 'NCN'
						RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
									val(crSigFiTef.cnIdents),crSigFiTef.cNmRedes,crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
									crSigFiTef.cFinalzs,crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs,xPar.Fpags, val(crSigFiTef.cnValors)/100)

						lcSql = [Select CidChaves From SigFiTef Where cnIdents = ']+crSigFiTef.cnIdents+[']
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr4.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
							Select LocSigFiTef
							Scan
								SqlCanTef = [Update SigFiTef Set cStatus = 'CNC' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
								ThisForm.poDataMgr4.SqlExecute(SqlCanTef)
								ThisForm.poDataMgr4.Commit()
							EndScan
						EndIf
						
						ThisForm.DeleteSigTef(xPar.cnidtefs,lcTipo)

						mObse = Nvl(CrEest.obses,'') + chr(13)+'Erro Impressão Finalizadoras - Varios Tefs '

						If !RetNImp
							MessageBox('Problemas Comunicação com Tef !!',0+48,'')
							mObse = Nvl(CrEest.obses,'') + chr(13)+'Problema Tef - Não enviou NCN'
						EndIf

						lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set Obses = ?mObse Where empDopNums = ']+CrEest.EmpDopNums+[']
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')

					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
			Select crPar
		EndScan
		Wait Clear
		Select crSigFiFis
		Goto Top
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA')
			RetImp = ThisForm.FecharCupom(oFormulario, crSigFiFis.Imps)
		EndIf
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'ELGIN')
			RetImp = ThisForm.FecharCupom(oFormulario, crSigFiFis.Imps)
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If CrEest.lcancelas
	llCanc = !(ImpVen And ImpFin And RetImpcVinc)
	_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
	llDtAlt = _pData
	lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set lCancelas = ?llCanc, DtAlts = ?llDtAlt, DataTrans = Null Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrEest.EmpDopNums+[']
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where empDopNums = ']+CrEest.EmpDopNums+[']
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
EndIf

CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado

=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.Commit()

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE cupomnfiscal
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE cupomnfiscal
Local lnCodigo,lcDescr,lnOrdem,lnQtd,lnUnit, lnItems, lnValDesc

oFormulario = This.oModemEest

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

ThisForm.ItemNIcm = .t.
ThisForm.ImpNFiscal = .t.
lnCodigo = TprMvCab.numes
lcDescr  = PadR( AllTrim(TprMvCab.Emps) + ' ' + AllTrim( TprMvCab.Dopes ), 40 )
lcDescr  = Padr(fLimpaTexto(lcDescr),40)

lnOrdem = 0
lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNtb Where Imps=']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Ordems = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.TrNfis,2)
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql,'CrSigFiNtb') > 0
	lnOrdem = crSigFiNtb.OperNF
EndIf

lnQtd    = 1
lnUnit   = TprMvCab.Valos
lnValDesc= TprMvCab.ValVars
ImpVen   = .f.

Go Top in crTpmMvItn
Do Case
	Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','ELGIN')
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','ELGIN')
			lnValDesc = 0
		EndIf

		lnOrdem = 0
		lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNtb Where Imps=']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Ordems = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.TrNfis,2)
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql,'CrSigFiNtb') > 0
			lnOrdem = crSigFiNtb.OperNF
		EndIf
		ImpVen = AbrirCupomNf(oFormulario,lnordem,TprMvCab.Valos)

		If ( crSigCdOpe.OpCrs # 4 Or Eof('crTpmMvItn') ) And ImpVen
			If crSigCdOpe.Opernf = 'S'
				ThisForm.Cnfliquido = .t.
				Select TmpOperacao
				Go Top
				lnQtdItem = 0
				DO while Not Eof()
					If Codigos = 0
						skip
						Loop
					EndIf
					ndope = Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos,10),4))
					nnume = Val(Right(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos,10),6))
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe','ndopes',nDope)
					lnUnit   = TmpOperacao.Valos
					lnCodigo = nnume
					lcDescr  = PadR( AllTrim(TmpOperacao.EmpSubns) + ' ' + AllTrim( TmpOpe.Dopes ), 40 )
					lcDescr  = Padr(fLimpaTexto(lcDescr),40)
					ImpVen   = CompNFiscal( oFormulario, lnOrdem, lnUnit, lcDescr )
					If Not ImpVen
						ImpVen = .t.
						DO While .t.
							llOk = 7
							DO While llOk = 7
								llOk = Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (12), Tentar Novamente ?',4+32+256,'')
							EndDo
							VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,oFormulario)
							If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Not Empty(VerStatus)
								Exit
							EndIf
						Enddo
						Select TmpOperacao
						Loop
					EndIf
					lnQtdItem = lnQtdItem + 1
					Select TmpOperacao
					Skip
				Enddo
			Else
				ImpVen = .f.
				DO While Not ImpVen
					ImpVen = CompNFiscal( oFormulario, lnOrdem, lnUnit - lnValDesc, lcDescr )
					If Not ImpVen
						DO While .t.
							llOk = 7
							DO While llOk = 7
								llOk = Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (13), Tentar Novamente ?',4+32+256,'')
							EndDo
							VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,oFormulario)
							If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Not Empty(VerStatus)
								Exit
							EndIf
						Enddo
						Loop
					EndIf
					Exit
				Enddo
			EndIf
		Else
			ImpVen = .f.
			DO While Not ImpVen
				ImpVen = CompNFiscal( oFormulario, lnOrdem, lnUnit - lnValDesc, lcDescr )
				If Not ImpVen
					DO While .t.
						llOk = 7
						DO While llOk = 7
							llOk = Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (14), Tentar Novamente ?',4+32+256,'')
						EndDo
						VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,oFormulario)
						If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Not Empty(VerStatus)
							Exit
						EndIf
					Enddo
					Loop
				EndIf
				Exit
			Enddo
		EndIf
	Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
		If ( crSigCdOpe.OpCrs # 4 ) Or Eof('crTpmMvItn')
			If crSigCdOpe.Opernf = 'S'
				Select TmpOperacao
				Go Top
				lnQtdItem = 0
				DO While Not Eof()
					If Codigos = 0
						Skip
						Loop
					EndIf
					ndope = Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos,10),4))
					nnume = Val(Right(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos,10),6))
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe','ndopes',nDope)
					lnUnit   = TmpOperacao.Valos
					lnCodigo = nnume
					lcDescr  = PadR( AllTrim(TmpOperacao.EmpSubns) + ' ' + AllTrim( TmpOpe.Dopes ), 40 )
					lcDescr  = Padr(fLimpaTexto(lcDescr),40)
					ImpVen = VenFis(lnCodigo,lcDescr,lnOrdem,lnQtd,lnUnit,0,oFormulario,'')
					If Not ImpVen
						ImpVen = .t.
						DO While .t.
							llOk = 7
							DO While llOk = 7
								llOk = Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (15), Tentar Novamente ?',4+32+256,'')
							EndDo
							VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,oFormulario)
							If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Substr(VerStatus,2,1) = 'S'
								Exit
							EndIf
						Enddo
						_ItemCupFis = VerSubt(oFormulario,.t.)
						Select TmpOperacao
						Loop
					EndIf
					lnQtdItem = lnQtdItem + 1
					Select TmpOperacao
					Skip
				Enddo
			Else
				DO While Not ImpVen
					ImpVen = VenFis(lnCodigo,lcDescr,lnOrdem,lnQtd,lnUnit,0,oFormulario,'')
					If Not ImpVen
						DO While .t.
							llOk = 7
							DO While llOk = 7
								llOk = Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (16), Tentar Novamente ?',4+32+256,'')
							EndDo
							VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,oFormulario)
							If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Substr(VerStatus,2,1) = 'S'
								Exit
							EndIf
						Enddo
						_ItemCupFis = VerSubt(oFormulario,.t.)
						If _ItemcupFis = 0
							Loop
						EndIf
					EndIf
					Exit
				Enddo
			EndIf
		Else
			Select crTpmMvItn &&csTmpcrTpmMvItn
			Go Top
			lnQtdItem = 0
			DO While Not Eof()
				If Qtds<=0 Or Empty(cpros)
					Skip
					Loop
				EndIf
				lnQtd    = crTpmMvItn.Qtds
				lnUnit   = crTpmMvItn.Units
				lcDescr  = AllTrim(TprMvCab.MascNum) + '-' + AllTrim(TprMvCab.Dopes)
				If Not IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.CodBarras )
					lnCodigo = crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
					If Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Notas)
						lcDescr = '' + crTpmMvItn.Notas + ' ' + AllTrim(crTpmMvItn.DPros)
					EndIf
				Else
					lnNotas = Val( crTpmMvItn.Notas )
					If crTpmMvItn.Notas = Transform( lnNotas, '@L 999999' )
						lnCodigo = 0 + lnNotas
						lcDescr  = AllTrim(crTpmMvItn.DPros)
					Else
						lnCodigo = TprMvCab.Numes
					EndIf
				EndIf
				lcDescr  = Padr(fLimpaTexto(lcDescr),40)
				ImpVen = VenFis(lnCodigo,lcDescr,lnOrdem,lnQtd,lnUnit,0,oFormulario,'')
				If Not ImpVen
					ImpVen = .t.
					DO While .t.
						llOk = 7
						DO While llOk = 7
							llOk = Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (17), Tentar Novamente ?',4+32+256,'')
						EndDo
						VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,oFormulario)
						If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Substr(VerStatus,2,1) = 'S'
							Exit
						EndIf
					Enddo
					_ItemCupFis = VerSubt(oFormulario,.t.)
					If _ItemcupFis <> lnQtdItem + 1
						Select crTpmMvItn
						Loop
					EndIf
				EndIf
				lnQtdItem = lnQtdItem + 1
				Select crTpmMvItn
				Skip
			EndDo
		EndIf
		
	Case  crSigFiFis.Imps='BEMATECH'
		ImpVen = .T.

	Case InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMA8501','EPSON')
		lnOrdem = 0
		lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNtb Where Imps=']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Ordems = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.TrNfis,2)
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql,'CrSigFiNtb') > 0
			lnOrdem = crSigFiNtb.OperNF
		EndIf
		If Not ThisForm.GerarCupom()
			Return .f.
		Endif		
		ImpVen = AbrirnFiscal(oFormulario)
		ImpVen = ImpVen And CompNfiscal(oFormulario,lnordem,TprMvCab.Valos-TprMvCab.ValVars )
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMA8501')
			ImpVen = ImpVen And iFechanFiscal(oFormulario,TprMvCab.ValVars)
		EndIf

	Case crSigFiFis.Imps = 'DARUMA'
		lnOrdem = 0
		lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNtb Where Imps=']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Ordems = ]+Str(crSigCdOpe.TrNfis,2)
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql,'CrSigFiNtb') > 0
			lnOrdem = crSigFiNtb.OperNF
		EndIf
		IF not INLIST(lnordem,'01','02')	&& Homologação paf 09/2012 - não abre cupom nao fiscal - Sangria e suprimentos tem função propria
			ImpVen = AbrirnFiscal(oFormulario,lnordem,TprMvCab.Valos-TprMvCab.ValVars,TprMvCab.ValVars)
		ELSE
			ImpVen = .t.
		ENDIF
		
		If Not ThisForm.GerarCupom()
			Return .f.
		Endif

	Case crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA'
		ImpVen = .t.

EndCase

IF crSigFiFis.Imps = 'DARUMA'
	&& Homologação paf 09/2012 - calcula cupom nao fiscal - Sangria e suprimentos ainda não tem o numero atual
	lngnf = LeituraNognf()
	lngnf = TRANSFORM(VAL(lngnf)+1, '@L 999999')
	replace CcfGnfs with lngnf in TprMvCab
ENDIF

If ImpVen
	If Not ( CrSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 And InList(CrSigCdOpe.nfiscals,1,2) )
		lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set Notas = ']+TprMvCab.Notas+[', nCupoms = ']+TprMvCab.nCupoms+[', ]+;
				   [CcfGnfs = ']+TprMvCab.CcfGnfs+[' Where CidChaves = ']+TprMvCab.CidChaves+[']
		=ThisForm.PodataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
		=ThisForm.Podatamgr2.commit()
	Endif
Endif

Return(ImpVen)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE delecao
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE delecao
Lparameters _Operacao

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvHst Where OriDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' ]
