	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvHst 3)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvCab Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvCab)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete    = [Delete From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvItn 3)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvIts)')
	Return .F.
Endif

*-- Rafael - 27/02/2018 - deletar a etiqueta caso a movimentação de Origem seja deletada
lcDelete = [Delete From SigOpEtq Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigOpEtq)')
	Return .F.
Endif

* Richard em 28/08/2014 - Incluído o " And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))"
lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvCpv Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))]
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvCpv)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvCcr Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))]
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crMccr') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrMccr 3)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Select CrMccr
Scan
	=fRecalculaS( CrMccr.Grupos, CrMccr.Contas, CrMccr.DataS, CrMccr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )
Endscan

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvCcr Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))]
LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
If LnErro < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvCcr)')
	Return .F.
Endif

*-- Rafael - 28/11/2019 - Deleta o Titulo pela Origem (ORIDOPNUMS)
lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvCpv Where OriDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))]
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvCpv)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvCcr Where OriDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))]
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crMccr') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrMccr 3)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Select CrMccr
Scan
	=fRecalculaS( CrMccr.Grupos, CrMccr.Contas, CrMccr.DataS, CrMccr.Moedas, Thisform.poDataMgr  )
Endscan

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvCcr Where OriDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[' And (Borderos = 0 Or UsuConfs = Space(10))]
LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
If LnErro < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvCcr)')
	Return .F.
Endif
*--

lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrPar') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrPar 3)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Store 0 To lnValoBxs

Select crPar
Scan
	lcFpags  = crPar.FPags
	lcCheque = crPar.Bancos + crPar.Agencias + crPar.Contas + crPar.Numeros
	Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',lcFpags)
	If crSigCdOpe.Caixas = 1 And crSigCdOpe.COpers = 2 And ;
			crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1 And !Empty(lcCheque)
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdPbx','CrPrBx','nCheques',crPar.Numeros)
			Select CrPrBx
			Index On Bancos + Agencias + NContas + NCheques Tag NCheques
			=Seek(lcCheque)
			Scan While CrPrBx.Bancos+CrPrBx.Agencias+CrPrBx.NContas+CrPrBx.NCheques=lcCheque
				llDep = .T.
				lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdPbx Set Deposits = ?llDep Where CidChaves = ']+CrPrBx.CidChaves+[']
				LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
				If LnErro < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdPbx 2)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif
	Endif
	lnValoBxs = lnValoBxs + Iif( crSigOpFp.Baixas = 1, Round( xPar.CotFPgs * xPar.Valos, 2 ), 0 )
Endscan

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvPar)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigTtCcd Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigTtCcd)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigCdCmm Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigCdCmm)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcQuery = [Select NumLotes From SigChLcq Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrCheh') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrCheH)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Select CrCheH
Scan
	If NumLotes > 0
		_Lote = NumLotes
		lcDelete = [Delete From SigCheH Where NumLotes = ]+Str(_Lote)
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigCheH)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
	Endif
Endscan

lcDelete = [Delete From SigChLcq Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigChLcq)')
	Return .F.
Endif

*- Apaga cheques Emitidos -*
Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCqChi','CrChi','EmpDopNums', _Operacao )
Select crChi
Scan
	If crChi.Emitidos
		llCancela = .T.
		lcUpdate = [Update SigCqChi Set Cancelas = ?llCancela Where CidChaves=']+crChi.CidChaves+[']
		LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
	Else
		lcDelete = [Delete From SigCqChi Where CidChaves = ']+crChi.CidChaves+[']
		LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
	Endif
	If LnErro < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
		Return .F.
	Endif
Endscan

lcQuery = [Select * From SigCqChm Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrChm') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrChm 3)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Select crChm
Scan
	lcNums   = crChm.Nums
	lcCheque = crChm.Bancos + crChm.Agencias + crChm.NContas + crChm.NCheques
	lcDelete = [Delete From SigCqChm Where CidChaves = ']+crChm.CidChaves+[']
	If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigCqChm)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	lcWher = [Select * From SigCqChm Where nCheques=']+crChm.NCheques+[' ]
	LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWher,'CrChm2')
	If LnErro < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrChm2)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	_Apaga = .F.
	Select * From CrChm2 Where Bancos+Agencias+NContas+NCheques=lcCheque And EmpDopNums # _Operacao ;
		Into Cursor CrChm3 Readwrite
	Index On DtSis Tag DtSis
	If Reccount() = 0
		_Apaga = .T.
	Else
		Go Bott
		lcUMovs      = CrChm3.Codigos
		lcNumCheques = CrChm3.Numeros
	Endif

	lcWher = [Select * From SigChe Where Nums=']+lcNums+[' ]
	LnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWher,'CrChe')
	If LnErro < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrChe)')
		Return .F.
	Endif
	Select crChe
	Index On Bancos + Agencias + NContas + NCheques Tag Cheque
	Seek (lcCheque)

	=fCriarCurSit(crChe.Iclis)

	If _Apaga
		Insert Into crSigExChq (Agencias,Bancos,vencs,NCheques,NContas,Nums,;
			umovs,valors,Contas,Grupos,Iclis,Autos,;
			datatrans,Emps,notas,usuars,dataexcls,CidChaves) ;
			values (crChe.Agencias,crChe.Bancos,crChe.vencs,crChe.NCheques,crChe.NContas,crChe.Nums,;
			crChe.umovs,crChe.valors,crChe.Contas,crChe.Grupos,crChe.Iclis,crChe.Autos,;
			datatrans,crChe.Emps,crChe.notas,usuar,_pData, fUniqueIds())

		lcDelete = [Delete From SigChe Where Nums = ']+crChe.Nums+[']
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigChe)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
	Else
		lDtAlt = _pData
		lcUpdate = [Update SigChe Set Umovs = ']+lcUMovs+[', Numeros=']+lcNumCheques+[', ]+;
			[DtAlts = ?lDtAlt Where Nums = ']+crChe.Nums+[']
		LnErro   = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
		If LnErro < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigChe)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrPar') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrPar 4)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
		Select crPar
		Index On Bancos + Agencias + Contas + Numeros Tag Cheque
		Scan
			If crPar.Bancos + crPar.Agencias + crPar.Contas + crPar.Numeros = lcCheque
				lcPago = '1'
				ldDat = _pData

				lcUpdate = [Update SigMvPar Set VPags = 0, Pagos = ?lcPago, DtAlts = ?ldDat ] + ;
					[Where Cidchaves = '] + crPar.CidChaves + [']

				If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvPar)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
				Exit
			Endif
		Endscan
	Endif
Endscan

lcDelete = [Delete From SigCdCar Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigCdCar)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigCdCtt Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigCdCtt)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigCdCrd Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigCdCrd)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigOpDev Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigOpDev 2)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvPec Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvPec)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvMov Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvMov)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtv Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtv)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvNfi Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Operacao+[']
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvNfi)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Return .T.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE deletesigtef
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE deletesigtef
Lparameters pcIdent,pcDelTp

Local llchecaSigTef
llchecaSigTef = .f.
If !used('SigTef')
	Use goSistema.DirTefEcfs+'\SigTef' in 0
	llchecaSigTef = .t.
EndIf
=seek('R'+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+pcIdent,'SigTef','Ident')
Select SigTef
If !eof('SigTef')
	Delete in SigTef
EndIf				
If llchecaSigTef 
	Use in SigTef
EndIf

If Type('pcDelTp')='C' And pcDelTp = 'NCN' And Used('CrTefImp')
	Select CrTefImp
	_Order = Order()
	Set Order to Ident
	Seek pcIdent
	Dele While cnIdents = pcIdent And !IsEmpty(pcIdent)
	If !IsEmpty( _Order )
		Set Order to ( _Order )
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE desmembra
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE desmembra
LParameters _Valor, _DesmembraItem1

Local Desmemb, _RecNo

If _DesmembraItem1
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Desmemb=.t.
	If (_Valor+ThisForm.citem-1) > crSigCdOpe.qtdites
		If MessageBox( 'Quantidade Maior Quer a Máxima Permitida na Movimentação !!!' + ;
					   Chr(13) + Chr(10) + 'Deseja Continuar Com o Valor de ' + ;
					   Str( ( crSigCdOpe.QtdItes - ThisForm.CItem + 1 ), 3 ) + '?',4+256+32)=6
			_Valor = crSigCdOpe.QtdItes - ThisForm.CItem + 1
			Replace crTpmMvItn.qtds with _Valor in crTpmMvItn
		Else
			Replace crTpmMvItn.Qtds with 1 in crTpmMvItn
			Desmemb = .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	If Desmemb
		Select crTpmMvItn
		_RecNo = Recno('crTpmMvItn')
		Scatter Memvar
		m.Qtds = 1
		Wait Window 'Aguarde... Desmembrando Itens!!!' Nowait
		Do While _Valor > 1
			ThisForm.CItem = ThisForm.CItem + 1
			m.CItens = ThisForm.CItem
			Insert Into crTpmMvItn From Memvar
			_Valor = _Valor - 1
		EndDo
		Wait clear
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Locate For Recno() = _RecNo
		Replace Qtds With _Valor in crTpmMvItn
		Delete For Empty(Cpros)
		Scan
			If DesMembs
				Loop
			EndIf
			Replace DesMembs With .t. in crTpmMvItn
			=ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
		EndScan
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Return .t.
	Else
		Return .f.	
	EndIf
Else
	lnQtds = _Valor - 1
	Select crTpmMvIts
	Replace crTpmMvIts.Qtds With 1
	Select crTpmMvIts
	Scatter MemVar
	m.Qtds = 1
	Do While lnQtds > 0
		Insert Into crTpmMvIts From MemVar
		lnQtds = lnQtds - 1
	EndDo
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Return
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE desmembrac
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE desmembrac
Lparameters _Produto, _GerarNota, pQtd, pDop3

Local _RecNo, Desmemb, Oper, OpePad, _cItem2, llRetorno

Oper       = crSigCdOpe.Opers
OpePad     = crSigCdOpe.OpePads
OpePadC    = crSigOpCdd.OpePadcs
lnQtMult   = Iif(Type('pqtd')='N',pQtd,1)
lcDopC     = Iif(Type('pDop3')='C',pDop3,TprMvCab.Dopes)

llRetorno  = .T.

Desmemb=.T.
Select crTpmMvItn
_RecNo = Recno('crTpmMvItn')
Scatter Memvar
_cItem2 = m.cItens

* Richard em 19/06/2012 - Estava excluindo sempre que o primeiro registro não era considerado, ficando zero.
*Delete For cItem2 = m.cItens
Delete For cItem2 = m.cItens And m.cItens > 0

If Not _GerarNota

	Cont = 0
	Scan
		Cont = Cont + 1
		Select crTpmMvIts
		Set Order To
		Set Order To cItens
		Seek crTpmMvItn.cItens
		Scan While cItens = crTpmMvItn.cItens
			Replace cItens With Cont
		Endscan

		Select CrSigSubMv
		Set Order To
		Set Order To cItem2
		Seek crTpmMvItn.cItens
		Scan While cItem2 = crTpmMvItn.cItens
			Replace cItem2 With Cont
		Endscan

		If Used([crSigMvIte])
			Select CrSigMvIte
			Set Order To
			Set Order To cItens
			Seek crTpmMvItn.cItens
			Scan While cItens = crTpmMvItn.cItens
				Replace cItens With Cont
			Endscan
		Endif

		Select crTpmMvItn
		_cIt = cItens
		_RecNo2 = Recno()
		Replace cItem2 With Cont For cItem2 = _cIt
		Go _RecNo2
		Replace cItens With Cont
	Endscan
	Thisform.CItem = Cont
Endif

*!*	lcSql = [Select Mats, Qtds, Pesos, ObsOfs From SigPrCpo Where Cpros = ']+_Produto+[' Order by Mats ]
lcSql = [Select a.Mats, a.Qtds, a.Pesos, a.ObsOfs From SigPrCpo a Inner Join SigCdGrp b On a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus Where a.Cpros = ']+_Produto+[' And b.Semiacabs <> 1 ] + ;
	[Union ] + ;
	[Select a.Mats, a.Qtds, a.Pesos, a.ObsOfs From SigPrCpo a Where a.Cpros in ] + ;
	[(Select a.Mats From SigPrCpo a Inner Join SigCdGrp b On a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus Where a.Cpros = ']+_Produto+[' And b.Semiacabs = 1) Order by a.Mats]
If Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCompo') > 0

	lcSql = [Select Cgrus From SigOpGpo Where dopes = ']+lcDopC+[']
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpgpOpe')
	Select tmpgpOpe
	Index On Cgrus Tag Cgrus
	llTemGru = Reccount('TmpgpOpe') > 0

	*** Tiago - 25/11/2010 - Calcula a quantidade conforme a tabela de desconto da Movimentação automática
	If Type('pDop3') = 'C'
		lcSql = [Select tabdps as tabds From SigCdOpe Where dopes = ']+lcDopC+[']
		=Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpOpeAuto')
		If !Empty(TmpOpeAuto.tabds)
			lcQuerPro = [Select a.Cpros, a.Cgrus, a.Reffs, a.Situas, a.Cunis, a.Dpros, a.Pesoms, a.fvendas, a.fcustos, a.moepvs, ]+;
				[a.moepcs, a.moevs, a.pvens, a.moecs, a.pcuss, a.moedas, a.valors, a.cbars, a.linhas, a.colecoes, ]+;
				[a.mUltComps, a.vUltComps, a.cftios, a.Sgrus, a.mercs, a.CodFinP, a.LtMinsv, b.nTipoJoals, a.custofs ]+;
				[From SigCdPro a Inner Join SigCdGrp b on b.cGrus = a.cGrus Where a.Cpros = ']+_Produto+[']

			=Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuerPro,'CrTmpPro')

			_Formulas = Thisform.Formula1( '', 'TmpOpeAuto' )
			_Formula1 = Mline( _Formulas, 1 )
			_Moeda1   = Padr(Mline( _Formulas, 2 ),3)
			_Formula2 = Mline( _Formulas, 3 )
			_Moeda2   = Padr(Mline( _Formulas, 4 ),3)
		Endif
	Endif
	***

	Select CrTmpCompo
	Scan
		Wait Window 'Aguarde... Carregando Itens de Composicao !!!' Nowait

		lcQuerPro = [Select a.Cpros, a.Cgrus, a.Reffs, a.Situas, a.Cunis, a.Dpros, a.Pesoms, a.fvendas, a.fcustos, a.moepvs, ]+;
			[a.moepcs, a.moevs, a.pvens, a.moecs, a.pcuss, a.moedas, a.valors, a.cbars, a.linhas, a.colecoes, ]+;
			[a.mUltComps, a.vUltComps, a.cftios, a.Sgrus, a.mercs, a.CodFinP, a.LtMinsv, b.nTipoJoals, a.custofs ]+;
			[From SigCdPro a Inner Join SigCdGrp b on b.cGrus = a.cGrus Where a.Cpros = ']+CrTmpCompo.Mats+[']

		=Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuerPro,'CrTmpPro')

		If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.Mercs) And crSigOpCdd.Mercs <> CrTmpPro.Mercs
			Loop
		Endif

		If llTemGru And Not Seek(CrTmpPro.Cgrus,'TmpGpOpe','Cgrus')
			Loop
		Endif

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Set Order To CPros
		
		*-- Rafael - 02/03/2018 - Agrupa referencias
		llAgrupa = (crSigOpCdd.AgrCompo = 1)
		If llAgrupa
			If Seek(CrTmpCompo.Mats,[crTpmMvItn],[CPros])
				m.cItens = crTpmMvItn.cItens
				m.cItem2 = crTpmMvItn.cItem2

				Select crTpmMvItn
				Set Order To
				Replace Qtds   With Qtds + CrTmpCompo.Qtds * _QtdsP,;
					Pesos  With Pesos + CrTmpCompo.Pesos * _QtdsP
			Else
				llAgrupa = .F.
			Endif
		Endif

		Select crTpmMvItn
		If Not llAgrupa
			Seek Space(10)
			If Eof()
				Append Blank
				Thisform.CItem = Thisform.CItem + 1
				m.cItens = Thisform.CItem
			Else
				m.cItens = crTpmMvItn.cItens
			Endif
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Set Order To
			Replace cItens With m.cItens,;
				CPros  With CrTmpCompo.Mats,;
				Qtds   With CrTmpCompo.Qtds * lnQtMult,;
				Pesos  With CrTmpCompo.Pesos * lnQtMult,;
				cItem2 With Iif(! _GerarNota,cItem2,0),;
				Obs   With CrTmpCompo.ObsOfs
		Endif
		*** Tiago - 25/11/2010 - Calcula a quantidade conforme a tabela de desconto da Movimentação automática
		If Type('pDop3') = 'C' And !Empty(TmpOpeAuto.tabds) And (!IsEmpty( _Formula1 ) Or !IsEmpty( _Formula2 ))
			_Peso = lnQtMult
			_xFator = 1
			_xPreco = 0
			_Qtde = CrTmpCompo.Qtds
			Store 0 To _xTotalPeso, _xTotalPreco
			If !IsEmpty( _Formula1 )
				_Fator = ' _xFator '
				_Preco = ' _xPreco '
				_xTotalPeso = &_Formula1

				Replace Qtds With _xTotalPeso, Pesos With _xTotalPeso In crTpmMvItn
			Endif
			If !IsEmpty( _Formula2 )
				_Fator = ' _xFator '
				_Preco = ' _xPreco '
				_xTotalPreco = &_Formula2

				Replace UniVals With _xTotalPreco In crTpmMvItn
			Endif
		Endif
		***

		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoAuts,1,3)
			lcSql = [Select Codigos from SigCdLpc Where lPrecos = ']+TprMvCab.lPrecos+[']
			lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmplPre')
			If lnErro < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Return 0
			Endif
			lcwhere = [Select * From SigCdLpi Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.CPros+[' And LPrecos = ']+TprMvCab.lPrecos+[']
			lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcwhere,'crSigCdLpi')
			If lnErro < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Return 0
			Endif
			Select crSigCdLpi
			Go Top
			If Reccount() > 0 And (IsEmpty(crSigCdLpi.VencFs) Or Between(TprMvCab.DataS,crSigCdLpi.VencIs, crSigCdLpi.VencFs))
				lcMoeVs = crSigCdLpi.MoeVs
				Replace crTpmMvItn.UniVals With crSigCdLpi.PVens, ;
					crTpmMvItn.MoeFats   With crSigCdLpi.MoeVs, ;
					crTpmMvItn.lPrecos   With TprMvCab.lPrecos,;
					crTpmMvItn.CodlPrecs With CrTmplPre.Codigos In crTpmMvItn
			Else
				If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 1
					lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeVs
					lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.PVens
				Else
					If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 2
						lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeCs
						lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.PCuss
						If Inlist(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
							_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
							lcQuery = [Select Moevs, Pvens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.CPros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
							=Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
							If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.PVens > 0 And Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.MoeVs)
								lcMoeVs   = CrTmpfPro.MoeVs
								lnUniVals = CrTmpfPro.PVens
							Endif
						Endif
						lcQuery = [Select MoeQs, QtdEqs ] + ;
							[From SigCdMoe ] + ;
							[Where CMoes = '] + lcMoeVs + [' ] + ;
							[Order By MoeQs, QtdEqs]

						If (Thisform.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpMoe') < 1)
							=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpMoe)')
							Return 0
						Endif
						Go Top In crTmpMoe

						If Not Eof('crTmpMoe')
							If Not IsEmpty(crTmpMoe.Moeqs)
								lcMoeVs   = crTmpMoe.Moeqs
								lnUniVals = lnUniVals * Iif( crTmpMoe.Qtdeqs = 0, 1, crTmpMoe.Qtdeqs )
							Endif
						Endif
					Else
						If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 5
							lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.Moedas
							lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.Valors
						Else
							If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7
								lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.mUltComps
								lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.vUltComps
							Else
								If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
									=fCustoMedio(TprMvCab.Emps,CrTmpPro.CPros,TprMvCab.DataS,Thisform.poDataMgr,(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
									lcMoeVs   = TmpCusMed.Moedas
									lnUniVals = TmpCusMed.Valors
								Else
									lnUniVals = 0
									lcMoeVs   = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
				If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 11
					lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.custofs
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 15
					lnUniVals = crTmpPro.custofs
					lcQuery = [select customedioreais as csmedio, (select moedaps from sigcdpam) as csmoedas ] + ;
							[from customedio3 where cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' ]
					If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpProMd') < 1
						=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpProMd)')
						Return 0
					EndIf
					If Reccount('CrTmpProMd')>0
						lnUniVals = CrTmpProMd.csmedio
					EndIf 	
				EndIf
				Select crTpmMvItn
				Replace crTpmMvItn.UniVals With lnUniVals
			Endif
		Else
			lcMoeVs = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
		Endif

		xOper = Iif( Oper=1, 'E', Iif( Oper = 2, 'S', Iif( Oper = 3,Iif(Not Empty(OpePadC),OpePadC,OpePad), crTpmMvItn.Opers)))

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Replace crTpmMvItn.dpros With CrTmpPro.dpros, ;
			crTpmMvItn.cunis With CrTmpPro.cunis, ;
			crTpmMvItn.MoeVs With lcMoeVs,;
			crTpmMvItn.Reffs With CrTmpPro.Reffs,;
			crTpmMvItn.Opers With xOper

		If( CrTmpPro.nTipoJoals == 3 ) And Seek(_cItem2,[crTpmMvIts],[CItens]) And (Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvIts.CodCors) Or Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvIts.CodTams))
			_Cor = crTpmMvIts.CodCors
			_Tam = crTpmMvIts.CodTams
			Select crTpmMvIts
			Append Blank In crTpmMvIts

			Replace cItens  With crTpmMvItn.cItens,;
				Emps    With TprMvCab.Emps,;
				Dopes   With TprMvCab.Dopes,;
				Numes   With TprMvCab.Numes,;
				CPros   With crTpmMvItn.CPros,;
				Qtds    With crTpmMvItn.Qtds,;
				Pesos   With crTpmMvItn.Pesos,;
				QtdEmbs	With 1,;
				CodCors With _Cor,;
				CodTams With _Tam In crTpmMvIts
		Endif
		Select crTpmMvItn

		Thisform.Calc_ValIte()

	Endscan
	llRetorno = .T.
Else
	llRetorno = .F.
Endif
Return llRetorno

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE etiqueta
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE etiqueta
Lparameters pOperacao
Local lcChave

lcOperacao = Iif(Type('pOperacao')='C',pOperacao,TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )

If MessageBox('Confirma impressão das Etiquetas ?(S/N)',4+32+256,lcOperacao) # 6
	Return
EndIf

Zap in dbimpressao

If lcOperacao = ( TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.CtrlLotes,1,2) And crSigOpCdc.ietiqs=1 
		lnBar = Val( Str(crSigCdOpe.Ndopes,4)+Transf(TprMvCab.Numes,"@L 999999") )
		lcObs = crSigCdOpe.Abrevs + "-" + Transf(TprMvCab.Numes,"@L 999999")

		Insert Into dbImpressao ( CPros, Qtds, Cbars, Obs) Values ( crSigCdPam.Ouros, 1, lnBar, lcObs)

		lcbusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvItn Where 0=1 Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') < 0
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		lcquery = [Select * From SigMvIts Where 0=1 Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEsti2') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf

	Else
		lcbusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[' Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') < 0
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		lcquery = [Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEsti2') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	lcbusca = lcOperacao
	lcQuery = [Select a.*,b.cunis From SigMvHst a, SigCdPro b Where a.OriDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[' And ]+;
			  [a.Opers = 'E' And a.Cpros = b.Cpros ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	lcquery = [Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' And 0=1 ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEsti2') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
		Return 0
	EndIf

EndIf
	
Select CrEsti2
Index On Citens Tag Citens

Select crEesti
Scan
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorQuery('SigCdUni','crSigCdUni','Cunis',CrEesti.Cunis) And ( CrEesti.Opers = 'E' Or crSigOpCdd.EtqSaids = 1 )
		lcSql = [Select a.Cpros, a.Cgrus, b.nTipoJoals, b.etipads ]+;
				[From SigCdPro a Inner Join SigCdGrp b on b.cGrus = a.cGrus Where a.Cpros = ']+CrEesti.Cpros+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao (LocalPro)')
			Return 0
		EndIf

		If LocalPro.EtiPads = 'D' && se for D - Selecionadas, só pode imprimir esse grupo pela Etiqueta selecionadas ou Reimpressão de Etiquetas
			Loop
		EndIf
		
		If Type( "_QtEtiq" ) # "N"
			Public _QtEtiq
		EndIf

		_QtEtiq = crEesti.Qtds
		_QtPeso = CrEesti.Pesos
		If crSigCdUni.pqtds='S' And crSigCdUni.Etiqs#'S'
			_QtEtiq = 0
			_QtPeso = 0
			Do Form SigOpQtE With crEesti.Cpros
		EndIf

		If crSigCdUni.Etiqs = 'S'
			If Not Empty(crEesti.CodBarras)
				Select crEsti2
				Seek CrEesti.Citens

				Insert Into dbImpressao (cpros, qtds, qtdeEtiq, Pesos, Obs, PVens, Moedas, EmpDopNums, CItens, CodTams) ;
								 Values (str(crEesti.CodBarras,14), 1, _QtEtiq, _QtPeso, crEsti2.CodCors, crEesti.Units, crEesti.Moedas, crEesti.Empdopnums, CrEesti.Citens, crEsti2.CodTams)
			Else
				Select crEsti2
				Seek CrEesti.Citens
				Scan While crEsti2.CItens = CrEesti.Citens
					If Not Empty(crEsti2.CodBarras)
						Insert Into dbImpressao (CPros, Qtds, QtdeEtiq, CodTams, Obs, PVens, Pesos, Moedas, EmpDopNums, CItens) ;
										 Values (Str(crEsti2.CodBarras, 14), 1, crEsti2.Qtds, crEsti2.CodTams, ;
										 		 crEsti2.CodCors, crEesti.Units, _QtPeso, crEesti.Moedas, crEesti.Empdopnums, CrEesti.Citens)
					EndIf
				EndScan
			EndIf
		Else
			Select crEsti2
			Seek CrEesti.Citens
		
			Insert Into dbImpressao (CPros, Qtds, Pesos, Obs, PVens, Moedas, EmpDopNums, CItens, CodTams) ;
			                 Values (crEesti.CPros, _QtEtiq, _QtPeso, crEsti2.CodCors, crEesti.Units, crEesti.Moedas, crEesti.Empdopnums, CrEesti.Citens, crEsti2.CodTams)
		EndIf
	EndIf
Endscan

Update dbImpressao Set Pedido = crSigCdOpe.Abrevs

Select dbImpressao
Go Top
If (crSigOpCdd.TpTlEtiqs = 2)
	ThisForm.Tipo = [OPERACAO]
	Do Form SigOpIpE With ThisForm, .t.
Else
	Do Form SigOpEtS With ThisForm, ThisForm.DataSessionId
EndIf
* Fim *********************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE excluir
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE excluir
Lparameters _GravaDel, _PulaECF

Local Exclui, Checka, lnnumes, lcCodCors, lcCodTams, lcCodProd, _BxParcial, lcWhere, lcNumChqs,lcCheque, lcFPags, lcLoteCart, llDesMarcaCC, llEtiSemHist, lnCfgOpCrs, lcTransacao, lcEDN, lcNotas, lcNumCheques, lcUMovs, _ChaveDelBx, _ChaveDelPro, _pData, lnValoBxs, llComTef, llAtvCcd, oFormulario
Private lldtalt, lexclui

lcCidQuery = fUniqueIds()
_pData   = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
lcUltGrv = TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + '-Excluir'

Wait Window 'Aguarde. Excluindo Movimentações!!! ' Nowait

Goto Top In TprMvCab

=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
_Conserto   = ( crSigCdOpe.Consers = 1 )
lcTransacao = 'OP: ' + Alltrim(TprMvCab.Emps) + '-' + Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes) + '-' + Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))
lnCfgOpCrs  = crSigCdOpe.OpCrs
_BxEstpe    = .F.
_BxPagos    = ( crSigCdOpe.BxPagos = 1 )
_BaixaSn    = ( crSigCdOpe.BaixaSns = 1 )
llComTef    = .F.
RetNImp     = .F.
Exclui      = .T.
llAtvCcd    = .F.
Thisform.NoCcf = ' '
Thisform.NoCoo = ' '
oFormulario = Thisform.omodemEest

=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvPar','CrPar','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))

If Thisform.pcEscolha='EXCLUIR'
	Thisform.gestoquel()	&& mena 04/11/2015 atualiza estoque por local
Endif

If Thisform.pcEscolha='EXCLUIR' And (Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) Or Inlist(crSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)) And _GravaDel
	Select CrPar
	Scan
		Scatter Memvar Memo
		Select crSigExMvp
		Append Blank
		Gather Memvar Memo
	Endscan
Endif
*** mena - 20/07/2016 - cancela cartao se CNF em impressora não fiscal ***
If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,3) And Thisform.pcEscolha='EXCLUIR' And crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA'
	lcEDN=TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
	=CancelCVCfe(lcEDN,oFormulario,oFormulario)
Endif

If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And Thisform.pcEscolha='EXCLUIR' And crSigFiFis.Imps <> 'S/IMPRESSORA' And Not _PulaECF
	***mena - 26/05/2016 - pega ultimo ccf para verificar se pode excluir este cupom ***
	lnNoCCf = LeituraNoCcf()	&& le o ultimo numero do CCF
	If lnNoCCf <> TprMvCab.ccfgnfs
		Messagebox('Exclusão Cancelada,'+Chr(13)+'O Equipamento não pode realizar esta Movimentação !!!',0+48,'')
		Exclui=.F.
	Endif

	*!*		***mena - 17/05/2016 - pega ultimo coo para verificar se pode excluir este cupom ***
	*!*		lnNoCoo = LeituraNoCupom(oFormulario)
	*!*		IF lnNoCoo <> TprMvCab.notas
	*!*			MessageBox('Exclusão Cancelada,'+Chr(13)+'O Equipamento não pode realizar esta Movimentação !!!',0+48,'')
	*!*			Exclui=.f.
	*!*		EndIf

	*!*		lnnumes = Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes) + TprMvCab.Emps
	*!*		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigSySeq','crAutoriza','Valor',lnnumes)
	*!*			If crAutoriza.Conteudo <> TprMvCab.Numes
	*!*				lcQuery = [Select Max(Numes) as Numes From SigMvCab Where Dopes = '] + TprMvCab.Dopes + [']
	*!*				ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalUlt])
	*!*				Select LocalUlt
	*!*				Go Top In LocalUlt
	*!*				If (LocalUlt.Numes <> TprMvCab.Numes)
	*!*					MessageBox('Exclusão Cancelada,'+Chr(13)+'O Equipamento não pode realizar esta Movimentação !!!',0+48,'')
	*!*					Exclui=.f.
	*!*				EndIf
	*!*			EndIf
	*!*		EndIf
	
	If Exclui
		lcQuery = [Select nQtdVias, cTefdReqs, cTefdResps From SigFiNfs Where cComprovs = 'SITEF' And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
		Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [ccSigFiNfs])
		llPrimeira = .T.
		llUseTef = .F.
		llUsecrTef = .F.
		llAtvCcd = .F.
		*!*oFormulario = ThisForm.omodemEest
		Select CrPar
		Locate For Not IsEmpty(CrPar.cnIdTefs) And Val(CrPar.cnIdTefs)<>0
		If Not Eof() And Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON','NSWEDA') &&And crSigCdPam.SisTef = 3 And Not Empty(crSigCdPam.numips)
			If Not TprMvCab.lCancelas
				If Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DARUMA')
					Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
					*** Tiago - 09/06/2009 - Incluído para deixar Movimentação em vermelho caso dê algum problema no meio da impressão do tef
					*!*	Mena - retirado 18/03/2013 thisform.poDataMgr.commit()
					lldtalt = Thisform.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
					lexclui = Exclui
					lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set lCancelas = ?lexclui, DtAlts = ?llDtAlt, DataTrans = Null Where EmpDopNums = ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
					Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
					Thisform.poDataMgr.commit()
					******************
					=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.,.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc

					Exclui2 = Exclui And CancelCcd(TprMvCab.EmpDopNums,Thisform)
					If Exclui And !Exclui2
						Messagebox('Venda será excluída, mas cancele os TEFs no modo administrativo.',64,'Erro na impressão do TEF')
					Endif
				Else
					Exclui = Exclui And CancelCcd(TprMvCab.EmpDopNums,Thisform)
				Endif

			Endif
			llAtvCcd = .T.
		Else
			Select CrPar
			Scan
				If !IsEmpty(CrPar.cnIdTefs) And Val(CrPar.cnIdTefs)<>0
					If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,3)
						If llPrimeira And Messagebox('Movimentação com pagamento pelo TEF,';
								+Chr(13)+Chr(10)+'Confirma Cancelamento Fiscal !!',4 + 32 + 256,'') = 7
							Exclui = .F.
							Exit
						Else
							llComTef   = .T.
							llPrimeira = .F.
							lcSql = [Select * From SigFiTef Where cIdents = ']+[R]+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+CrPar.cnIdTefs+[' And cHeaders = 'CRT']
							Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrSigFiTef')
							If crSigCdPam.SisTef = 1 Or (crSigCdPam.SisTef = 3 And Empty(crSigCdPam.numips))
								llCancelTef = .T.
								Do While llCancelTef
									Select crSigFiTef
									Go Top
									Scan
										If cStatus <> 'CNC'
											If ! Used('crTef')
												Create Cursor CrTef (cinfos c(100))
												llUsecrTef = .T.
											Endif

											lcdirreq = Alltrim(ccSigFiNfs.cTefdReqs)
											lcdirresp = Alltrim(ccSigFiNfs.cTefdResps)
											lnqtdvia = ccSigFiNfs.nQtdVias
											lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')

											Do Form SIGCNTEF With crSigFiTef.cnNSUs, crSigFiTef.cNmRedes, Val(crSigFiTef.cnValors)/100, 'Cancelamento'

											lcTipo = 'CNC'
											RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,'CNC',;
												val(crSigFiTef.cnIdents),crSigFiTef.cNmRedes,crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
												crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, crSigFiTef.Fpags, Val(crSigFiTef.cnValors)/100)

											lcTipo = 'CNF'
											RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
												val(crSigFiTef.cnIdents),crSigFiTef.cNmRedes,crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
												crSigFiTef.cFinalzs,crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, crSigFiTef.Fpags)
											If RetImpr
												If ! Used('CrTefImp')
													Create Cursor CrTefImp (cinfos c(100),nordems N(2),cnIdents c(10),nVias N(2))
													Index On cnIdents Tag Ident
													Index On Str(nVias,2)+cnIdents Tag Via
													llUseTef = .T.
												Endif
												Select CrTefImp
												Delete All
												If ! Used("CrTefResp")
													Create Cursor CrTefResp (cinfos c(100))
													Index On Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,1,3) Tag Resp
												Endif
												Select CrTefResp
												Set Order To Resp
												Delete All
												lcdirreq = Alltrim(ccSigFiNfs.cTefdReqs)
												lcdirresp = Alltrim(ccSigFiNfs.cTefdResps)

												lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')

												Append From &lcarquivo. Sdf
												Seek '009'
												If Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)) = '0'
													For lnContaQtdVia = 1 To ccSigFiNfs.nQtdVias
														Select CrTefResp
														Go Top
														Seek '029'
														If Found()
															Do While cinfos = '029'
																Select CrTefResp
																Scatter Memvar
																m.cnIdents = crSigFiTef.cnIdents
																m.cinfos = Strtran(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11),'"','')
																m.nVias = lnContaQtdVia
																Insert Into CrTefImp From Memvar
																Select CrTefResp
																Skip
															Enddo
															Select CrTefImp
														Else
														Endif
													Next
													RetcVinc = .F.
													Do While ! RetcVinc
														RetcVinc = RRelGerVinc(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario)
														If ! RetcVinc
															If Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (19), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'')=7
																Messagebox("Cancelamento Realizado com Sucesso, Reimpressão pelo Modulo Administrativo",64,'')
																RetcVinc = .T.
															Endif
														Endif
													Enddo
													llCancelTef = .F.
												Else
													Seek '030'
													lcMsg = Iif(Empty(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)),'Movimentação Cancelada pelo Usuário',Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)))
													Do Form SigTfDss With "Erro na Trasação","",lcMsg,"","","VM",0,0
													If Messagebox("Confirma Cancelamento da Movimentação",4+32+256,"") = 6
														llCancelTef = .F.
														Return
													Endif
												Endif
											Endif
										Else
											llCancelTef = .F.
										Endif
										If llUsecrTef
											Use In CrTef
										Endif
									Endscan
								Enddo
								If Used("CrTefResp")
									Use In CrTefResp
								Endif
							Endif
							If crSigCdPam.SisTef = 3 And ! Empty(crSigCdPam.numips)
								llCancelTef = .T.
								Do While llCancelTef
									Select crSigFiTef
									Go Top
									Scan
										If cStatus <> 'CNC'
											lcSql=[SELECT * From SigOpFp Where Fpags = ']+crSigFiTef.Fpags+[']
											Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,"csSigOpFp")
											Select crSigFiTef
											lcData=Alltrim(cndttrans)

											If Alltrim(crSigCdPac.VerSitefs) = '4.1'
												Do Form SigOpCtf With crSigCdPam.numips, crSigFiTef.CnCaixas, cnValors, csSigOpFp.Opers, lcData, cnNSUs, csSigOpFp.lCartao,.T. To llCancel
											Else
												Do Form SigTfCan With crSigCdPam.numips, crSigFiTef.CnCaixas, cnValors, csSigOpFp.Opers, lcData, cnNSUs, csSigOpFp.lCartao,.T. To llCancel
											Endif

											If llCancel
												lcSql = [Select CidChaves From SigFiTef  Where ctipos = 'R' And cHeaders='CRT' AND CNNSUS = ']+Alltrim(crSigFiTef.cnNSUs)+[']
												If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
													Select LocSigFiTef
													Scan
														lcSql=[Update SigFiTef set cStatus = 'CNC' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
														RetSql=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql)
														If RetSql > 0
															Thisform.poDataMgr.commit()
														Endif
													Endscan
												Endif
											Endif
											If ! Used('CrTefImp')
												Create Cursor CrTefImp (cinfos c(100),nordems N(2),cnIdents c(10),nVias N(2))
												Index On cnIdents Tag Ident
												Index On Str(nVias,2)+cnIdents Tag Via
												llUseTef = .T.
											Endif
											Select CrTefImp
											Delete All
											If ! Used("CrTefResp")
												Create Cursor CrTefResp (cinfos c(100))
												Index On Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,1,3) Tag Resp
											Endif
											Select CrTefResp
											Set Order To Resp
											Delete All
											lcdirreq = Alltrim(ccSigFiNfs.cTefdReqs)
											lcdirresp = Alltrim(ccSigFiNfs.cTefdResps)

											lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')

											If File(lcarquivo)
												Append From &lcarquivo. Sdf
												Seek '009'
												If Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)) = '0'
													For lnContaQtdVia = 1 To ccSigFiNfs.nQtdVias
														Select CrTefResp
														Go Top
														Seek '029'
														If Found()
															Do While cinfos = '029'
																Select CrTefResp
																Scatter Memvar
																m.cnIdents = crSigFiTef.cnIdents
																m.cinfos = Strtran(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11),'"','')
																m.nVias = lnContaQtdVia
																Insert Into CrTefImp From Memvar
																Select CrTefResp
																Skip
															Enddo
															Select CrTefImp
														Else
														Endif
													Next
													RetcVinc = .F.
													Do While ! RetcVinc
														RetcVinc = RRelGerVinc(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario)
														If ! RetcVinc
															If Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (20), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'')=7
																Messagebox("Cancelamento Realizado com Sucesso, Reimpressão pelo Modulo Administrativo",64,'')
																RetcVinc = .T.
															Endif
														Endif
													Enddo
													llCancelTef = .F.
												Else
													Seek '030'
													lcMsg = Iif(Empty(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)),'Movimentação Cancelada pelo Usuário',Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)))
													Do Form SigTfDss With "Erro na Trasação","",lcMsg,"","","VM",0,0
													If Messagebox("Confirma Cancelamento da Movimentação",4+32+256,"") = 6
														llCancelTef = .F.
														Return
													Endif
												Endif
											Else
												lcMsg = 'Movimentação Cancelada pelo Usuário'
												Do Form SigTfDss With "Erro na Trasação","",lcMsg,"","","VM",0,0
												If Messagebox("Aborta Cancelamento da Movimentação",4+32+256,"") = 6
													llCancelTef = .F.
													Return
												Endif
											Endif
										Else
											llCancelTef = .F.
										Endif
									Endscan
								Enddo
								If Used("CrTefResp")
									Use In CrTefResp
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
						If llUseTef And Used('CrTefImp')
							Use In CrTefImp
						Endif
					Endif
					If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 And Not TprMvCab.lCancelas
						Messagebox('Movimentação com pagamento pelo TEF, Impossível Exclusão !!',0+48,'')
						Exclui = .F.
						Exit
					Endif
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif
	Endif
	If Exclui
		oFormulario = Thisform.omodemEest
		Select crSigFiFis
		Goto Top
		Do Case
		Case Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON')
			If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'DARUMA' And llAtvCcd
				**ja Executou o cancelamento pelo ccd
			Else
				If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1
					If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'BEMA8501'
						Select CrPar
						Count For !IsEmpty(CrPar.cnIdTefs) And Val(CrPar.cnIdTefs)<>0 To lnQtdTef
						If lnQtdTef = 0
							Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
							=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
						Endif
					Else
						Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
						=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.,.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
					Endif
				Else
					If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3
						=fLerFiscal()
						Select crSigFiFis
						Goto Top
						If Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMA8501')
							Select CrPar
							Count For !IsEmpty(CrPar.cnIdTefs) And Val(CrPar.cnIdTefs)<>0 To lnQtdTef
							If lnQtdTef = 0
								=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
								Exclui = ExcCupomNF(oFormulario)
							Endif
						Endif
						If Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'EPSON')
							Exclui = ExcCupomNF(oFormulario)
							=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.,.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
						Endif
						If Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DARUMA')
							Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
							=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.,.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif

		Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','ELGIN')
			If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 And llComTef And Not llAtvCcd
				**Não emite cancelamento do cupom não fiscal porque não é ultimo COO
			Else
				Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
				=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
			Endif

		Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
			If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1
				Checka=RotSTatus(1,oFormulario)
				If Type('Checka')='L'
					Checka=''
				Endif

				If Substr(Checka,1,1)='L' And Substr(Checka,6,1) = 'K'
					Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
					=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
					If !Exclui
						Messagebox('Exclusão Cancelada,Cupom Fiscal não impresso !!',0+16,'')
					Endif
				Else
					If (Substr(Checka,1,1)='V' Or Substr(Checka,1,1)='F') And Substr(Checka,6,1) = 'K'
						Exclui = FisFinv(oFormulario)
						If Exclui
							Checka=RotSTatus(1,oFormulario)
							Do While Substr(Checka,1,1)='X'
								Checka=RotSTatus(1,oFormulario)
							Enddo
							If Substr(Checka,1,1)='L' And Substr(Checka,6,1)='K'
								Exclui = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
								=Thisform.GerarCupom(.T.)  &&Guarda o CCo do Cancelamento para gravar o SigExMvc
								If !Exclui
									Messagebox('Exclusão Cancelada,Cupom Fiscal não impresso !!',0+16,'')
								Endif
							Endif
						Else
							Messagebox('Exclusão Cancelada,Sem Finalização,Cupom Fiscal não impresso !!',0+16,'')
						Endif
					Else
						Messagebox('Exclusão Cancelada,Estado Inválido,Cupom Fiscal não impresso !!',0+16,'')
						Exclui=.F.
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
		Endcase
	Endif
Endif

If Exclui
	Create Cursor TmpEtiquetas ( CodBarras N(14), Opers c(1) )

	Create Cursor TmpBxPends (BxEmps c(3), BxDopes c(20), BxNumes N(6))
	Index On BxEmps + BxDopes + Str(BxNumes,6) Tag BxEmpDopN

	Create Cursor csTmpOpAut (AutEmps c(3), AutDopes c(20), AutNumes N(6))
	Index On AutEmps + AutDopes + Str(AutNumes,6) Tag EmpDopNum

	Create Cursor csTmpOpeaut (AutEmps c(3), AutDopes c(20), AutNumes N(6))
	Index On AutEmps + AutDopes + Str(AutNumes,6) Tag EmpDopNum

	Select TprMvCab
	Go Top
	_Posicao = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )
	lcEDNe   = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdi','crSigOpCdi','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	
	If Thisform.pcEscolha='EXCLUIR'
		
		If Type([crSigOpCdi.chkOpnCsh])=[N] And InList(crSigOpCdi.chkOpnCsh,1,3,4)
			=ThisForm.OpenCash(TprMvCab.Contads, .F., .F., .T. )
		EndIf 
		
		Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvNfi','CrNfis','EmpDopNums',_Posicao)
		Select crNFis
		Go Top
		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdSer','CrSerie','EmpCods',Thisform.pEmps + crNFis.Series) Or ;
				ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdSer','CrSerie','EmpCods',Space(3) + crNFis.Series) )
			If crSigOpCdd.CancNfs <> 1 And ( ( crSerie.ImpNfs = 1 And crNFis.Impress > 0 ) Or crSerie.ImpNfs = 3 And Messagebox('Confirma Cancelamento da Nota Fiscal?',4+32,'Atenção!!!') = 6 )
				llCanc = .T.
				lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvNfi Set Cancelas = ?llCanc Where EmpDopNums = ']+crNFis.EmpDopNums+[']
				lnErro   = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
				If lnErro < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvNfi)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
			Else
				lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvNfi Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDNe ]
				lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
				If lnErro < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvNfi)')
					Return .F.
				Endif

				Select crNFis
				Go Top
				If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.nFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !Eof( 'crNFis' )
					=fCanUniqueKey( Val( crNFis.NFis ), TprMvCab.Emps + "NOTA FISCAL" + crNFis.Series )
					=fCanUniqueKey( crNFis.Selos, TprMvCab.Emps + 'SELO NOTA FISCAL' + crNFis.Series )
				Endif

			Endif
		Endif
		If Not Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And .F.
			lnnumes = Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes) + TprMvCab.Emps
			If Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigSySeq','crAutoriza','Valor',lnnumes)
				If crAutoriza.Conteudo = TprMvCab.Numes
					=fCanUniqueKey( TprMvCab.Numes, Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes ) + TprMvCab.Emps )
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
		*** Mena - 05/02/2017 - excluir desconto somente se operacao exclusao ***
		IF !f07ExcluirDesconto(lcEDNe,Thisform.poDataMgr)	&& MENA - 22/12/2017 - exclui os descontos associados 
			RETURN .F.
		ENDIF
	Endif
	Trans   = crSigCdOpe.transs
	_BxParc = crSigCdOpe.BxParcials
	_BxAuto = crSigCdOpe.BxAutos

	lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvPec Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
	If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEstPe') < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrEstPe)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvItn','CrEesti','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 ))
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvIts','CrEsti2','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 ))

	Select CrEsti2
	Index On Citens Tag Citens

	Select crEesti
	Scan
		If !Empty( crEesti.CodBarras )
			Insert Into TmpEtiquetas ( CodBarras, Opers ) Values ( crEesti.CodBarras, crEesti.Opers )
		Else
			Select CrEsti2

			Scan

					Insert Into TmpEtiquetas ( CodBarras, Opers ) ;
						Values ( CrEsti2.CodBarras, crEesti.Opers )
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif

		If Seek(crEesti.CPros, 'csOpeAut', 'CPros') And ;
				Not Seek(TprMvCab.Emps + csOpeAut.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), 'csTmpOpAut', 'EmpDopNum' )
			Insert Into csTmpOpAut( AutEmps, AutDopes, AutNumes ) ;
				Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, csOpeAut.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes )
		Endif
		If Seek(crEesti.CPros, 'csOpeTrf', 'Cpros') And ;
				Not Seek(TprMvCab.Emps + csOpeTrf.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), 'csTmpOpeAut', 'EmpDopNum' )
			Insert Into csTmpOpeaut( AutEmps, AutDopes, AutNumes ) ;
				Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, csOpeTrf.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes )
		Endif

		lcEmp = Iif(Empty(crSigCdOpe.EmpPads),TprMvCab.Emps,crSigCdOpe.EmpPads)
		If crSigCdOpe.Consers = 1 And !Empty(crSigCdPam.OpConsers) And Not Seek(lcEmp + crSigCdPam.OpConsers + crEesti.Notas, 'csTmpOpAut', 'EmpDopNum' )
			Insert Into csTmpOpAut( AutEmps, AutDopes, AutNumes ) ;
				Values ( lcEmp, crSigCdPam.OpConsers, Val(crEesti.Notas) )
		Endif
		If crSigOpCdc.InibePa = 3 And ;
				Not Seek(lcEmp + csOpeAut.Dopes + crEesti.Notas, 'csTmpOpAut', 'EmpDopNum' )
			Insert Into csTmpOpAut( AutEmps, AutDopes, AutNumes ) ;
				Values ( lcEmp, csOpeAut.Dopes, Val(crEesti.Notas) )
		Endif

	Endscan

	lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDNe ]
	lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
	If lnErro < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvItn)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	If _BxParc = 1 Or _BxAuto = 1 Or _BxParc = 3

		lcQuery = [Select distinct EmpdopNumb From SigBxEst Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDNe ]
		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrBxIt') < 1)
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrBxIt)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		Select CrSigTempd
		Zap

		Select CrBxIt
		Scan
			Select CrSigTempd
			Append Blank
			Replace EmpDopNums With CrBxIt.EmpDopNumb,;
				CidQuerys  With lcCidQuery,;
				CidChaves  With fUniqueIds()
		Endscan

		If !Thisform.poDataMgr4.Update('CrSigTempd')
			=Thisform.poDataMgr4.Rollback()
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrSigTempD 3)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
		If Thisform.poDataMgr4.commit() < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Commit 4)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		lcQuery = [Select b.EmpdopNums,b.Cpros,b.CodBarras,b.QtBaixas,b.cidChaves,b.citens,b.Qtds,b.QtProds,b.QtReservas,b.Dpros ]+;
			[From SigMvItn b, SigTempd a ]+;
			[Where a.CidQuerys = '] + lcCidQuery + [' And a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums ]

		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrBxItem1') < 1)
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrBxItem1)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		lcQuery = [Select b.EmpDopNums, b.Citens, b.Cpros, b.CodCors, b.CodTams, b.QtBaixas, b.CidChaves, b.QtdEmbs, b.Qtds,b.QtProds,b.QtReservas,b.CodEmbs From SigTempd a, SigMvIts b Where a.CidQuerys = '] + lcCidQuery + [' And a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums ]
		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrBxItem2') < 1)
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrBxItem2)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		Thisform.poDataMgr4.fSqlApagarTmp('SigTempD', lcCidQuery )

		Select CrBxItem1
		Index On EmpDopNums + CPros + Str(Citens,4) Tag EmpDopNum

		Select CrBxItem2
		Index On EmpDopNums + CPros + CodCors + CodTams Tag EmpDopc
		Index On EmpDopNums + Str(Citens,4) Tag EmpDopNum

		=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigBxEst','CrBxEst','EmpDopNums',lcEDNe)

	Endif

	If _BxParc = 1 Or _BxAuto = 1

		Select crBxEst
		Scan
			_BxEstpe = .T.
			If Not Seek(' ','TmpBxPends','BxEmpDopN')
				Insert Into TmpBxPends (BxEmps, BxDopes, BxNumes) Values (crBxEst.EmpBs, crBxEst.DopeBs, crBxEst.NumeBs)
			EndIf
			_QtBaixarX  = 0
			_QtBaixar   = crBxEst.Qtdes
			_cItem      = crBxEst.cItens
			_ChaveDelBx = crBxEst.EmpBs + crBxEst.DopeBs + Str( crBxEst.NumeBs, 6 )
					
			If Empty(crBxEst.CodCors) And Empty(crBxEst.CodTams) And Empty(crBxEst.CodEmbs)
				Select CrBxItem1
				Set Order To EmpDopNum
				Seek ( _ChaveDelBx + crBxEst.CPros )
				_BaixaTotal = .T.
				Scan While EmpDopNums + CPros = _ChaveDelBx + crBxEst.CPros And _QtBaixar > 0
					If (crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss = 3 And crBxEst.CodBarras # CrBxItem1.CodBarras) OR (crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubns = 2 And CrBxItem1.Dpros <> crBxEst.Dpros)
						Loop
					Endif
					_BaixaTotal = .F.
					If _QtBaixar < CrBxItem1.QtBaixas
						_Saldo = CrBxItem1.QtBaixas - _QtBaixar
						Replace CrBxItem1.QtBaixas With Iif(_Saldo < 0, 0, _Saldo)
						_QtBaixar = 0
					Else
						_QtBaixar = _QtBaixar - QtBaixas
						Replace CrBxItem1.QtBaixas With 0
					Endif
					llBaixa = Iif(CrBxItem1.Qtds = CrBxItem1.QtBaixas,.T.,.F.)
					lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvItn Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrBxItem1.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llBaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrBxItem1.CidChaves+[']
					lnErro   = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')

						Return .F.
					Endif

			Else
				
				Select CrBxItem2
				Set Order To EmpDopNum
				*Seek ( _ChaveDelBx + Str(crBxEst.Citens,4) )
				_BaixaTotal = .T.
				
				*Scan While CrBxItem2.EmpDopNums + Str(CrBxItem2.Citens,4) = _ChaveDelBx + Str(crBxEst.Citens,4) And _QtBaixar > 0
				Scan 
					Select CrBxItem2
					If CrBxItem2.EmpDopNums <> _ChaveDelBx
						Loop
					EndIf 
					If Str(CrBxItem2.Citens,4) <> Str(crBxEst.Citens,4)
						Loop
					EndIf 
					If _QtBaixar <= 0
						Loop
					EndIf 
					If CrBxItem2.QtBaixas <= 0
						Loop
					EndIf 
					If CrBxItem2.CPros + CrBxItem2.CodCors + CrBxItem2.CodTams + CrBxItem2.CodEmbs # crBxEst.CPros + crBxEst.CodCors + crBxEst.CodTams + crBxEst.CodEmbs
						Loop
					EndIf
					If crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubns = 2
						=Seek(CrBxItem2.EmpDopNums + CrBxItem1.CPros + Str(CrBxItem1.Citens,4),'CrBxItem1','EmpDopNum')
						If CrBxItem1.Dpros <> crBxEst.Dpros
							Loop
						Endif
					EndIf

					_QtBaixado = 0
					If _QtBaixar < CrBxItem2.QtBaixas
						_Saldo = CrBxItem2.QtBaixas - _QtBaixar
						Replace CrBxItem2.QtBaixas With Iif(_Saldo < 0,0,_Saldo)
						_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar * CrBxItem2.QtdEmbs
						_QtBaixar = 0
					Else
						_QtBaixado = _QtBaixar * CrBxItem2.QtdEmbs
						_QtBaixar = _QtBaixar - CrBxItem2.QtBaixas 
						Replace CrBxItem2.QtBaixas With 0
					Endif
					llBaixa = Iif(CrBxItem2.Qtds=CrBxItem2.QtBaixas,.T.,.F.)
					lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvIts Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrBxItem2.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llBaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrBxItem2.CidChaves+[']
					lnErro   = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
					If lnErro < 1
						Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvIts)')
						Return .F.
					Endif
					
					*----------------
					_QtBaixarX = _QtBaixado
					Select CrBxItem1
					Set Order To EmpDopNum
					_BaixaTotal = .T.
					Scan 
						Select CrBxItem1
						If CrBxItem1.EmpDopNums <> _ChaveDelBx
							Loop
						EndIf  
						If CrBxItem1.CPros <> crBxEst.CPros
							Loop
						EndIf
						If CrBxItem1.Citens <> CrBxItem2.Citens
							Loop
						EndIf
						If _QtBaixarX <= 0
							Loop
						EndIf 
						If (crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss = 3 And crBxEst.CodBarras # CrBxItem1.CodBarras) OR (crSigOpCdd.TpBxSubns = 2 And CrBxItem1.Dpros <> crBxEst.Dpros)
							Loop
						EndIf
						_BaixaTotal = .F.
						If _QtBaixarX < CrBxItem1.QtBaixas
							_Saldo = CrBxItem1.QtBaixas - _QtBaixarX
							Replace CrBxItem1.QtBaixas With Iif(_Saldo < 0, 0, _Saldo)
							_QtBaixarX = 0
						Else
							_QtBaixarX = _QtBaixarX - CrBxItem1.QtBaixas
							Replace CrBxItem1.QtBaixas With 0
						Endif
						llBaixa = Iif(CrBxItem1.Qtds = CrBxItem1.QtBaixas,.T.,.F.)
						lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvItn Set QtBaixas = ]+Str(CrBxItem1.QtBaixas,12,3)+[, ChkSubn = ?llBaixa Where CidChaves = ']+CrBxItem1.CidChaves+[']
						lnErro   = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
						If lnErro < 1
							Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvItn)')
							Return .F.
						EndIf
						Select CrBxItem1
					Endscan
					*----------------
					
*!*						Select CrBxItem1
*!*						Set Order To EmpDopNum
*!*						Seek( CrBxItem2.EmpDopNums)
*!*						Do While CrBxItem1.EmpDopNums = CrBxItem2.EmpDopNums And _QtBaixado > 0
*!*							If CrBxItem1.Citens = CrBxItem2.Citens
*!*								Select CrBxItem1
*!*								_Saldo = CrBxItem1.QtBaixas - _QtBaixado
*!*								Replace CrBxItem1.QtBaixas With Iif(_Saldo<0,0,_Saldo)
*!*								_QtBaixado = 0
*!*								llBaixa = Iif(CrBxItem1.Qtds=CrBxItem1.QtBaixas,.T.,.F.)

*!*							Endif

				lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkBxParcs = ?llsubn, ChkSubn = ?llSubn, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where CidChaves = ']+CrEest.CidChaves+[']

									Return .F.
								Endif
							Endif

				If (crEti.Emps + crEti.Dopes + Str(crEti.Numes,6) = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))
					If ( Thisform.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR' ) And ( crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs = 1 )
						Select crTpmMvItn
						Set Order To CodBarras
						Seek (TmpEtiquetas.CodBarras)
						If Eof()
							lcDelete = [Delete From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ]+Str(TmpEtiquetas.CodBarras,14)
							If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
								=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigOpEtq)')
								Return .F.
							Endif
						Endif
						Select crTpmMvItn
						Set Order To
					Else
						lcDelete = [Delete From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ]+Str(TmpEtiquetas.CodBarras,14)
						If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,' ') < 1)
							=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigOpEtq 2)')
							Return .F.
						Endif
					Endif
				Else
					Store Space(10) To _GrupoEti, _ContaEti, _DopeHis

					If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crhis') < 1)
						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrHis 4)')
						Return .F.
					Endif

					llEtiSemHist = Eof('crHis')
					Entra = .F.

						_EmposEti = CrHis.Emps
						Entra = .T.

							Loop

					Endscan

									Endif
									Skip
								Enddo
								If Eof()

								Endif
								Replace Qtds  With CrHisEtq.Qtds,;
									Pesos With CrHisEtq.Pesos In crEti
								aQtd = crEti.Qtds

												Pesos  With CrHisEtq.Pesos ,;

									Endif

										aPes = crEti.Pesos
									Endif

								Go Top

									[Contas=']+_ContaEti+[', ]+;

			lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdPro Set pcuss = ?lnValor, pesoms = ?lnPeso Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.CPros+[']
			If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdPro)')
				Ret = .F.
				Exit
			Endif

		Endscan
	EndIf

	****************************************************************************************************************
	If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'EXCLUIR'
		lcCurCred = []
		*-- Rafael - 02/03/2017 - Valida Limite de Credito das contas de centro de custo por Matriz
		If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.limcres, 7 )
			If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposCC) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaCCs) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt)
				lcCurCred = [TprMvCab]
				If !Thisform.RetornaLimiteCreditoMatriz( crSigOpCdd.GruposCC, TprMvCab.ContaCCs, crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt, crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt, 'Centro de Custo', lcCurCred )
					Return .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		EndIf
		
		If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.limcres, 8 )
			If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposCC) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaCCs) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt)
				If !ThisForm.LimiteCreditoMatriz( crSigOpCdd.GruposCC, TprMvCab.ContaCCs, crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt, crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt, 'Centro de Custo' )
					Return .F.
				EndIf 
			EndIf 
		EndIf 
	Endif

	If (LocalTOpe.GerGdmis = 2 And LocalTOpe.AtuCompras = 1)
		Select crEesti
		Scan
			If Empty(CPros)
				Loop
			Endif

			lcSql = [Select Top 1 Cpros,Datas,Valors,Moedas From SigOpClU Where Cpros = ']+crEesti.CPros+[' And ]+;
				[EmpDopNums <> ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[' ]+;
				[Order by Datas Desc ]
			If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocalCalcU') < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (LocalCalcU)')
				Return .F.
			Endif

			llData = Iif(Reccount('LocalCalcU') = 0,Null,localCalcU.DataS)
			lnValor = localCalcU.valors
			lcMoeda = localCalcU.Moedas

			lcUpdate = [UpDate SigCdPro Set UltComps = ?llData, vUltComps = ]+Str(lnValor,12,2)+[, ]+;
				[mUltComps = ']+lcMoeda+[' Where Cpros = ']+crEesti.CPros+[']
			If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdPro)')
				Ret = .F.
				Exit
			Endif
		Endscan
	Endif

	If Used('TmpBxPends')
		Use In TmpBxPends
	Endif

	If Used('TmpEtiquetas')
		Use In TmpEtiquetas
	Endif

	If Used('csTmpOpAut')
		Use In csTmpOpAut
	Endif

	If Thisform.pcEscolha = [EXCLUIR]
		lcUpdate = [Update SigCdSed set EmpDopNums = '' Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
		If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdSed)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		*** Tiago - 20/08/2014 - SRCOM - 4alerta - envio de e-mail
		If crSigCdPac.Alertas = 1 And Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 193, 01))) = 1
			lnReg = Iif(Reccount([TmpOperacao])=0,1,Reccount([TmpOperacao]))
			Dimension laOpeBaixa(lnReg)
			Select TmpOperacao
			Scan
				If !IsEmpty(TmpOperacao.Codigos) And TmpOperacao.ChkSubn
					nDope = Int(Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 4)))
					=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','ndopes',nDope,[Dopes])
					Dope  = CrTmpOpe.Dopes
					Nume  = Int(Val(Right(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 6)))
					lcEDN = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + Dope + Str(Nume, 6)
					laOpeBaixa(Recno()) = lcEDN
				Endif
			Endscan

			Do Form SigPrEml With TprMvCab.EmpDopNums, Thisform.pcEscolha, laOpeBaixa
		Endif
	Endif

	lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvCab Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
	If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'') < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvCab 5)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	If Not Thisform.Baixabxest(.T.)
		Return .F.
	Endif

	If Not Thisform.Carrega_vsubn(.T.)
		Return .T.
	Endif

	Return .T.
Else
	Return .F.
Endif


ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE fazcontra
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE fazcontra
LPARAMETERS vTipo, pArquivo

Local NOper, VOper, Oper, Grupo, Conta, Cot, Valor, SOper, SGrupo, SConta, SMoed, SCot
Local SValor, NLanc, VLanc, Venc, Dataa, ValPag, Emp, Hist, Dope, Nume, Dopc, Numc, Nota
Local Titulo, Grupoe, Contae, Grupoa, Contaa, ValLiq, Hist2

lcArqMccr = 'cqSigMvCcr'
If Type('pArquivo') = [C]
	lcArqMccr = pArquivo
EndIf

Select (lcArqMccr)
NOper  = &lcArqMccr..nopers
VOper  = &lcArqMccr..vopers
Oper   = &lcArqMccr..sopers
Grupo  = &lcArqMccr..sgrupos
Conta  = &lcArqMccr..scontas
Moed   = &lcArqMccr..smoedas
Cot    = &lcArqMccr..scotacaos
Valor  = &lcArqMccr..svalors
SOper  = &lcArqMccr..opers
SGrupo = &lcArqMccr..grupos
SConta = &lcArqMccr..contas
SMoed  = &lcArqMccr..moedas
SCot   = &lcArqMccr..cotacaos
SValor = &lcArqMccr..valors
NLanc  = &lcArqMccr..nlancs
VLanc  = &lcArqMccr..vlancs
Data   = &lcArqMccr..datas
Venc   = &lcArqMccr..vencs
Dataa  = &lcArqMccr..datalts
Valpag = &lcArqMccr..valpags
Emp    = &lcArqMccr..emps
Hist   = &lcArqMccr..hists
Hist2  = &lcArqMccr..Hist2s
Dope   = &lcArqMccr..Dopes
Nume   = &lcArqMccr..numes
Dopc   = &lcArqMccr..dopcs
Numc   = &lcArqMccr..numcs
Nota   = &lcArqMccr..nfs
Titulo = &lcArqMccr..titulos
Grupoe = &lcArqMccr..grupems
Contae = &lcArqMccr..contems
Grupoa = &lcArqMccr..grupages
Contaa = &lcArqMccr..contages
ValLiq = &lcArqMccr..valliqs
lcTipo = IIF(vTipo,&lcArqMccr..Tipos,' ')
lcJob    = &lcArqMccr..Jobs
_CidChave = Dtos(Data)+Transform(fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(Data)),"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey 

Insert Into (lcArqMccr) ( VOpers, NOpers, NLancs, VLancs, Opers, Grupos,;
		Contas, Moedas, Cotacaos, Valors, Emps, Datas, usualts, datalts,;
		sgrupos, scontas, smoedas, scotacaos, svalors, sopers, autos,;
		hists, Dopes, numes, valpags, vencs, dopcs, numcs, nfs, titulos,;
		grupems, contems, grupages, contages, valliqs, CidChaves, Tipos, Hist2s, Jobs ) ;
	Values ( vOper, nOper, nLanc, vLanc, Oper, Grupo, Conta, Moed, Cot,;
		Valor, Emp, Data, Usuar, Dataa, sGrupo, sConta, sMoed, sCot,;
		sValor, sOper, .t., hist, Dope, Nume, valpag, venc, dopc, numc,;
		nota, titulo, grupoe, contae, grupoa, contaa, valliq, _CidChave, lcTipo, Hist2, lcJob )
Replace &lcArqMccr..gruconmoes with &lcArqMccr..grupos + &lcArqMccr..contas + &lcArqMccr..moedas,;
		&lcArqMccr..empdopnums with &lcArqMccr..emps + &lcArqMccr..dopes + Str(&lcArqMccr..numes,6),;
		&lcArqMccr..empdopncs  with &lcArqMccr..emps + &lcArqMccr..dopcs + Str(&lcArqMccr..numcs,6),;
		&lcArqMccr..Pagos      With Iif(&lcArqMccr..Valors=&lcArqMccr..valpags,'0','1') ,;
		&lcArqMccr..DopoTps    with &lcArqMccr..Dopcs + &lcArqMccr..Opers + &lcArqMccr..Tipos + &lcArqMccr..Pagos in &lcArqMccr.

If lcArqMccr = 'cqSigMvCcr'
	=fRecalculaS( &lcArqMccr..Grupos, &lcArqMccr..Contas, &lcArqMccr..Datas, &lcArqMccr..Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr  )
EndIf

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE fdavrg
Thisform.poDatamgr.CursorQuery([SigOpCdd], [LocalOpe2], [Dopes], Padr(TprMvCab.Dopes, 20), [DckDPro3s])
Go Top In LocalOpe2
*!*	If Eof([LocalOpe2])
*!*		Insert Into LocalOpe2 (DckLogos, DckAcess, DocAcess, ChkImpDp, ChkImpRot, ChkImpMon) Values (0, 0, [], 0, 0, 0)

*!*	EndIf

*!*	Thisform.poDatamgr.CursorQuery([SigOpCdc], [LocalDcOpe], [Dopes], Padr(TprMvCab.Dopes, 20), [DocTit, DocOrig, DocDest, ] + ;
*!*					  [DckReffs, DocReffs, DckPrzE, DocPrzE, TxtPrzEnts, ChkPrzEnts, DckVend, DocVend, DocPag, ] + ;
*!*					  [DckTVend, DckBarra, DckFretes, DocFretes, DckIcmIpi, DocDesco, DocAcres, DckEntregs, DocEntregs, ] + ;
*!*					  [DckObsI, ImgTecs, DckTermos, TitTermos, TxtTermos, ViaTermos, TitTermgs, TxtTermgs, TitTermGs, ] + ;
*!*					  [TxtTermBs, DocFxSemVl, DocFxVencs, DckTpFats, DckFiscal, DckImpIte, DckSubN])

Thisform.poDatamgr.CursorQuery([SigOpCdc], [LocalDcOpe], [Dopes], Padr(TprMvCab.Dopes, 20), [DckFiscal])
lcQryGer = [Select Ordems From SigFiRlg Where descrs = 'DAV EMITIDOS' And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
