IF RECCOUNT('cstmpger') = 0
	MESSAGEBOX([Relatório Gerencial 'DAV ' não cadastrado.],64,'Aviso')
	RETURN .f.
ENDIF

ThisForm.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdEmp','CrEmp','Cemps',ThisForm.pEmps,[RazSocs,Cgcs])
lcfor = ''
* Inserindo Dados do Fornecedor
*!*	If InList(crSigCdOpe.Opers, 1, 3) And Not Empty(LocalDcOpe.DocOrig)
*!*		lcFor = TprMvCab.ContaOs
*!*	EndIf
*!*	If InList(crSigCdOpe.Opers, 2, 3) And Not Empty(LocalDcOpe.DocDest)
*!*		lcFor = TprMvCab.ContaDs
*!*	EndIf
If InList(crSigCdOpe.Opers, 1, 3) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaOs)
	lcFor = TprMvCab.ContaOs
EndIf
If InList(crSigCdOpe.Opers, 2, 3) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs)
	lcFor = TprMvCab.ContaDs
EndIf

ThisForm.Podatamgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli', 'LocalCli', 'IClis', lcFor, ;
				  'Razaos, RClis, Endes, Nums, Compls, Ceps, Cidas, Bairs, Estas, Contato, ' + ;
				  'Ddds, Tel1s, Tel2s, Faxs, eMails, Cpfs, Rgs, InscMuns, TpClis')

*** mena 21/01/2016 - monta empdopnums ***
*!*lcEdn = TprMvCab.empdopnums
lcEDN = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)

cndoc = Padl(TprMvCab.Numes, 10, '0') && Padl(crSigCdOpe.nDopes, 4, '0')

Create Cursor crRelGer1 (cLinhas c(48))
Create cursor crRelGer (cCodBarras c(48), lImpBars N(1))

INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras,lImpBars) VALUES (cndoc,1)
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (PADC(Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes) + [ - ] + cndoc,48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE('-',48))
*!*	lcbarra = PADL(cndoc,16,'0')
*!*	lcBarra = lcBarra + CalcDv(lcBarra)
*!*	lcBarra = lcBarra + CalcDv(lcBarra)
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger VALUES (PADC('Identificação do Estabelecimento Emitente',48))
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger VALUES (REPLICATE('-',48))
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger VALUES (PADR('Denominação',30) + 'CNPJ')
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger VALUES (PADR(CrEmp.RazSocs,29) + [ ] + CrEmp.Cgcs)
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger VALUES (REPLICATE('-',48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (PADC('Dados do Cliente',48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE('-',48))
cnome = Iif(Empty(LocalCli.Razaos), LocalCli.RClis, LocalCli.Razaos)
cnome = PADR(cnome,35) + [ - ] + lcFor
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (cnome)
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('CPF: ' + LocalCli.Cpfs + ' RG: ' + LocalCli.RGS)
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Endereço: ' + PADR(LocalCli.Endes,30) + ',' + LocalCli.Nums)
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Bairro: ' + LocalCli.Bairs)
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Cidade: ' + PADR(LocalCli.cidas,20) + '/' + LocalCli.Estas + ' CEP: ' + LocalCli.Ceps)
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Contato: ' + LocalCli.Contato)
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('E-mail: ' + LocalCli.eMails)
*!*	INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Telefone: ' + PADR(LocalCli.Tel1s,15) + ' Fax: ' + PADR(LocalCli.faxs,15))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE('-',48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Item Código         Descrição')
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES ('Qtd.      Un. Vl unit                   Vl Total')
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE('-',48))

* Campos Usados Do SigMvItn
* CItens 	= Nº do Ítem
* CPros		= Código do Produto
* Reffs		= Referência do Fornecedor (SigCdPro)
* DPros		= Descrição do Produto
* CUnis		= Unidade
* Qtds		= Quantidade
* Units		= Valor Unitário
* Totas		= Valor Total
* Aliqs		= Alíquota do IPI
* ValIpis	= Valor do IPI
* Obs		= Observação do Item
* ValDescs  = Valor desconto/acréscimo

lcQuery = [Select a.CItens, a.CPros, b.Reffs, a.DPros, a.CUnis, a.Qtds, a.Units, a.Totas, ] + ;
				 [a.Aliqs, a.ValIpis, a.Obs, b.iFors, a.ValDescs, a.sittricms, a.aliqicms, a.univals, a.cidchaves ] + ;
		    [From SigMvItn a, SigCdPro b ] + ;
		   [Where a.EmpDopNums = '] + lcEdn + [' And ] + ;
		   		 [a.CPros = b.CPros ] + ;
		   [Order By a.CItens]

If (Thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalEestI]) < 1)
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalEestI)])
	Return .f.
EndIf
Go Bottom In LocalEestI

If (crSigOpCdd.ImpFxSers = 1)
	lnItn = LocalEestI.CItens

	lcQuery = [Select a.* ] + ;
			    [From SigMvItt a ] + ;
			   [Where a.EmpDopNums = '] + lcEdn + [' ] + ;
			   [Order By a.CItens]

	If (Thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalEestis]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalEestis)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Go Top In LocalEestis

	Select LocalEestis
	Scan
		lnItn = lnItn + 1

		Insert Into LocalEestI (CItens, CPros, DPros, CUnis, Qtds, Units, Totas) ;
						Values (lnItn, LocalEestis.CPros, LocalEestis.DPros, LocalEestis.CUnis, ;
								LocalEestis.Qtds, LocalEestis.Units, LocalEestis.Totas, LocalEestis.univals)
	EndScan
EndIf
Go Top in LocalEestI

* Campos Usados Do SigMvIts
* CItens 	= Nº do Ítem
* CPros		= Código do Produto
* Reffs		= Referência do Fornecedor (SigCdPro)
* DPros		= Descrição do Produto
* CUnis		= Unidade
* Qtds		= Quantidade
* Units		= Valor Unitário
* Totas		= Valor Total
* Aliqs		= Alíquota do IPI
* ValIpis	= Valor do IPI
* Obs		= Observação do Item

lcQuery = [Select a.CItens, a.CPros, c.Reffs, a.DPros, b.CodEmbs as CUnis, b.Qtds, a.Units, ] + ;
				 [b.QtdEmbs, a.Aliqs, a.ValIpis, a.Qtds as QtdsA, a.Obs, c.iFors, a.ValDescs, b.codbarras, b.codtams, b.pesos, b.codcors, b.empdopnums, ] + ;
				 [a.sittricms, a.aliqicms, a.univals, a.cidchaves ]+ ;
		    [From SigMvItn a, SigMvIts b, SigCdPro c ] + ;
		   [Where a.EmpDopNums = '] + lcEdn + [' And ] + ;
		   		 [a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums And ] + ;
		   		 [a.CItens = b.CItens And ] + ;
		   		 [b.CPros = c.CPros ] + ;
		   [Order By a.CItens]

If (Thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [TmpEstI2]) < 1)
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (TmpEstI2)])
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select CItens, CPros, Reffs, DPros, CUnis, Qtds, Units * Iif(QtdEmbs > 0, QtdEmbs, 1) as Units, ;
	  (Qtds * Units) * Iif(QtdEmbs > 0, QtdEmbs, 1) as Totas, Aliqs, iFors, ;
	  (ValIpis / Iif(QtdsA=0,1,QtdsA)) * (Qtds * Iif(QtdEmbs > 0, QtdEmbs, 1)) as ValIpis, Obs, codbarras, codtams, pesos, codcors, empdopnums, ;
	  sittricms, aliqicms, univals, cidchaves, valdescs ;
  From TmpEstI2 ;
 Order By CItens ;
  Into Cursor LocalEstI2 ReadWrite

Go Top In LocalEstI2
Select LocalEstI2
Index On Str(CItens, 6) Tag CItens

oFormulario = thisform.omodemEest
lnNoFabr = leiturafab(oFormulario)
If Type('lnNoFabr')<>'C' OR EMPTY(lnNoFabr)
	MessageBox('Não foi possível ler número de fabricação da impressora.',16,'Aviso')
	RETURN .f.
ENDIF

*!*	lnnocupom = TprMvCab.notas
lcNoCupom = LeituraNoCupom(oFormulario)
If type('lcNoCupom')='C' And Not Empty(lcNoCupom)
	lnnoCupom = Transform(Val(lcNoCupom) + 1, '@L 999999')
ENDIF

lnItn = 0
lnSeq = 0
Select LocalEestI
Scan
	lcFis = []
	If (LocalDcOpe.DckFiscal = 1) Or (LocalOpe2.DckDPro3s = 1) && Se Apanha a Descrição Fiscal ou Completa do Produto
		lcQuery = [Select DescFis, DPro3s ] + ;
					[From SigCdPro ] + ;
				   [Where Cpros = '] + LocalEestI.CPros + [']

		If (Thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalPro]) < 1)
			=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (Processamento - LocalPro)])
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Go Top In LocalPro
		If Not Eof([LocalPro])
			lcFis = Nvl(Iif(LocalDcOpe.DckFiscal = 1, LocalPro.DescFis, LocalPro.DPro3s), [])
			lcFis = Strtran(Strtran(Strtran(Alltrim(lcFis), Chr(13), [ ]), Chr(10), [ ]), [  ], [ ])
		EndIf
	EndIf

	Select LocalEstI2
	If Seek(Str(LocalEestI.CItens, 6), 'LocalEstI2', 'CItens')
		Select LocalEstI2
		Scan While (CItens = LocalEestI.CItens)
			lnItn = lnItn + 1
			lnSeq = lnSeq + 1
			
			* Qtd de Casas de acordo com Movimentação ( Quantidade )
			lnCas  = Iif(crSigOpCdd.CasQtds = 0 , 3, crSigOpCdd.CasQtds )
			lcMask = '999999999'+Iif(lnCas>0,'.' + Repl( '9', lnCas ),'')
			lnSetAnt = Set("Decimals") 
			Set Decimals To Max(lnCas,0)
			lcQtd  = Transform(LocalEstI2.Qtds,Right(lcMask,9))
			Set Decimals To lnSetAnt
			
			* Qtd de Casas de acordo com Movimentação ( valor unitário )
			lnCas   = Iif(crSigCdOpe.Casas = 0 , 2, crSigCdOpe.Casas )
			lcMask  = '999999999'+Iif(lnCas>0,'.' + Repl( '9', lnCas ),'')
			lnSetAnt = Set("Decimals") 
			Set Decimals To Max(lnCas,0)
			lcUnits = Transform(LocalEstI2.Units,Right(lcMask,15))
			Set Decimals To lnSetAnt			
			
			lnCas = 48 - Len(lcQtd + [ ] + LocalEstI2.cunis + [X] + lcUnits + [ ])
			
			INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (STR(lnSeq,4) + [ ] + LocalEstI2.cpros + [ ] + Iif(Empty(lcFis), LocalEstI2.DPros, lcFis))
			INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (lcQtd + [ ] + LocalEstI2.cunis + [X] + lcUnits + [ ] + PADL(TRANSFORM(LocalEstI2.totas,'999999.99'),lncas))
			=ECFLOG('CD', TprMvCab.nCupoms, oFormulario,'S',lnnofabr,'LocalEstI2')
			Select LocalEestI
		EndScan
		Select LocalEestI
	Else
		lnItn = lnItn + 1
		lnSeq = lnSeq + 1

		lnTotal = LocalEestI.totas
		lnUnit = LocalEestI.Units
		If LocalEestI.ValDescs <> 0 && Se tiver desconto/acréscimo, calcula o preço unitário para sair separado
			lnUnit = LocalEestI.Units + LocalEestI.ValDescs
			lnTotal = lnUnit * LocalEestI.Qtds
		EndIf

		* Qtd de Casas de acordo com Movimentação ( quantidade )
		lnCas  = Iif(crSigOpCdd.CasQtds = 0 , 3, crSigOpCdd.CasQtds )
		lcMask = '999999999'+Iif(lnCas>0,'.' + Repl( '9', lnCas ),'')
		lnSetAnt = Set("Decimals") 
		Set Decimals To Max(lnCas,0)
		lcQtd  = Transform(LocalEestI.Qtds,Right(lcMask,9))
		Set Decimals To lnSetAnt

		* Qtd de Casas de acordo com Movimentação ( valor unitário )
		lnCas   = Iif(crSigCdOpe.Casas = 0 , 2, crSigCdOpe.Casas )
		lcMask  = '999999999'+Iif(lnCas>0,'.' + Repl( '9', lnCas ),'')
		lnSetAnt = Set("Decimals")
		Set Decimals To Max(lnCas,0)
		lcUnits = Transform(lnUnit,Right(lcMask,15))
		lcUnit2s = Transform(LocalEestI.Units,Right(lcMask,15))		
		Set Decimals To lnSetAnt

		lnCas = 48 - Len(lcQtd + [ ] + LocalEestI.cunis + [X] + lcUnits + [ ])
	
		INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (STR(lnSeq,4) + [ ] + LocalEestI.cpros + [ ] + Iif(Empty(lcFis), LocalEestI.DPros, lcFis))
		INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (lcQtd + [ ] + LocalEestI.cunis + [X] + lcUnits + [ ] + PADL(TRANSFORM(lnTotal,'999,999.99'),lnCas))
		If LocalEestI.ValDescs <> 0
			INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (Padr(Iif(LocalEestI.ValDescs < 0,[acrescimo],[desconto]),9) + TRANSFORM(ABS(LocalEestI.ValDescs),'999,999.99') + Space(10) + PADL(TRANSFORM(LocalEestI.totas,'999,999.99'),lnCas))
		EndIf
		=ECFLOG('CD', TprMvCab.nCupoms, oFormulario,'S',lnnofabr,'LocalEestI')
		Select LocalEestI
	EndIf
EndScan

*** Homologação paf - 09/2012 - seleciona itens cancelados na Movimentação de orçamento RG ***
lcQuery = [Select a.CPros, a.DPros, a.empdopnums, a.Qtds, a.Units, a.Totas From sigexmvi a ] + ;
		  [Where a.empdopnums = '] + lcEdn + [']

If (Thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalEestIE]) < 1)
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalEestI)])
	Return .f.
EndIf
********************************************************************************************
**** Homologação paf 09/2012 - inclui itens cancelados da impressão do DAV RG ****
	SELECT LocalEestIE
	GO top
	SCAN
		lnItn = lnItn + 1
		lnSeq = lnSeq + 1
		INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (STR(lnSeq,4) + [ ] + LocalEestIE.cpros + [ ] + ALLTRIM(LocalEestIE.DPros) + ' CANCELADO')
	ENDSCAN
********************************************************************************

ctotal = TRANSFORM(thisform.totite,'999,999.99')
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (PADL(REPLICATE('-',24),48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (PADR('Total',38) + PADL(ctotal,10))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE(' ',48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE(' ',48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (REPLICATE(' ',48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (PADC(REPLICATE('_',30),48))
INSERT INTO crrelger(cCodBarras) VALUES (PADC('Assinatura Cliente',48))

*!*	oFormulario = thisform.omodemEest
*!*	lnNoFabr = leiturafab(oFormulario)
*!*	If Type('lnNoFabr')<>'C' OR EMPTY(lnNoFabr)
*!*		MessageBox('Não foi possível ler número de fabricação da impressora.',16,'Aviso')
*!*		RETURN .f.
*!*	ENDIF

*!*	*!*	lnnocupom = TprMvCab.notas
*!*	lcNoCupom = LeituraNoCupom(oFormulario)
*!*	If type('lcNoCupom')='C' And Not Empty(lcNoCupom)
*!*		lnnoCupom = Transform(Val(lcNoCupom) + 1, '@L 999999')
*!*	ENDIF
DO CASE
	CASE InList(crSigFiFis.Imps, [BEMA8501])
		ImpVen = ImprimirRG(Transform(csTmpGer.Ordems,'@L 99'), [crRelGer1], [crRelGer], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)
	CASE InList(crSigFiFis.Imps, [EPSON],[NSWEDA])
		ImpVen = ImprimirRG(csTmpGer.Ordems, [crRelGer1], [crRelGer], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)
	CASE InList(crSigFiFis.Imps, [DARUMA])
		ImpVen = ImprimirRG('DAV', [crRelGer1], [crRelGer], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)
	OTHERWISE
		impven = .t.
ENDCASE

Ok=.f.
If ImpVen
	If Not ThisForm.GerarCupom(.f.,.t.)
		Return .f.
	Endif
	If Not ( CrSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 And InList(CrSigCdOpe.nfiscals,1,2) )
		lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set Notas = ']+TprMvCab.Notas+[', nCupoms = ']+TprMvCab.nCupoms+[', ]+;
				   [CcfGnfs = ']+TprMvCab.CcfGnfs+[', nEmps = '] + lnNoFabr + [' Where CidChaves = ']+TprMvCab.CidChaves+[']
		=ThisForm.PodataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
		=ThisForm.Podatamgr2.commit()
	ENDIF

	_pData = ThisForm.PodataMgr.GetDatetime()
	llDtAlt = _pData
	lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set lCancelas = ?ok , DtAlts = ?llDtAlt, DataTrans = Null Where EmpDopNums = ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
	=ThisForm.PoDatamgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where empDopNums = ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
	=ThisForm.PoDatamgr2.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
	=ThisForm.Podatamgr2.commit()	
Endif
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE fecharcupom
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE fecharcupom
Lparameters oFormulario, pImpEcf

Local llRetorno, crlf, lcCod, lcTxt

lcCliente = (TprMvCab.Contads)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',lcCliente,[Cpfs,Rclis,paises,Endes,Nums,cidas,Estas,Rgs])

lcCpf  = [ ]
lcNom  = [ ]
lcEnd  = [ ]
lcImp  = [N]
lcPais = Iif(IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.Paises),'BRASIL',Upper(CrTmpCli.paises))
lcVend = Alltrim(TprMvCab.Vends)
If InList(crSigCdOpe.ImpClis,[S],[O]) And (lcPais <> [BRASIL] Or crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 )
	lcCpf = ALLTRIM(CrTmpCli.Rgs)+' '+alltrim(CrTmpCli.Paises)
	lcNom = Alltrim(CrTmpCli.Rclis)
	lcImp = [S]
	If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3
		If crSigOpCdd.ConfIcs <> 1 Or MessageBox('Deseja Imprimir o CPF/CNPJ do Cliente? ',4+32+256,'Confirmação') = 6
			lcCpf = "CNPJ/CPF Consumidor:"+ALLTRIM(CrTmpCli.Cpfs)
		EndIf
	EndIf
ELSE
	IF InList(crSigCdOpe.ImpClis,[S],[O])
		lcImp = [S]
		lcNom = Alltrim(CrTmpCli.Rclis)		
		lcCpf = ALLTRIM(CrTmpCli.Endes) + '-' + ALLTRIM(CrTmpCli.Nums) + chr(13) + CHR(10) + ;
				ALLTRIM(crtmpcli.cidas) + '-' + ALLTRIM(crtmpcli.estas) 
	ENDIF
EndIf

*** Tiago - 11/11/2010
lcdav = ''
If crSigOpCdd.PafEcfs = 1
	lcWhere = [Select codigos, dopes From SigMvPec Where EmpDopNums = ?TprMvCab.empdopnums ]
	lnErro = ThisForm.podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpEstpe')
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEstPe)')
		RETURN .f.
	ENDIF
	SELECT CrTmpEstpe
	Go top
	IF !EMPTY(CrTmpEstpe.codigos)
		OldNDope = Val( Left( Str( CrTmpEstpe.codigos, 10 ), 4) )
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe','ndopes',oldNdope,[Dopes])
	
		=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdPaf','temppaf','dopes',fDecriptografar(TmpOpe.Dopes))
		lcdav = IIF(INLIST(fCriptografar(temppaf.Docs),'3','4'),'DAV','PV')+Padl(Right(Alltrim(Str(CrTmpEstpe.codigos,10,0)),6),10,'0')
	ENDIF

*!*		SCAN
*!*			lcdav = lcdav + IIF(!empty(lcdav),',','') + TRANSFORM(CrTmpEstpe.codigos,'@L 9999999999')
*!*		EndScan
	If Reccount('CrTmpEstPe') > 1
		lcDoppe = CrTmpEstpe.dopes &&crSigOpCdc.DopeNfs
*!*			If ( ( crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 1 And Not Empty(lcDoppe) ) Or crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2 )
			If .t.	&&ThisForm.Gerarnota(lcDoppe)
				lnLoop = .f.
				DO While Not lnLoop

					llTaOk = .t.

					If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))

*!*							ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Gravando Dados'

						llTaOk = llTaOk And SqlCalcp2(.t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm)
						llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaS( .t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,Thisform)
						llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaC(.t.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,ThisForm)
						llTaOk = llTaOk And ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0 

					Else

*!*							Wait Window 'Executando Gravação Fisica dos arquivos ' Nowait

						llTaOk = llTaOk And SqlCalcp2(.t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
						llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaS( .t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
						llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaC(.t.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
						llTaOk = llTaOk And ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0 And llTaOk
							llTaOk = ThisForm.poDataMgr6.Commit() > 0
							If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
								llTaOk = .t.
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf

					If Not llTaOk
						ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
							ThisForm.poDataMgr6.RollBack()
						EndIf
						If MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração da Movimentação '+Alltrim(lcDoppe)+'. Tentar Novamente!!',4+32,'Falha na Conexão') = 7

							Select crSigMvNfi
							Go top
							=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
							If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !Eof( 'crSigMvNfi' )
								=fCanUniqueKey( Val( crSigMvNfi.NFis ), TprMvCab.Emps + "NOTA FISCAL" + crSigMvNfi.Series )
								=fCanUniqueKey( crSigMvNfi.Selos, TprMvCab.Emps + 'SELO NOTA FISCAL' + crSigMvNfi.Series )
							EndIf

							MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração da Movimentação '+Alltrim(lcDoppe)+'. Gere Pelo Processo Manual!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
							lnLoop = .T.
						EndIf
					Else
						lnLoop = .T.
					EndIf
				EndDo
			Else
				ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()

				If ( crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 1 And Not Empty(lcDoppe) )
					Select crSigMvNfi
					Go top
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
					If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !Eof( 'crSigMvNfi' )
						=fCanUniqueKey( Val( crSigMvNfi.NFis ), TprMvCab.Emps + "NOTA FISCAL" + crSigMvNfi.Series )
						=fCanUniqueKey( crSigMvNfi.Selos, TprMvCab.Emps + 'SELO NOTA FISCAL' + crSigMvNfi.Series )
					EndIf
					MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração da Movimentação '+Alltrim(lcDoppe)+'. Gere Pelo Processo Manual!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Else
					MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração das Movimentações Filhos. Favor Gerar Novamente o processo!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				EndIf
			EndIf
*!*			EndIf
 
		Select CrTmpEstpe
		Go top
		lcdav = IIF(INLIST(fCriptografar(temppaf.Docs),'3','4'),'DAV','PV')+Padl(Right(Alltrim(Str(CrTmpEstpe.codigos,10,0)),6),10,'0')
	EndIf


*** homologacao paf - 09/2012 - Verifica se usuario de MG ou RJ para cadastrar mensagem promocional ***
	crlf = CHR(10) + CHR(13)
	lcCod = ''
	lcTxt = ''
	lcD = DTOC(TprMvCab.datas) 

*** homologacao paf - 05/2016 - imprime numero da NF manual (SC)
	lcCod = IIF(TprMvCab.npedclis = 0,[], 'NF: '+ALLTRIM(TRANSFORM(TprMvCab.npedclis, '@L 999999')))

	If (crSigCdEmp.Estas = 'MG')
		lcCod = 'MINAS LEGAL:' + ALLTRIM(Strtran(Strtran(Strtran(crSigCdEmp.cgcs, [.], []), [-], []), [/], []))
		lcCod = lcCod + [ ] + SUBSTR(lcD,1,2) + SUBSTR(lcD,4,2) +SUBSTR(lcD,7,4)  
		lcD = TRANSFORM(TprMvCab.valos, '@R 999999999.99')
		lcD = ALLTRIM(Strtran(lcD, [.], []))
		lcD = IIF(SUBSTR(lcD, 1, 1)<>'0',lcD,SUBSTR(lcD, 2))
		lcD = IIF(SUBSTR(lcD, 1, 1)<>'0',lcD,SUBSTR(lcD, 2))
		lcCod = lcCod + [ ] + lcD+crlf
	ENDIF
	
*** mena - 20/05/2016 - este item foi revogado na homologação ***	
*!*		If (crSigCdEmp.Estas = 'RJ')
*!*			*** mena 17/08/2015 - retirado para pegar do campo da empresa - OS TRECHOS DO TEXTO PRECISAM ESTAR SEPARADOS POR PONTO E VIRGULA (;) ***
*!*			&&& 'CUPOM MANIA, CONCORRA A PRÊMIOS' + crlf + 'ENVIE SMS P/ 6789: '
*!*			lcTxt = STREXTRACT(ALLTRIM(crSigCdEmp.textopaf),';',';',1)	&& pega o primeiro texto do campo - 'CUPOM MANIA, CONCORRA A PRÊMIOS'
*!*			lcCod = IIF(EMPTY(lcTxt),[],lcTxt + crlf)	
*!*			lcTxt = STREXTRACT(ALLTRIM(crSigCdEmp.textopaf),';',';',3)	&& pega o segundo texto - 'ENVIE SMS P/ 6789: '
*!*			lcCod = lcCod + lcTXT+SUBSTR(Strtran(Strtran(Strtran(crSigCdEmp.ies, [.], []), [-], []), [/], [])+SPACE(8), 1, 8)
*!*			lcCod = lcCod + SUBSTR(lcD,1,2) + SUBSTR(lcD,4,2) +SUBSTR(lcD,9,2) + TprMvCab.notas + SUBSTR(TprMvCab.ecfs, 1, 3)+crlf
*!*			lcCod = lcCod + STREXTRACT(ALLTRIM(crSigCdEmp.textopaf),';',';',5)+crlf
*!*		ENDIF
**********************************************************************************************************************
		
	*****
ENDIF
*** Mena - 27/03/2014 - inclui vendedor ***
lcCod = lcCod + CHR(10) + lcVend

*** Mena - 10/06/2013 mostra imposto aproximado no fechamento do cupom fiscal ***
*!*	IF TYPE('thisform.impostoa')='N' and thisform.impostoa <> 0
*!*		lcCod = lcCod + CHR(10) + 'Val Aprox dos Tributos R$' + ALLTRIM(TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoa, '999999.99')) + ;
*!*				' (' + ALLTRIM(TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoa/TprMvCab.valos*100, '99.99'))+'%) IBPT'  
*!*	ENDIF

lcTxt = ''
IF crSigCdOpe.CupFis=1 and thisform.impostoF+thisform.impostoE+thisform.impostoM <> 0	&& mena 29/01/2016 so imprime impostos se for CF
	lcTxt = CHR(10)+'Trib aprox R$: '
	IF thisform.impostoM <> 0
		lcTXT = lcTxt+IIF(thisform.impostoF<>0,TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoF, '@Z 9999.99') + 'Fed ','')
		lcTXT = lcTxt+IIF(thisform.impostoE<>0,TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoE, '@Z 9999.99') + 'Est ','')
		lcTXT = lcTxt+IIF(thisform.impostoM<>0,TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoM, '@Z 9999.99') + 'Mun ','')
	ELSE
		lcTXT = lcTxt+IIF(thisform.impostoF<>0,TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoF, '@Z 9999.99') + 'Federal ','')
		lcTXT = lcTxt+IIF(thisform.impostoE<>0,TRANSFORM(thisform.impostoE, '@Z 9999.99') + 'Estadual ','')
	ENDIF
	lcTXT = lcTxt+CHR(10)+'Fonte: ' + PADR(ALLTRIM(ibptax.m),30) + ibptax.k
ENDIF

lcCod = lcCod + lcTxt


*** Mena - 11/09/2013 - incluido vencimento da ultima forma de pagamento - solicitacao LaSalete ***
IF crSigCdOpe.CupFis=3
	SELECT xpar
	GO bottom
	IF !EOF() and !EMPTY(xpar.vencs)
		lccod = lcCod+crlf+'Vencimento: '+DTOC(xpar.vencs)
	ENDIF
ENDIF

If InList(pImpEcf,'ELGIN')
	llRetorno = FecharCupom(oFormulario, crSigCdOpe.CupFis, lcImp, lcCpf, lcNom)
Else
	If crSigCdOpe.CupFis=1 && Mena - 13/06/2014 - se for cupom não fiscal mantem os dados do cliente
  		lcCpf = [] && mena 27/03/2014 - já imprime endereço no inicio do cupom
	  	lcNom = [] && ja imprime nome no inicio do cupom 
	Endif
	llRetorno = FecharCupom(oFormulario, lcImp, lcCpf, lcNom, goSistema.Operador, lcdav, lcCod )
EndIf

Return (llRetorno)


ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE formula1
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE formula1
LParameter pcMoedas, pArqCab, pArqItem

Local lcpArqCab

If Type('pArqCab')='C'
	lcpArqCab = Alltrim(pArqCab)
Else
	lcpArqCab = 'TprMvCab'
EndIf

If Type('pArqItem')='C'
	lcpArqItem = Alltrim(pArqItem)
Else
	lcpArqItem = 'crTpmMvItn'
Endif

lcQuery = [Select * From SigOpTdt Where Codigos = ']+&lcpArqCab..Tabds+[']
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigOpTdt') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigOpTdt 2)')
	Return 0
EndIf

Select crSigOpTdt
Index On Codigos + Str(Tipos,1) + CodTips Tag CodTips
Set Order to CodTips

Local _Formula, _Form, _Conta, _Campo, _Oper, _Const, _Formula1, _Formula2, _ValConst, lcMoedas

lcMoedas = Iif( Type('pcMoedas') = 'C', PadR( pcMoedas, 10 ), Replicate( Chr(255), 10 ) )
Store '' to _Formula1, _Formula2, _Moeda1, _Moeda2

If Seek( &lcpArqCab..Tabds + '4' + CrTmpPro.CPros ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..Tabds + '9' + CrTmpPro.CodFinP ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..Tabds + '1' + CrTmpPro.CGrus ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..Tabds + '2' + CrTmpPro.Linhas ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..Tabds + '3' + CrTmpPro.Colecoes ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..TabDs + '5' + lcMoedas ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..TabDs + '6' + CrTmpPro.Cunis ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..TabDs + '7' + CrTmpPro.Cftios ) Or ;
	Seek( &lcpArqCab..TabDs + '8' + CrTmpPro.Sgrus )

	*** Tiago - 29/05/2013 - DRW - Checa se a tabela está configurada para olhar a faixa (por quantidade, peso ou total peso)
	If !Inlist(crSigOpTdt.Faixas,0,1)
		lcCdTabDi = crSigOpTdt.codigos
		lnTipos   = crSigOpTdt.tipos
		lcCodTips = crSigOpTdt.codtips
		lnFaixa = Iif(crSigOpTdt.Faixas = 2,&lcpArqItem..Qtds,Iif(crSigOpTdt.Faixas = 3,&lcpArqItem..Pesos,&lcpArqItem..TPesos))
		If InList(crSigOpCdc.CarCompos,5) and !Empty(&lcpArqItem..Citem2)
			lcitem = &lcpArqItem..Citem2
			Select Qtds from crTpmMvItn where Citens = lcitem into cursor LocalFaixa
			lnFaixa = lnFaixa / LocalFaixa.Qtds
		Endif
		Select crSigOpTdt
		Set Key To lcCdTabDi + Str(lnTipos,1) + lcCodTips
		Locate for Between(lnFaixa,crSigOpTdt.FInicias,crSigOpTdt.FFinals)
	Endif
	Select crSigOpTdt	
	_Moeda1 = Moeda1s
	_Moeda2 = Moeda2s
	For _Form = 1 to 2
		_Formula = '_Formula' + Str( _Form, 1 )
		For _Conta = 1 to 3
			_Campo = 'Campo' + Str( _Conta, 1 ) + 't' + Str( _Form, 1 ) + 's'
			_Oper    = 'Oper' + Str( _Conta, 1 ) + 't' + Str( _Form, 1 ) + 's'
			_Const  = 'Const' + Str( _Conta, 1 ) + 't' + Str( _Form, 1 ) + 's'
			Do Case
				Case &_Campo = 2
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' _Peso '
				Case &_Campo = 3
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' &_Fator. '
				Case &_Campo = 4
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' &_Preco. '
				Case &_Campo = 5
					If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCnt','crSigCdCnt','Codigos',&_Const)
						If Empty( crSigCdCnt.Moedas )
							&_Formula = &_Formula + Alltrim( Str( crSigCdCnt.Consts, 14, 6 ) )
						Else
							_ValConst = crSigCdCnt.Consts * ThisForm.Cotacao( crSigCdCnt.Moedas )
							&_Formula = &_Formula + Alltrim( Str( _ValConst, 14, 6 ) )
						EndIf
					EndIf
				Case &_Campo = 6
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' _Qtde '
				Case &_Campo = 7
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' _Comprimento '
			Other
				Exit
			Endcase
			Do Case
				Case _Conta < 3 And &_Oper = 2
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' + '
				Case _Conta < 3 And &_Oper = 3
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' - '
				Case _Conta < 3 And &_Oper = 4
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' * '
				Case  _Conta < 3 And &_Oper = 5
					&_Formula = &_Formula + ' / '
			Other
				Exit
			Endcase
		Next
	Next
Endif

Select crSigOpTdt
Set Key To

If !IsEmpty( _Formula1 )
	_Formula1 = " ( " + _Formula1 + " ) "
EndIf
If !IsEmpty( _Formula2 )
	_Formula2 = " ( " + _Formula2 + " ) "
EndIf
Return _Formula1 + Chr( 13 ) + _Moeda1 + Chr( 13 ) + _Formula2 + Chr( 13 ) + _Moeda2

**************** fim ******************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE geranrtitulo
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE geranrtitulo
Lparameters pNot, pFpg

lcTit = Alltrim(pNot)

If Empty(lcTit) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.DopCs)
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigOpFp], [LocalOpFp], [Fpags], pFpg) And (LocalOpFp.ValPends = 1)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigOpOpe], [LocalOpOpe], [Dopes], crSigCdOpe.DopCs, [Identifics])
		lcTit = LocalOpOpe.Identifics + Transform(fGerUniqueKey(crSigCdOpe.DopCs), [@L 999999])
	EndIf
EndIf

Return lcTit
* Fim **************************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE gerarcupom
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE gerarcupom
Lparameters pCancelamento, pEmiteDav

Local lnTenta, lcNocupom, lcNoCcf, lnNoCcf, lnNoCupom

oFormulario = Thisform.omodemEest

lnTenta = 2
DO While lnTenta > 0
	lcNoCupom = ''
	lcNoCupom = LeituraNoCupom(oFormulario)
	If type('lcNoCupom')='C' And Not Empty(lcNoCupom)
		Do Case
			Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','BEMATECH','ELGIN','BEMA8501','DARUMA','S/IMPRESSORA','EPSON')
				lnNoCupom = val(lcNoCupom)
				*** mena - 18/04/2016 - incluida DAruma ***
				If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','EPSON','DARUMA') And crSigCdOpe.CupFis=3 And Not pEmiteDav
					lnNoCupom = lnNoCupom + 1
				ENDIF
				If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DARUMA') AND pEmiteDav && quando pemitdav=.t. pega o próximo coo - 1; deve ser usado quando o cupom estiver fechado
					lnNoCupom = lnNoCupom - 1
				ENDIF
			Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
				lnNoCupom = val(lcNoCupom) + 1
		EndCase
		lcNoCupom = Transform(lnNoCupom,'@L 999999')
		lnTenta   = 0
	Else
		lnTenta = lnTenta - 1
		ldtime = DateTime()
		Do While DateTime() - ldtime <= 1	&& mena 20/11/2014 diminui tempo 2
			=chrsaw(.5)
		EndDo
		lcNoCupom = []
	EndIf
	CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
	fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado
	If Val(lcNoCupom) = 0 And lnTenta = 0 And Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (50), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'Leitura do No.Fabricacao') = 6
		CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
		fBlockInput(.T.)			&& trava teclado
		lnTenta = 2
	Endif
ENDDO
CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado

If Val(lcNoCupom) = 0
	Return .f.
EndIf

lnTenta = 2
DO While lnTenta > 0
	If CrSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 or pEmiteDav && Tiago - 08/04/2011 - Inclui para gravar o GNF quando é DAV tmb; se der erro futuramente tirar
		lcNoccf	= LeituraNoGnf()
	Else
		lcNoCcf = LeituraNoCCf()
	Endif
	lnNoCcf = 0

	If type('lcNoccf')='C' And Not Empty(lcNoccf)
		Do Case
			Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','BEMATECH','ELGIN','BEMA8501','DARUMA','S/IMPRESSORA','EPSON')
				lnNoccf = val(lcNoccf)
				If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','NSWEDA','EPSON') And crSigCdOpe.CupFis=3 And Not pEmiteDav
					lnNoccf = lnNoccf + 1
				Endif
				If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DARUMA') And crSigCdOpe.CupFis=3 And Not pEmiteDav
					lnModelo = ImpModelo()
					If lnModelo = 3
						lnNoccf = lnNoccf + 1
					Endif
				Endif
			Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
				lnNoccf = val(lcNoccf) + 1
		EndCase
		lcNoccf = Transform(lnNoccf,'@L 999999')
		lnTenta   = 0
	Else
		lnTenta = lnTenta - 1
		ldtime = DateTime()
		Do While DateTime() - ldtime <= 1	&& mena 20/11/2014 diminui tempo 2
			=chrsaw(.5)
		EndDo
		lcNoCcf = []
	EndIf
	If Val(lcNoccf) = 0 And lnTenta = 0 And Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (50), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'Leitura do No.'+Iif(CrSigCdOpe.CupFis=3,'GNF','CCF')) = 6
		lnTenta = 2
	EndIf
EndDo
If Val(lcNoccf) = 0
	Return .f.
EndIf

If pCancelamento
	ThisForm.NoCcf = lcNoCCf
	ThisForm.NoCoo = lcNoCupom

ELSE
	Select TprMvCab
	Replace notas   With lcNoCupom ,;
			nCupoms With lcNoCupom ,;
			ccfgnfs With lcNoCCf In TprMvCab
Endif
Return (.T.)

ENDPROC

	*** Tiago - 27/01/2011
	_PuxaOrigem   = CsOpenv2.ConOSubs

	_lcGrupoo = []

EndIf

If ( (InList(_GerOpe,1,5) And Not Empty(lcDop) ) Or _GerOpe = 2 ) &&And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'

			Go Top In LocalFPag
			lnPar = Iif(LocalFPag.FParcs > 0, LocalFPag.FParcs, 1) 
			ldVct = Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas) + LocalFPag.Entradas
			For I = 1 to lnPar
				_Noper = Iif(llMcc, 0, fGerUniqueKey([SIGMVCCR]))

				Insert Into xPar (CotFpgs, Datas, Emps, Dopes, Numes, EmpDopNums, FPags, Nopers, Valos, ;
								  Vencs, Parcs, cnIdTefs, cIdChaves, TParcs, MoeFpgs, Pagos, DtAlts) ;
						  Values (1, TprMvCab.Datas, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
						      	  TprMvCab.EmpDopNums, LocalFPagO.FPags, _Noper, ;
						      	  TprMvCab.Valos / lnPar, ldVct, I, Padr(Sys(3), 10), fUniqueIds(), ;
						      	  lnPar, LocalFPag.MoeFpgs, [1], TprMvCab.Datas)
						      		  
				ldVct = ldVct + LocalFPag.Dias
				
				If llMcc
					ThisForm.ContaCorrenteCCP(.t., [xPar])
					Replace Nopers With cqSigMvCcr.Nopers In xPar
				EndIf
			Next
		Else
			If _GerOpe = 2 And lnValPar # TprMvCab.Valos			
				Select xpar
				Zap
				Append From Dbf('xPar2')

				_Moeda  = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, Iif( Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )
				lnPerct = TprMvCab.Valos / LnValPar
				xTotPar = 0
				lnDesc  = 0
				CotOper = ThisForm.Cotacao( _Moeda )
				lnInd   = 1
				Select xPar
				Scan
					lnValDsc = 0
					If crSigOpCdd.VarPs = 1
						lnValDsc = xPar.ValDescs * lnPerct
					EndIf
					
					Replace Valos    With Valos * lnPerct ,;
							ValDescs With lnValDsc in xPar

					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
					lnInd = Iif(crSigOpFp.Indices=0,1,crSigOpFp.Indices)
					If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
						xTotPar = Round( xTotPar - ( xPar.Valos * (xPar.CotFPgs*lnInd) / CotOper ), 2 )
					Else
						xTotPar = Round( xTotPar + ( xPar.Valos * (xPar.CotFPgs*lnInd) / CotOper ), 2 )
					EndIf
					lnValDsc = lnValDsc + xPar.ValDescs
					lnDesc   = lnDesc + xPar.ValDescs
				EndScan
				Replace TprMvCab.ValVarPs With -lnDesc in TprMvCab
				Select xPar
				Go bott
				If xTotPar <> TprMvCab.Valos
					Replace Valos With Valos + ( ( TprMvCab.Valos - xTotPar ) / (xPar.CotFPgs*lnInd) ) in xPar
				EndIf
				If crSigOpCdd.VarPs = 1 And TprMvCab2.ValVars = TprMvCab2.ValVarPs
					lndif = TprMvCab.ValVars - TprMvCab.ValVarPs
					If lndif <> 0
						Replace ValVarPs With ValVarPs + lnDif in TprMvCab
						Replace ValDescs With ValDescs - lnDif in xPar
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf

			Select xPar
			Scan
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
				If crSigOpFp.TpVencs = 2
					xDtVenc = Dtot(Ttod(Iif(Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.PrazoEnts),TprMvCab.PrazoEnts,TprMvCab.Datas)) + crSigOpFp.Entradas )
					Replace Vencs With xDtVenc in xPar
				EndIf
			EndScan
		EndIf
		
		_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

		Replace DtAlts With _pData in TprMvCab

		Ret = ThisForm.Carrega_Comi() And ;
			  ThisForm.Carrega_eestiE() And ;
			  ThisForm.Carrega_Eesti() And ;
			  ThisForm.Carrega_Estpe() And ;
			  ThisForm.Carrega_Par() And ;
			  ThisForm.Baixa_estpe() 

		* Richard em 16/10/2012 - Acrescentado o (CsPedidos.Parcs = 1) Para Somente gerar parcelas nas movimentações configuradas
*!*			If Ret And (CsPedidos.Parcs = 1)
*!*				Ret = ThisForm.Carrega_Par()
*!*			EndIf
		
		If Ret
			=ThisForm.GravHis()

			If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
				ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde.........'
			Else
				Wait Window 'Executando Gravação dos Dados ' Nowait
			EndIf

			Select crSigMvCab
			Delete For Empty(Dopes)

			Select TprMvCab
			Go Top In TprMvCab
			Replace UsuLibs With ThisForm.UsuLibs In TprMvCab
	
			Insert Into crSigMvCab ( Acres, ChkBxParcs, Chksubn, CodObs, Datars, ;
					Datas, Datatrans, Desc2s, Descs, Devols, Dopes, Empds, Emps, Grvends, Locals, ;
					Lotechqs, LPrecos, Mascnum, Nemps, Notas, Ntrans, Numes, ;
					Numolds, Obses, Opers, Tabds, Tpfats, Transps, Usuals, Usuars, Valacres, Valdes2s, ;
					Valdescs, Valdevs, Valinis, Valos, Valvars, Vars, Vends, Usulibs, Grupoos, Contaos, ;
					Grupods, Contads, ValEncs, PrazoEnts, GrResps, Resps, Valservs, DtEmis, CotUsus, ;
					Qtdes, Espes, PBrus, PLiqs, Ecfs, dGopes, nPedClis, EmpDopNums, CidChaves, ;
					DtAlts, EmpGopNums, Nops, DtRecs, ContaEs, LocalEnts, CodTrans, Operadors, ;
					vCompensas, EmpDnbxs, ValNdevs, MotDscs, Protats, nDeclaras, UsuPagos, ;
					EmpDnCrds, MoeIts, DtAgends, ObsAgends, Localizas, ValVarPs, ValTrans, Jobs, ;
					ObsCabMovs, PTax1s, PTax2s, GrupoCCs, ContaCCs, identrega, nlivdg, chavenota, ;
					IdTransp, ckPresente, NumeroNota, ckOperPend, EmpRet, VlrDesNf);
				Values ( TprMvCab.Acres, TprMvCab.ChkBxParcs, TprMvCab.Chksubn, ;
					TprMvCab.CodObs, TprMvCab.Datars, TprMvCab.Datas, ;
					TprMvCab.Datatrans, TprMvCab.Desc2s, TprMvCab.Descs, TprMvCab.Devols, ;
					TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Empds, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Grvends, TprMvCab.Locals, ;
					TprMvCab.Lotechqs, TprMvCab.Lprecos, TprMvCab.Mascnum, ;
					TprMvCab.Nemps, TprMvCab.Notas, TprMvCab.Ntrans, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
					TprMvCab.Numolds, TprMvCab.Obses, TprMvCab.Opers, TprMvCab.Tabds, TprMvCab.Tpfats, ;
					TprMvCab.Transps, TprMvCab.Usuals, TprMvCab.Usuars, TprMvCab.Valacres, TprMvCab.Valdes2s, ;
					TprMvCab.Valdescs, TprMvCab.Valdevs, TprMvCab.Valinis, TprMvCab.Valos, ;
					TprMvCab.Valvars, TprMvCab.Vars, TprMvCab.Vends, TprMvCab.Usulibs, ;
					TprMvCab.Grupoos, TprMvCab.Contaos, TprMvCab.Grupods, TprMvCab.Contads, ;
					TprMvCab.Valencs, TprMvCab.PrazoEnts, TprMvCab.GrResps, TprMvCab.Resps, ;
					TprMvCab.ValServs, TprMvCab.DtEmis, TprMvCab.CotUsus, TprMvCab.Qtdes, ;
					TprMvCab.Espes, TprMvCab.PBrus, TprMvCab.PLiqs, TprMvCab.Ecfs, ;
					TprMvCab.Dgopes, TprMvCab.nPedClis, ;
					TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), TprMvCab.CidChaves, ;
					TprMvCab.DtAlts,TprMvCab.Emps + ThisForm.pDGope + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), ;
					TprMvCab.Nops, TprMvCab.DtRecs, TprMvCab.ContaEs, TprMvCab.LocalEnts, ;
					TprMvCab.CodTrans, goSistema.Operador, TprMvCab.vCompensas, TprMvCab.EmpDnBxs,;
					TprMvCab.ValNdevs, TprMvCab.MotDscs, TprMvCab.ProtAts, TprMvCab.nDeclaras, ;
					TprMvCab.UsuPagos, TprMvCab.EmpDnCrds, TprMvCab.MoeIts, TprMvCab.DtAgends, ;
					TprMvCab.ObsAgends, TprMvCab.Localizas, TprMvCab.ValVarPs, TprMvCab.ValTrans, ;
					TprMvCab.Jobs, TprMvCab.ObsCabMovs, TprMvCab.PTax1s, TprMvCab.PTax2s, ;
					TprMvCab.GrupoCCs, TprMvCab.ContaCCs, TprMvCab.identrega, TprMvCab.nlivdg, ;
					TprMvCab.chavenota, TprMvCab.IdTransp, TprMvCab.ckPresente, TprMvCab.NumeroNota, ;
					TprMvCab.ckOperPend, TprMvCab.EmpRet, TprMvCab.VlrDesNf)

			If InList(crSigCdOpe.BxPagos,3,4) Or crSigOpCdc.BxPagos = 1
				Select xPar
				Locate For Acumulas = 1
				If Eof()
					Select crSigMvCab
					Replace crSigMvCab.ChkPagos With .t.,;
							crSigMvCab.UsuPagos With Iif(crSigCdOpe.BxPagos=4,crSigMvCab.UsuPagos,Usuar) in crSigMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf

			If crSigMvCab.Notas='000000'
				Replace crSigMvCab.Notas With ' ' in crSigMvCab
			EndIf

			Select CqSigMvCcr
			Replace Docus With ' ' For Alltrim(Docus)='000000'
			Go top
			Replace Nfs   With ' ' For Alltrim(nfs)='000000'
			Go top

			* Richard em 11/10/2012 - 
			lcSql = [Select a.PrecoPs, a.EdComis, a.CMoes, a.TabdPs, b.lblTxidCs ] + ;
					  [From SigCdOpe a, SigOpCdi b ] +;
					 [Where a.Dopes = '] + crSigMvCab.Dopes + [' And ] + ;
					 	   [a.Dopes = b.Dopes]
					 	
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, [LocalOpers]) < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (GerarNota - 1a)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			Go Top In LocalOpers
			If (LocalOpers.Precops = 2) And (Substr(LocalOpers.lblTxidCs, 1, 1)=[3])
				Update cqSigMvCcr ;
				   Set Valors  = crSigMvCab.Valos, ;
				       SValors = crSigMvCab.Valos, ;
				       Moedas  = csPedidos.Moedas, ;
				       SMoedas = csPedidos.Moedas

				Update cqSigMvCcr ;
				   Set GruConMoes = Grupos + Contas + Moedas, ;
				   	   EmpDopNcs  = Emps + Dopcs + Str(Numcs,6), ;
				   	   Pagos      = Iif(Valors = ValPags, [0], [1]), ;
				   	   DopoTps    = Dopcs + Opers + Tipos + Pagos

				Select cqSigMvCcr
				Scan
					=fRecalculaS( cqSigMvCcr.Grupos, cqSigMvCcr.Contas, cqSigMvCcr.Datas, cqSigMvCcr.Moedas, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
				EndScan
			EndIf
			Use In LocalOpers
						
			Select crSigMvCpv
			Replace Docus With ' ' For Alltrim(Docus)='000000'
			Replace Nfs   With ' ' For Alltrim(nfs)='000000'

			Select crSigMvNfi
			Delete For NFis=='000000' OR nfis==SPACE(6)
			Go Top
			Replace Numes      With TprMvCab.Numes,;
					EmpdopNums With Emps + Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) in crSigMvNfi

			Select crSigOpEtq
			Replace all EmpDopNums With Emps + Dopes + Str(Numes,6) in crSigOpEtq

			Select crSigMvEte
			Zap
			Select CrRemEestE
			Zap

			If InList(crSigCdOpe.chDtEntrs, 3, 4)
				Select crSigMvEte
				Zap
				Append Blank
				Replace Emps       With crSigMvCab.Emps,;
						Dopes      With crSigMvCab.Dopes,;
						Numes      With crSigMvCab.Numes,;
						EmpDopNums With crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums,;
						prazoEnts  With crSigMvCab.PrazoEnts

				Select CrRemEestE
				Zap
				Append Blank
				Replace Emps       With crSigMvCab.Emps,;
						Dopes      With crSigMvCab.Dopes,;
						Numes      With crSigMvCab.Numes,;
						EmpDopNums With crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums,;
						prazoEnts  With crSigMvCab.PrazoEnts
			EndIf

			If (crSigCdOpe.EdComis = 5) && Tipo 5 = Lança Só o CC dos Produtos // Richard em 30/07/2012 Para Vianna
				If Not ThisForm.Comissao(fChecaAcesso( padl(crSigCdOpe.nDopes,8,'0'), 'ALTCC' )) && Tiago - 27/08/2015 - Voltei checagem de acesso do usuário se pode alterar CC - .t.)
					Return .f.
				Endif

				ThisForm.ContaCorrenteCCP(.t.)
			EndIf
			
			Select TprMvCab
			Go Top
			If Empty(CidChaves) Or Empty(Emps) or Empty(Dopes) Or numes = 0
				Ret = .f.
				MessageBox('houve um problema na geração do cabecalho!!!, Favor alterar novamente!!!',0+16,'')
			Else
				Ret = ThisForm.Gravaupd()
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf

Return ( Ret )

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE geredcpr
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE geredcpr
Lparameters pArqItem, pArqCb, pCnx, pOperacao

Local _GrupoOrig, _ContaOrig

Create Cursor TmpComiss ( Grupos c(10), Contas c(10), Bases n(12,2), Moedas c(3), GruCads c(10), ;
                     Comissaos n(12,2), Baixas n(12,2), Linhas c(10), Flags L, Percs n(6,2), Impostos n(6,2), ;
                     Juros n(6,2), Ctfils n(1), rclis c(50), ComiOrgs  n(12,2))
Index on Grupos + Contas + Moedas + Linhas Tag GruConMoe
Index on Moedas Tag Moeda

lcSql = [Select Grupos,Contas,cTipos,cOpers,cMoes,PesoVts,PrecoVts From SigCdOpe Where Dopes  = ']+pOperacao+[']
pCnx.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalOpe')
=pCnx.cursorquery('SigCdPam','LocalParam',.f.,.f.,[MoedaPs])

_GrupoOrig = ' '
_ContaOrig = ' '

If !IsEmpty( LocalOpe.Grupos + LocalOpe.Contas )

	If LocalOpe.ctipos = 1
		_GrupoOrig = LocalOpe.Grupos
		_ContaOrig = LocalOpe.Contas
	Else
		If LocalOpe.COpers = 1
			_GrupoOrig = &pArqCb..Grupoos
			_ContaOrig = &pArqCb..Contaos
		Else
			_GrupoOrig = &pArqCb..Grupods
			_ContaOrig = &pArqCb..Contads
		Endif
		
		If !Empty(_ContaOrig) And pCnx.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_ContaOrig, [grupomats, contamats])
			If !Empty( crtmpCli.GrupoMats ) And !Empty( CrTmpCli.ContaMats )
				_GrupoOrig = CrTmpCli.GrupoMats
				_ContaOrig = CrTmpCli.ContaMats
			Endif
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	Select * From (pArqItem) Into Cursor LocalMvItn ReadWrite
	
	ThisForm.Ratearcc([LocalMvItn], pArqCb, pCnx)

	lnTotal = &pArqCb..Valos
	
	Select LocalMvItn
	Scan
		cPro = LocalMvItn.Cpros
		lcSql = [Select GruCcus, ContaCcus From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+cPro+[']
		pCnx.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro')
		
		_GrupoCC = Iif(Empty(LocalPro.GruCcus),_GrupoOrig,LocalPro.GruCcus)
		_ContaCC = Iif(Empty(LocalPro.ContaCcus),_ContaOrig,LocalPro.ContaCcus)

       	cotacaof = fBuscarCotacao(LocalMvItn.MoeFats,Date(), pCnx)
		CotCv    = fBuscarCotacao(LocalParam.Moedaps,Date(), pCnx)

		_Converte = .f.
		lcMoe = LocalOpe.Cmoes
		If Empty( LocalOpe.Cmoes )
			lcMoe = LocalParam.MoedaPs
			_Converte = .t.
		Endif
		Cotacao = fBuscarCotacao(LocalMvItn.Moedas,Date(), pCnx)
	
		totite = 0
		TotSai = 0
		TotEnt = 0
		If crSigCdOpe.PesoVts = 1
			totite = totite + ( LocalMvItn.tpesos * Iif( _Converte, Cotacaof / Cotcv, 1 ) )
		Endif
		If crSigCdOpe.PrecoVts = 1
			totite = totite + ( (LocalMvItn.ToTas + LocalMvItn.ValRats ) * Iif( _Converte, Cotacao / Cotcv, 1 ) )
		EndIf
		
		If LocalMvItn.opers = "S"
			totsai = totsai + totite
		Else
			totent = totent + totite
		EndIf

		If Not Seek(_GrupoCc + _ContaCC + lcMoe,'TmpComiss','GruConMoe')
			Insert Into TmpComiss (Grupos,Contas,Moedas) Values ;
				(_GrupoCC, _ContaCC, lcMoe )
		EndIf
		Replace Bases     With Bases + 	(TotSai - TotEnt ),;
				Comissaos With Comissaos + (TotSai - TotEnt ),; 
				ComiOrgs  With Comissaos In TmpComiss 
	EndScan
	Update TmpComiss Set Bases = Abs(Bases), Comissaos = Abs(Comissaos)
	Select TmpComiss
	Sum Comissaos to lnTotCm
	If lnTotal <> lnTotCm
		Go BOTTOM in TmpComiss
		Replace Comissaos With Comissaos + (lnTotal - lnTotCm), ;
				ComiOrgs  With Comissaos In TmpComiss
	Endif
EndIf
Return .t.
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE gestoquel
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE gestoquel
**** mena 04/11/2015 - atualiza estoque por locais - feito para EnPremier ****
**** mena 05/05/2016 - atualiza estoque por locais (Quantidade e Peso) - incluido controle de peso para a HDG
Local lcMsg, lcGrupo, lcConta
lcMsg=''

*** mena 04/11/2015 atualiza estoque por local ***

If crSigOpCdc.MovLocs=3 And .F.
	*** cria cursor de movimento de local ***
	lcQuery = [Select * from sigmvesl Where 1=0]
	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigMvEsl') < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEstL)')
		Return 0
	Endif


	If Inlist(Thisform.pcEscolha, 'ALTERAR','EXCLUIR')	&& se for alteração ou exclusão voltar as qtdes
		*** Volta para saldo anterior ***
		Select crItn
		Goto Top
		Do While Not Eof('crItn')

			lcGrupo=[]
			lcConta=[]

			*** GRAVA a origem ***
			If !Empty(crItn.localos)

				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Opers,2,3) 	&& se operação de saida
					lcGrupo=TprMvCab.grupoos
					lcConta=TprMvCab.contaos
				Endif

				If !Empty(lcGrupo) And !Empty(lcConta)

					lcQuery = [Select * from sigmvesl Where emps = ']+TprMvCab.emps+[' and grupos = ']+lcGrupo+;
						[' and estos = '] + lcConta + [' and cpros = ']+crItn.cpros+[' and locals=']+crItn.localos+[']
					If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalestL') < 1)
						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEstL)')
						Return 0
					Endif
					If Eof('localestL')
						lcCid=fUniqueIds()
					Else
						Select localestL
						Scatter memvar 
						
						Select crSigMvEsl
						Append Blank 
						Gather Memvar 
						lcCid=localestL.cidChaves
					Endif
					Select crSigMvEsl
					Locate For emps=TprMvCab.emps And grupos=lcGrupo And estos=lcConta And locals=crItn.localos And cpros=crItn.cpros
					If Not Found()
						Insert Into crSigMvEsl(emps,grupos,estos,locals,cpros,sqtds,spesos,cidChaves,dtalts) Values ;
							(TprMvCab.emps, lcGrupo, lcConta, crItn.localos, crItn.cpros, localestL.sqtds+crItn.qtds, localestL.spesos+crItn.tpesos, lcCid, Datetime())
					Else
						Replace sqtds With sqtds-crItn.qtds
						Replace spesos With spesos-crItn.tpesos		&& mena - 05/05/2016 incluido controle de peso para HDG
						Replace dtalts With Datetime()
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif

			*** grava o destino ***
			If !Empty(crItn.locals)

				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Opers,1,3) 	&& se operação de entrada
					lcGrupo=TprMvCab.grupods
					lcConta=TprMvCab.contads
				Endif

				If !Empty(lcGrupo) And !Empty(lcConta)
					lcQuery = [Select * from sigmvesl Where emps = ']+TprMvCab.emps+[' and grupos = ']+lcGrupo+;
						[' and estos = '] + lcConta + [' and cpros = ']+crItn.cpros+[' and locals=']+crItn.locals+[']
					If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalestL') < 1)
						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEstL)')
						Return 0
					Endif
					If Eof('localestL')
						lcCid=fUniqueIds()
					Else
						Select localestL
						Scatter memvar 
						
						Select crSigMvEsl
						Append Blank 
						Gather Memvar 
						lcCid=localestL.cidChaves
					Endif
					Select crSigMvEsl
					Locate For emps=TprMvCab.emps And grupos=lcGrupo And estos=lcConta And locals=crItn.locals And cpros=crItn.cpros
					If Not Found()
						Insert 	Into crSigMvEsl(emps,grupos,estos,locals,cpros,sqtds,spesos,cidChaves,dtalts) Values ;
							(TprMvCab.emps, lcGrupo, lcConta, crItn.locals, crItn.cpros, localestL.sqtds-crItn.qtds, localestL.spesos-crItn.tpesos, lcCid, Datetime())
					Else
						Replace sqtds  With sqtds+crItn.qtds
						Replace spesos With spesos+crItn.tpesos		&& mena - 05/05/2016 incluido controle de peso para HDG
						Replace dtalts With Datetime()
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
			Select crItn
			Skip
		Enddo
	Endif

	If Inlist(Thisform.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR')
		*** Atualiza saldo ***
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Goto Top
		Do While Not Eof('crTpmMvItn')

			*** grava o destino ***
			If !Empty(crTpmMvItn.locals)

				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Opers,1,3) 	&& se operação de entrada
					lcGrupo=TprMvCab.grupods
					lcConta=TprMvCab.contads
				Endif

				If !Empty(lcGrupo) And !Empty(lcConta)
					lcQuery = [Select * from sigmvesl Where emps = ']+TprMvCab.emps+[' and grupos = ']+lcGrupo+;
						[' and estos = '] + lcConta + [' and cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.cpros+[' and locals=']+crTpmMvItn.locals+[']
					If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalestL') < 1)
						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEstL)')
						Return 0
					Endif
					If Eof('localestL')
						lcCid=fUniqueIds()
					Else
						Select localestL
						Scatter memvar 
						
						Select crSigMvEsl
						Append Blank 
						Gather Memvar 
						lcCid=localestL.cidChaves
					Endif
					Select crSigMvEsl
					Locate For emps=TprMvCab.emps And grupos=lcGrupo And estos=lcConta And locals=crTpmMvItn.locals And cpros=crTpmMvItn.cpros
					If Not Found()
						Insert 	Into crSigMvEsl(emps,grupos,estos,locals,cpros,sqtds,spesos,cidChaves,dtalts) Values ;
							(TprMvCab.emps, lcGrupo, lcConta, crTpmMvItn.locals, crTpmMvItn.cpros, localestL.sqtds+crTpmMvItn.qtds, localestL.spesos+crTpmMvItn.tpesos, lcCid, Datetime())
					Else
						Replace sqtds  With sqtds+crTpmMvItn.qtds
						Replace spesos With spesos+crTpmMvItn.tpesos	&& mena - 05/05/2016 incluido controle de peso para HDG
						Replace dtalts With Datetime()
					Endif
				Endif
			EndIf
			
			*** GRAVA a origem ***
			If !Empty(crTpmMvItn.localos) And (crTpmMvItn.locals <> crTpmMvItn.localos)

				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Opers,2,3) 	&& se operação de saida
					lcGrupo=TprMvCab.grupoos
					lcConta=TprMvCab.contaos
				Endif

				If !Empty(lcGrupo) And !Empty(lcConta)
					lcQuery = [Select * from sigmvesl Where emps = ']+TprMvCab.emps+[' and grupos = ']+lcGrupo+;
						[' and estos = '] + lcConta + [' and cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.cpros+[' and locals=']+crTpmMvItn.localos+[']
					If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'localestL') < 1)
						=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEstL)')
						Return 0
					Endif
					If Eof('localestL')
						lcCid=fUniqueIds()
					Else
						Select localestL
						Scatter memvar 
						
						Select crSigMvEsl
						Append Blank 
						Gather Memvar 
						lcCid=localestL.cidChaves
						
					Endif
					Select crSigMvEsl
					Locate For emps=TprMvCab.emps And grupos=lcGrupo And estos=lcConta And locals=crTpmMvItn.localos And cpros=crTpmMvItn.cpros
					If Not Found()
						Insert Into crSigMvEsl(emps,grupos,estos,locals,cpros,sqtds,spesos,cidChaves,dtalts) Values ;
							(TprMvCab.emps, lcGrupo, lcConta, crTpmMvItn.localos, crTpmMvItn.cpros, ;
							Iif((localestL.sqtds-crTpmMvItn.qtds)<0,0,localestL.sqtds-crTpmMvItn.qtds) ,;
							Iif((localestL.spesos-crTpmMvItn.tpesos)<0,0,localestL.spesos-crTpmMvItn.tpesos), lcCid, Datetime())
					Else
						Replace sqtds With sqtds-crTpmMvItn.qtds
						Replace spesos With spesos-crTpmMvItn.tpesos		&& mena - 05/05/2016 incluido controle de peso para HDG
						Replace dtalts With Datetime()
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Skip
		Enddo
	Endif
	*Delete From crSigMvEsl Where sqtds = 0

	If Not Thisform.poDataMgr.Update([crSigMvEsl])
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (Update - crSigMvEsl)])
		Return 0
	Endif

Endif
*************************************************

Return

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE gravaupd
Local Ret, llOk, lnCtArq
Ret = .T.

Select crSigMvCab

	Update crSigMvCpv Set TitBans = Thisform.TitBans Where Empty(TitBans)

	Update crSigMvPec Set pStatus = crStsMvPec.pStatus Where Codigos = crStsMvPec.Codigos && Tiago - 01/07/2015 - Alterei para checar o Codigos pois não tava atualizando os subniveis corretamente - EmpDopNums = crStsMvPec.EmpDopNums

				EmpDopNums  With TprMvCab.EmpDopNums,;

Select CrSigMvChv

Scan

		Append Blank
		replace ChaveNota	With crChaves.ChaveNota,;
				EmpDopNums  With TprMvCab.EmpDopNums,;

	Select crSigMvIts
	Go Top
	Scan
		If Not Empty(crSigMvIts.CodBarras)
			Insert Into crSigOpEta(cbars_new, cbars_old, CidChaves, cpros, EmpDopNums );
				Values(crSigMvIts.CodBarras,Val(crSigMvIts.Locals),fUniqueIds(),crSigMvIts.cpros, crSigMvIts.EmpDopNums)
		Endif
		Replace crSigMvIts.Locals With [] In crSigMvIts

	Select crSigMvItn
	Go Top
	Scan
		If Not Empty(crSigMvItn.CodBarras)
			Insert Into crSigOpEta(cbars_new, cbars_old, CidChaves, cpros, EmpDopNums );
				Values(crSigMvItn.CodBarras,Val(crSigMvItn.Obs),fUniqueIds(),crSigMvItn.cpros, crSigMvItn.EmpDopNums)
		EndIf

		Select crSigMvItn
	Endscan

Select crSigMvPar

		Set Cotacaos = crSigMvPar.CotFpgs ;
		Where Nopers = crSigMvPar.Nopers

	* Richard em 15/07/2013 - Para gravar as parcelas X de Y no Histórico

		Update cqSigMvCcr ;

			Where Nopers = crSigMvPar.Nopers

	* Richard em 28/08/2012 - Para não deixar parcelas pendentes quando for administradora

			(crSigOpFp.OriDes=4) And (crSigOpFp.valpends = 1) && Administradora

		Replace VPags With 0, ;
			Pagos With '1' In crSigMvPar
	Endif
Endscan

* Richard em 25/03/2014 - Gravar Lançamentos da Configuração Financeira da Movimentação
Go Top In crSigMvCab
Go Top In crSigMvItn
Go Top In crSigMvNfi
lcQuery = [Select b.RealPrevs ] + ;
	[From SigCdOpe a, SigOpOpe b ] + ;
	[Where a.Dopes = '] + crSigMvCab.Dopes + [' And ] + ;
	[a.DopCs = b.Dopes]

If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalOpe]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalOpe)],5000)
	Return .F.
Endif
Go Top In LocalOpe
lcCcr = Iif(LocalOpe.RealPrevs = 2, [crSigMvCpv], [cqSigMvCcr])
Use In LocalOpe

*!*	*-- Alteração para Atualizar o Grupo e Conta Emitente da Despesa
*!*	If Not Empty(crSigMvCab.ContaCcs) and Not Empty(crSigMvCab.GrupoCcs)
*!*		lcContaCcs = crSigMvCab.ContaCcs
*!*		lcGrupoCcs = crSigMvCab.GrupoCcs
*!*		Select cqSigMvCcr

*!*		Scan		
*!*			If crSigCdOpe.caixas = 1 And crSigCdOpe.parcs = 1 And crSigCdOpe.parcontas = 1 &&CAIXA =SIM, PARCELAS=SIM, CONTABILIZA PARCELAS=SIM
*!*				Do Case
*!*				Case crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 And crSigCdOpe.copers = 2 &&TIPO DAS CONTAS=DE ESTOQUE, MOVIMENTO DE CAIXA=SAIDA, irá gravar:
*!*					If cqSigMvCcr.Opers = 'C'
*!*						replace ContEms With lcContaCcs , GrupEms With lcGrupoCcs  in cqSigMvCcr
*!*					EndIf 
*!*				Case crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 And crSigCdOpe.copers = 1 &&TIPO DAS CONTAS=DE ESTOQUE, MOVIMENTO DE CAIXA=ENTRADA, irá gravar: 
*!*					If cqSigMvCcr.Opers = 'D'
*!*						replace ContEms With lcContaCcs , GrupEms With lcGrupoCcs  in cqSigMvCcr
*!*					EndIf 
*!*				Case crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 1 And crSigCdOpe.copers = 2 &&TIPO DAS CONTAS=FINANCEIRA, MOVIMENTO DE CAIXA=SAIDA, irá gravar:
*!*					If cqSigMvCcr.Opers = 'C'
*!*						replace ContEms With lcContaCcs , GrupEms With lcGrupoCcs  in cqSigMvCcr
*!*					EndIf
*!*				Case crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 1 And crSigCdOpe.copers = 1 &&TIPO DAS CONTAS=FINANCEIRA, MOVIMENTO DE CAIXA=ENTRADA, irá gravar:
*!*					If cqSigMvCcr.Opers = 'D'
*!*						replace ContEms With lcContaCcs , GrupEms With lcGrupoCcs  in cqSigMvCcr
*!*					EndIf 
*!*				EndCase 
*!*			EndIf 			
*!*			Select cqSigMvCcr
*!*		EndScan 
*!*	EndIf 

*-- Alteração para Atualizar o Grupo e Conta (Grupems e Contems) Emitente da Despesa
If Not Empty(crSigMvCab.ContaCcs) and Not Empty(crSigMvCab.GrupoCcs)
	lcContaCcs = crSigMvCab.ContaCcs
	lcGrupoCcs = crSigMvCab.GrupoCcs

	Select CqSigMvHst
	Go Top

	Iif(Used([crSigMvIte]),1, 0)

lnItn = 53
If Used([crSigMvIte])
	lnItn = lnItn + 1
	lcListArq(lnItn,1) = [crSigMvIte]
Endif

For lnCtArq = 1 To lnArq

	If Not (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
		Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.Caption = 'Aguarde... '+Str(lnCtArq,2)+'/' + Alltrim(Str(lnArq, 10))
	Else
		Wait Window 'Executando Gravação dos Dados '+Str(lnCtArq,2)+'/' + Alltrim(Str(lnArq, 10)) Nowait
	Endif

	If Ret And !Thisform.poDataMgr.Update(lcListArq(lnCtArq,1))
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update '+lcListArq(lnCtArq,1)+')',1000)
		Ret = .F.
		Exit
	Endif
Next

If Ret
	If Thisform.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
		llOk = Thisform.poDataMgr6.Update('crSigMvEte')
		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
			llOk = .T.
		Endif
	Else
		llOk = .T.
	Endif
	llOk = llOk And Thisform.poDataMgr.Update('CrRemEestE')
	If Not llOk
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update crSigMvEte)',5000)
		Ret = .F.
	EndIf
Else
	Messagebox('Favor Refazer a Venda.',48,'Falha na Conexão',5000)	
Endif
Return (Ret)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE gravhis
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE gravhis
Local _nRegistro, _Reservado, _Inicio

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde........'
Else
	Wait Window 'Criando Chaves Primárias no Arquivo de Histórico ' Nowait
EndIf

Select Dopes,Estoqs,Origems,Destinos,EstOrigs,EstDests From crSigCdOpe ;
Where 0=1 Into Cursor LocalOpe ReadWrite

Select Distinct Dopes From CqSigMvHst Into Cursor SelOperacao
Select SelOperacao
Scan
	lcSql = [Select Dopes,Estoqs,Origems,Destinos,EstOrigs,EstDests From SigCdOpe ]+;
			[Where Dopes = ']+SelOperacao.Dopes+[' ]
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'xTmpOpe')
	Select LocalOpe
	Append From Dbf('xTmpOpe')
EndScan

Select LocalOpe
Index on Dopes Tag dopes

Select CqSigMvHst
Go Top
_nRegistro = Reccount()

_Reservado = 0
DO While _Reservado = 0 And _nRegistro > 0
	_Reservado = fGerUniqueKey(Dtos(Datas),,,_nRegistro + 1)
EndDo
_Inicio    = _Reservado - _nRegistro

_RerSeq   = 0
DO While _RerSeq = 0 And _nRegistro > 0
	_RerSeq    = fGerUniqueKey('HISTBAR',,,_nRegistro + 1)
EndDo
_IniSeq    = _RerSeq - _nRegistro

Scan
	*** Tiago - 01/12/2011 - Comentei devido ao erro de cálculo do saldo de peso no histórico da Martinelli
	* Checagem Para Alimentar o Peso nos Arquivos Auxiliares (Richard 06/06/2011)
*!*		If (crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts = 2)
*!*			Select crTpmMvItn
*!*			Go Top In crTpmMvItn
*!*			Locate For CPros = CqSigMvHst.CPros And CodCors = CqSigMvHst.CodCors And CodTams = CqSigMvHst.CodTams
*!*			If Not Eof([crTpmMvItn]) And Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.Pesos)
*!*				Replace Pesos With crTpmMvItn.Pesos * crTpmMvItn.Qtds In CqSigMvHst
*!*			EndIf
*!*		EndIf
	* Fim da Checagem Para Alimentar o Peso nos Arquivos Auxiliares

	Select CqSigMvHst
	_Inicio = _Inicio + 1
	_IniSeq = _IniSeq + 1

	m.NewOpe = CqSigMvHst.Opers
	
	*** Tiago - 23/10/2015 - Definido com o Richard que vamos gravar no cidchaves a mesma letra da movimentação para padronizar, assim a ordem do histórico fica correta
*!*		=Seek(CqSigMvHst.Dopes,'LocalOpe')
*!*		If 	LocalOpe.estoqs = 1 and LocalOpe.Origems = 1 and InList(LocalOpe.EstOrigs,1,2) And ;
*!*				LocalOpe.destinos = 1 and InList(LocalOpe.EstDests,1,2)
*!*			m.NewOpe = Iif(CqSigMvHst.Opers = [E],[H],[K])
*!*		EndIf

	Replace CidChaves With Dtos(Datas)+m.NewOpe+Transform(_Inicio,"@L 999999")+ThisForm.Sigkey ,;
			Seqs      WITH _IniSeq

	=SqlCalcP2(CqSigMvHst.Emps, CqSigMvHst.Grupos, CqSigMvHst.Estos, CqSigMvHst.CPros, CqSigMvHst.Datas, CqSigMvHst.CodCors, CqSigMvHst.CodTams, ThisForm.poDataMgr )
	=fRecalculaC(CqSigMvHst.Emps, CqSigMvHst.CPros, CqSigMvHst.Datas, ThisForm.poDataMgr ) 
EndScan
Wait Clear
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE habilitajob
*** Tiago - 19/03/14 - SRCOM - Habilita campo JOBS e busca descrição do JOBS
With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
	.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Job.Visible = Inlist(Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 25, 1))),1,3)

	lcQuery = [Select Iclis, Rclis, Cpfs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = ']+TprMvCab.Jobs+[']
	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpCli') < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 3)')
		Return .f.
	Endif
	.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Job.get_dconta.Value = CrTmpCli.Rclis
EndWith

Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE impbol
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE impbol
Local lnTpB

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

lnTpB = 0

Do Case 
	Case !EMPTY(substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers,233,2))	&& mena - 30/06/2016 - Pega tipo de boleto para Rosana
		lnTpB = VAL(substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers,233,2))
	
	Case (crSigOpCdc.BolItes = 3) && SubNiveis
		lnTpB = 11

	Case (crSigOpCdc.BolItes = 4) && Detalhado
		lnTpB = 13

	Case (crSigOpCdc.BolItes = 5) && Romaneio
		lnTpB = 14

	Case (crSigOpCdc.BolItes = 7) && Controle Interno
		lnTpB = 17

	Case (crSigOpCdc.BolItes = 6) && Vendedor
		If (crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2) &&Impressão das Multiplas Movimentações geradas
			Do Form SigOpIgm With ThisForm, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, .f., 16
		Else
			lnTpB = 16
		EndIf

	Case (crSigOpCdc.BolItes = 8) && mena - 03/11/2014 - Duplicata/Carne
		lnTpB = 18

	Otherwise && Sim / Não
		lnTpB = 3
EndCase

If (lnTpB > 0)
	Do Form SigOpIbo With Thisform, lnTpB,,TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
						 TprMvCab.valdevs, crSigOpCdc.qvias, crSigOpCdc.qtdbols
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE impdocto
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE impdocto
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdi','crSigOpCdi','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdd','crSigOpCdd','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
******* impressao boleto

thisform.pcEscolha = ''
If InList(crSigCdOpe.docus,1,5,11)
	DO SigPrIdc with TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes,TprMvCab.valdevs, crSigOpCdc.QtdDocs,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm,.T.
EndIf

If InList(crSigCdOpe.Docus, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12)	&& mena - 08/11/2016 - incluido 10 para MonteCarlo
	Do Form SigReIfx With TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, .F., .T.
EndIf

* Impressão do Relatório de Job
If InList(Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 25, 1))), 1, 3) && Se Tem Campo de Job Ativo Na Tela
	If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 157, 01))) = 1)  && Tela de Job (1-Sim / 2 e 0-Não)
		Do Form SigReJob With ThisForm
	EndIf
EndIf

If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.nOpCrs) &&crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 5 And 
	lcSql = [Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, ValDevs From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrEest') > 0
		pcEmp = crEest.Emps
		pcDop = crEest.Dopes
		pnNum = crEest.numes
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe','dopes',pcDop)
		If InList(TmpOpe.Docus,1,5)
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',pcDop) And ;
				ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',pcEmp + pcDop + Str(pnNum,6))
				DO SigPrIdc with pcEmp, pcDop, pnNum, CrEest.valdevs, crSigOpCdc.QtdDocs,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm,.T.
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If InList(TmpOpe.Docus, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11)
			Do Form SigReIfx With pcEmp, pcDop, pnNum, .F., .T.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2 &&Impressão das Multiplas Movimentações geradas
	DO Form SigOpIgm With Thisform,TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes,.t.
EndIf

ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdi', 'crSigOpCdi', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)
If Not Eof('crSigOpCdi') And (crSigOpCdi.chkInvs = 1)
	Do Form SigReIiv With TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes
EndIf

If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 24, 1))) = 1) && Richard - Mostrar Tela de Títulos Gerados - 10/03/2014
	lcQuery = [Select Emps, Dopcs, Numcs, Titulos, Pastas ] + ;
			  	[From SigMvCcr ] + ;
			   [Where EmpDopNums = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes, 6) + [' And ] + ;
		   			 [Opers = '] + Iif(crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1, [C], [D]) + [']

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalTits]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalTits)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select LocalTits
	Goto Top In LocalTits	
	If Not Eof([LocalTits])
		Do Form SigReIdt With Thisform,LocalTits.Emps, LocalTits.Dopcs, LocalTits.Titulos, LocalTits.Numcs, LocalTits.Pastas	
	EndIf
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE impgarantia
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE impgarantia
Lparameters pOperacao
Local lcChave

lcOperacao = Iif(Type('pOperacao')='C',pOperacao,TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )

If MessageBox('Confirma impressão das Etiquetas ?(S/N)',4+32+256,lcOperacao) # 6
	Return
EndIf

Zap in dbimpressao

If lcOperacao = ( TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) )

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.CtrlLotes,1,2) And crSigOpCdc.ietiqs=1 
		lnBar = Val( Str(crSigCdOpe.Ndopes,4)+Transf(TprMvCab.Numes,"@L 999999") )
		lcObs = crSigCdOpe.Abrevs + "-" + Transf(TprMvCab.Numes,"@L 999999")

		Insert Into dbImpressao ( CPros, Qtds, Cbars, Obs) Values ( crSigCdPam.Ouros, 1, lnBar, lcObs)

		lcbusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvItn Where 0=1 Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') < 0
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		lcquery = [Select * From SigMvIts Where 0=1 Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEsti2') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf

	Else
		lcbusca = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[' Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') < 0
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		lcquery = [Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' Order By CItens]
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEsti2') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	lcbusca = lcOperacao
	lcQuery = [Select a.*,b.cunis From SigMvHst a, SigCdPro b Where a.OriDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[' And ]+;
			  [a.Opers = 'E' And a.Cpros = b.Cpros ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	lcquery = [Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' And 0=1 ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEsti2') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao')
		Return 0
	EndIf

EndIf
	
Select CrEsti2
Index On Citens Tag Citens

Select crEesti
Scan
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorQuery('SigCdUni','crSigCdUni','Cunis',CrEesti.Cunis) And ( CrEesti.Opers = 'E' Or crSigOpCdd.EtqSaids = 1 )
		lcSql = [Select a.Cpros, a.Cgrus, b.nTipoJoals, b.etipads ]+;
				[From SigCdPro a Inner Join SigCdGrp b on b.cGrus = a.cGrus Where a.Cpros = ']+CrEesti.Cpros+[']
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro') < 1
			MessageBox('Favor Reiniciar o Processo!!!',0+48,'Erro Conexao (LocalPro)')
			Return 0
		EndIf

		If LocalPro.EtiPads = 'D' && se for D - Selecionadas, só pode imprimir esse grupo pela Etiqueta selecionadas ou Reimpressão de Etiquetas
			Loop
		EndIf
		
		If Type( "_QtEtiq" ) # "N"
			Public _QtEtiq
		EndIf

		_QtEtiq = crEesti.Qtds
		_QtPeso = CrEesti.Pesos
		If crSigCdUni.pqtds='S' And crSigCdUni.Etiqs#'S'
			_QtEtiq = 0
			_QtPeso = 0
			Do Form SigOpQtE With crEesti.Cpros
		EndIf

		If crSigCdUni.Etiqs = 'S'
			If Not Empty(crEesti.CodBarras)
				Select crEsti2
				Seek CrEesti.Citens

				Insert Into dbImpressao (cpros, qtds, qtdeEtiq, Pesos, Obs, PVens, Moedas, EmpDopNums, CItens, CodTams) ;
								 Values (str(crEesti.CodBarras,14), 1, _QtEtiq, _QtPeso, crEsti2.CodCors, crEesti.Units, crEesti.Moedas, crEesti.Empdopnums, CrEesti.Citens, crEsti2.CodTams)
			Else
				Select crEsti2
				Seek CrEesti.Citens
				Scan While crEsti2.CItens = CrEesti.Citens
					If Not Empty(crEsti2.CodBarras)
						Insert Into dbImpressao (CPros, Qtds, QtdeEtiq, CodTams, Obs, PVens, Pesos, Moedas, EmpDopNums, CItens) ;
										 Values (Str(crEsti2.CodBarras, 14), 1, crEsti2.Qtds, crEsti2.CodTams, ;
										 		 crEsti2.CodCors, crEesti.Units, _QtPeso, crEesti.Moedas, crEesti.Empdopnums, CrEesti.Citens)
					EndIf
				EndScan
			EndIf
		Else
			Select crEsti2
			Seek CrEesti.Citens
		
			Insert Into dbImpressao (CPros, Qtds, Pesos, Obs, PVens, Moedas, EmpDopNums, CItens, CodTams) ;
			                 Values (crEesti.CPros, _QtEtiq, _QtPeso, crEsti2.CodCors, crEesti.Units, crEesti.Moedas, crEesti.Empdopnums, CrEesti.Citens, crEsti2.CodTams)
		EndIf
	EndIf
Endscan

Update dbImpressao Set Pedido = crSigCdOpe.Abrevs

Select dbImpressao
Go Top
If (crSigOpCdd.TpTlEtiqs = 2)
	ThisForm.Tipo = [OPERACAO]
	Do Form SigOpIpE With ThisForm, .t.
Else
	Do Form SigOpEtS With ThisForm, ThisForm.DataSessionId
EndIf
* Fim *********************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE imprcfinanciado
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE imprcfinanciado
lnNoFabr  = LeituraFab(oFormulario)
lcNoCupom = LeituraNoCupom(oFormulario)
If type('lcNoCupom')='C' And Not Empty(lcNoCupom)
	lnnoCupom = Transform(Val(lcNoCupom) + 1, '@L 999999')
Else
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select xPar

Scan

	lcQryPar = [Select ncodfinzs, nFinancs, mFinancs From SigOpFp Where FPags = '] + xPar.Fpags + [']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryPar, [csTmpPag])
	
	lcQryPar = [Select Descrs From SigFiNal Where nCodFinzs = ] + Alltrim(Str(csTmpPag.ncodfinzs)) + ;
	           [ And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryPar, [csTmpFinal])

	lcQryPar = [Select Descrs, Ordems From SigFiRlg Where Ordems = ] + Alltrim(Str(csTmpPag.nFinancs)) + ;
	           [ And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryPar, [csTmpRelg])


	lcQryFin = [Select nRelGers From SigFiNal Where nCodFinzs = ] + Alltrim(Str(csTmpPag.ncodfinzs)) + [ And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryFin, [csTmpFin])
		
	lcQryGer = [Select Texto, Ordems From SigFiRlg Where Ordems = ] + Alltrim(Str(csTmpFin.nRelGers)) + [ And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryGer, [csTmpGer])

	If csTmpPag.nFinancs = 1
		
		Create Cursor crFinVin (cLinhas c(48))
		
		Select crFinVin 
		Append Blank
		
		Replace cLinhas With 'Emp: ' + TprMvCab.Emps + [  ] + ;
		                     'Mov: '+ TprMvCab.Dopes + [  ] + ;
		                     'No: '+ Transform(TprMvCab.numes, '@L 999999')
		                     
		lcQryCli = [Select rclis, endes, nums, bairs, cidas, estas, Cpfs, Rgs from SigCdCli Where iClis = '] + TprMvCab.Contads + [']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryCli, [csTmpCli])
		
		Select crFinVin 

		Append Blank

		Append Blank
		Replace cLinhas With 'Nome : ' + Left(csTmpCli.rClis,41)
		
		Append Blank
		
		lcEnd = Alltrim(csTmpCli.Endes) + [, ] + csTmpCli.Nums
		Replace cLinhas With 'End. : ' + left(lcEnd, 41) 
		
		If ! Empty(Substr(lcEnd, 42))
			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With '       ' + Substr(lcEnd, 42) 
		EndIf
		
		Append Blank
		Replace cLinhas With csTmpCli.Bairs 
		
		Append Blank
		Replace cLinhas With Alltrim(csTmpCli.Cidas) + [ - ] + csTmpCli.Estas
		
		Append Blank
		Replace cLinhas With 'CPF : ' + Alltrim(csTmpCli.Cpfs) + Iif(!Empty(csTmpCli.rgs), [ - ] + csTmpCli.Estas, [])
		
		Append Blank

		Append Blank
		Replace cLinhas With [   Parcela       Vencimento          Valor]

		lcPags = xPar.Fpags

		lnValor = 0
		lnParcelas = 1
		
		Select xPar
		
		lnRegPag = Recno()

		Do While lcPags = xPar.Fpags
			
			Select crFinVin 
			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With [       ] + Transform(xPar.Parcs, '@L 99') + ;
			                     [        ] + Dtoc(xPar.Vencs) + ;
			                     [      ] + Transform(xPar.Valos, '999,999.99')
			                     
			lnValor = lnValor + xPar.Valos

			Select xPar
			If xPar.Parcs = xPar.TParcs
				lnParcelas = xPar.TParcs
				Skip
				Exit
			Else
				Skip
			EndIf
			
		EndDo
		
		Select crFinVin 
		Append Blank

		Select crFinVin 

		lcTexto = Nvl(Alltrim(csTmpPag.mFinancs), [])
		
		Do While ! Empty(lcTexto)
		
			lcLinha = Left(lcTexto, 48)
			
			lnPosEnter = At(Chr(13), lcLinha)

			If lnPosEnter = 0
			
				Append Blank
				Replace cLinhas With Left(lcTexto, 48)
				lcTexto = Substr(lcTexto, 48)
				
			Else
			
				Append Blank
				Replace cLinhas With Left(lcTexto, lnPosEnter - 1)
				lcTexto = Substr(lcTexto, lnPosEnter + 2)
				
			EndIf
				
		Enddo
	
		Append Blank
		Append Blank
		
		Append Blank
		Replace cLinhas With [  --------------------------------------------  ] 

		Append Blank
		lcNome = Left(Alltrim(csTmpCli.rClis), 44)
		Replace cLinhas With Replicate(' ', Int((44 - Len(lcNome)) / 2)) + lcNome
		
		Do Case
			Case InList(crSigFiFis.Imps, [DARUMA], [NSWEDA])
				llRetorno = ImprimirCCD(Alltrim(csTmpFinal.Descrs), lnValor, lnPArcelas, TprMvCab.Notas, [crFinVin], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)

			Case InList(crSigFiFis.Imps, [BEMA8501])	
				llRetorno = ImprimirCCD(Transform(csTmpGer.Ordems,'@L 99'), lnValor, lnPArcelas, TprMvCab.Notas, [crFinVin], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)
			
			Otherwise
				llRetorno = ImprimirCCD(csTmpPag.ncodfinzs, lnValor, lnPArcelas, TprMvCab.Notas, [crFinVin], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)
		
		EndCase
		
		lcQryFin = [Select nRelGers From SigFiNal Where nCodFinzs = ] + Alltrim(Str(csTmpPag.ncodfinzs)) + [ And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryFin, [csTmpFin])
		
		lcQryGer = [Select Texto, Ordems From SigFiRlg Where Ordems = ] + Alltrim(Str(csTmpFin.nRelGers)) + [ And Imps = '] + crSigFiFis.Imps + [']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryGer, [csTmpGer])

		lcQryGer = [Select nImpBars From SigFiMpf Where cImpFabs = '] + fDecriptografar(Alltrim(TprMvCab.nEmps)) + [']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryGer, [csTmpImpf])

		Create Cursor crRelGer (cLinhas c(48))
		
		Select xPar
		Go lnRegPag
		
		Do While lcPags = xPar.Fpags
		
			Select crRelGer 
			Zap
			
			Select crRelGer
			Append Blank

			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With 'Emp: ' + TprMvCab.Emps + [  ] + ;
			                     'Mov: '+ TprMvCab.Dopes + [  ] + ;
			                     'No: '+ Transform(TprMvCab.numes, '@L 999999')
			                     
			Append Blank

			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With 'Nome : ' + Left(csTmpCli.rClis,41)
			
			Append Blank
			
			lcEnd = Alltrim(csTmpCli.Endes) + [, ] + csTmpCli.Nums
			Replace cLinhas With 'End. : ' + left(lcEnd, 41) 
			
			If ! Empty(Substr(lcEnd, 42))
				Append Blank
				Replace cLinhas With '       ' + Substr(lcEnd, 42) 
			EndIf
			
			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With csTmpCli.Bairs 
			
			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With Alltrim(csTmpCli.Cidas) + [ - ] + csTmpCli.Estas
			
			*** inserido 3 linhas para não deixa as parcelas no meio da mensagem de 'comprovante não fiscal'
			Append Blank
			Append Blank
			Append Blank
						
			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With [   Parcela       Vencimento          Valor]

			Append Blank
			Replace cLinhas With [       ] + Transform(xPar.Parcs, '@L 99') + ;
			                     [        ] + Dtoc(xPar.Vencs) + ;
			                     [      ] + Transform(xPar.Valos, '999,999.99')

			Append Blank
			
			Append Blank
			
			lcTexto = Nvl(Alltrim(csTmpGer.Texto), [])
			
			Do While ! Empty(lcTexto)
			
				lcLinha = Left(lcTexto, 48)
				
				lnPosEnter = At(Chr(13), lcLinha)

				If lnPosEnter = 0
				
					Append Blank
					Replace cLinhas With Left(lcTexto, 48)
					lcTexto = Substr(lcTexto, 48)
					
				Else
				
					Append Blank
					Replace cLinhas With Left(lcTexto, lnPosEnter - 1)
					lcTexto = Substr(lcTexto, lnPosEnter + 2)
					
				EndIf
				
			Enddo
			
			Append Blank

			lcQryEmp = [Select nEmps From SigCdEmp Where cEmps = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + [']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryEmp, [csTmpEmp])
			
			lcQryOpe = [Select nDopes From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = '] + TprMvCab.Dopes + [']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQryOpe, [csTmpOpe])
			
			Create cursor crBarras (cCodBarras c(18), lImpBars N(1))
			
			lcBarra = Transform(csTmpEmp.nEmps, '@L 999') + [0] + ;
			          Transform(csTmpOpe.nDopes, '@L 9999') + Transform(xPar.Parcs, '@L 99') + ;
			          Transform(TprMvCab.Numes, '@L 999999') 
			          
			lcBarra = lcBarra + CalcDv(lcBarra)
			lcBarra = lcBarra + CalcDv(lcBarra)
			
			Append Blank
			Replace cCodBarras With lcBarra
			Replace lImpBars   With csTmpImpf.nImpBars
			
			lcBarra = lcBarra + Transform(xPar.Parcs, '@L 99') + ;
			          Alltrim(Str(Val(Sys(1)) + (ttod(xPar.Vencs) - Date()))) + ;
			          Transform(xPar.Valos * 100,  '@L 9999999') 

			lcBarra = lcBarra + CalcDv(lcBarra)
			lcBarra = lcBarra + CalcDv(lcBarra)
			
			Append Blank
			Replace cCodBarras With Right(lcBarra, 18)
			Replace lImpBars   With csTmpImpf.nImpBars
			
			lnnoCupom = Transform(Val(lnnoCupom) + 1, '@L 999999')

			If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps, [BEMA8501])
				ImprimirRG(Transform(csTmpGer.Ordems,'@L 99'), [crRelGer], [crBarras], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)
			Else
				ImprimirRG(csTmpFin.nRelGers, [crRelGer], [crBarras], lnNoFabr, lnnoCupom)			
			EndIf
			
			Select xPar
			If xPar.Parcs = xPar.TParcs
				lnParcelas = xPar.TParcs
				Skip
				Exit
			Else
				Skip
			EndIf
			
		EndDo
		
	EndIf 
	
EndScan
Return .t.

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE imprcfiscal
Lparameters getfpg,getvpar
Local oModem,RetImpFin,lnFinal

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',getfpg)

If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrSigFiNal') > 0
	Final = crSigFiNal.Ordems
else
	Final = 0
EndIf

	RetImpFin=FinFisDA(Final,getvpar,Iif(TprMvCab.ValVars<0,TprMvCab.ValVars,0),oFormulario,getvpar)
	ThisForm.Primeira=.f.
Else
	RetImpFin=FinFis(Final,getvpar,oFormulario)
EndIf
If RetImpFin 
	MessageBox('Impressão OK !!',0+48,'')
Else
	MessageBox('Erro na Impressão !!',0+16,'')
EndIf
Return(RetImpFin)
**************** fim ****************
ENDPROC
