------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE imprcvincanc
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE imprcvincanc
lParameters pIdent

oFormulario = This.oModemEest
oFormu = Thisform
lcCupoms='R'+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+PADR(alltrim(str(TprMvCab.numes,10)),10)+'CNC'
ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigFiTef','crSigFiTef', 'cCupoms', lcCupoms)
If ThisForm.TransTef > 1
	RetCVinc = .f.
	lcSql=[Select * From SigFiTef Where cEmps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' and ]+;
	                                [cDopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[' and ]+;
	                              [cnCupoms = ']+PADR(alltrim(str(TprMvCab.numes,10)),10)+[' and ]+;
	                              [cHeaders = 'CNC']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,"crSigFiTef")
	Scan 
		Do Case
			Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','ELGIN')
				ImpVinc = FinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,TprMvCab.Notas,Final,oFormulario)
			Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
				ThisForm.CntTxt
				Select crSigFiTef
				ImpVinc = RFinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario)
				With ThisForm.CntTefTxt
					.TxtOper.Caption = ''
					.TxtCli.Caption = ''
					.TxtTpTrans.Caption = ''
					.Visible = .f.
				EndWith
			Case crSigFiFis.Imps='BEMATECH'
				ImpVinc = FinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,crSigFiNal.Descrs,oFormulario,oFormu,TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes)
		EndCase
		If !ImpVinc
			Messagebox('Erro na Impressão do Cupom Vinculado de Cancelamento, '+chr(13)+chr(10)+;
				'É necessário Reimpressão do Cupom !!',0+48,'ERRO')
		EndIf
	EndScan
Else
	**** Versão para enviar status da impressão do Cupom Não Vinculado ao TEF
	RetCVinc = .f.
	LoopCVinc = .t.
	RetImpr = .f.
	RetNImp = .f.
	lcIdents='R'+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+alltrim(str(pIdent,20))
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigFiTef','crSigFiTef', 'cIdents', lcIdents)
	_Hist=''
	Do While LoopCVinc
		ImpVinc = RFinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario)
		If ImpVinc
			lcTipo = 'CNF'
			RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
						val(crSigFiTef.cnIdents),crSigFiTef.cNmRedes,crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
						crSigFiTef.cFinalzs,crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, CrSigFiTef.Fpags)
			If RetImpr 
				LoopCVinc = .f.
				RetCVinc = .t.
				loop
			EndIf
		ELSE
			If (InList(crSigCdPam.SisTef,1,3) and Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (11), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'')=7 )
				Do Form SIGCNTEF with crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,crSigFiTef.cNmRedes,Iif(crSigCdPam.SisTef=3,val(StrTran(crSigFiTef.cnValors,',','.')),val(crSigFiTef.cnValors)/100)
				lcTipo = 'NCN'
				RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
							val(crSigFiTef.cnIdents),crSigFiTef.cNmRedes,crSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
							crSigFiTef.cFinalzs,crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, CrSigFiTef.Fpags, Val(crSigFiTef.cnValors) / 100 )
				
				lcSql = [Select cidchaves From SigFiTef Where cnIdents = ']+CrSigFiTef.cnIdents+[']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr4.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
					Select LocSigFiTef
					Scan
						SqlCanTef = [Update SigFiTef Set cStatus = 'CNC' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
						ThisForm.poDataMgr4.SqlExecute(SqlCanTef)
						ThisForm.poDataMgr4.Commit()
					EndScan
				EndIf
				LoopCVinc = .f.
				RetCVinc = .f.
				_Hist = 'Erro Impressão Finalizadoras - Um Tef ( NCN ) '
				if !RetNImp
					Messagebox('Problemas Comunicação Tef !!',0+48,'ERRO')
					_Hist = _Hist + chr(13)+'Problema Tef - Não enviou NCN'
				EndIf
				loop
			Else
				VerStatus = RotStatus(1,oFormulario)
				If Type('VerStatus')<>'L'
					If Substr(VerStatus,1,1)='R'
						FinFimVinc(oFormulario)
					EndIf
					If Substr(VerStatus,1,1)='L' and Substr(VerStatus,6,1)='N'
						RelGerVinc(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario,Thisform)
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndDo
	Wait Clear
	If !RetCVinc
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
		ThisForm.poDataMgr2.RollBack()
		_Hist   = Nvl(TprMvCab.Obses,'') + Chr(13) + IIF(isempty(_Hist),'',_Hist)
		_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
		llDtAlt = _pData
		lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set Obses = ']+_Hist+[', DtAlts = ?llDtAlt Where CidChaves = ']+TprMvCab.CidChaves+[']
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.Commit()

		Messagebox('Erro na Impressão do Cupom Vinculado de Cancelamento, '+chr(13)+chr(10)+;
				'É necessário Reimpressão do Cupom pelo modo ADM  !!',0+48,'ERRO')
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags,[cCupomnvs,ncodfinzs])
	If  !empty(crSigOpFp.cCupomnvs)
		exit
	EndIf

	Final = crSigFiNal.Ordems
else
	Final = 0
EndIf
RetCVinc = .f.
LoopCVinc = .t.
RetImpr = .f.
RetNImp = .f.

RetFim = .f.
_Hist = ''
Do While LoopCVinc
	If lPrimeira
		Do Case
		Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','ELGIN')
			ImpVinc = FinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,TprMvCab.Notas,Final,oFormulario,oFormu,TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes)
		Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')

		Case crSigFiFis.Imps='BEMATECH'
			ImpVinc = FinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,crSigFiNal.Descrs,oFormulario,oFormu,TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes)

			ImpVinc = FinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,crSigFiNal.Descrs,oFormulario,oFormu,TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes, '4')
		Case crSigFiFis.Imps='DARUMA'
			ImpVinc = FinCVinculado(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,crSigFiNal.Descrs,oFormulario,oFormu,TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes)
		Case crSigFiFis.Imps='S/IMPRESSORA'
*!*			Case INLIST(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6)		&& mena 17/06/2016
			ImpVinc = Iif(PrintCVCfe(TprMvCab.Emps),.T.,.F.)
		Endcase
		lPrimeira = .F.
	Endif
	Clear Typeahead
	With Thisform.CntTefTxt
		.TxtOper.Caption = ''
		.TxtCli.Caption = ''
		.TxtTpTrans.Caption = ''
		.Visible = .F.
	Endwith

	If Not (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
		Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.Caption = 'Aguarde Processamento TEF'
	Else
		Wait Window 'Aguarde Processamento TEF !!' Nowait
	Endif

	If ImpVinc
		Select crAux1
		Go Top
		If Not Eof()
			If fVerInternet()
				*** confirma cupom  se aberto ****
				llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
				lcTipo = 'CNF'
				RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
					val(crAux1.cnIdents),crAux1.cNmRedes,crAux1.cnNSUs,;
					crAux1.cFinalzs,crAux1.cCupomnvs, crAux1.Fpags)
				LoopCVinc = .F.
				RetCVinc = .T.
				Loop
			Else
				Do While Not fVerInternet()
 					MESSAGEBOX("Aguardando conexão da Internet.",2,"",5)
 				Enddo
				RetImpr = .F.
				ImpVinc = .F.
			Endif
		Endif
	Endif
	If !ImpVinc
		Clear Typeahead
		fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado
		If (!RetImpr or (Inlist(crSigCdPam.SisTef,1,3) And Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (6), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'')=7 ))
*** nao confirma cupom aberto ****
			Select crAux1
			Go Top
			If Not Eof()
				llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
				lcTipo = 'NCN'
				RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
					val(crAux1.cnIdents),crAux1.cNmRedes,crAux1.cnNSUs,;
					crAux1.cFinalzs,crAux1.cCupomnvs, crAux1.Fpags)
				Do Form SIGCNTEF With crAux1.cnNSUs, crAux1.cNmRedes,Iif(crSigCdPam.SisTef=3,Val(Strtran(crAux1.cnValors,',','.')),Val(crAux1.cnValors)/100), 'Última transação TEF Cancelada'
				Thisform.DeleteSigTef(crAux1.cnIdents,'CRT')
			Endif
			=FinFimVinc(oFormu)	&& finaliza cupom interrompido
			=VendaCancel(oFormu)	&& mena 05/2012 (????não cancela CF depois de CCV)

*** Cancela só os confirmados ****
			Select TmpSigFiTef
			Go Top
			Scan

				If crSigCdPam.SisTef = 1

					lcCupomnv = TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs
					Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigFiNfs Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And cComprovs = ?lcCupomnv],'crSigFiNfs')

					lcdirreq = Alltrim(crSigFiNfs.cTefdReqs)
					lcdirresp = Alltrim(crSigFiNfs.cTefdResps)
					lnQtdVias = crSigFiNfs.nqtdvias

					llCancTef = .T.
					Do While llCancTef

						lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')
						=ApagaResp(Thisform.poDataMgr)

						llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
						lcTipo = 'CNC'
						RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,'CNC',;
							val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
							TmpSigFiTef.cFinalzs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, TmpSigFiTef.Fpags, Val(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors) / 100)
						If RetNImp
							lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.001')
							Select CrTefImp
							Delete All
							Select CrTefResp
							Set Order To Resp
							Delete All
							Append From &lcarquivo Sdf

*** Mena 05/2012 pega informaçoes 012 e 027 para confirmação
							Select CrTefResp
							Goto Top
							If Seek('012')
								lccnNSUs = Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)
							Endif
							Select CrTefResp
							Goto Top
							If Seek('027')
								lccFinalzs = Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)
							Endif
**************************************************************
							Seek '009'
							If Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)) = '0'
								Seek '030'
								lcMsg = Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11))
								Do Form SigTfDss With "Cancelamento","",lcMsg,"","","VR",0,0,(crSigCdPac.InibEscs=2)	&& mena 16/01/2014-mudado o nome do cursor
								For lnContaQtdVia = 1 To lnQtdVias
									Select CrTefResp
									Go Top
									Seek '029'
									If Found()
										Do While cinfos = '029'
											Select CrTefResp
											Scatter Memvar
											m.cnIdents = TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents
											m.cinfos = Strtran(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11),'"','')
											m.nvias = lnContaQtdVia
											Insert Into CrTefImp From Memvar
											Select CrTefResp
											Skip
										Enddo
										Select CrTefImp
									Else
									Endif
								Next
								llCancTef = .F.
								RetCVinc = .F.
								Do While ! RetCVinc
*** mena 16/06/2016 verifica se imprime na não fiscal ***
									If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6)
										RetCVinc = PrintCVCfe(TprMvCab.Emps)
									Else
										RetCVinc = RRelGerVinc(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario)
									Endif
									If ! RetCVinc
										Clear Typeahead
										fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado
										If Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (7), Tentar Novamente ?',4+48,'')=7
											llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
											lcTipo = 'NCN'
											RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,'',0,lcTipo,;
												val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,lccnNSUs,;
												lccFinalzs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs,TmpSigFiTef.Fpags)

											Do Form SIGCNTEF With TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,Iif(crSigCdPam.SisTef=3,Val(Strtran(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors,',','.')),Val(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors)/100)

											llcan = .T.					&& cancelou cupom vinculado
											llCancTef = .T.
											RetCVinc = .T.
											Thisform.DeleteSigTef(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,'CNC')
										Endif
									Else
										llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
										lcTipo = 'CNF'
										RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,'',0,lcTipo,;
											val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,lccnNSUs,;
											lccFinalzs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs,TmpSigFiTef.Fpags)
										llcan = .T.					&& cancelou cupom vinculado
										llCancTef = .F.
										lcSql = [Select CidChaves From SigFiTef Where ctipos = 'E' And cHeaders='CNC' AND CNNSUS = ']+Alltrim(TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs)+[']
										If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
											Select LocSigFiTef
											Scan
												lcSql=[Update SigFiTef set cStatus = 'CNF' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
												RetSql=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql)
												Thisform.poDataMgr.Commit()
											Endscan
										Endif
										Thisform.DeleteSigTef(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,'CNC')
									Endif
								Enddo
								fBlockInput(.T.)			&& trava teclado
							Else
								Seek '030'
								lcMsg = Iif(Empty(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)),'Movimentação Cancelada pelo Usuário',Alltrim(Substr(CrTefResp.cinfos,11)))
								Do Form SigTfDss With "Erro na Trasação","",lcMsg,"Cancelar pelo Modulo Administrativo","","VM",0,0
								If Messagebox("Pressione Ok para tentar novamente",64,"") = 1
									llCancTef = .T.
								Endif
							Endif
							lcarquivo = Lower(lcdirresp + 'IntPos.STS')
							Thisform.DeleteSigTef(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents,'CRT')	&& Mena 05/2012
						Endif
					Enddo

				Else

					llCancTef = .T.
					Do While llCancTef
						Select TmpSigFiTef
						llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
						lcTipo = 'NCN'
						RetNImp=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
							val(TmpSigFiTef.cnIdents),TmpSigFiTef.cNmRedes,TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,;
							TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs,TmpSigFiTef.cCupomnvs, TmpSigFiTef.Fpags, Val(TmpSigFiTef.cnValors) / 100 )
						lcSql = [Select CidChaves From SigFiTef Where ctipos = 'R' And cHeaders='CRT' AND CNNSUS = ']+Alltrim(TmpSigFiTef.cnNSUs)+[']
						If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocSigFiTef') > 0
							Select LocSigFiTef
							Scan
								lcSql=[Update SigFiTef set cStatus = 'CNC' Where CidChaves = ']+LocSigFiTef.CidChaves+[']
								RetSql=Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql)
								Thisform.poDataMgr.Commit()
							Endscan
						Endif
						llCancTef = .F.
					Enddo
					RetCVinc = .F.
				Endif
			Endscan
			_Hist = 'Erro Impressão Cumpom Vinculado - Varios Tefs '
			LoopCVinc = .F.
			Loop
		Else
			fBlockInput(.T.)			&& trava teclado
			RetFim = .F.
			Do Case
			Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA','BEMATECH','ELGIN','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON')
*!*						If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMA8501','EPSON')	&& mena - homologacao tef - saiu em 13/01/2014
				If Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'EPSON')
					RetFim = FinFimVinc(oFormu)
					Do While ! RetFim
						VerStatus = RotStatus(1,oFormulario)
						If Type('VerStatus')<>'L'
							If Upper(VerStatus) = 'IMPRESSORA OK'
								RetFim=.T.
							Endif
						Else
							Messagebox('Impressora Não Responde (9), Tentar Novamente ?',0+16,'')
						Endif
					Enddo
				Else
					RetFim = FinFimVinc(oFormu)
				Endif
			Case Inlist(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6)		&& mena 17/06/2016 SAT ou NFCe
				RetFim = .T.
			Case  Inlist(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
				VerStatus = RotStatus(1,oFormulario)
				If Type('VerStatus')<>'L'
					If Substr(VerStatus,6,1) = 't'
						Messagebox('Encontrou-se no comando a string "TOTAL"',0+48,'ERRO')
						FinFimVinc(oFormu)
						Select SigMvCab
						_Hist = 'Erro Impressão Cumpom Vinculado - Varios Tefs - Encontrou-se no comando a string "TOTAL"'
						LoopCVinc = .F.
						RetCVinc = .F.
						Loop
						=ApagaResp(Thisform.poDataMgr)
					Endif
					If !(Substr(VerStatus,1,1)='L' And Substr(VerStatus,6,1)='K')
						If Substr(VerStatus,1,1)='R'
							RetFim = FinFimVinc(oFormu)
						Else
							RetFim = .F.
						Endif
					Else
						RetFim = .T.
					Endif
				Endif
			Endcase
			If RetFim .And. ! lPrimeira
				Thisform.CntTxt
*** mena 16/06/2016 verifica se imprime na não fiscal ***
				If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.cupfis,5,6)
					ImpVinc = PrintCVCfe(TprMvCab.Emps)
				Else
					ImpVinc = RelGerVinc(crSigFiTef.cnIdents,oFormulario,Thisform)
				Endif

				If ImpVinc		&& imprimiu cupom vinculado?
*** confirma cupom aberto ****
					Select crAux1
					Go Top
					If Not Eof()
						llAtiva = VerifGP('ATV', Thisform, Thisform.nocaixa,  _empr, crSigFiFis.Imps, Thisform.poDataMgr, crSigFiTef.cCupomnvs )
						lcTipo = 'CNF'
						RetImpr=TefImpr(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,lcTipo,;
							val(crAux1.cnIdents),crAux1.cNmRedes,crAux1.cnNSUs,;
							crAux1.cFinalzs,crAux1.cCupomnvs, crAux1.Fpags)
******************************************
					Endif
				Endif
				Clear Typeahead
			Endif
		Endif
		With Thisform.CntTefTxt
			.TxtOper.Caption = ''
			.TxtCli.Caption = ''
			.TxtTpTrans.Caption = ''
			.Visible = .F.
		Endwith
	Else
		LoopCVinc = .F.
		RetCVinc = .T.
	Endif
Enddo

=ApagarIntPos(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
Wait Clear
_Hist = Nvl(crEest.Obses,'') + Chr(13) + IIF(isempty(_Hist),'',_Hist)
lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set Obses = ']+_Hist+[' Where CidChaves = ']+crEest.CidChaves+[']
=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'')
If RetCVinc 
	_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
	llCanc = .f.
	llDtAlt = _pData
	lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set lCancelas = ?llCanc, DtAlts = ?llDtAlt Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrEest.EmpDopNums+[']
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
EndIf

CLEAR TYPEAHEAD
fBlockInput(.F.)			&& destrava teclado
Return (RetcVinc and !llcan)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE impsedex
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE impsedex
Create Cursor TmpSedex (cBarCeps c(7), cBarSedexs c(16), NomeCli c(50), Endes c(60), Nums c(10), Compls c(25), Bairs c(40), Cidas c(30), Estas c(2), ceps c(9), ;
NomeRem c(50), EndEmp c(60), NumEmp c(10), BaiEmp c(40), CidEmp c(30), EstaEmp c(2), cepEmp c(9), NumCarts c(21), cFilas c(8), Supervs c(8), ;
Notas c(6), Series c(3))

lcEDN = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)

*** Endereço do cliente
Thisform.podatamgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.ContaDs,'Rclis as NomeCli, Endes, Nums, Bairs, Cidas , Estas , Ceps, Compls')
Select crTmpCli
Scatter memo memvar
Insert into TmpSedex from memvar

*** Busca endereço de entrega se estiver preenchido
If !Empty(TprMvCab.ContaEs)
	Dimension laArray(2)
	laArray(1) = TprMvCab.ContaEs	&& mena 31/08/2016 estava pegando do cursor errado crTprMvCab.ContaEs
	laArray(2) = TprMvCab.LocalEnts	&& crTprMvCab.LocalEnts
	
	If fEndEntrega(@laArray, Thisform.podatamgr,,TprMvCab.IDEntrega)
		Select TmpSedex
		replace Endes With laArray(06)
		replace Nums With laArray(07)
		replace Bairs With laArray(09)
		replace Cidas With laArray(10)
		replace Estas With laArray(11)
		replace Ceps With laArray(04)
		replace Compls With laArray(08)
		
		Scatter Memo Memvar
		Gather Memo Memvar
	EndIf
Endif

*** Busca código de barras do CEP
oConCep = CreateObject('fSqlConector', 'CEP')
If (oConCep.pnIdconn > 0)
	lcQuery = [Select cBarCeps from Cep where Ceps = '] + TmpSedex.Ceps + [']
	oConCep.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[TmpCep])
	replace cBarCeps With TmpCep.cBarCeps in TmpSedex
Endif
If Empty(TmpSedex.cBarCeps)
	Messagebox([Código de barras do CEP em branco. Contate o suporte.],64,[Aviso])
	Return .f.
Endif

*** Endereço da empresa
Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdEmp', 'crEmpresa', 'Cemps', TprMvCab.Emps, 'RazSocs as Remetente, Ceps as CepEmp, Endes as EndEmp, Numeros as NumEmp, ;
								Bairs as BaiEmp, Cidas as CidEmp, Estas as EstaEmp, Nums as NumCarts, cFilas, Supervs')

Select crEmpresa
Scatter memo memvar
Select TmpSedex
Gather memo memvar

*** Busca número da Nota e série
Thisform.podatamgr.CursorQuery([SigMvNfi], [LocalNFis], [EmpDopNums], TprMvCab.EmpDopNums, [Nfis, Series])

replace Notas With LocalNFis.Nfis
replace Series With LocalNFis.Series

If Inlist(thisform.pcescolha,[INSERIR],[ALTERAR])
	lcQuery = [Select cBarSedexs from SigCdSed Where EmpDopNums = '] + lcEDN + [']
	Thisform.podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[LocalSedex])
	Select LocalSedex
	If Eof()
		If Messagebox([Deseja gerar etiqueta de sedex?],4+32+256,[Etiqueta Sedex]) = 7
			Return .t.
		Endif
		*** Pega a primeira etiqueta disponível e atualiza o empdopnums
		llOk = .f.
		Do While !llOk
			lcQuery = [Select cBarSedexs, nNumEtiqs from SigCdSed Where cEmps = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + [' And EmpDopNums = '' Order By nNumEtiqs]
			Thisform.podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[LocalSedex])
			
			Select LocalSedex
			Go top 
			If Eof()
				Messagebox([Não existe numeração de etiqueta disponível.],64,[Contate o Suporte])
				Return .f.
			Endif
			
			lcUpdate = [Update SigCdSed set EmpDopNums = '] + TprMvCab.EmpDopNums + [', DtUsos = ?TprMvCab.Datas Where nNumEtiqs = ?LocalSedex.nNumEtiqs And cEmps = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + [']
			llOk = (ThisForm.PodataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') > 0)
		Enddo
		If llOk
			=ThisForm.Podatamgr2.commit()
		Else
			Return .f.			
		Endif
	Endif
Else
	lcQuery = [Select cBarSedexs from SigCdSed Where EmpDopNums = '] + lcEDN + [']
	Thisform.podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[LocalSedex])	
	If Empty(LocalSedex.cBarSedexs)
		Return .t.
	Endif 
Endif
replace cBarSedexs With LocalSedex.cBarSedexs in TmpSedex

*** Avisa quando numero de etiqueta for <= 100
Select LocalSedex
If Thisform.pcescolha = [INSERIR] And !Eof() And Reccount() <= 100
	Messagebox([Número de etiquetas disponíveis chegou a : ] + Str(Reccount(),3) , 64, [Aviso])
Endif

Select TmpSedex
Report form SigReSed Preview NoConsole

*** Tiago - 27/08/2015 - Ícaro - Grava na etiqueta de sedex se ela já foi impressa
If goSistema.ControlaImp
	lcUpdate = [Update SigCdSed set Impress = 1 Where EmpDopNums = '] + lcEDN + [']
	llOk = (ThisForm.PodataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') > 0)
	If llOk
		=ThisForm.Podatamgr2.commit()
	Endif
Endif

Select TprMvCab

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE inserir
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE inserir
Local Ret, _pData

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

If InList(crSigCdOpe.NFiscals,1,2) And (crSigMvNfi.NFis=='000000' Or crSigMvNfi.nFis = ' ')
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','CrSigCdSer','EmpCods',ThisForm.pEmps + crSigMvNfi.Series) Or ;
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','CrSigCdSer','EmpCods',Space(3) + crSigMvNfi.Series));
		And (crSigCdOpe.TipoNfs = 3 Or (crSigCdOpe.Tiponfs = 4 And crSigCdSer.Tiponfs = 3))
		llImpNF = .T.
		lcSerie = crSigMvNfi.Series
		lnNota  = fGerUniqueKey( crSigMvNfi.Emps + 'NOTA FISCAL' + lcSerie, .T. )
		lcNota  = Transf( lnNota, "@L 999999" )
		Select crSigMvNfi
		Replace crSigMvNfi.Nfis With lcNota
		Select TprMvCab
		Replace TprMvCab.Notas With lcNota
	EndIf
	
	If crSigMvNfi.NFis == '000000' Or crSigMvNfi.nFis = ' '
		lcSerie = crSigMvNfi.Series 
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','crTmpSerie','EmpCods',TprMvCab.Emps + lcSerie)
		If Eof('crTmpSerie')
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','crTmpSerie','EmpCods',Space(3) + lcSerie)
		EndIf
		If Not Eof('crTmpSerie')

				lnTPs=IIF(lnTPs=0,1,lnTPs)
				
				lnValor = (crTpmMvItn.totas + NVL(TmpMed.TVr,0))/lnTQt
				lnValor = IIF(TmpUni.cestos='1', lnValor, (crTpmMvItn.totas + NVL(TmpMed.TVr,0))/lnTPs)
				lnPeso  = (crTpmMvItn.pesos + NVL(TmpMed.TPs,0))/lnTQt

				lcUpDate = [UpDate SigCdPro Set pcuss = ?lnValor, pesoms = ?lnPeso Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'') < 1
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdPro)')
					ret = .f.
					Exit
				EndIf
			EndScan
		EndIf
		****************************************************************************************************************
		
		If (LocalTOpe.GerGdmis = 2 And LocalTope.AtuCompras = 1) And Inlist(ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR')
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Scan
				If Empty(Cpros)
					Loop
				EndIf
				lcSql = [Select Cpros, UltComps From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcsql,'TmpPro') < 1
					MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigClLan)')
					Ret = .f.
				EndIf
				
				llData  = TprMvCab.Datas
				llDtalt = _pData
				lnValor = crTpmMvItn.Units
				lcMoeda = crTpmMvItn.Moedas

				If TprMvCab.Datas > TmpPro.UltComps Or IsEmpty(TmpPro.UltComps)
					lcUpDate = [UpDate SigCdPro Set UltComps = ?llData, Datas = ?llDtalt, vUltComps = ]+Str(lnValor,12,2)+[, ]+;
							   [mUltComps = ']+lcMoeda+[' Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
					If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'') < 1
						MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigCdPro)')
						ret = .f.
						Exit
					EndIf
				EndIf

				Insert Into crSigOpClU (Emps,Dopes,Numes,empDopNums,cpros,Valors,Datas,Moedas,Cidchaves) Values ;
							(TprMvCab.Emps,TprMvCab.Dopes,TprMvCab.Numes,TprMvCab.EmpdopNums,;
							crTpmMvItn.Cpros,lnValor,llData,lcMoeda,fUniqueIds() )
			EndScan
		EndIf
		
		If Not ThisForm.poDataMgr.Update('crSigOpClU')
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigOpClU)')
			ret = .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

Return ( Ret )

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE itemfiscal
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE itemfiscal
Lparameters vCancItem

Local ImpVen, ImpFin, Final, Primeira, LnSoma, lnCodBarra, lcProduto, lnNotas, _Memo

If ( crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 ) Or ( ThisForm.SubNivelFiscal And Not vCancItem )
	Return .T.
EndIf

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Imprimindo Itens...'
EndIf

oFormulario = This.oModemEest
lnSoma = 0
ImpVen=.t.
ImpFin=.t.

Select crTpmMvItn
lcSql = [Select Estas, mostraim, mostrapara, aliqia From SigCdEmp Where Cemps  =']+TprMvCab.emps+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrSigCdEmp') < 1
	llOk = 7
	DO While llOk = 7
		llOk = 	MessageBox('Tributação Inválida !!! Tentar Novamente? ',4+48+256,'')
	EndDo
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcSql = [Select Cpros,Icms,Cgrus,Cbars,TpTribs,cunis,SitTrIcms,sgrus,mercs,DescFis,CodFinP,DescEcfs,IdPro,ClFiscals,origmercs From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrtmpPro') < 1
	llOk = 7
	DO While llOk = 7
		llOk = 	MessageBox('Tributação Inválida !!! Tentar Novamente? ',4+48+256,'')
	EndDo
	Return .f.
EndIf

ThisForm.VerIcms
If ThisForm.lOkIcms
	lcProduto  = crTpmMvItn.DPros
	If Not IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.CodBarras)
		lnCodBarra = crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
		If crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 4 And Not IsEmpty( AllTrim( crTpmMvItn.Notas ) )
			lcProduto = AllTrim(crTpmMvItn.Notas) + ' ' + crTpmMvItn.DPros
		EndIf
	Else
		lnNotas = Val( crTpmMvItn.Notas )
		If crSigCdOpe.OpCrs = 4 And Not IsEmpty( AllTrim( crTpmMvItn.Notas ) ) And ;
				( Transform( lnNotas, '@L 999999' ) = crTpmMvItn.Notas )
			lnCodBarra = 0 + lnNotas
		Else
			lnCodBarra = CrTmpPro.CBars
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigCdOpe.ChkEDesc = 1
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
			lnPDesc = Round((crTpmMvItn.Valdescs/(crTpmMvItn.Units+crTpmMvItn.Valdescs)) * 100,2)
			lnVUnit = crTpmMvItn.Units + crTpmMvItn.ValDescs
		Else
			lnPDesc = crTpmMvItn.ValDescs*crTpmMvItn.Qtds
			lnVUnit = crTpmMvItn.Units + crTpmMvItn.ValDescs
		EndIf
	Else
		lnPDesc = 0
		lnVUnit = crTpmMvItn.Units
	EndIf

*** Mena - 14/05/2018 - pega imposto transparente do banco de dados *** 
	IF INLIST(crSigcdemp.mostraim, 2,4)	&& ecf ou ambos
		IF CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA =0
			lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdIbp Where ufs = ']+CrSigCdEmp.estas+[' and codigo = ']+ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals)+[' order by datini desc]
			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalIbp]) < 1)
				=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalIbp)])
				Return 0
			ENDIF
			SELECT LocalIbp
			GO top
			lnImposF = IIF(INLIST(ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.origmercs), '0','3','4','5'), NVL(LocalIbp.nacfederal,0), NVL(LocalIbp.impfederal,0))
			lnImposE = NVL(LocalIbp.estadual,0)
			lnImposM = NVL(LocalIbp.municipal,0)
		ELSE
			lnImposF = CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA
			lnImposE = 0.00
			lnImposM = 0.00
		ENDIF
		thisform.impostoF = thisform.impostoF + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposF/100, 2)
		thisform.impostoE = thisform.impostoE + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposE/100, 2)
		thisform.impostoM = thisform.impostoM + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposM/100, 2)
	ENDIF
	******************************************************************
	
*!*		Mena - retirado 14/05/2018 ******************************************************************
*!*		**** Mena - 04/06/2013 - inclui o valor do imposto aproximado ****
*!*		**** Mena - 02/02/2015 - retirado e substituido por trecho abaixo*
*!*	*!*		IF INLIST(crSigcdemp.mostraim, 2,4)	&& ecf ou ambos
*!*	*!*			IF USED('IBPTAX')
*!*	*!*				SELECT ibptax
*!*	*!*				LOCATE for c1 =  crTmpPro.ClFiscals 
*!*	*!*				*** verifica qual a Origem da mercadoria para aplicar a aliquota correspondente da tabela IBPT ***
*!*	*!*				lnImposA = IIF(FOUND(), IIF(INLIST(ALLTRIM(crTmpPro.origmercs), '0','3','4','5'), VAL(TRANSFORM(c4, '999999.99')), VAL(TRANSFORM(c5, '999999.99'))), 0)
*!*	*!*			ELSE
*!*	*!*				lnImposA = CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA
*!*	*!*			ENDIF
*!*	*!*			thisform.impostoa = thisform.impostoa + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposA/100, 2)
*!*	*!*		ENDIF
*!*		******************************************************************
*!*		**** Mena - 02/02/2015 - inclui o valor do imposto aproximado utilizando novas tabelas com aliquota Federal/Estadual/Municipal****
*!*		lcIBPT = goSistema.DirFiscais + 'IBPT\versao'+'.txt'
*!*		IF FILE(lcIBPT)
*!*			lcVTX = FILETOSTR(lcIBPT)
*!*		ELSE
*!*			lcVTX = '15.1'
*!*		ENDIF
*!*		lcIBPT = goSistema.DirFiscais + 'IBPT\TabelaIBPTax'+CrSigCdEmp.estas+lcVTX+'.XLS'
*!*		lcIBPTdbf = 'TabelaIBPTax'+CrSigCdEmp.estas+lcVTX
*!*		IF FILE(lcIBPT) AND !USED('IBPTAX')
*!*			SELECT 0
*!*			IMPORT FROM &lcIBPT TYPE XL5
*!*			USE
*!*			SELECT 0
*!*			use (lcIBPTdbf) alias IBPTAX
*!*		ENDIF

*!*		IF INLIST(crSigcdemp.mostraim, 2,4)	&& ecf ou ambos
*!*			IF USED('IBPTAX')	&& se este arquivo existe foi criado o DBF correspondente na no diretorio atual
*!*				SELECT IBPTAX
*!*				LOCATE for ALLTRIM(A) =  ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.ClFiscals) 
*!*				lnImposF = IIF(FOUND(), IIF(INLIST(ALLTRIM(CrTmpPro.origmercs), '0','3','4','5'), VAL(TRANSFORM(E, '999999.99')), VAL(TRANSFORM(F, '999999.99'))), 0)
*!*				lnImposE = VAL(TRANSFORM(G, '999999.99'))
*!*				lnImposM = VAL(TRANSFORM(H, '999999.99'))
*!*			ELSE
*!*				lnImposF = CrSigCdEmp.aliqIA
*!*				lnImposE = 0.00
*!*				lnImposM = 0.00
*!*			ENDIF
*!*			thisform.impostoF = thisform.impostoF + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposF/100, 2)
*!*			thisform.impostoE = thisform.impostoE + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposE/100, 2)
*!*			thisform.impostoM = thisform.impostoM + ROUND(crTpmMvItn.Qtds*crTpmMvItn.Units*lnImposM/100, 2)
*!*		ENDIF
*!*		******************************************************************

	lcTipo = CrSigFiTri.Tipos
	If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'NSWEDA' And InList(CrSigFiTri.Tipos,'F','I','N')
		lcTipo = Padr(CrSigFiTri.Tipos,3)
	EndIf
	If Not Empty(CrTmpPro.DescEcfs)
		lcProduto = CrTmpPro.DescEcfs
	EndIf
	lcProduto = fLimpaTexto(lcproduto)
	lcitem = TRANSFORM(crTpmMvItn.citens,'@L 999')
	If vCancItem
		ImpVen = CancelItemGen(lnCodBarra, lcProduto, crSigFiTri.Ordems, crTpmMvItn.Qtds, lnvUnit, lnPDesc, ;
						oFormulario, lcTipo)
	Else
		ImpVen = VenFis(lnCodBarra, lcProduto, crSigFiTri.Ordems, crTpmMvItn.Qtds, lnVUnit, lnpDesc, ;
						oFormulario, lcTipo, lcitem,Left(CrTmpPro.Cunis,2), .f. )
						
	EndIf

Else
	llOk = 7
	DO While llOk = 7
		llOk = 	MessageBox('Tributação Inválida !!! Tentar Novamente? ',4+48+256,'')
	EndDo
	ImpVen = .F.
EndIf

If ImpVen
	ThisForm.ImpressoItem=.T.
	If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 and CrSigOpCdd.PafEcfs = 1
		thisform.Atuagt(0,.t.,.t.)
	EndIf
Else
	llOk = 7
	DO While llOk = 7
		llOk = 	MessageBox('Erro na Impressão do Item!!! Tentar Novamente? ',4+48+256,'')
		ThisForm.poFormxeest1.SubTotAc = .t.
	EndDo

	ThisForm.plitem = .f.
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.Enabled = .f.
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Pagto.Enabled = .f.
EndIf
Select crTpmMvItn
Return(ImpVen)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE libaltfpag
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE libaltfpag
Lparameters pBlq

Local _posicao

_Posicao  = crSigMvCab.Emps + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str( crSigMvCab.Numes, 6 )

If InList(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
	okdt = fVerificaBloqueio(crSigMvCab.datas, ThisForm.podatamgr) = 0 Or ThisForm.VerBloqueio2(crSigMvCab.Datas,crSigOpCdc.Bloqueios,crSigOpCdd.ddBlqs,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	If !okdt
		MessageBox('Periodo Bloqueado !!!',0+48,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	okdt = fBloqueioPorPeriodo(crSigMvCab.datas, ThisForm.podatamgr) = 0 Or ThisForm.VerBloqueio2(crSigMvCab.Datas,crSigOpCdc.Bloqueios,crSigOpCdd.ddBlqs,ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	If !okdt
		MessageBox('Periodo Bloqueado !!!',0+48,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf
If pBlq &&Verifica somente a checagem do Periodo (Chamado de Serviços / Dados Complementares
	Return .t.
EndIf

If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And crSigMvCab.Vars <> 0
	If ( crSigCdOpe.TipoNfs = 4 And ( ( ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdSer','CrSigCdSer','EmpCods',ThisForm.pEmps + CrTmpNFis.Series) Or ;
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdSer','CrSigCdSer','EmpCods',Space(3) + CrTmpNFis.Series )) And crSigCdSer.ImpNfs = 1 ) ) Or ;
		( crSigCdOpe.TipoNfs # 4 And crSigCdOpe.Agrupas = 1 )
		MessageBox('Movimentação com Nota Fiscal e Variação não pode ser alterada!!!!',0+16,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

lcQuery = [Select Cemps, Nums, AltMovTrs From SigCdEmp Where Cemps = ']+crSigMvCab.Emps+[']
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrSigCdEmp') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrSigCdEmp 2)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcSql = [Select * From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, 'LocalEestT') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEestT)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

If ( Not IsEmpty(crSigMvCab.datatrans) Or Reccount('LocalEestT') > 0 ) And ( Not InList(crSigCdOpe.AltTrans,1,3) Or crSigCdEmp.AltMovTrs#1 )
	MessageBox('Movimentação já transportada !!!',0+48,'')
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcQuery = [Select Concs, Dtaudits From SigMvCcr Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrMccr') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrMccr)')
	Return .f.
EndIf
Select CrMccr
Scan
	If CrMccr.Concs
		Messagebox( 'Lançamentos já Conciliados !',0+48,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	If Not IsEmpty(CrMccr.DtAudits)
		Messagebox( 'Lançamentos já Auditado!',0+48,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndScan

*- Verifica cheques -*
lcWhere = [Select Nums From SigCqChm Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CsCheques')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsCheques)')
	Return .f.
Else
	Select CsCheques
	Scan
		lcNum = CsCheques.Nums
		lcWhere = [Select * From SigCqChm Where Nums = ?lcNum Order By Nums, DtSis Desc ]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'Crtmpchm')
		If LnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpChm)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Select CrtmpChm
		Go Top
		If Not ( crtmpChm.Emps + crtmpChm.Dopes + Str(crtmpChm.NumDopes,6) = _Posicao )
			MessageBox('Cheque: ' + crtmpChm.Bancos + '-' + crtmpChm.Agencias + '-' + ;
					   crtmpChm.nContas + '-' + crtmpChm.ncheques + ;
					   ' Apresenta Movimentação ... ',48,;
					   'Ultima Movimentação do Cheque: ' + crtmpChm.Codigos)
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Select csCheques
	EndScan
EndIf

*- Verifica parcela -*
lcwhere = [Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrtmpPar')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPar)')
	Return .f.
Else
	Select CrtmpPar
	Scan
		lcMsg = ''
		Do Case
			Case Not IsEmpty(crTmpPar.DPags) And crSigCdOpe.COpers = 2
				lcMsg = 'Movimentação Possui Cartão de Crédito já depositado ou Baixado ... '
			
			Case ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',CrTmpPar.Fpags) And ( crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1 ) And ( crtmpPar.VPags # 0 ) And crSigCdPam.SisTef = 1
				 If ThisForm.ChecaCondPar()
					lcMsg = 'Parcela ' + Upper(AllTrim(crtmpPar.FPags)) + ' ' + AllTrim(Transf(crtmpPar.Valos,'@Z 999,999,999.99')) + ' Já Paga ... '
				 EndIf
		EndCase
		
		If Not Empty(lcMsg)
			MessageBox( lcMsg, 48, 'Movimentação Com Parcelas Pagas')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf

*- Verifica cartao -*
lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdCtt Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpCart')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCart)')
	Return .f.
Else
	Select crtmpCart
	Scan
		If !IsEmpty(crtmpCart.Recebidos)
			MessageBox('Movimentação possui Cartão de Crédito c/ movimento !!',0+48,'')
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf

*- Verifica Lançamentos Conta Corrente Já Baixados -*
lcWhere = [Select Distinct Emps, Nopers, Hists From SigMvCcr Where EmpDopNums = ']+_Posicao+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CsMccrBx')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsMccrBx)')
	Return .f.
Else
	Select csMccrBx
	Scan
		lcEmp = CsMccrBx.Emps
		lnOper= CsMccrBx.Nopers
		lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdPit Where Emps = ?lcEmp And Nopers = ?lnOper]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrtmpPrit')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPrit)')
			Return .f.
		Else
			Select CrTmpPrit
			If Reccount() > 0
				MessageBox( AllTrim(CrTmpPrIt.Hists) + ' No Valor de ' + ;
							AllTrim(Str(CrtmpPrIt.Valos,12,2)) + ' ' + AllTrim(crtmpPrIt.Moedas) + ;
							' Já Baixado.', 48, 'Lançamento de Conta Corrente Já Baixado')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf
Return .t.
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE libdevols
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE libdevols
Lparameters pGru, pCon, pPro, pCnx

lcConexao = pCnx

Private pDtI
Store 0 to Qtdev, Qtded

lcSel = Alias()

Select crTpmMvItn
lnRec = Recno()
Scan For CPros = pPro
	Qtded = Qtded + Qtds
Endscan
Go lnRec

Wait Window 'Verificando Vendas!!! Aguarde...' NoWait

lcTmpParam = 'SQL' + Sys(2015)
lcTprMvCab  = 'SQL' + Sys(2015)
lcTmpItn   = 'SQL' + Sys(2015)
lcTmpOpe   = 'SQL' + Sys(2015)

lnSQLErr = lcConexao.SQLExecute([Select ValDevs From SigCdPam], lcTmpParam)
If (lnSQLErr < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdPam)')
Else
	Go Top In &lcTmpParam.
	ldDtI = fDtoSql(Date() - &lcTmpParam..ValDevs)

	For _Cont = 1 to 2
		If (_Cont = 1)
			lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
			    		[From SigMvCab ] + ;
			    	   [Where GrupoOs = '] + pGru + [' And ] + ;
			    	   		 [ContaOs = '] + pCon + [' And ] + ;
			    	   		 [Datas >= ?ldDtI ] + ; 
			    	   [Order By GrupoOs Desc, ContaOs Desc, Datas Desc]
		Else
			lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
			    		[From SigMvCab ] + ;
			    	   [Where GrupoDs = '] + pGru + [' And ] + ;
			    	   		 [ContaDs = '] + pCon + [' And ] + ;
			    	   		 [Datas >= ?ldDtI ] + ; 
			    	   [Order By GrupoDs Desc, ContaDs Desc, Datas Desc]
		EndIf

		lnSQLErr = lcConexao.SQLExecute(lcQuery, lcTprMvCab)
		If (lnSQLErr < 1)		&& Caso Falhe ao Executar a Instrução SQL Acima
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigMvCab)')
		EndIf

		Select &lcTprMvCab.
		Scan
			lcQuery = [Select a.Estoqs, a.TipoOps, b.GerGdmis ] + ;
						[From SigCdOpe a, SigCdTom b ] + ;
					   [Where a.Dopes = '] + &lcTprMvCab..Dopes + [' And ] + ;
					   		 [a.Estoqs = 1 And ] + ;
					   		 [a.TipoOps = b.Codigos And ] + ;
					   		 [b.GerGdmis = 1 ] + ;
			    	   [Order By a.Dopes]

			lnSQLErr = lcConexao.SQLExecute(lcQuery, lcTmpOpe)
			If (lnSQLErr < 1)		&& Caso Falhe ao Executar a Instrução SQL Acima
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdOpe)')
			Else
				If Not Eof(lcTmpOpe)
					Select &lcTprMvCab.
					_ChBusca = Emps + Dopes + Str(Numes, 6)

					lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
					    		[From SigMvItn ] + ;
					    	   [Where EmpDopNums = '] + _ChBusca + [' And ] + ;
					    	   		 [CPros = '] + pPro + [' ] + ;
					    	   [Order By CItens]

					lnSQLErr = lcConexao.SQLExecute(lcQuery, lcTmpItn)
					If (lnSQLErr < 1)		&& Caso Falhe ao Executar a Instrução SQL Acima
						=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigMvItn)')
					Else
						Select &lcTmpItn.
						Scan
				            If (&lcTmpItn..Opers = [E])
				            	Qtded = Qtded + Qtds
				            Else
				            	Qtdev = Qtdev + Qtds
				            EndIf
						EndScan
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
	   EndScan
	Next
	Wait Clear

	If Not (lnSQLErr < 1)
		Do Case
			Case (Qtdev = 0)
				=Messagebox('Atenção!!! Este cliente nunca comprou esta peça.', 48, 'ATENÇÃO!!!' )
			Case (Qtdev < Qtded)
		      	=Messagebox('Atenção, este cliente devolveu esta peça mais do que comprou.' + Chr(13) + ;
		      				'Total de Vendas     : ' + Alltrim( Str( Qtdev ) ) + Chr( 13 ) + ;
		      				'Total de Devoluções : ' + Alltrim( Str( Qtded ) ), 48, 'ATENÇÃO!!!' )
		   	Case (Qtdev = Qtded)
		   		=Messagebox( 'Atenção, este cliente está devolvendo todas as peças compradas.', 48, 'ATENÇÃO!!!' )
		EndCase
	EndIf
EndIf

If Used(lcTmpParam)
	Use In &lcTmpParam.
EndIf
If Used(lcTprMvCab)
	Use In &lcTprMvCab.
EndIf
If Used(lcTmpItn)
	Use In &lcTmpItn.
EndIf
If Used(lcTmpOpe)
	Use In &lcTmpOpe.
EndIf

If Not Empty(lcSel)
	Select(lcSel)
EndIf
Return
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE liberapagto
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE liberapagto
Lparameters _ValTit, _MoeTit, _DatTit

If crSigOpCdd.ChkLimOps <> 1
	Return .t.
EndIf

lcSql = [Select CCargs From SigCdUsu Where Usuarios = ']+Usuar+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrSigCdUsu') < 1
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrSigCdUsu)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcSql = [Select VlLibOpes From SigCdCrg Where CCargs = ']+CrSigCdUsu.cCargs+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CrTmpCarg') < 1
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCarg)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

Go Top In crSigCdPam
lcMoe = crSigCdPam.MoedaPs
lnCot = ThisForm.Cotacao(lcMoe, _DatTit)
lcTit = crSigCdUsu.CCargs

lnVlL = _ValTit * Iif(_MoeTit = lcMoe, 1, ThisForm.Cotacao(_MoeTit, _DatTit) / lnCot )
llLib = (crTmpCarg.VlLibOpes >= lnVlL)

If Not llLib
	=MessageBox('Usuário Não Autorizado a Liberar Pagamento Neste Valor!!!', 0+48, lcTit)
	Return .f.
EndIf

Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE limitecreditomatriz
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE limitecreditomatriz
Lparameters _Grupo, _Conta, _GrupoEm, _ContaEm, _Tipo
Local _Limite, _CotLim, _Saldo, _CotSal, _CotMov, _CotPar, _FatConv, _ValorAnt, _ValorMov, _pData, _Matriz, _pAno, _pMes, _Campo, _CmpUp, _cMes, _SaldoMov, _cFiltro

=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdGcr', 'crSigCdGcr2', 'Codigos', _Grupo)

_Grupo = Iif(Not Empty(CrSigCdGcr2.GrupoLms),CrSigCdGcr2.GrupoLms,_Grupo)

_pData = TprMvCab.DataS &&crSigMvCcr.vencs
_pAno  = Str(Year(_pData),4)
_pMes  = Padl(Month(_pData),2,'0')
_cMes  = Alltrim(Str(Month(_pData)))
_Valor = TprMvCab.Valos &&crSigMvCcr.Valors

_Campo = []
_CmpUp = []
_cFiltro = []

If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,[ALTERAR]) 
	_cFiltro = [ And c.empdopnums <> ']+TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )+[' ]
EndIf 

_ValidaLim = .T.

Do Case
Case _pMes = '01'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Jan As LimCres, a.Acm_Jan As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Jan '
Case _pMes = '02'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Fev As LimCres, a.Acm_Fev As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Fev '
Case _pMes = '03'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Mar As LimCres, a.Acm_Mar As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Mar '
Case _pMes = '04'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Abr As LimCres, a.Acm_Abr As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Abr '
Case _pMes = '05'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Mai As LimCres, a.Acm_Mai As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Mai '
Case _pMes = '06'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Jun As LimCres, a.Acm_Jun As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Jun '
Case _pMes = '07'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Jul As LimCres, a.Acm_Jul As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Jul '
Case _pMes = '08'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Ago As LimCres, a.Acm_Ago As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Ago '
Case _pMes = '09'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Set As LimCres, a.Acm_Set As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Set '
Case _pMes = '10'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Out As LimCres, a.Acm_Out As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Out '
Case _pMes = '11'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Nov As LimCres, a.Acm_Nov As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Nov '
Case _pMes = '12'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Dez As LimCres, a.Acm_Dez As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Dez '
Endcase

Select CrSigCdGcr2

_SaldoMov = 0
_MoeMov = []
lcQuery = [Select Ano, replicate('0',2-len(ltrim(rtrim(Mes))))+ltrim(rtrim(Mes)) as Mes, ] + ;
	[ GruposEmt, ContasEmt, GruposCC, ContasCC, Cmoes, sum(valos) as Valos ] + ;
	[ from( ] + ;
	[ select a.limcres, a.dopes, b.GruposEmt, b.ContasEmt, month(datas) as mes, year(datas) as ano, ] + ; 
	[ case when c.grupoccs = space(10) then b.GruposCC else c.grupoccs end as GruposCC, ] + ;
	[ case when c.contaccs = space(10) then b.ContasCC else c.contaccs end as ContasCC, ] + ;
	[ c.datas, a.Cmoes, c.valos ] + ;
	[ from sigcdope a ] + ;
	[ join sigopcdd b on a.dopes = b.dopes ] + ; 
	[ join sigmvcab c on a.dopes = c.dopes ] + ; 
	[ where a.limcres in(7) and c.valos <> 0 ] +_cFiltro + [ ) a ] + ;
	[ Where 0=0 ] + ;
	[ And Ano = ']+_pAno+[' and Mes = ']+_cMes+[' ] + ;
	[ and GruposCC = ']+_Grupo+[' and ContasCC = ']+_Conta+[' ] + ;
	[ And GruposEmt= ']+_GrupoEm+[' and ContasEmt = ']+_ContaEm+[' ] + ;
	[ group by GruposEmt, ContasEmt, mes, ano, GruposCC, ContasCC, Cmoes ]
	
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crSldMov]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSldMov)])
	Return .F.
Endif

_SaldoMov = crSldMov.valos
_MoeMov = crSldMov.Cmoes

lcQuery = [Select a.cidchaves, a.codigo, a.grupos, a.contas, a.chkvalida, b.sgrupos, b.scontas, b.Ano, b.moeda ] +_Campo+ ;
	[From SigCdMtI a ] + ;
	[join SigCdMtz b on a.codigo = b.codigo ] + ;
	[Where b.Inativas = 0 And b.ano = ']+_pAno+[' and b.sgrupos = ']+_Grupo+[' and b.scontas = ']+_Conta+[' ] + ;
	[And Grupos = ']+_GrupoEm+[' and Contas = ']+_ContaEm+[' ]


If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crSigCdMtI]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigCdMtI)])
	Return .F.
Endif

Select crSigCdMtI
If Empty(_SaldoMov)
	_SaldoMov = crSigCdMtI.Saldos
	_MoeMov = crSigCdMtI.Moeda
EndIf 

* Checando o Limite de Crédito da Empresa Matriz de Cobrança
_Matriz = []
Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [LocalMtz], [IClis], _Conta, [ContaMats])
If Not Used([LocalMtz])
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalMtz)])
	Return .F.
Endif
Go Top In LocalMtz
If Not Eof([LocalMtz]) And Not Empty(LocalMtz.ContaMats)
	_Matriz = LocalMtz.ContaMats

	lcQuery = [Select a.cidchaves, a.codigo, a.grupos, a.contas, a.chkvalida, b.sgrupos, b.scontas, b.Ano, b.moeda ] + _Campo + ;
		[From SigCdMtI a ] + ;
		[join SigCdMtz b on a.codigo = b.codigo ] + ;
		[Where b.ano = ']+_pAno+[' and b.sgrupos = ']+_Grupo+[' and b.scontas = ']+_Matriz+[' ] + ;
		[And Grupos = ']+_GrupoEm+[' and Contas = ']+_ContaEm+[' ]

	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crSigCdMtI]) < 1)
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigCdMtI)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
	If Not Used([crSigCdMtI])
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - crSigCdMtI)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
	Go Top In crSigCdMtI
Endif

If Empty(_Matriz)
	Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [LocalContas], [IClis], _Conta, [IClis])
	If Not Used([LocalMtz])
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalMtz)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
Else
	lcQuery = [Select IClis ] + ;
		[From SigCdCli ] + ;
		[Where ContaMats = '] + _Matriz + [']

	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalContas]) < 1)
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalContas)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
Endif

_Conta = LocalContas.IClis

_ValidaLim = (crSigCdMtI.chkvalida = 1)

If CrSigCdGcr2.LimCres = 1
	lcTitulo = 'Crédito'

	Select crSigCdMtI
	Go Top
	
	_Saldo = 0
	
	_Limite = LimCres
	If Empty(_Limite)
		_Limite = 0.01
	EndIf 
		
	_MoeLim = Moeda
	_CotLim = Thisform.Cotacao(_MoeLim)
	
	_CotSal = Thisform.Cotacao(_MoeMov)
	If _MoeMov # crSigCdMtI.Moeda
		_Saldo = _Saldo + Round( _SaldoMov * _CotSal / _CotLim, 2 )
	Else
		_Saldo = _Saldo + _SaldoMov
	Endif

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	If crSigCdOpe.Cmoes # crSigCdMtI.Moeda
		_CotMov = Thisform.Cotacao(crSigCdOpe.Cmoes)
		_Valor =  Round( _Valor * _CotMov / _CotLim, 2 )
	Endif

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvPar','CrPar','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 ))

	Select crPar
	_ValorAnt = 0
	Scan
		=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',crPar.Fpags)
		If crSigOpFp.ValPends # 1
			Loop
		EndIf
		
		*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Nao checa o Limite de Credito pela condição de pagamento
		If crSigOpFp.ChkLimCre = 2
			Loop
		EndIf
		
		If Moefpgs # crSigCdMtI.Moeda
			_CotPar = Thisform.Cotacao(Moefpgs)
			_ValorAnt = _ValorAnt + Round( Valos * _CotPar / _CotLim, 2 )
		EndIf 
	Endscan

	_Saldo = _Saldo + _Valor - _ValorAnt

	_chequec = 0
	_chequep = 0
	Select LocalContas
	Scan
		lcQuery = [Select sum(a.valors) as Valors, a.fpags ]+;
			[From SigChe a, SigCdOpt b ] + ;
			[Where a.GrClis = ']+_Grupo+[' ]+;
			[And a.Iclis = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' ] + ;
			[And a.umovs = b.operacaos And b.tipos='DB' ] + ;
			[Group By a.Fpags ]
		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'Cheques') < 1)
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Cheques)')
			Return .F.
		Endif

		Select Cheques
		Scan
			If IsEmpty(Fpags)
				_chequep = _chequep + valors
			Else
				=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
				*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Nao checa o Limite de Credito pela condição de pagamento
				If crSigOpFp.ChkLimCre = 2
					Loop
				Endif
				If crSigOpFp.ValPends # 1
					_chequec = _chequec + valors
				Else
					_chequep = _chequep + valors
				Endif
			Endif
		Endscan
		_chequec = Round( _chequec / _CotLim, 2 )
		_chequep = Round( _chequep / _CotLim, 2 )

		If crSigCdPam.ChqlCreds
			_Saldo = _Saldo + _chequec
		Endif
	Endscan
Endif

If CrSigCdGcr2.LimEstoqs = 1 And !IsEmpty( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes )
	lcTitulo = 'Estoque'
	lcChave  = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)

	_MoeLim = crSigCdPam.MoeLimes
	_CotLim = Thisform.Cotacao( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes, _pData )

	If CrSigCdGcr2.LimCres <> 1
		_Limite = 0
		_Saldo  = 0

		Select crSigClLcr
		Scan
			_CotLmc = Thisform.Cotacao( Moedas, _pData )
			_Limite = _Limite + ( LimCres * Iif(Moedas#_MoeLim,_CotLmc / _CotLim, 1 ) )
		Endscan
	Endif
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

	Select LocalContas
	Scan
		If crSigCdOpe.EstDests = 1
			lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, Sum(a.Sqtds) as Qtds From SigMvEst a, SigCdGcr b ]+;
				[Where a.Estos = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' And a.Grupos = b.codigos And b.chkLimEsts <> 2 Group by a.Cpros ]

			If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrEst') < 1)
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Estoque)')
				Return .F.
			Endif

			lcQuery = [Select Cpros, Sum(Qtds*-1) as Qtds ]+;
				[From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcChave+[' Group By Cpros ]

			If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrEsti') < 1)
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Estoque 2)')
				Return .F.
			Endif

			Select Cpros, Sum(qtds) As qtds ;
				From crEst ;
				Group By Cpros ;
				Union All;
				Select Cpros, Sum(qtds) As qtds ;
				From crTpmMvItn ;
				Group By Cpros;
				Union All;
				Select Cpros, Sum(qtds) As qtds ;
				From crEsti ;
				Group By Cpros;
				Into Cursor TmpEst
		Else
			lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, Sum(a.Sqtds) as Qtds From SigMvEst a, SigCdGcr b ]+;
				[Where a.Estos = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' And a.Grupos = b.Codigos And b.ChkLimEsts <> 2 Group by a.Cpros ]

			If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'TmpEst') < 1)
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (TmpEst)')
				Return .F.
			Endif
		Endif

		Select TmpEst
		Scan
			=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',TmpEst.Cpros, [Cpros, Moevs, pvens, fvendas, moepvs, pesoms, custofs, moecusfs, Linhas, cunis, cproeqs, sgrus, mercs,CodFinP])
			=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdLin','CrTmpLin','Linhas',CrTmpPro.Linhas)

			If crSigCdPam.TpPrecos = 1
				m.moeEst = CrTmpPro.Moevs
				m.vlEst  = Round( CrTmpPro.pvens * Iif( CrTmpPro.fvendas # 0 And !IsEmpty( CrTmpPro.moepvs ), CrTmpPro.fvendas, 1 ) , 2 )
				If CrTmpLin.TpVendas = '2'
					m.vlEst = CrTmpPro.Pesoms * m.vlEst
				Endif
			Else
				m.vlEst = CrTmpPro.Custofs
				If CrTmpLin.TpCustos = '2'
					m.vlEst = CrTmpPro.Pesoms * m.vlEst
				Endif
				m.moeEst = CrTmpPro.Moecusfs
			Endif
			m.vlEst = m.vlEst * TmpEst.qtds

			If _MoeLim # m.moeEst
				_Saldo = _Saldo + ( m.vlEst * Thisform.Cotacao( m.moeEst, _pData ) / _CotLim )
			Else
				_Saldo = _Saldo + m.vlEst
			Endif
		Endscan
	Endscan
Endif

llUpdate = .T.

If CrSigCdGcr2.LimCres = 1 Or (CrSigCdGcr2.LimEstoqs = 1 And !IsEmpty( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes ) )

	If _Limite <> 0 And _Saldo = 0
		_Saldo = _Valor
	Endif

	If _Saldo > _Limite And _ValidaLim

		Messagebox( 'O Limite de '+lcTitulo+' da conta de ' + Alltrim( _Tipo ) + ' é de : ' + ;
			Transf( _Limite, '999,999,999.99' ) + ' ' + Alltrim( _MoeLim ) + '. ' + Chr( 13 ) + ;
			'O saldo desta conta somado ao valor ' + Chr( 13 ) + ;
			'da movimentação excedeu o limite de '+lcTitulo+' : ' + ;
			Transf( _Saldo, '999,999,999.99' ) + ' ' + Alltrim( _MoeLim ) + '. ' + Chr( 13 ) , 48, '' )
		Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIMITE', _Conta, ' ', TprMvCab.Numes, _pData, TprMvCab.Emps To _Retorno
		llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )

		If !llOk
			llUpdate = .F.
			Return .F.
		Else
			llUpdate = .T.
		Endif
	Endif

	lcUpdate = [Update SigCdMti set ]+_CmpUp+[ = ]+Alltrim(Str((_Valor + _SaldoMov),13,2))+[ Where cIdChaves = ']+crSigCdMtI.cIdChaves+[']
	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate) < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdMti)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

Endif

Return .T.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE limitecrédito
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE limitecrédito
LParameters _Grupo, _Conta, _Tipo
Local _Limite, _CotLim, _Saldo, _CotSal, _CotPar, _FatConv, _ValorAnt, _ValorMov, _pData, _Matriz

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdGcr', 'crSigCdGcr', 'Codigos', _Grupo)

_Grupo = Iif(Not Empty(crSigCdGcr.GrupoLms),crSigCdGcr.GrupoLms,_Grupo)

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

Select crSigCdGcr

*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Mudanca na busca porque na ROSANA JOIAS o GRUPO+CONTA estava invertido
*=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigClLcr', 'crSigClLcr', 'GruContas', _Grupo + _Conta)

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigClLcr Where Grupos = '] + _Grupo + [' And Contas = '] + _Conta + [' ], [crSigClLcr]) < 1)
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigClLcr)])
	Return 0
EndIf

* Checando o Limite de Crédito da Empresa Matriz de Cobrança
_Matriz = []
ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [LocalMtz], [IClis], _Conta, [ContaMats])
If Not Used([LocalMtz])
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalMtz)])
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In LocalMtz
If Not Eof([LocalMtz]) And Not Empty(LocalMtz.ContaMats)
	_Matriz = LocalMtz.ContaMats
	
	*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Mudanca na busca porque na ROSANA JOIAS o GRUPO+CONTA estava invertido
	*ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigClLcr], [crSigClLcr], [GruContas], _Grupo + _Matriz)
	
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigClLcr Where Grupos = '] + _Grupo + [' And Contas = '] + _Matriz + [' ], [crSigClLcr]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigClLcr)])
		Return 0
	EndIf
	If Not Used([crSigClLcr])
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - crSigClLcr)])
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In crSigClLcr
EndIf

If Empty(_Matriz)
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [LocalContas], [IClis], _Conta, [IClis])
	If Not Used([LocalMtz])
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalMtz)])
		Return 0
	EndIf
Else
	lcQuery = [Select IClis ] + ;
			    [From SigCdCli ] + ;
			   [Where ContaMats = '] + _Matriz + [']

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalContas]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalContas)])
		Return 0
	EndIf
EndIf

If crSigCdGcr.LimCres = 1
	lcTitulo = 'Crédito'
	
	Select crSigClLcr
	Go Top
	_Limite = LimCres
	_MoeLim = Moedas
	_CotLim = ThisForm.Cotacao(Moedas)
	_Saldo = 0

	Select LocalContas
	Scan
		lcSql = [Select a.*, b.ChkLimCrds From SigMvSlc a, SigCdGcr b Where a.Grupos = ']+_Grupo+[' And ]+;
				[Contas = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' And a.Grupos = b.Codigos And b.ChkLimCrds <> 2 ]
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'crSigMvSlc')
	
		Select crSigMvSlc
		Scan
			_CotSal = ThisForm.Cotacao(Moedas)
			If Moedas # crSigClLcr.Moedas
				_Saldo = _Saldo + Round( Saldos * _CotSal / _CotLim, 2 )
			Else
				_Saldo = _Saldo + Saldos 
			EndIf
		Endscan
	EndScan
	
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	_CotSal = ThisForm.Cotacao(crSigCdOpe.Cmoes)

	_ValorAnt = 0
	_FatConv = 1

	If crSigCdOpe.Cmoes # crSigClLcr.Moedas
		_FatConv = _CotSal / _CotLim
	EndIf
	
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvPar','CrPar','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 ))

	Select crPar
	_ValorAnt = 0
	Scan
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',crPar.Fpags)
		If crSigOpFp.ValPends # 1
			Loop
		EndIf
		*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Nao checa o Limite de Credito pela condição de pagamento
		If crSigOpFp.ChkLimCre = 2
			Loop
		EndIf
		_CotPar = ThisForm.Cotacao(Moefpgs)
		_ValorAnt = _ValorAnt + Round( Valos * _CotPar / _CotLim, 2 )
	Endscan

	Select xPar
	_ValorMov = 0
	Scan 
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
		If crSigOpFp.ValPends # 1
			Loop
		EndIf
		*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Nao checa o Limite de Credito pela condição de pagamento
		If crSigOpFp.ChkLimCre = 2
			Loop
		EndIf
		_CotPar = ThisForm.Cotacao(Moefpgs)
		_ValorMov = _ValorMov + Round( Valos * _CotPar / _CotLim, 2 )
	Endscan

	_Saldo = _Saldo + _ValorMov - _ValorAnt

	_chequec = 0
	_chequep = 0
	Select LocalContas
	Scan
		lcQuery = [Select sum(a.valors) as Valors, a.fpags ]+;
					[From SigChe a, SigCdOpt b Where a.GrClis = ']+_Grupo+[' ]+;
			 			[And a.Iclis = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' And a.umovs = b.operacaos And b.tipos='DB' Group By a.Fpags ]

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'Cheques') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Cheques)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf

		Select Cheques
		Scan
			If IsEmpty(fpags)
				_chequep = _chequep + valors
			Else
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
				*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Nao checa o Limite de Credito pela condição de pagamento
				If crSigOpFp.ChkLimCre = 2
					Loop
				EndIf
				If crSigOpFp.valpends # 1
					_chequec = _chequec + valors
				Else
					_chequep = _chequep + valors
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Endscan
		_Chequec = Round( _chequec / _CotLim, 2 )
		_Chequep = Round( _chequep / _CotLim, 2 )

		If crSigCdPam.ChqlCreds
			_Saldo = _Saldo + _Chequec
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf

If crSigCdGcr.LimEstoqs = 1 And !IsEmpty( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes )
	lcTitulo = 'Estoque'
	lcChave  = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)

	_MoeLim = crSigCdPam.MoeLimes
	_CotLim = ThisForm.Cotacao( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes, _pData )

	If crSigCdGcr.LimCres <> 1
		_Limite = 0
		_Saldo  = 0

		Select crSigClLcr
		Scan
			_CotLmc = ThisForm.Cotacao( Moedas, _pData )
			_Limite = _Limite + ( LimCres * Iif(Moedas#_MoeLim,_CotLmc / _CotLim, 1 ) )
		EndScan
	EndIf
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	
	Select LocalContas	
	Scan
		If crSigCdOpe.EstDests = 1
			lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, Sum(a.Sqtds) as Qtds From SigMvEst a, SigCdGcr b ]+;
					   [Where a.Estos = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' And a.Grupos = b.codigos And b.chkLimEsts <> 2 Group by a.Cpros ]

			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrEst') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Estoque)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		
			lcQuery = [Select Cpros, Sum(Qtds*-1) as Qtds ]+; 
					[From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcChave+[' Group By Cpros ]
			
			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrEsti') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Estoque 2)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
	
			Select Cpros, Sum(qtds) as Qtds ;
			  From crEst ;
			 Group By Cpros ;
			 Union All;
			Select Cpros, Sum(Qtds) as Qtds ; 
			  From crTpmMvItn ;
			 Group By Cpros;
			 Union All;
			Select Cpros, Sum(Qtds) as Qtds ; 
			  From crEsti ;
			 Group By Cpros;
			  Into Cursor TmpEst 
		Else
			lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, Sum(a.Sqtds) as Qtds From SigMvEst a, SigCdGcr b ]+;
					[Where a.Estos = '] + LocalContas.IClis + [' And a.Grupos = b.Codigos And b.ChkLimEsts <> 2 Group by a.Cpros ]

			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'TmpEst') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (TmpEst)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	
		Select TmpEst 
		Scan
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',TmpEst.Cpros, [Cpros, Moevs, pvens, fvendas, moepvs, pesoms, custofs, moecusfs, Linhas, cunis, cproeqs, sgrus, mercs,CodFinP])
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdLin','CrTmpLin','Linhas',CrTmpPro.Linhas)

			If crSigCdPam.TpPrecos = 1
				m.moeEst = CrTmpPro.Moevs
				m.vlEst  = Round( CrTmpPro.pvens * Iif( CrTmpPro.fvendas # 0 And !IsEmpty( CrTmpPro.moepvs ), CrTmpPro.fvendas, 1 ) , 2 )
				If CrTmpLin.TpVendas = '2'
					m.vlEst = CrTmpPro.Pesoms * m.vlEst
				EndIf
			Else
				m.vlEst = CrTmpPro.Custofs
				If CrTmpLin.TpCustos = '2'
					m.vlEst = CrTmpPro.Pesoms * m.vlEst
				EndIf
				m.moeEst = CrTmpPro.Moecusfs
			EndIf
			m.vlEst = m.vlEst * TmpEst.Qtds
			
			If _MoeLim # m.MoeEst
				_Saldo = _Saldo + ( m.vlEst * ThisForm.Cotacao( m.moeEst, _pdata ) / _CotLim )
			Else
				_Saldo = _Saldo + m.VlEst
			EndIf
		EndScan
	EndScan
EndIf

If crSigCdGcr.LimCres = 1 Or (crSigCdGcr.LimEstoqs = 1 And !IsEmpty( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes ) )

	If _Saldo > _Limite
	
		Messagebox( 'O Limite de '+lctitulo+' da conta de ' + Alltrim( _Tipo ) + ' é de : ' + ;
						Transf( _Limite, '999,999,999.99' ) + ' ' + Alltrim( _MoeLim ) + '. ' + CHR( 13 ) + ;
						'O saldo desta conta somado ao valor ' + CHR( 13 ) + ;
						'da movimentação excedeu o limite de '+lcTitulo+' : ' + ;
						Transf( _Saldo, '999,999,999.99' ) + ' ' + Alltrim( _MoeLim ) + '. ' + CHR( 13 ) , 48, '' )
		Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIMITE', _Conta, ' ', TprMvCab.Numes, _pdata, TprMvCab.Emps To _Retorno
		llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
		
		If !llOk
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		
		ThisForm.UsuLibs = Substr(_Retorno,2,10)
		
	EndIf

EndIf
Return .t.

ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE limpadt
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE limpadt
Local llOk

llOk = .t.
*!*	lcSql = [Select CidChaves,DataTrans From SigMvCab where EmpDopNums = ']+ListaEest.EmpDopNums+[']
*!*	If Thisform.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpLimpa') < 1
*!*		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão - SigMvCab ')
*!*		llOk = .f.
*!*	Else
*!*		lcSql = [Select * From SigMvEtt Where EmpDopNums = ']+ListaEest.EmpDopNums+[']
*!*		If Thisform.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TprMvCabT') < 1
*!*			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão - SigMvEtt ')
*!*			llOk = .f.
*!*		Else
*!*			Select TmpLimpa
*!*			Go Top
*!*			If IsEmpty(TmpLimpa.DataTrans) And Reccount('TprMvCabT') = 0
*!*				MessageBox('Movimentação Não Transportada!!! ',0+16,'')
*!*				llOk = .f.
*!*			Endif
*!*		EndIf
*!*	EndIf

*!*	If llOk And MessageBox('Confirma limpeza da data de transporte ?',4+32+256,Alltrim(ListaEest.Dopes)+'/'+Str(ListaEest.Numes,6)) = 6
*!*		lcSql = [Update SigMvCab Set DataTrans = Null Where EmpDopNums = ']+ListaEest.EmpDopNums+[']
*!*		If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
*!*			ThisForm.Podatamgr.rollback()
*!*			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão - Update SigMvCab ')
*!*		Else
*!*			lcSql = [Delete From SigMvEtt where EmpDopNums = ']+ListaEest.EmpDopNums+[']
*!*			If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
*!*				ThisForm.Podatamgr.rollback()
*!*				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão - Delete SigMvEtt ')
*!*			Else
*!*				ThisForm.Podatamgr.Commit()
*!*				=fGravarLog('T', ListaEest.Dopes, 'LIMPADT', ListaEest.Emps + '-' + AllTrim(ListaEest.Dopes) + '-' + AllTrim(Str(ListaEest.Numes,6)),Usuar)
*!*			Endif
*!*		EndIf
*!*	EndIf
*!*	Thisform.Pagina.Lista.Grade.SetFocus

lcSql = [Select * From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, 'LocalEestT') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalEestT)')
	llOk = .F.
Endif

If ( Not IsEmpty(crSigMvCab.datatrans) Or Reccount('LocalEestT') > 0 ) And llOk And ( Not Inlist(crSigCdOpe.AltTrans,1,3) Or crSigCdEmp.AltMovTrs#1 )
	llOk = .F.
	If fChecaAcesso(Padl(crSigCdOpe.Ndopes, 8, [0]), [LIMPADTT])
		If Messagebox([Movimentação já transportada. Deseja limpar a data de transporte?],4+32+256,Alltrim(crSigMvCab.Dopes)+'/'+Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6)) = 6
			Replace Datatrans With Null In crSigMvCab
			lcSql = [Update SigMvCab Set DataTrans = Null Where EmpDopNums = ']+crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
				ThisForm.Podatamgr.rollback()
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão - Update SigMvCab ')
			Else
				lcSql = [Delete From SigMvEtt where EmpDopNums = ']+crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
				If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'') < 1
					ThisForm.Podatamgr.rollback()
					=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão - Delete SigMvEtt ')
				Else
					ThisForm.Podatamgr.Commit()
					=fGravarLog('T', crSigMvCab.Dopes, 'LIMPADT', crSigMvCab.Emps + '-' + AllTrim(crSigMvCab.Dopes) + '-' + AllTrim(Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6)),Usuar)
				Endif
				llOk = .T.
			Endif
		Endif
	Else
		Messagebox('Movimentação já transportada !!!',0+48,'Aviso')
	Endif
Endif

Return llOk
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE limparjobs
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE limparjobs
If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 160, 01))) = 1)  && Pasta Job / Filtrar Job por Usuário (Sim / Não)
	lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
			    [From SigClJob ] + ;
			   [Where Usuars = '] + Usuar + [']

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalClJob]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalClJob)])
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select LocalClJob
	Go Top In LocalClJob
	If Not Eof([LocalClJob])
		Scan
			Update ListaEest Set Apagar = 1 Where Jobs = LocalClJob.Jobs
		EndScan
		Delete From ListaEest Where Apagar = 0
	EndIf
	Use In LocalClJob
EndIf

* Richard em 03/09/2014 - Eliminar JOBs de Acesso Restrito da Listagem
Update ListaEest Set Apagar = 1
Select ListaEest
Scan
	If Not fChecaAcessoJOB(Usuar, ListaEest.Jobs, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
		Replace Apagar With 0 In ListaEest
	EndIf
EndScan
Delete From ListaEest Where Apagar = 0
* Fim **************************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE matuvalpres
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE matuvalpres
Local lnRecNo, _Difer, _Porc, _Tipo, _TotPeso, _TotItem, _Cota, _Total, _Itens, lnSinals

If InList( crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3 )
	Select TmpTotal
	Set Order To Moeds
	Scan
		If IsEmpty( Moeds )
			Delete
			Loop
		EndIf
		Replace ValItens With 0
	Endscan

	Select crTpmMvItn
	lnRecNo = Iif( Not Eof() And Not Bof(), RecNo, 0 )
	Scan For Not IsEmpty(Cpros)
		_TotPeso = crTpmMvItn.Fators * crTpmMvItn.Pesos * crTpmMvItn.Qtds
		_TotItem = crTpmMvItn.Totas
		Select TmpTotal
		If _TotPeso # 0 And crSigCdOpe.PesoVts = 1
			If Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.MoeFats) And !Seek( crTpmMvItn.MoeFats )
				Insert Into TmpTotal ( moeds ) Values ( crTpmMvItn.MoeFats )
			EndIf
			Replace ValItens With ValItens + iif(crTpmMvItn.Opers='S',1,-1) * _TotPeso
		EndIf
		If _TotItem # 0
			If Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Moedas) And !Seek( crTpmMvItn.Moedas )
				Insert Into TmpTotal ( moeds ) Values ( crTpmMvItn.Moedas )
			EndIf
			Replace ValItens With ValItens + iif(crTpmMvItn.Opers='S',1,-1) * _TotItem
		EndIf
	Endscan

	Select TmpTotal
	Store 0 To _Total, _Itens
	Scan
		_Cota = ThisForm.Cotacao( TmpTotal.Moeds )
		_Total = _Total + ( TmpTotal.Valtots * _Cota )
		_Itens = _Itens + ( TmpTotal.Valitens * _Cota )
		lnSinals = Iif(crSigCdOpe.Opers # 3, 1, Iif( TmpTotal.ValItens < 0, -1, 1))
		Replace TmpTotal.ValItens With Abs(TmpTotal.ValItens), ;
				TmpTotal.nSinals  With lnSinals
	Endscan
		
	Select TmpTotal
	Scan
		If TmpTotal.ValItens # TmpTotal.ValTots And TmpTotal.ValItens > 0
			If TmpTotal.ValItens > TmpTotal.ValTots
				 _Difer = TmpTotal.ValItens - TmpTotal.ValTots
				 _Porc  = Round(( _Difer / TmpTotal.ValItens) * 100,2)
				 _Tipo  = Iif( TmpTotal.nSinals >=0, "D", "A" )
			Else
				 _Difer = TmpTotal.ValTots - TmpTotal.ValItens
				 _Porc  = Round(( _Difer / TmpTotal.ValItens)*100,2)
				 _Tipo  = Iif( TmpTotal.nSinals >= 0, "A", "D")
			EndIf
			Replace TmpTotal.ValDifs  With _Difer, ;
					TmpTotal.PorcDifs With _Porc, ;
					TmpTotal.Tipos    With _Tipo
		Else
			If TmpTotal.ValItens = 0
				Replace TmpTotal.ValDifs  With TmpTotal.ValTots, ;
						TmpTotal.PorcDifs With 0, ;
						TmpTotal.Tipos    With "A"
			Else
				Replace TmpTotal.ValDifs  With 0, ;
						TmpTotal.PorcDifs With 0, ;
						TmpTotal.Tipos    With " "
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Endscan

	Select crTpmMvItn
	If lnRecNo # 0
		Goto ( lnRecNo )
	EndIf
	
	Select TmpTotal
	Set Order to
EndIf

Return
************* fim ***********
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE mcadautomatico
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE mcadautomatico
LParameters pcCadGrupo, pcCpfs, plAuto

Local lcRetCli, lcMsg, lcCaption, lcCpfs, lnTpClis, lnIClis, lnResposta

lcRetCli  = ''
lcMsg     = ''
lcCaption = ''
lnTpClis  = 0

If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdGcr','CrTmpGccr','Codigos',pcCadGrupo) And CrTmpGccr.TpCods = 1
	lcCpfs = StrTran( pcCpfs, '.', '' )
	lcCpfs = StrTran( lcCpfs, '-', '' )
	lcCpfs = StrTran( lcCpfs, '/', '' )
	lcCpfs = AllTrim( lcCpfs )

	If Len(Alltrim(lcCpfs))<>14
		If fValidarCPF( lcCpfs )
			lnTpClis = 1
			lcCpfs   = Transf(lcCpfs, '@R 999.999.999-99')
		Else
			MessageBox('CPF ' + AllTrim(lcCpfs) + ' Inválido!!! ',0+16,'Cadastro Automático de Contas')
		EndIf
	Else
		If fValidarCNPJ( lcCpfs )
			lnTpClis = 2
			lcCpfs = Transf( lcCpfs, '@R 99.999.999/9999-99' )
		Else
			MessageBox('CNPJ ' + AllTrim(lcCpfs) + ' Inválido!!! ',0+16,'Cadastro Automático de Contas')
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If InList( lnTpClis, 1, 2 )
		If plAuto
			lnResposta = 6
		Else
			lnResposta = MessageBox(iif(lnTpClis = 1,'CPF ','CNPJ ') + AllTrim(lcCpfs) + ;
						 ' Não Está Cadastrado. ' + Chr(13) + 'Deseja Cadastrá-lo ? ', ;
						 32+4, 'Cadastro Automático de Contas')
		EndIf
		If lnResposta = 6					 
			If CrTmpGccr.TpEmps = 1
				lnIclis = fGerUniqueKey( AllTrim( CrTmpGccr.Codigos ) + TprMvCab.Emps )
				lcIclis = AllTrim( CrTmpGccr.DgCods + TprMvCab.Emps + PadL( lnIclis, 6, '0' ) )
			Else
				lnIclis = fGerUniqueKey( AllTrim( CrTmpGccr.Codigos ) )
				lcIclis = AllTrim( CrTmpGccr.DgCods + PadL( lnIclis, 9, '0' ) )
			EndIf
			_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
			Insert Into crSigCdCli (Iclis, Cpfs, Usuars, TpCads, Grupos, DataIncs, TpClis, NClis, DtAlts) ;
					Values ( lcIclis, lcCpfs, Usuar, CrTmpGccr.TpCads, pcCadGrupo, _pData, ;
							 lnTpClis, lnIClis, _pData )
			lcRetCli = lcIclis

			m.Retorno = ThisForm.poDataMgr3.UpDate('crSigCdCli')
			IF !m.Retorno
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdCli ')
				ThisForm.poDataMgr3.RollBack()
				lcRetCli = ' '
			EndIf
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr3.Commit() < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Commit 3)')
				ThisForm.poDataMgr3.RollBack()
				lcRetCli = ' '
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	If Eof('crTmpGccr')
		lcMsg     = 'Grupo de Conta ' + AllTrim(pcCadGrupo) + ' Inválido ... ' + Chr(13) + ;
			        'Contate o Suporte Técnico.'
		lcCaption = 'Erro: Cadastro Inconsistente'
	Else
		lcMsg     = 'Configuração do Grupo de Conta ' + AllTrim(pcCadGrupo) + ' Incorreto ... ' + Chr(13) + ;
			        'Contate o Suporte Técnico.'
		lcCaption = 'Erro: Código de Conta Precisa Ser Automático'
	EndIf
EndIf

If Not IsEmpty(lcMsg)
	MessageBox(lcMsg, 48, lcCaption)
EndIf
Return( lcRetCli )

***************** fim *****************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE montahists
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE montahists
Lparameters pTit, pFpg, pCli

Local lcHis, lcTit, lcFpg, lcCli

lcTit = Iif(Type([pTit])=[C], pTit, Titulos)
lcFpg = Iif(Type([pFpg])=[C], pFpg, [])
lcCli = Iif(Type([pCli])=[C], pCli, [])

lcHis = []
If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Hists)
	lcHis = lcHis + Alltrim(crSigCdOpe.Hists) + [ ]
EndIf

If (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 5) And ThisForm.MultEmps
	lcHis = lcHis + Alltrim(Emps) + [ ]
EndIf

Do Case
	Case (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 1) && NF
		lcHis = lcHis + Iif(Empty(Notas), [SEM DOCUMENTO], Alltrim(Notas))

	Case (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 2) && Título
		lcHis = lcHis + Iif(Empty(lcTit), [SEM DOCUMENTO], Alltrim(lcTit)) + [/] + Alltrim(Str(ThisForm.ContaPar))

	Case (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 3) && Movimentação
		lcHis = lcHis + fGerMascara(Numes)

	Case (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 5) && Movimentação Detalhada
		lcHis = lcHis + Alltrim(Dopes) + [ ] + Alltrim(fGerMascara(Numes)) + [ ] + ;
						Iif(Empty(lcFpg), [], [(] + Alltrim(crSigOpFp.FPags) + [) ]) + ;
						Alltrim(lcCli)

	Case (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 6) && Conta
		lcCta = Iif(crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1, TprMvCab.ContaOs, TprMvCab.ContaDs)

		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli', 'crTmpCli', 'Iclis', lcCta, [IClis, RClis])
		lcHis = lcHis + Alltrim(crTmpCli.RClis) + [ (] + Alltrim(crTmpCli.IClis) + [)]
		
	CASE (crSigCdOpe.TpHists = 7) && Observação - Julian - 29/07/2017 - Exclusivo Monte Carlo
		lcHis = lcHis + ALLTRIM(TprMvCab.Obses)
		
EndCase

Return lcHis
* Fim **************************************************************************************
ENDPROC

PROCEDURE montaobs
Lparameters pCnx

Local lcMsg

Replace CodObs With crObs.Codigos In TprMvCab

EndIf
* Fim **************************************************************************************
