------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE mostrapends
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE mostrapends
Parameters _Grupo, _Conta

Local _Msg, lcCaption

If IsEmpty(_Conta)
	Return
EndIf

Wait Window 'Verificando Pendências...' Nowait

_AliasOrig = Select()

Select TprMvCab
_OrdPend = Order()
_posicao = emps + Dopes + str( numes, 6 )
_ChaveCli = _Grupo + _Conta
_Cliente  = _Conta
Store .F. To _Devolvido, _Estoque, _ConsertoPronto, _ConsertoFornecedor, _ConsertoPendente, _DevolvidoPendente, llChqDevol
Store 0 To _nDevolvido, _nEstoque, _nConsertoPronto, _nConsertoFornecedor, _nConsertoPendente, _nDevolvidoPendente


=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigOpCdd],[crSigOpCdd],[Dopes],TprMvCab.Dopes)
If Type([crSigOpCdd.chqDevol])=[N] And crSigOpCdd.chqDevol = 1
	llChqDevol = .T.
EndIf 

lcWhere = [Select a.Nums, Sum(1) as TotDevs From SigChe a, SigCqChm b, SigCdOpt c ]+;
		[Where a.GrClis = ']+_Grupo+[' And a.Iclis = ']+_Conta+[' And a.Nums = b.Nums ]+;
		[And b.Codigos = c.Operacaos And c.Devolvidos = 'S' Group By a.Nums ]

lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'TmpDevolvidos')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (TmpDevolvidos)')
	Return .f.
EndIf
Select TmpDevolvidos
go top
Sum(TotDevs) to _nDevolvido

If _nDevolvido > 0 And llChqDevol
	_Devolvido  = .T.
EndIf

lcwhere = [Select a.Umovs, a.Nums From SigChe a, SigCdOpt b Where a.Grclis = ']+_Grupo+[' And a.Iclis = ']+_Conta+[' ]+;
		[And a.Umovs = b.Operacaos And b.Devolvidos = 'S' ]

lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'TmpDevPend')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (TmpDevPend)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select TmpDevPend
Scan
	_DevolvidoPendente  = .T.
	_nDevolvidoPendente = _nDevolvidoPendente + 1
EndScan

lcQuery = [Select Grupos, Sum(Sqtds) As sQtds From SigMvEst Where Grupos = ']+_Grupo+[' ]+;
		[ And Estos = ']+_Conta+[' Group by Grupos ]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crEst') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrEst)')
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select crEst
Go Top
_nEstoque = Sqtds
_Estoque = ( Sqtds # 0 )

Select crSigCdPam
Go Top

If !Empty(crSigCdPam.OpConsers)
	llSubn = .f.
	lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvCab Where Dopes = ']+crSigCdPam.OpConsers+[' And Grupoos = ']+_Grupo+[' And Contaos = ']+_Conta+[' And ChkSubn = ?llSubn ]
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crEest') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrEest 2)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	
	Select CrEest
	Scan
		_ChaveEmp = Emps 
		_ChaveNum = Str( Numes , 6 )
		Do Case 
			Case ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvCab','EmpDopNums',_ChaveEmp + crSigCdPam.OpConRClis + _ChaveNum )
			Case ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvCab','EmpDopNums',_ChaveEmp + crSigCdPam.OpConRFors + _ChaveNum )
				_ConsertoPronto = .T.
				_nConsertoPronto = _nConsertoPronto + 1
			Case ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvCab','EmpDopNums',_ChaveEmp + crSigCdPam.OpConFors + _ChaveNum )
				_ConsertoFornecedor = .T.
				_nConsertoFornecedor = _nConsertoFornecedor + 1
		Other
			_ConsertoPendente = .T.
			_nConsertoPendente = _nConsertoPendente + 1
		EndCase
	EndScan
EndIf

ok = .t.
If crSigCdPam.BloqCheqs And _DevolvidoPendente
	Do Form SigOpSen With 'CHDEVOLVIDO', _nDevolvidoPendente, _Grupo + ' / ' + _Conta To _Retorno
	ok = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
EndIf
Select TprMvCab

Wait Clear 
If !ok
	Select Int( _AliasOrig )
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcCaption = AllTrim( _Grupo ) + ' / ' + AllTrim( _Conta ) + ;
			Iif( ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',_Conta,[rclis]), AllTrim(crtmpCli.Rclis), '' )
_Msg = 'Esta conta possui : ' + Chr( 13 ) + Chr( 13 )
If _Devolvido
	_Msg = _Msg + Alltrim( Str( _nDevolvido, 6 ) )+ ;
			' cheque' + Iif( _nDevolvido>1,'s','' ) + ;
			' devolvido' + Iif( _nDevolvido>1,'s','' )
	If _nDevolvidoPendente # 0
		If _nDevolvido = _nDevolvidoPendente
			_Msg = _Msg + ' e pendente' + Iif( _nDevolvido>1,'s.','.' )
		Else
			_Msg = _Msg + ', sendo ' + Alltrim( Str( _nDevolvidoPendente, 6 ) )+ ;
					' pendente' + Iif( _nDevolvido>1,'s.','.' )
		EndIf
	Else
		_Msg = _Msg + '.'
	EndIf
	_Msg = _Msg + Chr( 13 )
EndIf
If _Estoque
	_Msg = _Msg + Alltrim( Str( _nEstoque, 6 ) )+ ;
			' peça' + Iif( _nEstoque>1,'s','' ) + ;
			' em seu estoque.' + Chr( 13 )
EndIf
If _ConsertoPendente
	_Msg = _Msg + Alltrim( Str( _nConsertoPendente, 6 ) )+ ;
			' conserto' + Iif( _nConsertoPendente>1,'s','' ) + ;
			' pendente' + Iif( _nConsertoPendente>1,'s.','.' ) + Chr( 13 )
EndIf
If _ConsertoFornecedor
	_Msg = _Msg + Alltrim( Str( _nConsertoFornecedor, 6 ) )+ ;
			' conserto' + Iif( _nConsertoFornecedor>1,'s','' ) + ;
			' em fornecedores.' + Chr( 13 )
EndIf
If _ConsertoPronto
	_Msg = _Msg + Alltrim( Str( _nConsertoPronto, 6 ) )+ ;
			' conserto' + Iif( _nConsertoPronto>1,'s','' ) + ;
			' pronto' + Iif( _nConsertoPronto>1,'s.','.' ) + Chr( 13 )
EndIf
_Msg = _Msg + Chr( 13 ) + 'Verifique maiores detalhes na Pesquisa Global de Vendas...'
If _Devolvido Or _Estoque Or _ConsertoPronto Or _ConsertoFornecedor Or _ConsertoPendente
	=MessageBox( _Msg, 48, lcCaption )
EndIf

Select Int( _AliasOrig )
Return .t.
************* fim *******************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE procrateio
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE procrateio
Lparameters pArqCab, pArqIte, pArqNf

Local totite,totent,totsai, __ordem, lServcIt, pnVlRat, xVlr
Store 0 to TotIte, TotEnt, TotSai, lnVlRat, xVlr
pCnx = ThisForm.poDataMgr

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde.'
Else
	WAIT Windows 'Aguarde... Executando rateio dos itens!!!' Nowait
EndIf
pArqCab = Iif(Type('pArqCab')=[C],pArqCab,[TprMvCab])
pArqIte = Iif(Type('pArqIte')=[C],pArqIte,[crTpmMvItn])
pArqNf  = Iif(Type('pArqNf') =[C],pArqNf ,[crSigMvNfi])

=pCnx.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','Dopes',&pArqCab..Dopes)

IF crSigCdOpe.Vars <> 1 And &pArqCab..ValVars = 0
	Return
EndIf

ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','crTmpCfo','Codigos',&pArqNf..cFis)

lnttvl = &pArqCab..Valos - &pArqNf..VlFretes - &pArqNf..Vlseguros - &pArqNf..DespAces - ;
		 &pArqNf..ValIpis - &pArqNf..IcmsS - Iif(CrTmpCfo.IncIcmNfs = 1,&pArqNf..ValIcms,0) 

lServcit = .f.
If InList(crSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
	lcSerie = &pArqNf..Series
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','crTmpSerie','EmpCods',&pArqCab..Emps + lcSerie)
	If Eof('crTmpSerie')
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','crTmpSerie','EmpCods',Space(3) + lcSerie)
	EndIf
	If CrTmpSerie.TpServicos = 3
		lnttvl = lnttvl - &pArqNf..VTotSers
		lServcit = .t.
	EndIf
EndIf

lnTtFn = 0
llTemRat = .f.
Select &pArqIte.
__ordem = Order()
Set Order To
Scan
	If IsEmpty(Cpros)
		Loop
	EndIf
		
	lcSql = [Select ClFiscals From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+&pArqIte..Cpros+[']
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro')

	If !Seek( &pArqIte..moefats, "TmpCot" )
       	cotacaof = fBuscarCotacao(&pArqIte..MoeFats,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), pCnx)
		Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( &pArqIte..moefats, Cotacaof )
 	Else
		Cotacaof = TmpCot.Valos
	EndIf

	_Converte = .f.
	If Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes )
		If !Seek( crSigCdPam.Moedaps, "TmpCot" )
			CotCv = fBuscarCotacao(crSigCdPam.Moedaps,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), pCnx)
			Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( crSigCdPam.Moedaps, Cotcv )
		Else
			Cotcv = TmpCot.Valos
		EndIf
		_Converte = .t.
	EndIf

	If !Seek( &pArqIte..moedas, "TmpCot" )
		Cotacao = fBuscarCotacao(&pArqIte..Moedas,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), pCnx)
		Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( &pArqIte..moedas, Cotacao )
	Else
		Cotacao = TmpCot.Valos
	EndIf

	totite = 0
	If crSigCdOpe.PesoVts = 1
		totite = totite + ( &pArqIte..tpesos * Iif( _Converte, Cotacaof / Cotcv, 1 ) )
	EndIf
	If crSigCdOpe.PrecoVts = 1
		totite = totite + ( &pArqIte..totas * Iif( _Converte, Cotacao / Cotcv, 1 ) )
	EndIf

	Ret = .t.
	If InList(crSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
		If IsEmpty( StrTran( LocalPro.ClFiscals, '.', '' ) )
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
	Else
		IF &pArqIte..Utilizas > 9 And &pArqIte..Utilizas <> 14  &&Preco alterado
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
		IF Ret AND crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 AND &pArqIte..Opers = 'E'
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
		IF Ret AND Not IsEmpty(&pArqIte..Notas) And IsEmpty(&pArqIte..CodBarras)
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf

	IF NOT Ret And crSigCdOpe.CupFis <> 1
		lnttvl = lnttvl - totite
	Else
		llTemRat = .t.
		If &pArqIte..opers = "S"
			totsai = totsai + totite
		else
			totent = totent + totite
		EndIf
	EndIf

	lnTtFn = lnTtFn + (totIte * Iif(&pArqIte..Opers='E',1,-1))

EndScan
Set Order to &__Ordem
lnItem = Abs( round(totsai - totent,2) )
pnRateioItem = IIF(lnItem=0,1,( lnTtVl / LnItem )) &&abs
If Not llTemRat
	lnttvl = &pArqCab..Valos - &pArqNf..VlFretes - &pArqNf..Vlseguros - &pArqNf..DespAces - &pArqNf..ValIpis - &pArqNf..IcmsS 
	If lServcit
		lnttvl = lnttvl - &pArqNf..VTotSers
	EndIf
	pnRateioItem = IIF(lnTtFn=0,1,( lnTtVl / Abs(lnTtFn) ))
EndIf

pnVlRat = Abs(lnTtfn) - lnTtVl

SELECT &pArqIte.
_TemItens = .f.
Scan
	lcSql = [Select ClFiscals From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+&pArqIte..Cpros+[']
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro')

	_Rat = .t.
	If InList(crSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
		If IsEmpty( StrTran( LocalPro.ClFiscals, '.', '' ) )
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
	Else
		IF &pArqIte..Utilizas > 9 And &pArqIte..Utilizas <> 14  &&Preco alterado
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
		IF _Rat AND crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 AND &pArqIte..Opers = 'E'
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
		IF _Rat AND Not IsEmpty(&pArqIte..Notas) And IsEmpty(&pArqIte..CodBarras)
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
	IF _Rat Or crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 Or Not llTemRat
		if crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos = 4			&& Mena - 08/2012 considera o rateio da mesma forma que o calculo do preço
			Replace &pArqIte..Unit2s  WITH &pArqIte..Units * pnRateioItem,;
					&pArqIte..ValRats WITH (((&pArqIte..Units * pnRateioItem) - &pArqIte..Units) * &pArqIte..Qtds * &pArqIte..pesos)
		ELSE
			*** Mena - 01/03/2018 - arredonda para duas casas o rateio do desconto ***
			Replace &pArqIte..Unit2s  WITH ROUND(&pArqIte..Units * pnRateioItem,2),;
					&pArqIte..ValRats WITH ((&pArqIte..Unit2s - &pArqIte..Units) * &pArqIte..Qtds)
		ENDIF
	Else
		Replace &pArqIte..Unit2s  WITH &pArqIte..Units,;
				&pArqIte..ValRats WITH 0
	EndIf
	If !Seek( &pArqIte..moefats, "TmpCot" )
       	cotacaof = fBuscarCotacao(&pArqIte..MoeFats,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), pCnx)
		Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( &pArqIte..moefats, Cotacaof )
 	Else
		Cotacaof = TmpCot.Valos
	EndIf

	_Converte = .f.
	If Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes )
		If !Seek( crSigCdPam.Moedaps, "TmpCot" )
			CotCv = fBuscarCotacao(crSigCdPam.Moedaps,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), pCnx)
			Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( crSigCdPam.Moedaps, Cotcv )
		Else
			Cotcv = TmpCot.Valos
		EndIf
		_Converte = .t.
	EndIf

	If !Seek( &pArqIte..moedas, "TmpCot" )
		Cotacao = fBuscarCotacao(&pArqIte..Moedas,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), pCnx)
		Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( &pArqIte..moedas, Cotacao )
	Else
		Cotacao = TmpCot.Valos
	EndIf

	pnVlRat = pnVlRat + ( &pArqIte..ValRats * Iif( _Converte, Cotacao / Cotcv, 1 ) )

	_TemItens = .t.
EndScan
If pnVlRat <> 0 And _TemItens
	Go bott
	If Empty(Cpros)
		Skip -1
	EndIf
	Replace Valrats With ValRats - pnVlRat in &pArqIte.
EndIf

RETURN .t.
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE procrateio2
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE procrateio2
Lparameters pArqCab, pArqIte, pArqNf

Local totite,totent,totsai, __ordem, lServcIt, pnVlRat, xVlr
Store 0 to TotIte, TotEnt, TotSai, lnVlRat, xVlr
pCnx = ThisForm.poDataMgr

If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
	ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde....'
Else
	WAIT Windows 'Aguarde... Executando rateio Frete + Seguro!!!' Nowait
EndIf

pArqCab = Iif(Type('pArqCab')=[C],pArqCab,[TprMvCab])
pArqIte = Iif(Type('pArqIte')=[C],pArqIte,[crTpmMvItn])
pArqNf  = Iif(Type('pArqNf') =[C],pArqNf ,[crSigMvNfi])

=pCnx.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','Dopes',&pArqCab..Dopes)

Select &pArqIte.
__ordem = Order()
Set Order To
Sum Totas   to lnttvl
Sum ValIpis to lnttvipi
Sum ((AliqIcms * BaseIcms) / 100 ) to lnttvicm

lnTtFr = &pArqNf..VlFretes
lnSmfr = 0 

lnDif1 = &pArqNf..VlFretes
lnDif2 = &pArqNf..VlSeguros
lnDif3 = &pArqNf..DespAces
lnUltRg = 0
lnDifFr1 = 0.01
lnDifFr2 = 0.02

Scan
	If IsEmpty(Cpros)
		Loop
	EndIf
	lntt1 = 0
	lntt2 = 0
	lntt3 = 0
	If &pArqNf..VlFretes <> 0 And lnttvl <> 0
		lntt1 = ( &pArqIte..totas / lnttvl * &pArqNf..VlFretes )
	EndIf
	If &pArqNf..VlSeguros <> 0 And lnttvl <> 0
		lntt2 = ( &pArqIte..totas / lnttvl * &pArqNf..VlSeguros )
	EndIf
	If &pArqNf..DespAces <> 0 And lnttvl <> 0
		lntt3 = ( &pArqIte..totas / lnttvl * &pArqNf..DespAces )
	EndIf
	
	lnSmfr = lnSmfr + Round(lntt1,2)
	If abs(lnTtFr - lnSmfr) = lnDifFr1
		If lnSmfr > lnTtFr
			lntt1 = lntt1 - lnDifFr1
			lntt1 = Round(lntt1,2)
		Else
			lntt1 = lntt1 + lnDifFr1
			lntt1 = Round(lntt1,2)
		EndIf 
	EndIf 
	
	If abs(lnTtFr - lnSmfr) = lnDifFr2
		If lnSmfr > lnTtFr
			lntt1 = lntt1 - lnDifFr2
			lntt1 = Round(lntt1,2)
		Else
			lntt1 = lntt1 + lnDifFr2
			lntt1 = Round(lntt1,2)
		EndIf 
	EndIf 
	
	Replace RatFrts With lntt1 ,;
			RatSegs With lntt2 ,;
			RatDacs With lntt3 In &pArqIte.

	lnDif1 = lnDif1 - &pArqIte..RatFrts
	lnDif2 = lnDif2 - &pArqIte..RatSegs
	lnDif3 = lnDif3 - &pArqIte..RatDacs

EndScan
Go bottom
Replace RatFrts With RatFrts + lnDif1,;
		RatSegs With RatSegs + lnDif2,;
		RatDacs With RatDacs + lnDif3  In &pArqIte.

lnDif1 = &pArqNf..FrtIpis + &pArqNf..VlFretes
lnDif2 = &pArqNf..SegIpis + &pArqNf..VlSeguros
lnDif3 = &pArqNf..DesIpis + &pArqNf..DespAces
lnUltRg = 0
Scan
	lntt1 = 0
	lntt2 = 0
	lntt3 = 0
	If &pArqIte..Valipis <> 0 And lnttvIPI <> 0
		lnUltRg = Recno('&pArqIte.')
		lntt1 = ( &pArqIte..ValIpis / lnttvipi * &pArqNf..FrtIpis )
		lntt2 = ( &pArqIte..ValIpis / lnttvipi * &pArqNf..SegIpis )
		lntt3 = ( &pArqIte..ValIpis / lnttvipi * &pArqNf..DesIpis )
	EndIf
	Replace RatFrts With RatFrts + lntt1 ,;
			RatSegs With RatSegs + lntt2 ,;
			RatDacs With RatDacs + lntt3 In &pArqIte.
	lnDif1 = lnDif1 - &pArqIte..RatFrts
	lnDif2 = lnDif2 - &pArqIte..RatSegs
	lnDif3 = lnDif3 - &pArqIte..RatDacs
EndScan
Go bottom
If lnUltRg <> 0
	Locate for Recno() = lnUltRg
EndIf
Replace RatFrts With RatFrts + lnDif1,;
		RatSegs With RatSegs + lnDif2,;
		RatDacs With RatDacs + lnDif3 In &pArqIte.

lnDif1 = &pArqNf..FrtIcms + &pArqNf..SegIcms
lnDif2 = &pArqNf..FrtIcms + &pArqNf..SegIcms
lnDif3 = &pArqNf..DesIcms
lnDif4 = &pArqNf..DesIcms
lnUltRg = 0
Scan
	lntt1 = 0
	lntt2 = 0
	_ValIcms = ((AliqIcms * BaseIcms) / 100 )
	If _ValIcms <> 0 And lnttvIcm <> 0
		lnUltRg = Recno('&pArqIte.')
		lntt1 = ( _ValIcms / lnttvIcm * lnDif2 )
		lntt2 = ( _ValIcms / lnttvIcm * lnDif3 )
	EndIf

	Replace RatIcms  With lntt1 ,;
			RatIcmDs With lntt2 In &pArqIte.

	lnDif1 = lnDif1 - &pArqIte..RatIcms
	lnDif4 = lnDif4 - &pArqIte..RatIcmDs

	If crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1

		lcSql = [Select b.Colunas From SigCdPro a, SigCdIcm b Where a.cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[' And a.SitTrIcms = b.Codigos ]
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrTmpTrIcm')

		lnBase = Round(crTpmMvItn.Qtds * crTpmMvItn.Units,2)
		Replace BaseIpi3s With lnBase In crTpmMvItn
		Do Case
			Case Val(CrTmpTrIcm.Colunas) = 1
				Replace BaseIcms  With Round(lnBase+crTpmMvItn.ValRats,2) In crTpmMvItn

			Case Val(CrTmpTrIcm.Colunas) = 2
				Replace BaseIcm2s  With Round(lnBase+crTpmMvItn.ValRats,2) In crTpmMvItn

			Case Val(CrTmpTrIcm.Colunas) = 3
				Replace BaseIcm3s  With Round(lnBase+crTpmMvItn.ValRats,2) In crTpmMvItn

		EndCase
	EndIf
EndScan
Go bottom
If lnUltRg <> 0
	Locate for Recno() = lnUltRg
EndIf
Replace RatIcms  With RatIcms  + lnDif1 ,;
		RatIcmDs with RatIcmDs + lnDif4 In &pArqIte.

Select &pArqIte.
Set Order to &__Ordem
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE retornalimitecreditomatriz
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE retornalimitecreditomatriz
Lparameters _Grupo, _Conta, _GrupoEm, _ContaEm, _Tipo, _pCursor
Local _Limite, _CotLim, _Saldo, _CotSal, _CotPar, _FatConv, _ValorAnt, _ValorMov, _pData, _Matriz, _pAno, _pMes, _Campo, _CmpUp

=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdGcr', 'crSigCdGcr2', 'Codigos', _Grupo)

_pCursor = Iif(Type([_pCursor])=[C] And Not Empty(_pCursor),_pCursor,[TprMvCab])

_Grupo = Iif(Not Empty(CrSigCdGcr2.GrupoLms),CrSigCdGcr2.GrupoLms,_Grupo)

_pData = &_pCursor..DataS &&crSigMvCcr.vencs
_pAno  = Str(Year(_pData),4)
_pMes  = Padl(Month(_pData),2,'0')
_cMes  = Alltrim(Str(Month(_pData)))
_Valor = &_pCursor..Valos

_SaldoMov = 0
_MoeMov = []

lcQuery = [Select Ano, replicate('0',2-len(ltrim(rtrim(Mes))))+ltrim(rtrim(Mes)) as Mes, ] + ;
	[ GruposEmt, ContasEmt, GruposCC, ContasCC, Cmoes, sum(valos) as Valos ] + ;
	[ from( ] + ;
	[ select a.limcres, a.dopes, b.GruposEmt, b.ContasEmt, month(datas) as mes, year(datas) as ano, ] + ;
	[ case when c.grupoccs = space(10) then b.GruposCC else c.grupoccs end as GruposCC, ] + ;
	[ case when c.contaccs = space(10) then b.ContasCC else c.contaccs end as ContasCC, ] + ;
	[ c.datas, a.Cmoes, c.valos ] + ;
	[ from sigcdope a ] + ;
	[ join sigopcdd b on a.dopes = b.dopes ] + ;
	[ join sigmvcab c on a.dopes = c.dopes ] + ;
	[ where a.limcres in(7) and c.valos <> 0 ) a ] + ;
	[ Where 0=0 ] + ;
	[ And Ano = ']+_pAno+[' and Mes = ']+_cMes+[' ] + ;
	[ and GruposCC = ']+_Grupo+[' and ContasCC = ']+_Conta+[' ] + ;
	[ And GruposEmt = ']+_GrupoEm+[' and ContasEmt = ']+_ContaEm+[' ] + ;
	[ group by GruposEmt, ContasEmt, mes, ano, GruposCC, ContasCC, Cmoes ]

If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crSldMov]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSldMov)])
	Return .F.
Endif

_SaldoMov = crSldMov.Valos
_MoeMov = crSldMov.Cmoes

_Campo = []
_CmpUp = []

Do Case
Case _pMes = '01'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Jan As LimCres, a.Acm_Jan As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Jan '
Case _pMes = '02'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Fev As LimCres, a.Acm_Fev As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Fev '
Case _pMes = '03'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Mar As LimCres, a.Acm_Mar As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Mar '
Case _pMes = '04'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Abr As LimCres, a.Acm_Abr As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Abr '
Case _pMes = '05'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Mai As LimCres, a.Acm_Mai As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Mai '
Case _pMes = '06'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Jun As LimCres, a.Acm_Jun As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Jun '
Case _pMes = '07'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Jul As LimCres, a.Acm_Jul As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Jul '
Case _pMes = '08'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Ago As LimCres, a.Acm_Ago As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Ago '
Case _pMes = '09'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Set As LimCres, a.Acm_Set As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Set '
Case _pMes = '10'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Out As LimCres, a.Acm_Out As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Out '
Case _pMes = '11'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Nov As LimCres, a.Acm_Nov As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Nov '
Case _pMes = '12'
	_Campo = ' ,a.Val_Dez As LimCres, a.Acm_Dez As Saldos '
	_CmpUp = ' Acm_Dez '
Endcase

Select CrSigCdGcr2

lcQuery = [Select a.cidchaves, a.codigo, a.grupos, a.contas, b.sgrupos, b.scontas, b.Ano, b.moeda ] +_Campo+ ;
	[From SigCdMtI a ] + ;
	[join SigCdMtz b on a.codigo = b.codigo ] + ;
	[Where b.Inativas = 0 And b.ano = ']+_pAno+[' and b.sgrupos = ']+_Grupo+[' and b.scontas = ']+_Conta+[' ] + ;
	[And Grupos = ']+_GrupoEm+[' and Contas = ']+_ContaEm+[' ]


If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crSigCdMtI]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigCdMtI)])
	Return .F.
Endif

Select crSigCdMtI
If Empty(_SaldoMov)
	_SaldoMov = crSigCdMtI.Saldos
	_MoeMov = crSigCdMtI.Moeda
Endif

* Checando o Limite de Crédito da Empresa Matriz de Cobrança
_Matriz = []
Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [LocalMtz], [IClis], _Conta, [ContaMats])
If Not Used([LocalMtz])
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalMtz)])
	Return .F.
Endif
Go Top In LocalMtz
If Not Eof([LocalMtz]) And Not Empty(LocalMtz.ContaMats)
	_Matriz = LocalMtz.ContaMats

	lcQuery = [Select a.cidchaves, a.codigo, a.grupos, a.contas, b.sgrupos, b.scontas, b.Ano, b.moeda ] + _Campo + ;
		[From SigCdMtI a ] + ;
		[join SigCdMtz b on a.codigo = b.codigo ] + ;
		[Where b.ano = ']+_pAno+[' and b.sgrupos = ']+_Grupo+[' and b.scontas = ']+_Matriz+[' ] + ;
		[And Grupos = ']+_GrupoEm+[' and Contas = ']+_ContaEm+[' ]

	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crSigCdMtI]) < 1)
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigCdMtI)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
	If Not Used([crSigCdMtI])
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - crSigCdMtI)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
	Go Top In crSigCdMtI
Endif

If Empty(_Matriz)
	Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigCdCli], [LocalContas], [IClis], _Conta, [IClis])
	If Not Used([LocalMtz])
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (CursorQuery - LocalMtz)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
Else
	lcQuery = [Select IClis ] + ;
		[From SigCdCli ] + ;
		[Where ContaMats = '] + _Matriz + [']

	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalContas]) < 1)
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalContas)])
		Return .F.
	Endif
Endif

If CrSigCdGcr2.LimCres = 1
	Select crSigCdMtI
	Go Top

	_Saldo = 0
	_Limite = LimCres
	If Empty(_Limite)
		_Limite = 0.01
	Endif

	_MoeLim = Moeda
	_CotLim = Thisform.Cotacao(_MoeLim)

	_CotSal = Thisform.Cotacao(_MoeMov)
	If _MoeMov # crSigCdMtI.Moeda
		_Saldo = _Saldo + Round( _SaldoMov * _CotSal / _CotLim, 2 )
	Else
		_Saldo = _Saldo + _SaldoMov
	Endif

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	If crSigCdOpe.Cmoes # crSigCdMtI.Moeda
		_CotMov = Thisform.Cotacao(crSigCdOpe.Cmoes)
		_Valor =  Round( _Valor * _CotMov / _CotLim, 2 )
	Endif

*!*		=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvPar','CrPar','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 ))
*!*		Select crPar
*!*		_ValorAnt = 0
*!*		Scan
*!*			=Thisform.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',crPar.Fpags)
*!*			If crSigOpFp.ValPends # 1
*!*				Loop
*!*			Endif
*!*			*--Rafael - 30/06/2016 - Nao checa o Limite de Credito pela condição de pagamento
*!*			If crSigOpFp.ChkLimCre = 2
*!*				Loop
*!*			Endif
*!*			If Moefpgs # crSigCdMtI.Moeda
*!*				_CotPar = Thisform.Cotacao(Moefpgs)
*!*				_ValorAnt = _ValorAnt + Round( Valos * _CotPar / _CotLim, 2 )
*!*			Endif
*!*		Endscan
*!*		_Saldo = _Saldo + _Valor - _ValorAnt
	
Endif

If CrSigCdGcr2.LimCres = 1 Or (CrSigCdGcr2.LimEstoqs = 1 And !IsEmpty( crSigCdPam.MoeLimes ) )

	lcUpdate = [Update SigCdMti set ]+_CmpUp+[ = ]+_CmpUp+[-]+Alltrim(Str(_Valor,13,2))+[ Where cIdChaves = ']+crSigCdMtI.cIdChaves+[']
	If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpdate) < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdMti)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

Endif
Return .T.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE selecionatabd
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE selecionatabd
lcQuery = [Select a.* From SigOpTdz a, SigOpTdo b Where b.Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' And a.Codigos = b.Tabds And (a.DtTerms is null or a.DtTerms >= getdate()) ]
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigOpTdz')

Select * From crSigOpTdz Where (IsEmpty(DtTerms) Or DtTerms >= TprMvCab.Datas) ;
Into Cursor csSigOpTdz
Select csSigOpTdz
Goto Top
If Eof()
	lcQuery = [Select a.*,b.Padraos From SigOpTdz a, SigOpTde b ]+;
			[Where a.Codigos = b.CodtabDs And (a.DtTerms is null or a.DtTerms >= getdate()) And b.Emps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' ]

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigOpTdz')

	Select * From crSigOpTdz Where (IsEmpty(DtTerms) Or DtTerms >= TprMvCab.Datas) ;
	Into Cursor csSigOpTdz
	Select csSigOpTdz
	Goto Top
	If Eof()
		lcQuery = [Select *, 0 as Padraos From SigOpTdz Where 0=0 And (DtTerms is null or DtTerms >= getdate()) ]
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigOpTdz')
		Select * From crSigOpTdz Where ( IsEmpty(DtTerms) Or DtTerms >= TprMvCab.Datas ) ;
		Into Cursor csSigOpTdz
	EndIf
EndIf

Select csSigOpTdz
Index On Codigos Tag Codigos
************** fim *************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE sqldados
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE sqldados
Private pVdr, lcEDNss

pVdr = 'ZZZZZZZZZZ'

ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.btnAguarde.Visible = .t.
ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.btnAguarde.Refresh
ThisForm.Draw

llDatai = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Dt_inicial.Value
llDataf = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Dt_final.Value
llDatai = fDtoSQL(llDatai)
llDataf = fDtoSQL(llDataf,'23:59:59')
lcEmpr  = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Get_cd_empresa.Value

If ThisForm._pconsulta Or ThisForm.pAlterar
	lcEDNss = ThisForm.pemps + _Dope + Str(ThisForm.pNumes,6)
Else && Inserção de novo?
	lcEDNss = []
EndIf

If crSigOpCdd.LibcSens = 3 And Not ThisForm.checavd
	pVdr = 'ZZZZZZZZZZ'
Else
	pVdr = ThisForm.UsuVendedor
EndIf
ThisForm.checavd = .f.
ThisForm.UsuVendedor = []

With ThisForm.Pagina.Lista
	If .cntFiltros.Op_Ordem.Value = 1
		llCmbt = .t.
		llCmbf = .f.
	Else
		If .cntFiltros.Op_Ordem.Value = 2
			llCmbt = .f.
			llCmbf = .f.
		Else
			llCmbt = .t.
			llcmbf = .t.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndWith

With ThisForm.Pagina.Lista
	If .cntFiltros.Op_Pago.Value = 1
		llPagot = .t.
		llPagof = .f.
	Else
		If .cntFiltros.Op_Pago.Value = 2
			llPagot = .f.
			llPagof = .f.
		Else
			llPagot = .t.
			llPagof = .t.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndWith

ThisForm.poDataMgr.Requery('ListaEest')
Select ListaEest
Index On Emps + Dopes + notas Tag Dopem
Index On Emps + Dopes + Grupoos + Contaos + Str(numes,6) Tag EmpdopOri
Index On Emps + Dopes + Grupods + Contads + Str(numes,6) Tag EmpdopDes
Index On EmpDopNums Tag EmpDopNums

ThisForm.LimparJobs() && 31/07/2014 - Richard

Select ListaEest
_RegLista = Reccount('ListaEest')
Go Top
ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Caption = 'Relação ( '+Alltrim(Str(_RegLista))+' )'

ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.btnAguarde.Visible = .f.

ThisForm.antempr  = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Get_cd_empresa.Value
ThisForm.Antdtini = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.dt_Inicial.Value
ThisForm.AntDtfin = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Dt_final.Value

ThisForm.LockScreen = .T.
=fCarregaGrade(ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade)
ThisForm.LockScreen = .F.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE totalizait
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE totalizait
Lparameters pOpCr

Local lnReg, totSai, totEnt, TotBnus, TotFpg, lnValor, lnVP, lnVI, lnVTI

Store 0 to TotSai,TotEnt,TotEBnus,TotSBnus,lnVP, lnVI, lnVTI

ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','Dopes',_Dope)

Select * From crTpmMvItn Where Not Empty(Cpros) Into Cursor ItBoNus ReadWrite
Select ItBonus
If Reccount() = 0
	Select TmpOperacao
	Scan for Codigos > 0
		_CodOper = Transf( Val( Right( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 6 ) ), "999999" )
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrOpe','ndopes', Val(Left( Str( TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10 ), 4 )))
		lcbusca = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + CrOpe.dopes + _CodOper

		lcSql = [Select EmpDopNums,lCancelas From SigMvCab Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocEest')
		If LocEest.lCancelas
			Loop
		EndIf
		
		lcSql = [Select * From SigMvItn ]+;
				[Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']

		ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TprMvCabi')
		Select TprMvCabi
		Scan
			Scatter to Memvar
			Select ItBonus
			Append From array memvar
		EndScan
		
		If pOpCr = 9
			llFalse = .f.
			lcSql = [Select a.fpags,a.Valos,a.lCancelas,a.CodBcrts,a.CotFpgs From SigMvPar a, SigOpFp b ]+;
					[Where a.EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[' And a.lCancelas = ?llFalse And ]+;
					[a.Fpags = b.Fpags And b.ChkBins = 3 ]
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpPar')
			Select TmpPar
			Scan
				If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.CodBcrts) And TmpPar.CodBcrts <> crSigOpCdd.CodBcrts
					Loop
				EndIf
				lnVP = lnVP + (TmpPar.Valos * Iif(TmpPar.CotFpgs>1,TmpPar.CotFpgs,1) )
			EndScan
		EndIf
	EndScan
EndIf
Select ItBonus
Scan
	If IsEmpty(Cpros)
		Loop
	EndIf
	
	If !Seek( ItBonus.moefats, "TmpCot" )
       	cotacaof = fBuscarCotacao(ItBonus.MoeFats,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), ThisForm.poDataMgr )
		Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( ItBonus.moefats, Cotacaof )
 	Else
		Cotacaof = TmpCot.Valos
	EndIf

	_Converte = .f.
	If Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ) && And SigCdOpe.ValPres = 1
		If !Seek( crSigCdPam.Moedaps, "TmpCot" )
			CotCv = fBuscarCotacao(crSigCdPam.Moedaps,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), ThisForm.poDataMgr )
			Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( crSigCdPam.Moedaps, Cotcv )
		Else
			Cotcv = TmpCot.Valos
		EndIf
		_Converte = .t.
	EndIf

	If !Seek( ItBonus.moedas, "TmpCot" )
		Cotacao = fBuscarCotacao(ItBonus.Moedas,ttod(ThisForm.DataPadrao), ThisForm.poDataMgr )
		Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( ItBonus.moedas, Cotacao )
	Else
		Cotacao = TmpCot.Valos
	EndIf

	totite = 0
	If crSigCdOpe.PesoVts = 1
		totite = totite + ( ItBonus.tpesos * Iif( _Converte, Cotacaof / Cotcv, 1 ) )
	EndIf
	If crSigCdOpe.PrecoVts = 1
		totite = totite + ( (ItBonus.Totas + ItBonus.ValRats) * Iif( _Converte, Cotacao / Cotcv, 1 ) )
	EndIf
	
	lcSql = [Select b.Bonus From SigCdPro a left Join SigCdLin b On a.Linhas = b.Linhas ]+;
			[Where a.Cpros = ']+ItBonus.Cpros+[']
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.sqlexecute(lcSql,'xPro')
	If Type('xPro.Bonus') = 'N' And xPro.Bonus = 2
		If ItBonus.opers = "S"
			TotSBnus = TotSBnus + totite
		Else
			TotEBnus = TotEBnus + totite
		EndIf
		Loop
	EndIf
	If ItBonus.opers = "S"
		totsai = TotSai + totite
	Else
		totent = TotEnt + totite
	EndIf
EndScan
lnVI  = Abs( round(totsai - totent,2) )
lnVTI = Abs( round(TotSBnus - TotEBnus,2) ) + lnVI

If pOpCr = 9
	lnValor = (lnVP * ( lnVI / lnVTI ) )
Else
	lnValor = lnVI
EndIf
Return lnValor

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE totpar
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE totpar
local total,cotacao
munid=-1
total=0
lnTotEnc = 0
Select xPar
Scan
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',xPar.Fpags)
		Cotacao = 1
		If !Empty( xpar.cotfpgs )
			cotacao = xpar.cotfpgs
		Else
			cotacao = ThisForm.Cotacao(xPar.moefpgs)
		EndIf

		_MoeOpe = Iif( Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, ;
				  Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )

		Cotoper = ThisForm.cotacao(_Moeope)
		lnInd   = Iif(crSigOpFp.Indices=0,1,crSigOpFp.Indices)

		If xPar.MoeFpgs # _MoeOpe
			If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
				Total = Round( Total - ( xPar.Valos * (Cotacao*lnInd) / CotOper ), 2 )
			Else
				Total = Round( Total + ( xPar.Valos * (Cotacao*lnInd) / CotOper ), 2 )
			EndIf
			If Munid # 0
				Munid = Round( Cotacao / 200, 2 )
			Endif

			*** Tiago - 04/06/2013 - Ícaro - Grava o total de encargos das condições de pagamento
*!*				_Enc = (( xPar.Valos * (Cotacao*lnInd) / CotOper ) * CrSigOpFp.Encargos) / 100
*!*				lnTotEnc = lnTotEnc + _Enc 		
		ELSE
			if (CrSigOpFp.infos != 'J')
				If crSigOpFp.Trocos = 1
					Total = Total - xPar.Valos
				Else
					Total = Total + xPar.Valos
				EndIf
			ENDIF
			
			 Munid = 0

			*** Tiago - 04/06/2013 - Ícaro - Grava o total de encargos das condições de pagamento
*!*				_Enc = (xPar.Valos * CrSigOpFp.Encargos) / 100
*!*				lnTotEnc = lnTotEnc + _Enc 							 
		EndIf
		If crSigCdOpe.Valpres = 1
			Munid = Round( Cotacao / 200, 2 )
		Endif
	EndIf
	Select xPar
Endscan

_MoeOpe = Iif( Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, ;
		  Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )

lcQuery = [Select Toleras ] + ;
		    [From SigCdMoe ] + ;
		    [Where CMoes = '] + _MoeOpe + [']

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalMoe]) < 1)
	=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalMoe)])
	Return 0
EndIf

ThisForm.Munipar = Iif(LocalMoe.Toleras <> 0, LocalMoe.Toleras, Munid )
ThisForm.Topar = Total
*** Tiago - 04/06/2013 - Ícaro - Grava o total de encargos das condições de pagamento
*!*	Replace ValEncs With lnTotEnc in TprMvCab		

* Calcula valor total da Movimentação
If crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 1 And crSigCdOpe.DigItens = 2 And ;
		(Not InList(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3)) And TprMvCab.ValServs = 0
	ThisForm.atuatot
EndIf

Select TprMvCab
*************** fim ****************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE transfauto
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE transfauto
Lparameters pCodBarra

Select crTpmMvItn
_Msg = ''
Scan For !IsEmpty(CodBarras) And IsEmpty(_Msg)

	If crTpmMvItn.EtiqOk And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
		Loop
	EndIf

	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigOpEtq','CrEti','Cbars',crTpmMvItn.CodBarras)

		lcEmpos = CrEti.Empos
		lcGrupo = []
		lcConta = []

		If (InList( crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs,1,2,4 ) Or InList( crSigCdOpe.EstDests,1,2,4 ) )
			Do Case
				Case crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'S' And (crEti.Empos # TprMvCab.Emps)
					If crSigCdOpe.Transs = 3 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) And ;
					   	crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 And TprMvCab.GrupoOs = crEti.Grupos And ;
					   	TprMvCab.ContaOs = crEti.Contas
					Else
						If crSigCdOpe.Transs = 5 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2
							If Not fContaPermitida(ThisForm.poDataMgr,crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs,crEti.Grupos,CrEti.Contas,.t.)
								_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + 'O Grupo/Conta Não Permitido para esta Movimentação!!!'
							Else
								lcEmpos = crEti.Empos
								lcGrupo = CrEti.Grupos
								lcConta = CrEti.Contas
							EndIf
						Else
							_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + ' não pertence a esta empresa!'
						EndIf
					EndIf

				Case crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'S' And IsEmpty( crEti.Contas ) And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2
					_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + ' já foi vendida!'

				Case crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'S' And InList(crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs,2,4) And (TprMvCab.Grupoos # CrEti.Grupos Or TprMvCab.Contaos # CrEti.Contas) And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 
					If crSigCdOpe.Transs = 5 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) 
						If Not fContaPermitida(ThisForm.poDataMgr,crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs,crEti.Grupos,CrEti.Contas,.t.)
							_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + 'O Grupo/Conta Não Permitido para esta Movimentação!!!'
						Else
							lcEmpos = crEti.Empos
							lcGrupo = CrEti.Grupos
							lcConta = CrEti.Contas
						EndIf
					Else
						_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + ' não pertence a este estoque!'
					EndIf

				Case crSigCdOpe.EstDests = 2 And (TprMvCab.Grupods # CrEti.Grupos Or TprMvCab.Contads # CrEti.Contas) And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 
					_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + ' não pertence a este estoque!'
					
				Case crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' And crSigCdOpe.Transs = 3 And ;
						Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.EmpPads) And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And ;
							IsEmpty(CrEti.Grupos + CrEti.Contas)
					_Msg = ''
					lcEmpos = crSigCdOpe.EmpPads

				Case crSigCdOpe.OPers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' And InList(crSigCdOpe.EstDests,2,4) And (TprMvCab.Grupods # CrEti.Grupos Or ;
							TprMvCab.Contads # CrEti.Contas) And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4)
					_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + ' não Pertence a Este Estoque !'

				Case crSigCdOpe.Transs = 1 And TprMvCab.Emps # CrEti.Empos And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 
					_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras,14) + ' não pertence a esta empresa!'
			EndCase

			If !IsEmpty(_Msg)
				lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvHst Where CodBarras = ]+Str(CrEti.Cbars,14)+[ Order by Seqs Desc ]
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,'CrHis') < 1
					_Msg = 'Favor reinicializar o processo.Falha na Conexão (CrHis)'
				Else
					Select CrHis
					Go Top
					If !Eof() And ( ThisForm.pcEscolha = "ALTERAR" ) And ;
						( ( (Not crSigCdOpe.Transs = 1) And (crHis.EmpDopNums=TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+ Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))) Or ;
						  ( (crSigCdOpe.Transs = 1) And (crHis.Empos+crHis.Emps+crHis.Dopes+Str(crHis.Numes,6)==TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.EmpDs+TprMvCab.Dopes+ Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) ) ) )

						=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))
						If crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 And ;
							TprMvCab.GrupoOs = crEest.GrupoOs And TprMvCab.ContaOs == crEest.ContaOs
							_Msg = ''
						Else
							_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Str(crEti.CBars,14) + ' não pertence a este estoque'
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
				If TprMvCab.EmpDopNums = CrHis.EmpdopNums
					Select CrHis
					Skip
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Empty(_msg)
			Replace crTpmMvItn.Empos     With lcEmpos,;
					crTpmMvItn.GrupoEts  With lcGrupo,;
					crTpmMvItn.ContaEts  With lcConta,;
					crTpmMvItn.EtiqOk    With .t. in crTpmMvItn
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndScan
If !IsEmpty(_Msg)
	MessageBox( _Msg, 32, 'Problema no Histórico da Etiqueta' )
	Return .f.
EndIf
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE validaestoque
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE validaestoque
Lparameters pValida

If Not pValida

	Select * From TprMvCab Where 0=1 Into Cursor TprMvCab3 ReadWrite
	Select TprMvCab3
	Index On Dopes Tag Dopes

	lcSql = [Select a.cDopes, a.cnivels, a.nCors, b.abrevs, a.Ordems from SigCdMop a, SigCdOpe b, SigOpCdc c ]+;
			[Where a.cDopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' And a.cnivels = b.dopes And b.Abrevs <> ' ' And ]+;
			[b.Dopes = c.Dopes And c.OpeInatvs <> 1 Order By a.Ordems]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CsPedidos') < 1
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (csPedidos)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Select CsPedidos
	Index On nCors  Tag nCors
	Index On Abrevs Tag Abrevs
	Index On Ordems Tag Ordems
	Set Order To Ordems
	
	lcSql = [Select b.dopes, b.GruOrigs, b.ConOrigs, b.GruDests, b.ConDests, b.TabDescs, b.Tabdps, a.Ordems ]+;
			[From SigCdMop a, SigCdOpe b, SigOpCdc c ]+;
			[Where a.cDopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' And a.cNivels = b.dopes And b.Abrevs <> ' ' And ]+;
			[b.Dopes = c.Dopes And c.OpeInatvs <> 1 Order By a.Ordems]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CsOpe') < 1
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (csOpe)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	
	Select CsOpe
	Scan
		Insert Into TprMvCab3 (Datas, Emps, Dopes, GrupoOs, ContaOs, GrupoDs, ContaDs, lPrecos, Jobs, ObsCabMovs) Values ;
			( TprMvCab.Datas, TprMvCab.Emps, CsOpe.Dopes, CsOpe.GruOrigs, CsOpe.ConOrigs, ;
				CsOpe.GruDests, CsOpe.ConDests, TprMvCab.lPrecos, TprMvCab.Jobs, TprMvCab.ObsCabMovs )
 
		Replace ContaOs With Iif(Empty(ContaOs),TprMvCab.ContaOs, ContaOs) ,;
				ContaDs With Iif(Empty(ContaDs),TprMvCab.ContaDs, ContaDs) ,;
				GrupoOs With Iif(Empty(GrupoOs),TprMvCab.GrupoOs, GrupoOs) ,;
				GrupoDs With Iif(Empty(GrupoDs),TprMvCab.GrupoDs, GrupoDs) ,;
				TabDs   with Iif(CsOpe.TabDescs=6,CsOpe.Tabdps,TprMvCab.Tabds) In TprMvCab3
	EndScan
Else
	If Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs)
		=Seek( crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs, 'CsPedidos', 'Abrevs' )
		=Seek(CsPedidos.cNivels,'TprMvCab3','Dopes')
		=ThisForm.Calc_ValIte(.f.,'TprMvCab3')
	Else
		=ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
	EndIf	
EndIf
Return .t.
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE validarnfs
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE validarnfs
Lparameters pNot, pSer, pEdn, pCtO, pCtD, pCnx, pCfo, pEmp
Local lcRet, lcNot, lcSer, lcEdn, lcCtO, lcCtD, lcQry, lcCfo, lcEmp
lcRet = []
lcNot = Iif(Type([pNot]) = [C], Padr(pNot, 06), [])
lcSer = Iif(Type([pSer]) = [C], Padr(pSer, 03), [])
lcEdn = Iif(Type([pEdn]) = [C], Padr(pEdn, 29), [])
lcCtO = Iif(Type([pCtO]) = [C], Padr(pCtO, 10), [])
lcCtD = Iif(Type([pCtD]) = [C], Padr(pCtD, 10), [])
lcCfo = Iif(Type([pCfo]) = [C], Padr(pCfo, 10), [])
lcEmp = Iif(Type([pEmp]) = [C], Padr(pEmp, 03), [])

If (Type([pCnx]) = [O]) And Not Empty(lcNot) 
	lcQry = [Select a.EmpDopNums ] + ;
			  [From SigMvNfi a, SigMvCab b ] + ;
			 [Where a.NFis = '] + lcNot + [' And ] + ;
			 	    Iif(Empty(lcSer), [], [a.Series = ']  + lcSer + [' And ]) + ;
			 	    Iif(Empty(lcCtO), [], [b.ContaOs = '] + lcCtO + [' And ]) + ;
			 	    Iif(Empty(lcCtD), [], [b.ContaDs = '] + lcCtD + [' And ]) + ;
			 	    Iif(Empty(lcCfo), [], [a.Cfis = '] + lcCfo + [' And ]) + ;
			 	    Iif(Empty(lcEmp), [], [b.Emps = '] + lcEmp + [' And ]) + ;
			 	    Iif(Empty(lcEdn), [], [Not a.EmpDopNums = '] + lcEdn + [' And ]) + ;
			 	    [a.EmpDopNums = b.EmpDopNums]
	
	If (pCnx.SQLExecute(lcQry, [crAr1]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!! Falha na Conexão (ValidarNfs)], 0+16, [Atenção!!! ])
		If Used([crAr1])
			Use In crAr1
		EndIf
		Return lcRet
	Else
		Go Top In crAr1
		If Not Eof([crAr1]) 
			lcRet = crAr1.EmpDopNums
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf
Return lcRet
************************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE valida_bemat
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE valida_bemat
Local lRetorno

lRetorno = .t.

If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'S/IMPRESSORA')
	ThisForm.Validacao = ThisForm.Validacao + 1
	goSistema.ValidaBematech = .t.
EndIf

If Not goSistema.ValidaBematech

	lcSql = [Select * From SigFiNal Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' Order by Ordems]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrSigFiNal') < 1
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrSigFiNal)')
		Return 0
	EndIf

	lcQuery = [Select * From SigOpFp ]
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigOpFp') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigOpFp 3)')
		Return 0
	EndIf

	Select crSigOpFp
	Scan
		If crSigOpFp.Trocos # 1 And crSigOpFp.nCodFinzs > 0
			Select * From CrSigFiNal Where nCodFinzs = crSigOpFp.ncodfinzs Into Cursor crTmpFinal
			Select crTmpFinal
			If Reccount() = 0
				Messagebox('Finalizadora da Forma de Pagamento não Cadastrada !!'+chr(13)+'Favor corrigir e Tentar Novamente !!',16,'ERRO')
				lRetorno = .f.
				Exit
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndScan
	If lRetorno &&Checar Cadastro de Finalizadoras
		Do Case
			Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON')
				Select crSigFiNal
				Scan
					If crSigFiNal.Ordems = 0
						Messagebox('Primeira Finalizadora Cadastrada Errada !!'+chr(13)+'Favor corrigir e Tentar Novamente !!',16,'ERRO')
						lRetorno = .f.
						Exit
					EndIf
				EndScan
				If lRetorno
					Select * From CrSigFiNal Where Ordems = 1 Into Cursor CrTmpFinal
					Select CrTmpFinal
					If Reccount() = 0
						Messagebox('Primeira Finalizadora não Cadastrada !!'+chr(13)+'Favor corrigir e Tentar Novamente !!',16,'ERRO')
						lRetorno = .f.
					EndIf
				EndIf

			Case  InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','SWEDA','NSWEDA','ELGIN','NDATAREGIS')
				If lRetorno
					Select * From CrSigFiNal Where Ordems = 0 Into Cursor CrTmpFinal
					Select CrTmpFinal
					If Reccount() = 0
						Messagebox('Primeira Finalizadora não Cadastrada !!'+chr(13)+'Favor corrigir e Tentar Novamente !!',16,'ERRO')
						lRetorno = .f.
					EndIf
				EndIf
		EndCase

	EndIf
	
	If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501') And lRetorno
	
		OFormulario = ThisForm.omodemEest

		Select crSigFiNal
		Scan
			If crSigFiNal.Ordems > 1
				Dados   = Padr(crSigFiNal.Descrs,16)
				Dados = chr(27)+chr(71)+Dados
				ChkCH = ChkSum(Dados,'H')
				ChkCL = ChkSum(Dados,'L')
				Comando = chr(02)+chr(20)+chr(00)+ Dados+chr(ChkCL)+chr(ChkCH)
				RetImp=CommFiscalR(Comando,OFormulario,5)
			EndIf
		EndScan

	EndIf
	
	If lRetorno
		ThisForm.Validacao = ThisForm.Validacao + 1
		goSistema.ValidaBematech = .t.
	EndIf

EndIf
Return ( lRetorno )

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE valorultvendas
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE valorultvendas
Local llBusca, lcMoeOper, lnValTots, lnValItens, lnUniVals, lnUnits, lnCotOper, lcCodProduto
Local lnCasas, lnCodBarras, lcOperacao, lcObs, lnNParcs, lnRateio, lcMoevs, lnMoeVals
Local lnDescVals

lcCodProduto = crTpmMvItn.CPros
lnCodBarras  = crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
lcMoeOper   = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
lnCasas     = crSigCdOpe.Casas
lnQtdPrecos = crSigCdOpe.QtdPrecos
PesoAuto    = crSigCdOpe.PesoAuts

llBusca = .F.
If Not IsEmpty(lnCodBarras)
	lcQuery = [Select a.EmpDopNums, a.Moevs, a.UniVals, a.MoeVals, a.DescVals, a.Dopes, a.Emps, a.Numes, a.Utilizas, ] + ;
					 [a.Notas, a.CodBarras, a.Opers, a.Totas, a.Units, a.MoeFats, a.Qtds, a.Moedas, a.Fators, ]+;
					 [c.Datas, c.TabDs, c.ContaDs  ] + ;
			    [From SigMvItn a, SigCdOpe b, SigMvCab c, SigCdTom t ] + ;
			   [Where a.EmpdopNums = c.EmpdopNums And ] + ;
			   		 [a.CodBarras = ] + Str(lnCodBarras) + [ And ] + ;
			   		 [a.Opers = 'S' And ] + ;
			   		 [a.Dopes = b.Dopes And ] + ;
			   		 [b.TipoOps = t.Codigos And ] + ;
			   		 [t.GerGdmis = 1]

	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEesti') > 0
		Select CrEesti
		Index On Datas Tag Datas
		Set Order to Datas Desc
		Go Top
		Do While Not Eof('CrEesti') And  Not llBusca
			If crEesti.EmpDopNums # TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
				llBusca = .T.
			Else		
				Select CrEesti
				Skip
			EndIf
		EndDo
	EndIf
EndIf

If llBusca
	lcMoevs    = crEesti.MoeVs
	lnUniVals  = crEesti.UniVals
	lnMoeVals  = crEesti.MoeVals
	lnDescVals = crEesti.DescVals
	lcOperacao = crEesti.EmpDopNums

	lcSql = [Select a.Sgrus, a.Compos, b.Mercs From SigCdPro a, SigCdGrp b ]+;
			[Where a.Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.cpros+[' And a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus ]
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'CsTmpPro') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão ValorUltVendas(CsTmpPro)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	lcSql = [Select Dopes, ValPres, cMoes, Opers From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+CrEesti.Dopes+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpOpe') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão ValorUltVendas(TmpOpe)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
		
	lcObs = AllTrim(crEesti.Emps) + ' ' + AllTrim(crEesti.Dopes) + ' ' + ;
		    AllTrim(Str(crEesti.Numes,6)) + ' : ' + DtoC(crEestI.Datas) + ' - ' + AllTrim(crEestI.TabDs)
	If IsEmpty(TprMvCab.ContaOs)
		Replace TprMvCab.ContaOs With CrEestI.Contads In TprMvCab
	EndIf

	lcSql = [Select Deprecias From SigOpCdc Where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpDcOpe') < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão ValorUltVendas(TmpDcOpe)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	LnDepre = 1
	If TmpDcOpe.Deprecias = 1
		lnQtDia = ( Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas) - Ttod(CrEestI.Datas) )
		lcSql = [Select * From SigOpDup Where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[']
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'TmpDpOpe')
		Select TmpDpOpe
		m.xPercs = 0
		Select TmpDpOpe
		Scan
			If Between(lnQtDia,TmpDpOpe.QtddIs,TmpDpOpe.QtddFs)
				m.xPercs = TmpDpOpe.Percs
				Exit
			EndIf
		EndScan
		LnDepre = ( ( 100 - m.xPercs ) / 100 )
	EndIf

	If TmpOpe.ValPres = 3 And Not IsEmpty(TmpOpe.CMoes)
		If Not Empty(lcMoeOper)
			lnCotOper = ThisForm.Cotacao(lcMoeOper, TprMvCab.Datas)
		Else
			lnCotOper = 1
		EndIf
		
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvMov','CrEstMo','EmpDopNums',lcOperacao, [ValTots])

		Select crEstMo
		Go Top
		Store 0 to lnValTots, lnValItens
		If Not Eof()
			lnValTots  = crEstMo.ValTots
		EndIf

		lcQuery = [EmpDopNums, moevs, univals, moevals, descvals, dopes, emps, numes, ]+;
				  [Utilizas, notas, codbarras, opers, totas, units, moefats, qtds, moedas, fators]

		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvItn','CrEestiV','EmpDopNums',lcOperacao, lcQuery)
		
		lnValItens = 0
		Select crEestiV
		Go Top
		If Not Eof()
			Do While Not Eof('crEestiV')
				Do Case
					Case (crEestiV.Utilizas = 2) Or ( Not IsEmpty(crEestiV.Notas) And IsEmpty(crEestiV.Codbarras) )
						lnValTots = lnValTots - ( Iif(crEestiV.Opers='S',1,-1) * crEestiV.Totas )
						
					Case (TmpOpe.Opers = 3 And crEestiV.Opers = 'E')
						lnValTots = lnValTots + crEestiV.Totas
					
					OtherWise
						lnValItens = lnValItens + Iif( crEestiV.Opers = 'S', 1, -1 ) * crEestiV.Totas
				EndCase

				Select crEestiV
				Skip
			EndDo
		EndIf

		lnUnits = Round( lnUniVals * ( lnMoeVals / lnCotOper ) * ( 1 - lnDescVals ), lnCasas )
		
		
		xRateio = Abs( lnValTots / lnValItens )
		
		lnUnitLq = Round( lnUnits * iif((lnValItens # 0) And (lnValTots # 0), ;
					xRateio, 1), lnCasas )
		lnUnits = Round( lnUnits * iif((lnValItens # 0) And (lnValTots # 0), ;
					xRateio, 1) * LnDepre , lnCasas )
		
		lcObs = lcObs + ' - ' + Alltrim( Transf( lnUnitLq, '99,999,999.99' ) )
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Replace crTpmMvItn.Moedas   With lcMoeOper, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Units    With lnUnits, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Pesos    With Iif(PesoAuto = 2,0,crTpmMvItn.Pesos ), ;
				crTpmMvItn.DescVals With 0, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Totas    With iif(InList(lnQtdPrecos, 1, 5) or (lnQtdPrecos = 3 and crTpmMvItn.citem2=0),crTpmMvItn.Qtds * lnUnits, lnUnits), ;
				crTpmMvItn.Utilizas With 1, ;
				crTpmMvItn.MoeVs    With lcMoeVs, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Obs      With lcObs
	Else
		lnUnitLq = ( CrEesti.Units )
		lnUnits = ( CrEesti.Units * LnDepre )
		lcObs = lcObs + ' - ' + AllTrim( Transf( LnUnitLq, '99,999,999.99' ) )
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Replace crTpmMvItn.Units    With lnUnits,    ;
				crTpmMvItn.MoeFats  With crEesti.MoeFats,  ;
				crTpmMvItn.DescVals With crEesti.DescVals, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Moedas   With crEesti.Moedas,   ;
				crTpmMvItn.Fators   With crEesti.Fators,   ;
				crTpmMvItn.Pesos    With Iif(PesoAuto = 2,0,crTpmMvItn.Pesos ), ;
				crTpmMvItn.Utilizas With 1, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Totas    With LnUnits * crTpmMvItn.Qtds, ;
				crTpmMvItn.MoeVs    With crEesti.MoeVs, ;
				crTpmMvItn.Obs      With lcObs

	EndIf
	lnDias = Iif(Not IsEmpty(CrEesti.Datas) ,( Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas) - Ttod(CrEesti.Datas) ), 0 )
	Do Case
		Case CsTmpPro.Sgrus = [N]
			Replace TpTroca With 31 In crTpmMvItn

		Case CrEesti.Dopes = Padr([TR],20)
			Replace TpTroca With 32 In crTpmMvItn
		
		Case lnDias > 0 And lnDias < 60
			If lnDias > 15 And (CsTmpPro.Mercs = [REL] Or CsTmpPro.Compos = [PER ] )
				Replace TpTroca With 33 In crTpmMvItn
			Else
				If CrEesti.dopes = Padr([V],20)
					Replace TpTroca With 34 In crTpmMvItn
				EndIf
			EndIf

		Case lnDias >= 60 And lnDias <= 365 And CrEesti.dopes = Padr([V],20)
			Replace TpTroca With 35 In crTpmMvItn

		Case lnDias > 365 And CrEesti.dopes = Padr([V],20)
			Replace TpTroca With 36 In crTpmMvItn

	EndCase
EndIf
Select crTpmMvItn

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE verbloqueio2
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE verbloqueio2
Lparameters pDat, pTpBlq, pDdBlq, pCnx
Local lnRet, ldDat
lnRet = .t.
pData = pCnx.GetDatetime()
ldDat = Iif(Type([pDat])=[T], Ttod(pDat), Iif(Type([pDat])=[D], pDat, Ttod(pData)))
If (pTpBlq = 2)
	If (pDdBlq = 0)
		lnRet = .t.
	Else
		If (ldDat < (Ttod(pData) - pDdBlq))
			lnRet = .F.
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	lnRet = .f.
EndIf
Return lnRet

ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE vericms
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE vericms
Local lnIcm

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCfo','crTmpCfo','Codigos',crSigCdOpe.Cfos)

ThisForm.lOkIcms=.f.
lnIcm = 0
lcTrIcm = ''

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdIcm','CrTmpTrIcm','Codigos',CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms) 
lcSitTribIcm = CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms && PAF - Tiago - 22/03/2011

If Not Empty(CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms) And InList(CrTmpTrIcm.Tipos,'F','I','N')
	SqlTrib = [Select * From SigFiTri Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Tipos = ']+CrTmpTrIcm.Tipos+[']
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(SqlTrib,'crSigFiTri')
	Select crSigFiTri 
	Go top
	If !Eof()
		lnIcm = CrSigFiTri.Aliqs
		lcTrIcm = CrSigFiTri.Tipos
		ThisForm.lOkIcms=.t.
	EndIf
Else
	If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Cfos) And Upper(CrTmpCfo.Icms) = 'N'
		lcTp = 'N'
		SqlTrib = [Select * From SigFiTri Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Tipos = ']+lcTp+[']
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(SqlTrib,'crSigFiTri')
		Select crSigFiTri 
		Go top
		If !Eof()
			lnIcm = CrSigFiTri.Aliqs
			lcTrIcm = CrSigFiTri.Tipos
			ThisForm.lOkIcms=.t.
		EndIf
	Else
		If !Empty(CrTmpPro.Icms) or CrTmpPro.Icms<>0
			SqlTrib = [Select * From SigFiTri Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+['And  Aliqs Between ]+Alltrim(Str(Int(CrTmpPro.Icms)))+;
			                                              [ And ]+Alltrim(Str(Int(CrTmpPro.Icms)+1))
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(SqlTrib,'crSigFiTri') > 0
				Select crSigFiTri 
				Go top
				Locate For Aliqs = CrTmpPro.Icms
				If ! Eof()
					lnIcm = CrTmpPro.Icms
					lcTrIcm = CrSigFiTri.Tipos
					ThisForm.lOkIcms=.t.
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Else
			lcSql = [Select * From SigCdCfi Where Grupos = ']+CrTmpPro.Cgrus+[' And Ests = ']+CrSigCdEmp.Estas+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcsql,'CrTmpCicfi') < 1
				Return 
			EndIf
			Select CrTmpCicFi
			Index On TpTribs Tag TpTribs
			If Seek(CrTmpPro.TpTribs) Or Seek(Space(04))
				SqlTrib = [Select * From SigFiTri Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' and Aliqs Between ]+Alltrim(Str(Int(CrTmpCicFi.Icms)))+;
				                                              [ And ]+Alltrim(Str(Int(CrTmpCicFi.Icms)+1))+;
				                                              [ And Tipos = ']+CrTmpCicFi.TpIcms+[']
				ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(SqlTrib,'crSigFiTri')
				Select crSigFiTri 
				Go top
				Locate For Aliqs = CrTmpCicFi.Icms
				If !Eof()
					lnIcm = crTmpCicfi.Icms
					lcTrIcm = CrSigFiTri.Tipos
					ThisForm.lOkIcms=.t.
				EndIf
				*** PAF - Tiado - 22/03/2011
				If Not Empty(CrTmpCicFi.SitTrIcms)
					lcSitTribIcm = CrTmpCicFi.SitTrIcms
				Endif				
			Else
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdUfs','crSigCdUfs','Estados',CrSigCdEmp.Estas) And ;
					( crSigCdUfs.Aicms > 0 Or (crSigCdUfs.Aicms = 0  And crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA' ) )
					SqlTrib = [Select * From SigFiTri Where Imps = ']+crSigFiFis.Imps+[' And Aliqs Between ]+Alltrim(Str(Int(crSigCdUfs.Aicms)))+;
					                                              [ And ]+Alltrim(Str(Int(crSigCdUfs.Aicms)+1))
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(SqlTrib,'crSigFiTri')
					Select crSigFiTri 
					Go top
					Locate For Aliqs = crSigCdUfs.Aicms
					If ! Eof()
						lnIcm = crSigCdUfs.Aicms
						lcTrIcm = CrSigFiTri.Tipos
						ThisForm.lOkIcms=.t.
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

Select crTpmMvItn
Replace aliqicms  With lnIcm,;
		Tipos     With lcTrIcm,;
		IdPro     With CrTmpPro.IdPro ,;
		SitTrIcms With lcSitTribIcm in crTpmMvItn

If lnIcm >= 90
	ThisForm.ItemNIcm = .t.
else
	ThisForm.ItemNIcm = .f.
EndIf

If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA'
	ThisForm.lOkIcms = .t.
EndIf

ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE verifmtcub
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE verifmtcub
lParameters pRetT

If crSigOpCdd.MtCubs <= 0
	Return .t.
EndIf

Select [ ] as Agrupar, Sum(Mtcubs * Qtds) as TT From crTpmMvItn Into Cursor ToTMtCub Group by 1
If pRetT
	Return ( TotMtCub.TT )
Else
	If TotMtCub.TT > crSigOpCdd.MtCubs
		MessageBox('Excesso de Capacidade em Metros Cúbicos!!!!'+Chr(13)+;
					'Capacidade M3:'+Str(crSigOpCdd.MtCubs,8,3)+Chr(13)+;
					'Informado    :'+Str(TotMtCub.Tt,8,3),0+16,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Return .t.
EndIf

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE versubtotal
Local _ValCupFis, llOk

If Not InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'S/IMPRESSORA')

	Wait Window 'Verificando Sub-Total da Impressora...' Nowait
	_ValCupFis = VerSubt(oFormulario)
	Wait clear

	If _ValcupFis <> TprMvCab.Valinis
		llOk = 7
		DO While llOk = 7
			llOk = MessageBox('O Total do Cupom não Confere Com Total de Itens do Sistema. '+Chr(13)+;
						'Por Favor Tente outra Vez ou Cancele o Cupom!!!'+Chr(13)+;
						'Aperte SIM para continuar o sistema',4+16+256,'Atenção..')
		EndDo
		Return .f.
	Else
		Return .t.
	EndIf

EndIf
Return .t.
ENDPROC

	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvOrc)')
	Return .F.
Endif

lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvOrp Where EmpDopNums = ']+pcPosicao+['  ]
lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
If lnErro < 1
	Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvOrp)')
	Return .F.
Endif

*!*		lcDelete = [select Barras, LocAtus From SigCdMlc Where EmpDopNums = ']+pcPosicao+['  ]
*!*		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'TmpCdMlc')

lcDelete = [Delete From SigCdMlc Where EmpDopNums = ']+pcPosicao+['  ]

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE ratearcc
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE ratearcc
Lparameters pArqItem, pArqCb, pCnx
Local totite,totent,totsai, __ordem, lServcIt, pnVlRat, xVlr
Store 0 to TotIte, TotEnt, TotSai, lnVlRat, xVlr
=pCnx.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrSigCdOpe','Dopes',&pArqCb..Dopes)
IF crSigCdOpe.Vars <> 1 And &pArqCb..ValVars = 0
	Return
EndIf
pCnx.Sqlexecute([Select * From SigMvNfi Where EmpdopNums = ']+&pArqCb..EmpDopNums+['],[LocalnFis])
lnttvl = &pArqCb..Valos
lServcit = .f.
If InList(CrSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
	lcSerie = LocalNfis.Series
	pCnx.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','crTmpSerie','EmpCods',TprMvCab.Emps + lcSerie)
	If Eof('crTmpSerie')
		pCnx.CursorQuery('SigCdSer','crTmpSerie','EmpCods',Space(3) + lcSerie)
	EndIf
	If CrTmpSerie.TpServicos = 3
		lnttvl = lnttvl - LocalNfis.VTotSers
		lServcit = .t.
	EndIf
Endif
lnTtFn = 0
llTemRat = .f.
Select (pArqItem)
__ordem = Order()
Set Order To
Scan
	If IsEmpty(Cpros)
		Loop
	Endif
	=pCnx.Sqlexecute([Select ClFiscals From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+&pArqItem..Cpros+['],[LocalPro])
	Cotacaof = fBuscarCotacao(&pArqItem..Moedas,Date(), pCnx)
	_Converte = .f.
	If Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes )
		CotCv = fBuscarCotacao(CrSigCdPam.Moedaps,Date(), pCnx)
		_Converte = .t.
	Endif
	Cotacao = fBuscarCotacao(&pArqItem..Moedas,Date(), pCnx)
	totite = 0
	If crSigCdOpe.PesoVts = 1
		totite = totite + ( &pArqItem..tpesos * Iif( _Converte, Cotacaof / Cotcv, 1 ) )
	Endif
	If crSigCdOpe.PrecoVts = 1
		totite = totite + ( &pArqItem..totas * Iif( _Converte, Cotacao / Cotcv, 1 ) )
	Endif
	Ret = .t.
	If InList(CrSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
		If IsEmpty( StrTran( LocalPro.ClFiscals, '.', '' ) )
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
	Else
		IF &pArqItem..Utilizas > 9 And &pArqItem..Utilizas <> 14  
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
		IF Ret AND crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 AND &pArqItem..Opers = 'E'
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
		IF Ret AND Not IsEmpty(&pArqItem..Notas) And IsEmpty(&pArqItem..CodBarras)
			Ret = .f.
		EndIf
	Endif
	IF NOT Ret And CrSigCdOpe.CupFis <> 1
		lnttvl = lnttvl - totite
	Else
		llTemRat = .t.
		If &pArqItem..opers = "S"
			totsai = totsai + totite
		else
			totent = totent + totite
		EndIf
	Endif
	lnTtFn = lnTtFn + (totIte * Iif(&pArqItem..Opers='E',1,-1))
EndScan
Set Order to &__Ordem
lnItem = Abs( round(totsai - totent,2) )
pnRateioItem = IIF(lnItem=0,1,( lnTtVl / LnItem )) 
If Not llTemRat
	lnttvl = &pArqCb..Valos
	If lServcit
		lnttvl = lnttvl - LocalNfis.VTotSers
	Endif
	pnRateioItem = IIF(lnTtFn=0,1,( lnTtVl / Abs(lnTtFn) ))
Endif
pnVlRat = Abs(lnTtfn) - lnTtVl
Select(pArqItem)
Scan
	=pCnx.Sqlexecute([Select ClFiscals From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+&pArqItem..Cpros+['],[LocalPro])
	_Rat = .t.
	If InList(CrSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
		If IsEmpty( StrTran( LocalPro.ClFiscals, '.', '' ) )
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
	Else
		IF &pArqItem..Utilizas > 9 And &pArqItem..Utilizas <> 14
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
		IF _Rat AND crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 AND &pArqItem..Opers = 'E'
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
		IF _Rat AND Not IsEmpty(&pArqItem..Notas) And IsEmpty(&pArqItem..CodBarras)
			_Rat = .f.
		EndIf
	Endif
	IF _Rat Or CrSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 Or Not llTemRat
		Replace &pArqItem..Unit2s  WITH &pArqItem..Units * pnRateioItem,;
				&pArqItem..ValRats WITH ((&pArqItem..Unit2s - &pArqItem..Units) * &pArqItem..Qtds)
	Else
		Replace &pArqItem..Unit2s  WITH &pArqItem..Units,;
				&pArqItem..ValRats WITH 0
	EndIf
	pnVlRat = pnVlRat + &pArqItem..ValRats
EndScan
If pnVlRat <> 0
	Go bott
	Replace Valrats With ValRats - pnVlRat in &pArqItem.
EndIf
Return .t.
************************************************************************************
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE validamovbarraautomatica
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE validamovbarraautomatica
parameters pcMovimento

Local llOk
llOk = .T.

If ( crSigCdOpe.transs = 5 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) ) Or Inlist(crSigOpCdc.GerOpes,1,2)
	
	lcSql = [Select EmpDnCrds, EmpDopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+pcMovimento+[']
	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, 'CsTmpTrfs') < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CsTmpTrfs)')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	Select CsTmpTrfs
	Scan

		lcEmpDopNum = CsTmpTrfs.EmpDopNums
		_lcOpe = Substr(lcEmpDopNum,4,20)

		=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','cTmpCdOpe','dopes',_lcOpe)
		=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','cTmpOpCdc','dopes',_lcOpe)
		=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdd','cTmpOpCdd','dopes',_lcOpe)

		If cTmpCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And llOk
		
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEmpDopNum+[' ]
			LnErro = Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTprMvCabi')
			If LnErro < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCabi)')
				ok = .F.
			Endif
		
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEmpDopNum+[' ]
			LnErro = Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpEsti2')
			If LnErro < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEsti2)')
				llOk = .F.
			Else
				lcSql = [Select EmpDnCrds, EmpDopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+lcEmpDopNum+[' ]
				If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, 'CsTmpTrfs') < 1)
					=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CsTmpTrfs)')
					Return .F.
				Endif
				Select CsTmpTrfs
				Index On EmpDopNums Tag EmpDopNums

				Select crTmpEsti2
				Index On Citens Tag Citens

				Select CrTprMvCabi
				Scan
					If !Empty(CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras)
						lnBarra = CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras
						lcWhere = [Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, Cbars From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ]+Str(lnBarra,14)+[ ]
						LnErro = Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrtmpEti')
						If LnErro < 1
							Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEti)')
							llOk = .F.
							Exit
						Else
							Select CrtmpEti
							llEtiOk = ( Reccount() > 0 )
							If Not llEtiOk
								Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
									' Não Consta no Cadastro de Etiquetas.', 48, 'Código de Etiqueta Inconsistente')
								llOk = .F.
								Exit
							Else
								lcWhere = [Select CodBarras, Datas, Emps, Dopes, Numes, EmpDopNums, Opers From SigMvHst Where CodBarras = ]+Str(lnBarra,14)+[ Order By CodBarras, Seqs Desc]
								LnErro = Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpHis')
								If LnErro < 1
									Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpHis 3)')
									llOk = .F.
									Exit
								Else
									Select crTmphis
									Go Top
									If Reccount() > 0
										llHisOk = ( crTmphis.EmpDopNums = lcEmpDopNum Or ;
											( Inlist(cTmpCdOpe.transs,3,5) And Not Empty(cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'E' And crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
											( cTmpCdOpe.transs = 3 And Not Empty(cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'S' And crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Emps + cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
											( cTmpCdOpe.transs = 1 And Not Empty(crSigMvCab.Empds) And crSigMvCab.Empds # crSigMvCab.Emps And crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
											( cTmpCdOpe.transs = 5 And Seek(crTmphis.EmpDopNums,'CsTmpTrfs','EmpDopNums') ) )
										If Not llHisOk
											Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
												' já Foi Movimentada.', 48, 'Última Movimentação: ' + ;
												AllTrim(crTmphis.Emps) + ' ' + Alltrim(crTmphis.Dopes) + ' ' + ;
												AllTrim(Str(crTmphis.Numes,6)))
											llOk = .F.
											Exit
										Endif
									Else
										If (CrtmpEti.Emps # crSigMvCab.Emps ) Or ;
												( CrtmpEti.Dopes # crSigMvCab.Dopes ) Or ( CrtmpEti.Numes # crSigMvCab.Numes )
											Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
												' sem Histórico.', 48, 'Última Movimentação Não Encontrada')
											llOk = .F.
											Exit
										Endif
									Endif
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
					Else
						lcProcura2 = CrTprMvCabi.Citens
						Select crTmpEsti2
						Set Order To Citens
						Seek ( lcProcura2 )
						Scan While Citens = lcProcura2
							If !Empty( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras )
								lnBarra = crTmpEsti2.CodBarras
								lcWhere = [Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, Cbars From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ?lnBarra ]
								LnErro = Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crtmpEti')
								If LnErro < 1
									Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEti 2)')
									llOk = .F.
									Exit
								Else
									Select CrtmpEti
									llEtiOk = ( Reccount() > 0 )
									If Not llEtiOk
										Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
											' Não Consta no Cadastro de Etiquetas.', 48, 'Código de Etiqueta Inconsistente')
										llOk = .F.
										Exit
									Else
										lcWhere = [Select CodBarras, Datas, Emps, Dopes, Numes, EmpDopNums, Opers From SigMvHst Where CodBarras = ?lnBarra Order By CodBarras, Seqs Desc ]
										LnErro = Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crtmpHis')
										If LnErro < 1
											Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpHis 4)')
											llOk = .F.
											Exit
										Else
											Select crTmphis
											Go Top
											If Reccount() > 0
												llHisOk = ( crTmphis.EmpDopNums = lcEmpDopNum Or ;
													( Inlist(cTmpCdOpe.transs,3,5) And Not Empty(cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'E' And ;
													crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
													( cTmpCdOpe.transs = 3 And Not Empty(cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'S' And ;
													crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Emps + cTmpCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
													( cTmpCdOpe.transs = 1 And Not Empty(crSigMvCab.Empds) And crSigMvCab.Empds # crSigMvCab.Emps And ;
													crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) )
												If Not llHisOk
													Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
														' já Foi Movimentada.', 48, 'Última Movimentação: ' + ;
														AllTrim(crTmphis.Emps) + ' ' + Alltrim(crTmphis.Dopes) + ' ' + ;
														AllTrim(Str(crTmphis.Numes,6)))
													llOk = .F.
													Exit
												Endif
											Else
												If ( CrtmpEti.Emps # crSigMvCab.Emps ) Or ;
														( CrtmpEti.Dopes # crSigMvCab.Dopes ) Or ( CrtmpEti.Numes # crSigMvCab.Numes )
													Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
														' sem Histórico.', 48, 'Última Movimentação Não Encontrada')
													llOk = .F.
													Exit
												Endif
											Endif
										Endif
									Endif
								Endif
							Endif
							Select crTmpEsti2
						Endscan
					Endif
					Select CrTprMvCabi
				Endscan
			Endif
		Endif
	Endscan
Endif

Return llOk
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE chkopvld
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE chkopvld
Local lnOldSel, llOk, lnDiaMov, lnDiaBlq

lnOldSel = Select()
lnDiaMov = 0
lnDiaBlq = 0 
llOk = .T.

If Alltrim(crSigCdPam.Dopes) <> ALLTRIM(TprMvCab.Dopes) And Not Empty(crSigCdPam.Dopes)
	Return .T.
EndIf 

lcQuery = [Select Empresa, Dopes, Grupos, Contas, IsNull(Max(Dias),0) as Dias ] + ;
	[From SigOpVld ] + ;
	[Where Empresa = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' ] + ;
	[And Dopes Not In(Select Dopes From SigCdPam) ] + ;
	[Group By Empresa, Dopes, Grupos, Contas ]
	
If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[crSigOpVld]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (SigOpVld)])
	Return .F.
Endif

Select crSigOpVld
Go Top
Scan
	
	lnDiaBlq = crSigOpVld.Dias

	lcQuery = [Select Dopes, Min(datas) as Data, IsNull(datediff(DAY,Min(Datas),GetDate()),0) as Dias ] + ;
		[From sigmvcab ] + ;
		[Where Emps = ']+crSigOpVld.Empresa+[' ] + ;
		[And GrupoOs = ']+crSigOpVld.Grupos+[' ] + ;
		[And ContaOs = ']+crSigOpVld.Contas+[' ] + ;
		[And Dopes = ']+crSigOpVld.Dopes+[' ] + ;
		[And ChkSubn = 0 and ChkPagos = 0 ] + ;
		[group by dopes ]
	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[crSigAux]) < 1)
		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigAux)])
		Return .F.
	Endif	
	
	If Reccount([crSigAux])>0
		lnDiaMov = Nvl(crSigAux.Dias,0)
		
		If lnDiaBlq = 0 And lnDiaBlq <= lnDiaMov
			Messagebox('Operação Bloqueada, Existe uma Movimentação ' + crSigOpVld.Dopes + ' em aberto a '+Alltrim(Str(lnDiaMov,3))+' Dias, Favor Verificar !!!',0+48,'')
			llOk = .F.
		EndIf 
		
		If lnDiaBlq < lnDiaMov and llOk =.T.
			Messagebox('Operação Bloqueada, Existe uma Movimentação ' + crSigOpVld.Dopes + ' em aberto a '+Alltrim(Str(lnDiaMov,3))+' Dias, Favor Verificar !!!',0+48,'')
			llOk = .F.
		EndIf 
		
		If Not llOk
			Exit 
		EndIf 	
	EndIf 	
	Select crSigOpVld
EndScan 


*!*	&&[And Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[' ]

*!*	lcQuery = [Select Dopes, Min(datas) as Data, IsNull(datediff(DAY,Min(Datas),GetDate()),0) as Dias ] + ;
*!*		[From sigmvcab ] + ;
*!*		[Where Emps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' ] + ;
*!*		[And GrupoOs = ']+TprMvCab.grupoos+[' ] + ;
*!*		[And ContaOs = ']+TprMvCab.contaos+[' ] + ;
*!*		[And ChkSubn = 0 ] + ;
*!*		[group by dopes ]
*!*	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[crSigAux]) < 1)
*!*		=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crSigAux)])
*!*		Return .F.
*!*	Endif

*!*	Select crSigAux
*!*	Go Top
*!*	Scan

*!*		lnDiaMov = crSigAux.Dias
*!*		lcDopes = crSigAux.Dopes
*!*		lnDiaBlq = 0
*!*		
*!*		lcQuery = [Select IsNull(Max(Dias),0) as Dias ] + ;
*!*			[From SigOpVld ] + ;
*!*			[Where Empresa = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' ] + ;
*!*			[And Grupos = ']+TprMvCab.grupoos+[' ] + ;
*!*			[And Contas = ']+TprMvCab.contaos+[' ] + ;
*!*			[And Dopes = ']+lcDopes+[' ]
*!*			
*!*		If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[crSigOpVld]) < 1)
*!*			=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (SigOpVld)])
*!*			Return .F.
*!*		Endif

*!*		Select crSigOpVld
*!*		If Reccount([crSigOpVld])>0
*!*			lnDiaBlq = crSigOpVld.Dias
*!*		EndIf 
*!*			
*!*		If lnDiaBlq <> 0
*!*			If lnDiaBlq < lnDiaMov
*!*				Messagebox('Operação Bloqueada, Existe uma Movimentação ' + lcDopes + ' em aberto a '+Alltrim(Str(lnDiaMov,3))+' Dias, Favor Verificar !!!',0+48,'')
*!*				llOk = .F.
*!*			EndIf 
*!*		EndIf 
*!*		
*!*		If Not llOk
*!*			Exit 
*!*		EndIf 
*!*		
*!*		Select crSigAux
*!*	EndScan 

*!*	If Reccount([crSigAux])>0
*!*		
*!*	EndIf 


Return llOk



ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE baixaempenhopedido
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE baixaempenhopedido
Local llRetorno
llRetorno = .T.
_pData = Datetime() 

If IsEmpty(TprMvCab.PedidoWeb)
	Return .T.
Endif

=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdPac','CrSigCdPac')

lcDopVdAVEco = CrSigCdPac.DopVdAVEco
lcMovVndEco = CrSigCdPac.MovVndEco
lcMovPicSto	= 'VENDA PICKUP STORE'
lcMovShiSto = 'VENDA SHIP FROM STOR'
lcMovCancel = 'CANCELA VENDA E-COMM'

=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdd','crSigOpCdd','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

If Not InList(TprMvCab.Dopes,lcDopVdAVEco,lcMovVndEco,lcMovPicSto,lcMovShiSto,lcMovCancel)
	Return (llRetorno)
EndIf 

lcUltGrv = ( TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + '-Baixa_WbPed' )

lcQuery =[select empdopnums from sigmvcab ] + ;
	[where pedidoweb = ']+TprMvCab.PedidoWeb+[' ] + ;
	[and dopes not in(']+lcDopVdAVEco+[',']+lcMovVndEco+[',']+lcMovPicSto+[',']+lcMovShiSto+[',']+lcMovCancel+[') ]
	
If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'csPedWeb') < 1
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (csPedWeb)')
	Return .F.
Endif

Select csPedWeb
Scan

	lcEdn = csPedWeb.EmpDopNums

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigMvCab','CrTprMvCab','EmpDopNums',lcEdn)


	lcbusca = CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums
	llChkf = .T.
	ldDtAlt = _pData
	llDtBx  = TprMvCab.DataS
	lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, ChkBxParcs = ?llChkf, DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[']
	lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	If lnErro < 0
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 16)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .F.
	Endif
	lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvItn Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, QtBaixas = Qtds  Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[']
	lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	If lnErro < 0
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvItn 16)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .F.
	Endif
	lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvIts Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf, QtBaixas = Qtds  Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[']
	lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	If lnErro < 0
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvIts 16)')
		Wait Clear
		Return .F.
	Endif
	If Seek(Substr(lcbusca,4,20),'crSigCdMei','Dopes')
		lcDelete = [Delete From SigMvEtt Where EmpdopNums = ']+lcbusca+[']
		lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
		If lnErro < 0
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigMvEtt - Baixasubnivel)')
			Return .F.
		Endif
	Endif
	lcUpDate = [Update SigMvEte Set ChkSubn = ?llChkf Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcbusca+[']
	If Thisform.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn  > 0
		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
			lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'',4)
			lnErro = 1
		Else
			lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr6.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
		Endif
	Else
		lnErro = Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
	Endif
	If lnErro < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvEte )')
		Return .F.
	Endif

	Select csPedWeb
Endscan
Return (llRetorno)

ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE validaevento
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE validaevento
Parameters pValida
Local lnOldSel
lnOldSel = Select()

Select crEventos
Select Cods from crEventos Where Cods <> '' into cursor Duplica group by Cods having sum(1) > 1 
Select Duplica
If Reccount() > 0
	=MessageBox('Evento Informado mais de uma vez, Favor Verificar.!!!',0+32,'')
	Select(lnOldSel)
	Return .F.
EndIf 

If pValida
	Select crEventos
	Delete From crEventos Where Empty(Cods) 
	Select Cods from crEventos Where Cods <> ' ' Into cursor Vazio readwrite 
	Select Vazio
	If Reccount([Vazio]) = 0
		=MessageBox('Nenhum Evento Informado, Favor Verificar.!!!',0+32,'')
		Select(lnOldSel)
		Return .F.
	EndIf 
EndIf 
	
Select(lnOldSel)
Return .T.
ENDPROC

	Return .f.
Endif

*** mena 05/11/2015 seleciona itens da operação antes das alterações para controle de estoque por local ***

	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigmvItn)')
	Return .f.
Endif

**** mena - 12/08/2015 - Seleciona registro de finalidade itn ****
If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigOpFnl where empdopnums = '] +pcEDN+ ['], [crSigOpFnl]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (sigopfnl)])
	Return .f.
Endif

**** mena - 01/01/2017 - Seleciona registro de descontos por item ****
If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvItd where empdopnums = '] +pcEDN+ ['], [crSigMvItd]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (sigMvItd)])
	Return .f.
Endif

**** mena - 01/01/2017 - Seleciona registro de atendimentos por vendedor ****
If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvAte where empdopnums = '] +pcEDN+ ['], [crSigMvAte]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (sigMvAte)])
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select crEventos
Zap

If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([select a.*, b.descs from SigMvEvt a join SigCdEvt b on a.Cods = b.Cods Where a.EmpDopNums = ']+pcEDN+['], [TmpEve]) < 1)

	Return 0

	Select crEventos
	Append Blank
	replace Descs with TmpEve.Descs, Cods with TmpEve.Cods
	Select TmpEve		
EndScan

Select crEventos
If Reccount() = 0
	Append Blank
EndIf

ThisForm.pagina.dados.cntObs.cntObservacao.cntEventos.gradeeve.Refresh

ENDPROC
