* PROCEDURE opencash
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE opencash
Parameters pcConta, pItens, pDesItem, pFinaliza, pConsulta

Local lcConta, lcDocumento, lnRetOpen, lcToken, lnOldSel, lcRetLim
Store [] To lcConta, lcDocumento, lcToken, lcRetLim
Store 0 To lnRetOpen
lnOldSel = Select()

If !Type([pcConta])=[C]
	Return .F.
Endif

lcRetOpen=[]

Thisform.OpenValorLimiteCash = 0

If crSigCdPac.ChkOpnCsh = 1

	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdi','crSigOpCdi','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

	If Type([crSigOpCdi.chkOpnCsh])=[N] And InList(crSigOpCdi.chkOpnCsh,1,4)

		lcQuery = [Select Iclis,Rclis,Cpfs From SigCdCli Where Iclis = '] + pcConta + [']
		If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [csOpenC]) < 1)
			=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (csOpenC)])
			Return 0
		Endif

		lcConta = Alltrim(csOpenC.Iclis)
		lcDocumento = Alltrim(Strt(Strt(Strt(csOpenC.Cpfs, ".", "" ), "-", "" ), "/", "" ))

		Thisform.OpenPossuiCarteira = .F.
		If Not IsEmpty(lcDocumento)
			lcToken = Thisform.OpenGetToken()
			If Type([lcToken])=[C] And Not IsEmpty(lcToken)
				lcRetOpen=Alltrim(Str(Thisform.OpengetValor(lcToken,lcDocumento),12,2))
				If !Thisform.OpenPossuiCarteira
					=Thisform.OpenCadastraCarteira(lcToken,lcConta)
				Endif

				If pDesItem
					pItens = .F.
				Endif

				If pItens Or pFinaliza Or pDesItem
					lcRetLim = Thisform.openConsultaCash(lcToken,lcDocumento,lcRetOpen, pItens, .F., pFinaliza)
					Thisform.OpenValorLimiteCash = Val(lcRetLim)

					If pItens
						Select TprMvCab
						Replace ValUtiCsh With Thisform.OpenValorLimiteCash In TprMvCab
					Endif

					If pDesItem
						lcRetLim = Thisform.openConsultaCash(lcToken,lcDocumento,lcRetOpen, pItens, pDesItem, pFinaliza)
						Thisform.OpenValorLimiteCash = Val(lcRetLim)
					Endif

					If pFinaliza
						= Thisform.OpenPreFinaliza(lcToken,lcDocumento,lcRetOpen, pItens, pDesItem, pFinaliza)
						=Thisform.OpenFinalizaVenda(lcToken,lcDocumento,lcRetOpen)
					Endif
				Endif
			Else
				=Messagebox([Serviço Indisponivel no Momento!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (OpenCash)])
			Endif
		Endif
	Endif
EndIf 

Select(lnOldSel)

Return lcRetOpen
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE opengetvalor
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE opengetvalor
Parameters cToken, cCpfCnpj

Local cDocumento, cUrl, nRetorno, cRetorno

cDocumento = Alltrim(cCpfCnpj)
cToken = "Bearer "+cToken
cUrl = [https://api.opencashback.io/core/v2/customers/]+cDocumento+[/wallet]

nRetorno = 0

*-- Crie uma instância do objeto WinHTTP
oWinHTTP = Createobject("WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1")

*-- Abra uma conexão com o servidor
oWinHTTP.Open("GET", cUrl)

*-- Adicione o cabeçalho de autorização
oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Authorization", cToken)

Try 
	*-- Envie a solicitação e aguarde a resposta
	oWinHTTP.Send()

	*-- Verifique se a solicitação foi bem-sucedida
	Do Case
	Case InList(oWinHTTP.Status,200,201,204)
		*-- Se a solicitação for bem-sucedida, exiba o conteúdo da resposta
		cRet = oWinHTTP.ResponseText
		cRetorno = StrExtract(cRet,'"balance":',',"pending_balance')
		nRetorno = Val(cRetorno)
		
		ThisForm.OpenPossuiCarteira = .T.
		
	Case oWinHTTP.Status = 404 
		ThisForm.OpenPossuiCarteira = .F.
		
	OtherWise
		*-- Se a solicitação falhar, exiba o status da resposta
		Messagebox("Falha na conexão: " + oWinHTTP.StatusText,48,"GetValor - Erro: "+Alltrim(Str(oWinHTTP.Status)))
	EndCase
Catch

EndTry 
*-- Libere o objeto WinHTTP
Release oWinHTTP

If nRetorno <> 0
	nRetorno = Round(nRetorno / 100,2)
EndIf 
	
Return nRetorno

ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE opengettoken
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE opengettoken
Local cBody, cConta, cSenha, cRetorno
Set Step On 
cConta = ["montecarlo@lemoney.com"]
cSenha = ["0p3nc4$hb4CK"]
cRetorno = []
*-- Defina o corpo da solicitação (payload)
cBody = '{ "email": '+cConta+', "password": '+cSenha+' }'

*-- Defina a URL de destino
cURL = "https://api.opencashback.io/core/v2/auth/login"

*-- Crie uma instância do objeto WinHTTP
oWinHTTP = Createobject("WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1")

*-- Configure a solicitação POST
oWinHTTP.Open("POST", cURL)

*-- Adicione o cabeçalho Content-Type
oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")

Try
	*-- Envie a solicitação com o corpo
	oWinHTTP.Send(cBody)

	*-- Verifique se a solicitação foi bem-sucedida
	If InList(oWinHTTP.Status,200,201,204)
		*-- Se a solicitação for bem-sucedida, exiba o conteúdo da resposta
		cRetorno = oWinHTTP.ResponseText
		cRetorno = Alltrim(Substr(cRetorno,18,44))
	Else
		*-- Se a solicitação falhar, exiba o status da resposta
		Messagebox("Falha na conexão: " + oWinHTTP.StatusText,48,"GetToken - Erro: "+Alltrim(Str(oWinHTTP.Status)))
	Endif
Catch 
	cRetorno = []
EndTry

*-- Libere o objeto WinHTTP
Release oWinHTTP

Return cRetorno
ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE openconsultacash
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE openconsultacash
Parameters cToken, cCpfCnpj, cRetOpen, pItens, pDesItem, pFinaliza

Local cDocumento, cUrl, nRetorno, cRetorno, cRetlimit, nRetLimite

cDocumento = Alltrim(cCpfCnpj)
cToken = "Bearer "+cToken
cRetlimit = []
nRetLimite = 0

pArqCab = Iif(Type('pArqCab')=[C],pArqCab,[TprMvCab])
pArqIte = Iif(Type('pArqIte')=[C],pArqIte,[crTpmMvItn])

* Crie uma instância do objeto WinHTTP
oWinHTTP = CREATEOBJECT("WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1")

* Defina a URL de destino
cURL = "https://api.opencashback.io/core/v2/orders"

* Configure a solicitação POST
oWinHTTP.Open("POST", cURL)

* Adicione o cabeçalho Authorization
oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Authorization", cToken)

lnOldSel = Select()
lnReg = 0
lcItens = []

Select crSigMvItd
Index On cItens Tag cItens 
Go Top

Select crTpmMvItn
Go Top
Scan 
	If Empty(crTpmMvItn.CPros)
		Loop		
	EndIf 
	If crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E'
		Loop		
	EndIf 
	If Empty(crTpmMvItn.Totas)
		Loop		
	EndIf 
	If lnReg = 0
		lcItens = []
	Else
		lcItens = lcItens + [, ]
	EndIf 
	
	lnTotal = crTpmMvItn.Totas
	If Seek(crTpmMvItn.cItens,[crSigMvItd],[cItens])
		If crSigMvItd.cdesc = '40CASHBACK'
			lnTotal = lnTotal + crSigMvItd.vdes
		EndIf 	
	EndIf 
	lcItens = lcItens + '{ "id": "'+Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.CPros)+'", "price": '+Alltrim(Str(lnTotal*100))+', "quantity": '+Alltrim(Str(crTpmMvItn.Qtds))+', "description": "'+Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.Dpros)+'" }'
	lnReg = lnReg + 1
	Select crTpmMvItn
EndScan

Select(lnOldSel)

If Not IsEmpty(lcItens)
	* Defina o corpo da solicitação (payload)
	cBody = '{ "external_id": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Emps)+[ ]+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes)+[ ]+Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))+Sys(2015)+'", '+;
			'"items": [ '+lcItens+;
			'], "document": "'+cDocumento+'"'+;
			', "total": '+Alltrim(Str((TprMvCab.Valos)*100))+''+;
			', "discount": 0'+;
			', "delivery_date": "'+Alltrim(Dtoc(TprMvCab.Datas,1))+'"'+;
			', "filial": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Emps)+'"'+;
			', "seller": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Vends)+'"'+;
			', "origin": "pdv"'+;
			', "channel": "store" }'

	* Defina o tipo de conteúdo
	oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
	
	Try 
		* Envie a solicitação com o corpo
		oWinHTTP.Send(cBody)

		* Verifique se a solicitação foi bem-sucedida
		IF InList(oWinHTTP.Status,200,201)
		    * Se a solicitação for bem-sucedida, exiba o conteúdo da resposta
			cRet = oWinHTTP.ResponseText

			cRetReceived = Alltrim(Str(Round(Val(StrExtract(cRet,'"cashback_received":',',"cashback_limit')) / 100,2),12,2))
			cRetlimit = Alltrim(Str(Round(Val(StrExtract(cRet,'"cashback_limit":','}')) / 100,2),12,2))
			
			If pItens
				lcMsg = [Saldo de Bônus Atual: $ ] + cRetOpen + Chr(13)
				lcMsg = lcMsg + [Saldo Limite para Utilizar: $ ] +cRetlimit+ Chr(13)
				lcMsg = lcMsg + [Saldo Gerado Previsto: $ ] +cRetReceived+ Chr(13)
				
				=MessageBox(lcMsg,0+64,[Atenção])
			EndIf 
				
			If pDesItem
				=ThisForm.OpenAplicaDesconto(cRet)
			EndIf 
		ELSE
		    * Se a solicitação falhar, exiba o status da resposta
		    Messagebox("Falha na conexão: " + oWinHTTP.StatusText,48,"ConsultaCash - Erro: "+Alltrim(Str(oWinHTTP.Status)))
		EndIf
	Catch
	
	EndTry 
EndIf 

* Libere o objeto WinHTTP
RELEASE oWinHTTP
	
Return cRetlimit

ENDPROC

		', "delivery_date": "'+Alltrim(Dtoc(TprMvCab.Datas,1))+'"'+;
		', "filial": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Emps)+'"'+;
		', "seller": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Vends)+'"'+;
		', "origin": "pdv"'+;
		', "channel": "store" '+;
		', "status": "'+Iif(llCancela,'cancelled','done')+'"'+;
		', "cashback": '+Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.ValUtiCsh*100))+''+;
		', "payment_methods": [ '+lcParcelas+']}'

* Defina o tipo de conteúdo
oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")

Try 
	* Envie a solicitação com o corpo
	oWinHTTP.Send(cBody)

	* Verifique se a solicitação foi bem-sucedida
	IF InList(oWinHTTP.Status,200,201)
	    * Se a solicitação for bem-sucedida, exiba o conteúdo da resposta
		cRet = oWinHTTP.ResponseText
	ELSE
	    * Se a solicitação falhar, exiba o status da resposta
	    Messagebox("Falha na conexão: " + oWinHTTP.StatusText,48,"FinalizaVenda - Erro: "+Alltrim(Str(oWinHTTP.Status)))
	ENDIF
Catch

EndTry 

* Libere o objeto WinHTTP
RELEASE oWinHTTP

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE openaplicadesconto
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE openaplicadesconto
Parameters pcJson

Local objJSON
objJSON = Createobject("JSON")

lnLimCash = Thisform.OpenValorLimiteCash
lnVlrCash = TprMvCab.ValUtiCsh
lcEmp = TprMvCab.emps
lnTotResc = 0
lnPropor = 0
lnTotQty = 0

*** mena - 02/04/2017 - seleciona tabelas habilitadas na operação***
lcQuery = [Select a.* from SigOpTdz a, SigCdTbd c where a.codigos = c.codigos and c.dopes = ']+TprMvCab.dopes+[' and a.tpdesc <> 0]
If (Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crDesc]) < 1)
	=Messagebox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crDesc)])
	Return .F.
Endif

*** mena - 02/04/2017 - tabela 11 precisa estar habilitadas na empresa***
Delete From crDesc Where tpDesc = 11 And !listaemp Like [%]+lcEmp+[%]

Select 0 As selecao, 000000000.00 As valdes, descos As descosmax, * From crDesc  Order By Codigos Into Cursor crDesc Readwrite
Replace All descos With 0.00 In crDesc

Select *, Space(10) As usuars From crDesc where codigos = '40CASHBACK' Into Cursor localDes Readwrite
Select localDes

If Used([csItenJson])
	Use In csItenJson
Endif

If Used([crSigMvItd])
	Zap In crSigMvItd
Endif

lcJson = Alltrim(Strextract(pcJson,'[',']'))
lcJson = '['+lcJson+']'

Create Cursor csItenJson(Quantity N(10),Id c(20), Price N(10), Description c(100), Accumulation N(10), Rescue N(10))

Select csItenJson
Index On Id Tag Id
Go Top

objJSON.ToCursor(lcJson, "csItenJson")
Select csItenJson
Go Top

Select Sum(Rescue) As TotDesc, Sum(Quantity) as Qtds ;
from csItenJson Into Cursor csTotResc Readwrite

lnTotResc = Nvl(TotDesc,0)
lnTotQty = Nvl(Qtds,0)

If Not Empty(lnTotResc)
	lnTotResc = Round(lnTotResc / 100,2)
Endif

If lnTotResc > 0 And lnVlrCash > 0
	lnPropor = (lnVlrCash / lnLimCash)
Endif

Select csItenJson
Go Top
Scan

	If Empty(csItenJson.Rescue)
		Loop
	EndIf
	
	lnValDesc = Round(((csItenJson.Rescue / 100) * lnPropor),2)
	
	lnpDes = 0
	If lnPropor > 0 and lnTotQty > 0
		lnpDes = Round(((lnPropor * 100) / lnTotQty),2)
	EndIf 
	
	If Seek(Padr(Alltrim(csItenJson.Id),14,[ ]),[crTpmMvItn],[Cpros])
	
		lcIdChave = fUniqueIds()
		Insert Into crSigMvItd(citens, emps, dopes, numes, cpros, cidchaves, empdopnums, dtalts, cdesc, ddesc, pdes, vdes, valbase, tpDesc, codigo, usuars) ;
		Values(crTpmMvItn.citens, TprMvCab.emps, TprMvCab.dopes, TprMvCab.numes, crTpmMvItn.cpros, lcIdChave, TprMvCab.empdopnums, Datetime(), ;
		localDes.Codigos, localDes.descrs, lnpDes, lnValDesc, crTpmMvItn.unitorigs, localDes.tpDesc, crSigcdDes.codigo, localDes.usuars )
		ThisForm.OpenCashPossuiDesconto = .T.
	EndIf 

	Select csItenJson
Endscan

Select crTpmMvItn
Go Top
Scan 
	ThisForm.Calc_ValIte(.f.,.f.,.t.)
	Select crTpmMvItn
EndScan 

ThisForm.totite=fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.Podatamgr)
ThisForm.AtuaTot()


ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE openprefinaliza
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE openprefinaliza
Parameters cToken, cCpfCnpj, cRetOpen, pItens, pDesItem, pFinaliza

Local cDocumento, cUrl, nRetorno, cRetorno, cRetlimit, nRetLimite

cDocumento = Alltrim(cCpfCnpj)
cToken = "Bearer "+cToken
cRetlimit = []
nRetLimite = 0

pArqCab = Iif(Type('pArqCab')=[C],pArqCab,[TprMvCab])
pArqIte = Iif(Type('pArqIte')=[C],pArqIte,[crTpmMvItn])

* Crie uma instância do objeto WinHTTP
oWinHTTP = CREATEOBJECT("WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1")

* Defina a URL de destino
cURL = "https://api.opencashback.io/core/v2/orders"

* Configure a solicitação POST
oWinHTTP.Open("POST", cURL)

* Adicione o cabeçalho Authorization
oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Authorization", cToken)

lnOldSel = Select()

Select crSigMvItd
Index On cItens Tag cItens 
Go Top

lnReg = 0
lcItens = []

Select crTpmMvItn
Go Top
Scan 
	If Empty(crTpmMvItn.CPros)
		Loop		
	EndIf 
	If crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E'
		Loop		
	EndIf 
	If Empty(crTpmMvItn.Totas)
		Loop		
	EndIf 
	If lnReg = 0
		lcItens = []
	Else
		lcItens = lcItens + [, ]
	EndIf 
	lnTotal = crTpmMvItn.Totas
	If Seek(crTpmMvItn.cItens,[crSigMvItd],[cItens])
		If crSigMvItd.cdesc = '40CASHBACK'
			lnTotal = lnTotal + crSigMvItd.vdes
		EndIf 	
	EndIf 
	lcItens = lcItens + '{ "id": "'+Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.CPros)+'", "price": '+Alltrim(Str(lnTotal*100))+', "quantity": '+Alltrim(Str(crTpmMvItn.Qtds))+', "description": "'+Alltrim(crTpmMvItn.Dpros)+'" }'
	lnReg = lnReg + 1
	Select crTpmMvItn
EndScan

Select(lnOldSel)

If Not IsEmpty(lcItens)
	* Defina o corpo da solicitação (payload)
	cBody = '{ "external_id": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.EmpDopNums)+'", '+;
			'"items": [ '+lcItens+;
			'], "document": "'+cDocumento+'"'+;
			', "total": '+Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.Valos*100))+''+;
			', "discount": 0'+;
			', "delivery_date": "'+Alltrim(Dtoc(TprMvCab.Datas,1))+'"'+;
			', "filial": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Emps)+'"'+;
			', "seller": "'+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Vends)+'"'+;
			', "origin": "pdv"'+;
			', "channel": "store" }'

	* Defina o tipo de conteúdo
	oWinHTTP.SetRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
	Try 
	* Envie a solicitação com o corpo
	oWinHTTP.Send(cBody)

	* Verifique se a solicitação foi bem-sucedida
	IF InList(oWinHTTP.Status,200,201)
	    * Se a solicitação for bem-sucedida, exiba o conteúdo da resposta
		cRet = oWinHTTP.ResponseText
	ELSE
	    * Se a solicitação falhar, exiba o status da resposta
	    Messagebox("Falha na conexão: " + oWinHTTP.StatusText,48,"PreFinaliza - Erro: "+Alltrim(Str(oWinHTTP.Status)))
	EndIf
	Catch
	
	EndTry 
EndIf 
* Libere o objeto WinHTTP
RELEASE oWinHTTP

Return cRetlimit

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE KeyPress
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE KeyPress
Lparameters nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl

Local loGrupo, loDados, lnFpagina

m.loGrupo   = This.pagina.lista.grupo_op
m.loDados   = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
m.lnFpagina = This.pagina.ActivePage

Do Case
	Case m.nKeyCode==13 And m.lnFpagina==1 And Upper(This.ActiveControl.BaseClass)=='PAGE' && Enter
		NoDefault

	Case m.nKeyCode==-1 And m.lnFpagina==1 And ThisForm.plAcInserir && F2
		NoDefault
		m.loGrupo.Click( 1 )
	Case m.nKeyCode==-1 And m.lnFpagina==2 And m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.btnCadastros.Visible && F2
		NoDefault
		m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.btnCadastros.Click()

	Case m.nKeyCode==13 And m.lnFpagina==1 And Upper(This.pagina.lista.ActiveControl.BaseClass)=='GRID' && Enter
		NoDefault
		m.loGrupo.Click( 2 )

	Case m.nKeyCode==-2 And m.lnFpagina==1 And ThisForm.plAcalterar   && F3
		NoDefault
		m.loGrupo.Click( 3 )
	Case m.nKeyCode==-2 And m.lnFpagina==2 And m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.btnCadastros.Visible && F3
		NoDefault
		m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.btnCadastros.Click()

	Case m.nKeyCode==-3 And m.lnFpagina==1 And ThisForm.plAcexcluir  && F4
		NoDefault
		m.loGrupo.Click( 4 )
	Case m.nKeyCode==-3 And m.lnFpagina==2 And m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Bot_Consulta.Visible && F4
		NoDefault
		m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Bot_Consulta.Click()

	Case m.nKeyCode==-4 And m.lnFpagina==1  && F5
		NoDefault
		m.loGrupo.Click( 5 )
	Case m.nKeyCode==-4 And m.lnFpagina==2 And m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Bot_Consulta.Visible && F5
		NoDefault
		m.loDados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Bot_Consulta.Click()

	Case m.nKeyCode==-5 And m.lnFpagina==1 And ThisForm.plAclistar  && F6
		NoDefault
		m.loGrupo.Click( 6 )
EndCase

ENDPROC

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE mativapagina1
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE mativapagina1
Lparameters pAtivaPg

Private pVdr, lcEDNss

pVdr = 'ZZZZZZZZZZ'

If ThisForm.plativapagina1 &&And Not ThisForm._pPagamento	
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
	ThisForm.poDataMgr2.RollBack()
	ThisForm.poDataMgr3.RollBack()
	ThisForm.poDataMgr4.RollBack()

	ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.btnAguarde.Visible = .t.
	ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.btnAguarde.Refresh
	ThisForm.Draw

	llDatai = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Dt_inicial.Value
	llDataf = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Dt_final.Value
	llDatai = fDtoSQL(llDatai)
	llDataf = fDtoSQL(llDataf,'23:59:59')
	lcEmpr  = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Get_cd_empresa.Value

	

	If ThisForm._pconsulta Or ThisForm.pAlterar
		lcEDNss = ThisForm.pemps + _Dope + Str(ThisForm.pNumes,6)
	Else && inserção
		lcEDNss = []
	EndIf

	With ThisForm.Pagina.Lista
		If .cntFiltros.Op_Ordem.Value = 1
			llCmbt = .t.
			llCmbf = .f.
		Else
			If .cntFiltros.Op_Ordem.Value = 2
				llCmbt = .f.
				llCmbf = .f.
			Else
				llCmbt = .t.
				llcmbf = .t.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndWith

	With ThisForm.Pagina.Lista
		If .cntFiltros.Op_Pago.Value = 1
			llPagot = .t.
			llPagof = .f.
		Else
			If .cntFiltros.Op_Pago.Value = 2
				llPagot = .f.
				llPagof = .f.
			Else
				llPagot = .t.
				llPagof = .t.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndWith

	DoDefault()

	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Requery('ListaEest')
	Select ListaEest
	Index On Emps + Dopes + notas Tag Dopem
	Index On Emps + Dopes + Grupoos + Contaos + Str(numes,6) Tag EmpdopOri
	Index On Emps + Dopes + Grupods + Contads + Str(numes,6) Tag EmpdopDes
	Index On EmpDopNums Tag EmpDopNums

	ThisForm.LimparJobs() && 31/07/2014 - Richard

	Select ListaEest
	Go Top
	Set Order To EmpDopNums

	If ThisForm.LocRegister > 0
		Set Near On
		Seek ThisForm.pEmps + _Dope + Str(ThisForm.Locregister,6)
		Set Near Off
	EndIf
	If !Empty( ThisForm.Ordenação )
		Set Order To ThisForm.Ordenação
	Else
		Set Order To EmpDopNums
	EndIf

	ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.btnAguarde.Visible = .f.

	ThisForm.antempr  = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Get_cd_empresa.Value
	ThisForm.Antdtini = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.dt_Inicial.Value
	ThisForm.AntDtfin = ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Dt_final.Value

	ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Enabled = .t.

	If Not ThisForm.plAutoinclusao Or pAtivaPg
		ThisForm.Pagina.ActivePage = 1
		ThisForm.KeyPreview = .t.
	EndIf

	If Not crSigCdPam.BlqmEmps And ThisForm.Ultoperacao = 'INSERIR'
		ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.cntFiltros.Cnt_periodo.Get_cd_empresa.SetFocus
	EndIf
EndIf

on key label CTRL+M fChamarPaf() && Tiago - 04/01/2011

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE msv_alterar
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE msv_alterar
Local llOk

lcDoppe = crSigOpCdc.DopeNfs
If ( ( crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 1 And Not Empty(lcDoppe) ) Or crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2 )
	If ThisForm.Excluir()
		ThisForm.msv_inserir()
	EndIf
Else
	IF ThisForm.Excluir() And ThisForm.TransfAuto() And ThisForm.Inserir()

		llOk = SqlCalcp2(.t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm)

		If llOk
			llOk = fRecalculaS( .t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,Thisform)
		EndIf
		If llOk
			llOk = fRecalculaC(.t.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,ThisForm)
		EndIf

		If llOk
			llOk = (ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0 )
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0 And llOk
				llOk = ( ThisForm.poDataMgr6.Commit() > 0 )
			EndIf
		EndIf

		If Not llOk
			ThisForm.LimpaCursor(.t.)
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
				ThisForm.poDataMgr6.RollBack()
			EndIf
			MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a alteracao. tente novamente!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
			ThisForm.retorna = .f.
		EndIf
	Else
		ThisForm.LimpaCursor(.t.)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
			ThisForm.poDataMgr6.RollBack()
		EndIf
		MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a alteracao. tente novamente!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
		ThisForm.retorna = .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE msv_excluir
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE msv_excluir
Lparameters pPulaECF
Local llOk, lcExc

lcExc = TprMvCab.EmpDopNums

If ThisForm.Excluir(.t.,pPulaECF) 
	llOk = .t.
	If Not ThisForm.poDataMgr.UpDate('crSigExMvc')
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (update crSigExMvc)')
		llOk = .f.
	EndIf

	If llOk And Not ThisForm.poDataMgr.UpDate('crSigExMvi')
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (update crSigExMvi)')
		llOk = .f.
	EndIf

	If Not ThisForm.poDataMgr.UpDate('crSigExMvp')
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (update crSigExMvp)')
		llOk = .f.
	EndIf

	lcDelete = [Delete From SigOpArq Where fkChaves = '] + Padr(lcExc, 30) + [']
	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcDelete,'')
	IF lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Delete SigOpArq)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
		
	If llOk
		llOK = SqlCalcp2(.t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm)
	EndIf
	If llOk
		llOk = fRecalculaS( .t.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,Thisform)
	EndIf
	If llOk
		llOk = fRecalculaC(.t.,.f.,.f.,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.f.,ThisForm)
	EndIf
	If llOk
		llOk = ( ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0 )
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0 And llOk
			llOk = ( ThisForm.poDataMgr6.commit() > 0 )
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If Not llOk
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
			ThisForm.poDataMgr6.RollBack()
		EndIf
		MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a alteracao. tente novamente!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
		ThisForm.retorna = .f.
	EndIf
ELSE
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
		ThisForm.poDataMgr6.RollBack()
	EndIf
	MessageBox('Nao foi possivel completar a alteracao. tente novamente!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
	ThisForm.retorna = .f.
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE msv_inserir
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE msv_inserir
Local llOk, lcDoppe, llTaOk, lnTentativa, lcEDN, llgNf

lnTentativa = 0

Do While lnTentativa < 3

	lnTentativa = lnTentativa + 1

	If Thisform.Inserir()

		llTaOk = .T.

		If Not (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))

			Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.Caption = 'Gravando Dados...'

			llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaS( .T.,Thisform.poDataMgr,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,Thisform)
			llTaOk = llTaOk And SqlCalcp2(.T.,Thisform.poDataMgr,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,Thisform)
			llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaC(.T.,.F.,.F.,Thisform.poDataMgr,.F.,Thisform)

		Else

			Wait Window 'Executando Gravação Fisica dos arquivos ' Nowait

			llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaS( .T.,Thisform.poDataMgr)
			llTaOk = llTaOk And SqlCalcp2(.T.,Thisform.poDataMgr)
			llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaC(.T.,.F.,.F.,Thisform.poDataMgr)

		Endif

		If llTaOk

			*--- Rafael - 05/05/2017 - Quando tem movimentação automatica na observação, gera as automaticas para o que esta na observação
			If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.CodObs)
				lcQuery = [Select a.Abrevs, b.MovAutDop from SigCdOpe a join SigCdObs b on a.Dopes = b.MovAutDop Where b.codigos = ]+Str(TprMvCab.CodObs)
				If Thisform.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[csTmpAbrev]) < 1
					Messagebox([Favor reinciar o processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (csTmpAbrev)])
					Return .F.
				Endif
				Select csTmpAbrev
				If Reccount([csTmpAbrev])>0 And Not IsEmpty(csTmpAbrev.Abrevs)

					lcAbrvs = csTmpAbrev.Abrevs

					Select crSigOpCdc
					Replace GerOpes With 1 ,;
					DopeNfs With csTmpAbrev.MovAutDop In crSigOpCdc
				Endif
			EndIf

			If Type([crSigOpCdi.chkOpnCsh])=[N] And InList(crSigOpCdi.chkOpnCsh,1,3,4)
				=ThisForm.OpenCash(TprMvCab.Contads, .F., .F., .T. )
			EndIf 
			
			lnTentativa = 3
			lcDoppe = crSigOpCdc.DopeNfs
			=Thisform.LimpaCursor(.T.)

			llgNf = .T.
			If ( ( Inlist(crSigOpCdc.GerOpes,1,5) And Not Empty(lcDoppe) ) Or crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2 ) And llgNf
				If Thisform.Gerarnota(lcDoppe)
					lnLoop = .F.
					Do While Not lnLoop

						If Not (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))

							Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.Caption = 'Gravando Dados'

							llTaOk = llTaOk And SqlCalcp2(.T.,Thisform.poDataMgr,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,Thisform)
							llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaS( .T.,Thisform.poDataMgr,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,Thisform)
							llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaC(.T.,.F.,.F.,Thisform.poDataMgr,.F.,Thisform)
							llTaOk = llTaOk And Thisform.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0

						Else

							Wait Window 'Executando Gravação Fisica dos arquivos ' Nowait

							llTaOk = llTaOk And SqlCalcp2(.T.,Thisform.poDataMgr)
							llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaS( .T.,Thisform.poDataMgr)
							llTaOk = llTaOk And fRecalculaC(.T.,.F.,.F.,Thisform.poDataMgr)
							llTaOk = llTaOk And Thisform.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0
							If Thisform.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0 And llTaOk
								llTaOk = Thisform.poDataMgr6.Commit() > 0
								If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
									llTaOk = .T.
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif

						If Not llTaOk
							Thisform.poDataMgr.Rollback()
							If Thisform.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
								Thisform.poDataMgr6.Rollback()
							Endif
							If Messagebox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração da Movimentação '+Alltrim(lcDoppe)+'. Tentar Novamente!!',4+32,'Falha na Conexão') = 7

								Select crSigMvNfi
								Go Top
								=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',&_pCursor..Dopes)
								If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !Eof( 'crSigMvNfi' )
									=fCanUniqueKey( Val( crSigMvNfi.NFis ), &_pCursor..Emps + "NOTA FISCAL" + crSigMvNfi.Series )
									=fCanUniqueKey( crSigMvNfi.Selos, &_pCursor..Emps + 'SELO NOTA FISCAL' + crSigMvNfi.Series )
								Endif

								Messagebox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração da Movimentação '+Alltrim(lcDoppe)+'. Gere Pelo Processo Manual!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
								lnLoop = .T.
							Endif
						Else
							lnLoop = .T.
						Endif
					Enddo
				Else
					Thisform.poDataMgr.Rollback()

					If ( crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 1 And Not Empty(lcDoppe) )
						Select crSigMvNfi
						Go Top
						=Thisform.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',&_pCursor..Dopes)
						If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !Eof( 'crSigMvNfi' )
							=fCanUniqueKey( Val( crSigMvNfi.NFis ), &_pCursor..Emps + "NOTA FISCAL" + crSigMvNfi.Series )
							=fCanUniqueKey( crSigMvNfi.Selos, &_pCursor..Emps + 'SELO NOTA FISCAL' + crSigMvNfi.Series )
						Endif
						Messagebox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração da Movimentação '+Alltrim(lcDoppe)+'. Gere Pelo Processo Manual!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
					Else
						Messagebox('Nao foi possivel completar a Geração das Movimentações Filhos. Favor Gerar Novamente o processo!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
					Endif
				Endif
			EndIf
			
		Endif

		llTaOk = llTaOk And Thisform.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0
		If Thisform.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0 And llTaOk
			llTaOk = Thisform.poDataMgr6.Commit() > 0
			If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
				llTaOk = .T.
			Endif
		EndIf
		
		If Not llTaOk
			Thisform.LimpaCursor(.T.)
			Thisform.poDataMgr.Rollback()
			If Thisform.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
				Thisform.poDataMgr6.Rollback()
			Endif
			If lnTentativa = 3
				Thisform.retorna = .F.
				Messagebox('Nao foi possivel completar a alteracao. tente novamente!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
			Endif
		Endif
	Else
		Thisform.retorna = .F.
		lnTentativa = 3
		Thisform.LimpaCursor(.T.)
		Thisform.poDataMgr.Rollback()
		Messagebox('Nao foi possivel completar a alteracao. tente novamente!!',16,'Falha na Conexão')
	Endif
Enddo
Return

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE msv_procurar
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE msv_procurar
Select ListaEest
Set Near On
Do Case
	Case !Empty( TprMvCab.MascNum )
		lnNumero = fRetornaInt( Alltrim( TprMvCab.MascNum ) )
		Set Order to EmpDopNums
		Seek ThisForm.pEmps + _Dope + Str( lnNumero, 6 )
		
	Case !Empty( TprMvCab.Notas )
		Set Order to Dopem
		Seek ThisForm.pEmps + _Dope + TprMvCab.Notas

	Case (!Empty( TprMvCab.Grupoos ) AND !crSigCdOpe.FixGOrigs) OR (!EMPTY(TprMvCab.Contaos) AND !crSigCdOpe.FixCorigs )
		Set Order to EmpDopOri
		Seek ThisForm.pEmps + _Dope + TprMvCab.Grupoos + Alltrim( TprMvCab.Contaos )
	
	Case !Empty( TprMvCab.Grupods )
		Set Order to EmpDopDes
		Seek ThisForm.pEmps + _Dope + TprMvCab.Grupods + Alltrim( TprMvCab.Contads )
	
Endcase
Set Near Off
ThisForm.LocRegister = Numes

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE Release
If Not InList(Type('ThisForm.antform.poFormEEst1'),'U','N')
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
	ThisForm.poDataMgr2.RollBack()
	ThisForm.poDataMgr3.RollBack()
	ThisForm.poDataMgr4.RollBack()
*	ThisForm.antform.poFormEEst1 = ThisForm
	ThisForm.Hide
	ThisForm.Enabled = .f.
	ThisForm.antform.Enabled = .t.
	NoDefault 
Else 
	ThisForm.poDataMgr.Release
	ThisForm.poDataMgr2.Release
	ThisForm.poDataMgr3.Release
	ThisForm.poDataMgr4.Release
	dodefault()
EndIf

If (Type([ThisForm.AntForm])=[O]) And Not IsNull(ThisForm.AntForm)
	ThisForm.AntForm.Enabled = .T.
	ThisForm.AntForm.KeyPreview=.t.
EndIf

*!*	EndIf
	
ENDPROC

PROCEDURE pagina.lista.grade.AfterRowColChange
LPARAMETERS nColIndex

If Usuar <> '4CONTROL'
	ldData = Date()
	ldDataMov = Iif(Type([ListaEest.datas])=[T],Ttod(ListaEest.datas),ListaEest.datas)

	ThisForm.poDataMgr.SQLExecute([Select Supervis From SigCdUsu Where Usuarios = '] + Usuar + ['], [crUsuario])
	Select crUsuario
	Go Top In crUsuario	
		
	lcImp = Iif(crUsuario.Supervis = [S], [i], [n])

	If Not IsEmpty(ldData) And Not IsEmpty(ldDataMov) And lcImp <> 'i'
		If ldData <> ldDataMov
			If fChecaAcesso( padl(crSigCdOpe.nDopes,8,'0'), 'BLQALTMOV' )
				This.parent.grupo_op.Alterar.Enabled = .F.
			EndIf 
		Else
			This.parent.grupo_op.Alterar.Enabled = fChecaAcesso(padl(crSigCdOpe.nDopes,8,'0'), [ALTERAR])
		EndIf
	EndIf 
EndIf 

 
ENDPROC

	Endif

	If ok &&Verifica cheques -*
		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Nums From SigCqChm Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CsCheques') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsCheques)')
			ok = .F.
		Else
			Select CsCheques
			Scan
				lcNum = CsCheques.Nums
				If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCqChm Where Nums = ?lcNum Order By Nums, DtSis Desc ],'Crtmpchm') < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpChm)')
					ok = .F.
					Exit
				Endif
				Select CrtmpChm
				Go Top
				If Not ( CrtmpChm.Emps + CrtmpChm.Dopes + Str(CrtmpChm.NumDopes,6) = _Posicao )
					Messagebox('Cheque: ' + CrtmpChm.Bancos + '-' + CrtmpChm.Agencias + '-' + CrtmpChm.nContas + '-' + CrtmpChm.ncheques + ' Apresenta Movimentação ... ',48,'Ultima Movimentação do Cheque: ' + CrtmpChm.Codigos)
					ok = .F.
					Exit
				Endif
				Select CsCheques
			Endscan
		Endif
	Endif

	*-- Validação quando for TEF nao deixar alterar por pode ter parcela integrada
	If ok  And crSigCdPam.SisTef = 1 && Verifica parcela -*
		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrtmpPar') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPar)')
			ok = .F.
		Else
			Select CrtmpPar
			Scan
				lcMsg = ''
				Do Case
				Case Not IsEmpty(CrtmpPar.DPags) And crSigCdOpe.COpers = 2
					lcMsg = 'Movimentação Possui Cartão de Crédito já depositado ou Baixado ... '

				Case Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',CrtmpPar.Fpags) And (crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1) And (CrtmpPar.VPags - CrtmpPar.Valocurs # 0)
					If Thisform.ChecaCondPar()
						lcMsg = 'Parcela ' + Upper(Alltrim(CrtmpPar.Fpags)) + ' ' + Alltrim(Transf(CrtmpPar.Valos,'@Z 999,999,999.99')) + ' Já Paga ... '
					Endif
				Endcase

				If Not Empty(lcMsg)
					Messagebox( lcMsg, 48, 'Movimentação Com Parcelas Pagas')
					ok = .F.
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif

		*- Verifica cartao -*
		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdCtt Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTmpCart') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCart)')
			ok = .F.
		Else
			Select crtmpCart
			Scan
				If !IsEmpty(crtmpCart.Recebidos) &&Or !IsEmpty(crtmpCart.Dt_Deposit)
					ok = .F.
					Messagebox('Movimentação possui Cartão de Crédito c/ movimento !!',0+48,'')
					Exit
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif
	Endif

	If ok && Verifica Lançamentos Conta Corrente Já Baixados -*
		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Distinct Emps, Nopers, Hists From SigMvCcr Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CsMccrBx') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CsMccrBx)')
			ok = .F.
		Else
			Select csMccrBx
			Scan
				lcEmp = csMccrBx.Emps
				lnOper= csMccrBx.Nopers
				If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdPit Where Emps = ?lcEmp And Nopers = ?lnOper And Dopes <> 'FECHAMENTO' ],'CrtmpPrit') < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPrit)')
					ok = .F.
				Else
					Select CrTmpPrit
					If Reccount() > 0
						ok = .F.
						Messagebox( Alltrim(CrTmpPrit.Hists) + ' No Valor de ' + Alltrim(Str(CrTmpPrit.Valos,12,2)) + ' ' + Alltrim(CrTmpPrit.Moedas) + ' Já Baixado.', 48, 'Lançamento de Conta Corrente Já Baixado')
						Exit
					Endif
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif
	Endif

	** Verifica se existe subnivel
	If ( crSigMvCab.ChkSubn=.T. Or (crSigMvCab.ChkBxParcs=.T. And crSigOpCdc.nItemBxs <> 1)) And Not Inlist(crSigOpCdc.GerOpes,1,2,5) And ok
		ok=.F.
		Messagebox('Movimentação já foi baixada!!!',0+48,'')
	Endif

	If ok And crSigMvCab.ValoBxs # 0
		Messagebox('Movimentação Com Valor Baixado.', 48, lcCaption )
		ok = .F.
	Endif

	If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTprMvCabi') < 1
		Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCabi)')
		ok = .F.
	Endif

	If !crSigMvCab.ChkSubn And ok && Verifica se tem Quantidade Baixada
		Select CrTprMvCabi
		Scan
			If CrTprMvCabi.QtBaixas # 0 And crSigOpCdc.nItemBxs <> 1
				ok = .F.
				Exit
			Endif
		Endscan
		If !ok
			Messagebox('Movimentação apresenta item(ns) já Baixado(s)!!!',0+48,'')
		Endif
	Endif

	If crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And ok And crSigOpCdc.nItemBxs <> 1
		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvIts Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTmpEsti2') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEsti2)')
			ok = .F.
		Else
			If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select EmpDnCrds, EmpDopNums From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+lcEDN+['], 'CsTmpTrfs') < 1)
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CsTmpTrfs)')
				Return .F.
			Endif
			Select CsTmpTrfs
			Index On EmpDopNums Tag EmpDopNums

			Select crTmpEsti2
			Index On Citens Tag Citens

			Select CrTprMvCabi
			Scan
				If !Empty(CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras)
					lnBarra = CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras
					If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, Cbars From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ?lnBarra ],'CrtmpEti')< 1
						Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEti)')
						ok = .F.
						Exit
					Else
						Select CrtmpEti
						llEtiOk = ( Reccount() > 0 )
						If Not llEtiOk
							Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras, 14 ) + ' Não Consta no Cadastro de Etiquetas.', 48, 'Código de Etiqueta Inconsistente')
							ok = .F.
							Exit
						Else
							If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select CodBarras, Datas, Emps, Dopes, Numes, EmpDopNums, Opers From SigMvHst Where CodBarras = ?lnBarra Order By CodBarras, Seqs Desc],'CrTmpHis') < 1
								Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpHis 3)')
								ok = .F.
								Exit
							Else
								Select crTmphis
								Go Top
								If Reccount() > 0
									llHisOk = ( crTmphis.EmpDopNums = _Posicao Or ;
										( Inlist(crSigCdOpe.transs,3,5) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'E' And crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
										( crSigCdOpe.transs = 3 And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'S' And crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Emps + crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
										( crSigCdOpe.transs = 1 And Not Empty(crSigMvCab.Empds) And crSigMvCab.Empds # crSigMvCab.Emps And crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
										( crSigCdOpe.transs = 5 And Seek(crTmphis.EmpDopNums,'CsTmpTrfs','EmpDopNums') ) )
									If Not llHisOk
										Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras, 14 ) + ' já Foi Movimentada.', 48, 'Última Movimentação: ' + ;
											AllTrim(crTmphis.Emps) + ' ' + Alltrim(crTmphis.Dopes) + ' ' + ;
											AllTrim(Str(crTmphis.Numes,6)))
										ok = .F.
										Exit
									Endif
								Else
									If (CrtmpEti.Emps # crSigMvCab.Emps ) Or ;
											( CrtmpEti.Dopes # crSigMvCab.Dopes ) Or ( CrtmpEti.Numes # crSigMvCab.Numes )
										Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( CrTprMvCabi.CodBarras, 14 ) + ' sem Histórico.', 48, 'Última Movimentação Não Encontrada')
										ok = .F.
										Exit
									Endif
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Else
					lcProcura2 = CrTprMvCabi.Citens
					Select crTmpEsti2
					Set Order To Citens
					Seek ( lcProcura2 )
					Scan While Citens = lcProcura2
						If !Empty( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras )
							lnBarra = crTmpEsti2.CodBarras
							If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, Cbars From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ?lnBarra ],'crtmpEti') < 1
								Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEti 2)')
								ok = .F.
								Exit
							Else
								Select CrtmpEti
								llEtiOk = ( Reccount() > 0 )
								If Not llEtiOk
									Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras, 14 ) + ' Não Consta no Cadastro de Etiquetas.', 48, 'Código de Etiqueta Inconsistente')
									ok = .F.
									Exit
								Else
									If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select CodBarras, Datas, Emps, Dopes, Numes, EmpDopNums, Opers From SigMvHst Where CodBarras = ?lnBarra Order By CodBarras, Seqs Desc ],'crtmpHis') < 1
										Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpHis 4)')
										ok = .F.
										Exit
									Else
										Select crTmphis
										Go Top
										If Reccount() > 0
											llHisOk = ( crTmphis.EmpDopNums = _Posicao Or ;
												( Inlist(crSigCdOpe.transs,3,5) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'E' And ;
												crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
												( crSigCdOpe.transs = 3 And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs) And crTmphis.Opers = 'S' And ;
												crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Emps + crSigCdOpe.DopeETrfs + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) Or ;
												( crSigCdOpe.transs = 1 And Not Empty(crSigMvCab.Empds) And crSigMvCab.Empds # crSigMvCab.Emps And ;
												crTmphis.EmpDopNums = crSigMvCab.Empds + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str(crSigMvCab.Numes,6) ) )
											If Not llHisOk
												Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras, 14 ) + ;
													' já Foi Movimentada.', 48, 'Última Movimentação: ' + ;
													AllTrim(crTmphis.Emps) + ' ' + Alltrim(crTmphis.Dopes) + ' ' + ;
													AllTrim(Str(crTmphis.Numes,6)))
												ok = .F.
												Exit
											Endif
										Else
											If ( CrtmpEti.Emps # crSigMvCab.Emps ) Or ( CrtmpEti.Dopes # crSigMvCab.Dopes ) Or ( CrtmpEti.Numes # crSigMvCab.Numes )
												Messagebox( 'A Etiqueta de Código ' + Str( crTmpEsti2.CodBarras, 14 ) + ' sem Histórico.', 48, 'Última Movimentação Não Encontrada')
												ok = .F.
												Exit
											Endif
										Endif
									Endif
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
						Select crTmpEsti2
					Endscan
				Endif
				Select CrTprMvCabi
			Endscan
		Endif
	Endif

	*-- Rafael - 27/02/2018 - Valida se os barras das movimentações automaticas foram movimentados
	If Type([crSigOpCdd.ChkBarAuto])<>'N' or Type([crSigOpCdd.ChkBarAuto])='N' And crSigOpCdd.ChkBarAuto <> 1
		If Not Thisform.ValidaMovBarraAutomatica(lcEDN)
			ok = .F.
		Endif
	Endif
	*-----

	If ( crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1 ) And ok And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1
		If crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdFcx Where Emps = ']+crSigMvCab.Emps+[' And Grupos = ']+crSigMvCab.Grupoos+[' And Contas = ']+crSigMvCab.Contaos+[' Order By Codigos desc]
			If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpFecha') < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFecha)')
				ok = .F.
			Else
				Select CrTmpFecha
				Go Top
				If Reccount() > 0 And Dtos(crSigMvCab.DataS) < Dtos(Ttod(CrTmpFecha.DataS)+crSigCdPac.ndFechas)
					Messagebox([Período Bloqueado Para a Conta ] + Thisform.CfgTitOrigem + [...], 32, [Atenção!!!])
					ok = .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
		If crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1 And ok
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdFcx Where Emps = ']+crSigMvCab.Emps+[' And Grupos = ']+crSigMvCab.Grupods+[' And Contas = ']+crSigMvCab.Contads+[' Order By Codigos desc]
			If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrtmpFecha') < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFecha 2)')
				ok = .F.
			Else
				Select CrTmpFecha
				Go Top
				If Reccount() > 0 And Dtos(crSigMvCab.DataS) < Dtos(Ttod(CrTmpFecha.DataS)+crSigCdPac.ndFechas)
					Messagebox( 'Período bloqueado para a conta ' + Thisform.CfgTitDestino + '...', 32, '' )
					ok = .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
	Endif

	If ok And !IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Dopcs ) And Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpOpe','CrDope','Dopes',crSigCdOpe.Dopcs,[RealPrevs]) And CrDope.RealPrevs = 2
		If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Dopcs From SigMvCcr Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEDN+['], 'CrMccr') < 1)
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrMccr 2)')
			Return 0
		Endif
		Select CrMccr
		Scan
			If Not Empty(CrMccr.Dopcs)
				Messagebox( 'Títulos Previstos já foram Aprovados!!!',0+48,'Impossivel Alterar/Excluir')
				ok = .F.
				Exit
			Endif
		Endscan
	Endif

	If ok
		=Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select EmpDopNums, DataTrans From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums+['],'CrTprMvCab')
		Select CrTprMvCab
		Go Top
		If Reccount() > 0
			EmpCrd = Left(CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums,3)
			DopCrd = Substr(CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums,4,20)
			NumCrd = Val(Right(CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums,6))
			=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe','Dopes',DopCrd,[Ndopes,altTrans])
			_Codigo = ( ( TmpOpe.Ndopes * 1000000 ) + NumCrd )

			If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvPec Where Codigos = ]+Str(_Codigo,10)+[ ]+[And EmpDopNums <> ']+crSigMvCab.EmpDopNums+[' And EmpSubns = ']+EmpCrd+[' ], 'TmpEstPe') < 1)
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (TmpEstPe)')
				Return 0
			Endif
			Select TmpEstPe
			If Reccount() > 0
				Messagebox( 'Movimentação de Crédito '+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+' já utilizado!!!',0+48,'Impossivel Alterar/Excluir')
				ok = .F.
			Endif
			If ok
				If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigOpDev Where Codigos = ]+Str(_Codigo,10), 'TmpDevol') < 1)
					=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (TmpDevol)')
					Return 0
				Endif
				Select TmpDevol
				If Reccount() > 0
					Messagebox( 'Movimentação de Crédito '+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+' já utilizado!!!',0+48,'Impossivel Alterar/Excluir')
					ok = .F.
				Endif
			Endif
			If ok
				=Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select EmpDopNums From SigMvEtt Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+['],'CsTprMvCabT')
				Select CsTprMvCabT
				Go Top
				If ( Reccount('CsTprMvCabT') > 0 Or Not IsEmpty(CrTprMvCab.datatrans) ) And ( Not Inlist(TmpOpe.AltTrans,1,3) Or crSigCdEmp.AltMovTrs#1 )
					Messagebox( 'Movimentação de Crédito '+CrTprMvCab.EmpDopNums+' já Transportado!!!',0+48,'Impossivel Alterar/Excluir')
					ok = .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
	Endif

	If ok And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.BxPagos,3,4) And TprMvCab.ChkPagos And Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.DtAgends)
		Messagebox( 'Movimentação com Agendamento !!!',0+48,'Impossivel Alterar/Excluir')
		ok = .F.
	Endif
Endif

*-- Rafael - 05/12/2016 - Atualiza o Combo de Status
This.Parent.Parent.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GetDPStatus.Value = []
lcStatus = Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.pStatus),crSigMvCab.pStatus,TprMvCab.pStatus)
If Not Empty(lcStatus)
	If Seek(lcStatus,[crSigStats],[Cods])
		This.Parent.Parent.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GetDPStatus.Value = crSigStats.Descs

lcIdTransp = Iif(Empty(TprMvCab.IdTransp),crSigMvCab.IdTransp,TprMvCab.IdTransp)

Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdPac ],'crSigCdPac')

If Inlist(This.Value,1,3) And crSigCdPac.ampmsts > 0
	If This.Value = 1

			Endif

	If This.Value = 3 And Val(Left(Dtos(ListaEest.DataS),6)) <= crSigCdPac.ampmsts
		If Messagebox('Lançamento do Periodo Anterior. '+Chr(13)+'Geracao de Consultor Master já efetuada!!!',4+32+256,'Continua') = 7
			ok = .F.
		Endif
	Endif

Endif

If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+_Dope+['], 'crSigCdOpe') < 1)
	=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdOpe 4)')
	ok = .F.
Endif

If This.Value = 3 And crSigOpCdc.ietiqs = 1 And ( Not Thisform.MGOpe) And ok
	If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Cunis From SigCdUni Where Etiqs = 'S'], 'LocalUni') < 1)
		=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalUni)')
		ok = .F.

	Select LocalUni
	If Reccount() > 0
		If Messagebox('Os Barras gerados serão Alterados. Continua? ',4+32+256,'Atenção') = 7
			ok = .F.
		Endif
	Endif
Endif

If This.Value = 3 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And ( Not Thisform.MGOpe) And ok
	If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA' And crSigMvCab.Nemps = '99999999999999999999'
	Else
		Messagebox('Movimentação não permitida !!',0+48,'')
		ok = .F.

Endif

*** Tiago - 18/02/2011 - PAF - Bloco inteiro que controla o TEF foi alterado

*!* mena 17/06/2016 - incluido SAT e NFCe If (( This.Value = 1 ) And ( Inlist( crSigCdOpe.CupFis, 1, 3) ) And ( Not Thisform.MGOpe ) And ok) Or (crSigOpCdd.pafecfs = 1 And Val(fCriptografar(CrSigCdPaf.Docs)) = 3 And ok)

							Endif

						Endscan
					Endif

				If Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigMvCab','CrTprMvCab','EmpDopNums',lcEDNSub, [EmpDopNums, Valos, ValoBxs, ChkSubn])
					Select tmpoperacao
					Replace tmpoperacao.Valos      With CrTprMvCab.Valos,   ;
						tmpoperacao.OldValoBxs With CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs - m.ValoBxs, ;
						tmpoperacao.ValoBxs    With 0, ChkSubn With CrTprMvCab.ChkSubn
				Endif
			Endif
		Endscan
		Select tmpoperacao
		Count To X For Codigos <> 0
		If X = 0 And Thisform._pConsulta
			Thisform.LibPend = .T.
		Endif

		If crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss = 5
			lcCidQuery = fUniqueIds()

			=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe',.F.,.F.,[Dopes,ndopes])

			Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigOpOss Where cDopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+['],'PendSSOpe')
			Select PendSSOpe
			Index On cNivels Tag cNivels

			Select CrSigTempd
			Zap

			Select Distinct a.EmpSubns + b.Dopes + Str(Val(Right(Str(a.Codigos, 10), 6)), 6) As EmpDopNums, b.Dopes ;
				From tmpoperacao a, TmpOpe b ;
				Where Val(Left(Str(a.Codigos, 10), 4)) = b.Ndopes ;
				Into Cursor Operacoes
			Select Operacoes
			Scan
				If Seek(Operacoes.Dopes,'PendSsOpe','cNivels')
					Select Dopess From PendSSOpe Where cNivels = Operacoes.Dopes Into Cursor Selecao
					Select Selecao
					Scan
						Select CrSigTempd
						Append Blank
						Replace EmpDopNums With Operacoes.EmpDopNums,;
							CidQuerys  With lcCidQuery,;
							Dopes      With Selecao.Dopess,;
							CidChaves  With fUniqueIds()
					Endscan
				Endif
			Endscan

			If !Thisform.Podatamgr4.Update('CrSigTempd')
				=Thisform.Podatamgr4.Rollback()
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Wait Clear
				Return .F.
			Endif
			If Thisform.Podatamgr4.commit() < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão')
				Wait Clear
				Return .F.
			Endif

			lcQuery = [Select a.CidChaves, a.cItens, a.Cpros, a.Qtdes, a.QtdBxs, a.Dpros From SigTempd c, SigBxEst a ]+;
				[Where c.CidQuerys = ?lcCidQuery And c.EmpDopNums = a.EmpDopNumb and c.Dopes = a.Dopes ]
			If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'xBaixaIt') < 1)
				=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (xBaixaIT)')
				Wait Clear
				Return .F.
			Endif

			Thisform.Podatamgr4.fSqlApagarTmp('SigTempD', lcCidQuery )

			Select xBaixaIT
			Scan
				lnSaldo = Iif(Qtdes>=QtdBxs,Qtdes - QtdBxs,0)
				Select xBaixaSS
				Append Blank
				Replace Cpros With xBaixaIT.Cpros,dpros With xBaixaIT.dpros,Qtds  With lnSaldo In xBaixaSS
			Endscan
		Endif

		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigOpDev Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTmpDevol') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpDevol)')
			Thisform.mAtivapagina1
			Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
			Return
		Endif

		Select CrTmpDevol
		Scan
			If !Empty(CrTmpDevol.Codigos)
				Scatter Memvar Memo
				Insert Into TmpDevol From Memvar
			Endif
		Endscan

		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs,1,3)
			Insert Into TmpDevol (Emps, Dopes, Numes, TpCodigos) Values (TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, crSigCdOpe.OpCrs )
		Endif

		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvEtv Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTprMvCabV') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCabV)')
			Thisform.mAtivapagina1
			Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
			Return
		Endif
		Select CrTprMvCabV
		Scan
			If !Empty(Left(CrTprMvCabV.Contas,1)) And !Empty(CrTprMvCabV.Grupos)
				Scatter Memvar Memo
				If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select Rclis From SigCdCli where Iclis = ']+m.Contas+['],'CrTmpCli') < 1
					Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli)')
					Thisform.mAtivapagina1
					Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
					Return
				Endif
				m.Rclis = CrTmpCli.Rclis
				Insert Into TprMvCabV From Memvar
			Endif
		Endscan

		_MoeOpe = Iif( Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ) )
		m.Valos = 0
		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvMov Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTmpEstMo') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEstMo)')
			Thisform.mAtivapagina1
			Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
			Return
		Endif

		Select CrTmpEstMo
		Scan
			Select CrTmpEstMo
			Scatter Memvar Memo
			If Not Empty(m.Moeds) Or Not Empty(m.ValTots) Or Not Empty(m.ValItens)
				Select tmptotal
				If !Seek(m.Moeds)
					Insert Into tmptotal From Memvar
				Else
					Gather Memvar Memo
				Endif

				If tmptotal.Moeds # _MoeOpe
					*** Tiago - 08/09/2015 - Atualiza a cotação com a que foi gravada na movimentação
					If Not Seek( CrTmpEstMo.Moeds, "TmpCot" )
						If CrTmpEstMo.MoeVals # 0
							Insert Into tmpcot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( CrTmpEstMo.Moeds, CrTmpEstMo.MoeVals )
						Endif
					Else
						Replace Valos With CrTmpEstMo.MoeVals In tmpcot
					Endif

					Cotacao = Thisform.Cotacao( tmptotal.Moeds, TprMvCab.DataS )
					m.Valos = Round( m.Valos + ( tmptotal.ValTots * Cotacao ), 2 )
				Else
					m.Valos = m.Valos + tmptotal.ValTots
				Endif
			Endif
		Endscan

		If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigMvNfi Where EmpDopNums = ?lcEDN ],'CrTmpNfis') < 1
			Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpNFis)')
			Thisform.mAtivapagina1
			Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
			Return
		Endif

		Select CrTmpNfis
		Scan
			Scatter Memvar Memo
			Insert Into crSigMvNfi From Memvar
		Endscan

		If( Thisform._pConsulta ) And Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CodServs)
			=fAjustarServs(Thisform.Podatamgr,.F.,Thisform.rcvIss,Thisform.rcvirf,Thisform.rcvinss,Thisform.rcvpis,Thisform.rcvcofins,Thisform.rcvCsll)
		Endif

		Thisform.totpres = m.Valos
		Select tmptotal
		Thisform.Pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GradeTotal.Refresh

		Thisform.Criabaixa()

		Select crSigMvCab
		Zap
	Endif
	Select crTpmMvIts
	Set Order To Citens
	Set Key To crTpmMvItn.Citens

	If Thisform.pcEscolha='INSERIR'
		If (Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+_Dope+['], 'crSigCdOpe') < 1)
			=Messagebox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdOpe 7)')
			Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
			If (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
			Else
				Thisform.Visible = .T.
				Thisform.Enabled = .T.
				Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Release
				If Thisform.Acttoolbar
					goSistema.BarraAtalho.Visible = .T.
				Endif
			Endif
			Return 0
		Endif
		Thisform.totpres = 0
		llnew = .T.
		_Inicio = 0
		If Thisform.MGOpe
			lcGope = Padr(Thisform.antform.GrupoOper,20)
			If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdGpe Where Dgopes = ?lcGope ],'CrTmpGope') < 1
				Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpGOpe)')
				If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
					Thisform.plcancelar = .T.
				Endif
				Thisform.mAtivapagina1
				Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
				If (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
				Else
					Thisform.Visible = .T.
					Thisform.Enabled = .T.
					Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Release
					If Thisform.Acttoolbar
						goSistema.BarraAtalho.Visible = .T.
					Endif
				Endif
				Return
			Endif
			Select CrTmpGope
			Go Top
			If Reccount() > 0
				If Inlist(CrTmpGope.NumOpers,1,3)
					_Inicio = Thisform.pNumes
					llnew = .F.
					If Thisform.Podatamgr.SqlExecute([Select * From SigCdGpo Where Dgopes = ']+Padr(Thisform.antform.GrupoOper,20)+[' And Dopers = ']+Thisform.antform.doper+['],'crtmpGopeo') < 1
						Messagebox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpGOpeo')
						If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
							Thisform.plcancelar = .T.
						Endif
						Thisform.mAtivapagina1
						Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
						If (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
						Else
							Thisform.Visible = .T.
							Thisform.Enabled = .T.
							Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Release
							If Thisform.Acttoolbar
								goSistema.BarraAtalho.Visible = .T.
							Endif
						Endif
						Return
					Endif
					Select crtmpGopeo
					If Reccount() > 0
						If !Empty(crtmpGopeo.confops)
							=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','dopes',crtmpGopeo.confops,[Numeras])
							If crTmpOpe.Numeras = 1
								If CrTmpGope.FontNums = 1
									_Inicio = fGerUniqueKey(Alltrim(Thisform.antform.GrupoOper)+Thisform.pEmps)
								Else
									_Inicio = fGerUniqueKey(Alltrim(_Dope)+Thisform.pEmps)
								Endif
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Else
					If CrTmpGope.FontNums = 1
						_Inicio = fGerUniqueKey(Alltrim(Thisform.antform.GrupoOper)+Thisform.pEmps)
						Thisform.pNumes = _Inicio
						llnew = .F.
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif

		*** Tiago - 09/07/2012 - Ícaro - Gera numeração aleatório para os pedidos
		If crSigCdOpe.Numeras = 5
			_Inicio = 0
			Do While _Inicio = 0
				_Inicio = fKeyGen()
				If Thisform.Podatamgr.ChkRegister('SigMvCab','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(_Inicio,6))
					_Inicio =  0
				Endif
			Enddo
			Thisform.pNumes = _Inicio
			llnew = .F.
		Endif

		If llnew And crSigCdOpe.Numeras # 2 && Tiago - 11/08/2014 - Não pode gerar numeração quando puxa subnível pois pode gerar numeração já existente
			_Inicio = fGerUniqueKey( Alltrim( _Dope ) + Thisform.pEmps )
			Thisform.pNumes = _Inicio
		Endif

		_IniLet     = Alltrim( fGerMascara( _Inicio ) )
		_TabD       = Iif( Not Inlist(crSigCdOpe.TabDescs, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 ), Spac( 10 ), crSigCdOpe.Tabdps )
		_ListaPreco = ''

		Do Case
		Case crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 1
			If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.ConOrigs) And Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',crSigCdOpe.ConOrigs, [Iclis, lPrecos])
				_ListaPreco = CrTmpCli.LPrecos
			Endif

		Case crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 2
			If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.ConDests) And Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',crSigCdOpe.ConDests, [Iclis, lprecos])
				_ListaPreco = CrTmpCli.LPrecos
			Endif

		Case crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 5
			Thisform.MudaLPrecos    = .F.
			_ListaPreco = crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads
		Endcase

		If Empty(_ListaPreco)
			_ListaPreco = crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads
		Endif

		_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()
		Insert Into TprMvCab ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Usuars, Datars, DataS, Transps, Mascnum, Tabds, LPrecos, CidChaves, EmpDopNums, Dgopes, vcompensas, TpFats ) ;
			Values ( Thisform.pEmps, _Dope, Iif(!Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Numeras,2,3) Or Thisform.MGOpe,_Inicio,0), Usuar, _pData, Thisform.DataPadraos, ;
			.F., Iif(!Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Numeras,2,3) Or Thisform.MGOpe,_IniLet,''), _TabD, _ListaPreco, fUniqueIds(), ;
			ThisForm.pEmps + _Dope + Str(Iif(crSigCdOpe.Numeras # 3,_Inicio,0),6), Thisform.pdgope, ;
			crSigCdOpe.vcompensas, Iif(crSigCdOpe.edtpfats=1,crSigOpCdc.TpFatPs,' ') )


		*-- Verifica a Data da Movimentação
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorQuery('SigCdEmp','CrTmpEmp','CEmps',TprMvCab.Emps)
		lnValBlqEmp = Iif(Type([CrTmpEmp.BlqDatas])=[N],CrTmpEmp.BlqDatas,0)
		If crSigCdOpe.BlqDatas=1 or lnValBlqEmp=2
			ldDataMov = Iif(Type([TprMvCab.Datas])=[T],Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas),TprMvCab.Datas)
			If ldDataMov <> Date()
				=fGravarLog('T', TprMvCab.Dopes, 'DTBLOQBTN', TprMvCab.Emps + '-' + AllTrim(TprMvCab.Dopes) + '-' + AllTrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)),Usuar)
				Update TprMvCab set datas = Date()
			EndIf 
		EndIf 
		
		Select TprMvCab
		Go Top

		** Checa Série da NF
		If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Series)
			Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdSer','crSigCdSer','EmpCods',Thisform.pEmps + crSigCdOpe.Series)
			If Not Used([crSigCdSer]) Or Eof([crSigCdSer])
				Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdSer','crSigCdSer','EmpCods',Space(3) + crSigCdOpe.Series)
			Endif
			If( crSigCdSer.BlqInss == 1 ) And (crSigCdOpe.Agrupas == 1)
				=fVerImpPends(Thisform.pEmps,crSigCdOpe.Series,Thisform.Podatamgr,.T.)
			Endif
		Endif

		If Thisform.Podatamgr.ChkRegister('SigMvCab','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)) And crSigCdOpe.Numeras = 1
			Messagebox('Este Número de Documento já existe ('+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+')!!!',0+48,'')
			If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
				Thisform.plcancelar = .T.
			Endif
			Thisform.mAtivapagina1
			Thisform.LockScreen = .F.
			If (Isnull(Thisform.poFormxEEst1))
			Else
				Thisform.Visible = .T.
				Thisform.Enabled = .T.
				Thisform.poFormxEEst1.Release
				If Thisform.Acttoolbar
					goSistema.BarraAtalho.Visible = .T.
				Endif
			Endif
			Return 0
		Endif

		Thisform.LocRegister = TprMvCab.Numes

		If crSigCdOpe.cEmpSubns = 5 And crSigOpCdc.CarESubns <> 1
			Replace TprMvCab.Empds With TprMvCab.Emps
		Endif

		If (Inlist(crSigCdOpe.DigObs, 1, 3)) And !IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.ObsPads) And Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
			=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdObs','CrTmpObs','codigos',crSigCdOpe.ObsPads)
			Select CrTmpObs
			Go Top
			If (Reccount() > 0) And ;
					Not ([#]  $ CrTmpObs.Observas) And ;
					Not ([$]  $ CrTmpObs.Observas) And ;
					Not ([%]  $ CrTmpObs.Observas) And ;
					Not ([@]  $ CrTmpObs.Observas) And ;
					Not ([!]  $ CrTmpObs.Observas) And ;
					Not ([^$] $ CrTmpObs.Observas) And ;
					Not ([^V] $ CrTmpObs.Observas)

				Select TprMvCab
				Replace TprMvCab.Obses  With CrTmpObs.Observas, ;
					TprMvCab.CodObs With crSigCdOpe.ObsPads
			Endif
		Endif

		Thisform.SelecionaTabD()
		If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 4) And ( IsEmpty( TprMvCab.Tabds ) Or ;
				Not Seek(TprMvCab.Tabds,'csSigOpTdz','Codigos') )
			Select csSigOpTdz
			Scan
				If csSigOpTdz.Padraos = 1
					Select TprMvCab
					Replace TprMvCab.Tabds With csSigOpTdz.Codigos
					Exit
				Endif
			Endscan
		Endif

		*** Tiago - 11/05/2011 - Se variação = 1 e valor de variação padrão estiver preenchido
		If (crSigCdOpe.vars = 1 And crSigOpCdc.VarPads <> 0)
			Replace vars With crSigOpCdc.VarPads In TprMvCab
		Endif

		If !Empty(crSigOpCdd.MinFretes)
			If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.NFiscals,1,2)
				Replace VlFretes With crSigOpCdd.MinFretes In crSigMvNfi
			Else
				Replace ValTrans With crSigOpCdd.MinFretes In TprMvCab
			Endif
		Endif
		***
		If (crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1) &&And (crSigCdOpe.SubNObrigs # 1)
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Insert Into crTpmMvItn ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Citens) Values( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, 1 )
		Endif

		Insert Into tmpoperacao ( Emps, Dopes, Numes ) Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes )

		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs,1,3)
			Insert Into TmpDevol (Emps, Dopes, Numes, TpCodigos) Values (TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, crSigCdOpe.OpCrs )
		Endif

		Insert Into tmptotal (Moeds) Values	(crSigCdOpe.Cmoes)
	Endif

	Insert Into TprMvCabV ( Emps, Dopes, Numes ) Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes )

	=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
	If Inlist(Thisform.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR','EXCLUIR','CONSULTAR')
		Select TmpDevol
		Goto Top
		Thisform.Pagina.dados.GradeDevol.Refresh

		Select tmpoperacao
		Goto Top
		With Thisform.Pagina.dados
			.GradeOperação.Refresh
			.GradeMultiSubN.Refresh
		Endwith

		Select tmptotal
		Goto Top
		Thisform.Pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GradeTotal.Refresh

	Endif

	If Thisform.pcEscolha = [INSERIR] And crSigOpCdd.ConsertoPc = 1
		This.Parent.Parent.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Conserto.getEmpD.Value = Thisform.pEmps
		This.Parent.Parent.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Conserto.getEmpD.Refresh
	Endif

	If Inlist(Thisform.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR','CONSULTAR','PROCURAR')
		Thisform.SelecionaTabD()
	Endif

	=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe', 'crSigCdOpe', 'Dopes', _Dope)
	=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc', 'crSigOpCdc', 'Dopes', _Dope)
	=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdi', 'crSigOpCdi', 'Dopes', _Dope)
	=Thisform.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdd', 'crSigOpCdd', 'dopes', _Dope)
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorQuery('SigCdEmp', 'crSigCdEmp', 'CEmps', TprMvCab.Emps)

	If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR' And Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 )
		lnAliqMed = Thisform.CalcBasFrt()
		Replace AliqMed With lnAliqMed In TprMvCab
	Endif

	* Richard em 30/01/2013 - Armazena a variável TitBans na propriedade pra posterior gravação no SIGMVCCR
	If Used([crSigOpCdi]) And Not Empty(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 4, 12))
		Thisform.TitBans = Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 4, 12)
	Endif

	Thisform.AjustaBotoes()

	With Thisform.Pagina.dados
		Select crSigCdOpe
		.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTotPrs.Visible = .F.
		.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTotPrs.Enabled = .F.
		.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTotPrs.Value =  0
		.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.lblTotPrs.Visible = .F.

		**** Carrega Pedido
		With .GradeOperação
			.Visible = (crSigCdOpe.SubNs=1 Or (crSigCdOpe.SubNs=3 And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Nivels))) And Thisform.pcEscolha # 'PROCURAR'
			.Enabled = (crSigCdOpe.SubNs=1 Or (crSigCdOpe.SubNs=3 And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.Nivels))) And Thisform.pcEscolha # 'PROCURAR'
			If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
				.Visible = .F.
				.Enabled = .F.
			Endif
		Endwith

		With .GradeDevol
			If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
				.Visible = .F.
				.Enabled = .F.
			Endif
		Endwith

Thisform.KeyPreview = .T.

ENDPROC
