------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE pagina.dados.grupo_salva.Salva.Click
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE pagina.dados.grupo_salva.Salva.Click
Parameters pnSalva

Private pDat
Local Resp, desconto, limite, empcar, dopcar, numcar, escolha, Imprime, lnResposta, llImpNF
Local _Cheque, _Conserto, _OperCaixa, lnValoBxs, lnValos, lnCotacao, lnValoSubns, lnRestoBxs
Local lnCotOper, lcMoeOper, lnValConvs, lcMsg, lcCaption, lnChqOpers, lnCOpers, lcItemObrigs
Local lnTotal, lnItens, lnCota, lnDiferenca, Limite, llVerLimite, lnSinals, llBoletoBancario
Local lnTotItem, lcCampos, lnCount, llFPagsObrigs, vCond, lnFPagsObrigs, _pData, llTaOk, _Posicao, lcEstas, lnVImpSer

pDat = Datetime()
_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

lcItemObrigs = ''
Select TprMvCab 
Go Top
_Posicao = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
_Conserto  = crSigCdOpe.Consers = 1 
_OperCaixa = crSigCdOpe.COpers
lcMoeOper  = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
lnCotOper  = Iif( IsEmpty( lcMoeOper ), 1, ;
			 Iif( Seek( lcMoeOper, 'TmpCot', 'CMoes' ), TmpCot.Valos, ;
			 ThisForm.Cotacao( lcMoeOper, TprMvCab.Datas ) ) )
lcMsg = ''
lcCidQuery = fUniqueIds()

ThisForm.Retorna = .t.
Select crTpmMvIts
Set Order to CItens
Set Key To

If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR])
	*-- Rafael - 23/12/2016 - Criado o Metodo para diminuir a quantidade de linhas da validação de inserir e alterar 
	If Not ThisForm.Antes_salva()
		Return .F.
	EndIf
EndIf

If Type('pnSalva') = 'N'	
	Return .T.		&& Mena - 29/05/2018 - retorna se veio do SAT/NFCe
Endif

llValidaMatriz = .T.
If Thisform.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR'
	If ThisForm.valormovimentacao >= TprMvCab.Valos
		llValidaMatriz = .F.
	EndIf 
EndIf 

If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR]) And llValidaMatriz
	*-- Rafael - 24/04/2017 - Limite de credito pela Matriz contabil
	If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.limcres,7,8) 
		
		ldDataHoje = Iif(Type([TprMvCab.Datas])=[T],Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas),TprMvCab.Datas)
		If (crSigCdOpe.limcres = 7 And Thisform.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR' And ldDataHoje = Date()) Or (Thisform.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And crSigCdOpe.limcres = 8)
			lcCurCred = []
			*-- Rafael - 28/04/2017 - Valida Limite de Credito das contas de centro de custo por Matriz
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery([SigMvCab],[csTprMvCab],[EmpDopNums],TprMvCab.EmpDopNums)
			lcCurCred = [TprMvCab]
			If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposCC) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaCCs) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt)
				If !Thisform.RetornaLimiteCreditoMatriz( crSigOpCdd.GruposCC, TprMvCab.ContaCCs, crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt, crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt, 'Centro de Custo', lcCurCred )
					Return .F.
				Endif
			Endif
		EndIf
		
		If (crSigCdOpe.limcres = 7) Or (Thisform.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR' And crSigCdOpe.limcres = 8)
			If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposCC) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaCCs) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt) And Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt)
				If !ThisForm.LimiteCreditoMatriz( crSigOpCdd.GruposCC, TprMvCab.ContaCCs, crSigOpCdd.GruposEmt, crSigOpCdd.ContasEmt, 'Centro de Custo' )
					Return .F.
				EndIf 
			EndIf 
		EndIf 
	EndIf
EndIf

_OpEsc = ThisForm.pcEscolha

Imprime = .F. 
If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'CONSULTAR', 'PROCURAR' )
	If ThisForm._pConsulta
		ThisForm.AntForm.KeyPreview=.t.
		ThisForm.AntForm.Enabled = .T.
		ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Grupo_Saida.Sair.Click()
		ThisForm.Release
		Return .f.
	Else
		ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Refresh
		If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'CONSULTAR'
			ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1(.T.)
		Else
			ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1
		EndIf

		If _OpEsc = "PROCURAR"
			ThisForm.msv_procurar()
		EndIf

	EndIf

else

	If ThisForm.pcEscolha='EXCLUIR'
		If MessageBox("Confirma a Exclusão",4+32+256,_OpEsc)==6
			ThisForm.msv_excluir()
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )

		Select crTpmMvIts
		replace all Dopes with TprMvCab.Dopes, numes with TprMvCab.numes
		go top

		Select crTpmMvItn
		replace all Dopes with TprMvCab.Dopes, numes with TprMvCab.numes
		go top
		
		Select xPar
		replace all Dopes with TprMvCab.Dopes, numes with TprMvCab.numes
		replace all datas with _pData for IsEmpty( datas )
		go top

		Select a.*, b.Dopes As DopeAuts From crTpmMvItn a, csOpeAut b ;
			Where Not IsEmpty(a.Cpros) And a.Cpros == b.CPros ;
			Into Cursor csItemAut
		Index On Emps + DopeAuts + Str(Numes,6) Tag EmpDopNum

		Select a.*, b.Dopes As DopeAuts From crTpmMvItn a, csOpeTrf b ;
			Where Not IsEmpty(a.Cpros) And a.Cpros == b.CPros ;
			Into Cursor csItemOpe
		Index On Emps + DopeAuts + Str(Numes,6) Tag EmpDopNum
		

		*--- Rafael - 05/05/2017 - Quando tem movimentação automatica na observação, gera as automaticas para o que esta na observação
		If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.CodObs)
			lcQuery = [Select a.Abrevs, b.MovAutDop from SigCdOpe a join SigCdObs b on a.Dopes = b.MovAutDop Where b.codigos = ]+Str(TprMvCab.CodObs)
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,[csTmpAbrev]) < 1
				MessageBox([Favor reinciar o processo.],0+16,[Falha de Conexão (csTmpAbrev)])
				Return .F.
			EndIf 
			Select csTmpAbrev
			If Reccount([csTmpAbrev])>0 And Not IsEmpty(csTmpAbrev.Abrevs)
				
				lcAbrvs = csTmpAbrev.Abrevs
				
				Select crSigOpCdc
				replace GerOpes With 1 ,;
						DopeNfs With csTmpAbrev.MovAutDop In crSigOpCdc
			
				
				Select crTpmMvItn
				replace all Abrevis with lcAbrvs
				go top
			EndIf 
		EndIf 

		If ThisForm.pcEscolha='ALTERAR'
			ThisForm.msv_Alterar()
		Else
			ThisForm.msv_inserir()
		EndIf

		If !ThisForm.Retorna
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		
		Imprime = .T.

		llTaOk = ( ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit() > 0 )
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0 And llTaOk
			llTaOk = ( ThisForm.poDataMgr6.Commit() > 0 )
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3)
				llTaOk = .t.
			EndIf
		EndIf

		If Not llTaOk
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Commit)')
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr6.PnIdConn > 0
				ThisForm.poDataMgr6.RollBack()
			EndIf
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		
		Select TprMvCab2
		If Reccount() > 0
			Select TprMvCab
			Zap
			Append From Dbf('TprMvCab2')
		EndIf

		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And _OpEsc = 'INSERIR'
			lcUpdate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set lCancelas = lCancelas Where EmpDopNums = ']+TprMvCab.EmpDopNums+[']
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
		EndIf
		
	EndIf

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

	=fGravarLog('T', TprMvCab.Dopes, ThisForm.pcEscolha, TprMvCab.Emps + '-' + AllTrim(TprMvCab.Dopes) + '-' + AllTrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)))

	llTransOk1 = .t.
	
	If llTransOk1

		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc', 'crSigOpCdc', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdi', 'crSigOpCdi', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)

		=fCriarCurSit(.t.)  && acerta Situação do Cliente
		
		If Inlist( _OpEsc, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And Imprime
			=ThisForm.Podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdPaf','CrSigCdPaf','dopes',fDecriptografar(TprMvCab.Dopes))
					
			******* impressao Cupom Fiscal
			If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And _OpEsc = 'INSERIR' && mena - 29/01/2016 retirado para imprimir CNF junco com DAV AND !(CrSigOpCdd.PafEcfs = 1 AND VAL(fCriptografar(crSigCdPaf.docs)) = 3)
 				If crSigFiFis.Imps <> 'S/IMPRESSORA'
	 				ThisForm.CupomFiscal()
				ELSE
					IF thisform.imprcvinculado()						&& mena 20/07/2016 - para imprimir cupom vinculado em impressora não fiscal quando CNF  
						ThisForm.DeleteSigTef(crAux1.cnIdents,'CRT')	&& delete linha de arquivo auxiliar
					ENDIF
	 			EndIf
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr2.Commit()
				ThisForm.naowhen =.t.
			EndIf

			** Tiago - 16/02/2011 - PAF - Atualiza GT do ECF
			=ThisForm.AtuaGT(0,.t.,.f.)	
			
			******* impressao boleto Zebra
			If crSigOpCdc.VenBols = 3
				Do Form SigReBol With TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes
			EndIf

			******* impressao boleto
			If crSigOpCdc.venbols=1
				ThisForm.ImpBol()
			EndIf

			If CrSigOpCdd.PafEcfs = 1 AND VAL(fCriptografar(crSigCdPaf.docs)) = 3
				Thisform.fdavrg()
			Endif

			******* impressao documento
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.docus,1,5)
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes) And ;
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 ))

					If (crSigOpCdc.InibMVends = 7) && Vendedores de Leilão
						**** Mena - 17/10/2011 verifica se tem duplicidade de itens no banco e avisa ****
						lcSql = [select sum(1) as soma, sum(a.qtds) as qtds, sum(b.qtds) as sumitens, a.empdopnums, a.citens, a.codcors, a.codtams ] + ;
								[from sigmvits a, sigmvitn b ] + ;
								[where a.empdopnums = b.empdopnums and a.citens = b.citens and not a.empdopnums like 'crtnf complementar gene%' ] + ;
								[group by a.empdopnums, a.citens, a.codcors, a.codtams, a.qtds ] + ;
								[having sum(1) > 1 ] + ;
								[order by a.empdopnums, a.citens ]
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'cursor1') > 0
							IF RECCOUNT('cursor1') > 0
								MessageBox('Alerta de Duplicação de item - salvar.click - já gravado. Não é necessariamente inconsistência.',0+16,'')
								=fGravarLog('T', TprMvCab.Dopes, ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'DUPLICAÇÃO DE ITENS', Usuar )
							ENDIF
						ENDIF
						****************************************************************
					EndIf
										
					DO SigPrIdc with TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes,CrEest.valdevs, crSigOpCdc.QtdDocs,.F.,(Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 161, 1))) = 1),.F.,.F.,crSigOpCdc.TpImpDocs,.F.,Thisform, Iif(crSigOpCdc.chkimpdoc=1,.F.,.T.)
				EndIf
			EndIf

			******* impressao documento Fixo
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.Docus, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)
				Do Form SigReIfx With TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, crSigOpCdc.TpImpDocs
			EndIf

			* Impressão do Relatório de Job
			If InList(Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 25, 1))), 1, 3) && Se Tem Campo de Job Ativo Na Tela
				If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 157, 01))) = 1)  And Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 161, 1))) <> 1 && Tela de Job (1-Sim / 2 e 0-Não) - Inibir tela documento ao salvar
					Do Form SigReJob With ThisForm
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2 &&Impressão das Multiplas Movimentações geradas
				DO Form SigOpIgm With Thisform,TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes
			EndIf

			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

			******* impressao invoice
			If Not Eof('crSigOpCdi') And (crSigOpCdi.chkInvs = 1)
				Do Form SigReIiv With TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes
			EndIf
			
			If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.nOpCrs) And crSigCdOpe.OpCrs <> 8
				lcSql = [Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, ValDevs From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+[']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrEest') > 0
					pcEmp = crEest.Emps
					pcDop = crEest.Dopes
					pnNum = crEest.numes
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','TmpOpe','dopes',pcDop)
					If InList(TmpOpe.Docus,1,5)
						If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',pcDop) And ;
							ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',pcEmp + pcDop + Str(pnNum,6)))
							DO SigPrIdc with pcEmp, pcDop, pnNum, CrEest.valdevs, crSigOpCdc.QtdDocs,.F.,.F.,.F.,.F.,crSigOpCdc.TpImpDocs,.f.,ThisForm
						EndIf
					EndIf
					If InList(TmpOpe.Docus, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)
						Do Form SigReIfx With pcEmp, pcDop, pnNum, crSigOpCdc.TpImpDocs
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			******* impressao etiqueta boleto
			If crSigOpCdc.etibols=1
				If MessageBox('Confirma impressão da Etiqueta de Conserto ?(S/N)',4+32+256,'') = 6
					ThisForm.mEtiqCons
				EndIf
			EndIf

			******* impressao Nota Fiscal
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Impnota.Click()

			If Not Empty(crSigOpCdc.DopeNfs)
				lcSql = [Select Emps, Dopes, Numes, ValDevs From SigMvCab Where EmpDnCrds = ']+TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+[']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrEest') > 0
					pcEmp = crEest.Emps
					pcDop = crEest.Dopes
					pnNum = crEest.numes
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',pcDop)
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','Dopes',pcDop)
					=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',pcEmp + pcDop + Str(pnNum,6)))

					ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Impnota.Click(.t.)

				EndIf
			EndIf

			******* impressao sedex && Tiago - 06/02/2013
			If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 17, 1))) = 1)
				thisform.Impsedex()
			Endif
						
			****** impressao Duplicata
			lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
					    [From SigMvPar ] + ;
					   [Where EmpDopNums = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + [']

			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crPar]) < 1)
				=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (Salva - crPar)])
				Return .f.
			EndIf

			Select crPar
			Scan
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',crPar.Fpags)
				If crSigOpFp.ImpDups = 1
					Exit
				EndIf
			Endscan
			If crSigOpCdc.ImpDups == 1 And crSigOpFp.ImpDups == 1 And MessageBox('Confirma impressão da Duplicata ?(S/N)',4+32+256,'') = 6
				Do SigIpDup With TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6),'',.f.,ThisForm.poDataMgr
			EndIf
			
			****** impressao Boleto Bancário
			llBoletoBancario = .F.
			Select crPar
			Scan
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',crPar.Fpags)
				If crSigOpFp.ImpBols = 1
					llBoletoBancario = .T.
					Exit
				EndIf
			Endscan

			If (crSigOpCdc.ImpBols == 1) And llBoletoBancario
				ThisForm.LockScreen = .t.
				ThisForm.Enabled = .f.

				lcSql = [Select count(*) as qt from SigCnFbl Where fpags <> ' ']
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcsql,'LocalCfg') < 1
					=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalCfg)')
					Return .f.
				EndIf
	
				If LocalCfg.Qt = 0
					Do Form SigPrIbl With TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes, 6), ThisForm 
				Else
					Do Form SigPrIbb With TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes, 6), ThisForm 
				EndIf

				ThisForm.Enabled = .t.
			 	ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
			EndIf
			
			******* Atualiza Central de Crédito
			If !IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.ccentrals) And _OpEsc = 'INSERIR'
				If MessageBox('Atualizar Central de Crédito. Código '+crSigCdOpe.ccentrals+' ?(S/N)',4+32+256,'') = 6
					ThisForm.CentralCred
				EndIf
			EndIf
		
			limpche = .t.
			******* Impressao de Cheques
			Select crPar
			Scan
				 If InsChs
				 	limpche = .f.
				 EndIf
			Endscan

			Select xChq
			Set Order to CHQ
			If !eof() And limpche
				Do Form SigEmCh2 with ThisForm.oModemEest
			EndIf

			******* Autenticação
			ThisForm.autenticacao(1)

			****** impressao etiquetas Movimentação Entrada Automática
			If Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.DopeEtrfs)
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigOpCdc','TmpDcOpe','Dopes',crSigCdOpe.DopeEtrfs)
				If TmpDcOpe.ietiqs=1
					ThisForm.etiqueta(TprMvCab.Emps + crSigCdOpe.DopeEtrfs + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6))
				EndIf
			Endif

			*** Tiago - 15/08/2014 - SRCOM - 4alerta - envio de e-mail
			If crSigCdPac.Alertas = 1 And Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 193, 01))) = 1
				lnReg = Iif(Reccount([TmpOperacao])=0,1,Reccount([TmpOperacao]))
				Dimension laOpeBaixa(lnReg)
				Select TmpOperacao
				Scan
					If !IsEmpty(TmpOperacao.Codigos) and TmpOperacao.ChkSubn
						nDope = Int(Val(Left(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 4)))
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','ndopes',nDope,[Dopes])
						Dope  = crTmpOpe.Dopes
						Nume  = Int(Val(Right(Str(TmpOperacao.Codigos, 10), 6)))
						lcEDN = TmpOperacao.EmpSubns + Dope + Str(Nume, 6)
						laOpeBaixa(Recno()) = lcEDN
					Endif
				Endscan						
				
				Do form SigPrEml With TprMvCab.EmpDopNums, thisform.pcEscolha, laOpeBaixa			
			Endif
		EndIf

		*-- Rafael - 03/09/2018 - Abrir a tela de Geração da Nota Fiscal
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','csTmpCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
		If (Inlist(csTmpCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2) and INLIST(csTmpCdOpe.cupfis,0,2) And Inlist(Thisform.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR]))
			lnResp = MessageBox([Deseja realizar a Emissão da Nota Fiscal?],4+32+256,[Atenção])
			If lnResp = 6
				Do form SigPrNfe With TprMvCab.EmpDopNums, crSigmvnfi.series, crSigmvnfi.Operas
			EndIf 
		EndIf 
		
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdOpe', 'crSigCdOpe', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdc', 'crSigOpCdc', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdd', 'crSigOpCdd', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpCdi', 'crSigOpCdi', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes)
		
		****** impressao etiquetas de Garantia
		If crSigOpCdd.EtiGar=1
			ThisForm.ImpGarantia()
		EndIf

		****** impressao etiquetas
		If crSigOpCdc.ietiqs=1 Or InList(crSigCdOpe.CtrlLotes,1,2)
			ThisForm.etiqueta()
		EndIf
			
	EndIf
	
	Zap in crTpmMvItn
	Zap in crTpmMvIts
	Zap in xpar

	If (Int(Val(Substr(crSigOpCdi.lbltxidCs, 24, 1))) = 1) && Richard - Mostrar Tela de Títulos Gerados - 10/03/2014
		lcQuery = [Select Titulos ] + ;
				  	[From SigMvCcr ] + ;
				   [Where EmpDopNums = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes, 6) + [' And ] + ;
			   			 [Opers = '] + Iif(crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1, [C], [D]) + [']

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalTits]) < 1)
			=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalTits)])
			Return .f.
		EndIf
		Select LocalTits
		Goto Top In LocalTits	
		If Not Eof([LocalTits])
			ThisForm.LockScreen = .t.
			ThisForm.Enabled = .f.

			Do Form SigMvTit With TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6), Iif(crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1, [C], [D])

			ThisForm.Enabled = .t.
		 	ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If ThisForm._pConsulta
		ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Grupo_Saida.Sair.Click()
		ThisForm.AntForm.ProcessaPeriodo( .F., TprMvCab.Numes, TprMvCab.Dopes )
		ThisForm.AntForm.Enabled = .T.
		ThisForm.AntForm.KeyPreview=.t.
		ThisForm.Release
		Return .f.
	Else
		*** mena 27/05/2015 incluido NFCe e SAT ***
		If ( InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3,5,6) And crSigCdOpe.TransOns = 1 ) And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
			ThisForm.Visible = .f.
			lnCnt = 1
			ldtime = DateTime()
			Do While DateTime() - ldtime <= 1		&& mena 20/11/2014 diminui tempo 3
				If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA'
					Exit
				EndIf
				If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
					ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde Finalização '+Iif(crSigFiFis.Imps<>'S/IMPRESSORA','do Cupom !!!',' da Movimentação!!!')+Str(lnCnt,3)
				Else
					Wait Window 'Aguarde Finalização '+Iif(crSigFiFis.Imps<>'S/IMPRESSORA','do Cupom !!!',' da Movimentação!!!')+Str(lnCnt,3) nowait
				EndIf
				=chrsaw(.5)
				lnCnt = lnCnt + 1
			EndDo
		Else
			lcEdnu = TprMvCab.empdopnums		&& mena 02/07/2014 guarda empdopnums da atual
			ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Refresh
			If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'EXCLUIR'
				ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1(.T.)
			Else
				ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1
			EndIf
		EndIf
		*** Mena - 02/07/2014 - cancela prevendas do subnivel - homologacao 2014 ***
		If CrSigOpCdd.PafEcfs = 1 AND VAL(fCriptografar(crSigCdPaf.docs)) = 5 and _OpEsc = 'INSERIR'
			LOCAL lnNoFabr
			lnNoFabr =  LeituraFab(Thisform.podatamgr)

			lcQuerie = [Select empdopnums From Sigmvcab Where ultgrvs like '] + SUBSTR(lcEdnu,4) + [%']
			Thisform.poDatamgr.SqlExecute(lcQuerie, [crPrev])

			SELECT crPrev
			GO top
			SCAN
				IF !(cancprevenda(0,lnNoFabr,crPrev.empdopnums))
					RETURN .f.	
				ENDIF
				SELECT crPrev
			ENDSCAN
			_Dope = SUBSTR(lcEdnu,4,20)
		Endif
		Return .t.
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE pagina.dados.grupo_salva.Cancelar.Click
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE pagina.dados.grupo_salva.Cancelar.Click
Lparameters _NaoDodefault

private pcEscolha, pDat
Local lcPosicao, lnCodigo, lcCodDope, OkCancela, llCancelou

pDat = Datetime()

Select crSigCdPam
goto top
If Inlist(crSigCdPam.SisTef,1) And ThisForm.TransTef >=1
	llchecaSigTef = .f.
	If !used('SigTef')
		Use goSistema.DirTefEcfs+'\SigTef' in 0
		llchecaSigTef = .t.
	EndIf
	Select SigTef
	Count for ! Deleted() To lnQtdTef
	Go Top
	If lnQtdTef > 1 Or cStatus = 'CNF'
** Mena - retirado em 04/2012 - homologacao redecard - permite cancelar mais de um tef **
**		MessageBox('Movimentação possui movimentação com TEF , Impossível Cancelamento !!',0+48,'')
**		Return .f.
	EndIf
	If llchecaSigTef
		USE in SigTef
	EndIf
EndIf

ThisForm.totite=fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
if InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON') and ;
	ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR' and crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 and ;
	ThisForm.totite=0  and !ThisForm.ImpressoItem And ThisForm.AbriuCupom
	Messagebox('Não é possível Fechar ou Cancelar o Cupom,'+chr(13)+;
				'caso não tenha sido registrado pelo menos um item !!',0+16,'ERRO')
	Return .f.
EndIf

If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS','BEMATECH','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON') and ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR' and crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 and ThisForm.totite=0  and ThisForm.ImpressoItem
	Messagebox('Não é possível Fechar ou Cancelar o Cupom,'+chr(13)+;
				'caso não tenha sido registrado pelo menos um item !!',0+16,'ERRO')
	Return .f.
EndIf

OkCancela = .t.
lnCodigo  = TprMvCab.numes
llretnew = .t.
If ThisForm.mgope
	lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdGpe Where Dgopes = ']+padr(ThisForm.AntForm.GrupoOper,20)+[']
	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpGope')
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpGOpe 2)')
		ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1
		ThisForm.lockscreen = .f.
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Select CrTmpGope
	If Reccount() > 0 And CrTmpGope.FontNums = 1
		lcCodDope = Alltrim( ThisForm.antform.GrupoOper ) + TprMvCab.Emps
		llretnew = .f.
	EndIf
EndIf
If llretnew 
	lcCodDope = Alltrim( TprMvCab.Dopes ) + TprMvCab.Emps
EndIf
pcEscolha = ThisForm.pcEscolha

If _NaoDodefault
	ThisForm.plCancelar = .t.
Else
	=DoDefault()
EndIf

_GravaDel = .f.

If ThisForm.plCancelar
	llRetNewId = .t.
	llCancelou = .f.
	ThisForm.totite=fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	If ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR' And ( (crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 1 And ;
				!ThisForm.SubNivelFiscal And (ThisForm.totite<>0  And ThisForm.ImpressoItem) ) ;
				or (crSigCdOpe.CupFis = 3 And !ThisForm.SubNivelFiscal))

		Declare laArqs[1]
		lnArqs = ADir(laArqs, [?] + TprMvCab.Notas + [*.TXT])
		
		If lnArqs > 0
			lcDelete = [?] + TprMvCab.Notas + [*.TXT]
			Erase (lcDelete)
		EndIf 
			
		OkCancela = ThisForm.CancelCupomFiscal()
		_GravaDel = .t.
		llRetNewId = .f.
		llCancelou = .T.
	EndIf
	If ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR' And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) 
		oFormulario = ThisForm.oModemEest
		Select crSigFiFis
		Goto Top
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'SWEDA','NSWEDA') And ThisForm.AbriuCupom And Not llCancelou &&And ThisForm.TotIte = 0
			Fecha = ThisForm.FecharCupom(oFormulario,crSigFiFis.Imps)
			llRetNewId = .f.
		EndIf
		If InList(crSigFiFis.Imps,'ELGIN')
*			Fecha = VendaCancel(oFormulario)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	If ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR' And OkCancela
		If Not InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) Or llRetNewId
			=fCanUniqueKey( lnCodigo, lcCodDope )
		EndIf
		
		Select crSigMvNfi
		Go top
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
		If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !Eof( 'crSigMvNfi' )
			=fCanUniqueKey( Val( crSigMvNfi.NFis ), TprMvCab.Emps + "NOTA FISCAL" + crSigMvNfi.Series )
			=fCanUniqueKey( crSigMvNfi.Selos, TprMvCab.Emps + 'SELO NOTA FISCAL' + crSigMvNfi.Series )
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If Inlist( pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And OkCancela
	
		ThisForm.poDataMgr.RollBack()
		ThisForm.poDataMgr2.RollBack()

		If Inlist(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And ThisForm.totite<>0

			Select TprMvCab
			Goto Top
			Scatter Memvar
			m.cMarcas  = '*'
			m.DataExcl = TprMvCab.Datas
			Select crSigExMvc
			If Reccount() = 0
				Insert Into crSigExMvc From Memvar
			EndIf
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Scan
				If Empty(Cpros) Or Qtds = 0
					Loop
				EndIf
				Scatter Memvar
				m.CidChaves = fUniqueIds()
				m.EmpDopNums = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)
				Insert Into crSigExMvi From Memvar
			EndScan
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.UpDate('crSigExMvc')
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.UpDate('crSigExMvi')
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.Commit()
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If ThisForm._pConsulta And csSigOpCdd.chkMacro # 1
		ThisForm.Pagina.Lista.Grupo_Saida.Sair.Click()
		
*		ThisForm.AntForm.ProcessaPeriodo( .F., TprMvCab.Numes, TprMvCab.Dopes )
*!*			ThisForm.AntForm.Enabled = .T.
*!*			ThisForm.AntForm.KeyPreview=.t.
		ThisForm.Release
		Return .f.
	Else
		If ( InList(crSigCdOpe.CupFis,1,3) And crSigCdOpe.TransOns = 1 ) And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
			lnCnt = 1
			ldtime = DateTime()
			Do While DateTime() - ldtime <= 1 And Not _NaoDodefault && mena 20/11/2014 diminui tempo 6
				If crSigFiFis.Imps = 'S/IMPRESSORA'
					Exit
				EndIf
				If Not (IsNull(ThisForm.poFormxEEst1))
					ThisForm.poFormxeest1.Cnt_mensagem.Mensagem.caption = 'Aguarde Finalização '+Iif(crSigFiFis.Imps<>'S/IMPRESSORA','do Cupom Fiscal!!!',' da Movimentação!!!')+Str(lnCnt,3)
				Else
					Wait Window 'Aguarde Finalização '+Iif(crSigFiFis.Imps<>'S/IMPRESSORA','do Cupom Fiscal','da Movimentação')+Str(lnCnt,3) nowait
				EndIf
				=chrsaw(.5)
				lnCnt = lnCnt + 1
			EndDo
		Else
			If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'EXCLUIR'
				ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1(.t.)
			Else
				Select TmpPendR
				Go Top In TmpPendR
				* Richard Em 30/04/2013 - Alterado Para roberto na Zenith; Estava apanhando os campos de status 
				*						  de Filtro, Não os de status de Gravação (Está em validação nessa data)
*!*					Locate For pStatus = Substr(Alltrim(crSigOpCdd.StsSubs),2,1) or pStatus = Substr(Alltrim(crSigOpCdd.StsSubs),3,1) &&[R] ou [C]
				Locate For pStatus = Substr(Alltrim(crSigOpCdd.StsGrvs),2,1) or pStatus = Substr(Alltrim(crSigOpCdd.StsGrvs),3,1) &&[R] ou [C]
				If Not Eof([TmpPendR])
					If MessageBox('Confirma Gravação dos SubNiveis REPROVADOS ou CANCELADOS?',4+32,'') = 6
						Scan
							If !Empty(TmpPendR.pStatus) &&pStatus = [R]
 
								lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCab Set Usuals = '] + Usuar + [', ] + ;
								   							   [DtAlts = ?pDat, ] + ; 
								   							   [Obses = '] + TmpPendR.Obses + [', ] + ;
								   							   [pStatus = '] + pStatus + [' ] + ;
								   							   [Where EmpDopNums = ']+TmpPendR.EmpDopNums+[']
								If ThisForm.poDataMgr5.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 0
									MessageBox('Não foi possivel gravar a Movimentação '+TmpPendR.EmpDopNums,0+64,'')
								EndIf
							EndIf

							If !Empty(TmpPendR.CodTams)
								lcUpDate = [Update SigMvIts Set CodTams = '] + TmpPendR.CodTams + [' Where EmpDopNums = ']+TmpPendR.EmpDopNums+[']
								If ThisForm.poDataMgr5.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 0
									MessageBox('Não foi possivel gravar a Movimentação '+TmpPendR.EmpDopNums,0+64,'')
								EndIf

								If (crSigCdOpe.cBxSubns = 1) && Se "Cancela Bx SubNivel do SubNivel"
									lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvPec Where EmpDopNums = ']+TmpPendR.EmpDopNums+[']
									If ThisForm.poDataMgr5.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrEstPe') < 1
										MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrEstPe)')
										Return .f.
									EndIf
									Go Top In CrEstPe
												
									_nDope = Val(Left(Str(CrEstPe.Codigos,10),4))
									_nNume = Val(Right(Str(CrEstPe.Codigos,10),6))
									=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpe','CrTmpOpe','nDopes',_nDope,[Dopes])
									lcEdn = Iif(IsEmpty(CrEstPe.EmpSubns),ThisForm.pemps,CrEstPe.EmpSubns)+CrTmpOpe.Dopes+Str(_nNume,6)
									=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvPec','CrTmpEstPe','EmpDopNums',lcEdn)
									
									Select CrTmpEstPe
									Scan
										lcUpDate = [Update SigMvIts Set CodTams = '] + TmpPendR.CodTams + [' Where EmpDopNums = ']+CrTmpEstPe.EmpDopNums+[']
										If ThisForm.poDataMgr5.SqlExecute(lcUpdate,'') < 1
											=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (Update CodTam Sunnivel)')
											Return .f.
										EndIf
									EndScan
								EndIf
							EndIf
						EndScan
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr5.commit()
					EndIf
				EndIf

				*** Mena - 22/05/2013 - incluido para cancelar tefs pendentes de cupom nao fiscal ***
				If crSigCdOpe.cupfis=3 AND (crSigCdPam.Sistef = 1 Or (crSigCdPam.Sistef = 3 And Empty(crSigCdPam.numips)))
					=verifTEF(Thisform)
				endif
				**********************************************************************
				ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1
			EndIf
		EndIf
		Return .t.
	EndIf
Else
	Return .f.
ENDIF

ThisForm.plItem = .t.
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.Enabled = .t.
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Pagto.Enabled = .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE pagina.dados.Activate
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE pagina.dados.Activate
Local lcFoco

=DoDefault()
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)

lcFoco = 'Grupo_Salva.Salva'

If ThisForm.AtFoco
	ThisForm.AtFoco = .F.
	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
		Do Case
			Case ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'PROCURAR'
				lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getCodigo'

			Case InList( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'CONSULTAR', 'EXCLUIR' )
				lcFoco = 'Grupo_Salva.Salva'

			Case ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And ( Inlist(crSigCdOpe.Subns,1,3) )
				lcFoco = 'GradeOperação'

			Case ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And ( inlist(crSigCdOpe.SubNs,4,5)  Or (crSigCdOpe.SubNs=3 And Empty(crSigCdOpe.Nivels) ) )
				lcFoco = 'GradeMultiSubN'

			Case ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And ( InList(crSigCdOpe.Numeras,3,4) ) And Not ThisForm.mgope
				lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getCodigo'

			Case ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And ( crSigCdOpe.Numeras = 3 ) And ThisForm.mgope And crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1
				lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta'

			Case ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And ( crSigCdOpe.Numeras = 3 ) And ThisForm.mgope And crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1
				lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta'

			Case InList( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
				If crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 1
					lcFoco = 'Pagto'
				EndIf

				If InList(crSigCdOpe.digitens,1,3,4,5,8)
					lcFoco = 'btnItens'
				EndIf

				If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 1, 2, 5)
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Conta'
				EndIf

				If !crSigCdOpe.FixGVends And InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 1, 2, 5)
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Grupo'
				EndIf

				If crSigCdOpe.confes = 1
					If crSigCdOpe.Subns = 1
						lcFoco = 'GradeOperação'
					Else
						lcFoco = 'GradeMultiSubN'
					EndIf
				EndIf
						
				If !crSigCdOpe.FixCDests And crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta'
				EndIf

				If !crSigCdOpe.FixGDests And crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Grupo'
				EndIf

				If !crSigCdOpe.FixCOrigs And crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta'
				EndIf

				If !crSigCdOpe.FixGOrigs And crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Grupo'
				EndIf
						
				If InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDObrigs,1,3) And InList( crSigCdOpe.TabDescs, 1, 2, 4 )
					lcFoco = 'pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes'
				EndIf
						
		EndCase
	Endwith

	If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And crSigCdOpe.Digitens = 1 And crSigCdOpe.Origems # 1 And crSigCdOpe.Destinos # 1 And ;
		!InList(crSigCdOpe.Subns,1,3,4,5) And  !(InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 1, 2, 4, 5 )) And ;
		!(InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 1, 2) And InList(crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs, 1, 3)) And crSigCdOpe.TransOns # 1
		ThisForm.AcessoAuto = .t.
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.Click()
	Else
		If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' And crSigCdOpe.Digitens = 1 And crSigOpCdd.chkMacro = 1
			ThisForm.AcessoAuto = .t.
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.Click()
		Else
			If Not Empty(lcFoco)
				ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
				ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.&lcFoco..SetFocus
			EndIf
		EndIf 		
	EndIf
EndIf

Select TprMvCab
Go Top

If ThisForm._pPagamento And Not ThisForm.Clicado
	ThisForm.Clicado = .t.
	Keyboard '{ALT+O}'
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Click

PROCEDURE Click
ThisForm.Limpacursor()
ThisForm.LimpaCursor(.t.)

ThisForm.LocRegister = ListaEest.Numes
CidChav = ListaEest.CidChaves
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Requery('crSigMvCab')
Select crSigMvCab
If Eof()
	Return
EndIf

IF !thisform.chkopfec(2)		&& mena 08/07/2017 - checa se tem fechamento
	return
ENDIF

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',crSigMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','crSigOpCdc','dopes',crSigMvCab.Dopes)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdi','crSigOpCdi','dopes',crSigMvCab.Dopes) && Mena 02/06/2014 cria cursor para checar flag no recebimento

lcEest = crSigMvCab.Emps + crSigMvCab.Dopes + Str( crSigMvCab.Numes, 6 )
lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvNfi Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEest+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpNfis')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpNFis)')
	RETURN .f.
EndIf

If Not ThisForm.LibAltFpag()
	Return
EndIf

If Type( 'ThisForm.TotPres' ) # 'N'
	ThisForm.TotPres = crSigMvCab.Valos
EndIf

ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR'

Select crTpmMvItnS 
Zap
Select crTpmMvItn
Zap
Select xPar
Zap
Select crSigMvNfi
Zap
Select TprMvCab
Zap

Insert Into TprMvCab ( Acres, ChkBxParcs, Chksubn, CodObs, Datars, Datas, ;
		Datatrans, Desc2s, Descs, Devols, Dopes, Ecfs, Empds, Emps, Grvends, Iclis, Locals, ;
		Lotechqs, Lprecos, Mascnum, Nemps, Notas, Ntrans, Numes, Numolds, ;
		Obses, Opers, Tabds, Tpfats, Transps, Usuals, Usuars, Valacres, Valdes2s, Valdescs, ;
		Valdevs, Valinis, Valos, Valvars, Vars, Vends, Usulibs, Grupoos, Contaos, Grupods, ;
		Contads, Valencs, PrazoEnts, GrResps, Resps, ValServs, DtEmis, CotUsus, Nops, ;
		Qtdes, Espes, PBrus, PLiqs, Dgopes, ValVarPs, DtAlts, ValTrans, Jobs, ObsCabMovs, PTax1s, PTax2s );
	Values ( crSigMvCab.Acres, crSigMvCab.ChkBxParcs, crSigMvCab.Chksubn, ;
			 crSigMvCab.CodObs, crSigMvCab.Datars, crSigMvCab.Datas, crSigMvCab.Datatrans, ;
			 crSigMvCab.Desc2s, crSigMvCab.Descs, crSigMvCab.Devols, crSigMvCab.Dopes, crSigMvCab.Ecfs, ;
			 crSigMvCab.Empds, crSigMvCab.Emps, crSigMvCab.Grvends, crSigMvCab.IClis, crSigMvCab.Locals,;
			 crSigMvCab.Lotechqs, crSigMvCab.Lprecos, crSigMvCab.Mascnum, ;

Select TprMvCab

Select TprMvCab 
Go Top
lcEest = Emps + Dopes + Str( Numes, 6 )

lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvItn Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEest+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcwhere,'CrTprMvCabi')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTprMvCabi 3)')
	ok = .f.
EndIf
Select CrTprMvCabi
Scan
	scatter memvar
 	insert into crTpmMvItn from memvar
 	replace crTpmMvItn.obs with crTprMvCabi.obs in crTpmMvItn
 	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','crtmpPro','Cpros',m.Cpros, [Cpros, Moevs, moecs, moevs, moedas, cunis,mUltComps])
	Do Case
		Case crSigCdOpe.precops=1
			moeda=crtmppro.moevs

		Case InList(crSigCdOpe.precops,2,11,15)
			moeda=crtmppro.moecs
			If InList(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
				_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.ChkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
				lcQuery = [Select Moevs, pVens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
				If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 and Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
					Moeda = crtmpfPro.MoeVs
				EndIf
			EndIf


		Case crSigCdOpe.precops = 3
			If Empty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ) 
				moeda = crtmppro.moevs
			Else
				moeda = crSigCdOpe.cmoes
			EndIf

		Case crSigCdOpe.precops=5
			moeda=crtmppro.moedas

		Case crSigCdOpe.precops=7
			moeda=crtmppro.mUltComps
			
		Case InList(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
			=fCustoMedio(TprMvCab.Emps,m.cpros,TprMvCab.Datas,ThisForm.poDataMgr(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
			moeda = TmpCusMed.Moedas

	Other
		moeda = crSigCdOpe.cmoes
	Endcase
	If !Seek( crTprMvCabi.Moefats, "TmpCot" ) 
		If crTprMvCabi.FatVals # 0
			Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( crTprMvCabi.MoeFats, crTprMvCabi.FatVals )
		Else
			=ThisForm.Cotacao( crTprMvCabi.Moefats, crSigMvCab.Datas )
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If !Seek( Moeda, "TmpCot" ) 
		If crTprMvCabi.MoeVals # 0
			Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( Moeda, crTprMvCabi.MoeVals )
		Else
			=ThisForm.Cotacao( Moeda, crSigMvCab.Datas )
		EndIf
	EndIf
Endscan
If !Seek( crSigCdOpe.CMoes, "TmpCot" )
	=ThisForm.Cotacao( crSigCdOpe.CMoes,  crSigMvCab.Datas )
EndIf

lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEest+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcwhere,'crtmpPar')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPar 4)')
	ok = .f.
EndIf
Select crtmpPar
Scan
	If !IsEmpty( DPags ) Or ( ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',crTmpPar.Fpags) And crSigOpFp.ValPends = 1 And VPags # 0 )
		If ThisForm.ChecaCondPar()
			MessageBox( 'Movimentação possui parcelas pagas...', 48 )
			Select xPar
			Zap
			Return
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Select crTmpPar
	Scatter Memvar Memo
	Insert Into xPar from Memvar
Endscan

Select CrTmpNfis
Scan
	Scatter MemVar Memo
 	Insert Into crSigMvNfi from memvar
EndScan

lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvItt Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEest+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpEstiS')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpEstiS)')
	ThisForm.mAtivaPagina1
	ThisForm.lockscreen = .f.
	Return
EndIf

Select CrTmpEstiS
Scan
	scatter memvar memo
 	Insert into crTpmMvItnS from memvar
EndScan

*** mena 08/07/2017 - cria cursor de desconto para ser usado no recebimento ***
lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvItd Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcEest+[']
lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcwhere,'CrSigMvItd')
If lnErro < 1
	MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigMvItd)')
	ok = .f.
EndIf

Select TprMvCab
Go top

ThisForm.DigPar = .f.
ThisForm.TotPar()
Select xPar

ThisForm.Enabled = .f.
ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR'

Do Form SigOpPag with Thisform, ThisForm.DataSessionId, .T.

Select xPar
Set Order to

ThisForm.mativapagina1
ENDPROC

&& Classe, para o When retornar sempre .T. e o campo ficar aberto ou fechado através do ReadOnly

llRetorno = InList( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)

If llRetorno
	ThisForm.cDynBackColor = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Produto.DynamicBackColor
	ThisForm.nGradeRecNo   = RecNo('crTpmMvItn')
	lcDynBackColor         = [Iif(ThisForm.nGradeRecNo = RecNo('crTpmMvItn'),RGB(0,255,255),RGB(255,255,255))]
	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade
		.SetAll('DynamicBackColor', lcDynBackColor, 'Column')
		.Refresh
	EndWith
EndIf

ThisForm.lWhenGetObs = llRetorno
Return( llRetorno )
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
If ThisForm.lWhenGetObs
	If IsEmpty(This.Value) And crSigCdOpe.ObsItems = 1
		MessageBox('É Obrigatório Preenchimento da Observação Para Cada Produto ... ', 48, ;
				   'Observação do Item Obrigatória')
		Return 0			   
	EndIf
EndIf

ThisForm.lWhenGetObs = .F.	
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------

Local lcFoco, llNovaLinha, lcDynBackColor

If Not IsEmpty(ThisForm.cDynBackColor)
	With ThisForm.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade
		.SetAll('DynamicBackColor','Iif(ThisForm.nTpOpers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.Opers=[S] And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros),RGB(220,255,220),RGB(255,255,255))','Column')
		.Refresh
	EndWith
	ThisForm.cDynBackColor = ''
EndIf
llNovaLinha = ThisForm.lNovaLinha And Not ThisForm.GeraMultipla
ThisForm.lNovaLinha = .F.

	ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
EndIf
ThisForm.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh
ThisForm.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Produto.SetFocus
ENDPROC

================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.btnCadPro
* Classe: commandbutton (Base: commandbutton)
* Registro: 76
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Click
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Click
Local lcCodProduto, lcCodFornec, lnCadPro

lcCodFornec = ''
If crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1 And crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1
	lcCodFornec = TprMvCab.ContaOs
Else
	If crSigCdOpe.Opers = 2 And crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1
		lcCodFornec = TprMvCab.ContaDs
	Else
		lcCodFornec = Iif( crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1, TprMvCab.ContaOs, ;
					  Iif( crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1, TprMvCab.ContaDs, '' ) )
	EndIf
EndIf

If ThisForm.Geramultipla
	If Empty(crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs)
		MessageBox('Obrigatorio Informar o Tipo de Pedido Antes!!!',0+16,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	=Seek( crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs, 'CsPedidos', 'Abrevs' )
	If InList(CsPedidos.CadProds,3,4,5)
		lnCadPro = CsPedidos.CadProds
	Else
		MessageBox('Alteração não permitida pela configuração do Pedido '+crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs,0+16,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
Else
	lnCadPro = crSigCdOpe.CadProds
EndIf

lcSql = [Select Cgrus From SigCdPro Where cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
ThisForm.ParentForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocalGru')
lcGru = LocalGru.Cgrus
Do Form SigCdPro With .f., crTpmMvItn.Cpros, .f., .f., .f., .f., .t., lcGru, lcCodFornec To lcCodProduto

If crSigOpCdd.AtuaPesos = 1
	If Not Empty(lcCodProduto) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigCdPro','Cpros',lcCodProduto)
		lcSql = [Select a.Cpros, a.Cgrus, a.Reffs, a.Situas, a.Cunis, a.Dpros, a.Pesoms, a.fvendas, a.fcustos, a.moepvs, ]+;
				[a.moepcs, a.moevs, a.pvens, a.moecs, a.pcuss, a.moedas, a.valors, a.cbars, a.linhas, a.colecoes, ]+;
				[a.mUltComps, a.vUltComps, a.cftios, a.Sgrus, a.mercs, a.CodFinP, a.LtMinsv, b.nTipoJoals ]+;
				[From SigCdPro a Inner Join SigCdGrp b on b.cGrus = a.cGrus Where a.Cpros = ']+lcCodProduto+[']
		ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalPro')

		Replace Pesos With LocalPro.Pesoms In crTpmMvItn
		Replace Pesos With LocalPro.Pesoms In crTpmMvIts for cItens = crTpmMvItn.cItens
	EndIf
EndIf

If Not Empty(lcCodProduto) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigCdPro','Cpros',lcCodProduto)
	With ThisForm.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Produto
		If lnCadPro = 3
			ThisForm.ProdutoPai = .f.
		EndIf
		ThisForm.Congela = .t.
		.Text1.Value = lcCodProduto
		.Text1.Valid()
		.SetFocus
	EndWith
EndIf

ENDPROC

================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.btnPApaga
* Classe: commandbutton (Base: commandbutton)
* Registro: 78
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Click
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Click
Local lnRecNo, lnReg, llDel

Select crTpmMvItn
If Eof()
	MessageBox('Posicione no Produto que Deseja Excluir ... ',48,'Nada a Fazer')
Else
	If crTpmMvItn.BlqAlts
		MessageBox('Código do Produto não pode ser Alterado',0+48,'Movimentação com Baixa Parcial')
	Else
		If !IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.cpros)
			_CItem = crTpmMvItn.CItens
			_Cpro  = crTpmMvItn.Cpros
			_Qtde  = crTpmMvItn.Qtds
			_CarregaItens = InList( crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,1,3,4,5 ) And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
			_ChecaQtde    = InList( crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss,1,3,4 )
			_ChecaOper    = ( Empty(crSigOpCdc.ChkOpers) Or crTpmMvItn.Opers = crSigOpCdc.ChkOpers )

			lnReg = Recno()
			llDel = .f.
			
			Locate For .f.
			If Between(lnReg,1,Reccount('crTpmMvItn'))
				Go lnReg
				Delete
				Delete For cItem2 = _cItem
				llDel = .t.
			EndIf

			If llDel
				Select TmpOperacao
				_SubNiv = .f.
				Scan for !IsEmpty( Codigos )
					_SubNiv = .t.
				Endscan

				If _SubNiv And _ChecaQtde And _ChecaOper And Not _CarregaItens 
					Select xBaixa
					If Seek( _Cpro )
						Replace xbaixa.qtbaixas With xbaixa.qtbaixas - _Qtde in xBaixa
					EndIf
				EndIf

				Select crTpmMvIts
				Set Order to
				Set Order to CItens
				Seek ( _CItem )
				Do While Not Eof('crTpmMvIts') And crTpmMvIts.CItens = _CItem
					Delete 
					Seek ( _CItem )
				EndDo

				Select crSigSubMv
				Delete For cItem2 = _cItem

				If Used([crSigMvIte])
					Select crSigMvIte
					Delete For Citens = _cItem
				Endif
				
				If crSigCdOpe.CadProds = 3
					lcSql = [Select Cpros From SigMvItn Where Cpros = ']+_cPRO+[' And EmpDopNums <> ']+TprMvCab.EmpdopNums+[']
					ThisForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocEesti')

					lcSql = [Select Cpros From SigMvHst  Where Cpros = ']+_cPRO+[' And EmpDopNums <> ']+TprMvCab.EmpdopNums+[']
					ThisForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocHis')
					
					lcSql = [Select Mats From SigPrCpo Where Mats = ']+_cPro+[']
					ThisForm.PodataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'LocCompo')

					If Reccount('LocEesti') = 0	And Reccount('LocHis') = 0 And Reccount('LocCompo') = 0
						If MessageBox('Deseja Excluir O Cadastro de Produto ? ',4+16+256,'') = 6
							=ThisForm.ExcluirPro(_cPro)
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		Else
			Select [ ] as Agrupar,Count(1) As Total From crTpmMvItn Where IsEmpty(CPros) Into Cursor xApaga Group by 1
			If xApaga.Total > 1
				Select crTpmMvItn
				Delete
			Else
				ThisForm.ApaIte()
			EndIf
			If Used('xApaga')
				Use In xApaga
			EndIf
		EndIf

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Set Order To Citens
		Go top
		If Eof()
			Insert Into crTpmMvItn( Emps, Dopes, Numes, CItens) ;
				Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, 1 )
		EndIf
		Cont = 0
		Scan
			Cont = Cont + 1
			Select crTpmMvIts
			Set Order To
			Set Order to CItens
			Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
			Scan While CItens = crTpmMvItn.CItens
				Replace CItens With Cont
			Endscan

			Select CrSigSubMv
			Set Order To
			Set Order to CItem2
			Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
			Scan While CItem2 = crTpmMvItn.CItens
				Replace CItem2 With Cont
			EndScan

			If Used([crSigMvIte])
				Select CrSigMvIte
				Set Order To
				Set Order to CItens
				Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
				Scan While CItens = crTpmMvItn.CItens
					Replace CItens With Cont
				Endscan
			Endif
						
			Select crTpmMvItn
			_cIt = CItens
			_RecNo2 = Recno()
			Replace cItem2 With Cont For cItem2 = _cit
			Go _RecNo2
			Replace CItens With Cont
		Endscan

		ThisForm.CItem = Cont

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Set Order To 
		Goto Bottom
		If !Eof()
			Select crTpmMvIts
			Set Order to CItens
			Set Key to crTpmMvItn.CItens
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

Select crTpmMvItn
With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade
	If .Visible
		.Refresh
		.Produto.SetFocus
	EndIf
EndWith

*!*	With ThisForm.fwGradeR
*!*		If .Visible
*!*			.Refresh
*!*			.Produto.SetFocus
*!*		EndIf
*!*	EndWith
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs # 3

ENDPROC

		.Text1.ReadOnly = llCorTam
	EndWith
	If crSigCdOpe.Imagems=1 and crSigCdOpe.Confes <> 1
		* Figura no Campo Memo
		If Not Empty(crTmpPro.FigJpgs) And Not IsNull(crTmpPro.FigJpgs)
			lcFoto=Strconv(Strtran(Strtran(Strtran(crTmpPro.FigJpgs,[data:image/png;base64,],[]),[data:image/jpeg;base64,],[]),[data:image/jpg;base64,],[]),14)
			If (StrToFile(lcFoto, lcArquivo3) > 0)
				ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.imgProds.Picture = (lcArquivo3)
				ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.imgProds.Visible = .t.
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds
		.getPVens.Value    = 0
		.getMoevs.Value    = []
		.getPVIdeals.Value = 0
		.getMoedas.Value   = []
		.getBarras.Value   = []
		.getDPro3s.Value  = []
	EndWith
	
	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade
		.Produto.ReadOnly = Eof('crTpmMvItn')
		.Produto.Text1.ReadOnly = .F.
		.Qtd.ReadOnly = .T.
		.Qtd.Text1.ReadOnly = .T.
	EndWith
EndIf

Select crTpmMvIts
Set Order to
Set Order to CItens
Set Key to crTpmMvItn.CItens

Select crTpmMvItn
With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds
	.cntReffs.getReffs.Refresh
	.getMoeVs.Refresh
EndWith

With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade
	.SetAll('DynamicBackColor','Iif(ThisForm.nTpOpers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.Opers=[S] And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros),RGB(220,255,220),RGB(255,255,255))','Column')
EndWith
ThisForm.Refresh
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getObs.Refresh
ThisForm.LockScreen = .F.
Select crTpmMvItn
lnRecno = Recno()
Locate For Recno() = lnRecno

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
Return .F.
If Not InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR]) 
	Return .f.
EndIf

Select crTpmMvItn
If ThisForm.Desmembrou
	ThisForm.LockScreen = .T.
	=fCarregaGrade(ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade)
	ThisForm.LockScreen = .F.
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh
	ThisForm.Desmembrou = .f.
EndIf
ThisForm.OldCodBarras = crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
ThisForm.AntValu      = crTpmMvItn.Units
ThisForm.Abriuitem3   = .f.
ThisForm.Abriuitem2   = .f.
ThisForm.Preencheu1   = .f.
ThisForm.ProdutoPai   = .t.
ThisForm.Congela      = .f.
Return( Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs # 3)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local lcod,lfan,codcor,xobj,oper,precop,cuni,moec,moev,pcus,pven,cmoe, lcMoeVs, lnUniVals 
Local fcusto,fvenda,llProducao, lnAQtds, llTransfEtiq, lcEmpos, _Msg, _Caption, llVerEst2
Local lacampo, lcGrupo, lcConta, llRetorno

If Not Empty(ThisForm.BuscaProduto)
	ThisForm.BuscaProduto = ''
EndIf

This.Refresh 
If Not Empty(Alltrim(This.Tag)) And (Padr(This.Tag, 14) = Padr(This.Value, 14))
	Return .t.
EndIf

This.Value = Strtran(Strtran(This.Value, ['], []), ["], [])
This.Value = Strtran(Strtran(This.Value, '[', ''), ']', '')

llVerEst2 = .F.
_Msg = ''
_Caption = ''
ThisForm.Foco = ''
Select crTpmMvItn
llTransfEtiq = .F.
lcEmpos = crTpmMvItn.Empos
lcGrupo = crTpmMvItn.GrupoEts
lcConta = crTpmMvItn.ContaEts
llRetorno = .t.

lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
		    [From SigCdOpe ] + ;
		   [Where Dopes = '] + TprMvCab.Dopes + [']

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigCdOpe') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdOpe)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In crSigCdOpe

lcSql = [Select * From SigOpCdd Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql, 'crSigOpCdd') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigOpCdd)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In crSigOpCdd

Go Top in crSigCdPam

If Not fAbrirTabs(ThisForm.ParentForm.poDataMgr, [SigCdRpo], [LocalRopt], [Dopps = '] + TprMvCab.Dopes + ['])
	Return .f.
EndIf
llRes = (Reccount([LocalRopt]) > 0)
Use In LocalRopt

opdevol    = ( crSigCdOpe.Dopes = crSigCdPam.OpDevols )
llProducao = ( crSigCdOpe.Produc = 1 )
oper       = crSigCdOpe.Opers
OpePad     = crSigCdOpe.OpePads
precop     = crSigCdOpe.precops
cpro       = ''
dpro       = ''
peso       = 0
lcMoeVs    = ''
_CarItem   = crSigOpCdc.CarItes

lnAQtds = crTpmMvItn.AQtds
If Not Empty(Alltrim(This.Tag)) And (Padr(This.Tag, 14) <> Padr(This.Value, 14))
	If crSigCdOpe.SubNObrigs = 1 And crTpmMvItn.SubNObrigs = 1
		This.Value = This.Tag
		MessageBox('Código do Produto não pode ser Alterado',0+48,'Movimentação com Sub-Nível Obrigatório')
		Return .F.
	Else
		If Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs)
			This.Value = This.Tag
			MessageBox('Código do Produto não pode ser Alterado',0+48,'Movimentação com Tipo de Pedido ja informado!!!')
			Return .F.
		Else
			If crTpmMvItn.BlqAlts
				This.Value = This.Tag
				MessageBox('Código do Produto não pode ser Alterado',0+48,'Item com Baixa Parcial')
				Return .F.
			Else
				_CarregaItens = InList( crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,1,3,4,5 ) And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
				_ChecaQtde    = InList( crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss,1,3,4 )
				_ChecaOper    = ( Empty(crSigOpCdc.ChkOpers) Or crTpmMvItn.Opers = crSigOpCdc.ChkOpers )

				Qtd = 0
				lnAQtds = 0
				If IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras)
					Select crTpmMvIts
					SET ORDER TO 
					Set Order to CItens
					Scan for cItens = crTpmMvItn.Citens
						Select xBaixa2
						If Seek( crTpmMvIts.Cpros + crTpmMvIts.CodCors + crTpmMvIts.CodTams, 'xBaixa2', 'CPros' )
							Replace xBaixa2.QtBaixas with xBaixa2.QtBaixas - crTpmMvIts.Qtds In xBaixa2
						EndIf
					EndScan
					Select crTpmMvIts
					Goto Top
					Delete For crTpmMvIts.CItens = crTpmMvItn.CItens
				EndIf

				Select crTpmMvItn3
				SET ORDER TO 
				Set Order to CItens
				Goto Top
				Delete For crTpmMvItn3.CItens = crTpmMvItn.CItens

				Select CrSigSubMv
				Set Order To
				Set Order To citem2
				Delete For cItem2 = crTpmMvItn.CItens

				If Used([crSigMvIte])
					Select crSigMvIte
					Set Order To
					Set Order To Citens
					Delete For Citens = crTpmMvItn.Citens
				Endif
				
				Select TmpOperacao
				_SubNiv = .f.
				Scan for !IsEmpty( Codigos )
					_SubNiv = .t.
				Endscan

				If _SubNiv And _ChecaQtde And _ChecaOper And Not _CarregaItens 
					Select xBaixa
					If Seek( Padr(This.Tag,14) )
						Replace xbaixa.qtbaixas With xbaixa.qtbaixas - crTpmMvItn.Qtds
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	Qtd = iif(crTpmMvItn.Qtds = 0 And Not InList(crSigCdOpe.ZerQtds,1,4), 1, crTpmMvItn.Qtds)
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.qtd.text1.Value = Iif(ThisForm.Congela,Qtd,0)
EndIf

ThisForm.Congela = .f.
SNumero = .T.

If !Empty( This.Value )
	If !Empty( crTpmMvItn.CodBarras )
		If Padr(This.Value,14) = Padr(This.Tag,14) And !Empty( Alltrim(This.Tag) )
			This.Value = Alltrim( Str( crTpmMvItn.codbarras ) )
			Select crTpmMvItn
		Else
			If Padr(This.Value,14) = Padr(This.Tag,14) And !Empty( Alltrim(This.Tag) )
				Select crTpmMvItn
				Replace crTpmMvItn.Notas     With '',   ;
						crTpmMvItn.CodBarras With 0,    ;
						crTpmMvItn.Utilizas  With 0,    ;
						crTpmMvItn.Qtds      With 0,    ;
						crTpmMvItn.AQtds     With 0,    ;
						crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps   With .F. , ;
						crTpmMvItn.Empos     With '',	;
						crTpmMvItn.CodCors	 with '',	;
						crTpmMvItn.CodTams	 with ''
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		If Padr(This.Value,14) = Padr(This.Tag,14) And !Empty( Alltrim(This.Tag) )
			replace CodCors with '' in crTpmMvItn && Tiago - 05/11/2010 - Se altera o código do produto, limpa a cor
			replace CodTams with '' in crTpmMvItn && Tiago - 05/11/2010 - Se altera o código do produto, limpa a cor
		EndIf
	EndIf

	SNumero = fVerificarBarras( This.Value )
		
	llProEtq = .f.
	AchouReff = .f.
	If SNumero And Not InList(crSigOpCdd.AbreRefs, 3, 4)
		ck=.t.
		Select crTpmMvItn
		_Recnx = Recno()
		_Ordem = Order()
		Set Order to CodBarras
		If Seek( Val( This.Value ) ) And Recno() = _Recnx
			Skip
		EndIf
		If !Eof() And CodBarras = Val( This.Value )

			lcQuery = [Select c.AltEtiqs ] + ;
					    [From SigOpEtq a, SigCdPro b, SigCdGrp c ] + ;
					   [Where a.Cbars = ] + Str(Val(This.Value), 14) + [ And ] + ;
					   [a.cpros = b.Cpros And b.Mercs = c.Codigos ]

			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalGgrp') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalGgrp)')
				Return 0
			EndIf
			
			Select crTpmMvItn
			If  Not ( crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs = 4 And LocalGgrp.AltEtiqs = 1 )
				Messagebox( 'Código de Barras já digitado nesta Movimentação...', 48, '' )
				Set Order to &_Ordem
				Go _Recnx
				This.Value = ''
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
		Set Order to &_Ordem
		Go _Recnx

		lcQuery = [Select a.Empos, a.Grupos, a.Contas, a.Cbars, a.Cpros, a.Qtds, a.Pesos, a.CodCors, a.CodTams, a.Peso2s, b.cproEqs ] + ;
				    [From SigOpEtq a, SigCdPro b ] + ;
				   [Where a.Cbars = ] + Str(Val(This.Value), 14) + [ And a.cpros = b.cpros ] + ;
				   [Order By a.cbars ]
		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpEti') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpEti)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Go Top In crTmpEti
		If Not Eof('crTmpEti')
			_Msg = ''
			Do Case
				Case crSigCdOpe.Opers = 2 And (CrTmpEti.Empos # TprMvCab.Emps) And InList(crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs,1,2,4)
					lcQuery = [Select Cemps, Ativas ] + ;
							    [From SigCdEmp ] + ;
							   [Where Cemps = '] + crTmpEti.Empos + [' ] + ;
							   [Order By Cemps, Ativas]

					If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'csTmpEmp') < 1)
						=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (csTmpEmp)')
						Return 0
					EndIf
					Go Top In csTmpEmp

					If ( RecCount('csTmpEmp') = 1 ) And ( csTmpEmp.Ativas # 2 ) And ;
						( crSigCdOpe.Transs = 3 ) And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) And ;
					   	( crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 ) And ( TprMvCab.GrupoOs = crtmpEti.Grupos ) And ;
					   	( TprMvCab.ContaOs = crtmpEti.Contas )
					   	If IsEmpty(ThisForm.OldCodBarras) Or Val(This.Value) # ThisForm.OldCodBarras
						   	If MessageBox('Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ;
						   				   ' pertence a Empresa: ' + crtmpEti.Empos + ' !!! Confirma a transferência ? ', 4 + 32 + 256, ;
						   				   'Transferencia Automática de Etiqueta') # 6
								This.Value = ''
								Return 0
							EndIf
						EndIf
						llTransfEtiq = .T.
						lcEmpos = crtmpEti.Empos
						lcGrupo = ''
						lcConta = ''
					Else
						If ( RecCount('csTmpEmp') = 1 And csTmpEmp.Ativas # 2 And ;
							crSigCdOpe.Transs = 5 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) And ;
						   	crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 And ( TprMvCab.GrupoOs # crtmpEti.Grupos Or ;
						   	TprMvCab.ContaOs # crtmpEti.Contas Or TprMvCab.Emps # CrTmpEti.Empos ) )
						   	If IsEmpty(ThisForm.OldCodBarras) Or Val(This.Value) # ThisForm.OldCodBarras
							   	If MessageBox('Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ;
							   				   ' pertence ao Estoque: ' + CrTmpEti.Empos + '/'+ crtmpEti.Grupos+'/'+CrTmpEti.Contas + ' !!! Confirma a transferência ? ', 4 + 32 + 256, ;
							   				   'Transferencia Automática de Etiqueta') # 6
									This.Value = ''
									Return 0
								EndIf
							EndIf
							If Not fContaPermitida(ThisForm.PodataMgr,crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs,crtmpEti.Grupos,CrTmpEti.Contas)
								This.Value = ''
								Return 0
							EndIf
							llTransfEtiq = .T.
							lcEmpos = crtmpEti.Empos
							lcGrupo = CrTmpEti.Grupos
							lcConta = CrTmpEti.Contas
						Else
							If IsEmpty(crtmpEti.Grupos) And IsEmpty(crtmpEti.Contas)
								_Msg = 'Esta etiqueta já foi vendida!'
							Else
								If RecCount('csTmpEmp') = 1 And csTmpEmp.Ativas = 2 And ;
									( crSigCdOpe.Transs = 3 ) And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs)
									_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ;
										   ' Não Pode Ser Transferida, ' + Chr(13) + ;
										   'Pois Pertence a Empresa ' + AllTrim( crtmpEti.Empos ) + ;
										   ', que Está Inativa.'
								Else
									_Msg = 'Esta etiqueta não pertence a esta empresa!'
								EndIf
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf
					
				Case crSigCdOpe.Opers # 3 And IsEmpty( crtmpEti.Contas ) And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 And Val( This.Value ) # crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
					_Msg = 'Esta etiqueta já foi vendida!'

				Case crSigCdOpe.Opers # 3 And InList(crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs,2,4) And ;
						(TprMvCab.Grupoos # crtmpEti.Grupos Or TprMvCab.Contaos # crtmpEti.Contas Or TprMvCab.Emps # CrTmpEti.Empos );
						And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And Val( This.Value ) # crTpmMvItn.CodBarras

						lcQuery = [Select Cemps, Ativas ] + ;
								    [From SigCdEmp ] + ;
								   [Where Cemps = '] + crTmpEti.Empos + [' ] + ;
								   [Order By Cemps, Ativas]

						If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'csTmpEmp') < 1)
							=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (csTmpEmp)')
							Return 0
						EndIf
						Go Top In csTmpEmp

						If ( RecCount('csTmpEmp') = 1 And csTmpEmp.Ativas # 2 And ;
							crSigCdOpe.Transs = 5 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) And ;
						   	crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 And ( TprMvCab.GrupoOs # crtmpEti.Grupos Or ;
						   	TprMvCab.ContaOs # crtmpEti.Contas Or TprMvCab.Emps # CrTmpEti.Empos ) )
						   	If MessageBox('Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ;
						   				   ' pertence ao Estoque: ' + CrTmpEti.Empos + '/' + crtmpEti.Grupos+'/'+CrTmpEti.Contas + ' !!! Confirma a transferência ? ', 4 + 32 + 256, ;
						   				   'Transferencia Automática de Etiqueta') # 6
								This.Value = ''
								Return 0
							EndIf
							If Not fContaPermitida(ThisForm.PodataMgr,crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs,crtmpEti.Grupos,CrTmpEti.Contas)
								This.Value = ''
								Return 0
							EndIf
							llTransfEtiq = .T.
							lcEmpos = crtmpEti.Empos
							lcGrupo = CrTmpEti.Grupos
							lcConta = CrTmpEti.Contas
						Else
							_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ' Pertence ' + ;
								   ' ao Estoque ' + Alltrim(CrTmpEti.Empos)+'/'+AllTrim(crtmpEti.Grupos) + '/' + AllTrim(crtmpEti.Contas) + '.'
						EndIf
						
				Case crSigCdOpe.Opers # 3 And crSigCdOpe.EstDests = 2 And ;
						(TprMvCab.Grupods # crtmpEti.Grupos Or TprMvCab.Contads # crtmpEti.Contas) And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And Val( This.Value ) # crTpmMvItn.CodBarras 
					_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ' Pertence ' + ;
						   ' ao Estoque ' + AllTrim(crtmpEti.Grupos) + '/' + AllTrim(crtmpEti.Contas) + '.'

				Case crSigCdOpe.Transs = 1 And TprMvCab.Emps # crtmpEti.Empos And crSigCdOpe.Estoqs = 1 And Val( This.Value ) # crTpmMvItn.CodBarras 
					_Msg = 'Etiqueta ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999999999') + ' Pertence ' + ;
						   ' a Empresa ' + AllTrim(crtmpEti.Empos) + '.'
			EndCase
			
			If !IsEmpty(_Msg)
				lcQuery = [Select EmpDopNums, OriDopNums, CidChaves From SigMvHst Where CodBarras = ]+Str(CrTmpEti.cbars,14)+[ Order By CidChaves Desc ]
				If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crhis') < 1)
					=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crhis)')
					Return 0
				EndIf
				Select crHis
				Go Top
				If !Eof() And ( ThisForm.pcEscolha = "ALTERAR" ) And ;
						( ( ( Not crSigCdOpe.Transs = 1) And ;
						    ( crHis.EmpDopNums==TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.Dopes+ Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) ) ) Or ;
						  ( ( crSigCdOpe.Transs = 1 ) And ;
						    ( crHis.OriDopNums==TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.EmpDs+TprMvCab.Dopes+Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) ) ) )

					lcQuery = [Select Grupoos, Contaos ] + ;
							    [From SigMvCab ] + ;
							   [Where EmpDopNums = '] + TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes, 6) + [' ] + ;
							   [Order By Grupoos, Contaos]

					If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crEest') < 1)
						=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crEest)')
						Return 0
					EndIf
					Go Top In crEest

					If crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 2 And ;
						TprMvCab.GrupoOs = crEest.GrupoOs And TprMvCab.ContaOs == crEest.ContaOs
					Else
						Messagebox( 'Esta Etiqueta não pertence a este estoque', 32, '' )
						This.Value = This.Tag
						Return 0
					EndIf
				Else
					Messagebox( _Msg, 32, '' )
					this.Value = This.Tag
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If ( crSigCdOpe.SemEtiqs = 4 )
				Messagebox('Esta Movimentação não aceita Código de Barra!!',0+48,'')
				This.Value = This.Tag
				This.refresh
				Return 0
			EndIf
	
			If crSigCdOpe.CodBars = 3
				lcQuery = [Select EmpdopNums,CodBarras From SigMvItn Where CodBarras = ]+Str(CrTmpEti.Cbars)+[ And Dopes=']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[']
				If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrBarra') < 1)
					=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crEest)')
					Return 0
				EndIf
				Select CrBarra
				If Reccount() > 0
					MessageBox('Etiqueta ' + AllTrim(Str(crTmpEti.CBars,14)) + ' já digitada na Movimentação '+CrBarra.EmpDopNums,48,'')
					This.Value = This.Tag
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			llfalse = .f.
			If crSigCdOpe.CodBars <> 1 
				lcUpDate = [UpDate SigOpEtq Set Usuars = ']+Usuar+[' Where Cbars = ]+Str(CrTmpEti.Cbars)

	If crSigOpCdc.VincEMins = 1 And Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.EmpDs)

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Scan
			lnCount = lnCount + 1
			Select crTpmMvIts
			Set Order To
			Set Order to CItens
			Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
			Scan While CItens = crTpmMvItn.CItens
				Replace CItens With lnCount
			EndScan

			Select CrSigSubMv
			Set Order To
			Set Order to CItem2
			Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
			Scan While CItem2 = crTpmMvItn.CItens
				Replace CItem2 With lnCount
			EndScan

			If Used([crSigMvIte])
				Select CrSigMvIte
				Set Order To
				Set Order to CItens
				Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
				Scan While CItens = crTpmMvItn.CItens
					Replace CItens With Cont
				Endscan
			Endif
			
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Replace crTpmMvItn.CItens With lnCount
		EndScan	
		ThisForm.CItem = lnCount
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.refresh
	EndIf
EndIf

If (crSigOpCdc.Seriados = 1) && AutoZoom de Itens
	Local lcArquivo

	lcArquivo = Sys(2023) + '\' + goSistema.Sys2015Tmp + Sys(2015) + '.Jpg'

	lcCodPro  = crTpmMvItn.cpros
	lcSql = [Select a.cpros,a.dpros,a.FigJpgs From SigCdPro a Where a.cpros = ']+lcCodPro+[' ]
	ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcsql,'LocalPro')

	* Figura no Campo Memo
	If Not Empty(LocalPro.FigJpgs) And Not IsNull(LocalPro.FigJpgs)
		lcFoto=Strconv(Strtran(Strtran(Strtran(LocalPro.FigJpgs,[data:image/png;base64,],[]),[data:image/jpeg;base64,],[]),[data:image/jpg;base64,],[]),14)
		=StrToFile(lcFoto, lcArquivo)
		If File(lcArquivo)
			Do Form SigOpZom With lcArquivo, ;
								  'Produto : ' + LocalPro.CPros + ' - ' + LocalPro.DPros, ' '
			Delete File (lcArquivo)
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

=ThisForm.podatamgr.Cursorquery('SigCdGpr','CrTmpGgrp','codigos',CrTmpPro.Mercs)
If crSigCdOpe.CodBars = 1 And CrTmpGgrp.BarRefs <> 1
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Replace EtiEsps With .f.
EndIf

If crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps
	Go Top in crSigCdPam
	If crSigCdOpe.Dopes = crSigCdPam.OpDevols And Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And !IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.cpros ) And crTpmMvItn.qtds > 0 
		If crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1
			ThisForm.LibDevols(TprMvCab.Grupoos, TprMvCab.Contaos, crTpmMvItn.cpros, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
		Else
			ThisForm.LibDevols(TprMvCab.Grupods, TprMvCab.Contads, crTpmMvItn.cpros, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps And (crSigCdPac.BarIndivs < 2 Or crSigCdPac.BarIndivs = 4) And InList( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) 
		If Lastkey()=13 And ThisForm.citem<crSigCdOpe.qtdites
			If (crSigCdOpe.Opers # 3)
				If llVerEst2
					Select crTpmMvIts
				Else
					Select crTpmMvItn
				EndIf
				
				If llTransfEtiq Or (Iif(InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) And CrTmpGgrp.AltEtiqs = 1,.T.,fverest(ThisForm.podatamgr) ) )
					If (crSigCdOpe.EFators # 1) And (Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EPesos,1,3)) And ;
							(crSigCdOpe.EPrecos # 1) And (Not InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) Or CrTmpGgrp.AltEtiqs <> 1 )
						ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
						ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh
					EndIf
				Else
					ThisForm.ApaIte()
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If InList(crSigOpCdc.CarCompos,1,5,6) And Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
	ThisForm.DesMembraC(crTpmMvItn.Cpros,.f.,crTpmMvItn.pesos)
	ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
EndIf

If InList(crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs,1,3) And Lastkey() = 13
	ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
EndIf
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh

IF NOT llRetorno
	This.Tag = This.Value
EndIf

RETURN llRetorno

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
Local lRetorno, lOldCodPro, llAtivCopia

This.Refresh 
If Not Empty(Alltrim(This.Tag)) And (Padr(This.Tag, 14) = Padr(This.Value, 14))
	Return .t.
EndIf

lRetorno = ( IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.Utilizas ) And Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And ;
			crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs # 3 And crSigOpCdc.Varcppqs = 0 )

ThisForm.ProdutoPai = .t.
ThisForm.QtDesmemb = 0
lcCodPro = ' '
lOldCodPro = ' '
lcCodProduto = ' '
If crSigOpCdc.CarCompos = 3 And Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And Not crTpmMvItn.CarCompos
	Create Cursor crGrade (Marcas l(1), Mats c(14), DPros c(40), Qtds n(9,3), UniCompos c(3), PCompos n(12,3), ;
						   Moeds c(3), Totas n(12,2), Reffs c(40), FigJpgs m(4), Tipos c(20))

	Replace CarCompos With .t. in crTpmMvItn

	Do Form SigOpCpo With ThisForm, crTpmMvItn.CPros

	If Used([crGrade])
		ThisForm.DesMembraC(crTpmMvItn.Cpros,.t.,crTpmMvItn.pesos)
	EndIf
EndIf

If InList(crSigCdOpe.CadProds,3,5) And Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.cpros)
	lcSql = [Select Cpros, cproeqs From SigCdPro where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
	If ThisForm.podatamgr.sqlexecute(lcsql,'CrtmpPro') > 0
		lOldCodPro = crTpmMvItn.Cpros
		If (crSigCdOpe.CadProds = 3 And Empty(CrTmpPro.cproeqs)) Or (crSigCdOpe.CadProds = 5 And Not crTpmMvItn.CadProd )
			DO Form SigOpRef with CrTmpPro.cpros,crSigCdOpe.ItSituas,.F.,crSigOpCdd.nIdentFixa,crSigCdOpe.CadProds,TprMvCab.Dopes to lcCodPro
			ThisForm.QtDesmemb = 0
			If Len(lcCodPro) = 12
				lcCodProduto = Left(lcCodPro,14)
				ThisForm.QtDesmemb = Val(Right(lcCodPro,2))
			EndIf
			If Not Empty(lcCodProduto) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigCdPro','Cpros',lcCodProduto)
				With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Produto
					ThisForm.ProdutoPai = .f.
					.Text1.Value = lcCodProduto
					.Text1.Valid()
					Replace CadProd With .t. in crTpmMvItn
					If ThisForm.QtDesmemb < 2
						.SetFocus
					EndIf
				EndWith
			Else
				With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Produto
					.Text1.Value = Space(14)
					.SetFocus
				EndWith
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If Not lRetorno
	lcQuery = [Select Cunis, Cgrus, CodCors, CodTams, Mercs ] + ;
			    [From SigCdPro ] + ;
			   [Where CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' ] + ;
			   [Order By Cunis, Cgrus, CodCors, CodTams]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpPro') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpPro)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In crTmpPro

	lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
			    [From SigCdUni ] + ;
			   [Where CUnis = '] + crTmpPro.CUnis + [' ] + ;
			   [Order By CUnis]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpUni') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpUni)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In crTmpUni

	lcQuery = [Select TipoEstos, Mercs, cores, tams, embs, cgrus, dgrus, Pesos, Entregas ] + ;
			    [From SigCdGrp ] + ;
			   [Where CGrus = '] + crTmpPro.CGrus + [' ] + ;
			   [Order By TipoEstos, Mercs, cores, tams, embs, cgrus, dgrus, Pesos, Entregas]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpGru') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpGru)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In crTmpGru

	=ThisForm.Podatamgr.Cursorquery('SigCdGpr','CrTmpGgrp','Codigos',CrTmpPro.Mercs)
	llAltEtq  = ( CrTmpGgrp.AltEtiqs = 1 )

	llSubItem = ( crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts = 1 ) And Not WExist( 'SigOpSit' ) And ;
				( InList( CrTmpGru.TipoEstos, 2, 3, 4 ) Or ( CrTmpGru.Tams = 1) Or ;
					    ( CrtmpGru.Cores = 1 ) Or ( CrTmpGru.Embs = 1 ) )

	llSubServ = (crSigCdOpe.HabServs = 1) And Not WExist([SigOpSer])

	If !Inlist( LastKey(), 3, 5, 9, 15, 18, 24, 148, 27, 4 )
		If llSubItem
			Do Form SigOpSit With thisform, Thisform.datasessionid
			If Inlist( Thisform.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
				Thisform.Calc_ValIte
			EndIf
			ThisForm.Abriuitem2 = .t.
		Else		
			If llSubServ
				Do Form SigOpSer With ThisForm, ThisForm.datasessionid
				ThisForm.abriuitem3 = .t.
			EndIf
		EndIf
		
		If ( ThisForm.Abriuitem2 Or ThisForm.abriuitem3 ) And ThisForm.QtDesmemb < 2
			llNovaLinha = ( crSigCdOpe.EFators # 1 ) And ( Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EPesos,1,3) ) And (Not InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) Or Not llAltEtq )
			llNovaLInha = llNovaLinha And Not ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 1 Or ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 3 And ;
						  ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' Or ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'S' And ;
						  	Seek(crTpmMvItn.CPros, 'csOpeAut','CPros') ) ) Or ;
						  ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos=2 And crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=7 And crTpmMvItn.Units = 0 ) ) )
			llNovaLinha = llNovaLinha And Not(IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.Utilizas ) And crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And ;
						   crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs # 3 And crSigOpCdc.Varcppqs = 0 )
			If llNovaLinha
				ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If ThisForm.QtDesmemb > 1
		ThisForm.CriaRegistro(lOldCodPro,ThisForm.QtDesmemb,crTmpPro.CGrus )
	EndIf		
EndIf

Select crTpmMvItn
If (crSigOpCdd.LibcSens=3) And Lastkey()=9 && Balcão
	Clear Typeahead 
	If Inlist(ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR') And ;
	   (crSigCdOpe.AltDescs = 1 Or Left(crTpmMvItn.Dpros,1) = '.') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
		lnRec = Recno([crTpmMvItn])
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .t.
		Skip
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh 
		Go lnRec
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.ActivePage = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.PageOrder
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getDPros.SetFocus
	EndIf
EndIf	

ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE KeyPress
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE KeyPress
Lparameters nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl

If (nKeyCode = -4) And ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.btnPBuscas.Enabled
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.btnPBuscas.Click()
	Keyboard '{CTRL+Z}' 
EndIf

If nKeyCode = 9 And Not (crSigOpCdd.LibcSens=3) && Balcão

	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getObs.SetFocus
EndIf

If nKeyCode = 10
	If ( crSigCdOpe.CadProds = 5 And crTpmMvItn.CadProd )
		Replace CadProd With .f. In crTpmMvItn
		This.LostFocus()
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE DblClick
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE DblClick
If Not Empty(This.Value)
	If IsNull(ThisForm.poObjExt1)
		If goSistema.ConsultaAberta = .t.
			MessageBox('A Consulta Global de Produtos Já está Aberta.'+Chr(13)+;
				  	   'Favor Fechar Para Poder executar nova Consulta',0+16,'')
			Return
		Else
			Do Form SigOpCgp.Scx Name ThisForm.poObjExt1 Linked With [SigOpCgp] NoShow
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If (Type([ThisForm.poObjExt1])=[O])
		With ThisForm.poObjExt1
			.fld_principal.Pag_Consulta.Commandgroup1.Command1.Click()
			.fld_principal.Pag_Consulta.Filtro.Principal.get_produto_inicial.Value = Padr(This.Value, 14)
			.fld_principal.Pag_Consulta.Filtro.Principal.get_produto_final.Value   = Padr(This.Value, 14)
			.fld_principal.Pag_Consulta.grp_operacao.cmd_consulta.Click()
		EndWith 
	EndIf 
EndIf
ENDPROC
