------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
Return .F.
Local llRetorno, llSubItem

If Not InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR])
	Return .f.
EndIf

ThisForm.AntQtdBX = This.Value

lcQuery = [Select Cgrus, Cunis, mercs, LtMinsv ] + ;
		    [From SigCdPro ] + ;
		   [Where CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By Cgrus, Cunis]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpPro') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPro)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In CrTmpPro

ThisForm.podatamgr.cursorquery('SigCdUni','CrTmpUni','Cunis',crTpmMvItn.Cunis)

lcQuery = [Select TipoEstos, Mercs, Cores, Tams, Embs, Cgrus, Dgrus, Pesos ] + ;
		    [From SigCdGrp ] + ;
		   [Where CGrus = '] + CrTmpPro.Cgrus + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By TipoEstos, Mercs, Cores, Tams, Embs, Cgrus, Dgrus, Pesos]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpGru') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpGru)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In CrTmpGru
=ThisForm.Podatamgr.Cursorquery('SigCdGpr','CrTmpGgrp','Codigos',CrTmpPro.Mercs)

llSubItem = ( crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts = 1 ) And ( InList( CrTmpGru.TipoEstos, 2, 3, 4) Or crtmpGru.Cores = 1 Or crtmpGru.Tams = 1 Or CrTmpGru.Embs = 1 )
llSubServ = ( crSigCdOpe.HabServs = 1 )
llAltEtq  = ( CrTmpGgrp.AltEtiqs = 1 )

ThisForm.AntQtd = Iif(ThisForm.Preencheu1,0,This.Value)

If Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras) And (Not InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) Or CrTmpGgrp.AltEtiqs <> 1 )
	ThisForm.AntQtd = This.Value
EndIf

llRetorno = DoDefault() And crSigCdOpe.ZerQtds <> 4

llRetorno = ( llRetorno And ( Not InList(crTpmMvItn.Utilizas, Iif(llSubServ,2,1), 2, Iif(llSubServ,12,11), 12) ) And ;
		 Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CPros) And Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And;
	     crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And ;
		 crSigOpCdc.CarItes # 3 And ;
	     ((IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras) And Not crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps And Not llSubItem) Or ;
         ( ( InList(crSigCdOpe.Opers,1,3) And IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras) And ;
         	InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) And llAltEtq Or ;
         (InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) And llAltEtq) ) Or ;
         ( crSigCdOpe.Opers = 3 And crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' And IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras) ))))

If InList(crSigOpCdd.AbreRefs, 3, 4)
	llRetorno = .t.
EndIf

Return llRetorno

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local rec,ord,totite,cotacao,cotcv,valau, _SubNiv, llNovaLinha

If ( Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras) Or crTpmMvItn.BlqAlts Or InList(crSigCdOpe.ZerQtds,2,4)) And This.Value # ThisForm.AntQtd And Not InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4)
	This.Value = ThisForm.AntQtd
	This.Refresh
	If crTpmMvItn.BlqAlts
		MessageBox('Quantidade do Produto não pode ser Alterado',0+48,'Movimentação com baixa Parcial')
	EndIf
EndIf
If This.Value < 0
	MessageBox('Quantidade do Produto não poder ser negativo!!!',0+48,'Atenção')
	Return 0
EndIf

lcQuery = [Select Cpros, LtMinSv, Cgrus, Mercs From SigCdPro ] + ;
		   [Where CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' ]
If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpPro2') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPro2)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In CrTmpPro2

If CrTmpPro2.LtMinSv > 0 and crSigOpCdc.GerOpes <> 2
	lcTransacao = 'Emp: '+_Empr + ' Nº Oper: ' + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+ ' - ' + 'Produto: ' + crTpmMvItn.cPros + ' Qtd Mínima: ' + ;
	  			  Alltrim(Str(crTmpPro2.LtMinsV,10,2)) + ' Qtd Liberada ' + Alltrim(Str(This.Value,10,2))

	If crSigOpCdd.ChkQtMinv = 1 And Mod(This.Value,CrTmpPro2.LtMinSv) <> 0
			Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIBQTMIN', 'Libera Qtd Mínima de Venda', crTpmMvItn.cpros To _Retorno
			llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
			lcUsuLib = Substr( _Retorno, 2 )
			If !llOk
				MessageBox('Quantidade não é multiplo do limite de venda : '+Alltrim(Str(CrTmpPro2.LtMinSv)),0+48,'Atenção')
				Return 0
			Else				
				=fGravarLog('T', TprMvCab.Dopes, 'LIBQTMIN', lcTransacao, lcUsuLib )
				Replace UsuLibQMin with lcUsuLib in crTpmMvItn
			EndIf				
	Else
		If crSigOpCdd.ChkQtMinv = 3 And This.Value < CrTmpPro2.LtMinSv
			Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIBQTMIN', 'Libera Qtd Mínima de Venda', crTpmMvItn.cpros To _Retorno
			llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
			lcUsuLib = Substr( _Retorno, 2 )
			If !llOk
				MessageBox('Quantidade menor que o limite de venda : '+Alltrim(Str(CrTmpPro2.LtMinSv)),0+48,'Atenção')
				Return 0
			Else
				=fGravarLog('T', TprMvCab.Dopes, 'LIBQTMIN', lcTransacao, lcUsuLib )		
				Replace UsuLibQMin with lcUsuLib in crTpmMvItn			
			EndIf						
		EndIf
	EndIf		
EndIf

lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
		    [From SigCdOpe ] + ;
		   [Where Dopes = '] + TprMvCab.Dopes + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By Dopes]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crSigCdOpe') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdOpe)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In crSigCdOpe

_CarregaItens = InList( crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,1,3,4,5 ) And ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR'
_ChecaQtde    = InList( crSigCdOpe.ChkQtdss,1,3,4 )
_ChecaOper    = ( Empty(crSigOpCdc.ChkOpers) Or crTpmMvItn.Opers = crSigOpCdc.ChkOpers )

lcQuery = [Select Desmembs ] + ;
		    [From SigCdUni ] + ;
		   [Where CUnis = '] + crTpmMvItn.CUnis + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By Desmembs]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpUni') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpUni)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In crTmpUni

lcQuery = [Select TipoEstos, Mercs, Cores, Tams, Embs, Cgrus, Dgrus, Pesos ] + ;
		    [From SigCdGrp ] + ;
		   [Where CGrus = '] + CrTmpPro2.Cgrus + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By TipoEstos, Mercs, Cores, Tams, Embs, Cgrus, Dgrus, Pesos]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpGru') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpGru)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In CrTmpGru

Select TmpOperacao
_SubNiv = .f.
Scan for !IsEmpty( Codigos )
	_SubNiv = .t.
Endscan

If _SubNiv And _ChecaQtde And _ChecaOper
	If _CarregaItens
		If This.Value > crTpmMvItn.qtbaixas 
			Messagebox( 'Impossível baixar uma quantidade maior do que a pendente no subnível!', 48,'' )
			If !IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.qtbaixas )
				This.Value = ThisForm.antqtd
			Else
				This.Value = 0
			EndIf
			Return
		EndIf
	Else
		Select xBaixa
		If !Seek( crTpmMvItn.CPros ) Or This.Value > xBaixa.Qtds - xBaixa.QtBaixas + ThisForm.AntQtdBx
			Messagebox( 'Impossível baixar uma quantidade maior do que a pendente no subnível!', 48,'' )
			If !IsEmpty( xBaixa.QtBaixas )
				This.Value = ThisForm.AntQtdBx
			Else
				This.Value = 0
			EndIf
			Return
		Else
			If This.Value # ThisForm.AntQtdBx
				Replace xbaixa.qtbaixas with xbaixa.qtbaixas + This.Value - ThisForm.AntQtdBx in xbaixa
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	If This.Value < crTpmMvItn.QtBaixas And _ChecaQtde And _ChecaOper
		Messagebox( 'Impossível alterar a quantidade para menos do que o baixado!', 48,'' )
		This.Value = ThisForm.antqtd
		Return
	EndIf
EndIf
If (Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EPesos,1,3)) And crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps And Not InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4)
	replace crTpmMvItn.qtds with ThisForm.antqtd in crTpmMvItn
	this.refresh
	unlock
else
	if Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		cpro=crTpmMvItn.cpros && ThisForm.cpro
		lnBr=crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
		lnRg=Recno('crTpmMvItn')
		If crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps And crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs = 4 And crTpmMvItn.Opers = [S] And crTpmMvItn.Qtds <> 0
			lcSql = [Select Qtds, Pesos, aQtds, aPesos From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ]+Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras)
			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql, 'crTmpET') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpET)')
				Return 0
			EndIf
			Select [] as Agrupar,Sum(Qtds)+This.Value as Qtds From crTpmMvItn where CodBarras = lnBr And ;
				EtiEsps And opers = [S] And Recno() <> lnRg ;
			Into Cursor tcrTpmMvItn Group by 1
			lnSaldo = ( Iif(ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR',CrTmpEt.Qtds,CrTmpEt.aQtds)- tcrTpmMvItn.Qtds )
			If lnSaldo < 0
				MessageBox('Quantidade(1) não Disponivel!!!',0+16,'')
				This.Value = 0
				This.Refresh
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If crSigCdOpe.Transs = 3 And Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.DopesTrfs) And ;
				crSigCdOpe.Opers = 2 And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras) 
		Else
			Select crTpmMvItn
			*** Tiago - 18/05/2011 - Se Carrega composição = sim, - estoque, não checa estoque do grande grupo configurado
			llMrc = .f.

	 		If (!Empty(CrSigOpCdd.Mercs) and CrSigOpCdd.Mercs = CrTmpPro2.Mercs)
				llMrc = .t.
	 		Else
	 			If (crSigOpCdc.carcompos = 5)
					lcSql = [Select a.*, b.Dgrus From SigOpGpo a, SigCdGrp b Where a.Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[' And a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus ]
					ThisForm.PodataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'crFilGrupos')
					If Used([crFilGrupos])
						Select crFilGrupos
						Go Top In crFilGrupos
						If Not Eof([crFilGrupos])
							Locate For CGrus = crTmpPro2.CGrus
							If Not Eof([crFilGrupos])
								llMrc = .t.
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf

	 		If (crSigOpCdc.carcompos = 5 and llMrc)
	 			llEstqOk = .t.
	 		Else
	 			If !Empty(crTpmMvItn.CodCors) Or !Empty(crTpmMvItn.CodTams)
	 				Select crTpmMvIts
					Set Order to
					Set Order to CItens
					Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
					If !Eof()
						replace qtds with crTpmMvItn.qtds in crTpmMvIts
					EndIf
	 			EndIf
		 		llEstqOk = fVerEst(ThisForm.podatamgr,(ThisForm.antqtd = This.Value))
	 		EndIf
			Select crTpmMvItn
	 		***

			If (crTmpGru.TipoEstos < 2) Or (InList(crTmpGru.TipoEstos, 2, 3, 4) And llEstqOk)
				If ThisForm.antqtd#this.Value Or This.Value = 0
					ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
					ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh
				EndIf
				rec=recno('crTpmMvItn')
				ThisForm.totite=fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.Podatamgr)
				go (rec) in crTpmMvItn
			else
				replace crTpmMvItn.qtds with 0 in crTpmMvItn

				ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
				ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh

				This.refresh
				Unlock
				ThisForm.AntQtd = this.Value && Tiago - 30/05/2011 - Incluído essa linha pois não recalculava o valor do item quando não tinha estoque suficiente
				return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If crSigOpCdc.Varcppqs > 0 And This.Value # ThisForm.AntQtd

	If crSigCdOpe.opers = 3 And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 4 
		lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, a.PesoMs, b.Fatdivs, a.Mercs From SigCdPro a, SigCdUni b ] + ;
				   [Where a.CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' and a.Cunis = b.Cunis ] + ;
				   [Order by a.Cpros]

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpPro') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPro)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Go Top In CrTmpPro

		If crSigOpCdd.DmCppqs = 2
			xPeso = Iif(CrTmpPro.Pesoms > 0 And CrTmpPro.FatDivs > 0,(crTpmMvItn.Qtds * (CrTmpPro.Pesoms / CrTmpPro.FatDivs) ), 0 )
		Else
			xPeso = Iif(CrTmpPro.Pesoms > 0 And CrTmpPro.FatDivs > 0,Int(crTpmMvItn.Qtds / (CrTmpPro.Pesoms / CrTmpPro.FatDivs) ), 0 )
		EndIf
	Else
		xPeso = 0
	EndIf
	Replace crTpmMvItn.Pesos With xPeso
EndIf

Go Top in crSigCdPam

If crSigCdOpe.Dopes = crSigCdPam.OpDevols And Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And !IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.cpros ) And This.Value > 0
	If crSigCdOpe.Opers = 1
		ThisForm.LibDevols(TprMvCab.Grupoos, TprMvCab.Contaos, crTpmMvItn.cpros, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	Else
		ThisForm.LibDevols(TprMvCab.Grupods, TprMvCab.Contads, crTpmMvItn.cpros, ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	EndIf
EndIf

If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) 
	If ( This.Value > 1 ) And ( crtmpuni.Desmembs = 'S' ) And ( crSigCdOpe.Desmembs = 1 ) And ;
			( crSigCdOpe.EFators # 1 ) And ( Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ) And ;
			( Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EPesos,1,3))
		ThisForm.Desmembrou = ThisForm.Desmembra( This.Value )
	EndIf
	If Lastkey()=13 And ThisForm.citem<crSigCdOpe.qtdites
		llNovaLinha = ( crSigCdOpe.EFators # 1 ) And ( Not InList(crSigCdOpe.EPesos,1,3) ) And Not InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4)
		llNovaLInha = llNovaLinha And Not ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 1 Or ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 3 And ;
					  ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' Or ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'S' And ;
					  	Seek(crTpmMvItn.CPros, 'csOpeAut','CPros') ) ) Or ;
					  ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos=2 And crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=7 And crTpmMvItn.Units = 0 ) ) )
		llNovaLinha = llNovaLinha And Not ThisForm.GeraMultipla

		If llNovaLinha 
			Select crTpmMvItn
			ThisForm.lNovaLinha = .F.
			If crSigCdOpe.ObsItems = 1
				ThisForm.Foco = 'Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getObs'
				ThisForm.lNovaLinha = .T.
			Else
				ThisForm.Foco = 'Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwgrade.Produto'
				ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
			EndIf
		EndIf 
	EndIf

	* Se Desmebrou a Composição e Alterou a Quantidade Tem Que Remontar Multiplicando a Composição
	If (InList(crSigOpCdc.CarCompos,1,5) And Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And This.Tag <> Str(This.Value, 20, 6))
		Select crTpmMvItn
		_RecNo = Recno([crTpmMvItn])
		_Item2 = crTpmMvItn.cItens
		_QtdsP = crTpmMvItn.Qtds
		
		lcQuery = [Select Mats, Qtds, Pesos From SigPrCpo Where Cpros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' Order By Mats]
		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [crTmpCompo]) < 1)
			=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (crTmpCompo)])
			Return 0
		EndIf

		Select crTmpCompo
		Scan
			Select crTpmMvItn
			Go Top In crTpmMvItn
			Locate For CItem2 = _Item2 And CPros = crTmpCompo.Mats
			If Not Eof([crTpmMvItn])
				Replace Qtds  With crTmpCompo.Qtds  * _QtdsP, ;
						Pesos With crTmpCompo.Pesos * _QtdsP In crTpmMvItn
						
				If crSigOpCdc.CarCompos = 5
					Replace CarCompos With .t. in crTpmMvItn
					thisform.calc_valite()
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndScan
		Select crTpmMvItn
		Go _RecNo
	EndIf
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
Local lcFoco
ThisForm.lAutPreco = .F.
Select crTpmMvItn
If (crSigOpCdd.LibcSens=3) And Lastkey()=9 && Balcão
	Clear Typeahead 
	If Inlist(ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR') And ;
	   (crSigCdOpe.AltDescs = 1 Or Left(crTpmMvItn.Dpros,1) = '.') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
		lnRec = Recno([crTpmMvItn])
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .t.
		Skip
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh 
		Go lnRec
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.ActivePage = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.PageOrder
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getDPros.SetFocus 
	EndIf
Else
	If Not IsEmpty(ThisForm.Foco) And Not ThisForm.Desmembrou
		lcFoco = AllTrim(ThisForm.Foco)
		ThisForm.Foco = ''
		ThisForm.&lcFoco..Refresh
		ThisForm.&lcFoco..SetFocus
	EndIf
EndIf
ENDPROC

* PROCEDURE GotFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE GotFocus
This.Tag = Str(This.Value, 20, 6)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When

PROCEDURE When
Return .F.
Local llRetorno

If Not InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR])
	Return .f.
EndIf

lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
		    [From SigCdUni ] + ;
		   [Where CUnis = '] + crTpmMvItn.CUnis + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By CUnis]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpUni') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpUni)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In CrTmpUni
ThisForm.Podatamgr.Cursorquery('SigCdGpr','CrTmpGgrp','Codigos',CrTmpPro.Mercs)
llAltEtq  = ( CrTmpGgrp.AltEtiqs = 1 )

ThisForm.AntValu = This.Value
llRetorno = ( Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CPros) And ;
		 Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And ;
 		 crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And (InList(crSigCdOpe.Epesos,1,3) or (InList(crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs,3,4) And llAltEtq )) And crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs # 3 And crSigOpCdc.CarItes # 3)
Return llRetorno

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local llNovaLinha, llCProsAut

If Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CPros)
	cpro=crTpmMvItn.cpros 
	lnBr=crTpmMvItn.CodBarras
	lnRg=Recno('crTpmMvItn')
	If crTpmMvItn.EtiEsps And crSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs = 4 And crTpmMvItn.Opers = [S] And This.Value <> 0
		lcSql = [Select Qtds, Pesos, aQtds, aPesos From SigOpEtq Where Cbars = ]+Str(crTpmMvItn.CodBarras)
		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcsql, 'crTmpET') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpET)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Select [] as Agrupar,Sum(Pesos)+This.Value as Pesos From crTpmMvItn where CodBarras = lnBr And ;
			EtiEsps And opers = [S] And Recno() <> lnRg ;
		Into Cursor tcrTpmMvItn Group by 1
		lnSaldo = ( Iif(ThisForm.pcEscolha='INSERIR',CrTmpEt.Pesos,CrTmpEt.aPesos)- tcrTpmMvItn.Pesos )
		If lnSaldo < 0
			MessageBox('Quantidade não Disponivel!!!',0+16,'')
			This.Value = 0
			This.Refresh
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf

	llCProsAut = Seek(crTpmMvItn.Cpros,'csOpeAut','CPros')

	If This.Value # ThisForm.AntValu

		If crSigOpCdc.VarCppqs > 0
			lcQuery = [Select a.Cpros, a.PesoMs, b.FatDivs, a.mercs From SigCdPro a, SigCdUni b ] + ;
					   [Where a.CPros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' and a.Cunis = b.Cunis ] + ;
					   [Order by a.Cpros]

			If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpPro') < 1)
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpPro)')
				Return 0
			EndIf
			Go Top In CrTmpPro
			
			If crSigOpCdd.DmCppqs = 2
				xPeso = Iif(CrTmpPro.Pesoms > 0 And CrTmpPro.FatDivs > 0 ,(crTpmMvItn.Qtds * ( CrTmpPro.Pesoms / CrTmpPro.FatDivs ) ), 0)
			Else
				xPeso = Iif(CrTmpPro.Pesoms > 0 And CrTmpPro.FatDivs > 0 ,(crTpmMvItn.Qtds / ( CrTmpPro.Pesoms / CrTmpPro.FatDivs ) ), 0)
			EndIf
			xDif  = ( xPeso - This.Value )
			xVar  = Iif(xPeso=0,0,abs( xDif / xPeso * 100 ))
			If crSigOpCdc.TpVars = [Q] And xPeso > 0
				If Abs(xDif) > crSigOpCdc.VarCppqs
					lcMsg = 'Quantidade não permitida!!! Excedeu Qtde de Variação'
					If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.MsgVars)
						lcMsg = Alltrim(crSigOpCdd.MsgVars)
					EndIf
					MessageBox(lcMsg + ' '+Alltrim(Str(xPeso,12,3)),0+48,'Atenção')
					If crSigOpCdd.BlqVars <> 2
						If crSigCdOpe.opers = 3 And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 4 
							This.Value = xPeso
						EndIf
						Return .f.
					EndIf
				EndIf
			Else
				If xVar > crSigOpCdc.VarCppqs And xPeso > 0
					lcMsg = 'Quantidade não permitida!!! Excedeu % de Variação'
					If Not Empty(crSigOpCdd.MsgVars)
						lcMsg = Alltrim(crSigOpCdd.MsgVars)
					EndIf
					MessageBox(lcMsg + ' '+Alltrim(Str(xPeso,12,3)),0+48,'Atenção')
					If crSigOpCdd.BlqVars <> 2
						If crSigCdOpe.opers = 3 And crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs = 4 
							This.Value = xPeso
						EndIf
						Return .f.
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf

		If crSigCdOpe.PesoVts = 1 And IsEmpty( crTpmMvItn.Utilizas ) And Not llCProsAut
			Replace Units with 0 in crTpmMvItn
		EndIf
		If ThisForm.AntValu # This.Value
			ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh
		EndIf
		rec=recno('crTpmMvItn')
		ThisForm.totite=fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.Podatamgr)
		go (rec) in crTpmMvItn
	EndIf
	
	lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
			    [From SigCdUni ] + ;
			   [Where CUnis = '] + crTpmMvItn.CUnis + [' ] + ;
			   [Order By CUnis]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpUni') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpUni)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In CrTmpUni

	If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) 
		If ( This.Value > 0 ) And ( CrTmpUni.Desmembs = 'S' ) And ( crSigCdOpe.Desmembs = 1 ) And ;
				( crSigCdOpe.EFators # 1 ) And ( Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) )
			ThisForm.Desmembrou = ThisForm.Desmembra( crTpmMvItn.Qtds )
		EndIf
		If Lastkey()=13 And ThisForm.citem<crSigCdOpe.qtdites
			llNovaLinha = ( crSigCdOpe.EFators # 1 ) And ( Not ( (crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 1 And crTpmMvItn.utilizas <> 51) Or ;
						  ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 3 And ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' Or ;
						  ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'S' And llCProsAut ) ) ) Or ;
						  ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos=2 And crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=7 And crTpmMvItn.Units = 0 ) ) )

			llNovaLinha = llNovaLinha And Not ThisForm.GeraMultipla

			If llNovaLinha
				ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
				ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.refresh
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.cntProdLeilao.FwGrade.VALOR.Text1
* Classe: textbox (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 87

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
Return .F.
If Not InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR])
	Return .f.
EndIf

ThisForm.OldPreco = Iif(crTpmMvItn.UnitOrigs=0,This.Value,crTpmMvItn.UnitOrigs)
llOk = ( InList( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And ;
		Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.CPros) And ;
		( crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 ) And ;
		( crTpmMvItn.SubnObrigs # 3 ) And ; 
		( crTpmMvItn.Utilizas # 51 ) And ;
        ( ThisForm.lAutPreco Or crSigCdOpe.Eprecos = 1  Or ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 3 And ;
        ( crTpmMvItn.Opers = 'E' Or Seek( crTpmMvItn.Cpros, 'csOpeAut', 'CPros' ) ) ) Or ;
        ( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos=2 And crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=7 And crTpmMvItn.Units = 0 ) ) )

If NOt llOk
	ThisForm.lAutPreco = .f.
EndIf
Return llOk

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local lnCasas, Rec

lnCasas = crSigCdOpe.Casas

ThisForm.Foco = ''
This.Value = Round( This.Value, lnCasas )

If This.Value < 0 And crSigCdOpe.ValItNegs # 1
	MessageBox('Preço Inválido',0+48,'')
	This.Value = ThisForm.OldPreco
	Return 0	
EndIf
 
If ThisForm.lAutPreco And (crSigOpCdc.InibMVends = 7) && Vendedores de Leilão
	lnMin = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getPVIdeals.Value

	lcQuery = [Select b.PctDctLeis ] + ;
				[From SigCdPro a, SigCdGrp b ] + ;
			   [Where a.Cpros = '] + crTpmMvItn.CPros + [' And ] + ;
			   		 [a.Cgrus = b.Cgrus ] + ;
			   [Order By b.PctDctLeis]

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalBusca') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalBusca)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In LocalBusca
	If Not Eof([LocalBusca]) And (LocalBusca.PctDctLeis > 0)
		lnMin = lnMin - ((lnMin * LocalBusca.PctDctLeis) / 100)
	EndIf

	If (This.Value < lnMin)
		Do Form SigOpLim With 0, 0, 0, [X], ThisForm, ThisForm.poDataMgr, .f., .f., .f., .f., .f. To chkLim
		
		If Type('ChkLim') = 'L' And not chklim
			MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
			This.Value = ThisForm.OldPreco
			Return 0	
		Else
			Replace crTpmMvItn.UsuLibs WITH Left(ChkLim,10) in crTpmMvItn
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	IF ThisForm.lAutPreco AND NOT ThisForm.Chklimite(ThisForm.OldPreco,This.Value,0,0,.t.)
		Select crTpmMvItn
		This.Value = ThisForm.OldPreco
		Return 0
	EndIf
EndIf
Select crTpmMvItn

If ( This.Value # ThisForm.OldPreco ) And ( ThisForm.lAutPreco Or ;
		( Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Utilizas) And ( crTpmMvItn.Utilizas < 10 ) ) Or ;
		( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos = 2 And crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7 And crTpmMvItn.Utilizas < 10 ))
	Select crTpmMvItn
	Replace crTpmMvItn.Utilizas With crTpmMvItn.Utilizas + 10
EndIf

This.Refresh
ThisForm.lAutPreco = .F.

ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh

Rec = RecNo('crTpmMvItn')
ThisForm.TotIte = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.Podatamgr)
Go (Rec) in crTpmMvItn

lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
		    [From SigCdUni ] + ;
		   [Where CUnis = '] + crTpmMvItn.CUnis + [' ] + ;
		   [Order By CUnis]

If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'CrTmpUni') < 1)
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpUni)')
	Return 0
EndIf
Go Top In CrTmpUni

If ThisForm.pcEscolha $ 'INSERIR/ALTERAR' And crTpmMvItn.Qtds > 1 And ;
		CrTmpuni.desmembs = 'S' And crSigCdOpe.Desmembs = 1 
		ThisForm.Desmembrou = ThisForm.Desmembra( crTpmMvItn.Qtds )
EndIf

If LastKey()=13 And (ThisForm.cItem < crSigCdOpe.QtdItes)
	If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		If CrSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 9 && Parametro de valor minimo de produto (Cadastro de Movimentações) Bruno
			If this.Value < crTpmMvItn.univals 
				pVenda = Alltrim(Str(crTpmMvItn.univals,10,4))
				MessageBox([O valor mínimo para esse produto é ]+pVenda,0+64,thisform.Caption)
				this.Value = pVenda
				Return .f. 
			EndIf 	
		EndIf 
	
		ThisForm.lNovaLinha = .F.
		If crSigCdOpe.ObsItems = 1
			ThisForm.Foco = 'Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getObs'
			ThisForm.lNovaLinha = .T.
		Else
			ThisForm.Foco = 'Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Produto'
			If Not ThisForm.GeraMultipla
				ThisForm.mInsereLinha()
			EndIf
		EndIf
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh
	EndIf
EndIf 
  
If CrSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 9 && Parametro de valor minimo de produto (Cadastro de Movimentações) Bruno
	If this.Value < crTpmMvItn.univals 
		pVenda = Alltrim(Str(crTpmMvItn.univals,10,4))
		MessageBox([O valor mínimo para esse produto é ]+pVenda,0+64,thisform.Caption)
		this.Value = pVenda
		Return .f. 
	EndIf 	
EndIf 
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
Local lcFoco

ThisForm.lAutPreco = .F.
Select crTpmMvItn
If (crSigOpCdd.LibcSens=3) And Lastkey()=9 && Balcão
	Clear Typeahead 
	If Inlist(ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR') And ;
	   (crSigCdOpe.AltDescs = 1 Or Left(crTpmMvItn.Dpros,1) = '.') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
		lnRec = Recno([crTpmMvItn])
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .t.
		Skip
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh 
		Go lnRec
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.ActivePage = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.PageOrder
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.pgfPagina.pgProds.getDPros.SetFocus 
	EndIf
Else
	If Not IsEmpty(ThisForm.Foco)
		lcFoco = AllTrim(ThisForm.Foco)
		ThisForm.Foco = ''
		ThisForm.&lcFoco..Refresh
		ThisForm.&lcFoco..SetFocus
	EndIf
EndIf


ENDPROC

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
If Empty(this.Value)
	Return .f.
EndIf

If Type('this.Value') <> Type('This.Tag') Or This.Tag <> This.Value
	_CarItem   = crSigOpCdc.CarItes

	loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext', ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdConn, 'SigCdCor', ;
						   'crListaRemota', 'Cods', Padr(this.Value,4), 'Seleção', .T.)
	If Not loLista.plAchouRegistro
		loLista.mAddColuna('Cods', '', 'Código',.t.,'Cods')
		loLista.mAddColuna('Descs', '', 'Descrição',.t.,'Descs')
		loLista.Show()

		If LastKey() == 27
			this.Value = Iif( CrSigOpCdc.AltEtiqs = 1, this.Tag, '' )
			lcDescs = ''
		Else
			this.Value = CrListaRemota.Cods
			lcDescs = CrListaRemota.Descs
		EndIf
	Else
		lcDescs = CrListaRemota.Descs
	EndIf

	*** Mena  - 3/10/2011 - copiado da tela de itens
	*** Tiago - 06/06/2011 - Restrição de Movimentação - Checa se a Movimentação tem alguma cor restringida - Carat
	lcQuery = [Select Cgrus, Opers, Mercs, Contas, CodCors, ContaOrig From SigCdRpo Where Dopps = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalRopt1') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalRopt1)')
		Return 0
	EndIf

	SELECT LocalRopt1
	If Reccount('LocalRopt1') > 0
		SELECT Cgrus, Mercs, CodCors FROM LocalRopt1 Where Contas = ' ' And ContaOrig = ' ' INTO CURSOR Selecao
		Select Selecao
		If Reccount('Selecao') > 0
			Go top
			Locate For CodCors = crTpmMvItn.CodCors
			If Eof()
				=MessageBox('Produto Bloqueado para esta Movimentação!!!', 16, 'Restrição')
				Return 0
			EndIf
		Else
			SELECT Cgrus, Mercs, CodCors FROM LocalRopt1 Where Contas = TprMvCab.ContaDs INTO CURSOR Selecao2
			Select Selecao2
			If Reccount('Selecao2') > 0
				Go top
				Locate For CodCors = crTpmMvItn.CodCors
				If Not Eof()
					=MessageBox('Produto Bloqueado para Conta ' + ThisForm.CfgTitDestino + ' desta Movimentação!!!', 16, 'Restrição')
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			*-- Rafael - 27/02/2018 - Validação da conta de Origem
			SELECT Cgrus, Mercs, CodCors FROM LocalRopt1 Where ContaOrig = TprMvCab.ContaOs INTO CURSOR Selecao3
			Select Selecao3
			If Reccount('Selecao3') > 0
				Go top
				Locate For CodCors = crTpmMvItn.CodCors
				If Not Eof()
					=MessageBox('Produto Bloqueado para Conta ' + ThisForm.CfgTitOrigem + ' desta Movimentação!!!', 16, 'Restrição')
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		lcQuery = [Select distinct dopps From SigCdRpo Where Exclus = 1 And (Cgrus = ']+CrTmpGru.Cgrus+[' Or ]+;
				  [Mercs = ']+CrTmpGru.Mercs+[' Or CodCors = '] + crTpmMvItn.CodCors + [')]
		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'LocalRopt2') < 1)
			=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (LocalRopt2)')
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Select LocalRopt2
		If Reccount('LocalRopt2') > 0
			=MessageBox('Produto Bloqueado para esta Movimentação!!!', 16, 'Restrição de Exclusivo')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	ENDIF
	***

	Select crTpmMvIts
	Set Order to
	Set Order to CItens
	Seek crTpmMvItn.CItens
	If !Eof()
		Delete
	EndIf

 
	Insert Into crTpmMvIts ( CItens, CPros, Emps, Dopes, Numes, qtds, QtdEmbs, Pesos, CodCors, CodTams, CodEmbs ) ;
		Values ( crTpmMvItn.CItens, crTpmMvItn.CPros, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, 1, 1, ;
				 0 , this.Value, crTpmMvItn.CodTams, '' ) 

	replace qtds with 0 in crTpmMvItn

	*** Tiago - 30/05/2011 - Busca quantidade possui no estoque	
	If InList(_CarItem,1,3)
		lcCor = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Cor.Text1.Value
		lcTam = ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Tam.Text1.Value
		
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigMvEst Where EmpGruEsts = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+TprMvCab.GrupoOs+TprMvCab.contaOs+[' ]+;
				[And cpros=']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[' And sQtds > 0 ] + Iif(!Empty(lcCor),[ And CodCors = ']+lcCor+['],[]) + ;
				Iif(!Empty(lcTam),[ And CodTams = ']+lcTam+['],[])
		ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'csTprMvCab')

		Select CsTprMvCab
		Sum sQtds,sPesos to _Qtde, _speso

		Replace crTpmMvItn.Qtds  With Iif(crSigOpCdd.UnicRefs=3,crTpmMvItn.Qtds + _Qtde,_Qtde),;
				crTpmMvItn.Pesos With _sPeso in crTpmMvItn
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Qtd.Text1.Refresh
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.PeSO.Text1.Refresh
	EndIf
	***
*!*		ThisForm.Total_Item()
	ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.cntProdLeilao.fwGrade.Refresh()

	Rec = RecNo('crTpmMvItn')
	ThisForm.TotIte = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.Podatamgr)
	Go (Rec) in crTpmMvItn
Endif


ENDPROC

================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.cntObs.cntObservacao.getCodObs
* Classe: fwget (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 101
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE GotFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE GotFocus
This.Tag = Str(This.Value, 10)
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Private pIni, pFim

loCnx = ThisForm.poDataMgr

If Not Empty(This.Value) And Not (This.Tag = Str(This.Value, 10))
	loCnx.CursorQuery('SigCdOpe', 'LocalOpe', 'Dopes', TprMvCab.Dopes, 'ObsPads, ObsInis, ObsFins')
	pIni = Iif(Not Eof('LocalOpe') And Not Empty(LocalOpe.ObsInis), LocalOpe.ObsInis, 000)
	pFim = Iif(Not Eof('LocalOpe') And Not Empty(LocalOpe.ObsFins), LocalOpe.ObsFins, 999)
	
	If not Empty(crSigMvNfi.Cfis) and (crSigOpCdd.ChkCFOP <> 2)
		lcQuery = [Select ObsInis, ObsFins from SigCdOop where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[' and Cfops = ']+crSigMvNfi.Cfis+['] 
		loCnx.SQLExecute(lcQuery,[crTmpCfoOp])
		If not Eof([crTmpCfoOp])
			pIni = Iif( not Empty(crTmpCfoOp.ObsInis), crTmpCfoOp.ObsInis, pIni )
			pFim = Iif( not Empty(crTmpCfoOp.ObsFins), crTmpCfoOp.ObsFins, pFim )
		Endif
	Endif	

	lcQuery = [Select Codigos, Descrs ] + ;
			    [From SigCdObs ] + ;
			   [Where Codigos BetWeen ?pIni And ?pFim]

	If (loCnx.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crLocalObs') < 1)
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crLocalObs)')
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Select crLocalObs
	Index On Codigos Tag Codigos
	Index On Descrs Tag Descrs

	Set Near On
	If Not Seek(This.Value, 'crLocalObs', 'Codigos')
		m.loBrowse = CreateObject('fwbuscasel', 'crLocalObs', 'Codigos', This.Value, 'Observações')
		m.loBrowse.AddColuna('Codigos', '999', 'Cód.', .t., 'Codigos')
		m.loBrowse.AddColuna('Descrs', '', 'Descrição', .t., 'Descrs')
		m.loBrowse.Show
	Endif
	Set Near Off

	If (Lastkey()=27)
		Return 0
	EndIf

	This.Value = crLocalObs.Codigos
	
	loCnx.Cursorquery('SigCdObs','crObs','Codigos',This.Value)
		
	Select crObs
	ObsPadrao = Alltrim(crObs.Observas)

	ThisForm.MontaObs(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
ThisForm.Antvalu = This.Value
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
ENDPROC

If Not Empty(This.Value)
	loLista = CreateObject('fwBuscaExt', ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdConn, 'SigCdEvt', ;
						   'CrListaRemota', 'Cods', This.Value, 'Seleção', .t.)

		loLista.mAddColuna('Cods',  '', 'Código')

		loLista.Show()
	EndIf
	
	This.Value = CrListaRemota.Cods
	This.parent.parent.Column2.Text1.Value = CrListaRemota.Descs
	Use In CrListaRemota
Else
	This.Value = ''
	This.parent.parent.Column2.Text1.Value = ''
EndIf
This.Refresh
This.parent.parent.Column2.Text1.Refresh

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
If IsEmpty( This.Value ) And LastKey() = 13
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	Do Case
		Case (InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDObrigs,1,3)) And IsEmpty(TprMvCab.TabDs)
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGOrigs
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Grupo.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixCOrigs
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGDests
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Grupo.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixCDests
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.SetFocus
			
		Case ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.Visible
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.SetFocus
			
	EndCase
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local nDope, Nume, CodConf, _Posicao, NOpCr, lcNotas, lcProcura, lnCfgOpCrs, lnBxVlOpCrs, lnCfgChkCt
Local _ValDev, _ValNDev, lcFpagOpCrs, lnCotOpe, lnCotPar, lcCMoeOpCrs, llNovaLinha, lnRecNo
Local lcOutros, llRecalcula, llRetorno, lcMsg, lcCaption, _pData

If IsEmpty(This.Value) And IsEmpty(This.peantvalue)
	Return
EndIf

lcUltGrv = TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6) + '-Get_Devol'
_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

llRecalcula = .F.
llNovaLinha = .F.
llRetorno   = .T.
Select TprMvCab
Go Top
_Posicao = TprMvCab.emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + str( TprMvCab.numes, 6 )
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
NOpCr       = crSigCdOpe.NOpCrs
lnCfgOpCrs  = crSigCdOpe.OpCrs
lnBxVlOpCrs = crSigCdOpe.BxVlOpCrs
lcFPagOpCrs = crSigCdOpe.FPagOpCrs
lnCfgChkCt  = crSigCdOpe.Consgs
lcCMoeOpCrs = .F.
_ValDev     = 0
_ValNDev    = 0

If This.peantvalue # 0 And This.Value # This.peantvalue 
	Set Decimals to 0
	nDope = Val( Left( Str( This.peantvalue, 10), 4 ) )
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','ndopes',nDope)
	
	Select crSigCdOpe
	If RECCOUNT() > 0
		Dope = crSigCdOpe.Dopes
		Nume = Val( Right( Str( This.peantvalue, 10 ), 6 ) )
		set decimals to 2
		lcOutros = ''
		lcNota = Transform(Nume,"@L 999999")

		If lnCfgOpCrs = 1
			Declare LaCampo(1,2)
			LaCampo(1,1)='EmpDopNums'
			LaCampo(1,2)=TprMvCab.Emps + Dope + Str(Nume,6)
		Else
			If lnCfgOpCrs = 3
				Declare LaCampo(2,2)
				LaCampo(1,1)='Dopes'
				LaCampo(2,1)='Notas'
				LaCampo(1,2)=Dope
				laCampo(2,2)=lcNota
			Else
				Loop
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrTprMvCab',@LaCampo)
			lcSubn = .f.
			ldDtAlt= _pData
			llDtBx = Null
			lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?lcSubn, DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, DataTrans = Null, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where CidChaves = ']+CrTprMvCab.CidChaves+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
			If LnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 3)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			lcOutros = CrTprMvCab.Emps + ' : ' + Iif(lnCfgOpCrs = 1, Transf(CrTprMvCab.Numes,'@L 999999'), crTprMvCab.Notas )
			_ValDev  = _ValDev - Iif( lnBxVlOpCrs = 2, 0, CrTprMvCab.Valos - CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs )
			_ValNDev = _ValNDev - CrTprMvCab.Valos - CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs
			llRecalcula = .T.
			llNovaLinha = .T.
		Else
			MessageBox('Dados Inconsistentes ... ', 48, 'Movimentação Não Encontrada')
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
			This.Value = 0
			Return 0
		EndIf
			
		If Not IsEmpty(lcFPagOpCrs) And Not IsEmpty(lcOutros) And ;
				Seek( lcFPagOpCrs + lcOutros, 'xPar', 'FPagOpCrs' )
			Select xPar
			Delete
		EndIf

		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	Else
		MessageBox('Dados Inconsistentes ... ' + Chr(13) + 'Contate o Suporte Técnico.',48,;
				   'Movimentação Não Cadastrada')
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
		This.Value = 0
		Return 0
	EndIf
EndIf

If Not IsEmpty(This.Value) And This.Value # This.peantvalue 
	Select Count(1) As nTotal From TmpDevol Where Codigos = This.Value Into Cursor csVerDevol
	
	If csVerDevol.nTotal > 1
		MessageBox('Essa Movimentação Já Foi Digitada !!!',0+48,'Crédito Já Digitado')
		This.Value = 0
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Use In csVerDevol
	Set Decimals to 0
	NDope = Val( Left( Str( This.Value, 10 ), 4 ) )		&& Número da Movimentação
	If Not IsEmpty(NDope) And This.Value # This.peantvalue 
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','ndopes',nDope)
		Select crSigCdOpe
		If RECCOUNT() > 0
			lcSql = [Select Dopes, nddVals From SigOpCdc Where Dopes = ']+crSigCdOpe.Dopes+[']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'LocalDcOpe')

			Dope    = crSigCdOpe.Dopes
			Nume    = Val( Right( Str( This.Value, 10 ), 6 ) )
			lcNotas = Transf(Nume, '@L 999999') 
			lcCMoeOpCrs = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
			_nDdVal = LocalDcOpe.nDDvals

			Set Decimals to 2
			If Nume # 0
				Declare LaCampo(2,2)
				LaCampo(1,1)='Dopes'
				LaCampo(2,1)='Notas'
				LaCampo(1,2)=Dope
				laCampo(2,2)=lcNotas

				lcBusca     = TprMvCab.Emps + Dope + Str(Nume,6)

				Do Case
					Case NOpCr # Dope
						MessageBox('Movimentação de Crédito Inválida!!',0+48,'')
						This.Value = 0
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
						llRetorno = .F.
						
					Case lnCfgOpCrs = 1 AND NOT ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',lcbusca)
							MessageBox('Movimentação Inválida !!!',0+48,'')
							This.Value = 0
							=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
							llRetorno = .F.

					CASE lnCfgOpCrs = 1 And lnCfgChkCt # 2 AND ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigMvCab','CrEest','EmpDopNums',lcbusca);
							 AND Iif(lnCfgChkCt=3,(TprMvCab.ContaDs # CrEest.ContaOs),(TprMvCab.GrupoDs+TprMvCab.Contads) # (crEest.Grupoos+crEest.Contaos))
							MessageBox('Conta Inválida!!',0+48,'')
							This.Value = 0
							=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
							llRetorno = .F.
						
					Case lnCfgOpCrs = 3 AND NOT ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigMvCab','CrEest',@LaCampo)
							MessageBox('Movimentação: ' + AllTrim(Dope) + ' ' + lcNotas + ;
									   ' Não Encontrada.', 48, 'Movimentação de Crédito Não Encontrada')
							This.Value = 0
							=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
							llRetorno = .F.
						
					Case CrEest.ChkSubN
						lcMsg = Iif(lnCfgOpCrs = 3,'Crédito: ' + AllTrim(crEest.Dopes) + ' ' + crEest.Notas, ;
								'Movimentação: ' + AllTrim(crEest.Emps) + ' ' + AllTrim(crEest.Dopes) + ' ' + AllTrim(Str(crEest.Numes,6)))
						lcMsg = lcMsg + ' Já Utilizado.'
						lcCaption = Iif(lnCfgOpCrs = 3,'Crédito já utilizado','Movimentação já utilizada')
						MessageBox(lcMsg, 48, lcCaption)
						This.Value = 0
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
						Return 0

					Other

						If _nDdval > 0 And Ttod(CrEest.Datas) + _nDdVal < Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas)
							Do Form SigOpSen With 'DTVALIDA', Proper( CrEest.Dopes ) To _Retorno
							_Retorna = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
							If Not _Retorna
								Select TmpDevol
								This.Value = 0
								Return 0
							EndIf
						EndIf

						llNovaLinha = .T.
						llRecalcula = .T.
						lcSubn = .t.
						ldDtAlt= _pData
						llDtBx = TprMvCab.Datas
						lcUpDate = [UpDate SigMvCab Set ChkSubn = ?lcSubn, DtAlts = ?ldDtAlt, DtBaixas = ?llDtBx, UltGrvs = ?lcUltGrv Where CidChaves = ']+CrEest.CidChaves+[']
						lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcUpDate,'')
						If LnErro < 0
							MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (Update SigMvCab 4)')
							Return .f.
						EndIf
						Replace TmpOperacao.ChkSubn With .t. In TmpOperacao
						_ValDev  = _ValDev + Iif( lnBxVlOpCrs = 2, 0, creest.Valos - CrEest.ValoBxs)
						_ValNDev = _ValNDev + ( CrEest.Valos - CrEest.ValoBxs )
						If Not IsEmpty(lcFPagOpCrs) And lnBxVlOpCrs = 2 And Type('lcCMoeOpCrs') = 'C'
							lcOutros = crEest.Emps + ' : ' + Iif(lnCfgOpCrs = 1, Transf(crEest.Numes,'@L 999999'), crEest.Notas )
							=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',lcFpagOpCrs)
							If Not Seek( lcFPagOpCrs + lcOutros, 'xPar', 'FPagOpCrs' )
								Insert Into xPar ( FPags, Emps, Dopes, Numes, Datas, Parcs, Vencs, ;
										InsChs, Empos, Outros ) ;
									Values ( lcFPagOpCrs, TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, ;
											 TprMvCab.Datas, 1, TprMvCab.Datas, .T., TprMvCab.Emps, ;
											 lcOutros )
							Else
								Select xPar
								Replace xPar.Outros With lcOutros
							EndIf
							
							lnCotOpe = ThisForm.Cotacao( lcCMoeOpCrs, TprMvCab.Datas )
							lnCotPar = ThisForm.Cotacao( crSigOpFp.MoeFPgs, TprMvCab.Datas )
							Select xPar
							Replace xPar.Valos With Round( _ValNDev * lnCotOpe / lnCotPar, 2), ;
									xPar.VPags With Iif(crSigOpFp.ValPends = 2, ;
												    Round( _ValNDev * lnCotOpe / lnCotPar, 2), 0 ), ;
									xPar.MoeFPgs With crSigOpFp.MoeFPgs, ;
									xPar.CotFPgs With lnCotPar											    
						EndIf
				Endcase
			Else
				This.Value = 0
			EndIf
		Else
			If Not IsEmpty(nDope)
				MessageBox('Número De Movimentação: ' + Transf(nDope,'99') + ;
						   ' não está Cadastrado no Sistema.' + Chr(13) + ;
						   'Contate o Suporte Técnico para corrigir a configuração.', 48, ;
						   'Erro de Configuração do Sistema')
			EndIf
			This.Value = 0
		EndIf
	Else
		If Not IsEmpty(This.Value) And This.Value # This.peantvalue 
			MessageBox('Código de Movimentação de Crédito ' + Transf(This.Value,'@L 99999999') + ;
					   ' é Inválido ... ',48, 'Erro')
			This.Value = 0					   
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If llRecalcula
	ThisForm.TotIte = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)
	lnIpi = 0
	Select crSigMvNfi
	Locate For EmpDopNums = TprMvCab.Emps + TprMvCab.Dopes + Str( TprMvCab.Numes, 6 )
	If !Eof()
		If !crSigMvNfi.Cancelas
			lnIpi = crSigMvNfi.ValIpis
		EndIf
	EndIf

	ThisForm.nValDevols = ThisForm.nValDevols + _ValDev
	Select TprMvCab
	Replace ValDevs  With ValDevs + _ValDev,;
			ValNDevs With ValNDevs + _ValNDev

	lnTran = Iif(crSigOpCdc.nChkVsts = 1, TprMvCab.ValTrans, 0)

	Replace ValInis  With ThisForm.TotIte - TprMvCab.ValDevs, ;
			Valos    With Round( ThisForm.totite - TprMvCab.ValDevs + ;
						         TprMvCab.ValVars + TprMvCab.ValServs + lnIPI + lnTran, 2 )

	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos
		.Value = round( ThisForm.totite - TprMvCab.ValDevs + TprMvCab.valvars + TprMvCab.ValServs + lnTran,2)
		.Refresh
	EndWith
	
	ThisForm.Totpar

EndIf

ThisForm.RefreshCntResumo()

If Not llRetorno
	Return 0
EndIf

If llNovaLinha
	Select TmpDevol
	Skip
	If Eof()
		Insert Into TmpDevol (Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos, TpCodigos) ;
				Values (TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, 0, lnCfgOpCrs)
		KeyBoard "{DNARROW}"
	EndIf
EndIf
Select TmpDevol
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Refresh
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
This.peantvalue = This.Value
Return( InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR','ALTERAR' ) And ;
		crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And InList(crSigCdOpe.OpCrs, 1, 3) )
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus

PROCEDURE LostFocus
Set Confirm Off

If (_NumeroAnt Or _DigDocu Or IsEmpty( This.Value ) ) And LastKey() = 13 && _Conserto Or 
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.SetFocus
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	Do Case
		Case (InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDObrigs,1,3)) And Empty(TprMvCab.TabDs)
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGOrigs
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Grupo.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixCOrigs
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGDests
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Grupo.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixCDests
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.SetFocus
	EndCase
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
*********************************************************************
*** Grade de Tratamento de Sub-Níveis Múltiplos - Tabela SigOpCsn ***
*** determina os Sub-Níveis Permitidos para a Movimentação        ***
*********************************************************************
Local NDope, Nume, OpeAtu, lnRecOld, _PuxaOrigem, _PuxaDestino, lcItOrdem, _CfoAtual, _DestacaIPI
Local lnCOpers, lnCaixas, lnCheqs, lnParcs, lnParContas, lcCheque, lcMoeSubNs, lnCasas, QtdSub, UnitSub 
Local _MoePadrao, _PrecoPs, lcMsg, lnCodigos, _nCarItem, _ChkEmpDestino, lcMoePend, lnValLbOpe, _SemItens

lcUltGrv = TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+'-GrdMultSubn'

Goto Top In csSigOpCsn
lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigCdOpe') < 1
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdOpe 1)')
	Return .F.
EndIf

lcSql = [Select * From SigOpCdd Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
If ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'crSigOpCdd') < 1
	=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigOpCdd 1)')
	Return .F.
EndIf

lcMoeSubNs = ''

If ThisForm.MGOpe And Type('ThisForm.NivelMGOpe') = 'N' And ThisForm.NivelMGOpe = 0
	Set Decimals to 0
	lcSubNivel = csSigOpCsn.cNivels

	lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+lcSubNivel+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigCdOpe') < 1
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdOpe 2)')
		Return .F.
	EndIf
	
	lnNumNivel = Val( Str( crSigCdOpe.NDopes, 4 ) + Transf( ThisForm.pNumes, '@L 999999' ) )
	This.Value = lnNumNivel
	ThisForm.NivelMGOpe = This.Value
	Set Decimals to 2

	lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
	If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigCdOpe') < 1
		=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (SigCdOpe 3)')
		Return .F.
	EndIf
EndIf
lnCOpers      = crSigCdOpe.COpers
lnCaixas      = crSigCdOpe.Caixas
lnCheqs       = crSigCdOpe.Cheqs
lnParcs       = crSigCdOpe.Parcs
lnParContas   = crSigCdOpe.ParContas
OpeAtu        = crSigCdOpe.Opers
_Conserto     = crSigCdOpe.Consers = 1 
_NumeroAnt    = ( crSigCdOpe.Numeras = 2 )
_DigDocu      = ( crSigCdOpe.DigDoc = 4 )
_PedClis	  = ( crSigCdOpe.PedClis = 5)
_BaixaSubN    = ( crSigCdOpe.BaixaSns = 1 )
_CarregaItens = InList( crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,1,3,4,5,8,9,10,11)

				Else
					If crSigCdOpe.NDebitos # 1
						If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 )
							m.Qtds  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,m.Qtds,m.Qtds - ( m.Qtds * crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ))
							m.Units = ( m.Units - ( m.Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) )
							Qtdsub  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,Qtdsub,Qtdsub - ( Qtdsub * crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ))
							Unitsub = ( Unitsub - ( Unitsub * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) )
						Else
							m.Qtds  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,m.Qtds,m.Qtds - ( m.Qtds * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ) ) ))
							Qtdsub  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,Qtdsub,Qtdsub - ( Qtdsub * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ) ) ))
						EndIf
					Else
						If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 )
							m.Units = m.Units - ( m.Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 )
							Unitsub = Unitsub - ( Unitsub * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 )
						Else
							If crSigCdTif.PValors <> 0
								m.Units = m.Units - ( ( m.Units / crSigCdTif.PValors * 100 ) * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) ) )
								Unitsub = Unitsub - ( ( Unitsub / crSigCdTif.PValors * 100 ) * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) ) )
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
				m.ItemOk = Round( UnitSub * QtdSub, 2 )
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.Porcs # 0
				m.Qtds  = Round( m.Qtds * crSigCdOpe.Porcs / 100, 2 )
				lnQtds = Int( m.Qtds )
				Do Case
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 1 And lnQtds # m.Qtds && Acima
						m.Qtds = lnQtds + 1
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 2 And _Qtds # m.Qtds && Abaixo
						m.Qtds = lnQtds
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 3 && Sem Arredondamento
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 4 && Natural
						m.Qtds = Round( m.Qtds, 0 )
				Endcase
			EndIf
			If !IsEmpty( _MoePadrao ) And _MoePadrao # m.Moedas
				CotaP = ThisForm.Cotacao(_MoePadrao,TprMvCab.Datas)
				CotaI = ThisForm.Cotacao(m.Moedas,TprMvCab.Datas)
				m.Moedas = _MoePadrao
				m.Units  = Round( m.Units * CotaI / CotaP,lnCasas )
			EndIf

				m.Units = 0
			EndIf
			If _PrecoPs = 7
				m.Moedas  = CrTmpPro.mUltComps
				m.Units   = CrTmpPro.vUltComps
				m.UniVals = m.Units
				m.Moevs   = m.Moedas
			EndIf

				m.Units   = TmpCusMed.Valors
				m.Moevs   = m.Moedas
				m.Univals = m.Units
			EndIf

					CotaI  = ThisForm.Cotacao(m.Moedas,TprMvCab.Datas)
					lnUnit = Round(CrTmpPro.vUltComps * CotaP / CotaI,lnCasas)
				Else
					lnUnit = CrTmpPro.vUltComps
				EndIf
				*!* mena 28/10/2014 subst pela linha abaixo vItem   = lnUnit + ((m.Units - lnUnit)/2)
				vItem   = IIF(lnUnit = 0, m.Units, lnUnit + ((m.Units - lnUnit)/2)) && mena 28/10/2014 - testa se valor da compra = 0 para não dividir o preço por dois.
				m.Units = Iif(vItem > lnUnit,vItem,lnUnit)
				m.UniVals = m.Units
			EndIf
			If _PrecoPs = 11
				m.Units = CrTmpPro.custofs
				m.UniVals = m.Units			
			EndIf
			If _PrecoPs = 15	
				m.Units = CrTmpPro.custofs
				m.UniVals = m.Units
				lcQuery = [select customedioreais as csmedio, (select moedaps from sigcdpam) as csmoedas ] + ;
						[from customedio3 where cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' ]

					Return 0
				EndIf
				If Reccount('CrTmpProMd')>0
					m.Units = CrTmpProMd.custofs
					m.UniVals = m.Units
				EndIf 	
			EndIf 
			
			If crSigOpCdd.CarVlLiqs = 1
				m.Units = Round(Iif(m.Unit2s>0,m.Unit2s,m.Units),lnCasas)
				m.ValRats = 0
				m.Unit2s  = 0
			EndIf
			m.Totas = m.Qtds * m.Units

			m.AQtds = 0
			m.QtBaixas = crEesti.Qtds - m.QtBaixas
			lnOldItem = 0
			
			lcQuery = [Select TipoEstos, Mercs, cores, tams, embs, Cgrus, Dgrus, Pesos, Entregas From SigCdGrp ]+;
					  [Where Cgrus = ']+CrTmpPro.Cgrus+[']
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpGru')

			lcQuery = [Select Ifors From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[']
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
			Select CrTmpFPro
			Index on Ifors Tag Ifors

			If _AltDescricao
				m.dPros = CrTmpPro.dPros
			EndIf
			llNaoSegue = ( ( InList(crSigCdOpe.ItSituas,1,4) And CrTmpPro.Situas = 2 ) Or ;
					       ( crSigCdOpe.ItSituas = 2 And CrTmpPro.Situas # 2 ) Or ;
					       ( ThisForm.CItem >= crSigCdOpe.qtdites ) Or ;
					       ( crSigOpCdd.ItClfs = 2 And Len(Alltrim(Strtran(crTmpPro.ClFiscals,[.],[]))) <> 8) Or ;
    				       ( crSigOpCdd.ItClfs = 2 And IsEmpty( CrTmpPro.OrigMercs )) Or ;
   					       ( crSigOpCdd.ItClfs = 2 And IsEmpty( CrTmpPro.SitTrIcms )) Or ;
					       ( crSigOpCdd.ChkIfors = 1 And CrTmpPro.Ifors <> TprMvCab.ContaOs And Not Seek(TprMvCab.ContaOs,'CrTmpFPro','Ifors') ) Or ;
					       ( crSigOpCdd.ChkIfors = 2 And CrTmpPro.Ifors <> TprMvCab.ContaDs And Not Seek(TprMvCab.Contads,'CrTmpFPro','Ifors') ) Or ;

						[a.CodCors = b.Cods ]

				If CrSigCdOpe.EditDocs= 4

							EtiEsps   With .f. in crTpmMvItn

							MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdLpi)')
							Return .f.

						Go Top
						If Reccount() > 0 And (IsEmpty(crSigCdLpi.VencFs) Or BetWeen(TprMvCab.Datas,crSigCdLpi.VencIs, crSigCdLpi.VencFs))
							lcMoeVs = crSigCdLpi.MoeVs					
							Replace crTpmMvItn.univals with crSigCdLpi.PVens, ;
									crTpmMvItn.MoeFats With crSigCdLpi.MoeVs in crTpmMvItn

								lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeVs

							Else

									lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeCs
									lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.PCuss
									If InList(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
										_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.ChkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
										lcQuery = [Select Moevs, Pvens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
										=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
										If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 and Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
											lcMoeVs   = crtmpfPro.MoeVs
											lnUniVals = crtmpfPro.PVens
										EndIf

										lnUniVals = lnUniVals * Iif( crSigCdMoe.Qtdeqs = 0, 1, crSigCdMoe.QtdEqs )
									EndIf
								Else
									If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 5
										lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.Moedas
										lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.Valors
									Else
										If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7
											lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.mUltComps
											lnUniVals = CrTmpPro.vUltComps
										Else
											If InList(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
												=fCustoMedio(TprMvCab.Emps,CrTmpPro.Cpros,TprMvCab.Datas,ThisForm.poDataMgr,(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
												lcMoeVs   = TmpCusMed.Moedas
												lnUniVals = TmpCusMed.Valors
											Else
												lnUniVals = 0
												lcMoeVs   = crSigCdOpe.CMoes
											EndIf
										EndIf
									EndIf
								EndIf
							EndIf
							If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 11
								lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeCs
								lnUniVals = crTmpPro.custofs
							EndIf
							If crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 15
								lcMoeVs   = CrTmpPro.MoeCs
								lnUniVals = crTmpPro.custofs
								lcQuery = [select customedioreais as csmedio, (select moedaps from sigcdpam) as csmoedas ] + ;
										[from customedio3 where cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' ]
								If ThisForm.Podatamgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpProMd') < 1
									=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpProMd)')
									Return 0
								EndIf
								If Reccount('CrTmpProMd')>0
									lcMoeVs   = CrTmpProMd.csmoedas
									lnUniVals = CrTmpProMd.csmedio
								EndIf 	
							EndIf
							
							Select crTpmMvItn
							Replace crTpmMvItn.UniVals With lnUniVals
						EndIf
						If crSigCdOpe.Parcs <> 1 And crSigCdOpe.Vars <> 1
							Replace crTpmMvItn.ValRats With 0 ,;
									crTpmMvItn.Unit2s  With 0 in crTpmMvItn
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
				llSubItem = ( crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts = 1 ) And ;
							( InList( CrTmpGru.TipoEstos, 2, 3, 4 ) Or ( CrTmpGru.Tams = 1) Or ;
						    ( CrtmpGru.Cores = 1 ) Or ( CrTmpGru.Embs = 1 ) )

				lcQuery = [Select Desmembs ] + ;
						    [From SigCdUni ] + ;
						   [Where CUnis = '] + crTpmMvItn.CUnis + [' ] + ;
						   [Order By Desmembs]

				If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, 'crTmpUni') < 1)
					=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (crTmpUni)')
					Return 0
				EndIf
				Go Top In crTmpUni
				If ( ThisForm.pcEscolha $ 'INSERIR/ALTERAR' ) And ( crTpmMvItn.Qtds > 1 ) And ;
						( CrTmpUni.Desmembs = 'S' ) And ( crSigCdOpe.Desmembs = 1 ) And Not llSubItem
					=ThisForm.Desmembra( crTpmMvItn.Qtds, .t. )
				EndIf
			Else
				If !_CarregaItens
					Select xBaixa
					Set Order to Cpros
					If !Seek( crEesti.Cpros )
						Insert Into xBaixa ( Cpros,Pvens,Moevs ) Values ( CrEesti.Cpros, CrEestI.UniVals, CrEestI.Moefats )
					EndIf
					Replace xBaixa.Qtds     With xBaixa.Qtds + crEesti.Qtds,;
							xBaixa.QtBaixas With xBaixa.QtBaixas + crEesti.QtBaixas,;
							xBaixa.QtProds  With xBaixa.QtProds  + crEesti.QtProds

					Set Order to Cbars
					If !Seek( crEesti.CodBarras )
						Insert Into xBaixaEtq ( CodBarras, UniVals ) Values ( crEesti.CodBarras, crEesti.UniVals )
					EndIf
					Replace xBaixaEtq.Qtds     With xBaixaEtq.Qtds + crEesti.Qtds,;
							xBaixaEtq.QtBaixas with xBaixaEtq.QtBaixas + crEesti.QtBaixas
			 	EndIf

			If _CarregaItens And lnOldItem # 0 And crSigCdOpe.HabSubIts <> 3
				Select crEsti2
				Set Order To cItens
				=Seek(lnOldItem)
				Scan While CItens = lnOldItem
					Scatter Memvar Memo
					m.Qtds = m.Qtds - Iif(crSigCdOpe.SubNs=3,0,m.QtBaixas)
					m.Opers = Iif(Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.OpePads),crSigCdOpe.OpePads,Iif( OpeAtu = 1, 'E', Iif( OpeAtu = 2, 'S', m.Opers ) ) )
					If InList(crSigCdOpe.ApTpFats,1,4) And crSigCdOpe.NDebitos # 1 And !Empty( TprMvCab.TpFats )
						If crSigCdOpe.ApTpFats = 1 
							m.Qtds  = m.Qtds * crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100
						Else
							m.Qtds  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,m.Qtds,m.Qtds - ( m.Qtds * crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ))
						EndIf

						lnQtds = Int( m.Qtds )
						Do Case
							Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 1 And lnQtds # m.Qtds && Acima
								m.Qtds = lnQtds + 1
							Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 2 And _Qtds # m.Qtds && Abaixo
								m.Qtds = lnQtds
							Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 3 && Sem Arredondamento
							Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 4 && Natural

						Select crTpmMvIts

			lcSql = [Select * From SigMvItp Where EmpdopNums = ']+_Nivel+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrEsti3') < 1

				Insert Into crTpmMvItn From Memvar
				Replace crTpmMvItn.Obs With crEesti.Obs
				If crSigCdOpe.EditDocs= 3
					Replace crTpmMvItn.Notas With TRANSFORM(TprMvCab.Numes,"@L 999999") in crTpmMvItn
				EndIf
				If CrSigCdOpe.EditDocs= 4
					Replace crTpmMvItn.Notas With TprMvCab.Notas in crTpmMvItn
				EndIf							
				If crSigOpCdc.nCarBars = 1
					Replace CodBarras With 0 ,;
							EtiEsps   With .f. in crTpmMvItn
				EndIf
				If crSigOpCdc.nCarDocs = 1
					Replace crTpmMvItn.Notas With ' ' in crTpmMvItn
				EndIf
				wRegistros = wRegistros + 1
			EndScan
		EndIf

		Select crTpmMvItn
		lcItOrdem = Order()
		Set Order to
		lnItem = 0
		Scan
			lnItem = lnItem - 1
			lnOldItem = CItens
			Replace crTpmMvItn.CItens   With lnItem, ;
					crTpmMvItn.Utilizas With Iif( InList(_PrecoPs,4,9), 14, crTpmMvItn.Utilizas )

			If crSigCdOpe.ItemZeros = 1 And crTpmMvItn.Units = 0  And crTpmMvItn.Utilizas = 0 &&não recalcula o preço.
				Replace Utilizas With 14 in crTpmMvItn
			EndIf
			If crSigOpCdd.DesUtils = 1
				Replace Utilizas With 0 in crTpmMvItn
			EndIf

			Select crTpmMvIts
			Replace all CItens with lnItem for CItens = lnOldItem

			Select crSigSubMv
			replace all citem2 with lnItem for cItem2 = lnOldItem

			If Used([crSigMvIte])
				Select crSigMvIte
				Replace All Citens With lnItem For Citens = lnOldItem
			Endif
						
			Select crTpmMvItn
			lcQuery = [Select Cpros, Dpros, Moevs, Pvens, Moecs, Pcuss, Moedas, Valors, cunis, vUltComps, mUltComps,cftios,sgrus,CodFinP,OrigMercs,SitTrIcms ]+; 
					  [From SigCdPro Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[']
			=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcquery,'CrTmpPro')
			Do Case
				Case crSigCdOpe.precops=1
					lcwhere = [Select * From SigCdLpi Where Cpros = ']+crTpmMvItn.Cpros+[' And LPrecos = ']+TprMvCab.lPrecos+[']
					lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'crSigCdLpi')
					If lnErro < 1
						MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (crSigCdLpi 2)')
						Return .f.
					EndIf
					If !Empty( TprMvCab.LPrecos ) And NOT EOF('crSigCdLpi')
						moeda = crSigCdLpi.Moevs
					Else
						moeda = CrTmpPro.moevs
					EndIf

				Case InList(crSigCdOpe.precops,2,11,15)
					moeda = CrTmpPro.moecs
					If InList(crSigOpCdd.chkIfors,1,2)
						_Ct = Iif(crSigOpCdd.ChkIfors=1,TprMvCab.ContaOs,TprMvCab.Contads)
						lcQuery = [Select Moevs, Pvens From SigPrFnc Where Cpros = ']+CrTmpPro.Cpros+[' And Ifors = ']+_Ct+[']
						=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpFpro')
						If Not Eof('CrTmpfPro') And CrTmpfPro.pvens > 0 and Not Empty(CrTmpfPro.Moevs)
							moeda = crtmpfPro.MoeVs
						EndIf
					EndIf

				Case crSigCdOpe.precops=5
					moeda = CrTmpPro.moedas

				Case crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs = 7
					Moeda = CrTmpPro.mUltComps

				Case InList(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs,8,9)
					=fCustoMedio(TprMvCab.Emps,CrTmpPro.Cpros,TprMvCab.Datas,ThisForm.poDataMgr,(crSigCdOpe.PrecoPs=8))
					moeda = TmpCusMed.Moedas

				Other
					If IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ) 
						moeda = CrTmpPro.moevs
					Else
						moeda = crSigCdOpe.cmoes
					EndIf
			Endcase

			If !Seek( moeda, "TmpCot" )
				If crTpmMvItn.MoeVals = 0 Or !IsEmpty(_MoePadrao) Or crSigOpCdd.AtuCotas = 1
					_Cota = ThisForm.Cotacao(Moeda,TprMvCab.datas)
					If crSigOpCdd.AtuCotas = 1
						Replace MoeVals With _Cota In crTpmMvItn
					EndIf
				Else
					Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( Moeda, crTpmMvItn.MoeVals )
				EndIf
			EndIf

			If !Seek( crTpmMvItn.Moefats, "TmpCot" )
				If crTpmMvItn.FatVals = 0 Or crSigOpCdd.AtuCotas = 1
					_Cota = ThisForm.Cotacao(crTpmMvItn.MoeFats,TprMvCab.Datas)
					If crSigOpCdd.AtuCotas = 1
						Replace FatVals With _Cota In crTpmMvItn
					EndIf
				Else
					Insert Into TmpCot ( Cmoes, Valos ) Values ( crTpmMvItn.MoeFats, crTpmMvItn.FatVals )
				EndIf
			EndIf

			If !Seek( crTpmMvItn.Moedas, "TmpCot" )
				_Cota = ThisForm.Cotacao(crTpmMvItn.Moedas,TprMvCab.Datas)
			EndIf
		Endscan

		Select crTpmMvItn
		Replace All CItens with Abs( CItens )
		Set Order to &lcItOrdem.
		Go Top

		Select crTpmMvIts
		Replace All CItens with Abs( CItens )
		Set Order to CItens
		Set Key to crTpmMvItn.CItens
		
		Select crSigSubMv
		Replace All CItem2 with Abs( CItem2 )
		Set Order to CItem2
		Set Key to crTpmMvItn.CItens		

		If Used([crSigMvIte])
			Select crSigMvIte
			Replace All Citens With Abs(Citens)
			Set Key To To crTpmMvItn.Citens
		Endif
		
		Select crTpmMvItn

		If Eof( 'crTpmMvItn' ) &&And (crSigCdOpe.SubNObrigs # 1)
		 	Insert Into crTpmMvItn ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, CItens );
	 			 Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, 1 )
		EndIf
		
		Select crTpmMvIts
		Set Order to CItens
		Goto Top
		Set Key to crTpmMvItn.CItens
		
		If InList(crSigCdOpe.ParAutos,1,4,5) And ( lnTotCar > 0 Or Not _CarregaItens Or _SemItens )

			lcQuery = [Select a.Fpags,a.Fpagss,a.Contabs From SigOpFpo a ]+;
					  [Where a.dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[' ]
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'LocalFpagO') < 1
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão - LocalFpagO ')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			Select LocalFPago
			Index on Fpags tag Fpags

			lcBusca = TprMvCab.Emps + Dope + Str( Nume, 6 )
			lcWhere = [Select * From SigMvPar Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrPar')
			If lnErro < 0
				MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrPar)')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			Select CrPar
			Scan
				Scatter Memvar Memo
				If Seek(m.Fpags,'LocalFPagO','Fpags') And Not Empty(LocalFpagO.Fpagss)
					m.Fpags = LocalFpagO.Fpagss
				EndIf
				=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigOpFp','crSigOpFp','Fpags',m.Fpags)
				m.Ndias = 0
				If InList(crSigOpCdd.OpcSnas,1,2) And crSigOpFp.OpcSnas <> crSigOpCdd.OpcSnas
					Loop
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.ParRecals = 1
					If crSigOpFp.TpVencs = 2 And Not IsEmpty(CrTprMvCab.PrazoEnts)
						m.Ndias = Ttod(crPar.Vencs) - ttod(CrTprMvCab.PrazoEnts)
						m.Vencs = Ttod(crPar.Vencs) - ttod(CrTprMvCab.PrazoEnts) + Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas)
					Else
						m.nDias = Ttod(crPar.Vencs) - Ttod(crTprMvCab.Datas) 
						m.Vencs = Ttod(crPar.Vencs) - Ttod(crTprMvCab.Datas) + Ttod(TprMvCab.Datas)
					EndIf
				EndIf
				m.InsChs = InList(crSigCdOpe.ParAutos,4,5)
				m.ValDescs = Iif(crSigOpCdd.VarPs <> 1, 0, m.ValDescs)
				m.Datas = TprMvCab.Datas
				If lnCaixas = 1 And lnCOpers = 2 And InList(lnParContas, 1, 3)
					If lnCheqs = 1 And crSigOpFp.Infos = 'C' And crSigOpFp.EmiChqs # 1 And Not IsEmpty(m.Bancos)
						lcCheque = m.Bancos + m.Agencias + m.Contas + m.Numeros
						Declare LaCampo(4,2)
						LaCampo(1,1)='Bancos'
						LaCampo(2,1)='Agencias'
						LaCampo(3,1)='nContas'
						LaCampo(4,1)='Ncheques'
						LaCampo(1,2)=CrPar.Bancos
						LaCampo(2,2)=CrPar.Agencias
						LaCampo(3,2)=CrPar.Contas
						LaCampo(4,2)=CrPar.Numeros
						If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigChe','CrCheque',@LaCampo)
							=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdOpt','crSigCdOpt','Operacaos',CrCheque.Umovs)
							If crSigCdOpt.Tipos # 'DB'
								MessageBox('Cheque: ' + m.Bancos + '-' + m.Agencias + '-' + ;
										   m.Contas + '-' + m.Numeros + ' Não Pode Ser ' + ;
										   'Utilizado Nessa Movimentação ... ',48,'Última ' + ;
										   'Movimentação do Cheque: ' + crCheque.UMovs)
								Loop
							EndIf
						Else
							MessageBox('Cheque: ' + m.Bancos + '-' + m.Agencias + '-' + ;
									   m.Contas + '-' + m.Numeros + ' Não Consta No ' + ;
									   'Cadastro de Cheques ... ',48,'Contate o Suporte ' + ; 
									   'Técnico')
							Loop
						EndIf
					Else
						Declare LaCampo(2,2)
						LaCampo(1,1)='Emps'
						LaCampo(2,1)='Ncarts'
						LaCampo(1,2)=CrPar.Emps
						LaCampo(2,2)=CrPar.Ncarts
						If crSigOpFp.Infos = 'T' And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCrd','CrCard',@lacampo) And ;
								!Empty(crCard.TotPar)
							MessageBox( 'Cartão de Crédito Com Baixa Parcial ... ', 48, '' )
							Loop
						EndIf						
					EndIf
				EndIf
				
			 	Insert Into xPar From Memvar
			Endscan
		EndIf

		If _TabPadrao
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.peAntValue = ' '
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Valid()
		EndIf

		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)

		If _CarOpCr = 6
			lcSql = [Select * From SigOpDev Where EmpDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CrTmpDevol')
			Select CrTmpDevol
			Scan
				Scatter memvar
				Insert into TmpDevol From Memvar
			EndScan
		EndIf

		If _CarregaItens
			lcSql = [Select * From SigMvItt Where empDopNums = ']+lcBusca+[']
			If ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcSql,'CsEestiS') < 1
				=MessageBox('Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!', 16, 'Falha na Conexão (CSEestiS)')
				Return .F.
			EndIf
			Select CsEestiS
			Scan
				Scatter Memvar
				Insert Into crTpmMvItnS From Memvar
			EndScan
		EndIf

		If ( crSigCdOpe.Vars = 1 Or CrTprMvCab.ValVars <> 0 ) Or crSigOpCdd.nCarDscs <> 1
			Select TprMvCab
			Replace TprMvCab.ValVars With TprMvCab.ValVars + crTprMvCab.ValVars In TprMvCab
			If _ParAuto And crSigOpCdd.VarPs = 1
				Replace ValVarPs With ValVarPs + CrTprMvCab.ValVarPs in TprMvCab
			EndIf
		EndIf
		
		Select TprMvCab

		ThisForm.TotIte = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)

		lnTran = Iif(crSigOpCdc.nChkVsts = 1, TprMvCab.ValTrans, 0)
		_Valos = Round( ThisForm.totite - TprMvCab.valdevs + TprMvCab.valvars  + TprMvCab.ValServs + lnTran, 2 )
		Replace TprMvCab.ValInis With Round( ThisForm.totite - TprMvCab.valdevs, 2 ),;
				TprMvCab.Valos   With _Valos IN TprMvCab
		
		With ThisForm.pagina.dados
			If crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1 And !Empty( TprMvCab.ContaOs ) And ;
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contaos)
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.get_dconta.value=crcli.rclis
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.get_cpf.value=crcli.cpfs
			Else
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.get_dconta.Value = ''
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.get_cpf.Value = ''
			EndIf
			
			If crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1 And !Empty( TprMvCab.ContaDs) And ;
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.get_dconta.value=crcli.rclis
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.get_cpf.value=crcli.cpfs
			Else
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.get_dconta.Value = ''
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.get_cpf.Value = ''
			EndIf
			
			If InList( crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 1, 2, 5 ) And !Empty( TprMvCab.Vends ) And ;
					ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.vends)
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_dconta.value=crcli.rclis
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_cpf.value=crcli.cpfs
			Else
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_dconta.Value = ''
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.get_cpf.Value = ''
			EndIf
		endwith
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.refresh

		Select TprMvCab
		If TprMvCab.ValInis # 0
			Replace TprMvCab.Vars With Round(TprMvCab.ValVars / TprMvCab.ValInis * 100, 4) in TprMvCab
		Else
			Replace TprMvCab.Vars with 0 in TprMvCab
		EndIf
		
		If !_NumeroAnt And !_DigDocu &&!_Conserto And 
			Select TmpOperacao
			Replace Notas      With CrTprMvCab.Notas, ;
					CMoes      With lcMoeSubNs,    ;
					Valos      With CrTprMvCab.Valos, ;
					OldValoBxs With CrTprMvCab.ValoBxs, ;
					Ecfs	   With CrTprMvCab.Ecfs,;
					ValInis    With CrTprMvCab.ValInis,;
					VlFretes   With CrTmpNfis.VlFretes,;
					Series     With CrTmpNfis.Series ,;
					Nemps      With CrTprMvCab.Nemps , ;
					DespAces   With CrTmpNfis.DespAces,;
					VlValVars  With CrTprMvCab.ValVars ,;
					ValVars    With CrTprMvCab.ValVars, ;
					VlLibOpes  With lnValLbOpe In TmpOperacao

			If crSigOpCdd.CarOuVlrs = 1
				Replace FrtIpis   With CrTmpNfis.FrtIpis,;
						FrtIcms   With CrTmpNfis.FrtIcms,;
						VlSeguros With CrTmpNfis.VlSeguros,;
						SegIpis   With CrTmpNfis.SegIpis,;
						SegIcms   With CrTmpNfis.SegIcms,;
						DesIpis   With CrTmpNfis.DesIpis,;
						Cfops     With CrTmpNfis.Cfis,;
						DesIcms   With CrTmpNfis.DesIcms in TmpOperacao
			EndIf
			If crSigOpCdd.nCarFrts = 1
				Replace TmpOperacao.VlFretes With 0 in TmpOperacao
			EndIf
			If crSigOpCdd.nCarDesps = 1
				Replace TmpOperacao.DespAces With 0 in TmpOperacao
			EndIf
			If crSigOpCdd.nCarDscs = 1
				Replace TmpOperacao.VlValVars With 0 in TmpOperacao
			EndIf
			If (crSigOpCdd.SubFretes = 1) && Utilizar Frete do Subnível
				Replace Fretes With CrTmpNfis.Fretes In TmpOperacao
			EndIf
			If Empty(ThisForm.CfopSubn)
				ThisForm.CfopSubn = CrTmpNfis.Cfis
			EndIf
			Skip
			If Eof()
			 	Insert Into TmpOperacao ( Emps, Dopes, Numes, Codigos ) ;
			 			 Values ( TprMvCab.Emps, TprMvCab.Dopes, TprMvCab.Numes, 0 )
				KeyBoard "{DNARROW}"
			EndIf
		Else
			Return 1
		EndIf

		ThisForm.AtuaTot(.t.)
		If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 )
			ThisForm.CalcImposto( INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ))
		EndIf
		ThisForm.AtuaTot()
		ThisForm.mAtuValPres()

		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.refresh
		Select TmpOperacao
		Return 1
	Else
		Select TmpOperacao
		Return 0
	EndIf
EndIf
Select crTpmMvItn
set order to

lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'crSigCdOpe')

Select TmpOperacao
ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Refresh
Return .t.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
Public _OldCodigo

Set Confirm On
_OldCodigo = This.Value

Return( ( ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'INSERIR' Or (ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'ALTERAR' And ThisForm.LibPend ) ) ;
		And ( inlist(crSigCdOpe.SubNs,4,5) Or ( crSigCdOpe.SubNs=3 And Empty(crSigCdOpe.Nivels) ) ) ;
		and !(crSigOpCdd.otica = 1) )

ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.GradeOperação.Operação.Text1
* Classe: textbox (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 132
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
Set Confirm Off

If ( _Conserto Or _NumeroAnt Or _DigDocu Or IsEmpty( This.Value ) ) And LastKey() = 13
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.SetFocus
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
	Do Case
		Case (InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDObrigs,1,3)) And IsEmpty(TprMvCab.TabDs)
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGOrigs
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Grupo.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Origems = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixCOrigs
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixGDests
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Grupo.SetFocus

		Case (crSigCdOpe.Destinos = 1) And !crSigCdOpe.FixCDests
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.ActivePage = 1
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.SetFocus
	EndCase
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local NDope, Nume, CodConf, OpeAtu, lnRecOld, _PuxaOrigem, _PuxaDestino, lcItOrdem, QtdSub, UnitSub
Local lnCOpers, lnCaixas, lnCheqs, lnParcs, lnParContas, lcCheque, lcMoeSubNs, lnCasas, _CfoAtual, _DestacaIPI
Local _MoePadrao, _PrecoPs, lnCodigos, _nCarItem, _ChkEmpDestino, _pData, _nddval, lcMoePend, lnValLbOpe, _SemItens

lcUltGrv = TprMvCab.Dopes + Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)+'-GrdOperacao'

lcSql = [Select * From SigOpCdd Where Dopes = ']+TprMvCab.Dopes+[']
ThisForm.poDataMgr.Sqlexecute(lcSql,'crSigOpCdd')

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
lcMoeSubNs = ''

If ThisForm.MGOpe And Type('ThisForm.NivelMGOpe') = 'N' And ThisForm.NivelMGOpe = 0
	Set Decimals to 0
	lcsubnivel=crSigCdOpe.nivels
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',lcSubNivel)
	lnNumNivel = Val( Str( crSigCdOpe.NDopes, 4 ) + Transf( ThisForm.pNumes, '@L 999999' ) )
	this.value = lnNumNivel
	ThisForm.Nivelmgope = This.Value
	Set Decimals to 2
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',TprMvCab.Dopes)
EndIf

_pData = Datetime() &&ThisForm.poDataMgr.GetDatetime()

lnCOpers      = crSigCdOpe.COpers
lnCaixas      = crSigCdOpe.Caixas
lnCheqs       = crSigCdOpe.Cheqs
lnParcs       = crSigCdOpe.Parcs
lnParContas   = crSigCdOpe.ParContas
OpeAtu        = crSigCdOpe.Opers
_Conserto     = crSigCdOpe.Consers = 1 
_NumeroAnt    = ( crSigCdOpe.Numeras = 2 )
_Digdocu      = ( crSigCdOpe.DigDoc = 4 )
_PedClis	  = ( crSigCdOpe.PedClis = 5)
_BaixaSubN    = ( crSigCdOpe.BaixaSns = 1 )

							Unitsub = Unitsub * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100
						Else
							m.Qtds  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,m.Qtds,m.Qtds - ( m.Qtds * crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ))
							m.Units = ( m.Units - ( m.Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) )
							Qtdsub  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,Qtdsub,Qtdsub - ( Qtdsub * crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ))
							Unitsub = ( Unitsub - ( Unitsub * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) )
						EndIf
					Else
						If crSigCdOpe.ApTpFats = 1
							m.Qtds  = m.Qtds * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ) ) 
							Qtdsub  = Qtdsub * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ) ) 
						Else
							m.Qtds  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,m.Qtds,m.Qtds - ( m.Qtds * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ) ) ))
							Qtdsub  = Iif(crSigCdTif.PQtdes=100,Qtdsub,Qtdsub - ( Qtdsub * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PQtdes / 100 ) ) ))
						EndIf
					EndIf
				Else
					If crSigCdOpe.ApTpFats = 1
						If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 )
							m.Units = m.Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100
							Unitsub = Unitsub * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100
						Else
							If crSigCdTif.PValors <> 0
								m.Units = ( m.Units / crSigCdTif.PValors * 100 ) * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) ) 
								Unitsub = ( Unitsub / crSigCdTif.PValors * 100 ) * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) ) 
							EndIf
						EndIf
					Else
						If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 )
							m.Units = m.Units - ( m.Units * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 )
							Unitsub = Unitsub - ( Unitsub * crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 )
						Else
							If crSigCdTif.PValors <> 0
								m.Units = m.Units - ( ( m.Units / crSigCdTif.PValors * 100 ) * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) ) )
								Unitsub = Unitsub - ( ( Unitsub / crSigCdTif.PValors * 100 ) * ( 1 - ( crSigCdTif.PValors / 100 ) ) )
							EndIf
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf
				m.ItemOk = Round(Unitsub * Qtdsub, 2)
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.Porcs # 0
				m.Qtds  = Round( m.Qtds * crSigCdOpe.Porcs / 100, 2 )
				lnQtds = Int( m.Qtds )
				Do Case
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 1 And lnQtds # m.Qtds && Acima
						m.Qtds = lnQtds + 1
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 2 And _Qtds # m.Qtds && Abaixo
						m.Qtds = lnQtds
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 3 && Sem Arredondamento
					Case crSigCdOpe.Arreds = 4 && Natural

				Endcase

				CotaI = ThisForm.Cotacao(m.Moedas,TprMvCab.Datas)
				m.Moedas = _MoePadrao
				m.Units  = Round( m.Units * CotaI / CotaP,lnCasas )

				m.Units = 0
			EndIf

					CotaI  = ThisForm.Cotacao(m.Moedas,TprMvCab.Datas)
					lnUnit = Round(CrTmpPro.vUltComps * CotaP / CotaI,lnCasas)
				Else
					lnUnit = CrTmpPro.vUltComps
				EndIf

				vItem   = IIF(lnUnit = 0, m.Units, lnUnit + ((m.Units - lnUnit)/2)) && mena 28/10/2014 - testa se valor da compra = 0 para não dividir o preço por dois.
				m.Units = Iif(vItem > lnUnit,vItem,lnUnit)
				m.UniVals = m.Units
			EndIf
