------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE GotFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE GotFocus
If crSigCdOpe.Cadclis = 1 And InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
	*** mena 19/08/2014 - verifica o que pode ser digitado e mascara conforme o caso ***
	LOCAL lcGrupo, lnCpffix
	lcGrupo    = This.Parent.get_grupo.Value
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdGcr','crTmpGcr','Codigos',lcGrupo)
	lnCpffix=Int(Val(Substr(crTmpGcr.CfgCdGcr, 8, 1)))
	this.InputMask = IIF(lnCpffix = 1, '999.999.999-99', IIF(lnCpffix = 2, '99.999.999/9999-99',''))
ENDIF

RETURN

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
Local lcTpFat, lcCadGrupo, lcGruCadOs

lcTpFat = ' '
Cgc  = This.Value
Cgc1 = ' '
RetCli = ' '
llMostra = ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','LocalDcOpe','dopes',_Dope,[FixCadOs,FixCadDs])

lcGruCadOs = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCados), crSigCdOpe.GruCados, ' ' )

If !Empty(This.Value)
	Cgc = Strt( Strt( Strt( Cgc, ".", "" ), "-", "" ), "/", "" )
	If Len(Alltrim(Cgc))<>14
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 999.999.999-99" )
	Else
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 99.999.999/9999-99" )
	EndIf
	
	This.Value = Cgc1
	
	lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdCli Where Cpfs = ?Cgc1 ]+;
			Iif(LocalDcOpe.FixCadOs = 1 And Not Empty(lcGruCadOs),[And Grupos = ']+lcGruCadOs+['],[ ])

	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpCli')
	
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 10)')
		This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
		This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
		Return 0
	EndIf

	Select CrTmpCli
	Go Top
	If Reccount() = 0 Or Cgc1 = "999.999.999-99" or Cgc1 = "99.999.999/9999-99" 
		If crSigCdOpe.Cadclis = 1 And InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
			If crSigCdOpe.CadCliAuts = 1 Or ;
				(crSigCdOpe.CadCliAuts = 3 And MessageBox('Conta Não Cadastrada,  Deseja Cadastrar somente CPF/CNPJ?',4+32+256,'') = 6 )
				If Len(Alltrim(Cgc))<>14
					If Not fValidarCPF(Cgc1)
						=MessageBox('CPF Inválido!!!', 16, ' ')
						This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
						This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
						Return 0
					EndIf
				Else
					If Not fValidarCNPJ(Cgc1) 
						=MessageBox('CGC/CNPJ Inválido!!!', 16, ' ')
						This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
						This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
						Return 0
					EndIf
				EndIf
				lcCadGrupo = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCados), crSigCdOpe.GruCados, This.Parent.get_grupo.Value)
				RetCli     = ThisForm.mCadAutomatico(lcCadGrupo, This.Value,(crSigCdOpe.CadCliAuts = 3))
			Else
				If MessageBox('Conta não cadastrada, Deseja cadastrar ',4 + 32 + 256,' ')=6
					Select CrTmpCli
					If Cgc1 = "999.999.999-99" or Cgc1 = "99.999.999/9999-99" 
						this.value = ' '
					EndIf
					lcCadGrupo = Iif( Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadOs), crSigCdOpe.GruCadOs, this.parent.get_grupo.value )

					*** Mena - 10/10/2013 - substituida a chamada para inclusao automatica pelo CPF no cadastro de contas
*!*					Do Form SigCdCli with this.value, lcCadGrupo, .f., .f., .f., '1', '1' To RetCli
					lcCli = ''
					Do Form SIGCDCTA With 0,[SIGCDCTA],lcCli,.T.,Cgc1,lcCadGrupo 	
					************************************************************

* 				Do Form SIGCDCTA With 0, [SIGCDCTA], lcCli, .t.	// Trocar Aqui

				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		RetCli = CrTmpCli.Iclis  &&CrTmpCli.Cpfs
	EndIf
	If Empty(RetCli) And Reccount('CrTmpCli') = 0
		If ( LocalDcOpe.FixCadOs = 1 And Not Empty(lcGruCadOs) )
			Declare laGrupo[1,2]
			laGrupo[1,1] = 'Grupos'
			laGrupo[1,2] = lcGruCadOs
			m.loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext',ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdconn,'SigCdCli','crTmpcli','cpfs',This.Value,'Clientes',1000,'Cpfs',@laGrupo)
		Else
			m.loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext',ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdconn,'SigCdCli','crTmpcli','cpfs',This.Value,'Clientes',1000)
		EndIf
		If .Not.m.loLista.plAchouRegistro
			If llMostra
				m.loLista.mAddColuna('Cpfs' ,' ', 'C.P.F. / C.N.P.J.' )
			EndIf 
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Rclis',Replicate('x',50), 'Nome' )
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Iclis',' ', 'Código' )
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Grupos',' ', 'Grupo' )
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Situas','xxxxxxxx','Situação')
			m.loLista.Show()
		EndIf
	Else
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdCli Where ]+Iif(Len(RetCli)=10,[ Iclis = ],[ Cpfs = ])+[ ?RetCli ]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpCli')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 11)')
			This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Select CrTmpCli
	Go Top
	
	If not fChecarInativas( crTmpCli.IClis, ThisForm.poDataMgr )
		MessageBox('Conta Inativa ...',32,'' )
		This.Parent.get_conta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value = '' 
		This.SetFocus 
		Return 0
	EndIf	
	
	If InList(crSigOpCdd.ChkConta,1,3)
		If not ThisForm.ChkDadosConta(crTmpCli.IClis,InList(crSigCdOpe.NFiscals,1,2))
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	lfan = crTmpCli.Rclis
	lcod = crTmpCli.Iclis
	this.parent.get_conta.value  = CrTmpCli.Iclis
	this.parent.get_dconta.value = CrTmpCli.Rclis

	If Not Empty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
		lcGrupo = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
		If !Empty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadOs)
			lcGrupoCad = crSigCdOpe.GruCadOs
			lordem = .t.
		Else
			lcGrupoCad = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
		    lOrdem = .f.
		EndIf
		If !fAcessoContas( Usuar, lcGrupo, 'C', This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value, This.Parent.Get_Conta, This.Parent.Get_DConta, .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj ) &&,lordem, lcGrupoCad )
			MessageBox( 'Acesso Negado', 48, ' ' )
			this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
			this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
			this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf

	this.parent.get_conta.value  = CrTmpCli.Iclis
	this.parent.get_dconta.value = CrTmpCli.Rclis
	lcTpFat = CrTmpCli.CodTifs
	If IsEmpty( this.parent.get_grupo.value )
		this.parent.get_grupo.value = CrTmpCli.Grupos
	EndIf
	If llMostra
		this.parent.get_cpf.value    = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
	EndIf 
	this.parent.get_conta.refresh
	this.parent.get_dconta.refresh
	this.parent.get_grupo.refresh
	this.parent.get_cpf.refresh
	If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
		With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
			If crSigCdOpe.Vendes = 1
				If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.GrupoVens ) And IsEmpty( TprMvCab.GrVends )
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Grupo.Value = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens
				EndIf
				*** mena - 30/09/2015 - verifica flag se carrega vendedor do cliente
				If INT(VAL(SUBSTR(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 217,1)))=0 and ;
					!IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.ContaVens ) And (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.Vends ) or This.peantvalue # This.Value  ) And ;
					( TprMvCab.GrVends = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens Or crSigOpCdd.nChkGrps = 1 )
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
				EndIf
				If Not InList( crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs, 1, 3, 4, 5,6,7,9,10,12 )
					Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens,;
							TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens IN TprMvCab
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 11
					If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
						Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens In TprMvCab
					EndIf
					Replace TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVen2s In TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 6
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.Iclis
				Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.Iclis in TprMvCab
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 9
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
				Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens in TprMvCab
				If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
					Replace GrResps With crTmpCli.GrupoVens in TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.LPrecos ) Or This.Value # This.peantvalue ) And crSigCdOpe.Precops = 1 And crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 1
				_ListaPreco = CrTmpCli.LPrecos
				If ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) And TprMvCab.Lprecos <> crSigCdOpe.LprecoPads )
					_ListaPreco = crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads
					ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
				Else
					If Not ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) )
						ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf

			If (TprMvCab.Tabds = crSigCdOpe.Tabdps Or This.Value <> This.peantvalue)
				If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 1 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabds) And Seek(CrTmpCli.TabDs, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
					Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
					ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.TabDs) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
											    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
											     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabds
				Else
					If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 1 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And Seek(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
						Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
						ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
												    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
												     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabd2s
					Else
						_Tabd = Iif(Not InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDescs, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 ), Spac( 10 ), crSigCdOpe.Tabdps)
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = _Tabd
					EndIf
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Refresh
				EndIf
			EndIf

			If crSigCdOpe.Vendes = 1
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = ' '
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = ' '
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Vends)
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = crTmpCli.RClis
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.cRepls = 1 And ( IsEmpty( .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.Value ) Or crSigCdOpe.FixCDests )
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.Value = .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value
			EndIf
		Endwith
	EndIf
	If ThisForm.pcEscolha # "PROCURAR"
		If This.peantvalue # This.Value  Or ( IsEmpty( This.peantvalue ) And !IsEmpty( This.Value ) )
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,6,7)
				If ThisForm.CarItem()
					this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
					this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
					this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
					This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.expends, 1, 3 ) 
				If !ThisForm.MostraPends( TprMvCab.Grupoos, TprMvCab.Contaos )
					This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value = ' '
					This.Parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
					This.Parent.Get_dconta.Value = ' '
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.ContaOs) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contaos)
				If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.Obs ) And crSigCdOpe.ObsOrigs = 1 And crSigCdOpe.demoCreds <> 3
					MessageBox( CrTmpCli.Obs, 32, 'Observação da Conta ' + TprMvCab.Contaos )
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Not ThisForm.ChkUniDp()
				this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
				this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
				this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
				This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf

		lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdFcx Where Emps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' And Grupos = ']+TprMvCab.Grupoos+[' And Contas = ']+TprMvCab.Contaos+[' Order By Codigos desc]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpFecha')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFecha 10)')
			this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
			this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
			this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		Else
			Select CrTmpFecha
			Go Top
			If Reccount() > 0 And Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas) < dtos(Ttod(CrTmpFecha.Datas)+crSigCdPac.ndFechas)
				MessageBox([Período Bloqueado Para a Conta ] + ThisForm.CfgTitOrigem + [...], 32, [Atenção!!!])
				this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
				this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
				this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
				This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contaos)
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCst','CrTmpScli','Codigos',CrTmpCli.Situas)

		If crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds = 3
			Do Form SigOpLrC With Thisform, crSigCdOpe.Dopes,1 To Ret
			If Not Ret
				Return 0
			EndIf
		Else
			If crSigCdOpe.ExibSits=3 And CrtmpScli.DispMovs = 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Value)
				lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
				_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcDsit) + chr(13) + ;
					   '' + Iif(CrTmpScli.UltCompra=1,Transform(CrTmpCli.VultComps,"@Z 999,999,999.99") + ' / ' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.UltComps),Dtoc(CrTmpCli.UltComps),''),'') + Chr(13)+;
		               '' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.Nascs),Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Nascs),'') + Chr(13) + ;
		               '' + CrTmpCli.Codigos + Chr(13) + ;
		               '' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtnCons),'J - '+Dtoc(CrTmpCli.DtnCons),'') +  ;
		               '     ' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtCasas),'C - '+Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Dtcasas),'')
		        
		        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'Situação',.F.,.F.,"\imagens\geral_usuarios_60.jpg")

				If CrTmpScli.BlqMovs = 1 And Not crSigCdOpe.carnes = 2
					MessageBox( 'Movimentação Bloqueada pela Situacao da Conta...', 32, '' )
					this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
					this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
					this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
					This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If TprMvCab.ValVars < 0 And CrTmpScli.BlqDescs = 1
				lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
				_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcDsit) + chr(13) + ;
		               ' Desconto Bloqueado Pela Situação da Conta '
		        
		        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'SITUAÇÃO',.F.,.F.,"\VBMP\DESCONTO.ICO")
				this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
				this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
				this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
				This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf

	* Emite uma mensagem caso seja o primeiro lançamento deste grupo/conta

	If crSigCdOpe.Inibmlcs # 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value) And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)

		* Estoque
		
		If crSigCdOpe.estoqs = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.EstOrigs,1,2,4)
			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvEst','EmpGruEsts',ThisForm.pEmps + This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value + This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento de Estoque neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf

		* Conta Corrente
		* Se a Movimentação de Caixa for Saida e Contabiliza as Parcelas

		If ( crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 ) And InList(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
		   	Declare laCampo(2,2)
			laCampo(1,1) = 'Grupos'
			laCampo(1,2) = This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value 
			laCampo(2,1) = 'Contas'
			laCampo(2,2) = This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value 

			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvSlc',@laCampo)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento financeiro neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !IsEmpty(This.Value) And ( This.Value # This.peantvalue Or This.peantvalue="")
		If Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0 And Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
			Replace Cfis With ' ' in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
		ThisForm.CalcServico()
		llForcado = INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		ThisForm.CalcImposto( INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ),.f.,.f.,llForcado)
	EndIf
Else
	This.Value = ' '
	This.Refresh
	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem
		.Get_Conta.Value  = ' '
		.Get_dConta.Value = ' '
		.Get_Conta.Refresh
		.Get_dConta.refresh
	EndWith		
EndIf
Return(.t.)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
*** mena - 19/08/2014 checa cpf/cnpj ***
LOCAL cgc, cgc1
Cgc1  = This.Value
If Type([Cgc])<>[C]
	Cgc = []
EndIf 	
Cgc = Strt( Strt( Strt( Cgc1, ".", "" ), "-", "" ), "/", "" )
IF !EMPTY(cgc)
	If Len(Alltrim(Cgc))<>14
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 999.999.999-99" )
		If Not fValidarCPF(Cgc1)
			=MessageBox('CPF Inválido!!!', 16, ' ')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	Else
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 99.999.999/9999-99" )
		If Not fValidarCNPJ(Cgc1) 
			=MessageBox('CNPJ Inválido!!!', 16, ' ')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
ENDIF

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'PROCURAR' And IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value )
	Return .t.
EndIf
This.peantvalue = This.Value
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And !IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value ) And IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value )

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus

PROCEDURE LostFocus
If ThisForm.MudaLPrecos
	ThisForm.MudaLPrecos = .F.
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.peantvalue = ' '
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Valid()
EndIf

If ThisForm.MudaTabDescs
	ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = .F.
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.peantvalue = ' '
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Valid()
EndIf
ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.btnCadastros
* Classe: commandbutton (Base: commandbutton)
* Registro: 208
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Click
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Click
If Empty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
      =MessageBox([É Necessário o Preenchimento Da Conta!!!], 0+48, [Dados Incompletos]) 
      This.Parent.Get_Conta.SetFocus
      Return .f.
Else
      If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha, [INSERIR], [ALTERAR], [CONSULTAR])
            Do Form SIGCDCTA With 0, [SIGCDCTA], This.Parent.Get_conta.Value, .t., [], [], (ThisForm.pcEscolha = [CONSULTAR])
      EndIf
EndIf
* Fim **************************************************************************************

ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Bot_Consulta
* Classe: commandbutton (Base: commandbutton)
* Registro: 212
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Click
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Click

If IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value ) 
	MessageBox( 'É necessário o preenchimento da Conta...', 48 ) 
	This.Parent.Get_Conta.SetFocus
	Return 0

EndIf

If Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
	ThisForm.Enabled = .f.

	Do Form SigOpCgv With ThisForm, This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value

EndIf 

ENDPROC

ENDPROC

= fAcessoContab( Usuar, 'C', This.Value, This , '',This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value,ThisForm.poDataMgr,TprMvCab.Datas)

* Emite uma mensagem caso seja o primeiro lançamento deste grupo/conta

If crSigCdOpe.Inibmlcs # 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value) And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)

	* Estoque
	
	If crSigCdOpe.estoqs = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.EstDests,1,2,4)
		If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvEst','EmpGruEsts',ThisForm.pEmps + This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value + This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
			Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento de Estoque neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
		EndIf
	EndIf

	* Conta Corrente
	* Se a Movimentação de Caixa for Saida e Contabiliza as Parcelas

	If ( crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 ) And InList(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
	   	Declare laCampo(2,2)
		laCampo(1,1) = 'Grupos'
		laCampo(1,2) = This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value 
		laCampo(2,1) = 'Contas'
		laCampo(2,2) = This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value 

		If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvSlc',@laCampo)
			Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento financeiro neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
If Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs) And (crSigCdOpe.Vendes = 5) && Destino Com Acesso
	If Not ThisForm.CarregaVendedor()
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local lcGrupo, lordem, lcTpFat, lcGrupoCad, lnTpConsig

llMostra = ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj

If !Empty( This.Value ) and This.peantvalue <> this.value
	lcTpFat = ' '
	lnTpConsig = 0
	lcGrupo = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
	If !IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs)
		lcGrupoCad = crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs
		lordem  = .t.
	Else
		lcGrupoCad = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
	    lordem  = .f.
	EndIf

	If !fAcessoContas( Usuar, lcGrupo, 'C', This.Value, This, This.Parent.Get_DConta,lordem, lcGrupoCad, .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj)
		this.parent.Get_DConta.Value = ' '
		this.parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
		MessageBox( 'Acesso Negado...', 32, '' )
		this.Value = ' '
		Return 0
	Else
		lcCliente = This.Value
		If Empty(lcCliente)
			Return .t.
		EndIf
		If Not ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',lcCliente)
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 4)')
			Return .f.
		EndIf

		If not fChecarInativas( crTmpCli.IClis, ThisForm.poDataMgr )
			MessageBox('Conta Inativa ...',32,'' )
			This.Parent.get_conta.Value = ''
			This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
			This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value = '' 
			Return 0
		EndIf
		
		If not thisform.checaendr( crTmpCli.IClis )
			MessageBox('Endereço com restrição ...',32,'' )
			This.Parent.get_conta.Value = ''
			This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
			This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value = '' 
			Return 0
		EndIf

		If InList(crSigOpCdd.ChkConta,2,3)
			If not ThisForm.ChkDadosConta(crTmpCli.IClis,InList(crSigCdOpe.NFiscals,1,2))
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
		
		this.parent.get_conta.value  = CrTmpCli.IClis
		this.parent.get_dconta.value = CrTmpCli.RClis
		
		lcTpFat = CrTmpCli.CodTifs
		lnTpConsig = CrTmpCli.Consigs

		If IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value ) 
			this.parent.get_grupo.value  = CrTmpCli.Grupos
		EndIf
		If llMostra
			this.parent.get_cpf.value  = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
			this.parent.get_cpf.refresh
		EndIf 
		this.parent.get_conta.refresh
		this.parent.get_dconta.refresh
		this.parent.get_grupo.refresh
		If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
			With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
				If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 2, 5)
					If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.GrupoVens ) And IsEmpty( TprMvCab.GrVends )
						.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Grupo.Value = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens
					EndIf
					*** mena - 30/09/2015 - verifica flag se carrega vendedor do cliente
					If INT(VAL(SUBSTR(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 217,1)))=0 and ;
						!IsEmpty( crTmpCli.ContaVens ) And (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.Vends ) or This.Value # This.peantvalue  ) And ;
						( TprMvCab.GrVends = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens Or crSigOpCdd.nChkGrps = 1)
						.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Conta.Value = crtmpCli.ContaVens
					EndIf
					If Not InList( crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs, 1, 3, 4, 5,6,7,9,10,12)
						Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens,;
								TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens In TprMvCab
					EndIf
					If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 11
						If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
							Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens In TprMvCab
						EndIf
						Replace TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVen2s In TprMvCab
					EndIf
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 7
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.Iclis
					Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.Iclis in TprMvCab
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 10
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
					Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens in TprMvCab
					If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
						Replace GrResps With crTmpCli.GrupoVens in TprMvCab
					EndIf
				EndIf
				If (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.LPrecos ) Or This.Value # This.peantvalue ) And crSigCdOpe.Precops = 1 And crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 2
					_ListaPreco = CrTmpCli.LPrecos
					If ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) And TprMvCab.Lprecos <> crSigCdOpe.LprecoPads )
						_ListaPreco = crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads
						ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
					Else
						If Not ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) )
							ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
							.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
						EndIf
					EndIf
				EndIf

				If (TprMvCab.Tabds = crSigCdOpe.Tabdps Or This.Value <> This.peantvalue)
					If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 2 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabds) And Seek(CrTmpCli.TabDs, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
						Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
						ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.TabDs) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
												    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
												     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabds
					Else
						If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 2 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And Seek(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
							Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
							ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
													    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
													     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
							.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabd2s
						Else
							_Tabd = Iif(Not InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDescs, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 ), Spac( 10 ), crSigCdOpe.Tabdps)
							.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = _Tabd
						EndIf
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Refresh
					EndIf
				EndIf

				If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 2, 5)
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = ' '
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = ' '
					If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Vends)
						.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = crtmpCli.RClis
						.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = crtmpCli.Cpfs
					EndIf
				EndIf

				If crSigOpCdd.nRepOris = 1 && Comentei pois segundo o Cleber deve repetir mesmo se tiver preenchido a conta de origem - And IsEmpty( .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value )
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value = This.Value
				EndIf
								
			Endwith
		EndIf
	EndIf

	Select crSigCdOpe
	If ThisForm.pcEscolha # "PROCURAR"
		If This.Value # This.peantvalue  Or ( IsEmpty( This.peantvalue ) And !IsEmpty( This.Value ) )
			If crSigOpCdd.Consigs = 1 And lnTpConsig = 1
				Messagebox('Cliente Configurado para não Consignar. Utilização somente com Autorização!!',0+48,'ERRO')
				Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIBOPE', 'Libera Movimentação de Estoque', TprMvCab.Emps + ' '+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes)+' '+Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)) To _Retorno
				llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
				If !llOk
					MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
					Return .f.
				EndIf
				Replace LibCsgs With .t. in TprMvCab
			EndIf
			ThisForm.Alterafrete = .t.
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,6,7)
				If !ThisForm.CarItem()
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.expends, 2, 3 ) 
				If !ThisForm.MostraPends( TprMvCab.Grupods, TprMvCab.Contads )
					This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value =  ' '
					This.Parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
					This.Parent.Get_dconta.Value = ' '
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If !Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
				If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.Obs ) And crSigCdOpe.ObsDests = 1 And crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds <> 3
					MessageBox( CrTmpCli.Obs, 32, 'Observação da Conta ' + TprMvCab.Contads )
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Not ThisForm.ChkUniDp()
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf

		Select crSigCdOpe
		If crSigCdOpe.EdTpFats = 1 And IsEmpty(ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTpFats.Value)
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTpFats.Value = lcTpFat
		EndIf

		lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdFcx Where Emps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' And Grupos = ']+TprMvCab.Grupods+[' And Contas = ']+TprMvCab.Contads+[' Order By Codigos desc]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpFecha')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFecha 5)')
			Return .f.
		Else
			Select CrTmpFecha
			Go Top
			If Reccount() > 0 And Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas) < dtos(Ttod(CrTmpFecha.Datas)+crSigCdPac.ndFechas)
				MessageBox( 'Período bloqueado para a conta de ' + ThisForm.CfgTitDestino + '...', 32, '' )
				This.Value = This.peantvalue
				Return .f.
			EndIf
		EndIf
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCst','CrTmpScli','Codigos',CrTmpCli.Situas)
		
		If crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds = 3
			Do Form SigOpLrC With Thisform, crSigCdOpe.Dopes,2 To Ret
			If Not Ret
				Return 0
			EndIf
		Else
			If crSigCdOpe.ExibSits=1 And CrtmpScli.DispMovs = 1 And !IsEmpty(This.Value)
				lcQuery = [Select Descs ] + ;
						    [From SigCdClc ] + ;
						   [Where Grupos = '] + crTmpCli.Grupos + [' And ] + ;
						   		 [Codigos = '] + crTmpCli.Codigos + [']

				If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalClc]) < 1)
					=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalClc)])
					Return 0
				EndIf
				Go Top In LocalClc
				lcDCls = Iif(Eof([LocalClc]), [], [ - ] + Alltrim(LocalClc.Descs))

				lcDSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
				lcDSit = Iif(Empty(lcDSit), [], [ - ] + Alltrim(lcDSit))
				lcUlts = Iif(CrTmpCli.VultComps <= 0, [Não Há Compra Anterior Registrada], ;
						 Alltrim(Transform(CrTmpCli.VultComps,"@Z 999,999,999.99")) + ;
						 [ em ] + Iif(IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.UltComps), [], Dtoc(CrTmpCli.UltComps)))
				lcDtNP = Iif(IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.Nascs),   [Não Informada], Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Nascs))
				lcDtNM = Iif(IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtnCons), [Não Informada], Dtoc(CrTmpCli.DtnCons))
				lcDtNC = Iif(IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtCasas), [Não Informada], Dtoc(CrTmpCli.DtCasas))
				
				_Msg = [Situação: ] 	 + Alltrim(CrtmpCli.Situas)  + lcDSit + Chr(13) + ;
					   [Classificação: ] + Alltrim(CrtmpCli.Codigos) + lcDCls + Chr(13) + ;
					   Iif(CrTmpScli.UltCompra=1,[Última Compra: ] + lcUlts,'') + Chr(13)+;
		               [Nasc. Cliente: ] + lcDtNP + Chr(13) + ;
		               [Nasc. Cônjuge: ] + lcDtNM + Chr(13) + ;
		               [Dt. Casamento: ] + lcDtNC
		        
		        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'Situação',.F.,.F.,"\imagens\geral_usuarios_60.jpg")

				If CrTmpScli.BlqMovs = 1 And Not crSigCdOpe.carnes = 2
					MessageBox( 'Movimentação Bloqueada pela Situacao da Conta...', 32, '' )
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If TprMvCab.ValVars < 0 And CrTmpScli.BlqDescs = 1
				lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
				_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcDsit) + chr(13) + ;
		               ' Desconto Bloqueado Pela Situação da Conta '
		        
		        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'SITUAÇÃO',.F.,.F.,"\VBMP\DESCONTO.ICO")
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	*-- Rafael - 03/04/2024 - OpenCashBack
	=ThisForm.OpenCash(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
	

	* Emite uma mensagem caso seja o primeiro lançamento deste grupo/conta

	If crSigCdOpe.Inibmlcs # 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value) And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)

		* Estoque
		
		If crSigCdOpe.estoqs = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.EstDests,1,2,4)
			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvEst','EmpGruEsts',ThisForm.pEmps + This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value + This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento de Estoque neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf

		* Conta Corrente
		* Se a Movimentação de Caixa for Saida e Contabiliza as Parcelas

		If ( crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 ) And InList(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
		   	Declare laCampo(2,2)
			laCampo(1,1) = 'Grupos'
			laCampo(1,2) = This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value 
			laCampo(2,1) = 'Contas'
			laCampo(2,2) = This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value 

			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvSlc',@laCampo)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento financeiro neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !IsEmpty(This.Value) And ( This.Value # This.peantvalue Or This.peantvalue="")
		If Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0 And Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
			Replace Cfis With ' ' in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
		ThisForm.CalcServico()
		llForcado = INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		ThisForm.CalcImposto( INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ),.f.,.f.,llForcado)
	EndIf
Else
	If Empty( This.Value )
		this.parent.Get_DConta.Value = ' '
		this.parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
	Endif
EndIf

Return(.t.)
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'PROCURAR'
	Return .t.
EndIf
This.peantvalue = This.Value
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And !IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value ) &&And ThisForm.EditaDestino

ENDPROC

If Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs) And (crSigCdOpe.Vendes = 5) && Destino Com Acesso
	If Not ThisForm.CarregaVendedor()
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local lcGrupo, lordem, lcTpFat, lnTpCsg

llMostra = ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj

If !Empty( This.Value ) 

	lcTpFat = ' '
	lnTpCsg = 0

	If !IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs)
		lcGrupo = crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs
		lordem  = .t.
	Else
		lcGrupo = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
	    lordem  = .f.
	EndIf

	If (crSigOpCdd.LibcSens = 3) && Balcão
		loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext', ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdConn, 'SigCdCli', ;
							   'crListaRemota', 'Razaos', This.Value, 'Seleção', 1000, .F., ;
							   [ Razaos Like '%]+Alltrim(This.Value)+[%' ], .t., .t. )
		loLista.mAddColuna('Razaos',    '', 'Razão Social',.t., 'Razaos')
		If llMostra
			loLista.mAddColuna('Cpfs',      '', 'CPF/CNPJ',    .t., 'Cpfs')
		EndIf 
		loLista.mAddColuna('ContaVens', '', 'Vend.',       .t., 'ContaVens')
		loLista.mAddColuna('IClis',     '', 'Código',      .t., 'IClis')
		loLista.Show()
		If Lastkey() <> 27
			This.Parent.get_conta.Value  = CrListaRemota.IClis
			This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = CrListaRemota.RClis
			If llMostra
				This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value    = CrListaRemota.Cpfs
			EndIf 
		Else
			This.Parent.get_conta.Value  = ''
			This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
			This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value    = '' 
			Return 0		
		EndIf		
	Else
		lcFil = Iif(This.Parent.optBusca.Value = 1, [RCLIS], [RAZAOS])
		If !fAcessoContas( Usuar, lcGrupo, 'D', This.Value, This.Parent.Get_Conta, This, lOrdem,,ThisForm.poDataMgr,.t.,.f.,.f.,lcFil, .F., .F., ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj)
			this.parent.Get_Conta.Value = ' '
			this.parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
			MessageBox( 'Acesso Negado...', 32, '' )
			this.Value = ' '
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf

	lcCliente = this.parent.Get_Conta.Value
	If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',lcCliente)
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 5)')
		Return .f.
	EndIf

	If not fChecarInativas( crTmpCli.IClis, ThisForm.poDataMgr )
		MessageBox('Conta Inativa ...',32,'' )
		This.Parent.get_conta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value = '' 
		Return 0
	EndIf

	If not thisform.checaendr( crTmpCli.IClis )
		MessageBox('Endereço com restrição ...',32,'' )
		This.Parent.get_conta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value = '' 
		Return 0
	EndIf

	If InList(crSigOpCdd.ChkConta,2,3)
		If not ThisForm.ChkDadosConta(crTmpCli.IClis,InList(crSigCdOpe.NFiscals,1,2))
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf

	this.parent.get_conta.value  = CrtmpCli.Iclis
	this.parent.get_dconta.value = CrTmpCli.Rclis

	lcTpFat = CrTmpCli.CodTifs
	lnTpCsg = CrTmpCli.Consigs

	If IsEmpty( this.parent.get_grupo.value )
		this.parent.get_grupo.value  = CrTmpCli.Grupos
	EndIf
	this.parent.get_cpf.value  = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
	this.parent.get_cpf.refresh
	this.parent.get_conta.refresh
	this.parent.get_dconta.refresh
	this.parent.get_grupo.refresh
	If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
		With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 2, 5)
				If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.GrupoVens ) And IsEmpty( TprMvCab.GrVends )
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Grupo.Value = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens
				EndIf
				*** mena - 30/09/2015 - verifica flag se carrega vendedor do cliente
				If INT(VAL(SUBSTR(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 217,1)))=0 and ;
					!IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.ContaVens ) And (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.Vends ) or This.Value # This.peantvalue  ) And ;
					( TprMvCab.GrVends = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens Or crSigOpCdd.nchkGrps = 1)
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
				EndIf
				If Not InList( crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs, 1, 3, 4, 5,6,7,9,10,12)
					Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens,;
							TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens in TprMvCab
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 11
					If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
						Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens In TprMvCab
					EndIf
					Replace TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVen2s In TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 7
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.Iclis
				Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.Iclis in TprMvCab
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 10
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
				Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens in TprMvCab
				If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
					Replace GrResps With crTmpCli.GrupoVens in TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.LPrecos ) Or This.Value # This.peantvalue ) And crSigCdOpe.Precops = 1 And crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 2
				_ListaPreco = CrTmpCli.LPrecos
				If ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) And TprMvCab.Lprecos <> crSigCdOpe.LprecoPads )
					_ListaPreco = crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads
					ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
				Else
					If Not ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) )
						ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If (TprMvCab.Tabds = crSigCdOpe.Tabdps Or This.Value <> This.peantvalue)
				If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 2 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabds) And Seek(CrTmpCli.TabDs, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
					Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
					ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.TabDs) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
											    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
											     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabds
				Else
					If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 2 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And Seek(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
						Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
						ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
												    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
												     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabd2s
					Else
						_Tabd = Iif(Not InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDescs, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 ), Spac( 10 ), crSigCdOpe.Tabdps)
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = _Tabd
					EndIf
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Refresh
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 2, 5)
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = ' '
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = ' '
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Vends)
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = CrTmpCli.RClis
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
				EndIf
			EndIf

			If crSigOpCdd.nRepOris = 1 && Comentei pois segundo o Cleber deve repetir mesmo se tiver preenchido a conta de origem - And IsEmpty( .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value )
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value = .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.Value
			EndIf			
		Endwith
	EndIf

	Select crSigCdOpe
	If ThisForm.pcEscolha # "PROCURAR"
		If This.Value # This.peantvalue  Or ( IsEmpty( This.peantvalue ) And !IsEmpty( This.Value ) )
			If crSigOpCdd.Consigs = 1 And lnTpCsg = 1
				Messagebox('Conta Configurada para Não Consignar. Utilização somente com Autorização!!',0+48,'ERRO')
				Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIBOPE', 'Libera Movimentação de Estoque', TprMvCab.Emps + ' '+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes)+' '+Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)) To _Retorno
				llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
				If !llOk
					MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
					Return .f.
				EndIf
				Replace LibCsgs With .t. in TprMvCab
			EndIf

			ThisForm.Alterafrete = .t.
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,6,7)
				If !ThisForm.CarItem()
					Return .f.
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.expends, 2, 3 ) 
				If !ThisForm.MostraPends( TprMvCab.Grupods, TprMvCab.Contads )
					This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value = ' '
					This.Parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
					This.Parent.Get_dconta.Value = ' '
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.ContaDs) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
				If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.Obs ) And crSigCdOpe.ObsDests = 1 And crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds <> 3
					MessageBox( CrTmpCli.Obs, 32, 'Observação da Conta ' + TprMvCab.Contads )
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If Not ThisForm.ChkUniDp()
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf

		If crSigCdOpe.EdTpFats = 1 And IsEmpty(ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTpFats.Value)
			ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTpFats.Value = lcTpFat
		EndIf

		lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdFcx Where Emps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' And Grupos = ']+TprMvCab.Grupods+[' And Contas = ']+TprMvCab.Contads+[' Order By Codigos desc]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpFecha')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFecha 6)')
			Return .f.
		Else
			Select CrTmpFecha
			Go Top
			If Reccount() > 0 And Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas) < dtos(Ttod(CrTmpFecha.Datas)+crSigCdPac.ndFechas)
				MessageBox( 'Período bloqueado para a conta ' + ThisForm.CfgTitDestino + '...', 32, '' )
				This.Value = This.peantvalue
				Return .F.
			EndIf
		EndIf
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
		=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCst','CrTmpScli','Codigos',CrTmpCli.Situas)

		If crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds = 3
			Do Form SigOpLrC With Thisform, crSigCdOpe.Dopes,2 To Ret
			If Not Ret
				Return 0
			EndIf
		Else
			If crSigCdOpe.ExibSits=1 And CrtmpScli.DispMovs = 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Value)
				lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
				_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcDsit) + chr(13) + ;
		               '' + Transform(CrTmpCli.VultComps,"@Z 999,999,999.99")+ ' / ' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.UltComps),Dtoc(CrTmpCli.UltComps),'') + Chr(13)+;
		               '' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.Nascs),Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Nascs),'') + Chr(13) + ;
		               '' + CrTmpCli.Codigos + Chr(13) + ;
		               '' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtnCons),'J - '+Dtoc(CrTmpCli.DtnCons),'') + ;
		               '     ' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtCasas),'C - '+Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Dtcasas),'')
		        
		        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'Situação',.F.,.F.,"\imagens\geral_usuarios_60.jpg")

				If CrTmpScli.BlqMovs = 1 And Not crSigCdOpe.carnes = 2
					MessageBox( 'Movimentação Bloqueada pela Situacao da Conta...', 32, '' )
					Return 0
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If TprMvCab.ValVars < 0 And CrTmpScli.BlqDescs = 1
				lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
				_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcdsit) + chr(13) + ;
		               ' Desconto Bloqueado Pela Situação da Conta '
		        
		        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'SITUAÇÃO',.F.,.F.,"\VBMP\DESCONTO.ICO")
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	
	*-- Rafael - 03/04/2024 - OpenCashBack
	lcRetCash=ThisForm.OpenCash(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
	
	* Emite uma mensagem caso seja o primeiro lançamento deste grupo/conta

	If crSigCdOpe.Inibmlcs # 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value) And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)

		* Estoque
		
		If crSigCdOpe.estoqs = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.EstDests,1,2,4)
			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvEst','EmpGruEsts',ThisForm.pEmps + This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value + This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento de Estoque neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf

		* Conta Corrente
		* Se a Movimentação de Caixa for Saida e Contabiliza as Parcelas

		If ( crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 ) And InList(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
		   	Declare laCampo(2,2)
			laCampo(1,1) = 'Grupos'
			laCampo(1,2) = This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value 
			laCampo(2,1) = 'Contas'
			laCampo(2,2) = This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value 

			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvSlc',@laCampo)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento financeiro neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !IsEmpty(This.Value) And ( This.Value # This.peantvalue Or This.peantvalue="")
		If Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0 And Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
			Replace Cfis With ' ' in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf
		ThisForm.CalcServico()
		llForcado = INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
		ThisForm.CalcImposto( INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ),.f.,.f.,llForcado)
	EndIf
Else
	this.parent.Get_Conta.Value = ' '
	this.parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
EndIf

return(.t.)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'PROCURAR' And IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value )
	Return .t.
EndIf
This.peantvalue = This.Value
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And !IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value ) And ;
	IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value ) And IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Cpf.Value )
ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_cpf
* Classe: fwget (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 216

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE GotFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE GotFocus
If crSigCdOpe.Cadclis = 1 And InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
	*** mena 19/08/2014 - verifica o que pode ser digitado e mascara conforme o caso ***
	LOCAL lcGrupo, lnCpffix
	lcGrupo    = This.Parent.get_grupo.Value
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdGcr','crTmpGcr','Codigos',lcGrupo)
	lnCpffix=Int(Val(Substr(crTmpGcr.CfgCdGcr, 8, 1)))
	this.InputMask = IIF(lnCpffix = 1, '999.999.999-99', IIF(lnCpffix = 2, '99.999.999/9999-99',''))
ENDIF

RETURN


ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
Local lcTpFat, lcCadGrupo, lcGruCadDs, lnTpCsg

lcTpFat = ' '
Cgc  = This.Value
Cgc1 = ' '
RetCli = ' '
lnTpCsg = 0
llMostra = ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj

=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigOpCdc','LocalDcOpe','dopes',_Dope,[FixCadOs,FixCadDs])

lcGruCadDs = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs), crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs, ' ' )

If !Empty(This.Value)
	Cgc = Strt( Strt( Strt( Cgc, ".", "" ), "-", "" ), "/", "" )
	If Len(Alltrim(Cgc))<>14
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 999.999.999-99" )
	Else
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 99.999.999/9999-99" )
	EndIf
	
	lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdCli Where Cpfs = ?Cgc1 ]+;
			Iif(LocalDcOpe.FixCadDs = 1 And Not Empty(lcGruCadDs),[And Grupos = ']+lcGruCadDs+['],[ ])

	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpCli')
	
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 6)')
		This.Value = ' '
		Return 0
	EndIf

	This.Value = Cgc1
	
	Select CrTmpCli
	Go Top
	If Reccount() = 0 Or Cgc1 = "999.999.999-99" or Cgc1 = "99.999.999/9999-99" 
		If crSigCdOpe.Cadclis = 2 And InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
			If crSigCdOpe.CadCliAuts = 1 Or ;
				(crSigCdOpe.CadCliAuts = 3 And MessageBox('Conta Não Cadastrada,  Deseja Cadastrar somente CPF/CNPJ?',4+32+256,' ') = 6 )

				If Len(Alltrim(Cgc))<>14
					If Not fValidarCPF(Cgc1)
						=MessageBox('CPF Inválido!!!', 16, '')
						This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
						This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
						Return 0
					EndIf
				Else
					If Not fValidarCNPJ(Cgc1) 
						=MessageBox('CGC/CNPJ Inválido!!!', 16, '')
						This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
						This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
						Return 0
					EndIf
				EndIf
				lcCadGrupo = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs), crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs, This.Parent.get_grupo.Value)
				RetCli     = ThisForm.mCadAutomatico(lcCadGrupo, This.Value,(crSigCdOpe.CadCliAuts = 3))
			Else
				If MessageBox('Conta não cadastrada, Deseja cadastrar ',4 + 32 + 256,'')=6
					Select CrTmpCli
					If Cgc1 = "999.999.999-99" or Cgc1 = "99.999.999/9999-99" 
						this.value = ' '
					EndIf
					lcCadGrupo = Iif(Not IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs), crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs, This.Parent.get_grupo.Value)

					*** Mena - 10/10/2013 - substituida a chamada para inclusao automatica pelo CPF no cadastro de contas
*!*					Do Form SigCdCli with this.value, lcCadGrupo, .f., .f., .f., '1', '1' To RetCli
					lcCli = ''
					Do Form SIGCDCTA With 0,[SIGCDCTA],lcCli,.T.,Cgc1,lcCadGrupo 	
					************************************************************
				EndIf
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		RetCli = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
	EndIf

	If Empty(RetCli) And Reccount('CrTmpCli') = 0
		If ( LocalDcOpe.FixCadDs = 1 And Not Empty(lcGruCadDs) )
			Declare laGrupo[1,2]
			laGrupo[1,1] = 'Grupos'
			laGrupo[1,2] = lcGruCadDs
			m.loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext',ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdconn,'SigCdCli','crTmpcli','cpfs',This.Value,'Clientes',1000) &&,'Cpfs',@laGrupo
		Else
			m.loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext',ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdconn,'SigCdCli','crTmpcli','cpfs',This.Value,'Clientes',1000)
		EndIf
		If .Not.m.loLista.plAchouRegistro
			If llMostra
				m.loLista.mAddColuna('Cpfs' ,'', 'C.P.F. / C.N.P.J.' )
			EndIf 
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Rclis',Replicate('x',50), 'Nome' )
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Iclis','', 'Código' )
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Grupos','', 'Grupo' )
			m.loLista.mAddColuna('Situas','xxxxxxxx','Situação')
			m.loLista.Show()
		EndIf
	Else
		lcQuery = [Select * From SigCdCli Where ]+Iif(Len(RetCli)=10,[ Iclis = ],[ Cpfs = ])+[ ?RetCli ]
		lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery,'CrTmpCli')
		If lnErro < 1
			MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpCli 7)')
			This.parent.get_cpf.Value = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Select CrTmpCli
	Go Top
	lfan = crTmpCli.Rclis
	lcod = crTmpCli.Iclis
	lnTpCsg = CrTmpCli.Consigs
	
	If not fChecarInativas( crTmpCli.IClis, ThisForm.poDataMgr )
		MessageBox('Conta Inativa ...',32,'' )
		This.Parent.get_conta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_dConta.Value = ''
		This.Parent.get_Cpf.Value = '' 
		This.SetFocus 
		Return 0
	EndIf
	
	If InList(crSigOpCdd.ChkConta,2,3)
		If not ThisForm.ChkDadosConta(crTmpCli.IClis,InList(crSigCdOpe.NFiscals,1,2))
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	this.parent.get_conta.value  = CrTmpCli.Iclis
	this.parent.get_dconta.value = CrTmpCli.Rclis

	If Not Empty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
		lcGrupo = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
		If !IsEmpty(crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs)
			lcGrupoCad = crSigCdOpe.GruCadDs
			lordem  = .t.
		Else
			lcGrupoCad = This.Parent.Get_grupo.Value
		    lordem  = .f.
		EndIf
		If !fAcessoContas( Usuar, lcGrupo, 'C', This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value, This.Parent.Get_Conta, This.Parent.Get_DConta, .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., .F., ThisForm.lMostraCpfCnpj ) &&,lordem, lcGrupoCad )
			MessageBox( 'Acesso Negado', 48, '' )
			This.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
			This.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
	
	this.parent.get_conta.value  = CrTmpCli.Iclis
	this.parent.get_dconta.value = CrTmpCli.Rclis
	lcTpFat = CrTmpCli.CodTifs
	If IsEmpty( this.parent.get_grupo.value )
		this.parent.get_grupo.value = CrTmpCli.Grupos
	EndIf
	this.parent.get_cpf.value    = CrTmpCli.Cpfs

	this.parent.get_conta.refresh
	this.parent.get_dconta.refresh
	this.parent.get_grupo.refresh
	this.parent.get_cpf.refresh

	If InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
		With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 2, 5)
				If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.GrupoVens ) And IsEmpty( TprMvCab.GrVends )
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Grupo.Value = CrTmpCli.GrupoVens
				EndIf
				*** mena - 30/09/2015 - verifica flag se carrega vendedor do cliente
				If INT(VAL(SUBSTR(crSigOpCdd.ConfigGers, 217,1)))=0 and ;
					!IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.ContaVens ) And (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.Vends ) or This.Value # This.peantvalue   ) And ;
					( TprMvCab.GrVends = CrtmpCli.GrupoVens Or crSigOpCdd.nchkGrps = 1)
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
				EndIf
				If Not InList( crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs, 1, 3, 4, 5,6,7,9,10,12 )
					Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens,;
							TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens In TprMvCab
				EndIf
				If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 11
					If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
						Replace TprMvCab.GrResps With CrTmpCli.GrupoVens In TprMvCab
					EndIf
					Replace TprMvCab.Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVen2s In TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 7
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.Iclis
				Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.Iclis in TprMvCab
			EndIf
			If crSigCdOpe.ComisDivs = 10
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Responsavel.Get_conta.Value = CrTmpCli.ContaVens
				Replace Resps With CrTmpCli.ContaVens in TprMvCab
				If Empty(TprMvCab.GrResps)
					Replace GrResps With crTmpCli.GrupoVens in TprMvCab
				EndIf
			EndIf
			If (IsEmpty( TprMvCab.LPrecos ) Or This.Value # This.peantvalue ) And crSigCdOpe.Precops = 1 And crSigCdOpe.LPrecos = 2
				_ListaPreco = CrTmpCli.LPrecos
				If ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(TprMvCab.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) And TprMvCab.Lprecos <> crSigCdOpe.LprecoPads )
					_ListaPreco = crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads
					ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
				Else
					If Not ( Empty(CrTmpCli.LPrecos) And Not Empty(crSigCdOpe.LPrecoPads) )
						ThisForm.MudaLprecos  = (TprMvCab.lPrecos # _ListaPreco) 
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getLstPrecos.Value = _ListaPreco
					EndIf
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If (TprMvCab.Tabds = crSigCdOpe.Tabdps Or This.Value <> This.peantvalue)
				If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 2 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabds) And Seek(CrTmpCli.TabDs, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
					Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
					ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.TabDs) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
											    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
											     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabds
				Else
					If (crSigCdOpe.TabDescs = 2 And Not Empty(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And Seek(CrTmpCli.Tabd2s, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos'))
						Goto Top In crTpmMvItn
						ThisForm.MudaTabDescs = (TprMvCab.TabDs # CrTmpCli.Tabd2s) And (Eof('crTpmMvItn') Or ;
												    (Not Eof('crTpmMvItn') And Not IsEmpty(crTpmMvItn.Cpros) And ;
												     Not InList( crSigCdOpe.EPrecos, 1, 3 ) ))
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = CrTmpCli.Tabd2s
					Else
						_Tabd = Iif(Not InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDescs, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 ), Spac( 10 ), crSigCdOpe.Tabdps)
						.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Value = _Tabd
					EndIf
					.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes.Refresh
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If InList(crSigCdOpe.Vendes, 2, 5)
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = ' '
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = ' '
				If ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Vends)
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_dConta.Value = CrTmpCli.RClis
					.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Vendedor.Get_Cpf.Value = CrTmpCli.Cpfs
				EndIf
			EndIf
			
			If crSigOpCdd.nRepOris = 1 And IsEmpty( .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value )
				.pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Origem.Get_Conta.Value = .pgfPrincipal.pgContas.Destino.Get_Conta.Value
			EndIf			
		EndWith		
	EndIf
EndIf

If ThisForm.pcEscolha # "PROCURAR" And !Empty(This.Value)
	Select crSigCdOpe
	If This.Value # This.peantvalue   Or ( IsEmpty( This.peantvalue ) And !IsEmpty( This.Value ) )
		If crSigOpCdd.Consigs = 1 And lnTpCsg = 1
			Messagebox('Conta Configurada para Não Consignar. Utilização somente com Autorização!!',0+48,'ERRO')
			Do Form SigOpSen With 'LIBOPE', 'Libera Movimentação de Estoque', TprMvCab.Emps + ' '+Alltrim(TprMvCab.Dopes)+' '+Alltrim(Str(TprMvCab.Numes,6)) To _Retorno
			llOk = ( Left( _Retorno, 1 ) = "*" )
			If !llOk
				MessageBox('Autorização não Confirmada!!',0+48,'')
				Return .f.
			EndIf
			Replace LibCsgs With .t. in TprMvCab
		EndIf

		ThisForm.Alterafrete = .t.
		If InList(crSigCdOpe.ItAutos,6,7)
			If !ThisForm.CarItem()
				this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
				this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
				this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
				This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Inlist( crSigCdOpe.expends, 2, 3 ) 
			If !ThisForm.MostraPends( TprMvCab.Grupods, TprMvCab.Contads )
				This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value = ' '
				This.Parent.Get_cpf.Value = ' '
				This.Parent.Get_dconta.Value = ' '
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Not IsEmpty(TprMvCab.ContaDs) And ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
			If !IsEmpty( CrTmpCli.Obs ) And crSigCdOpe.ObsDests = 1 and crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds <> 3
				MessageBox( CrTmpCli.Obs, 32, 'Observação da Conta ' + TprMvCab.Contads )
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If Not ThisForm.ChkUniDp()
			this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
			this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
			this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf

	If crSigCdOpe.EdTpFats = 1 And IsEmpty(ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTpFats.Value)
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTpFats.Value = lcTpFat
	EndIf

	lcWhere = [Select * From SigCdFcx Where Emps = ']+TprMvCab.Emps+[' And Grupos = ']+TprMvCab.Grupods+[' And Contas = ']+TprMvCab.Contads+[' Order By Codigos desc]
	lnErro = ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcWhere,'CrTmpFecha')
	If lnErro < 1
		MessageBox('Favor reinicializar o processo.',16,'Falha na Conexão (CrTmpFecha 7)')
		this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
		this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
		this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
		This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
		Return 0
	Else
		Select CrTmpFecha
		Go Top
		If Reccount() > 0 And Dtos(TprMvCab.Datas) < dtos(Ttod(CrTmpFecha.Datas)+crSigCdPac.ndFechas)
			MessageBox( 'Período bloqueado para a conta ' + ThisForm.CfgTitDestino + '...', 32, '' )
			this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
			this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
			this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdCli','CrTmpCli','Iclis',TprMvCab.Contads)
	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.Cursorquery('SigCdCst','CrTmpScli','Codigos',CrTmpCli.Situas)

	If crSigCdOpe.DemoCreds = 3
		Do Form SigOpLrC With Thisform, crSigCdOpe.Dopes,2 To Ret
		If Not Ret
			Return 0
		EndIf
	Else
		If crSigCdOpe.ExibSits=1 And CrtmpScli.DispMovs = 1 And ! IsEmpty(This.Value)
			lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
			_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcDsit) + chr(13) + ;
	               '' + Iif(CrTmpScli.UltCompra=1,Transform(CrTmpCli.VultComps,"@Z 999,999,999.99") + ' / ' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.UltComps),Dtoc(CrTmpCli.UltComps),''),'') + Chr(13)+;
	               '' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.Nascs),Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Nascs),'') + Chr(13) + ;
	               '' + CrTmpCli.Codigos + Chr(13) + ;
	               '' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtnCons),'J - '+Dtoc(CrTmpCli.DtnCons),'') + ;
	               '     ' + Iif(!IsEmpty(CrTmpCli.DtCasas),'C - '+Dtoc(CrTmpCli.Dtcasas),'')
	        
	        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'Situação',.F.,.F.,"\imagens\geral_usuarios_60.jpg")

			If CrTmpScli.BlqMovs = 1 And Not crSigCdOpe.carnes = 2
				MessageBox( 'Movimentação Bloqueada pela Situacao da Conta...', 32, '' )
				this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
				this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
				this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
				This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
				Return 0
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If TprMvCab.ValVars < 0 And CrTmpScli.BlqDescs = 1
			lcdSit = Iif(Empty(CrTmpScli.Descr2s),CrTmpScli.Descrs,CrTmpScli.Descr2s)
			_Msg = '' + CrtmpCli.Situas + ' - ' + Alltrim(lcDsit) + chr(13) + ;
	               ' Desconto Bloqueado Pela Situação da Conta '
	        
	        =fMensagemFixa(_msg, 48, 'SITUAÇÃO',.F.,.F.,"\VBMP\DESCONTO.ICO")
			this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
			this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
			this.parent.get_cpf.value    = ' '
			This.parent.get_cpf.SetFocus
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

*-- Rafael - 03/04/2024 - OpenCashBack
=ThisForm.OpenCash(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)

* Emite uma mensagem caso seja o primeiro lançamento deste grupo/conta

If ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value) And ! IsEmpty(This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)

	If crSigCdOpe.Inibmlcs # 1

		* Estoque
		
		If crSigCdOpe.estoqs = 1 And Inlist(crSigCdOpe.EstDests,1,2,4)
			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvEst','EmpGruEsts',ThisForm.pEmps + This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value + This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento de Estoque neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf

		* Conta Corrente
		* Se a Movimentação de Caixa for Saida e Contabiliza as Parcelas

		If ( crSigCdOpe.COpers = 1 Or crSigCdOpe.ctipos = 2 ) And InList(crSigCdOpe.ParContas,1,3)
		   	Declare laCampo(2,2)
			laCampo(1,1) = 'Grupos'
			laCampo(1,2) = This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value 
			laCampo(2,1) = 'Contas'
			laCampo(2,2) = This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value 

			If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.ChkRegister('SigMvSlc',@laCampo)
				Messagebox('Atenção !!! Primeiro Lançamento financeiro neste Grupo/Conta',0+48,'')
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
Else
	this.parent.get_conta.value  = ' '
	this.parent.get_dconta.value = ' '
EndIf
If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !IsEmpty(This.Value) And ( This.Value # This.peantvalue Or This.peantvalue="")
	If Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0 And Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
		Replace Cfis With ' ' in crSigMvNfi
	EndIf
	ThisForm.CalcServico()
	llForcado = INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' )
	ThisForm.CalcImposto( INLIST(ThisForm.pcEscolha , 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ),.f.,.f.,llForcado)
EndIf

If Not Empty(TprMvCab.ContaDs) And (crSigCdOpe.Vendes = 5) && Destino Com Acesso
	If Not ThisForm.CarregaVendedor()
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

return(.t.)

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
*** mena - 19/08/2014 checa cpf/cnpj ***
LOCAL cgc, cgc1
Cgc  = This.Value
If Type([Cgc])<>[C]
	Cgc = []
EndIf 	
Cgc = Strt( Strt( Strt( Cgc, ".", "" ), "-", "" ), "/", "" )
IF !EMPTY(cgc)
	If Len(Alltrim(Cgc))<>14
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 999.999.999-99" )
		If Not fValidarCPF(Cgc1)
			=MessageBox('CPF Inválido!!!', 16, ' ')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	Else
		Cgc1 = TransForm( Cgc, "@R 99.999.999/9999-99" )
		If Not fValidarCNPJ(Cgc1) 
			=MessageBox('CNPJ Inválido!!!', 16, ' ')
			Return 0
		EndIf
	EndIf
ENDIF
This.Value = Cgc1
this.Refresh

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
If ThisForm.pcEscolha = 'PROCURAR' And IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value )
	Return .t.
EndIf
This.peantvalue = This.Value
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, "INSERIR", "ALTERAR" ) And !IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Grupo.Value ) And IsEmpty( This.Parent.Get_Conta.Value )

ENDPROC

================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GradeMobra.Moeda.Text1
* Classe: textbox (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 233
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
If IsEmpty( This.Value )
	If crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 1
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Pagto.SetFocus
	EndIf
	If InList(crSigCdOpe.DigItens,1,3,4,5,8)
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.SetFocus
	EndIf
	This.Refresh
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local lnRecno, LoLista

If !Empty( This.Value ) And This.Value # _OldMoeda
	Select TmpTotal
	Set Order to Moeds
	lnRecno = Recno()
	If Seek( This.Value ) And Recno() # lnRecno
		MessageBox( 'Moeda já lançada...', 48, '' )
		Go lnRecno
		Set Order to 
		This.Value = _Oldmoeda
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	Go lnRecno
	Set Order to 
	lcMoe = This.Value

	loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext', ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdConn, 'SigCdMoe', ;
						   'crListaRemota', 'Cmoes', This.Value, 'Seleção', .t.)

	If Not loLista.plAchouRegistro
		loLista.mAddColuna('Cmoes', '', 'Moe',.t.,'Cmoes')
		loLista.mAddColuna('Dmoes', '', 'Nome',.t.,'Dmoes')
		loLista.Show()
	EndIf
	
	This.Value = crListaRemota.Cmoes
	Use In crListaRemota

Else
	If Empty( This.Value )
		Delete
		Skip
		If Eof()
			Append Blank
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf
Return
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE When
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE When
Public _OldMoeda
_OldMoeda = TmpTotal.Moeds
If ThisForm.pcEscolha $ 'INSERIR/ALTERAR'
	If crSigCdOpe.confes=1
		return(.f.)
	else
		If crSigCdOpe.valpres=1
			return(.t.)
		else
			return(.f.)
		EndIf
	EndIf
else
	return .f.
EndIf

ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GradeMobra.Valor.Text1
* Classe: textbox (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 235
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
If This.Value = 0
	Return
EndIf

Coef   = TmpTotal.Coefs
Teor   = TmpTotal.Teors
Calcv1 = TmpTotal.Qtdes * Iif(Coef>0,Coef,1)
Calcv2 = TmpTotal.Qtdes * Iif(Teor>0,Teor,1)

Select TmpTotal
Replace Valtots With Calcv2
Replace MObras  With (Calcv1 - Calcv2)

ThisForm.cMobras

Return .T.

ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------

		crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And crSigCdOpe.ValPres = 1 )
ENDPROC


================================================================================

PROCEDURE Valid
If This.Value <= 0 And !IsEmpty(TmpTotal.Qtdes)
	MessageBox( 'Valor Invalido !', 32, '' )
	Return 0
EndIf

Coef = TmpTotal.Coefs
Teor = TmpTotal.Teors

Calcv2 = TmpTotal.Qtdes * Iif(Teor>0,Teor,1)

ThisForm.cMobras

ENDPROC

PROCEDURE Valid
If This.Value <= 0 And !IsEmpty(TmpTotal.Qtdes)
	MessageBox( 'Valor Invalido !', 32, '' )
	Return 0

Coef = TmpTotal.Coefs
Teor = TmpTotal.Teors

Calcv2 = TmpTotal.Qtdes * Iif(Teor>0,Teor,1)

Replace MObras  With (Calcv1 - Calcv2)

ThisForm.cMobras

Select TmpTotal
Keyboard "{DnArrow}"

ENDPROC

Local loLista, llForcado
If !Empty(This.Value)

						   'crListaRemota', 'Codigos', This.Value, 'Seleção', .T.)
	If Not loLista.plAchouRegistro

	This.Value = crListaRemota.Codigos

	Use In crListaRemota

		MessageBox('Tipo de Faturamento é Obrigatório!!!',0+16,'')

		=ThisForm.ValidaEstoque(.f.)
	EndIf

	Select crTpmMvItn
	Store 1 to Cotacao, Cotcv, Cotacaof

		If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
			Loop
		EndIf

				AltImpost With .f.,;

			ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
		EndIf
	Endscan
	ThisForm.TotIte = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3)
		_valinis = ThisForm.TotPres - TprMvCab.valdevs
	Else
		_valinis = ThisForm.Totite - TprMvCab.valdevs
	EndIf
	lnIpi = 0
	Select crSigMvNfi
	Go Top
	If !crSigMvNfi.Cancelas
		lnIpi = crSigMvNfi.ValIpis
	EndIf

	lnTran = Iif(crSigOpCdc.nChkVsts = 1, TprMvCab.ValTrans, 0)
	_valos = _valinis + TprMvCab.valvars + TprMvCab.ValEncs + TprMvCab.ValServs + lnIpi + lnTran

			TprMvCab.Valinis with _valinis in TprMvCab
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos.Refresh			


	*** Mena - 08/08/2014 - se mudar tipo faturamento recalcula impostos ***
	If InList( crSigCdOpe.NFiscals, 1, 2 ) And !IsEmpty(This.Value) And ( This.Value # This.peantvalue)
		If Reccount('crSigMvNfi') > 0 And Not Empty(crSigMvNfi.CFis)
			Replace Cfis With ' ' in crSigMvNfi
		EndIf

		ThisForm.CalcImposto(llForcado,.f.,.f.,llForcado)
	EndIf
	*************************************************************************

EndIf
Wait Clear

PROCEDURE InteractiveChange
*!*	local total

*!*	total=ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValIns.value
*!*	If this.value<>0 And not IsEmpty(this.value)
*!*		with ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos
*!*			.value=round(total+(total*this.value)/100,2)
*!*			.refresh
*!*		endwith
*!*		with ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValVrs
*!*			.value=round((total*this.value)/100,2)
*!*			.refresh
*!*		endwith
*!*	else
*!*		with ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos
*!*			.value=total
*!*			.refresh
*!*		endwith
*!*		with ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValVrs
*!*			.value=0
*!*			.refresh
*!*		endwith
*!*	EndIf

local total

total=ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValIns.value
If this.value<>0 And not IsEmpty(this.value)
	with ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValVrs
		.value=round((total*this.value)/100,2)
		.refresh
	endwith
Else
	with ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValVrs
		.value=0
		.refresh
	endwith
EndIf	

thisform.atuatot(.t.)
ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GradeTotal.Moeda.Text1
* Classe: textbox (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 267
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
If IsEmpty( This.Value )
	If crSigCdOpe.Parcs = 1
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.Pagto.SetFocus
	EndIf
	If InList(crSigCdOpe.DigItens,1,3,4,5,8)
		ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.btnItens.SetFocus
	EndIf
	ThisForm.Refresh
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
Local lnRecno, lcMoe, LoLista

lcMoe = This.Value

If Not Empty( This.Value ) And This.Value # _OldMoeda

	loLista = CreateObject('fwbuscaext', ThisForm.poDataMgr.pnIdConn, 'SigCdMoe', ;
						   'crListaRemota', 'Cmoes', This.Value, 'Seleção', .t.)

	If Not loLista.plAchouRegistro
		loLista.mAddColuna('Cmoes', '', 'Moe',.t.,'Cmoes')
		loLista.mAddColuna('Dmoes','','Nome',.t.,'Dmoes')
		loLista.Show()
	EndIf
	
	This.Value = crListaRemota.Cmoes
	Use In crListaRemota

	lcMoe = This.Value
	This.Refresh

	=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdMoe','crSigCdMoe','Cmoes',lcMoe)

	Select Count(1) as nRegs, a.Moeds ;
	  From TmpTotal a ;
	 Where Moeds = lcMoe ;
	 Group By a.Moeds ;
	  Into Cursor csVerMoeda
	
	Select csVerMoeda
	If Not Eof() And csVerMoeda.nRegs > 1
		MessageBox('Moeda já lançada !!!',0+48,'')
		This.Value = _OldMoeda
		Return .F.
	EndIf
	Select TmpTotal
Else
	If IsEmpty( This.Value )
		Delete
		Select RecNo() As nRecNo ;
			From TmpTotal Where IsEmpty(Moeds) ;
			Into Cursor csVerMoeda
		Select csVerMoeda
		Goto Top
		If Eof()
			Select TmpTotal
			Append Blank
		Else
			Select TmpTotal
			Goto (csVerMoeda.nRecNo)
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

Select TmpTotal
ENDPROC

PROCEDURE When
Public _OldMoeda
_OldMoeda = This.Value

		crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And crSigCdOpe.ValPres = 1 )

ENDPROC


================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.GradeTotal.Valor.Text1
* Classe: textbox (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 269
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE LostFocus
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE LostFocus
If crSigCdOpe.ValPres = 3 And InList(ThisForm.pcEscolha,'INSERIR','ALTERAR')
	With ThisForm.Pagina.Dados
		Do Case
			Case .btnItens.Visible
				.btnItens.SetFocus
				
			Case .Cotacao.Visible
				.Cotacao.SetFocus
			
			Case .NotaFiscal.Visible
				.NotaFiscal.SetFocus
				
			Case .Pagto.Visible
				.Pagto.SetFocus
				
			Case .Dados.Visible
				.Dados.SetFocus
				
			Case .Boleto.Visible
				.Boleto.Visible
				
			Case .Documento.Visible
				.Documento.SetFocus
				
			OtherWise
				.Grupo_Salva.Salva.SetFocus
				
		EndCase
	EndWith
EndIf
ENDPROC

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
If This.Value = 0 And _OldValor = 0 
	Return
EndIf
Select TmpTotal
If !Eof()
	_Rec = Recno()
Else
	_Rec = 0
EndIf
_MoeOpe = Iif( IsEmpty( crSigCdOpe.Cmoes ), crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, ;
		  Iif( crSigCdOpe.Valpres=1, crSigCdPam.MoedaPs, crSigCdOpe.CMoes ) )
m.valos = 0
Scan
	If TmpTotal.Moeds # _MoeOpe
		Cotacao = ThisForm.Cotacao(TmpTotal.Moeds)
		m.Valos = Round( m.Valos + ( TmpTotal.ValTots * Cotacao ), 2 )
	Else
		m.Valos = m.Valos + TmpTotal.ValTots
	EndIf
Endscan
ThisForm.TotPres = m.Valos
ThisForm.AtuaTot()
With ThisForm.pagina.dados
	.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos.Refresh
	.Refresh
EndWith

Select TmpTotal
If _Rec # 0
	Go _Rec
Else
	Go top
EndIf

If ValItens # ValTots And ValItens > 0 And !Eof()
	If ValItens > ValTots
		 _Difer = ValItens - ValTots
		 _Porc  = round(( _Difer / ValItens)*100,2)
		 _Tipo  = Iif( TmpTotal.nSinals >= 0, "D", "A" )
	Else
		 _Difer = ValTots - ValItens
		 _Porc  = round(( _Difer / ValItens)*100,2)
		 _Tipo  = Iif( TmpTotal.nSinals >=0, "A", "D" )
	EndIf
	Replace ValDifs  With _Difer
	Replace PorcDifs With _Porc
	Replace Tipos    With _Tipo
Else
	If !Eof()
		If ValItens = 0
			Replace ValDifs  With ValTots
			Replace PorcDifs With 0
			Replace Tipos    With "A"
		Else
			Replace ValDifs  With 0
			Replace PorcDifs With 0
			Replace Tipos    With " "
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

================================================================================
* OBJETO: SIGMVCAB.pagina.dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getTabDes
* Classe: fwget (Base: textbox)
* Registro: 288
================================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
* PROCEDURE Valid
------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Valid
=ThisForm.poDataMgr.cursorquery('SigCdOpe','crSigCdOpe','dopes',_Dope)
If !IsEmpty( This.Value )
	If Not Seek( This.Value, 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos' )
		loBrowse = CreateObject( 'fwbuscasel', 'csSigOpTdz', 'Codigos', This.Value, 'Cadastro de Tabelas' )
		loBrowse.AddColuna( 'Codigos', '', 'Código', .t., 'Codigos' )
		loBrowse.AddColuna( 'Descrs', '', 'Descrição' )
		loBrowse.AddColuna( 'Obss', '', 'Observação' )
		loBrowse.Show
		This.Value = csSigOpTdz.Codigos
	EndIf
	Replace TprMvCab.Tabds With This.Value in TprMvCab
	If csSigOpTdz.ChkAcTb = 1 And CsSigOpTdz.Descos <> 0
		If Not ThisForm.Chklimite(0,0,0,CsSigOpTdz.Descos * -1)
			This.Value = This.peAntvalue
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf
EndIf

If This.Value # This.peantvalue

	If Seek(This.peantvalue,'csSigOpTdz','Codigos') And csSigOpTdz.nParcs > 0
		Select xpar
		Count to x For Not Empty(Fpags) And Valos # 0
		If x > 0
			MessageBox('Obrigatório Excluir as Condições de Pagamento Antes!!!',0+48,'')
			This.Value = This.peAntValue
			Return .f.
		EndIf
	EndIf

	Wait Window 'Re-calculando Preço do Produto de Acordo Com Tabela de Variação'  NoWait

	If crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2
		=ThisForm.ValidaEstoque(.f.)
	EndIf

	Select crTpmMvItn
	Store 1 to Cotacao, Cotcv, Cotacaof
	Scan 
		If !ThisForm.poDataMgr.CursorQuery('SigCdPro','CrTmpPro','Cpros',crTpmMvItn.Cpros)
			Loop
		EndIf

		Replace ValDescs  With 0 ,;
				AltImpost With .f.,;
				Utilizas  With Iif( Utilizas < 10,Utilizas, Utilizas - 10 ) In crTpmMvItn

		If crSigOpCdc.GerOpes = 2 And Not Empty(crTpmMvItn.AbrevIs)
			ThisForm.ValidaEstoque(.t.)
		Else
			ThisForm.Calc_ValIte()
		EndIf
	EndScan
	
	ThisForm.TotIte = fTotalizarItn(ThisForm.poDataMgr)

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.ValPres, 1, 3)
		_valinis = ThisForm.TotPres - TprMvCab.valdevs
	Else
		_valinis = ThisForm.Totite - TprMvCab.valdevs
	EndIf

	lnIpi = 0
	Select crSigMvNfi
	Go Top
	If !crSigMvNfi.Cancelas
		lnIpi = crSigMvNfi.ValIpis
	EndIf

	lnTran = Iif(crSigOpCdc.nChkVsts = 1, TprMvCab.ValTrans, 0)
	_valos   = _valinis + TprMvCab.valvars + TprMvCab.ValEncs + TprMvCab.ValServs + lnIpi + lnTran

	Select TprMvCab
	Replace TprMvCab.Valos With _valos,;
			TprMvCab.Valinis with _valinis in TprMvCab
	ThisForm.Pagina.Dados.pgfPrincipal.pgOperacional.getValTos.Refresh

	If InList(crSigCdOpe.nFiscals,1,2)
		ThisForm.Calcimposto(.T.)
	EndIf

EndIf

Wait Clear

If IsEmpty(This.Value) And InList(crSigCdOpe.TabDObrigs,1,3) And Lastkey() <> 27 And .f.
	MessageBox('Obrigatório Informar Tabela de Variação.',48,'Informação Obrigatória')
	Return 0
EndIf
ENDPROC

This.peantvalue = This.Value
Return Inlist( ThisForm.pcEscolha, 'INSERIR', 'ALTERAR' ) And crSigCdOpe.Confes # 1 And crSigCdOpe.TabDescs # 6
